Half Plate.name: 半身板甲 Half Plate
Half Plate.description:
半身板甲由全身板甲所用的大部分上半身板片组成，而手臂与腿部则使用更轻或更稀疏的钢板防护。这使其在保有部分全身板甲防护力的同时，具有更佳的灵活性与速度。一套这种护甲附带一件内衬的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zBYEU9E7034ENCmh]{软甲} 与一副 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ix2vicchE79d6Cl3]{臂铠}。

Half plate consists of most of the upper body plates used in full plate, with lighter or sparser steel plate protection for the arms and legs. This provides some of the protection of full plate with greater flexibility and speed. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zBYEU9E7034ENCmh]{Padded Armor} and a pair of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ix2vicchE79d6Cl3]{gauntlets}.

Void Healing.name: 虚空 治疗 Void Healing

Broad Swipe.name: 横扫攻击 Broad Swipe
Broad Swipe.description:
巨人用它的长柄刀对两个相邻的敌人各进行一次打击，这两个敌人都在它的触及范围内。这两次攻击都计入巨人的多重攻击减值，但该减值要在两次攻击都结束后才会增加。

The giant makes two Strikes with its glaive against two adjacent foes, both of whom are within its reach. Both attacks count toward the giant's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.

Terrifying Charge.name: 骇人冲锋 Terrifying Charge
Terrifying Charge.description:
巨人疾走并以其角进行一次打击，此次打击的伤害获得+4环境加值。

若该打击命中，巨人尝试对目标进行[[/act demoralize]]。

The giant Strides and makes a horns Strike with a +4 circumstance bonus to damage.

If the strike hits, the giant attempts to [[/act demoralize]] the target.

Skeletal Giant.publicNotes:
巨人的复苏骸骨是极佳的死灵奴仆。

受控的骷髅（特征）是最常见的不死生物类型之一。

The reanimated bones of giants make excellent necromantic thralls.

Animated skeletons are among the most common types of undead.

Zombie Shambler.name: 丧尸（特征）蹒跚者 Zombie Shambler

Jaws.name: 啃咬 Jaws
Jaws.description:
需求 该丧尸具有一名生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} 状态。

Requirements The zombie has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
丧尸（特征）永久处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，且无法使用反应动作（）。

A zombie is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Zombie Shambler.publicNotes:
一只丧尸（特征）蹒跚者是一种行动迟缓的恐怖之物，在更大规模的群体中尤为危险。

丧尸（特征）唯一的渴望就是吞噬活人。丧尸（特征）毫无思考、永远蹒跚前行，是死亡的先兆，只有在它们被摧毁时才会停下。

A zombie shambler is a slow-moving horror dangerous in larger groups.

A zombie's only desire is to consume the living. Unthinking and ever-shambling harbingers of death, zombies stop only when they're destroyed.

Zozzlarin.name: 佐兹拉林 Zozzlarin

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你立刻将自己以及你穿戴和持握的任何物品从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的、在射程内的一处空旷空间中。若这会将另一名生物一同带上——即便你正将其装在异次元容器中携带——该法术将失效。

增幅（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里并知晓其相对于你的位置与距离即可。你获得持续1小时的临时免疫。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dimension Door (At Will).name: 次元门（随意） Dimension Door (At Will)
Dimension Door (At Will).description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立刻将自己以及你穿戴和持有的所有物品从你当前的空间传送到射程内你能看见的一处空旷空间中。若此举会将另一个生物一同带来——即使你把它装在一个异次元容器里携带——该法术会失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见你的目的地，只要你过去去过那里，并且知道它相对你的位置与距离即可。你会暂时获得免疫，持续1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only).name: 隐形术（意志）（仅自身） Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only)
Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only).description:
披覆于幻术之中，目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言都处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未探明}，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对他们而言改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐藏}。如果目标使用敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但即使目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Infernal Pact.name: 地狱契约 Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description:
你向一位强大的魔鬼提出请求，请它将一些下属束缚为你效劳。若你成功，该魔鬼会依其选择派遣给你以下之一：一名魔鬼，其等级不超过炼狱契约环阶的两倍；两名魔鬼，其等级各自都至少比该法术环阶两倍低2；或三名魔鬼，其等级各自都至少比该法术环阶两倍低3。

大成功或大失败 魔鬼被派遣到你身边，并为你效劳[[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 魔鬼被派遣到你身边，并为你效劳[[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大成功或大失败 不仅你的提出请求被拒绝，那位强大的魔鬼还会把其不悦传话给你的主人。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you its choice of one devil whose level is no more than double infernal pact's rank, two devils whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three devils whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声用口型说出词句，但这些词并不会从你的口中发出，而是直接传到目标的耳中。其他人听到你的词语并不会比你平常做口型时更清楚，但目标能听得一清二楚，仿佛他们正站在你身旁。

目标可以以反应动作（）做出简短回应，或者如果他们愿意，也可以在他们下一回合以自由动作（）回应，但他们必须能够看见你并且在射程内才能这么做。若他们回应，他们的回应会像原本的传讯术一样，直接传到你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you.

The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Summon Animal (Swarm creatures only).name: 召唤动物（仅限虫群生物） Summon Animal (Swarm creatures only)
Summon Animal (Swarm creatures only).description:
你召唤一只动物为你战斗。你召唤一个具有动物（特征）的普通生物，其等级为-1，例如在《Pathfinder Bestiary》各卷中所列者。升阶该法术会提高你能召唤的生物的最高等级。

升阶（2环） 等级 1

升阶（3环） 等级 2

升阶（4环） 等级 3

升阶（5环） 等级 5

升阶（6环） 等级 7

升阶（7环） 等级 9

升阶（8环） 等级 11

升阶（9环） 等级 13

升阶（10环） 等级 15

You conjure an animal to fight for you. You summon a common creature that has the animal trait and whose level is -1, such as those found in Pathfinder Bestiary volumes. Heightening the spell increases the maximum level of creature you can summon.

Heightened (2nd) Level 1

Heightened (3rd) Level 2

Heightened (4th) Level 3

Heightened (5th) Level 5

Heightened (6th) Level 7

Heightened (7th) Level 9

Heightened (8th) Level 11

Heightened (9th) Level 13

Heightened (10th) Level 15

Greater Darkvision.name: 强化黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对所有对抗魔法的豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Cocytan Filth.name: 科西坦污秽 Cocytan Filth
Cocytan Filth.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

潜伏期 [[/gmr 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{衰弱 1} (1 day)

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{衰弱 2} (1 day)

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{衰弱 3} (1 day)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

Onset [[/gmr 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} (1 day)

Infernal Eye.name: 炼狱之眼 Infernal Eye
Infernal Eye.description:
斥控魔会记录他们所看到的一切，尽管他们不会记住所有观察，但他们可以将其传递给另一个生物。

斥控魔向一个被触碰且自愿的生物重放10分钟的所见事件，该生物会在一瞬间的信息闪现中接收这些记忆。通过保持接触，斥控魔可以花费额外的3动作活动来重放更多信息。

在将他们的幻象转述给他者之后，斥控魔将再也无法回忆起那些事件。

The zebub records everything they see, and though they don't remember all observations, they can pass them along to another creature.

The zebub replays 10 minutes of witnessed events to a touched willing creature, which receives the memories in a flash of information. By remaining in contact, the zebub can spend additional 3-action activities to replay more information.

After relaying their visions to another, the zebub can't ever recall those events again.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
斥控魔的打击会对处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}状态的生物造成额外1d6精准伤害。

The zebub's Strikes deal an additional 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Zozzlarin.publicNotes:
斥控魔担任地狱的信使与间谍。它们能够与其他生物分享所见之事的能力使其格外有用——不仅对其他魔鬼如此，对凡人的召唤师亦然。一些地狱领主会将它们以庞大而可憎的虫群释放到毫无防备的土地上，在搜罗地狱军势日后可能派上用场的秘密的同时，贬损血肉与大地。斥控魔会利用任何机会，操纵意志薄弱或容易受诱惑的凡人去服从斥控魔的心血来潮。尽管傲慢而狡诈，斥控魔却缺乏多数魔鬼所具备的狡黠与自信，因此它们的阴谋往往着眼于满足自利或自我毁灭的野心。斥控魔由幼稚而怯懦的凡人灵魂形成，在地狱第七层柯西 图斯冰冷肮脏的荒原中，被魔鬼大公巴尔泽布重塑而成。

每一种魔鬼都在地狱的官僚体系与等级结构中扮演特定角色，不过有些魔鬼的职能要比其他魔鬼专门得多。

Zebubs serve as Hell's messengers and spies. Their ability to share what they've seen with other creatures makes them especially useful-not only to other devils, but also to mortal conjurers. Some infernal lords unleash them in enormous, horrid swarms upon unsuspecting lands to debase flesh and land alike while collecting secrets the infernal host might later put to use. Zebubs use any opportunity to manipulate weak-willed or easily tempted mortals into serving the zebubs' whims. While arrogant and deceitful, zebubs lack the cunning and confidence of most devils, and thus their schemes often focus on satisfying self-serving or self-destructive ambitions. Zebubs form from the souls of childish and craven mortals, reshaped by the archdevil Baalzebul in the frozen, filthy wastes of Hell's seventh layer, Cocytus.

Each type of devil plays a particular role in Hell's bureaucracies and hierarchies, though some have far more specialized functions than others.
Zozzlarin.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Brown Mold.name: 褐霉菌 Brown Mold

Emit Cold.name: 散发寒冷 Emit Cold
Emit Cold.description:
5英尺。褐霉菌对附近的生物造成 @Damage[2d6[cold]] 伤害。

5 feet. Brown mold deals @Damage[2d6[cold]] damage to nearby creatures.

Leech Warmth.name: 吸取暖意 Leech Warmth
Leech Warmth.description:
触发 火焰进入距褐霉菌5英尺内。

效果 褐霉菌扩张到其空间相邻的每一格。随着它生长，它从周围环境中抽取更多热量，在其扩张后对10英尺内的生物造成 @Damage[(2d6+6)[cold]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] 豁免）。

Trigger Fire comes within 5 feet of the brown mold.

Effect The brown mold expands into every square adjacent to its space. As it grows, it pulls more heat from its surroundings, dealing @Damage[(2d6+6)[cold]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] save) to creatures within 10 feet after it expands.

Brown Mold.disable:
@Check[survival|dc:18|name:移除褐霉菌|traits:environmental,fungus]（受训）以安全地移除霉菌

@Check[survival|dc:18|name:Remove Brown Mold|traits:environmental,fungus] (trained) to safely remove the mold
Brown Mold.hazarddescription:
这种不起眼的真菌会从空气中汲取热量。

This unassuming fungus leeches heat out of the air.
Brown Mold.reset:
扩张后，褐霉菌在1天内无法再次生长。

After expanding, the brown mold can't grow again for 1 day.

Doom of Tomorrow.name: 明日之厄 Doom of Tomorrow
Doom of Tomorrow.tokenName: 明日之厄 Doom of Tomorrow

Apocalypse Beam.name: 天启射线 Apocalypse Beam
Apocalypse Beam.description:
触发 一名生物快步进入距离立体景观壁龛背面10尺以内

效果 该陷阱对那名生物发射一道天启射线。

Trigger A creature steps within 10 feet of the back of a diorama alcove

Effect The trap fires an apocalypse beam at that creature.

Apocalypse Beam (From Tsunami).name: 天启射线（来自海啸） Apocalypse Beam (From Tsunami)

Apocalypse Beam (from Burning City).name: 天启射线（出自《燃烧之城》） Apocalypse Beam (from Burning City)

Apocalypse Beam (from Earthquake).name: 天启射线（来自地震） Apocalypse Beam (from Earthquake)

Apocalypse Beam (from Monster).name: 天启射线（来自怪物） Apocalypse Beam (from Monster)

Apocalypse Beam (from Undead Uprising).name: 天启射线（出自《Undead Uprising》） Apocalypse Beam (from Undead Uprising)

Doom of Tomorrow.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:20|name:迅速解除凄凉灯塔模型|traits:magical,trap]（受训）以在凄凉灯塔模型触发前迅速将其解除，或 @Check[stealth|dc:23|name:潜行绕过陷阱|traits:magical,trap]（受训）以在不触发陷阱的情况下悄悄绕过。

@Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Deactivate Model of Gauntlight|traits:magical,trap] (trained) to quickly deactivate the model of Gauntlight before it triggers, or @Check[stealth|dc:23|name:Creep by Trap|traits:magical,trap] (trained) to creep by a trap without triggering it.
Doom of Tomorrow.hazarddescription:
毁灭的声响从立体模型中升起，一道闪烁的能量光束从凄凉灯塔的微型模型中激射而出。

The sounds of devastation rise from the diorama, and a beam of shimmering energy lances outward from the tiny model of Gauntlight.
Doom of Tomorrow.reset:
每个陷阱都会在1小时后自动重置。

Each trap resets automatically after 1 hour.
Doom of Tomorrow.prototypeToken: 明日之厄 Doom of Tomorrow

Spike Launcher.name: 尖钉发射器 Spike Launcher

Spike.name: 尖钉 Spike
Spike.description:
触发 一名生物穿过其中一条绊线

效果 一枚尖钉沿着绊线的路径向触发生物发射，进行一次远程打击。

Trigger A creature crosses one of the trip lines

Effect A spike launches along the trip line's path against the triggering creature, making a ranged Strike.

Spike Launcher.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:16|name:停用发射器|traits:机械,陷阱] 以停用四个发射器之一，或 @Check[acrobatics|dc:12|name:避开绊线|traits:机械,陷阱] 以跨过一条绊线（这不会解除陷阱，但能避免触发它）

@Check[thievery|dc:16|name:Disable Launcher|traits:mechanical,trap] to disable one of the four launchers or @Check[acrobatics|dc:12|name:Avoid Trip Line|traits:mechanical,trap] to step over a trip line (this doesn't disarm the trap, but avoids triggering it)
Spike Launcher.hazarddescription:
一根锯齿状的金属尖钉从隐藏的发射器中射出。

A jagged spike of metal shoots from a hidden launcher.

Web Lurker Noose.name: 伏网怪绞索 Web Lurker Noose
Web Lurker Noose.tokenName: 伏网怪套索 Web Lurker Noose

Web Noose.name: 蛛网术绞索 Web Noose
Web Noose.description:
触发 一名生物踏入带有蛛网术绊线的方格。

效果 伏网怪的套索对触发生物进行一次套索打击。

Trigger A creature steps into the square with the web tripwire.

Effect The web lurker noose makes a noose Strike against the triggering creature.

Noose.name: 套索 Noose
Noose.description:
在一次成功的打击后，目标会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{被擒抱}状态，并被拉离地面（[[/act 逃脱 dc=22]]）。

只要目标被套索套住，它就在每个自己的回合结束时承受 @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] 伤害。

On a successful strike, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and pulled off the ground ([[/act escape dc=22]]).

The target takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage at the end of each of its turns as long as it's caught in the noose.

Web Lurker Noose.disable:
@Check[survival|dc:18|name:重新布置蛛网|traits:mechanical,trap]（受训）或 @Check[thievery|dc:18|name:重新布置蛛网|traits:mechanical,trap]（专家）来重新布置蛛网。

@Check[survival|dc:18|name:Rearrange the Webbing|traits:mechanical,trap] (trained) or @Check[thievery|dc:18|name:Rearrange the Webbing|traits:mechanical,trap] (expert) to rearrange the webbing.

Slick.description:
该属性使护甲变得湿滑，仿佛涂覆了一层薄薄的油膜。你获得对用于【逃脱】与【挤入空间】的特技检定的+1物品加值。

Retribution Axe.name: 复仇斧 Retribution Axe
Retribution Axe.description:
这把+1 巨斧的斧刃上刻有一个人类头骨的图案。

每当一个生物以一次攻击对你造成伤害时，头骨就会改变外观，看起来像那个生物的面孔。你在你下个回合结束前，对该生物的下一次伤害掷骰获得+2 环境加值。

由于每次你受到伤害时面孔都会重塑，只有当你攻击最近一次对你造成伤害的生物时，你才会获得这额外伤害。

自动应用的效果：

  • 对最后一个对你造成伤害的生物的下一次伤害掷骰获得+2 环境加值

The blade of this +1 greataxe bears a design of a human skull.

Whenever a creature damages you with an attack, the skull changes its appearance to look like the face of that creature. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next damage roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

Because the face reshapes each time you're damaged, you get the additional damage only if you attack the creature that damaged you most recently.

Automatically applied effects:

  • +2 circumstance bonus to your next damage roll against the last creature to damage you

Wayfinder.name: 寻路仪 Wayfinder
Wayfinder.description:
许可 开拓者协会成员

这个小巧的罗盘将古老科技重新利用，以从一种名为永劫石的神秘魔法物品中汲取奇异力量。它既是开拓者协会探员的职务徽记，也是各类冒险者间的身份象征。寻路仪可作为罗盘使用。

寻路仪中央的凹槽可容纳一枚永劫石。将永劫石放入该凹槽可让你获得其绕头飞旋时的全部好处，同时还能保护石头不易被注意到或被偷走。你可同时灌注寻路仪及其中的永劫石，并且它们在你的灌注上限中仅算作一件物品。已灌注并嵌入寻路仪的永劫石也会授予其共鸣力量。

如果在同一时间你身上携带超过一个嵌有已灌注永劫石的寻路仪，它们共鸣产生的破坏性干涉会使你无法从任何一个中获得好处。你仍可从额外绕头飞旋的永劫石中获益，只是不能通过寻路仪获得。

启动—光亮(术) A（专注）

效果 寻路仪成为1环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} 法术的目标。

Access member of the Pathfinder Society

This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called aeon stones. It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. A wayfinder functions as a compass.

An indentation in the middle of the wayfinder can hold a single aeon stone. Placing an aeon stone in this indentation provides you all the benefits of having the aeon stone orbiting your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. You invest a wayfinder and the aeon stone within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward your investiture limit. An invested aeon stone slotted in a wayfinder also grants its resonant power.

If you have more than one wayfinder with an invested aeon stone on your person at a given time, destructive interference from their resonance prevents you from gaining benefits from any of them. You can still benefit from additional aeon stones orbiting your head, just not in wayfinders.

Activate—Light A (concentrate)

Effect The wayfinder is targeted by a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} spell.

Wand of Magic Missile (Level 1).name: 魔法飞弹魔杖（等级 1） Wand of Magic Missile (Level 1)
Wand of Magic Missile (Level 1).description:
这根警棍长约一英尺，内含一个法术。其外观通常与其中的法术相关。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你以标注的等级施放该法术。

制作需求 提供一次以所列等级施放该法术。

注意：要制作特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料集或资料集浏览器拖入PC、NPC或战利品角色的物品栏。

@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated level.

Craft Requirements Supply a listed-level casting of the spell.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Mesmerizing Opal.name: 迷心蛋白石 Mesmerizing Opal
Mesmerizing Opal.description:
用法 固定于护甲

启动 F 想象

触发 你尝试进行一次欺瞒检定以进行虚招，但你尚未掷骰

这枚镶银的蛋白石坠饰燃起虹彩般的光辉。当你启动它时，若你触发的欺瞒检定结果为大失败，则改为失败（或若结果为成功，则改为大成功）。

Usage affixed to armor

Activate F Envision

Trigger You attempt a Deception check to Feint, but you haven't rolled yet

This silver-bound opal pendant is afire with iridescence. When you activate it, if the outcome of your triggering Deception check is a critical failure, you get a failure instead (or if the outcome is a success, you get a critical success instead).

Shining Sling Bullets.name: 闪光投石索弹丸 Shining Sling Bullets
Shining Sling Bullets.description:
一发闪耀弹药会发出微弱的发光。射出后，该弹药在20英尺半径内提供明亮光照（并在接下来的20英尺内提供昏暗光照），持续10分钟。若命中目标，它会黏附其上，使目标在相同半径内发出光亮。生物可以用一个交互动作移除该弹药，但弹药本身会在剩余的持续时间内继续发光，或直到被摧毁为止。

A piece of shining ammunition gives off a faint glow. When shot, this ammunition sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 20 feet) for 10 minutes. If it hits a target, it sticks, causing the target to shed light in the same radius. A creature can remove the ammunition with an Interact action, but the ammunition itself continues to glow for the rest of the duration or until destroyed.

Necklace of Fireballs I.name: 火球项链 I Necklace of Fireballs I
Necklace of Fireballs I.description:
这串珠子看起来是一根麻绳，上面挂着各种大小、光泽亮丽的红色珠子。启动时，它会短暂显露真实形态：一条金色铁链，其上用细线系着金色球体。

这条项链有一颗 [[/r 6d6[fire]]] 伤害珠，以及两颗 [[/r 4d6[fire]]] 伤害珠，带有一个 @Check[type:reflex|dc:21|basic:true|showDC:all] 豁免。当所有珠子都用尽后，这条项链会变为一根非魔法的麻绳。

启动 A 互动

效果 你从项链上取下一颗球体，使其以橙色光亮发光。在你启动球体之后，若你或其他任何人将其投掷出去（一次带有远程特征的互动动作），它会在落点处如火球术般爆炸。你的投掷可将火球术的中心置于70英尺内的任意位置，不过由GM裁定，若投掷异常困难，你可能需要进行一次攻击掷骰。如果在你下一回合开始前无人投掷该球体，它会变为一颗非魔法的红色珠子。

This string of beads appears to be a hemp string with lustrous red beads of various sizes hanging from it. When activated, it briefly appears in its true form: a golden chain with golden spheres attached by fine threads.

This necklace has one [[/r 6d6[fire]]] damage and two [[/r 4d6[fire]]] damage beads with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:21|basic:true|showDC:all] save. When all the beads are gone, the necklace becomes a non-magical hemp string.

Activate A Interact

Effect You detach a sphere from the necklace, causing it to glow with orange light. After you activate a sphere, if you or anyone else hurls it (an Interact action with the ranged trait), it detonates as a fireball where it lands. Your toss can place the center of the fireballed trait), it detonates as a fireball where it lands. Your toss can place the center of the fireball anywhere within 70 feet, though at the GM's discretion you might need to make an attack roll if the throw is unusually challenging. If no one hurls the sphere by the start of your next turn, it turns into a non-magical red bead.

Osprey Thieves' Gear.name: 鱼鹰盗贼道具 Osprey Thieves' Gear
Osprey Thieves' Gear.tokenName: 一堆道具 Heap of Gear

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这套皮制护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还带有小型金属板，在提供与皮制护甲大致相同的灵活性的同时，提供更为坚固的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Thieves' Tools.name: 盗贼工具 Thieves' Tools
Thieves' Tools.description:
你需要盗贼工具来使用贼活（技能）进行开锁或禁用装置（某些类型）。

如果你的盗贼工具已损坏，你可以通过用适用于你工具的 @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.Sw7MBLASN3xK4Y44]{替换用镐} 替换开锁镐来修理它们；这不需要使用修理动作。

You need thieves' tools to Pick Locks or Disable Devices (of some types) using the Thievery skill.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.Sw7MBLASN3xK4Y44]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action.

Healing Potion (Lesser).name: 治疗药水（次级） Healing Potion (Lesser)
Healing Potion (Lesser).description:
启动 A（操作）

治疗药水是一小瓶红宝石般的深红液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时会带来刺痛般的感觉。当你饮用一瓶治疗药水时，你恢复[[/r (2d8+5)[healing]]]{2d8+5 生命值}。

Activate A (manipulate)

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain [[/r (2d8+5)[healing]]]{2d8+5 Hit Points}.

Rapier.name: +1 细剑 Rapier
Rapier.description:
+1 细剑是一把细长的穿刺刃，带有篮式护手。许多人珍视它，将其视为一把决斗武器。

The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

Osprey Thieves' Gear.prototypeToken: 一堆道具 Heap of Gear

Weapon Potency (+1).name: 武器强度（+1） Weapon Potency (+1)
Weapon Potency (+1).description:
魔法强化使这把武器打击更准。用这把武器进行的攻击掷骰获得+1物品加值，且该武器可以被蚀刻一枚属性符文。

你可以将已经蚀刻在武器上的武器威能符文升级为更强的版本，将现有符文的数值提升为新符文的数值。你必须拥有更强符文的配方才能这么做，且升级的价格为两枚符文价格之间的差额。

制造需求你是制造的专家。

Magical enhancements make this weapon strike true. Attack rolls with this weapon gain a +1 item bonus, and the weapon can be etched with one property rune.

You can upgrade the weapon potency rune already etched on a weapon to a stronger version, increasing the values of the existing rune to those of the new rune. You must have the formula of the stronger rune to do so, and the Price of the upgrade is the difference between the two runes' Prices.

Craft Requirements You are an expert in Crafting.

Fear Gem.name: 恐惧宝石 Fear Gem
Fear Gem.description:
使用 附着于一把武器

启动 D @Compendium[pf2e.feats-srd.lkcM4V3VDAtjlR9P]{威吓打击}

黑暗的烟雾似乎在这颗黑曜石宝石内部翻涌。当你启动这颗宝石时，你进行一次威吓打击，如同战士专长一般。

如果你拥有威吓打击专长，将这次威吓打击造成的惊惧（状态）值提高为惊惧 2，或在大成功时为惊惧 3。

Usage affixed to a weapon

Activate D @Compendium[pf2e.feats-srd.lkcM4V3VDAtjlR9P]{Intimidating Strike}

Dark smoke seems to writhe within this obsidian gem. When you activate the gem, you make an Intimidating Strike, as the fighter feat.

If you have the Intimidating Strike feat, increase the frightened condition value from this Intimidating Strike to frightened 2, or frightened 3 on a critical hit.

Aller Rosk.name: 阿勒·罗斯克 Aller Rosk

Consume Tattooed Flesh.name: 啃食刺青尸体 Consume Tattooed Flesh
Consume Tattooed Flesh.description:
需求 Aller与一片带纹身的碎肉相邻，或与一具在过去一小时内死亡的生物尸体相邻

Aller吞食一口血肉并恢复 @Damage[4d6[治疗]] Hit Points。若该肉块带有纹身，他还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened 1}，并可以使用这次额外动作进行一次啃咬 Strike。

随后Aller在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Consume Flesh]]{1d4轮}内无法啃食尸体。他身上带有一片带纹身的血肉。

Requirements Aller is adjacent to a tattooed scrap of flesh or to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour

Aller devours a bite of flesh and regains @Damage[4d6[healing]] Hit Points. If the piece of flesh was tattooed, he is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened 1} and can use this extra action to make a jaws Strike.

Aller then can't Consume Flesh for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Consume Flesh]]{1d4 rounds}. He has one piece of tattooed flesh on his person.

Ghoul Fever.name: 食尸鬼热 Ghoul Fever
Ghoul Fever.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良效果（1天）

阶段 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] 伤害，且从所有治疗中恢复的生命值减半（1天）

阶段 3 同阶段2（1天）

阶段 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] 伤害，且无法从治疗中获得任何益处（1天）

阶段 5 同阶段4（1天）

阶段 6 死亡，并在下一个午夜以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{食尸鬼（特征）} 的形式复起。

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{Ghoul} the next midnight.

Paralysis.name: 麻痹 Paralysis
Paralysis.description:
任何被阿勒的攻击命中的活体、非精灵生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:22] 豁免，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}。该生物可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免，并且该DC在每次此类豁免时累积降低1。

Any living, non-elf creature hit by Aller's attack must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

Swift Leap.name: 迅捷跳跃 Swift Leap
Swift Leap.description:
阿勒跳跃至最多其速度的一半。此次移动不会触发反应动作（）。

Aller jumps up to half his Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Male ghoul tattoo artist

Augrael.name: 奥格雷尔 Augrael

Consume Flesh.name: 啃食尸体 Consume Flesh
Consume Flesh.description:
需求 奥格雷尔邻接一具在过去1小时内被摧毁的不死生物的尸体。

效果 奥格雷尔吞食被摧毁的不死生物的一块残躯，并恢复 @Damage[2d6[healing]] 生命值。

他从任意给定的尸体中恢复生命值只能一次。

Requirements Augrael is adjacent to the corpse of an undead creature that was destroyed within the last hour.

Effect Augrael devours a chunk of the destroyed undead creature and regains @Damage[2d6[healing]] Hit Points.

He can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

Ghoul Fever.description:

阶段 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] 伤害，并从所有治疗中恢复一半的生命值（1天）

阶段 3 如阶段2（1天）

阶段 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] 伤害，并无法从治疗中获得任何好处（1天）

阶段 5 如阶段4（1天）

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{Ghoul} the next midnight.

Paralysis.name: 麻痹 Paralysis
Paralysis.description:
任何被奥格雷尔的攻击命中的活体、非精灵生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20] 豁免，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免，且在每次此类豁免时DC累积降低1。

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
奥格雷尔对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}生物额外造成1d6点精准伤害。

Augrael deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Swift Leap.name: 迅捷跳跃 Swift Leap
Swift Leap.description:
奥格雷尔跳跃最多不超过其速度的一半。此移动不会触发反应动作（）。

Augrael jumps up to half his Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

男性摩洛克食尸鬼被流放者

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量汲入自身，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并扰乱不死生物，甚至可能使其逃离。该效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物 该法术造成等同于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但在大失败时还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}持续1轮。
  • 不死生物 若强韧豁免失败，目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}持续1轮。若为大失败，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}持续1轮，除非其意志豁免成功。

升阶（+1） 对活体生物造成的虚空伤害增加1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你喊出一道难以忽视的命令术。你可以命令目标接近你、逃离（如同其具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）} 状态）、放开它正拿着的东西、倒下成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，或原地不动。在它服从你的命令之前，它不能延后或进行任何反应动作（）。效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在其下一回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须用一个单动作来照你命令行事。

大成功或大失败 目标必须在其下一回合用全部动作来服从你的命令术。

升阶（5环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智变得混乱，并用一次精神冲击使其陷入眩晕术。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在该豁免中大失败，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗触须从你的指尖卷出，穿空疾驰。你对线内的活体生物造成2d4点虚空伤害以及@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]点伤害。线内每个活体生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半的虚空伤害，且不承受持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物承受全部伤害。

大失败 该生物承受双倍虚空伤害以及双倍持续流血伤害。

高度强化（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4，持续流血伤害增加1。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Harm.name: 伤害术 Harm
Harm.description:
你引导虚空能量来伤害活物或治疗不死生物。若目标是活体生物，你对其造成1d8虚空伤害，并且它进行一次基础强韧豁免。若目标是自愿的不死生物，你恢复等量生命值。你在施放此法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标、射程、区域以及其他参数。

1 (姿势) 该法术的射程为接触。

2 (verbal, 姿势) 该法术的射程为30尺。若你在治疗不死生物，将恢复的生命值提高8点。

3 (材料, verbal, 姿势) 你在30尺发散中散布虚空能量。这会以区域内所有活体与不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或伤害的数值提高1d8，且2动作版本的额外治疗提高8点。

You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (material, verbal, somatic) You disperse void energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Mage Hand.name: 法师之手 Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
你创造一只单一的魔法手，它要么隐形要么呈幽灵般的形态，抓住目标物体并缓慢移动它，最远可达20尺。由于你在使该物体漂浮，你可以将其向任何方向移动。当你维持该法术时，你可以让该物体额外移动20尺。如果该物体在法术结束时仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60尺，且你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60尺，且你可以以负载为2或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成2d4点精神伤害和1d4点持续精神伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害与持续伤害，且目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，则持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大失败 同失败，但目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d4点，持续伤害增加1d4点。

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{缩放持续精神伤害}

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and 1d4 persistent mental damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，则该生物进行一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功，则使用其豁免结果低一级的成功等级之结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个在射程内、未被持握且松散的物体掷向目标，该物体的负载为1或更低。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——取决于你投掷的物体——其数值等于1d6加上你的施法能力调整值。被投掷物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响该攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Lump of Decayed Flesh Strung on a Neckla.name: 一串腐烂肉块项链 Lump of Decayed Flesh Strung on a Necklace

Consume Flesh.name: 啃食尸体 Consume Flesh
Consume Flesh.description:
需求 溃烂教徒与一具在过去1小时内死亡的生物尸体相邻，或携带一块特制的腐烂肉块。

效果 溃烂教徒吞食尸体的一块肉或腐烂肉块并恢复生命值。他们通过食用在过去1小时内死亡的生物的血肉恢复 @Damage[1d6[healing]] 生命值，通过腐烂肉块恢复 @Damage[2d6[healing]] 生命值。

教徒从任何一具特定尸体中只能恢复生命值一次。

Requirements The Canker cultist is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour, or is carrying a specially prepared lump of decaying flesh.

Effect The Canker cultist devours a chunk of the corpse or the lump of decaying flesh and regains Hit Points. They regain @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points from consuming the flesh of a creature that died within the last hour, and @Damage[2d6[healing]] Hit Points from the lump.

The cultist can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

Ghoul Fever.name: 食尸鬼热 Ghoul Fever
Ghoul Fever.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

阶段 1 携带者且无不良效果（1天）

阶段 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] 伤害，且从所有治疗中恢复的生命值减半（1天）

阶段 3 同阶段2（1天）

阶段 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] 伤害，且无法从治疗中获得任何益处（1天）

阶段 5 同阶段4（1天）

阶段 6 死亡，并在下一个午夜作为一只 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{食尸鬼（特征）} 复活。

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{Ghoul} the next midnight.

Paralysis.name: 麻痹 Paralysis
Paralysis.description:
任何被溃烂教徒的攻击命中的活体、非精灵生物必须在一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20] 豁免中成功，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免，且DC在每次这样的豁免上累积降低1。

Any living, non-elf creature hit by a Canker cultist's attack must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

Swift Leap.name: 迅捷跳跃 Swift Leap
Swift Leap.description:
邪教徒跳跃至其速度的一半。此移动不会触发反应动作（）。

The cultist jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Canker Cultist.blurb:
食尸鬼狂热者
Ghoul zealot

Chandriu Invisar.name: 尚德里·尹萨 Chandriu Invisar

Site Bound.name: 束缚之地 Site Bound
Site Bound.description:
区域 C36 和 C37。

典型的幽灵（特征）只能离开其被杀之处或其出没之地的短距离。典型的限制是120英尺。有些幽灵（特征）并非绑定于某个地点，而是绑定于对其意义特殊的房间、建筑、物品或生物。

Area C36 and C37.

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
要让昌德丽乌永久安息，一名英雄必须以一次成功的@Check[diplomacy|dc:21|name:Convince Chandriu|overrideTraits:true]检定说服她停止对沃卢克的思念。

无论此次检定结果如何，昌德丽乌都会勃然大怒并发动攻击；但若交涉检定成功，她在战斗期间会在10轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓1}。若在她迟缓期间击败她，她便会安息。

当一个幽灵（特征）被摧毁时，它会在[[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后于其所束缚的地点内重新成形，并完全痊愈。只有当有人查明其存在的原因，并纠正任何阻止该灵魂休息的事物时，幽灵（特征）才能被永久摧毁。

To put Chandriu to rest permanently, a hero must convince her to stop pining over Volluk with a successful @Check[diplomacy|dc:21|name:Convince Chandriu|overrideTraits:true] check.

Regardless of the result of this check, Chandriu flies into a rage and attacks, but if the Diplomacy check is successful, she is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 10 rounds while she fights. If defeated while she is slowed, she is put to rest.

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Void Healing.name: 虚空 治疗 Void Healing

Despairing Cry.name: 绝望哭喊 Despairing Cry
Despairing Cry.description:
钱德莉乌因自己的失去与背叛而陷入绝望的哀嚎，迫使30英尺内的每个活着的生物尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:24] 豁免。

在失败时，生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓1}（在大失败时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓2}），持续1轮，因为他们被自己错失的机会所带来的悲伤所淹没。在成功时，生物在1分钟内暂时免疫钱德莉乌的绝望哭喊。

Chandriu wails in despair at her loss and betrayal, forcing each living creature within 30 feet to attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save.

On a failure, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure) for 1 round as they are overcome with sadness over their own missed opportunities. On a success, a creature is temporarily immune to Chandriu's Despairing Cry for 1 minute.

Chandriu Invisar.blurb:
女性卓尔幽灵管理员
Female drow ghost administrator

Ghoul.name: 食尸鬼（特征） Ghoul

Consume Flesh.name: 啃食尸体 Consume Flesh
Consume Flesh.description:
需求 食尸鬼（特征）邻接于一具在过去1小时内死亡的生物的尸体。

效果 食尸鬼（特征）吞食尸体的一块肉，并恢复 @Damage[1d6[healing]] 生命值。

它只能从任意一具给定的尸体中恢复生命值一次。

Requirements The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour.

Effect The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points.

It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

Ghoul Fever.name: 食尸鬼热 Ghoul Fever
Ghoul Fever.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:15]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良效果（1天）

阶段 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] 伤害，并从所有治疗中恢复一半的生命值（1天）

阶段 3 同阶段2（1天）

阶段 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] 伤害，并无法从治疗中获得任何好处（1天）

阶段 5 同阶段4（1天）

阶段 6 死亡，并在下一个午夜复活为一只 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{食尸鬼（特征）}。

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:15]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{Ghoul} the next midnight.

Paralysis.name: 麻痹 Paralysis
Paralysis.description:
任何被食尸鬼（特征）的攻击命中的活着的、非精灵生物必须在一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:15] 豁免中成功，否则将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免，并且在每次此类豁免时DC累计降低1。

Any living, non-elf creature hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:15] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

Swift Leap.name: 迅捷跳跃 Swift Leap
Swift Leap.description:
食尸鬼跳跃至其速度的一半。此次移动不会触发反应动作。

The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Ghoul.publicNotes:

Gibbering Mouther.publicNotes:
由喋喋不休的口器与渗出的、血肉般的烂泥构成的无定形团块，呓语之喉是地表与地下最为怪异的生物之一。它们永远饥饿，这些异怪总在寻找下一顿餐食，吃个不停却从不满足。呓语之喉只有最低限度的智力，能理解甚至能说邪灵语，但它们真正能以可理解的方式表达的情况极其罕见。取而代之的是，它们无数张嘴持续不断地咿呀乱语，形成一股声音洪流，扰乱区域内其他生物的思维模式。

呓语之喉起源于何处、以何种方式、为何而生，都是无解之问。它们与更为强大的修格斯有某些相似之处，因此有人提出两者同出一源；不那么宽厚的学者则认为，呓语之喉不过是凡人试图创造某种类似修格斯之物的产物——但为何要这么做依旧没有答案。还有人相信，呓语之喉是神祇为惩罚某种早已被遗忘却必然可怖的罪行而将其送入世界。至于呓语之喉自身对此几乎无话可说——至少谈不上任何意义。学者们耗费了无数小时试图理解呓语之喉的噪音；这些研究不仅让研究者身陷险境，其所得结论也充其量只是彼此矛盾、令人困惑。

不论其起源如何，呓语之喉遍布格拉利昂全境。人们曾在古老城市与遗迹之下的地城中记录到目击事件，也曾在塞卡米娜与奥弗这两层更深的幽暗地域诸多地区见到它们。在纳尔-沃斯的上层地区它们相对少见，或许是因为那里聚居地更为常见，而这些聚居地并不容忍呓语之喉的存在。

Amorphous blobs of yammering mouths and oozing, fleshy sludge, gibbering mouthers are among the strangest creatures found either aboveground or below. Perpetually ravenous, these aberrations are always seeking their next meals, ever eating but never sated. With a nominal intelligence, gibbering mouthers can understand and even speak Aklo, but they do so in an intelligible manner only rarely. Instead, their innumerable mouths constantly jabber and babble in a stream of sound that disrupts the thought patterns of other creatures in the area.

Where, how, and why gibbering mouthers originated are questions without answers. They share certain similarities with the much more powerful shoggoths, leading to theories that the two creatures share an origin; less charitable scholars have suggested that the gibbering mouther is instead a mortal's attempt to create something akin to a shoggoth-though the question of why remains unanswered. Still others believe gibbering mouthers were sent to the world by the gods as a punishment for some forgotten but surely terrible transgression. Gibbering mouthers themselves have little to say on the matter-at least, not in any sort of sense. Scholars have wasted countless hours in attempts to make sense of gibbering mouthers' noises-studies that put researchers into danger and give results that are contradictory and confusing at best.

Whatever their origin, gibbering mouthers range the entirety of Golarion. Sightings have been recorded in dungeons below ancient cities and ruins as well as many regions of the deeper Darklands layers of Sekamina and Orv. They are somewhat less common in the upper region of Nar-Voth, perhaps due to the prevalence of settlements that don't tolerate gibbering mouthers' presence.

Site Bound.name: 束缚之地 Site Bound
Site Bound.description:
区域 C13

典型的幽灵（特征）只能离开它被杀之处或它所萦绕的地方很短的距离。典型的限制是120英尺。有些幽灵（特征）则不是被束缚在某个地点，而是被束缚在对它而言很特别的房间、建筑、物品或生物上。

Area C13

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
移除这间房间的桌子和工具可让贾蕾尔前往来世。

当一个具有幽灵（特征）的存在被摧毁时，它会在其所束缚的地点于[[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后重新成形，并完全恢复。只有当有人查明其存在的原因，并纠正阻止该灵体休息的一切时，具有幽灵（特征）的存在才会被永久摧毁。

Removing this room's tables and tools allows Jarelle to move on to the afterlife.

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Malevolent Possession.name: 恶意占据 Malevolent Possession

Jarelle attempts to possess an adjacent corporeal creature. This has the same effect as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} spell (with a spell DC of 22), except since Jarelle doesn't have a physical body, she is unaffected by that restriction of the spell.

Jarelle 呼出一片 @Template[cone|distance:15] 的剧毒雾气，造成 @Damage[5d6[poison]|options:area-damage] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:22|basic] 豁免；在大失败时，目标还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}，持续24小时）。

随后她在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Poisoned Breath]]{1d4轮} 内无法再次使用剧毒吐息。

Jarelle exhales a @Template[cone|distance:15] of toxic mist that deals @Damage[5d6[poison]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:22|basic] save; on a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 24 hours).

She then can't use Poisoned Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Poisoned Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会将自己以及你穿戴和持握的所有物品从你当前的空间瞬间传送至你能看见的、在射程内的一处空旷空间。若这会让另一个生物与你一同前往——即使你正将其携带在一个异次元容器中——该法术将失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对你的位置与距离即可。你会暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道其相对于你的方位与距离即可。你会暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Infernal Pact.name: 炼狱契约 Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description:
你向一位强大的魔鬼提出请求，恳求它将一些下属束缚起来为你效劳。若你成功，该魔鬼会派遣它所选的一名魔鬼（其等级不超过地狱契约阶位的两倍）、两名魔鬼（其等级各自至少比该法术阶位两倍低2）、或三名魔鬼（其等级各自至少比该法术阶位两倍低3）。

大成功或大失败 这些魔鬼会被派到你身边，并为你效劳[[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 这些魔鬼会被派到你身边，并为你效劳[[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大成功或大失败 不仅你的提出请求被拒绝，而且那位强大的魔鬼会把它的不悦传话给你的主人。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you its choice of one devil whose level is no more than double infernal pact's rank, two devils whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three devils whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Infernal Wound.description:
长须魔鬼的长柄刀打击还会造成@Damage[1d6[bleed]]，该流血会抗拒治疗它的尝试。

用于止住流血的纯骰检定起始为@Check[flat|dc:20]。仅当流血的生物或一名盟友成功援助其恢复时，该DC才会降低至@Check[flat|dc:15]。对具有地狱创伤的生物执行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{实施急救}的DC提高5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.inLBsuLRE5xmVHdn]{效果：地狱创伤}

A bearded devil's glaive Strike also deals @Damage[1d6[bleed]] that resists attempts to heal it.

The flat check to stop the bleeding starts at @Check[flat|dc:20]. The DC is reduced to @Check[flat|dc:15] only if the bleeding creature or an ally successfully assists with the recovery. The DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid} to a creature with an infernal wound is increased by 5.

此移动不会触发反应动作（）。

Trigger The devil hits a creature with a glaive Strike.

Effect The devil moves the creature 5 feet in any direction. The destination square must be within reach of the devil's glaive.

This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Wriggling Beard.name: 蠕动胡须 Wriggling Beard
Wriggling Beard.description:

效果 胡须魔进行一次胡须打击。此次打击无视其多重攻击减值，且不会计入该减值。

Frequency once per round.

Effect The barbazu makes a beard Strike. This Strike ignores their multiple attack penalty and doesn't count toward that penalty.

Korlok.publicNotes:
胡须魔，也被称为长胡子的魔鬼或步兵魔鬼，是嗜杀的恶魔，它们通过充当地狱军队的步兵来满足自己对毁灭的渴望，常常率领小魔鬼与莱莫雷等较低等的魔鬼群投入战斗。长胡子的魔鬼挥舞带锯齿的关刀，造成参差不齐的裂伤，能抵抗治疗魔法，从而导致惊人的失血。当敌人靠得太近时，长胡子的魔鬼便用其蠕动胡须上的尖刺攻击，传播一种名为“阿弗纳斯热”的可憎传染病，陶醉于目睹受害者的力量从体内被缓慢吞噬的景象。

在地狱各层的邪恶炼狱领主麾下，都能找到胡须魔；它们残暴地放纵这些领主的心血来潮，并在随其意愿散播谋杀、苦难与痛楚时欢欣鼓舞。

作为腐化的大师与征服的设计者，魔鬼既试图诱惑凡人生命加入它们对一切亵渎之物的追逐，也试图将暴政传播到所有世界。它们向凡人提供的诱惑，从签署炼狱契约而获得的强大力量，到对某位恶魔庇护者耳语般的誓言之后得到的扭曲恩惠，或是数量繁多、更加隐晦的交易。那些屈服于这些诱惑的人，会被打入地狱深坑中无尽折磨的来世；在那里，唯一的逃脱希望，便是有机会获得晋升，成为炼狱序列中的一名魔鬼。每个魔鬼在这台无情的官僚机器——地狱——的运转维护中都有特定职责，从士兵与学者到审讯官、律师、法官与刽子手。卑微的莱莫雷与小魔鬼为更强大且更专业的魔鬼从事卑下劳役，例如契约魔鬼与艾琳涅丝；而最强大的深渊魔则能命令整支炼狱军团。

Barbazus, known also as bearded devils or infantry devils, are murderous fiends who satiate their lust for annihilation by serving as the foot soldiers of Hell's armies, often leading hordes of lesser devils such as imps and lemures into battle. Bearded devils wield serrated glaives to inflict jagged gashes that resist healing magic, resulting in tremendous blood loss. When enemies come too close, bearded devils strike with the spines of their wriggling beards to deliver a wretched contagion called Avernal fever, savoring the sight of their victim's strength being slowly devoured from within.

Barbazus can be found savagely indulging the whims of evil infernal lords from all layers of Hell, rejoicing as they disseminate murder, misery, and anguish as they see fit.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks. Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly lemures and imps perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as contract devils and erinyes, while the greatest pit fiends command entire infernal armies.
