Variant skeletal hulk

Chafkhem.name: 查夫肯姆 Chafkhem

Arcane Prepared Spells.name: 奥术预备法术 Arcane Prepared Spells

Freedom of Movement.name: 行动自如 Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
你能排斥会妨碍生物或令其移动变得迟缓的效果。在此法术效果影响下，目标无视任何会使其速度承受环境减值的效果。当其尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}一个使其处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}的效果时，除非该效果是魔法且阶位高于行动自如法术，否则其自动成功。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{法术效果：行动自如}

You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the freedom of movement spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Freedom of Movement}

Phantasmal Killer.name: 魅影杀手 Phantasmal Killer
Phantasmal Killer.description:
你为目标创造出一个它所能想象到的最可怕生物的幻影。只有该法术的目标能看见这个杀手，不过你能看见这幻象疾驰向前发动攻击时的模糊轮廓。杀手的效果基于目标进行意志豁免的结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到4d6精神伤害并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标受到8d6精神伤害并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大失败 目标恐惧至极，以至于可能会死去。它必须尝试一次强韧豁免；若目标失败，则它死亡。在成功的强韧豁免下，目标受到12d6精神伤害，直到其下个回合结束前陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}。此效果具有失能（特征）。

增幅（+1） 在失败时伤害增加2d6，在大失败时伤害增加3d6。

You create a phantasmal image of the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target. Only the spell's target can see the killer, though you can see the vague shape of the illusion as it races forth to attack. The effect of the killer is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes 8d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is so afraid it might die. It must attempt a Fortitude save; if the target fails, it dies. On a successful Fortitude save, the target takes 12d6 mental damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}. This effect has the incapacitation trait.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and by 3d6 on a critical failure.

Spell Immunity.name: 法术免疫 Spell Immunity
Spell Immunity.description:
你守护一名生物，使其免受单一法术的效果影响。选择一个法术，并将其名称作为言语成分的一部分大声说出。每当法术免疫的目标成为所命名法术的目标，或位于该法术的区域内时，法术免疫都会尝试反制该法术。若成功反制一个以区域或多个目标为目标的法术，法术免疫仅对受法术免疫影响的目标抵消其效果。

You ward a creature against the effects of a single spell. Choose a spell and name it aloud as part of the verbal component. Spell immunity attempts to counteract that spell whenever spell immunity's target is the target of the named spell or in that spell's area. Successfully counteracting a spell that targets an area or multiple targets with spell immunity negates the effects only for the target affected by spell immunity.

Awaken Portal.name: 唤醒传送门 Awaken Portal
Awaken Portal.description:
你试图通过向一扇休眠的门、传送门或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{传送法阵} 注入魔法能量来重新激活它。此仪式必须成功施行两次，分别在该传送门连接的两个地点各进行一次。虽然在憎恨魔窟中发现的传送法阵与传送门不需要任何额外花费即可唤醒，但其他传送门可能需要稀有物品或特定材料作为此仪式的代价，由GM酌情决定——有些传送门甚至可能强大到此仪式完全无法将其唤醒。

大成功或大失败 你唤醒传送门。若其另一侧已被唤醒，则该传送门可以正常使用，且不会自然停用。若其另一侧尚未唤醒，则此侧将保持唤醒状态1年，这可能为你留出足够的时间去找到并唤醒相连的传送门。

成功 同大成功或大失败，但若传送门另一侧尚未唤醒，则此侧仅保持唤醒状态[[/r 1d6 #days]]{1d6 days}，随后淡化并再次陷入休眠。

失败 你未能启动传送门，且魔法反冲使你陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} 状态，持续24小时。

大成功或大失败 同失败，但此外，一名敌对生物会被吸引穿过传送门，并立刻攻击在场的任何人。被吸引穿过传送门的生物会因传送门的性质而异

You attempt to reactivate a dormant gate, portal, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circle} by infusing it with magical energies. This ritual must be successfully performed twice, once at each location the portal connects. While the teleportation circles and portals found in the Abomination Vaults require no additional cost to awaken, other portals might require rare items or specific materials as a cost for this ritual at the GM's discretion—some portals might even be so powerful that this ritual cannot awaken them at all.

Critical Success You awaken the portal. If its other side is awakened, the portal can be used normally and won't deactivate naturally. If its other side is not awakened, this side remains awakened for 1 year, possibly allowing you enough time to find and awaken the connecting portal.

Success As critical success, but if the portal's other side is not awakened, this side remains awakened for only [[/r 1d6 #days]]{1d6 days} before it fades and falls dormant again.

Failure You fail to activate the portal, and magical backlash leaves you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 24 hours.

Critical Failure As failure, but in addition, a hostile creature is drawn through the portal and immediately attacks anyone present. The creature drawn through the portal varies, according to the portal's nature

Glyph of Warding.name: 守卫刻文 Glyph of Warding
Glyph of Warding.description:
你通过将一个敌对法术束缚进一个符号来制作一处陷阱。在施放该法术时，你还要施放一个更低法术环阶的法术以将其储存在刻文中。储存的法术必须只需3个动作或更少即可施放，具有敌对效果，并以一个生物为目标或具有一个区域。你可以为刻文设定口令、一个触发条件，或两者皆有。任何移动、打开或触碰目标容器，或进入目标区域，且没有说出口令或符合触发条件的生物，都会启动刻文，释放其中的有害法术。

一旦有法术被储存在刻文中，刻文获得该法术的所有特征。若储存的法术以一个或多个生物为目标，它以触发刻文的生物为目标。若其具有区域，则该区域以触发刻文的生物为中心。守卫刻文的持续时间在刻文被触发时结束。刻文被视为一个魔法陷阱；用你的法术DC来进行用于察觉检定以注意到它，以及用于神术检定以解除它；这两项检定都要求尝试者受训才可能成功。

你可以解消守卫刻文。你在同一时间内可维持生效的守卫刻文最大数量等于你的施法能力调整值。

You craft a trap by binding a hostile spell into a symbol. While Casting this Spell, you also Cast a Spell of a lower spell rank to store in the glyph. The stored spell must take 3 actions or fewer to cast, have a hostile effect, and target one creature or have an area. You can set a password, a trigger, or both for the glyph. Any creature that moves, opens, or touches the target container or enters the target area that doesn't speak the password or that matches the trigger activates the glyph, releasing the harmful spell within.

Once a spell is stored in the glyph, the glyph gains all the traits of that spell. If the stored spell targets one or more creatures, it targets the creature that set off the glyph. If it has an area, that area is centered on the creature that set off the glyph. Glyph of warding's duration ends when the glyph is triggered. The glyph counts as a magical trap, using your spell DC for both the Perception check to notice it and the Thievery check to disable it; both checks require the creature attempting them to be trained in order to succeed.

You can Dismiss glyph of warding. The maximum number of glyphs of warding you can have active at a time is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

Haste.name: 加速术 Haste
Haste.description:
魔法赋予目标更快行动的能力。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}（状态），并且每轮只能将额外的动作用于打击与疾行动作。

升阶（7环） 你可以以最多6个生物为目标。

Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

Mind Reading.name: 读心术 Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
通过一次粗略的精神接触，你尝试读取目标的思想。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。随后该目标会在1小时内对你的读心术暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 成功 当你施放法术时，目标会从你这里感知到模糊的表层想法。

成功 你会得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层想法，并且你会得知其智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持该法术以再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the Spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Blur.name: 朦胧术 Blur
Blur.description:
目标的形体看起来模糊不清。它变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。由于此效果的本质仍使目标的位置显而易见，目标无法使用此隐蔽来躲藏或潜行。

The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

Create Undead.name: 唤起死灵 Create Undead
Create Undead.description:
你将目标转化为一个不死生物，其等级上限如表 7-1 所允许。该仪式有许多版本，每个版本都专用于某一种特定的不死生物（例如：所有丧尸（特征）共用一个仪式、骷髅（特征）共用一个、食尸鬼（特征）共用一个，等等），而用于创造稀有不死生物的仪式本身也同样稀有。某些形态的不死生物（如巫妖）会以其自身独特的方法形成，无法通过某个版本的唤起死灵来创造。

表 7-1：生物创造仪式

生物等级 所需法术环阶 费用
-1 或 0 2 15 gp
1 2 60 gp
2 3 105 gp
3 3 180 gp
4 4 300 gp
5 4 480 gp
6 5 750 gp
7 5 1,080 gp
8 6 1,500 gp
9 6 2,100 gp
10 7 3,000 gp
11 7 4,200 gp
12 8 6,000 gp
13 8 9,000 gp
14 9 13,500 gp
15 9 19,500 gp
16 10 30,000 gp
17 10 45,000 gp

大成功 目标成为相应类型的不死生物。若其等级至少比你低 4 级，你可以使其成为仆从。这会使其获得仆从（特征），意味着当你对其施以命令术时，它可以使用 2 个动作；而命令它则是一个具有听觉与专注（特征）的单动作。你最多可以控制四个仆从。若它具备智能且未成为仆从，则该不死生物会因为你唤醒了它而对你有益，尽管它仍然是一个可憎而邪恶的生物。若它不具备智能且未成为仆从，你可以给予它一个简单命令；它会一心一意追逐该目标，无视你之后的任何命令。

成功 同大成功，但未成为你仆从的有智能不死生物对你仅为友善；而未成为你仆从的无智能不死生物会放过你，除非你对其进行攻击。它会在当地区域横行劫掠，而非遵循你的命令术。

失败 你未能创造该不死生物。

大失败 你创造出了该不死生物，但其灵魂被你污秽的死灵术折磨，对你充满了除仇恨之外的一切。它会试图毁灭你。

You transform the target into an undead creature with a level up to that allowed in Table 7-1. There are many versions of this ritual, each specific to a particular type of undead (one ritual for all zombies, one for skeletons, one for ghouls, and so on), and the rituals that create rare undead are also rare. Some forms of undead, such as liches, form using their own unique methods and can't be created with a version of create undead.

Table 7-1: Creatures Creation Rituals

Creature Level Spell Rank Required Cost
-1 or 0 2 15 gp
1 2 60 gp
2 3 105 gp
3 3 180 gp
4 4 300 gp
5 4 480 gp
6 5 750 gp
7 5 1,080 gp
8 6 1,500 gp
9 6 2,100 gp
10 7 3,000 gp
11 7 4,200 gp
12 8 6,000 gp
13 8 9,000 gp
14 9 13,500 gp
15 9 19,500 gp
16 10 30,000 gp
17 10 45,000 gp

Critical Success The target becomes an undead creature of the appropriate type. If it's at least 4 levels lower than you, you can make it a minion. This gives it the minion trait, meaning it can use 2 actions when you command it, and commanding it is a single action that has the auditory and concentrate traits. You can have a maximum of four minions under your control. If it's intelligent and doesn't become a minion, the undead is helpful to you for awakening it, though it's still a horrid and evil creature. If it's unintelligent and doesn't become a minion, you can give it one simple command. It pursues that goal single-mindedly, ignoring any of your subsequent commands.

Success As critical success, except an intelligent undead that doesn't become your minion is only friendly to you, and an unintelligent undead that doesn't become your minion leaves you alone unless you attack it. It marauds the local area rather than following your command.

Failure You fail to create the undead.

Critical Failure You create the undead, but its soul, tortured by your foul necromancy, is full of nothing but hatred for you. It attempts to destroy you.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你瓦解一个法术或效果背后的魔法。对目标进行一次反制检定。若你成功反制一件魔法物品，该物品在10分钟内变为其类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。若目标是一件神器或类似物品，你自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Hideous Laughter.name: 狂笑术 Hideous Laughter
Hideous Laughter.description:
目标被无法控制的大笑所淹没。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标被无法控制的大笑所折磨。它无法使用反应动作（）。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 且无法使用反应动作（）。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标倒地 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} 且在1轮内无法使用动作或反应动作（）。随后它承受失败效果。

The target is overtaken with uncontrollable laughter. It must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is plagued with uncontrollable laughter. It can't use reactions.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and can't use actions or reactions for 1 round. It then suffers the failure effects.

Inveigle.name: 迷心咒 Inveigle
Inveigle.description:
你赢得了目标的心智，使其将你视为亲近且值得信赖的朋友，并认为你提出的每一条暗示术都合理。目标对你抱持帮助态度，因此会不遗余力地帮助你。与任何其他愿意帮助你的生物一样，你能要求它做的事也有其限度。若你要求目标去做完全违背其天性之事，或对目标及其利益而言毫无必要地有害之事，它不仅会拒绝，而且还可以尝试一次意志豁免以提前终止该效果。由于施放时间与射程的限制，除非目标是自愿的（或许被说服该仪式会产生其他效果）或被束缚，否则通常很难施放该仪式。若该生物不愿意接受该仪式，它可以尝试一次意志豁免以使效果失效。

大成功或大失败 仪式成功，且目标在为终止该效果而进行的意志豁免上承受-4状态减值。

成功 仪式成功。

失败 仪式失败。

大成功或大失败 仪式失败，且目标转而憎恨你，在持续时间内对你变为敌对。

升阶（6环） 在整个施放期间，只要你拥有一缕头发、一滴血或该生物身体的其他一部分，并将其混入成本中使用的油料里，你就可以对至多1英里外的一个生物使用迷心咒。基础成本提高至100 gp。持续时间比正常更短，取决于你使用了该生物身体多大的一部分。血、头发、鳞片等会使该仪式持续1周，而一只手或其他相当可观的身体部位会使该仪式持续1个月。

You win over the target's mind, causing it to see you as a close and trusted friend and look upon your every suggestion as reasonable. The target is helpful toward you, so it will go out of its way to help you. As with any other helpful creature, there are limits to what you can ask of it. If you ever ask the target to do something completely against its nature or needlessly harmful to the target or its interests, not only does it refuse, but it also can attempt a Will save to end the effect early. Because of the casting time and range, it's generally difficult to cast this ritual unless the target is willing (perhaps convinced the ritual will have some other effect) or restrained. If the creature is unwilling to accept the ritual, it can attempt a Will save to negate the effect.

Critical Success The ritual succeeds and the target takes a -4 status penalty to Will saves to end the effect.

Success The ritual succeeds.

Failure The ritual fails.

Critical Failure The ritual fails and the target instead hates you, becoming hostile to you for the duration.

Heightened (6th) You can use inveigle on a creature up to 1 mile away throughout the casting, as long as you have a lock of hair, a drop of blood, or some other piece of the creature's body, which you mix into the oils used in the cost. The base cost increases to 100 gp. The duration is shorter than normal, based on how large a piece of the creature's body you use. Blood, hair, scales, and the like cause the ritual to last 1 week, while a hand or other substantial body part causes the ritual to last 1 month.

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
目标披上幻术斗篷，变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉} 状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其改为对他们而言处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐藏} 状态。若目标使用一个敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但若目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

See Invisibility.name: 识破隐形 See Invisibility
See Invisibility.description:
你可以看见@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物和物体。它们在你眼中呈现为半透明的轮廓，并且对你而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。

升阶（5环） 该法术的持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：看见无形}

You can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and objects. They appear to you as translucent shapes, and they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to you.

Heightened (5th) The spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入自身，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并扰乱不死生物，甚至可能迫使其逃离。其效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物该法术造成等于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但若大失败，还会在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。
  • 不死生物若强韧豁免失败，目标在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}。若大失败，目标还会在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，除非其成功通过一次意志豁免。

升阶（+1）对活体生物造成的虚空伤害增加1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你大声喊出一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你、逃离（如同其具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）}状态）、放开其手中所持之物、倒下并处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，或原地站定。在其服从你的命令之前，它不能延迟，也不能进行任何反应动作（）。“效果”取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在其下个回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须用一个单动作按你的命令行事。

大成功或大失败 目标必须在其下个回合用尽其所有动作以服从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你令目标的心智变得混沌，并以一道精神冲击使其陷入眩晕术。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中大失败，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，登记魔法的存在。除了是否存在魔法之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。

你只有在该魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到幻术系魔法。然而，带有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所对应的魔法学派。若有多个效果强度相同，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你还会定位最高等级魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体范围内（若来源大于此范围，则为距离最近的等效范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗术的卷须从你的指尖蜷曲伸出并在空中疾驰。你对直线中的活体生物造成2d4点虚空伤害以及@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]点伤害。直线中的每个活体生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半的虚空伤害且不受到持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害。

大失败 该生物受到双倍虚空伤害以及双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4，持续流血伤害增加1。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Mending.name: 修复术 Mending
Mending.description:
你修复目标物品。你每个法术环阶为目标恢复5点生命值，若因此将物品修复至其破损阈值以上，则可能移除 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} 状态。你无法替换遗失的部件，也无法修复已被完全摧毁的物体。

升阶（2环） 你可以以一个负载不超过1的非魔法物体为目标。

升阶（3环） 你可以以一个负载不超过2的非魔法物体为目标，或以一个负载不超过1的魔法物体为目标。

You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击检定。若你成功，则该生物进行一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功或大失败，则使用其豁免结果低一个成功等级的结果。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一面魔法的力场护盾术。这算作用出“举起护盾术”动作，使你在你下一回合开始前获得 AC +1 环境加值，但它不需要一只手来使用。

在该法术生效期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应动作（）。该护盾术具有 硬度 5。在你使用 Shield Block 后，该法术结束，且你在 10 分钟内无法再次施放它。与普通的 Shield Block 不同，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）对抗 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} 法术。

法术的升阶会提高护盾术的 硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（3环） 该护盾术具有 硬度 10。

升阶（5环） 该护盾术具有 硬度 15。

升阶（7环） 该护盾术具有 硬度 20。

升阶（9环） 该护盾术具有 硬度 25。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Tanglefoot.name: 绊足术 Tanglefoot
Tanglefoot.description:
一根覆盖着黏稠树汁的藤蔓凭空出现，从你的手中甩出并缠上目标。对目标尝试一次法术攻击。

大成功或大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足（状态）} 状态，并在1轮内其速度受到-10英尺的环境减值。它可以针对你的法术DC尝试 逃脱，以移除该减值与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足（状态）} 状态。

成功 目标在1轮内其速度受到-10英尺的环境减值。它可以针对你的法术DC尝试 逃脱，以移除该减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{法术效果: 缠绕藤蔓}

失败 目标不受影响。

升阶（2环） 效果持续2轮。

升阶（4环） 效果持续1分钟。

A vine covered in sticky sap appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack against the target.

Critical Success The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition and takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition.

Success The target takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine}

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.

Unseen Servant.name: 隐形仆役 Unseen Servant
Unseen Servant.description:
你召唤一个隐形仆役，你可以在维持法术的一部分中对其施加命令术。它会为你服务，直到其生命值降至0为止（此时法术结束），或直到你停止维持法术。该隐形仆役获得被召唤（特征）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.j7NNPfZwD19BwSEZ]{隐形仆役}（无阵营）

You summon an unseen servant, which you can command as part of Sustaining the Spell. It serves you until its Hit Points are reduced to 0, at which point the spell ends, or until you stop Sustaining the Spell. The unseen servant gains the summoned trait.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.j7NNPfZwD19BwSEZ]{Unseen Servant} (No Alignment)

Staff of Abjuration.name: 防护法杖 Staff of Abjuration
Staff of Abjuration.description:
这根雕刻精美的木杖接触时温暖，并以其内在能量嗡鸣作响。持用法杖时，你在识别防护学派魔法的检定上获得+2环境加值。

Activate 施法

效果 你从法杖中消耗一定数量的充能，以从其列表中施放一个法术。

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{护盾术}
  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4WAib3GichxLjp5p]{魔法警报}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TTwOKGqmZeKSyNMH]{轻柔着陆}
  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5esP2GVzvxWsMgaX]{环境适应}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{抗能量}

Craft Requirements 提供所有所列法术之所有所列等级各一次施放。

This intricately carved wooden staff is warm to the touch and thrums with inner energy. While wielding the staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to identify abjuration magic.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield}
  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4WAib3GichxLjp5p]{Alarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TTwOKGqmZeKSyNMH]{Gentle Landing}
  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5esP2GVzvxWsMgaX]{Environmental Endurance}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed levels of all listed spells.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality.name: 对抗活力的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality

Despair.name: 绝望灵光 Despair
Despair.description:
30英尺。活体生物在查夫肯姆的绝望灵光中时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。它们在该区域内无法自然从此恐惧(术)中恢复，但一旦离开便立刻恢复。当生物首次进入该区域时，它必须在进行 @Check[will|dc:24] 意志豁免（在承受因受惊而产生的减值之后）时成功，否则将 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹} 1轮。

该生物随后获得24小时的暂时免疫。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.1bOSJ2LbEC28aI9f]{效果：绝望灵光}

30 feet. Living creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} while in Chafkhem's despair aura. They can't naturally recover from this fear while in the area but recover instantly once they leave it. When a creature first enters the area, it must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:24] save (after taking the penalty from being frightened) or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

The creature is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.1bOSJ2LbEC28aI9f]{Effect: Despair}

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当查夫肯姆被摧毁时，死灵能量会在他房间内的魔法法阵中，于[[/gmr 1d10 #Rejuvenation]]{1d10天}内重塑他的身体。如果正在重塑的身体在这段时间内被摧毁，该过程会重新开始。查夫肯姆可以通过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Dbd5W6G8U2vzWolN]{祝圣术}仪式永久摧毁，或者如果魔法法阵被摧毁。

When Chafkhem is destroyed, necromantic energies rebuild his body in the magic circle in his room over [[/gmr 1d10 #Rejuvenation]]{1d10 days}. If the re-forming body is destroyed during that time, the process starts anew. Chafkhem can be destroyed for good with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Dbd5W6G8U2vzWolN]{Consecrate} ritual, or if the magic circle is destroyed.

Warding Script.name: 防护刻文 Warding Script
Warding Script.description:
触发 查夫肯姆能看见的一个生物对查夫肯姆进行一次近战打击

效果 查夫肯姆在空中描绘一个会发光并淡化的魔法符文。触发生物必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:25] 豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，直到其下个回合开始。

大成功或大失败 目标目盲 1 分钟。

Trigger A creature Chafkhem can see makes a melee Strike against Chafkhem

Effect Chafkhem traces a magical glyph in the air that glows and fades. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The target is blinded for 1 minute.

Mummy Rot.name: 腐尸症 Mummy Rot
Mummy Rot.description:
此疾病及其造成的任何伤害在该诅咒被移除前都无法被治疗。一名因腐尸症死亡的生物会化为尘埃，除非通过7环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} 仪式或类似的魔法，否则无法起死回生。

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

阶段 1 携带者，无任何不良效果（1分钟）

阶段 2 @Damage[6d6[void]] 伤害并 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}（1天）

This disease and any damage from it can't be healed until this curse is removed. A creature killed by mummy rot turns to dust and can't be resurrected except by a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual or similar magic.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 minute)

Stage 2 @Damage[6d6[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 day)

Chafkhem.blurb:
男性木乃伊（特征）仪式师
Male mummy ritualist
Chafkhem.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. vitality

Cratonys.name: 克拉托尼斯 Cratonys

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Painsight.name: 痛觉洞察 Painsight
Painsight.description:
链魔会自动知晓它所看见的生物是否具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{注定}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{受伤（状态）}状态，以及这些状态的数值

A velstrac automatically knows whether a creature it sees has any of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} conditions, as well as the value of those conditions

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Holy or.name: 再生 10（被神圣或银停用） Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Holy or Silver)

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Unnerving Gaze.name: 令人不安的凝视 Unnerving Gaze
Unnerving Gaze.description:
30尺。当一个生物在光环中结束其回合时，它看到的福音传道者的脸会被一位已故挚爱之人的面容所取代。该生物必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 意志豁免中成功，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐惧 2}（大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐惧 3}）。

30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it sees the face of a departed loved one in place of the evangelist's face. The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure).

Animate Chains.name: 活化锁链 Animate Chains
Animate Chains.description:
传道者附近的铁链长出倒钩并威胁性地扭动。除了位于传道者的铁链打击触及范围内的生物外，传道者还可以对任何与20英尺内一条无人持用的铁链相邻的生物进行铁链打击。

Chains in the evangelist's vicinity sprout barbs and writhe menacingly. The evangelist can make chain Strikes against any creature that is adjacent to an unattended chain within 20 feet, in addition to those within the reach of the evangelist's chain Strike.

Focus Gaze.name: 专注凝视 Focus Gaze
Focus Gaze.description:
传道者凝视其在30英尺内可见的一名生物。目标必须立刻尝试一次对抗令人不安的凝视的@Check[will|dc:21]意志豁免。此外，如果该生物已经@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐惧}，则在豁免失败时，只要该生物仍处于恐惧，传道者对该生物而言为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

在尝试此豁免后，该生物随后获得暂时免疫，直到传道者下一回合开始。

The evangelist stares at a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save against Unnerving gaze. In addition, if the creature was already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, on a failed save, the evangelist is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from the creature for as long as the creature remains frightened.

After attempting this save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of the evangelist's next turn.

Impaling Chain.name: 穿刺铁链 Impaling Chain
Impaling Chain.description:
当福音传道者以铁链打击造成重击时，目标会被刺穿并被固定在原地，因铁链而成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{被擒抱}。该生物在获得自由之前无法从持续流血伤害中恢复（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱} DC 25）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.gjo8LR6uOhDM5W7L]{效果：刺穿铁链}

When the evangelist critically hits with a chain Strike, the target is impaled and anchored in place, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the chain. The creature is unable to recover from persistent bleed damage until it gets free (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC 25).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.gjo8LR6uOhDM5W7L]{Effect: Impaling Chain}

Rusty Chains.name: 锈蚀锁链 Rusty Chains
Rusty Chains.description:
当克拉托尼斯用她的铁链对一名生物造成伤害时，包括被铁链刺穿所造成的持续流血伤害，该生物必须在一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:21|traits:disease,virulent] 豁免中成功，否则会感染一种名为链魔破伤风的严重破伤风。

链魔有时会故意用危险的疾病感染他们的铁链，例如这种具有侵袭性的破伤风。破伤风会导致僵硬、足以折断骨头的肌肉痉挛，并最终导致死亡。

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:21|traits:disease,virulent]

潜伏期 [[/gmr 1d4 #Velstrac Tetanus Onset]]{1d4 天}

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}（1 周）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2} 且无法说话（1 天）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}（1 天）

阶段 4 死亡

When Cratonys damages a creature with her chains, including persistent bleed damage from being impaled by a chain, the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21|traits:disease,virulent] saving throw or contract a severe form of tetanus called velstrac tetanus.

Velstracs sometimes intentionally infect their chains with dangerous diseases, such as this aggressive form of tetanus. Tetanus can produce stiffness, muscle spasms strong enough to break bones, and ultimately death.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21|traits:disease,virulent]

Onset [[/gmr 1d4 #Velstrac Tetanus Onset]]{1d4 days}

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 week)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and can't speak (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} (1 day)

Stage 4 death

Cratonys.publicNotes:
传道者，链魔们非正式的大使，游走于各个位面最遥远的疆域，传播其族类那种以痛苦求完美的可憎信条。因此，它们是材料位面上最常被遭遇到的链魔，或带领享乐主义的凡人血肉塑形者集会，或充当恐怖地城的卫士。在由炼狱势力统治的地区，传道者可能担任副官或顾问，以凡人的灵魂或上等凡人血肉为交换，低语通往力量的秘密路径。传道者的体型与人类相同，不过由于沉重的铁链总是披挂在其身形上，它们往往重达350磅或更多。

通过自残追寻终极感官体验，是那些栖居幽影的邪魔——链魔——令人毛骨悚然的执念。它们唯有在对受害者施加痛苦与恐惧、试验新的拷问形式，或将那令人煎熬的行径反施于自身时，才会超越其冷峻的超然。链魔自认是开悟的存在，超越了道德或凡人禁忌等限制，但它们的受害者只记得它们是毫无情感的折磨者，施加残虐的苦难。这些邪魔声称在思想、形体与行动上追求完美，然而它们不承认任何不需要痛苦地切除血肉或灵魂的“精进”。

链魔从那些最极端的受虐或施虐凡人的灵魂中显现——这些灵魂被审判后送往幽影位面。它们会呈现出契合其卑劣癖好的形貌，从低阶的占兆者到被称为遁隐者的痛苦与残割大师不等。转化过程一步一步扭曲灵魂，而其他链魔会带领其新成员穿行于幽影位面黑暗深处无数的痛苦厅室之间。

Evangelists, the velstracs' unofficial ambassadors, roam the farthest reaches of the planes to spread the word of their kind's abhorrent belief in perfection through pain. They are therefore the most frequently encountered velstracs on the Material Plane, leading covens of hedonistic mortal flesh-sculptors or serving as wardens of horrific dungeons. In regions ruled by infernal powers, evangelists may serve as lieutenants or advisors, whispering secret paths to power in exchange for mortal's souls or choice mortal flesh. Evangelists are the same size as humans, although with the heavy chains that always drape their forms, they often weigh 350 pounds or more.

The search for ultimate sensation through self-mutilation is the horrifying preoccupation of the shadow-dwelling fiends known as velstracs. They transcend their stoic detachment only when inflicting pain and terror upon their victims, practicing new forms of torture, or when turning their agonizing practices back on themselves. Velstracs consider themselves enlightened beings, transcending such limitations as morality or mortal taboos, but their victims know them as emotionless tormentors who inflict sadistic suffering. These fiends claim to seek perfection in thought, form, and action, although they don't recognize any refinement that doesn't require the painful excision of the flesh or spirit.

Velstracs manifest from the souls of the most extreme masochistic or sadistic mortals who are judged and sent on to the Shadow Plane. They take on forms that suit their vile predilections, ranging from the low-ranking augurs to the maestros of suffering and mutilation called eremites. The process of transformation warps the soul step by step, with other velstracs conveying their new members through untold chambers of pain among the dark reaches of the Shadow Plane.
Cratonys.blurb:
女性颂教链魔
Female evangelist velstrac
Cratonys.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Gibtas Bounder.name: 滚球跳跳 Gibtas Bounder

Bouncing Slam.name: 跳跃猛击 Bouncing Slam
Bouncing Slam.description:
跳跳向一个中型或更小的生物跳跃，落入该生物的空间并对该生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}。如果推撞失败，跳跳会从目标的方格弹跳到由目标选择的一个相邻方格。

The gibtas Leaps toward a Medium or smaller creature, landing in the creature's space and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shoving} the creature. If the Shove fails, the gibtas bounces out of the target's square to an adjacent square of the target's choosing.

Pinning Chomp.name: 咬牙切齿 Pinning Chomp
Pinning Chomp.description:
需求 跳跳的上一个动作是跳跃猛击，且跳跳成功推撞了目标

效果 跳跳尝试对其跳跃猛击的目标进行一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}，然后对目标进行一次啃咬打击。绊摔与打击都计入跳跳的多重攻击减值，但该减值直到两次攻击都完成后才会增加。

Requirements The gibtas's last action was a Bouncing Slam and the gibtas successfully Shoved the target

Effect The gibtas attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target of its Bouncing Slam, then makes a jaws Strike against the target. The Trip and Strike both count against the gibtas's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.

Gibtas Bounder.publicNotes:
一只完全成熟的跳跳会用其强壮的腿和富有弹性的身体跳跃，以跨越极远距离。大多数跳跳保持独居，除非与某个生物结下羁绊。

这种富有弹性的球形食腐者几乎全身都是滴着酸液的巨口，长着五只鼓胀的黑色眼睛和两条强壮而细长的腿。跳跳经常与单一的另一名生物结成羁绊——通常是更强大的异怪——并忠诚地为这位主人效劳，尽管行为常常反复无常。把跳跳当作宠物或守卫的生物很快就会学会让它远离任何重要的财物，以免那些他们不想被酸液溅到的东西遭殃。

A full-grown gibtas uses its powerful legs and rubbery body to bound great distances. Most gibtases remain solitary, unless bonded with a creature.

This rubbery, spheroid scavenger is nearly all acid-dripping mouth, with five bulbous black eyes and two powerful, gangly legs. A gibtas often forms a bond with a single other creature-usually, a more powerful aberration- and serves this master loyally, if erratically. Creatures who keep a gibtas as a pet or guard soon learn to keep it away from any important possessions they don't want spattered with acid.

Mimic.name: 拟形怪 Mimic

Adhesive.name: 黏合剂 Adhesive
Adhesive.description:
拟形怪覆盖着一层黏性黏液。任何击中拟形怪、被拟形怪击中或以其他方式触碰拟形怪的生物，必须在一次 @Check[reflex|dc:23] 豁免中成功，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{被擒抱}（逃脱 DC 23）。击中拟形怪的武器会黏在拟形怪身上，并且可以通过一次成功的 @Check[athletics|dc:23] 检定（以单动作进行）将其移除。

拟形怪在同一时间可以黏住任意数量的物体或生物。拟形怪可以使用单动作释放一个被黏住的生物或物体，并且在拟形怪死亡 1 分钟后，黏胶会溶解，释放所有被黏住的物体与生物。

The mimic is coated in an adhesive slime. Any creature that hits the mimic, is hit by the mimic, or otherwise touches the mimic must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} (Escape DC 23). A weapon that hits the mimic is stuck to the mimic and can be removed with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:23] check (made as a single action).

A mimic can have any number of objects or creatures stuck to it at a time. The mimic can release a stuck creature or object by using a single action, and the adhesive dissolves 1 minute after the mimic dies, releasing all stuck objects and creatures.

Object Lesson.name: 物体课 Object Lesson
Object Lesson.description:
触发 当拟形怪在使用“拟形物体”进行变形时，有生物触碰或与拟形怪进行物理互动。

效果 触发生物会自动被拟形怪的黏胶黏住（它不会进行豁免）。随后，拟形怪对任意与拟形怪相邻的生物进行一次拟足打击。

在拟形怪逃脱并换上新的伪装之前，“物体教训”无法再次使用。

Trigger A creature touches or physically interacts with the mimic while the mimic is transformed using Mimic Object.

Effect The triggering creature is automatically stuck by the mimic's adhesive (it receives no save). The mimic then makes a pseudopod Strike against any creature adjacent to the mimic.

Object Lesson can't be used again until the mimic escapes and takes on a new disguise.

Mimic Object.name: 拟态物体 Mimic Object
Mimic Object.description:
拟形怪会变为任何中型物体的形状。这不会改变拟形怪的质地或整体体型，但可以改变其颜色与视觉外观。它在欺骗检定以及用于伪装成其所拟形物体的DC上具有28的自动结果。

The mimic assumes the shape of any Medium object. This doesn't change the mimic's texture or overall size but can alter its coloration and visual appearance. It has an automatic result of 28 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as the object that it's mimicking.

Dwelling Lore (applies only to the dunge.name: 居所背景知识（仅适用于其所居住的地下城） Dwelling Lore (applies only to the dungeon it lives in)

Mimic.publicNotes:
被认为是一次旨在活化物体的失败实验的产物，或是某个邪恶的阿尔古苏造物，拟形怪是狡猾的怪物，能够变成常见的人工制成物体的形态。拟形怪是伏击型掠食者，也是贪婪的食客，凭借其令人不安的能力模仿常见家具与杂物的外形来给猎物以惊吓。它们会一直保持伪装，直到毫无戒心的冒险者恰好经过，然后便会突然出击进行伏击。

拟形怪拥有复杂而陌生的心智，虽然常常残忍且自私，它们也会时不时享受与猎物交谈。出于未知原因，它们对类人生物尤其感兴趣。拟形怪非常厌恶同类，并倾向于独自生活。一只拟形怪能够在其替代形态下维持极其漫长的时间，有时会在地城房间里伪装数十年。无论它等待多久，拟形怪都会保持警觉与戒备，随时准备发动攻击。

Thought to be the result of a failed experiment meant to animate objects or a sinister alghollthu creation, mimics are clever monsters that can take the form of common manufactured objects. Mimics are ambush predators and voracious eaters, surprising their prey through their uncanny ability to mimic the form of common furniture and miscellany. They remain disguised until unsuspecting adventurers happen by, then they lash out in ambush.

Mimics possess complex alien minds, and while often cruel and self-serving, they also enjoy conversation with their prey from time to time. For unknown reasons, they are especially interested in humanoids. Mimics have a strong dislike for others of their kind and tend to live alone. A mimic can remain in its alternate form for an extremely long period of time, sometimes remaining disguised in a dungeon chamber for decades. Regardless of how long it waits, the mimic remains vigilant and alert, ready to strike at any moment.

Shanrigol Heap.name: 塑肉残渣堆 Shanrigol Heap

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震感知觉（不精确）30尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Sapping Squeeze.name: 压榨 Sapping Squeeze
Sapping Squeeze.description:
需求 塑肉残渣抓住了一个生物

效果 塑肉残渣从其目标身上挤压出生命精华，造成 @Damage[(1d6+5)[bludgeoning],1d4[bleed]]{1d6+5 钝击伤害与 1d4 持续流血伤害}（@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] 豁免）。

塑肉残渣恢复等同于单一目标所受钝击伤害一半的临时生命值；这些临时生命值持续 1 分钟。

Requirements The shanrigol has a creature grabbed

Effect The shanrigol squeezes the life essence from its target, dealing @Damage[(1d6+5)[bludgeoning],1d4[bleed]]{1d6+5 bludgeoning and 1d4 persistent bleed damage} (@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] save).

The shanrigol regains temporary Hit Points equal to half the amount of bludgeoning damage a single target takes; these temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

Shred Flesh.name: 撕肉 Shred Flesh
Shred Flesh.description:
塑肉残渣会从目标身上撕下大块的血肉。被塑肉残渣的肉质拍击打击重击的生物会额外受到 @Damage[1d6[bleed]]，并在其流血期间处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1}。

A shanrigol rips flesh away from targets in great chunks. Creatures critically hit by the shanrigol's fleshy slap Strike take an additional @Damage[1d6[bleed]] and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for as long as they are bleeding.

Undulating Step.name: 波状蠕行 Undulating Step
Undulating Step.description:
塑肉残渣将其血肉与骨骼分离以穿过狭小空间。它移动，无视困难地形，并且能像超小型生物一样穿过狭窄空间。在它占据足以容纳其正常形态的区域之前，除了波状蠕行以外，它不能使用任何其他动作。

The shanrigol separates its flesh from its bones to fit through small spaces. It Strides, ignoring difficult terrain and fitting through tight spaces as though it were a Tiny creature. It can't use any actions other than Undulating Step until it occupies an area large enough for its normal form.

Shanrigol Heap.publicNotes:
最基础且最常见的塑肉残渣类型，会根据其大致形状被称为塑肉残渣堆。这些由扭曲血肉与碎裂骨骼拼合而成的聚合体，并非出于设计而是出于偶然建立狩猎场；它们会停留在过去猎物充足之处，以便在不断把更多残肢拼入其杂乱形体时，长得越来越大。只有极少数塑肉者会自愿创造这些憎邪，因为它们无视一切命令术与收容，只会去搜寻猎物。

塑肉者无论其出身或受训如何，都会制造出惊人数量的废弃物。当被丢弃的畸变血肉残余与偶然混入的炼金化合物或可憎能量一同堆积时，这团物质便可能迅速活化并重获生命。若没有塑肉者的引导，这些畸变的身体部件便会聚合成一只塑肉残渣——一团由骨骼、肌肉与筋腱构成的乱麻。

The most basic and common type of shanrigol is called, based on its general shape, a shanrigol heap. These amalgamations of warped flesh and shattered bone establish hunting grounds by accident rather than design, remaining where prey has been plentiful in the past so they can grow larger and larger as they add to their jumbled forms. Only rare fleshwarpers create these abominations willingly, as they ignore all commands and containment to seek out prey.

Fleshwarpers, regardless of their origin or training, create a shocking amount of waste. When the discarded remnants of aberrant flesh are heaped together with an accidental mixture of alchemical compounds or odious energy, the mass can quicken and regain life. Without the guidance of a fleshwarper, these aberrant body parts form into a shanrigol, a mess of bone, muscle, and sinew.

Siora Fallowglade.name: 西奥拉·法劳格莱德 Siora Fallowglade
Siora Fallowglade.tokenName: 西奥拉·法劳格莱德 Siora Fallowglade

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗的遮蔽，使光无法穿透或在该区域内发出。光不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源，比如火把或提灯，在区域内都不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本会延伸到黑暗之外亦然。这也会压制你此黑暗术等阶或更低等阶的魔法光亮。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括强效黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强透过黑暗看清。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Light Vulnerability.name: 光亮(术)易伤 Light Vulnerability
Light Vulnerability.description:
一个散发魔法光亮（例如来自 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{光亮(术)} 法术）的物体，在用于攻击幽影时被视为魔法。

An object shedding magical light (such as from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} spell) is treated as magical when used to attack the shadow.

Mark for Death.name: 死亡标记 Mark for Death
Mark for Death.description:
需求 西奥拉能看见她打算标记的目标

效果 西奥拉指定单一目标作为她的标记。她获得+2环境加值，用于对其目标进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜寻}的察觉检定，且她的幽灵之手对其目标的打击获得致命d8武器特征。

Requirements Siora can see the target she intends to mark

Effect Siora designates a single target as her mark. She gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} her target, and her spectral hand Strikes against her target gain the deadly d8 weapon trait.

Shadow Spawn.name: 幽影孳生物 Shadow Spawn
Shadow Spawn.description:
当一个生物的幽影被偷影拉离时，它会成为一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{幽影孳生体}，受创造它的幽影的命令术支配。这个幽影孳生体不具有偷影。若幽影孳生体被拉离的那个生物死亡，幽影孳生体会成为一个完整的、自治的幽影。若该生物从其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱}中恢复，它的幽影会回到它身上，而幽影孳生体会被熄灭。

When a creature's shadow is pulled free by Steal Shadow, it becomes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{Shadow Spawn} under the command of the shadow that created it. This shadow spawn doesn't have Steal Shadow. If the creature the shadow spawn was pulled from dies, the shadow spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous shadow. If the creature recovers from its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeeblement}, its shadow returns to it and the shadow spawn is extinguished.

Slink in Shadows.name: 潜行于幽影中 Slink in Shadows
Slink in Shadows.description:
幽影可以在生物或物体的幽影中@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{躲藏}或结束其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行}。

The shadow can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or end its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} in a creature's or object's shadow.

Steal Shadow.name: 窃取幽影 Steal Shadow
Steal Shadow.description:
需求 幽影在其上一个动作中以幽影之手打击命中了一名活体生物。

效果 幽影拉扯目标的幽影，使该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭（状态）2}（若为大成功或大失败命中则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭（状态）3}）。这会与来自幽影的其他力竭状态叠加，最高叠加至力竭（状态）4。若这使某生物的力竭值提高到3或更高，则目标的幽影将与其身体分离。由窃取幽影造成的力竭每小时减少1。

Requirement The shadow hit a living creature with a shadow hand Strike on its previous action.

Effect The shadow pulls at the target's shadow, making the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} on a critical hit). This is cumulative with other enfeebled conditions from shadows, to a maximum of enfeebled 4. If this increases a creature's enfeebled value to 3 or more, the target's shadow is separated from its body. Enfeebled from Steal Shadow decreases by 1 every hour.

Siora Fallowglade.publicNotes:
在幽影位面上度过漫长时代并吸收其魔法的幽影会变成高等幽影。

被称为幽影的神秘不死生物潜伏在黑暗之处，吞噬那些离光亮(术)太远的人。与幽影谈判的人——通常通过用一把发光的武器将它们挡在外——可能会得知重大秘密，因为它们是理想的间谍。

Shadows that spend long amounts of time on the Shadow Plane and absorb its magic become greater shadows.

The mysterious undead known as shadows lurk in dark places and feed on those who stray too far from the light. Those who parley with shadows, typically by keeping them at bay with a glowing weapon, may learn great secrets, for they are ideal spies.
Siora Fallowglade.blurb:
女性强大型幽影
Female greater shadow
Siora Fallowglade.prototypeToken: 西奥拉·法劳格莱德 Siora Fallowglade

Specter.name: 幽魂 Specter

Telepathy 100 feet (With Spectral Thrall.name: 心灵感应 100 尺（仅限幽灵奴仆） Telepathy 100 feet (With Spectral Thralls Only)

Pain Starvation.name: 痛苦饥饿 Pain Starvation
Pain Starvation.description:
一个幽魂若超过一个月未对活体类人生物造成任何虚空伤害，会变得绝望且近乎野兽化。它的阵营从守序邪恶变为混乱邪恶，失去对其可能拥有的任何腐化奴仆的控制，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}。它只能用其额外动作对类人生物目标进行邪秽接触打击（Strike）。在任何一个回合结束时，若它在该回合对活体类人生物造成了任意数量的虚空伤害，它会恢复为守序邪恶且不再处于 quickened 状态，但它失去控制的任何奴仆仍保持自由。

A specter that goes for more than a month without dealing void damage to a living humanoid becomes desperate and almost feral. It changes alignment from lawful evil to chaotic evil, loses control of any corrupted thralls it might have, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. It can use its additional action only to make vile touch Strikes against humanoid targets. At the end of any turn in which it deals any amount of void damage to a living humanoid, it reverts to lawful evil and is no longer quickened, but any thralls it lost control of remain free.

Sunlight Powerlessness.name: 阳光虚弱 Sunlight Powerlessness
Sunlight Powerlessness.description:
被阳光照到的幽魂会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2} 与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 2}，持续至其仍处于阳光之中为止。

A specter caught in sunlight is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for as long as it remains in the sunlight.

Spectral Corruption.name: 幽魂腐化 Spectral Corruption
Spectral Corruption.description:
幽魂进行一次邪秽接触打击。若其对一名活体生物造成伤害，幽魂获得[[/r 5 #Temporary Hit Points]]{5 临时生命值}，且目标生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:24]豁免以避免被腐化。

大成功 该生物不受影响，且在1分钟内暂时免疫幽魂腐化。

成功 该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}状态，持续1小时。

失败 该生物屈服于腐化并暂时成为幽魂奴仆。该生物被幽魂以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}状态控制，服从幽魂的心灵感应或口头命令，不过幽魂奴仆不会服从明显会自我毁灭的命令。此效果持续至该奴仆下个回合结束；届时其不再受控制，但会在1小时内获得Stupefied 2状态。

大失败 同失败，但持续时间为无限。该奴仆可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的意志豁免；若成功，则其不再受幽魂控制，但会在1小时内获得Stupefied 2状态。

The specter makes a Vile Touch Strike. If it damages a living creature, the specter gains [[/r 5 #Temporary Hit Points]]{5 temporary Hit Points} and the target creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save to avoid becoming corrupted.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to spectral corruption for 1 minute.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 hour.

Failure The creature succumbs to the corruption and becomes a spectral thrall temporarily. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} by the specter, obeying the specter's telepathic or spoken orders, though a spectral thrall does not obey obviously self-destructive orders. This lasts until the end of the thrall's next turn, at which point it is no longer controlled but becomes stupefied 2 for 1 hour.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is unlimited. The thrall can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns; on a success, it is no longer controlled by the specter but becomes stupefied 2 for 1 hour.

Specter.publicNotes:
当一个邪恶的凡人生物死亡时，有时会以幽魂的形式回到其死亡的区域作祟——一段充满憎恨的残留物，永远寻求杀戮他者——尤其是类人生物——试图将自己的痛苦分摊到尽可能多的灵魂之中。幽魂会维持其先前身份的某种怪异表象，但其目标感已被腐化。它无法被说服。

若幽魂被剥夺对活着的类人生物施加伤害术的机会，它会变得愈发痛苦与不理智，仿佛一个永远饥饿的人，其渴望借由死亡从剧痛中获得解脱却被永远拒绝。

When an evil mortal creature dies, it sometimes returns to haunt the area of its death as a specter, a hateful remnant, always seeking to slay others-particularly humanoids-in an attempt to distribute its pain among as many souls as it can. A specter maintains a strange semblance of its prior identity, but with a corrupted sense of purpose. It cannot be reasoned with.

A specter denied the opportunity to harm living humanoids grows increasingly agonized and irrational, akin to the mindset of a starving person forever denied a release from agony through death.

Squabbling Poltergeist.name: 争吵的骚灵 Squabbling Poltergeist

Occult Innate Spells.name: 奇术先天法术 Occult Innate Spells

Telekinetic Maneuver (At Will).name: 念动战技（随意） Telekinetic Maneuver (At Will)
Telekinetic Maneuver (At Will).description:
随着一阵念动力量的迸发，你移动一个敌人或其携带的某样物品。你可以尝试使用一次法术攻击掷骰来对目标进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{重新定位}或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}，而非进行运动检定。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动力之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造一只漂浮的魔法手，它要么是隐形的，要么呈幽灵般的形态，用来抓住目标物体并使其以缓慢的速度向任意方向浮空移动至多20英尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以额外移动该物体20英尺。若该法术结束时该物体仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

强化（3环） 你可以以一件无人持用且负载为1或更低的物体为目标。

强化（5环） 射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以一件无人持用且负载为1或更低的物体为目标。

强化（7环） 射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以一件无人持用且负载为2或更低的物体为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Invisible.name: 隐形 Invisible
Invisible.description:
你无法被看见。对所有人而言，你都是 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。生物可以通过 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜寻} 来侦测你；若某个生物在以其察觉检定对抗你的隐匿DC时成功，你会对该生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}，直到你通过 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行} 再次变为未侦测。若你在某人已经能看见你的情况下变为隐形，则你起初对其为隐藏（而非未侦测），直到你成功潜行。你在隐形时无法变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed}，除非通过特殊能力或魔法。

You can't be seen. You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to everyone. Creatures can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to detect you; if a creature succeeds at its Perception check against your Stealth DC, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to that creature until you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} to become undetected again. If you become invisible while someone can already see you, you start out hidden to them (instead of undetected) until you successfully Sneak. You can't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} while invisible except via special abilities or magic.

Telekinetic Object.name: 念动力物体 Telekinetic Object
Telekinetic Object.description:
伤害类型取决于投掷的物体

Damage type depends on object thrown

Site Bound.name: 束缚之地 Site Bound
Site Bound.description:
骚灵与某个地点绑定，不能从它被创造或形成的地方离开超过120英尺。有些骚灵则改为绑定在特定的房间、建筑物或类似的区域

A poltergeist is tied to a location and can't travel more than 120 feet from the place where it was created or formed. Some poltergeists are instead bound to a specific room, building, or similar area

Natural Invisibility.name: 天然隐形术 Natural Invisibility
Natural Invisibility.description:
骚灵天生处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态。只有当它使用“惊吓”时才会显形。

A poltergeist is naturally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. It becomes visible only when it uses Frighten.

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当一个骚灵被摧毁时，它会在被摧毁之处重新成形并完全痊愈，在[[/br 2d4 #Rejuvenation]]{2d4天}后。只有当有人查明其存在的原因，并纠正任何阻止该灵魂休息的事物时，骚灵才能被永久摧毁。

When a poltergeist is destroyed, it reforms, fully healed, where it was destroyed after [[/br 2d4 #Rejuvenation]]{2d4 days}. A poltergeist can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Telekinetic Defense.name: 念动力防御 Telekinetic Defense
Telekinetic Defense.description:
触发 一名生物接近至骚灵10英尺内

效果 骚灵对触发的生物发动一次心灵遥控物体打击。

Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the poltergeist

Effect The poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Strike against the triggering creature.

Frighten.name: 恐惧 Frighten
Frighten.description:
需求 该骚灵必须处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}

效果 该骚灵变为可见，呈现为骷髅般、幽魂似的人形。每个30英尺内的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 意志 豁免，失败则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐惧 2}。在大失败时，它还会在其恐惧持续期间变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}。成功时，该生物获得1分钟的暂时免疫。

在其下个回合开始时，该骚灵再次变为隐形。

Requirements The poltergeist must be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}

Effect The poltergeist becomes visible, appearing as a skeletal, ghostlike humanoid. Each creature within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a failure. On a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it's frightened. On a success, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

At the start of its next turn, the poltergeist becomes invisible again.

Telekinetic Storm.name: 念动力风暴 Telekinetic Storm
Telekinetic Storm.description:
骚灵用念动力投掷大量小型物体，例如数十件餐具或书本，可以将它们分散到多个敌人之间，或将它们集中指向一个目标。

  • 当此效果分散到多个敌人之间时，骚灵对每个处于 @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30尺} 内的生物，以-2减值进行一次念动物体打击。这些打击对骚灵的多重攻击减值而言计为一次攻击，且减值在所有攻击完成后才会增加。
  • 当此效果只有一个目标时，骚灵对该目标进行一次念动物体打击，且伤害提高至3d12。失败时造成 @Damage[1d12[untyped]] 伤害，大成功或大失败中的大失败时不造成伤害。

The poltergeist telekinetically throws numerous small objects, such as dozens of pieces of silverware or books, either spreading them out among multiple foes or directing them at one target.

  • When this effect is spread out among multiple foes, the poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Strike at a -2 penalty against each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet}. These count as one attack for the poltergeist's multiple attack penalty, and the penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.
  • When this effect has only one target, the poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Strike against the target, and the damage increases to 3d12. It deals @Damage[1d12[untyped]] damage on a failure, and no damage on a critical failure.

Squabbling Poltergeist.publicNotes:
当一名生物死亡时，无论出于何种原因其灵魂无法或不愿离开死亡地点，该灵魂可能显现为一名骚灵：一种躁动不安的、隐形的灵体，仍能够操纵实体物体。许多骚灵以一种源于或导致极端情感创伤的方式死去。

When a creature dies, and for whatever reason its spirit is unable or unwilling to leave the site of its death, that spirit may manifest as a poltergeist: a restless, invisible spirit that is still able to manipulate physical objects. Many poltergeists perished in a way that resulted from or led to extreme emotional trauma.

Viscous Black Pudding.name: 粘稠黑布丁怪 Viscous Black Pudding
Viscous Black Pudding.tokenName: 粘稠黑布丁怪 Viscous Black Pudding

Motion Sense 60 feet.name: 动态感知 60 尺 Motion Sense 60 feet
Motion Sense 60 feet.description:
黑布丁能够通过振动和空气移动感知附近的动静。

A black pudding can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

Adjust Shape.name: 调整形状 Adjust Shape
Adjust Shape.description:
粘稠黑布丁怪比大多数黑布丁怪更为浓稠，能够将自己的身体堆叠起来，或再次摊开。该布丁怪将其体型改变为中型、大型或巨型。若该布丁怪为中型，其密度会将其速度降低至10英尺，但除此之外，该能力不会改变其打击或其速度。若粘稠黑布丁怪发生分裂，则两个新的布丁怪在调整其形态之前，其体型都与当时的体型相同。

A viscous black pudding is thicker than most black puddings and can heap its body upon itself or spread itself out again. The pudding changes its size to Medium, Large, or Huge. If the pudding is Medium, its density reduces its Speeds to 10 feet, but this ability doesn't otherwise change its Strikes or its Speed. If the viscous black pudding Splits, both of the new puddings have the same size as it had at that time, until they Adjust their Shape.

Corrosive Mass.name: 腐蚀团块 Corrosive Mass
Corrosive Mass.description:
用金属或木质武器命中布丁的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[reflex|dc:22] 豁免，否则该武器受到 @Damage[2d6[acid]] 伤害（在如常对黑布丁造成伤害之后）。投掷武器与弹药会自动承受此伤害，且无豁免。

A creature that hits the pudding with a metal or wooden weapon must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:22] save or the weapon takes @Damage[2d6[acid]] damage (after dealing damage to the black pudding as normal). Thrown weapons and ammunition take this damage automatically with no save.

Split.name: 分裂 Split
Split.description:
当黑布丁被一次将造成挥砍或穿刺伤害的攻击命中，且其拥有10点或更多HP时，它会分裂成两个相同的布丁，每个布丁拥有原本HP的一半。

其中一个布丁处于与原本相同的空间，另一个出现在相邻的未占据空间中。若没有相邻空间处于未占据状态，它会自动将生物和物体推开以填充一个空间（由GM决定某个物体或生物是否过大或过于坚固而无法推动）。

When the black pudding is hit by an attack that would deal slashing or piercing damage and has 10 or more HP, it splits into two identical puddings, each with half the original's HP.

One pudding is in the same space as the original, and the other appears in an adjacent unoccupied space. If no adjacent space is unoccupied, it automatically pushes creatures and objects out of the way to fill a space (the GM decides if an object or creature is too big or sturdy to push).

Constrict.name: 紧勒 Constrict
Constrict.description:
@Damage[(1d8+7)[bludgeoning],1d6[acid]]{1d8+7 钝击伤害加上 1d6 强酸伤害}，@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] 豁免

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

@Damage[(1d8+7)[bludgeoning],1d6[acid]]{1d8+7 bludgeoning damage plus 1d6 acid damage}, @Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] save

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

Corrosive Touch.name: 腐蚀性接触 Corrosive Touch
Corrosive Touch.description:
当布丁用其假足击中一名生物时，任何酸性伤害都会对该生物的护甲或衣物以及该生物本身造成。

When the pudding hits a creature with its pseudopod, any acid damage is dealt to the creature's armor or clothing as well as the creature.

Suction.name: 吸附 Suction
Suction.description:
布丁怪可以在天花板和其他倒置表面上攀爬，尽管这些表面对它来说是困难地形。

The pudding can climb on ceilings and other inverted surfaces, though such surfaces are difficult terrain for it.

Viscous Black Pudding.publicNotes:
这些泥怪最常见于地下，它们在洞穴中搜寻可用其腐蚀性分泌物溶解的物体。这种腐蚀性酸液对那些攻击布丁的生物尤其危险，因为它能迅速伤害并摧毁道具。

史莱姆、霉菌以及其他泥怪可在阴湿的地城与幽暗的森林中发现。它们未必邪恶，但有些会长到巨大的体型，并有着永不满足的食欲。

Most often found below ground, these oozes scour caves for objects to dissolve with their corrosive secretions. This caustic acid is particularly dangerous to creatures that attack a pudding, as it can quickly damage and destroy gear.

Slimes, molds, and other oozes can be found in dank dungeons and shadowed forests. While not necessarily evil, some grow to enormous sizes and have insatiable appetites.
Viscous Black Pudding.blurb:
变体黑布丁
Variant black pudding
Viscous Black Pudding.prototypeToken: 粘稠黑布丁怪 Viscous Black Pudding

Rusty Grate Pit.name: 生锈的坑栅栏 Rusty Grate Pit
Rusty Grate Pit.tokenName: 生锈的坑栅栏 Rusty Grate Pit

Pitfall.name: 陷坑 Pitfall
Pitfall.description:
触发 一个生物走到格栅上

效果 触发的生物坠落进去并受到坠落伤害（@Damage[20[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] 伤害）。该生物可以使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{抓住边缘} 反应动作（）以避免坠落。

无论该生物是否抓住边缘，上方生锈的绞车都会砸落在触发的生物身上，造成 @Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]] 伤害并使其握持被震开（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] 豁免）。该生物仍然可以再次尝试抓住边缘。

Trigger A creature walks onto the grate

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes falling damage (@Damage[20[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage). That creature can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} reaction to avoid falling.

Whether or not the creature Grabs an Edge, the rusty winch above crashes down atop the triggering creature, dealing @Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]] damage and dislodging its grip (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save). The creature can still try to Grab an Edge again.

Rusty Grate Pit.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:18|name:无害地触发陷阱]，通过轻推闸门或悬挂的绞盘来无害地触发陷阱，或 @Check[thievery|dc:24|name:稳定格栅] 以稳定格栅，使其不会坍塌。

@Check[thievery|dc:18|name:Harmlessly Trigger Trap] to harmlessly trigger the trap by nudging the gate or the dangling winch, or @Check[thievery|dc:24|name:Stabilize Grate] to stabilize the grate so it doesn't collapse.
Rusty Grate Pit.hazarddescription:
生锈的栅格掩蔽着一个直径10英尺、深40英尺的坑洞。

The rusty grate covers a pit that's 10 feet in diameter and 40 feet deep.
Rusty Grate Pit.stealthdetails:
（专家），或若栅格为开启则为0

(expert), or 0 if the grate is open
Rusty Grate Pit.prototypeToken: 生锈的坑栅栏 Rusty Grate Pit

Shuffling Scythe Blades.name: 换位镰刃 Shuffling Scythe Blades
Shuffling Scythe Blades.tokenName: 换位镰刃 Shuffling Scythe Blades

Dicing Scythes.name: 切割镰刃 Dicing Scythes
Dicing Scythes.description:
触发 一名生物在分叉走廊连接处的15英尺×25英尺区域内快步

效果 陷阱使用镰刃换位；每个刀刃对其区域内的每个生物进行一次镰刃打击，然后它再次使用镰刃换位。随后陷阱为先攻掷骰。

Trigger A creature steps in the 15-footby-25-foot area where the branching hallways connect

Effect The trap uses Scythe Shuffle; each blade makes a scythe Strike against each creature in its region, then it uses Scythe Shuffle again. The trap then rolls for initiative.

Scythe Shuffle.name: 镰刃换位 Scythe Shuffle
Scythe Shuffle.description:
刀刃在走廊的分支中不规则地来回移动，会在地板下或墙后消失于视线之外。对每一片刀刃，掷骰 [[/gmr 1d4 #Direction Scythe Blade]]{1d4} 来决定它下一次进行镰刀打击的区域。生物可以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜寻}（@Check[perception|dc:22|traits:action:seek]）以获取关于其当前所处区域内刀刃的线索。若成功，该生物会知道其所在区域当前有多少片刀刃。

1. 主交汇处（走廊相连处的15英尺×25英尺区域，如区域 B20 所标示）

2. 北侧分支（从主交汇处到通往区域 B14 的密门）

3. 中央走廊（从主交汇处到通往区域 B24 的密门）

4. 南侧分支（从主交汇处到与区域 B25 共享的墙壁）

The blades travel erratically throughout the hallway's branches, out of sight under the floors or behind the walls. For each blade, roll [[/gmr 1d4 #Direction Scythe Blade]]{1d4} to determine the region in which it next makes scythe Strikes. A creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} (@Check[perception|dc:22|traits:action:seek]) to learn clues about blades in the region they're currently occupying. On a success, the creature knows how many blades are currently in its region.

1. Main intersection (the 15-foot-by-25-foot area where the hallways connect, as marked on area B20)

2. North branch (from the main intersection to the secret door to area B14)

3. Central hall (from the main intersection to the secret door to area B24)

4. South branch (from the main intersection to the wall shared with area B25)

Scythe.name: 长柄镰刀 Scythe
Scythe.description:
用镰刀攻击进行的打击不适用MAP

No MAP applies to strikes made by scythe attacks

No MAP.name: 无多重攻击减值（无 MAP） No MAP
No MAP.description:
这些镰刀打击不会施加多重攻击减值（MAP）。

The Scythe Strikes do not apply a MAP.

Shuffling Scythe Blades.disable:
@检定[thievery|dc:26|name:解除每片刀刃]（专家）以解除每片刀刃，或说出魔法口令（只有查夫肯姆知道）使陷阱停止运作10分钟

@Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Disable Each Blade] (expert) to disable each blade, or utter the magical passphrase (which only Chafkhem knows) to deactivate the trap for 10 minutes
Shuffling Scythe Blades.hazarddescription:
六把长刃隐藏在墙壁和地板的凹槽中；当走廊交叉口的任意一个压力板被踩下时，它们便会在这条走廊的不同位置间之字形穿梭。压力板多到不可能在穿过房间时避开它们。刀刃会缩回地板，在隐藏的凹槽中移动，然后再从墙壁的另一处位置摆出。

Six long blades, hidden in grooves in the walls and floor, zigzag through different parts of this hallway when any pressure plate in the hallway intersection is depressed; there are so many plates it's impossible to avoid them when moving through the room. The blades retreat into the floor and move through the hidden grooves before swinging out from the wall again in a different location.
Shuffling Scythe Blades.reset:
当区域 B20 中不再有生物时，该陷阱会重置。受损或被摧毁的刀刃不会在陷阱重置时被完全修复。

The trap resets when no creatures remain in area B20. Damaged or destroyed blades aren't repaired when the trap resets.
Shuffling Scythe Blades.routine:
（7 动作）陷阱为其每个刃片各花费 1 动作；每个刃片对其区域内的每个生物进行一次镰刃打击。使用其最后一个动作，陷阱使用镰刃换位。每摧毁一个刃片，陷阱可采取的动作数量减少 1。

(7 actions) The trap spends 1 action for each of its blades; a blade makes a scythe Strike against each creature in its region. With its final action, the trap uses Scythe Shuffle. Reduce the number of actions the trap can take by 1 for each destroyed blade.
Shuffling Scythe Blades.prototypeToken: 换位镰刃 Shuffling Scythe Blades

Healer's Tools.name: 医疗工具 Healer's Tools
Healer's Tools.description:
这套绷带、草药与缝合工具对进行医学检定以施行急救、治疗疾病、治疗毒素或治疗伤口是必要的。

This kit of bandages, herbs, and suturing tools is necessary for Medicine checks to Administer First Aid, Treat Disease, Treat Poison, or Treat Wounds.

Healer's Tools (Expanded).name: 医疗工具（扩展） Healer's Tools (Expanded)
Healer's Tools (Expanded).description:
这套由绷带、草药和缝合工具组成的工具包是进行医疗检定以施行急救、治疗疾病、治疗毒素或治疗伤口所必需的。专家级医疗工具为此类检定提供+1物品加值。当你将这些工具从一处携带到另一处时，你会把许多组件随身放在口袋或弹带上，以便取用。

This kit of bandages, herbs, and suturing tools is necessary for Medicine checks to Administer First Aid, Treat Disease, Treat Poison, or Treat Wounds. Expanded healer's tools provide a +1 item bonus to such checks. When you carry the tools from place to place, you keep many of the components handy on your person, in pockets or bandoliers.

Siora's Footlocker.name: 希奥拉的脚柜 Siora's Footlocker
Siora's Footlocker.tokenName: 西奥拉的脚柜 Siora's Footlocker

Hat of Disguise (Greater).name: 易容帽（高等） Hat of Disguise (Greater)
Hat of Disguise (Greater).description:
这顶看起来很普通的帽子允许你用幻术遮蔽自己。

启动 D 交互

频率 每天任意次数

效果 这顶帽子对你施放一个2环@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{幻象伪装}法术。在建立伪装时，你可以以魔法方式改变帽子的外观，使其看起来像一把梳子、缎带、头盔或其他头饰。

This ordinary-looking hat allows you to cloak yourself in illusions.

Activate D Interact

Frequency any number of times per day

Effect The hat casts a 2nd-level @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} spell on you. While setting up the disguise, you can magically alter the hat to appear as a comb, ribbon, helm, or other piece of headwear.

Pouch of Tiny Emeralds.name: 一袋微小祖母绿 Pouch of Tiny Emeralds

Siora's Poison Codex.name: 西奥拉的毒药法典 Siora's Poison Codex
Siora's Poison Codex.description:
这本书包含以下物品的炼金配方。

• @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.5RGNjhDxZ0yMhTds]{猎蛛毒}

• @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.QGXNqpP5KvSldoZz]{巨蝎毒}

• @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.aBOPYlfHAcXUmhF7]{巨蜂毒}

• @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.76T49dJYfxIrPvQe]{炽烈根糊}

This book contains the alchemical formulas for the following items.

• @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.5RGNjhDxZ0yMhTds]{Hunting Spider Venom}

• @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.QGXNqpP5KvSldoZz]{Giant Scorpion Venom}

• @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.aBOPYlfHAcXUmhF7]{Giant Wasp Venom}

• @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.76T49dJYfxIrPvQe]{Malyass Root Paste}

Siora's Footlocker.prototypeToken: 西奥拉的脚柜 Siora's Footlocker

Supply Room Shelves.name: 补给室货架 Supply Room Shelves
Supply Room Shelves.tokenName: 补给室货架 Supply Room Shelves

Bestial Mutagen (Moderate).name: 兽性诱变剂（中等） Bestial Mutagen (Moderate)
Bestial Mutagen (Moderate).description:
启动 A 交互

你的特征变形为某种野兽般的形态，肌肉量增加，但你笨重的体型很笨拙。

增益 你在运动检定和徒手攻击掷骰上获得+2物品加值。你获得一次爪子徒手攻击（[[/r 1d6[slashing]]] 伤害），具有灵巧特征，以及一次啃咬徒手攻击（[[/r 1d8[piercing]]] 伤害）。

缺点 你的AC承受-1减值，并且反射豁免承受-2减值。

持续时间 10分钟。

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.xFQRiVU6h8EA6Lw9]{效果：野兽突变剂（中等）}

Activate A Interact

Your features transform into something bestial and you take on muscle mass, but your lumbering form is clumsy.

Benefit You gain a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks and unarmed attack rolls. You gain a claw unarmed attack ([[/r 1d6[slashing]]] damage) with the agile trait and a jaws unarmed attack ([[/r 1d8[piercing]]] damage).

Drawback You take a -1 penalty to AC and a -2 penalty to Reflex saves.

Duration 10 minutes.

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.xFQRiVU6h8EA6Lw9]{Effect: Bestial Mutagen (Moderate)}

Juggernaut Mutagen (Moderate).name: 主宰突变剂（中等） Juggernaut Mutagen (Moderate)
Juggernaut Mutagen (Moderate).description:
启动 A 交互

在你饮用该诱变剂后，你的身体变得厚实而坚韧。你会散发出健康的发光，不过你也会变得迟缓而不善观察。

增益 你在强韧豁免中获得+2物品加值，并获得10点临时生命值。只要你在至少1整分钟内保持在最大生命值，你便会恢复这些临时生命值。

劣势 你在意志豁免、察觉检定以及先攻掷骰中承受-2减值。

持续时间 10分钟。

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.fUrZ4xcMJz0CfTyG]{效果: Juggernaut Mutagen (Moderate)}

Activate A Interact

After you drink this mutagen, your body becomes thick and sturdy. You exhibit a healthy glow, though you tend to be ponderous and unobservant.

Benefit You gain a +2 item bonus to Fortitude saves and 10 temporary Hit Points. Whenever you are at maximum Hit Points for at least 1 full minute, you regain the temporary Hit Points.

Drawback You take a -2 penalty to Will saves, Perception checks and initiative rolls.

Duration 10 minute.

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.fUrZ4xcMJz0CfTyG]{Effect: Juggernaut Mutagen (Moderate)}

Quicksilver Mutagen (Moderate).name: 速银诱变剂（中等） Quicksilver Mutagen (Moderate)
Quicksilver Mutagen (Moderate).description:
启动 A 交互

你的五官变得纤细而棱角分明。你变得更迅捷、更灵巧，但你的身体也变得脆弱。

增益 你在特技检定、隐匿检定、盗窃检定、反射豁免以及基于敏捷的攻击掷骰上获得+2物品加值，并且你的速度获得+10尺状态加值。

缺陷 你受到等同于你等级两倍的伤害；在诱变剂持续期间，你无法以任何方式恢复以此法失去的生命值。你的强韧豁免承受-2减值。

持续时间 10分钟。

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.VPtsrpbP0AE642al]{效果：水银诱变剂（中等）}

Activate A Interact

Your features become thin and angular. You become swifter and nimbler, but your body also becomes fragile.

Benefit You gain a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks, Stealth checks, Thievery checks, Reflex saves, and Dexterity-based attack rolls, and you gain a +10 foot status bonus to your Speed.

Drawback You take damage equal to twice your level; you can't recover Hit Points lost this way by any means while the mutagen lasts. You take a -2 penalty to Fortitude saves.

Duration 10 minutes.

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.VPtsrpbP0AE642al]{Effect: Quicksilver Mutagen (Moderate)}

Wand of Heal (Level 2).name: 1 环治疗术魔杖（等级 2） Wand of Heal (Level 2)
Wand of Heal (Level 2).description:
这根短杖约一英尺长，内含一个法术。其外观通常与其中的法术相关。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你以标示的等级施放该法术。

制作需求 提供一次该法术的所列等级施放。
