Climbing Bolt.name: 攀爬矢 Climbing Bolt
Climbing Bolt.description:
这支弩矢的矢杆上缠绕着细绳。当弩矢击中坚固的表面时，细绳会解开并扩展成一条50英尺长的绳索，牢牢固定在弩矢击中的表面上。可以用一个交互动作并成功通过DC 20运动检定将绳索拉脱。

The shaft of this bolt is wrapped with fine twine. When the bolt strikes a solid surface, the twine unwinds and enlarges into a 50-foot-long rope, securely fastened to the surface the bolt struck. The rope can be pulled free with an Interact action and a successful DC 20 Athletics check.

Afflicted Irnakurse.name: 受厄拿刻斯侵扰 Afflicted Irnakurse
Afflicted Irnakurse.tokenName: 受厄拿刻斯折磨 Afflicted Irnakurse

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Fearful Curse.name: 恐惧诅咒 Fearful Curse
Fearful Curse.description:
厄拿刻斯永久处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐惧 2}，这会将其有效等级降低 1。

The irnakurse is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, which lowers its effective level by 1.

Mind Lash.name: 心灵鞭笞 Mind Lash
Mind Lash.description:
被厄拿刻斯的触手命中的非邪恶生物会被毁灭人生的堕落影像所淹没，必须成功进行一次 @Check[will|dc:28] 意志豁免，否则将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}（若大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 4}）。

在尝试该豁免后，一名生物在24小时内对心灵鞭笞暂时免疫。

A non-evil creature hit by an irnakurse's tentacle is overwhelmed with corrupted images of a ruined life and must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:28] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 4} on a critical failure).

After attempting this save, a creature is temporarily immune to Mind Lash for 24 hours.

Soul Scream.name: 灵魂尖啸 Soul Scream
Soul Scream.description:
频率 每日一次

效果 厄拿刻斯释放出异界的尖啸，充满噩梦般的恐怖与痛苦。所有位于@Template[emanation|distance:10]内的非邪恶生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:28]意志豁免。厄拿刻斯可以维持灵魂尖啸最多6轮；每次它如此做时，都会重复该效果。

大成功或大失败 成功 该生物不受影响，并在24小时内暂时免疫灵魂尖啸。

成功 该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞（状态） 1}，持续1轮。

失败 该生物呆滞（状态） 1。针对灵魂尖啸的豁免进一步失败会使该状态值增加1，至多提高至呆滞（状态） 4。每当该角色进行一次整夜休息时，由灵魂尖啸获得的呆滞（状态）会降低1。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，但呆滞（状态）值每次增加2而非1。

Frequency once per day

Effect The irnakurse unleashes an alien shriek of nightmarish horror and pain. All non-evil creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:10] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save. The irnakurse can Sustain Soul Scream for up to 6 rounds; each time it does, it repeats the effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected, and is temporarily immune to Soul Scream for 24 hours.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is stupefied 1. Further failed saves against Soul Scream increase the condition value by 1, to a maximum of stupefied 4. Each time the character gets a full night's rest, the stupefied condition gained from Soul Scream decreases by 1.

Critical Failure As failure, except the stupefied value increases by 2 instead of by 1.

Storm of Tentacles.name: 触手风暴 Storm of Tentacles
Storm of Tentacles.description:
厄拿刻斯至多进行四次触手打击，每次针对不同的目标。这些攻击计入厄拿刻斯的多重攻击减值，但多重攻击减值要等到它完成所有攻击后才会增加。

The irnakurse makes up to four tentacle Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the irnakurse's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all of its attacks.

Afflicted Irnakurse.publicNotes:
厄拿刻斯是被卓尔施以格外残酷且侮辱性的塑肉仪式的地表精灵，因为卓尔以折磨其居住于地表的同族为特殊乐趣。制造一名厄拿刻斯的过程，是将一名不幸的精灵扭曲成一团畸形的错置肢体、松散皮肉与骨质突刺——本应位于体内的部分往往被完全暴露于世人眼前。厄拿刻斯会遭受精神调教，使其憎恨自己先前的形态，而这些生物比起其他一切目标，更偏好攻击地表精灵。

此处展示的两种塑肉体是由卑劣的炼金魔法重塑而成的可怖憎邪，由卓尔创造；他们将俘获的精灵或地蜥人（特征）转化为扭曲的怪物，随后将其释放以制造浩劫与恐惧。

Irnakurse are surface elves who drow have subjected to particularly cruel and humiliating fleshwarping practices, as drow take special delight in the torment of their surface-dwelling kin. The process of crafting an irnakurse involves twisting an unfortunate elf into a deformed mass of misplaced limbs, loose flesh, and bony protrusions-parts that should be internal are often left on full display to the world. Irnakurse are subject to mental conditioning that causes them to hate their prior forms, and these creatures prefer to attack surface elves over all other targets.

Horrid abominations reshaped by vile alchemical magic, the two fleshwarps presented here were created by drow, who transform captured elves or xulgaths into twisted monstrosities that can then be loosed to cause havoc and terror.
Afflicted Irnakurse.prototypeToken: 受难的厄拿刻斯 Afflicted Irnakurse

Destrachan.name: 暗音盲怪 Destrachan

Echolocation 120 feet.name: 回声定位 120 尺 Echolocation 120 feet
Echolocation 120 feet.description:
暗音盲怪可以在所列射程内将其听觉作为精确感官使用。

A destrachan can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range.

+4 Status to All Saves vs. Sonic.name: 对抗音波效果的所有豁免获得+4状态加值 +4 Status to All Saves vs. Sonic

Destructive Harmonics.name: 破坏性谐波 Destructive Harmonics
Destructive Harmonics.description:
暗音盲怪发出刺耳的音波尖啸，在一个@Template[cone|distance:60]或一个@Template[burst|distance:30]范围内造成@Damage[9d6[sonic]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]豁免）。

它在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Destructive Harmonics]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用破坏性和声。

The destrachan emits a harsh sonic cry that deals @Damage[9d6[sonic]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save) in either a @Template[cone|distance:60] or a @Template[burst|distance:30].

It can't use Destructive Harmonics again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Destructive Harmonics]]{1d4 rounds}.

Painful Harmonics.name: 痛苦谐波 Painful Harmonics
Painful Harmonics.description:
暗音盲怪发出一声音波尖啸，形成一个@Template[cone|distance:60]或一个@Template[burst|distance:30]。这阵刺耳的长嚎沿着该区域内活体生物的神经与骨骼共鸣，化作一波波令人失能的痛楚浪潮冲刷受害者。该区域内的每个活体生物都必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:26]豁免。

暗音盲怪在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Painful Harmonics]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用痛苦泛音。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}，持续1轮。

失败 该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{失聪}3轮，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑2}。

大失败 该生物失聪1分钟，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑3}。

The destrachan emits a sonic cry in either a @Template[cone|distance:60] or a @Template[burst|distance:30]. This discordant ululation resonates along the nerves and bones of living creatures in the area, manifesting as waves of incapacitating pain washing over the victims. Each living creature in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save.

The destrachan can't use Painful Harmonics again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Painful Harmonics]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 3 rounds and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is deafened for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.

Shattering Harmonics.name: 破碎谐振 Shattering Harmonics
Shattering Harmonics.description:
暗音盲怪将其谐波聚焦于60英尺内一个由水晶、金属、石头或木头制成的单一物品。目标物体受到 @Damage[7d8[sonic]] 伤害。若该物品有人持用，其携带者可以为该物品尝试一次 @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] 豁免。

暗音盲怪在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Shattering Harmonics]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用碎裂谐波。

The destrachan focuses its harmonics against a single item within 60 feet that is made of crystal, metal, stone, or wood. The target object takes @Damage[7d8[sonic]] damage. If the item is attended, its bearer can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save for the item.

The destrachan can't use Shattering Harmonics again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Shattering Harmonics]]{1d4 rounds}.

Destrachan.publicNotes:
这种地下爬行类恐怖生物用两条强壮的后腿行走。它的前肢长着锋利的弯曲利爪，而它那布满利齿、无眼、管状的头部有三只极度敏感的褶边耳，会转向附近发出的任何声音。然而，这个残忍怪物真正的武器，是它用于导航、交流与狩猎的声呐尖啸的放大版本。它通过一套复杂的咔哒声、尖叫与口哨声序列与同类沟通，但也足够聪明，能理解其他语言。大多数暗音盲怪至少理解另一种语言——通常是萨克弗罗斯语——而且往往可以讲道理。

作为专性食肉动物，暗音盲怪嗜好新鲜肉食，但也绝不会犹豫，会把路上发现的腐肉当作一餐。成群结队旅行时，这些生物非常乐于在攻击并制服旅人之前，先在数英里的隧道中跟踪他们，然后把他们活活吞食。

This underground reptilian horror walks on two powerful hind legs. Its forelimbs are armed with sharp curving claws, and its toothy, eyeless, tubular head has three hypersensitive frilled ears that turn toward any sound made in its vicinity. This cruel monster's true weapon, however, is an amplified version of the sonic cry that it uses to navigate, communicate, and hunt. It communicates with others of its kind through a complex series of clicks, shrieks, and whistles, but it is intelligent enough to understand other languages. Most destrachans understand at least one other language-usually Sakvroth-and can often be reasoned with.

An obligate carnivore, the destrachan relishes fresh meat but won't hesitate to make a meal of carrion it finds in its path. When traveling in packs, the creatures take great delight in stalking travelers through miles of tunnels before attacking and subduing them, then devouring them alive.
Destrachan.allSaves: +4 status to all saves vs. sonic

Dreshkan.name: 铁骨怪 Dreshkan

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Bleed, Death.name: 对抗流血、死亡效果、疾病、濒死、疲乏、麻痹、毒素、恶心的所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Bleed, Death Effects, Disease, Doomed, Fatigued, Paralyzed, Poison, Sickened

Defensive Needle.name: 防御针刺 Defensive Needle
Defensive Needle.description:
触发 一个生物对铁骨怪进行一次近战打击并大失败

效果 铁骨怪对该生物进行一次针刺打击。

Trigger A creature critically fails a melee Strike against the dreshkan

Effect The dreshkan makes a needle Strike against that creature.

Partially Technological.name: 半机械 Partially Technological
Partially Technological.description:
铁骨怪是半机械。活力治疗效果只能为铁骨怪提供正常一半的治疗量。

A dreshkan is partially technological. Vitality healing effects only heal a dreshkan half as much as normal.

Needle Spray.name: 针刺喷射 Needle Spray
Needle Spray.description:
铁骨怪用四肢稳住自身，并在一个 @Template[cone|distance:30] 内向任意数量的生物喷射针刺，造成 @Damage[2d4[piercing],2d8[electricity]]{2d4 穿刺伤害加 2d8 电击伤害}。区域内每个被选为目标的生物必须进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]。

The dreshkan braces itself on all four limbs and sprays needles at as many creatures as it would like in a @Template[cone|distance:30], dealing @Damage[2d4[piercing],2d8[electricity]]{2d4 piercing damage plus 2d8 electricity damage}. Each targeted creature in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic].

Swarming Stance.name: 集群姿态 Swarming Stance
Swarming Stance.description:
铁骨怪可以与摩洛克或另一只铁骨怪共享同一空间，但同一空间内至多只能有两只这样的生物。当这些生物共享同一空间时，它们的攻击掷骰获得+1环境加值。

A dreshkan can share the same space as a morlock or another dreshkan, but no more than two such creatures can occupy the same space. When these creatures share the same space, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls.

Dreshkan.publicNotes:
由于摩洛克源自遥远的人类祖先，笨拙或仓促地对一名摩洛克施行塑肉仪式，只会制造出一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.VCYF0NAfPKwTHkK1]{胶化人}。然而，技艺娴熟的塑肉者能够诱导出摩洛克的基因差异，从而造就一种完全不同的生物。制造铁骨怪的过程包括用金属骷髅（特征）替换摩洛克的骨骼。这副新的骷髅（特征）通常会被大幅强化，例如从脊柱伸出蛛形的肢体，或装配装满致命细针的弹匣。此后，奥术电流会在铁骨怪体内奔涌，使其变得紧张易怒。

摩洛克将铁骨怪视为血肉与科技令人惊叹的融合体，并乐意与这些生物并肩作战；在他们眼中，铁骨怪是摩洛克潜能的典范。

尽管把受害者扭曲成可怖形态是邪恶卓尔广为人知的消遣，但其他地下怪物也窃取了这些做法，或是独立发展出类似手段。虫状的双尾虫怪有时会扭曲那些领地与其无光疆域相邻的其他生物；下文所列的塑肉产物分别源自摩洛克与透肌魔人。

Because morlocks are descended from distant human ancestors, clumsily or hastily fleshwarping a morlock simply produces a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.VCYF0NAfPKwTHkK1]{Grothlut}. Skilled fleshwarpers, however, can tease out a morlock's genetic differences to make an entirely different creature. Creating a dreshkan involves replacing the morlock's bones with a metal skeleton. This new skeleton is often heavily augmented, such as with spiderlike limbs protruding from the spine or magazines of tiny, deadly needles. Arcane electricity courses through the dreshkan thereafter, making it jumpy and irritable.

Morlocks view dreshkans as impressive fusions of flesh and technology and gladly fight alongside these creatures, whom they view as paragons of morlock potential.

Although twisting victims into horrid shapes is a well-known pastime of evil drow, other subterranean monsters have stolen these practices or developed them independently. The worm-like seugathis sometimes warp other creatures whose territories abut their lightless lands; the fleshwarps below result from morlocks and urdefhans, respectively.
Dreshkan.allSaves: +2 status to all saves vs. bleed, death effects, disease, doomed, fatigued, paralyzed, poison, and sickened

Drider.name: 蛛化精灵 Drider

Arcane Prepared Spells.name: 奥术预备法术 Arcane Prepared Spells

Arcane Innate Spells.name: 奥术天生法术 Arcane Innate Spells

Clairvoyance.name: 鹰眼术 Clairvoyance
Clairvoyance.description:
你在射程内的一处位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的漂浮之眼（即使该位置在你的视觉线或效果线之外）。这只眼睛无法移动，但你可以如同使用你正常的视觉感官一般，从该点向所有方向观察。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
你甜言蜜语般的话语令生物难以抗拒。你向目标提出一项行动方案，你的措辞必须让该方案在目标看来像是合乎逻辑的行动方针，并且不能具有自我毁灭性或明显违背目标自身利益。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是正常地在和它说话，而不是在对它施放法术。

失败 目标立刻遵从你的暗示术。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标完成一项有限的暗示术内容，或该暗示术变得具有自我毁灭性，或产生其他明显的负面效果为止。

大失败 同失败，但基础持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你可以以最多10个生物为目标。

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Clairaudience.name: 锐耳术 Clairaudience
Clairaudience.description:
你在射程内的一个位置创造一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的漂浮耳朵（即使它在你的视觉线或效果线之外）。它无法移动，但你可以通过这只耳朵听见，如同使用你正常的听觉感官一样。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating ear at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.

Fireball.name: 火球术 Fireball
Fireball.description:
一道轰鸣的火焰爆风出现在你指定的斑点，造成6d6点火焰伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6点。

A roaring blast of fire appears at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Levitate.name: 浮空术 Levitate
Levitate.description:
你违抗重力，并对目标施放浮空术，使其离地5英尺。在法术的持续时间内，你可以用一个单动作使目标上升或下降10英尺，该动作具有专注（特征）。因浮空术而漂浮在空中的生物，其攻击掷骰承受-2环境减值。漂浮的生物可以花费一个交互动作来稳定自身，并在其本回合剩余时间内抵消该减值。若目标邻接于某个固定的物体或稳定性合适的地形，它可以通过攀爬（若表面为垂直，如墙壁）或匍匐（若表面为水平，如天花板）沿该表面移动。GM决定哪些表面可以被攀爬或匍匐通过。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{法术效果：浮空术}

You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. For the duration of the spell, you can move the target up or down 10 feet with a single action, which has the concentrate trait. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

Acid Arrow.name: 酸液箭 Acid Arrow
Acid Arrow.description:
你召唤一支酸箭，在命中后持续腐蚀目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击。命中时，你造成3d8点酸液伤害，外加@Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]]伤害。大成功时，将初始伤害加倍，但不加倍持续伤害。

升阶（+2） 初始伤害增加2d8，且持续酸液伤害增加1d6。

You conjure an arrow of acid that keeps corroding the target after it hits. Make a spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]] damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光线穿透或在该区域内发散。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在区域内时都不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外亦然。这也会压制你黑暗术法术环阶或更低环阶的魔法光亮。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即便具有暗视（但不包括高等暗视）的生物也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。它们将透过这片黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你解开某个法术或效果背后的魔法。对该目标进行一次反制检定。若你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品在10分钟内变为其类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。若该目标是神器或类似物品，你会自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
当你施放该法术时，区域内的所有生物在持续时间内会被你选择颜色的多彩、无热火焰勾勒轮廓。受妖火术影响的可见生物不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}状态。如果这些生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}状态，则在受妖火术影响期间它们处于Concealed状态，而不是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
披覆于幻象之中，目标变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言都处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对它们而言改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}状态。若目标使用敌对动作，则在该敌对动作完成后该法术结束。

强化（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但目标使用敌对动作时不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮(术)，这些光亮(术)彼此之间的距离不超过10英尺。每个都像火炬一样照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮(术)移动至多60英尺。每个光亮(术)必须保持在你120英尺内，并且与其他所有光亮(术)的距离保持在10英尺内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你放出一道脉冲，用以登记魔法的存在。除了魔法是否存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。

你只有在该魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才会侦测到幻术学派的魔法。然而，带有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术在射程内所侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果同样强大，则由 GM 决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 同 3环，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的来源。与模糊感官相同，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个 5 尺立方体内（或若目标大于该范围，则为最近的等效范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造一个简单声音的听觉幻觉，其最大音量相当于四个普通人同时喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法创造可理解的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60英尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120英尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Mage Hand.name: 法师之手 Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
你创造一只单独的魔法手，它可以是隐形或幽灵般的，抓住目标物体并缓慢移动至多20英尺。由于你在使物体悬浮，你可以让它朝任何方向移动。当你维持法术时，你可以让该物体额外移动20英尺。如果法术结束时物体仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以负载为1或更少的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以负载为1或更少的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以负载为2或更少的无人持用物体为目标。

You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Magic Missile.name: 魔法飞弹 Magic Missile
Magic Missile.description:
你射出一枚力场飞镖，呼啸着飞向你能看见的一名生物。它自动命中并造成 1d4+1 力场伤害。你在施放法术时每额外使用 1 个动作，发射的飞弹数量增加 1 枚，最多在使用 3 个动作时发射 3 枚飞弹。你可以分别为每枚飞弹选择目标。如果你将多于 1 枚飞弹射向同一目标，在应用伤害加值或减值、抗力、弱点等之前，先将伤害合并。

升阶（+2） 你每花费 1 个动作，就额外发射 1 枚飞弹。

You send a dart of force streaking toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of missiles you shoot by one, to a maximum of three missiles for 3 actions. You choose the target for each missile individually. If you shoot more than one missile at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You shoot one additional missile with each action you spend.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击掷骰。如果你成功，该生物尝试一次强韧豁免以决定法术的效果。如果你的攻击掷骰为大成功或大失败，使用其豁免结果降低一级成功等级的结果。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Ray of Frost.name: 霜冻射线 Ray of Frost
Ray of Frost.description:
你发射一道冰冷的射线。进行一次法术攻击掷骰。该射线造成 2d4 寒冷伤害。

大成功 目标受到双倍伤害，并且其各项速度在 1 轮内承受 -10 尺的状态减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{法术效果：霜冻射线}

成功 目标受到正常伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You blast an icy ray. Make a spell attack roll. The ray deals 2d4 cold damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Spell Effect: Ray of Frost}

Success The target takes normal damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭杆由木材制成。它的一端有羽翎以在飞行中保持稳定，另一端则装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对所有对抗魔法的豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Drider Venom.name: 蛛化精灵毒液 Drider Venom
Drider Venom.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:23]

最长持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{衰弱 1}

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:23]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}

Web Trap.name: 网捕 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被蛛化精灵的蛛网术攻击命中的生物将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}状态，并粘附在最近的表面上（逃脱 DC 21）。

A creature hit by a drider's web attack is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface (Escape DC 21).

Drider.publicNotes:
卓尔掌握的第一种塑肉仪式过程，至今仍是他们最成功也最臭名昭著的成果：蛛化精灵。将卓尔的身体与巨型蜘蛛的身体融合，蛛化精灵是一种具有明显两性异形的塑肉体——也是已知唯一能够繁衍后代的塑肉体。雌性蛛化精灵拥有优雅卓尔女性的上半身躯干，口中长着带毒的尖锐獠牙；而雄性蛛化精灵则面容丑陋、突变严重，进一步将类人形态与蜘蛛形态融为一体；这种外貌差异或许反映了卓尔社会的母系特质。在战斗中，所有蛛化精灵同样危险。

尽管塑肉仪式过程最初意在惩罚那些失宠的卓尔，但这种骇人变形带来的显著力量与强韧对一些卓尔颇具吸引力，卓尔城市中越来越多的低阶市民自愿接受这道痛苦的手术。作为交换，这些自愿的蛛化精灵必须强制服役一段时代，担任守卫、士兵或其他公职人员；之后他们会被允许过自己的生活，通常居住在位于城市边缘的洞窟中。残酷的真相是，对大多数蛛化精灵而言，他们活不到获得这份奖赏的那一刻，因为卓尔嗜好将他们的塑肉体奴隶役使至死，或将他们投入致命的战争任务之中——在那种任务里，生存只是极其渺茫的可能。

大多数蛛化精灵使用奥术魔法，但使用神术魔法的蛛化精灵也广为人知，而极少数则使用秘术或原始魔法。无论其魔法根源为何，蛛化精灵的先天法术都保持不变；但那些将不同类型的魔法作为备妥法术来施展者，其备妥的法术很可能与下方所呈现的蛛化精灵完全不同。

有些生物，尤其是卓尔，并不满足于仅仅杀死敌人。他们沉溺于通过一种名为塑肉仪式的骇人变形技术，使对手遭受彻底的羞辱与堕落。尽管塑肉仪式过程并非由卓尔创造，许多人却相信他们将其臻于完善。卓尔将敌人投入翻涌的魔法试剂大缸中加以折磨，同时重塑其血肉与心智，将其改造为可憎而怪诞之物。血肉的再构成带来了无数种塑肉体的变体，而以下只是这些恐怖造物的几个例子。

The first fleshwarping process mastered by the drow remains both their most successful and most infamous: the drider. Fusing the body of a drow with that of a giant spider, driders are a sexually dimorphic fleshwarp-the only fleshwarp known to be able to produce young. While female driders have the upper torsos of elegant drow women with mouths featuring sharp poisoned fangs, male driders have hideous, mutated countenances that further blend the humanoid form with that of a spider; the difference in appearance is perhaps a reflection on the matriarchal nature of drow society. In combat, all driders are equally dangerous.

Although the fleshwarping process was originally intended to be a punishment for drow who fell from grace, the significant powers and strengths gained from the horrifying transformation are attractive to some drow, and an increasing number of lower-ranking citizens in drow cities volunteer themselves for the painful procedure. In return for mandatory time serving as a guardian, soldier, or other public servant, such volunteer driders are later allowed to lead their own lives, typically in caverns located in a city's periphery. The painful truth is that for most driders, they do not live long enough to see this reward, for the drow have a penchant for working their fleshwarped slaves to death or deploying them in deadly war missions in which survival is a only a remote possibility.

Most driders use arcane magic, but driders who use divine magic are well known, while a rare few use occult or primal magic. A drider's innate spells remain the same regardless of the magical tradition, but those who use different types of magic as prepared spells may well have entirely different spells prepared than the drider presented below.

Some creatures, notably drow, are not happy with merely killing their enemies. They revel in the total degradation of their foes through the horrifying transformative technique known as fleshwarping. Though the fleshwarping process was not created by the drow, many believe they perfected it. The drow torture their enemies in vats of churning magical reagents, reshaping their flesh and psyche alike into horrid and monstrous things. The reconstitution of flesh results in countless variations of fleshwarps, and the following are just a couple of examples of these horrors.

Falxi Orshendiel.name: 法尔西·奥申迪尔 Falxi Orshendiel
Falxi Orshendiel.tokenName: 法尔西·奥申迪尔 Falxi Orshendiel

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造出一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光线穿透或在该区域内发出。光线不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在处于该区域内时都不会发出任何光，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外亦然。这也会压制你黑暗术法术环位或更低环位的魔法光源。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括强大黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时处于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的、绚丽且无热的火焰勾勒出轮廓。受妖火术影响时，可见的生物不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}状态。如果这些生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}状态，那么在受妖火术影响时它们处于Concealed状态，而不是处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}状态。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光源，彼此之间任意两个的距离都不超过10尺。每个都像火把一样发出光照。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光源移动至多60尺。每个光源必须保持在你120尺内，并且与所有其他光源保持在10尺内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这套皮革护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还加装小型金属板，提供了大部分皮革护甲的灵活性，同时具备更强的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Lethargy Poison.name: 昏睡毒 Lethargy Poison
Lethargy Poison.description:
昏睡毒常被卓尔及其他希望受害者存活的人用于打了就跑的战术；伏击者会撤退，直到毒素生效并让受害者昏迷。再次暴露于昏睡毒不会要求目标尝试额外的豁免掷骰；只有在对持续暴露的豁免掷骰中失败才会使其阶段推进。

启动 2 互动（伤害）

豁免掷骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

最大持续时间 4 小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 迟缓 1（1 分钟）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷}，且无法进行察觉检定来醒来（1 轮）

阶段 4 昏迷，且无法进行察觉检定来醒来（[[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 小时}）。

Lethargy poison is commonly used in hit-and-run tactics by drow and others who want their victims alive; the ambusher retreats until the poison sets in and the victim falls unconscious. Further exposure to lethargy poison does not require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing an saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Activate 2 Interact (Injury)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 slowed 1 (1 minute)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours}).

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗心灵效果的所有豁免获得 +2 状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Nimble Dodge.name: 灵巧闪避 Nimble Dodge
Nimble Dodge.description:
需求 卓尔游荡者在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{负荷}状态下无法使用此反应动作（）。

触发 卓尔游荡者被其能看见的生物进行的攻击命中或重击命中。

效果 卓尔游荡者针对触发的攻击获得+2环境加值至其护甲等级。

Requirements A drow rogue can't use this reaction while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered}.

Trigger The drow rogue is hit or critically hit by an attack made by a creature the drow rogue can see.

Effect The drow rogue gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Armor Class against the triggering attack.

Quick Draw.name: 快速拔取 Quick Draw
Quick Draw.description:
卓尔游荡者用【交互】动作拔出一把武器，然后用该武器进行【打击】。

The drow rogue draws a weapon using the Interact action, then Strikes with that weapon.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
该卓尔游荡者对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物造成额外1d6点精准伤害。

The drow rogue deals 1d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Falxi Orshendiel.publicNotes:
卓尔天生独来独往，卓尔游荡者谁也不信——尤其不信同为杀手的同伴。这些卓尔依靠警觉与适应来在他们社会中冷酷无情的生存法则下活下去。

最初的卓尔是数千年前一场毁灭性大灾变后逃入世界深处的精灵。在他们向下的旅途中，他们陷入争吵与内斗，引来了某些超越自身的邪恶智识的注意。究竟是某位恶魔领主的影响、粗暴巨兽罗伐古格，还是其他堕落之力所致无人知晓，但在那段时代里，这些精灵在精神与肉体上都发生了转变，他们的心被残忍、施虐与暴力的欲望所玷污。他们的眼睛颜色变为阴森的红色或惨白色，而他们的皮肤则呈现出一种超凡脱俗的淡紫光泽，使卓尔一眼便能被认出。卓尔还发展出强大的魔法能力与抗力，进一步赋予他们力量——代价却是他们的灵魂。

在随后的数个世纪里，卓尔发展成一个强大却以暴力维系、机能失调的社会，受恶魔领主崇拜影响，并以将权力与荣耀供奉给相对少数的贵族家族为中心。许多贵族家族本质上是母系结构，且都效忠于某位特定的恶魔领主庇主——但对崇拜、战争与法术的传统仍足以将这些常常争吵不休的家族捆绑在一起，使卓尔社会不至于从内部自我吞噬。对招致上位者怒火的恐惧(术)——无论那上位者是导师、父母、指挥官，还是自己所崇拜的恶魔——才是维系卓尔社会的真正纽带；这一体系既被最卑微的卓尔仆役所推崇，也同样为最强大的卓尔女祭司所尊崇。

卓尔在全世界都臭名昭著，但直到最近，大多数人仍以为那些崇拜恶魔、居住于地下的精灵故事，只是围着篝火讲的阴森传说。如今，卓尔的存在已是公认的事实；尽管他们栖身于深处黑暗洞窟的存在令人不安，但他们似乎暂时满足于不去打扰地表世界。

Loners at heart, drow rogues trust no one-least of all fellow slayers. Thees drow rely on awareness and adaptation to survive the cutthroat nature of their society.

The first drow were elves who fled into the depths of the world from a devastating cataclysm thousands of years ago. In their journey below, they fell to bickering and in-fighting, drawing the attention of sinister intelligences beyond their own. Whether it was the influence of a specific demon lord, the Rough Beast Rovagug, or some other fell force is unknown, but in that time the elves transformed both spiritually and physically, tainting their hearts with desires for cruelty, sadism, and violence. The hues of their eyes became sinister red or bleached white, and their flesh adopted an unearthly lavender sheen that made the drow instantly recognizable. The drow also developed potent magical abilities and resistances that further empowered them, if at the cost of their souls.

Over the centuries to follow, the drow developed into a powerful, if violently dysfunctional society, influenced by the worship of demon lords and focused on providing power and glory to a relatively small collection of noble houses. Many of these noble houses are matriarchal in nature and all hold allegiance to a specific demon lord patron-but traditions of worship, warfare, and wizardry help to bind the oft-bickering houses together enough that drow society doesn't simply consume itself from within. Fear of earning the wrath of one's superior-be it a teacher, a parent, a commander, or the demon one worships-is the real bond holding drow society together, and this system is held in esteem by the lowliest drow servant and by the most powerful drow priestess alike.

The drow are infamous throughout the world, but until recently most assumed stories of demon-worshipping, underground-dwelling elves were spooky legends crafted to share around a campfire. Today, the existence of drow is an understood truth, and while their presence in the dark caverns deep below is unsettling, they seem content to leave the surface world alone for now.
