You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成2d4心灵伤害和1d4持续心灵伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害但不承受持续伤害，且法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始与持续伤害，且目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，持续伤害结束且法术结束。

大失败 同失败，但目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d4，持续伤害增加1d4。

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and 1d4 persistent mental damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Coven.name: 秘社 Coven
Coven.description:
巫火将 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{梦魇术}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tlcrVRqW1MSKJ5IC]{魅影杀手}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0XP2XOxT9VSiXFDr]{魅影灾祸}以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i1TvBID5QLyXrUCa]{召唤怪形}加入其巫会的法术中。

一个巫会可以包含一个或多个巫火，但也必须至少包含一个能够组成巫会的活体生物；三个巫火无法组成巫会。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Coven]

The witchfire adds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tlcrVRqW1MSKJ5IC]{Phantasmal Killer}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0XP2XOxT9VSiXFDr]{Phantasmal Calamity}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i1TvBID5QLyXrUCa]{Summon Entity} to their coven's spells.

A coven can contain one or more witchfires, but it must also include at least one living creature capable of forming a coven; three witchfires cannot form a coven.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Coven]

Opportune Witchflame.name: 伺机巫焰 Opportune Witchflame
Opportune Witchflame.description:
触发 一名生物对巫火进行一次近战打击或触碰巫火

效果 巫火对触发的生物进行一次巫焰爱抚打击。

Trigger A creature makes a melee Strike against or touches the witchfire

Effect The witchfire makes a witchflame caress Strike against the triggering creature.

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当巫火守卫被摧毁时，只要此房间内仍有任何生物处于停滞状态，她就会在[[/gmr 1d4 #Rejuvenation]]{1d4天}后于被煤烟熏黑的柱子旁重塑，完全痊愈。

When the witchfire warden is destroyed, and as long as any creatures remain in stasis in this room, she reforms in [[/gmr 1d4 #Rejuvenation]]{1d4 days} at the soot-blackened pillar, fully healed.

Witchflame.name: 女巫之焰 Witchflame
Witchflame.description:
任何因巫火的打击而受到虚空伤害的生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:26] 豁免。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响，并在1小时内暂时免疫巫焰。

成功 该生物看起来被病态的绿色火焰点燃。这些火焰自身不造成伤害，但只要火焰燃烧，该生物就不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形} 生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽} 而非处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉}），并在1轮内获得火焰弱点5。

失败 同成功，但该效果为永久，直到被移除为止。

大成功或大失败 同失败，但该生物获得火焰弱点10。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.NHwmrSyF0e8HUE3m]{效果：巫焰（成功）}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.L7SiTshdimUPWfnB]{效果：巫焰（失败）}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.McawF8weCe7O81um]{效果：巫焰（大成功或大失败）}

Any creature that takes void damage from a witchfire's Strike must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to witchflame for 1 hour.

Success The creature appears to catch fire with sickly green flames. These flames deal no damage on their own, but as long as the flames burn, the creature can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}) and gains weakness 5 to fire for 1 round.

Failure As success, but the effect is permanent until removed.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature gains weakness 10 to fire.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.NHwmrSyF0e8HUE3m]{Effect: Witchflame (Success)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.L7SiTshdimUPWfnB]{Effect: Witchflame (Failure)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.McawF8weCe7O81um]{Effect: Witchflame (Critical Failure)}

Witchflame Kindling.name: 巫焰引火物 Witchflame Kindling
Witchflame Kindling.description:
需求 巫火30英尺内的一个生物正被巫焰灼烧

效果 巫火的双眼与口中明亮地发光，而目标生物身上的巫焰短暂地燃烧得炽热得多，对该生物造成 @Damage[5d6[fire],5d6[void]]{5d6火焰伤害与5d6虚空伤害}（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] 豁免）。

巫火在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Witchflame Kindling]]{1d4轮}内无法使用巫焰引燃。

Requirements A creature within 30 feet of the witchfire burns with witchflame

Effect The witchfire's eyes and mouth glow brightly, and the witchflame on the target creature momentarily burns much hotter, dealing @Damage[5d6[fire],5d6[void]]{5d6 fire damage and 5d6 void damage} to that creature (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save).

The witchfire can't use Witchflame Kindling for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Witchflame Kindling]]{1d4 rounds}.

Witchfire Warden.publicNotes:
这种虚体不死生物显现为一具蜿蜒的形体，周身缠绕着病态的绿色火焰。当强大的鬼婆（特征）或女巫在痛苦或暴怒中死去时，便会形成这种存在。火焰中心的躯体通常会呈现为女巫理想化的自我形象，而不论其死亡时的年代与外貌如何。

巫火常栖居于泥沼或沼泽之中，其周遭会缓慢变黑并衰败。这些地区往往饱受鬼火侵扰，它们似乎与当地的巫火有着某种不可思议的联系。巫火可能会造访其家园地形边缘的村落以诱走村民，但总会在能让其他村民听见的距离内攻击受害者，以确保他们听到惨叫。巫火也可能与其他鬼婆（特征）或女巫结为盟友，甚至加入她们的密会，但巫火无法完全凭自身形成密会。

Manifesting as a sinuous form wreathed in sickly green flames, this incorporeal undead forms when a powerful hag or witch dies in agony or rage. The body at the center of the flames usually resembles the witch's idealized self-image, regardless of their age and appearance at the time of their death.

A witchfire often resides in a bog or swamp, which slowly blackens and decays around them. These regions are often plagued by will-o'-wisps, which seem to have an uncanny relationship with the resident witchfire. A witchfire might visit villages on the edge of their home terrain to lure away villagers, but always attack victims within earshot to make sure that other villagers hear the screams. A witchfire might also ally with other hags or witches and even join their covens, but a witchfire is incapable of forming covens entirely on their own.

Ysondkhelir.name: 伊松德赫利 Ysondkhelir

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能天生法术 Occult Innate Spells

Outcast's Curse.name: 流放诅咒 Outcast's Curse
Outcast's Curse.description:
你用一道诅咒折磨目标，使其存在感令人不适、惹人厌烦。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 持续10分钟，每当目标尝试欺瞒、交涉、威吓或表演检定时，必须掷骰两次并采用较差的结果，并且他们在遭遇到的生物对其初始态度会变差一步（例如，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{不友好}而非@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{不关心}）。

失败 同成功，但效果为永久。

大成功或大失败 同失败，且目标在遭遇到的生物对其初始态度会变差两步。

You afflict the target with a curse that makes its presence abrasive and off-putting. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 10 minutes, the target must roll twice and use the worse result whenever attempting a Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check, and creatures they encounter have an initial attitude toward them of one step worse (for instance, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent}).

Failure As success, but the effect is permanent.

Critical Failure As failure, and creatures that the target encounters have an initial attitude toward them of two steps worse.

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
你甜言蜜语，让生物难以抗拒。你向目标提出一个行动方案，该方案必须以一种对目标而言看似合乎逻辑的方式来措辞，且不能是自我毁灭性的，或明显违背目标自身利益的。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是在正常与其交谈，而不是对其施放法术。

失败 目标立即遵从你的暗示术。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标完成一个有限的暗示术内容，或该暗示术内容变得自我毁灭性，或出现其他明显的负面效果为止。

大失败 同失败，但基础持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Tongues (Constant).name: 巧言术（恒定） Tongues (Constant)
Tongues (Constant).description:
目标可以理解所有词语，无论语言如何，并且也能说出其他生物的语言。当处于由多种生物组成的混合团体中时，每次目标开口说话时，它都可以选择一个生物，并用该生物能理解的语言说话，即使目标并不知道那是什么语言。

升阶（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

Hypnotic Pattern.name: 催眠图文 Hypnotic Pattern
Hypnotic Pattern.description:
你创造出一片不断变幻的色彩图案，它以几何形态的云团悬浮在空中。生物在该图案之内时处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}状态。此外，若生物在你施放该法术时位于图案之内、进入图案、在图案内结束其回合，或对图案使用一次搜寻或交互动作，则必须尝试一次意志豁免。当前被该图案@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}的生物不会再进行新的豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标被该图案迷魂。

大失败 目标被该图案迷魂。只要它仍处于迷魂状态，就不能使用反应动作（）。

You create a pattern of shifting colors that hovers in the air in a geometric cloud. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} while inside the pattern. In addition, a creature must attempt a Will saving throw if it is inside the pattern when you cast it, when it enters the pattern, when it ends its turn within the pattern, or if it uses a Seek or Interact action on the pattern. A creature currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the pattern doesn't attempt new saves.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is Fascinated by the pattern.

Critical Failure The target is Fascinated by the pattern. While it remains Fascinated, it can't use reactions.

Levitate.name: 浮空术 Levitate
Levitate.description:
你违抗重力并使目标施放浮空术，离地5英尺。于法术持续时间内，你可以用一个带有专注（特征）的单动作使目标向上或向下移动10英尺。因浮空术而漂浮在空中的生物，其攻击掷骰承受-2环境减值。漂浮的生物可以花费一个交互动作来稳定自身，并在其回合剩余时间内抵消该减值。若目标邻近一个固定物体或足够稳固的地形，它可以通过攀爬（若表面为垂直，如墙壁）或匍匐（若表面为水平，如天花板）沿着该表面移动。GM决定哪些表面可以被攀爬或匍匐通过。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{法术效果：浮空术}

You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. For the duration of the spell, you can move the target up or down 10 feet with a single action, which has the concentrate trait. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

Locate.name: 定位术 Locate
Locate.description:
你会知晓目标的方向（如果你选择了某个特定的物体，例如“我母亲的剑”）或最近的目标（如果你选择了一类物体，例如“剑”）。如果目标是某个特定的物体，你必须曾用自己的感官直接观察过它。如果目标是一类物体，你仍需要对该类物体有准确的心象。如果你与目标之间有铅或流动的水隔开，这个法术无法定位术该物体。这意味着如果最近的那件物体被铅或流动的水遮蔽，你可能会找到更远处的同类物体。

强化（5环） 你可以以特定的生物或族裔作为目标，而非物体，但你必须曾与想要作为目标的该生物或族裔见过面或近距离见过。

You learn the direction to the target (if you picked a specific object, such as "my mother's sword") or the nearest target (if you picked a type of object, such as "swords"). If the target is a specific object, you must have observed it directly with your own senses. If it's a type of object, you still need to have an accurate mental image of the type of object. If there's lead or running water between you and the target, this spell can't locate the object. This means you might find a type of object farther away if the nearest one is behind lead or running water.

Heightened (5th) You can target a specific creature or ancestry instead of an object, but you must have met or seen up close the creature or ancestry you want to target.

Mind Reading.name: 读心术 Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
你以一种粗略的精神接触，尝试读取目标的思想。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。随后，目标在1小时内暂时免疫你的读心术。

大成功或大失败 当你施放法术时，目标会从你这里感知到模糊的表层思绪。

成功 你会得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层思绪，并且你会得知其智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大成功或大失败 同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持法术以再次侦测目标的表层思绪。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the Spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Mirror Image.name: 镜影术 Mirror Image
Mirror Image.description:
三个你的幻象在你的空间内盘旋，可能会使那些攻击你的人改为击中其中一个幻象而非你本人。任何本应命中你的攻击，都有一定的随机几率改为命中你的一个幻象。如果三个幻象都还存在，则有 1/4 的几率命中你（在 [[/r 1d4]] 中掷出 1）。当剩余两个幻象时，则有 1/3 的几率命中你（在 [[/r 1d6]] 中掷出 1-2）。当只剩一个幻象时，几率为 1/2（在 [[/r 1d6]] 中掷出 1-3）。

一旦某个幻象被命中，它就会被摧毁。如果一次攻击掷骰未能命中你的 AC 但并未大失败，它会摧毁一个幻象，但没有额外效果（即使该攻击通常在失败时也会有某种效果）。如果一次攻击掷骰为大成功，且本会命中某个幻象，则会摧毁其中一个幻象，并且该次攻击掷骰改为对你造成成功。所有幻象都被摧毁后，该法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{法术效果：镜影术}

Three illusory images of you swirl about your space, potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the images instead of you. Any attack that would hit you has a random chance of hitting one of your images instead of you. If all three images remain, there is a 1 in 4 chance of hitting you (1 on [[/r 1d4]]). With two images remaining, there is a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you (1-2 on [[/r 1d6]]). With only one image, the chances are 1 in 2 (1-3 on [[/r 1d6]]).

Once an image is hit, it is destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit your AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys an image but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an attack roll is a critical success and would hit one of the images, one of the images is destroyed and the attack roll becomes a success against you. Once all the images are destroyed, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: Mirror Image}

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入体，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并使不死生物迷失方向，甚至可能迫使它们逃离。效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物 该法术造成等同于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但在大失败时还会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1}，持续1轮。
  • 不死生物 若强韧豁免失败，目标会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，持续1轮。若大失败，除非其在一次意志豁免中成功，否则目标还会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃窜}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 对活体生物造成的虚空伤害增加1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，用以登记魔法的存在。你获得的信息仅限于魔法是否存在，不会有更多内容。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。

你只有在幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到该幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果强度相同，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你也能精确定位最高等级魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体范围内（若来源大于该范围，则为最接近的范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Mage Hand.name: 法师之手 Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
你创造一只单独的魔法之手，可以是隐形或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并将其缓慢移动至多20英尺。由于你在使物体漂浮，你可以将其朝任意方向移动。当你维持法术时，你可以让该物体额外移动20英尺。若法术结束时物体仍在空中，物体会坠落。

强化（3环）你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

强化（5环）射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

强化（7环）射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以负载为2或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声动唇说出词句，但它们不会从你的口中发出，而是直接传送到目标的耳中。其他人仍无法比你平常动唇时更清楚地听见你的话，但目标听到你的话就如同站在你身旁一般。

目标可以以反应动作（）给出简短回应，或若他们愿意，也可以在其下个回合以自由动作（）回应，但他们必须能看见你且处于射程内才能这么做。若他们回应，其回应会直接传到你的耳中，就像最初的传讯术一样。

升阶（3环） 法术的射程提升至500尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you.

The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻象般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成2d4心灵伤害和1d4持续心灵伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害与持续伤害，且目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，则持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大失败 同失败，但目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

强化（+1） 伤害增加2d4，持续伤害增加1d4。

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{随等级成长的持续心灵伤害}

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and 1d4 persistent mental damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心灵以感知魔法灵光。施法完成后，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法；若是，你会得知其魔法学派。

如果该物体是幻觉，只有当该效果的等级低于你施放的阅读灵光法术的阶位时，你才会侦测到这一点。

强化（3环） 你可以以最多10个物体为目标。

强化（6环） 你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Leng Ruby.name: 冷原 红宝石 Leng Ruby
Leng Ruby.description:
许多冷原居民携带着从冷原采石场开采的奇异红宝石。只要一名生物持有一枚其自愿接受、由冷原居民作为赋礼或报酬给予的冷原红宝石，任何冷原居民就都能以1英里的射程将该生物作为目标施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KSAEhNfZyXMO7Z7V]{流放诅咒}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R8bqnYiThB6MYTxD]{幻痛术}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{读心术}，且佩戴者在对抗流放诅咒的豁免检定结果上使用比其豁免结果低一级的判定结果。

Many denizens of Leng carry strange rubies mined from quarries in Leng. As long as a creature holds a Leng ruby that it willingly accepted as a gift or payment from a denizen of Leng, any denizen of Leng can target that creature with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KSAEhNfZyXMO7Z7V]{Outcast's Curse}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R8bqnYiThB6MYTxD]{Phantom Pain}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading} at a range of 1 mile, and the bearer uses an outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its saving throw against Outcast's Curse.

Fragment of Urevian's Pendant.name: 乌瑞维安的坠饰碎片 Fragment of Urevian's Pendant

Planar Fast Healing.name: 位面快速治疗 Planar Fast Healing
Planar Fast Healing.description:
冷原居民始终与冷原保持连接，当他们远离冷原时，获得快速治疗5。他们在冷原上或在位面连接无法运作的区域中失去此能力。若被杀死，其身体会在[[/gmr 1d4 #Dissolve Body]]{1d4轮}内溶解为虚无，只留下他们的装备。被杀死的冷原居民会在冷原重塑；只有在其位面快速治疗无法运作时才能被永久杀死。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FastHealing]

A denizen of Leng maintains a connection to Leng at all times, and when away from Leng, they have fast healing 5. They lose this ability on Leng or in areas where planar connections do not function. If killed, their body dissolves into nothingness in [[/gmr 1d4 #Dissolve Body]]{1d4 rounds}, leaving behind their equipment. A slain denizen reforms in Leng; they can be permanently killed only when their planar fast healing doesn't function.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FastHealing]

No Breath.name: 无须呼吸 No Breath
No Breath.description:
冷原居民不需要呼吸。

Denizens of Leng don't need to breathe.

Debilitating Bite.name: 致残撕咬 Debilitating Bite
Debilitating Bite.description:
受到居民啃咬造成的伤害的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:27] 豁免，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}。每当一个目标在对抗此能力时额外一次豁免失败时，该状态的数值增加 1（最大至笨拙 4）。该状态数值每 24 小时减少 1。

A creature that takes damage from a denizen's bite must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. Each time a target fails an additional save against this ability, the condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of Clumsy 4). This condition value decreases by 1 every 24 hours.

Ysondkhelir.publicNotes:
这些邪恶的人形生物是来自冷原那寒冷、狂风呼啸的次元的奴隶贩子与掠夺者；他们乘坐阴森的黑船横行现实，这些船只能够航行越过次元与位面的边界。尽管大多数冷原居民像任何海盗一样追寻奴隶与劫掠，但也有一些自封为使节与商人，以遍及各地的阴谋播撒纷争。那些难以捉摸的冷原居民会用飘逸的长袍、隐匿之纱与宽大的头巾把自己打扮得像人类，但一旦瞥见其畸变的生理结构，便能从他们那顶短粗角冠与触手般的啃咬，以及覆毛、山羊般的腿部看出端倪。

在那些命令臭名昭著的黑船的凶悍船长之上，还存在着更高一阶的冷原居民。这些邪教徒与乐师担任大祭司，辛劳以安抚那俯视梦魇术界、怀着冰冷恶意的可怖神祇。

Slavers and raiders from the cold, windswept dimension of Leng, these malevolent humanoids range across reality in ominous black ships capable of sailing beyond the borders of dimensions and planes. Although most denizens of Leng seek slaves and plunder like any pirate, others operate as self-styled ambassadors and merchants, sowing discord with far-ranging plots. While the inscrutable denizens dress themselves in flowing robes, veils, and broad turbans to appear human, their aberrant physiology, when glimpsed, is evident from their crown of stubby horns and tentacled jaws to their furry, goat-like legs.

Above the fierce captains who command the infamous black ships are an even higher caste of denizens of Leng. These cultists and musicians serve as high priests, laboring to appease the frightening gods who look down upon the Nightmare Realm with cold malice.
Ysondkhelir.blurb:
男性冷原居民
Male denizen of leng

Painful Suggestion Trap.name: 痛苦暗示陷阱 Painful Suggestion Trap
Painful Suggestion Trap.tokenName: 痛苦暗示陷阱 Painful Suggestion Trap

Counterfeit Haunting.name: 伪造作祟 Counterfeit Haunting
Counterfeit Haunting.description:
触发 一个活着的生物移动经过符文

效果 一声可怖的呻吟在房间里回响，一个沙哑的心灵感应声音喊道：“出去！”

这声喊叫对房间内的生物造成 @Damage[6d12[mental]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:26|basic] 豁免）。在该豁免中失败的生物必须立刻离开房间，并且在1分钟内不能自愿再次进入（在大成功或大失败中大失败则为1小时）。

Trigger A living creature moves over the rune

Effect A frightful moan echoes through the room, and a hoarse telepathic voice shouts, "Get out!"

This shout deals @Damage[6d12[mental]] damage to creatures in the room (@Check[will|dc:26|basic] save). Creatures who fail this saving throw must immediately leave the room and can't willingly reenter it for 1 minute (1 hour on a critical failure).

Painful Suggestion Trap.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:28|name:移除符文|traits:魔法,陷阱]（专家）以在不触发它的情况下移除符文，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（4环；反制DC 26）以解除该符文

@Check[thievery|dc:28|name:Remove Rune|traits:magical,trap] (expert) to remove the rune without triggering it, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th level; counteract DC 26) to dispel the rune
Painful Suggestion Trap.hazarddescription:
在门槛内侧、污秽之下的地板上隐藏着一个符文，会触发一个赝造幽灵（特征）。

A hidden rune on the floor under the filth, just past the threshold, triggers an ersatz ghost.
Painful Suggestion Trap.reset:
该陷阱会在 1 小时后自动重置。

The trap automatically resets after 1 hour.
Painful Suggestion Trap.prototypeToken: 痛苦暗示陷阱 Painful Suggestion Trap

Paralyzing Light Trap.name: 麻痹之光陷阱 Paralyzing Light Trap
Paralyzing Light Trap.tokenName: 麻痹之光陷阱 Paralyzing Light Trap

Stasis Field.name: 静滞场 Stasis Field
Stasis Field.description:
触发 一个非魔鬼生物移动进入光亮(术)

效果 光亮(术)扩张以充满房间，且房间内每个非魔鬼生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:26] 豁免。兵营（区域 D15）内响起一阵高音铃声，在此房间内也能听到。随后陷阱掷骰先攻。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}。

失败 目标 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹} 1轮。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}，持续 [[/gmr 1d4 #Duration Stupefied]]{1d4轮}，并麻痹1轮。

Trigger A non-devil creature moves into the light

Effect The light expands to fill the room, and each nondevil creature within the room must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save. A high-pitched chime sounds in the barracks (area D15), audible in this room as well. The trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for [[/gmr 1d4 #Duration Stupefied]]{1d4 rounds} and paralyzed for 1 round.

Paralyzing Light Trap.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:26|name:扭曲或散射光亮(术)|traits:魔法,陷阱] (大师) 以扭曲或散射光亮(术)，保持光锥完好但防止陷阱触发，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（第4等级；反制 DC 26）以解除光亮(术)，使房间陷入黑暗

@Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Distort or Diffuse the Light|traits:magical,trap] (master) to distort or diffuse the light, keeping the light cone intact but preventing the trap from triggering, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th level; counteract DC 26) to dispel the light, leaving the room in darkness
Paralyzing Light Trap.hazarddescription:
当任何非恶魔的生物进入光亮(术)时，交织在光亮(术)中的魔法会将该生物固定在原地并触发魔法警报。

When any creature other than a devil enters the light, the magic interwoven in the light holds the creature in place and rings an alarm.
Paralyzing Light Trap.reset:
光亮(术)中的停滞魔法会在一小时内逐渐积累，之后陷阱可以再次触发。

The stasis magic in the light builds up over the course of an hour, after which the trap can trigger again.
Paralyzing Light Trap.routine:
（1动作）房间内所有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}的生物受到@Damage[1d10[mental]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:26|basic|traits:magical,trap]意志豁免）。豁免失败的生物还会麻痹1轮，但可以用一个反应动作（）在精神上抵抗这种停滞；这样做的生物受到@Damage[5d10[mental]]精神伤害，但不再麻痹。

(1 action) All @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} creatures in the room take @Damage[1d10[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:26|basic|traits:magical,trap] save). Creatures who fail also become paralyzed for 1 round but can use a reaction to mentally fight off this stasis; creatures who do so take @Damage[5d10[mental]] damage mental damage but are no longer paralyzed.
Paralyzing Light Trap.prototypeToken: 麻痹之光陷阱 Paralyzing Light Trap

Gallows Tooth.name: 绞架之齿 Gallows Tooth
Gallows Tooth.description:
使用方式 固定于一把武器上

启动 F 交互

触发 你攻击一个相邻的生物且尚未为你的攻击掷骰

需求 你在威吓上为大师

这颗骇人的臼齿悬挂在一根绳子上，绳子穿过其干枯、裸露的牙根上方的一个小孔。当你启动此护符时，你正在攻击的生物直到当前回合结束前陷入措手不及。

Usage affixed to a weapon

Activate F Interact

Trigger You attack an adjacent creature and haven't rolled your attack roll

Requirements You're a master in Intimidation

This grisly molar hangs from a cord threaded through a tiny hole just above its dried, exposed root. When you activate this talisman, the creature you're attacking becomes flat-footed until the end of the current turn.

Transparent Elemental Gem.name: 无色元素宝石 Transparent Elemental Gem
Transparent Elemental Gem.description:
启动 D 命令术，交互

你高喊一位元素领主的名字，将这枚玻璃般的宝石猛撞在坚硬表面上以启动它。它会裂开，施放一个5环@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{召唤元素}法术，召唤出一个你控制的元素生物，只要你在每轮花费一个动作来维持该启动。

此宝石有四种型号：透明色用于活体旋风，浅棕色用于活体山崩，红橙色用于活体野火，蓝绿色用于活体瀑布。

Activate D Command, Interact

You shout the name of an elemental lord and dash this glassy gem against a hard surface to activate it. It cracks open, casting a 5th-level @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} spell to summon forth an elemental you control as long as you spend an action each round to Sustain the Activation.

This gem comes in four varieties: transparent for a living whirlwind, light brown for a living landslide, reddish orange for a living wildfire, and blue-green for a living waterfall.

Grim Trophy.name: 惊惧战利品 Grim Trophy
Grim Trophy.description:
使用 附着于护甲

启动 F 凝神

触发 你尝试进行一次威吓检定以进行胁迫或挫败士气，但你尚未掷骰

需求 你在威吓上是专家。

该护符有多种形式，最常见的是以某种骇人方式展示的一截人型生物的断肢。当你启动该战利品时，选择两个目标，并将你的威吓检定结果与他们双方的DC分别比较。

Usage affixed to armor

Activate F Envision

Trigger You attempt an Intimidation check to Coerce or Demoralize, but you haven't rolled yet

Requirements You are an expert in Intimidation.

This talisman comes in many forms, most often a severed piece of a humanoid creature displayed in some gruesome manner. When you activate the trophy, select two targets and compare your Intimidation check result to both of their DCs.

Hellforge Materials.name: 地狱熔炉材料 Hellforge Materials
Hellforge Materials.tokenName: 地狱熔炉材料 Hellforge Materials

Cold Iron Chunk.description:
由冷铁制成的武器对恶魔与妖精同样致命。冷铁看起来像普通铁，但它从特别纯净的矿源开采，并在几乎不加热或完全不加热的情况下塑形。这个过程极其困难，尤其是对于高品级的冷铁物品。

银制武器对从魔鬼到狼人等各类生物都是一种绝望术。银制物品不如钢制物品耐用，而低品级的银制物品通常只是镀银。

Adamantine Chunk.description:
从自天而降的陨石中开采而得，精金是已知最坚硬的金属之一。它外观呈闪亮的黑色，并因其惊人的韧性与能够保持不可思议的锋利刃口的能力而备受珍视。

Explosive Arrow.name: 爆炸箭 Explosive Arrow
Explosive Arrow.description:
启动 A 交互

这发弹药上覆着粗粝的黑色烟灰。当启动后的爆炸弹药命中一个目标时，投射物在一个@Template[type:burst|distance:10]内爆炸，对区域内的每个生物（包括目标）造成[[/r 6d6]]火焰伤害。每个生物必须尝试一次@Check[type:reflex|dc:25|basic:true]豁免。

Activate A Interact

This piece of ammunition is coated in gritty black soot. When activated explosive ammunition hits a target, the missile explodes in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10], dealing [[/r 6d6]] fire damage to each creature in the area (including the target). Each creature must attempt a @Check[type:reflex|dc:25|basic:true] save.

Alchemist's Fire (Moderate).name: 炼金术士之火（中等） Alchemist's Fire (Moderate)
Alchemist's Fire (Moderate).description:
启动 A 打击

炼金术士之火是由挥发性液体组成的混合物，暴露在空气中会点燃。炼金术士之火造成 2d8 火焰伤害、2 点持续火焰伤害，以及 2 点火焰溅射伤害。你在攻击掷骰上获得 +1 物品加值。

Activate A Strike

Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals 2d8 fire damage, 2 persistent fire damage, and 2 fire splash damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

Red Dragon's Breath Potion (Young).name: 红龙吐息药水（幼年） Red Dragon's Breath Potion (Young)
Red Dragon's Breath Potion (Young).description:
这种液体含有红龙的血液。你饮用该混合物后的1小时内，你可以释放红龙的吐息。吐息的威力取决于药水的类型，基于用于制作药水的龙血所属红龙的年代。

呼出龙之吐息需要一个单动作。你制造一个 @Template[type:cone|distance:15] 的火焰，造成 [[/r 4d6[fire]]] 伤害。区域内的所有生物必须尝试进行一次 @Check[type:reflex|dc:23|basic:true|name:Young Red Dragon's Breath Potion] 豁免。

在你使用吐息后，你无法再次使用，直到 [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮} 后。

This liquid contains blood from a red dragon. For 1 hour after you imbibe the concoction, you can unleash a red dragon's breath weapon. The potency of the breath depends on the potion's type, based on the age of the dragon whose blood was used to make the potion.

Exhaling dragon breath uses a single action. You create a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] of fire which deals [[/r 4d6[fire]]] damage. All creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[type:reflex|dc:23|basic:true|name:Young Red Dragon's Breath Potion] save.

After you use the breath weapon, you can't do so again for [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Spellstrike Ammunition (Type III).name: 法术打击弹药（III型） Spellstrike Ammunition (Type III)
Spellstrike Ammunition (Type III).description:
神秘的纹样在这份弹药内创造出一个魔法蓄能库。你通过将法术施法灌注进弹药来启动法术打击弹药。该法术必须为弹药能够容纳的法术等级，且法术必须能够以施法者以外的生物为目标。被已启动的法术打击弹药命中的生物会成为该法术的目标。如果该生物不是该法术的有效目标，则法术会失去效果。

弹药只影响被命中的目标，即使该法术通常会影响多个目标也是如此。如果该法术需要进行法术攻击掷骰，则使用你用该弹药进行的远程攻击掷骰结果来决定该法术的成功程度。如果该法术需要进行豁免，则目标针对你的法术DC尝试该豁免。

弹药能够容纳的法术最高等级决定其物品等级与价格。

启动 D 施法

最大法术等级 3环

Mystic patterns create a magic reservoir within this ammunition. You activate spellstrike ammunition by Casting a Spell into the ammunition. The spell must be of a spell level the ammunition can hold, and the spell must be able to target a creature other than the caster. A creature hit by activated spellstrike ammunition is targeted by the spell. If the creature isn't a valid target for the spell, the spell is lost.

The ammunition affects only the target hit, even if the spell would normally affect more than one target. If the spell requires a spell attack roll, use the result of your ranged attack roll with the ammunition to determine the degree of success of the spell. If the spell requires a saving throw, the target attempts the save against your spell DC.

The maximum level of spell the ammunition can hold determines its item level and Price.

Activate D Cast a Spell

Maximum Spell Level 3rd

Bog-Rotted Froghemoth.name: 沼腐症沼喉怪 Bog-Rotted Froghemoth

Otherworldly Vision.name: 异界视觉 Otherworldly Vision
Otherworldly Vision.description:
沼喉怪的异界之眼使其能够察觉30尺内的生物，即使它们处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}或处于以太状态。它仍可能被成功的潜行检定所欺骗以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{躲藏}，但在此类情况下它的察觉DC为38。若带有视觉（特征）的幻觉位于30尺内，它也能看穿且不受其影响。

A froghemoth's alien eyes allow it to perceive creatures within 30 feet, even if they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} or ethereal. It can still be fooled by successful Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, but it has Perception DC 38 in such cases. It also sees through and is unaffected by illusions with the visual trait if they are within 30 feet.

Electric Torpor.name: 电流昏迷 Electric Torpor
Electric Torpor.description:
尽管沼喉怪免疫电击伤害，但每当它本应受到电击伤害时，它就会在 1 轮内处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 状态。

Though a froghemoth is immune to electricity damage, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round whenever it would have otherwise taken electricity damage.

Barbed Tongue.name: 倒钩之舌 Barbed Tongue
Barbed Tongue.description:
被沼喉怪的舌头击中的生物会被沼喉怪@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{抓住}。该生物不会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{定身}，但它不能移动到超出沼喉怪舌头触及的范围之外。一个生物可以通过一次成功的打击攻击AC 31并造成至少15点挥砍伤害来切断舌头。

这不会对沼喉怪造成任何伤害，但会使其无法使用舌头打击，直到它重新长出舌头为止，这需要1分钟。

A creature hit by the froghemoth's tongue becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the froghemoth. The creature isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move beyond the reach of the froghemoth's tongue. A creature can sever the tongue with a successful Strike against AC 31 that deals at least 15 slashing damage.

This deals no damage to the froghemoth but prevents it from using its tongue Strike until it regrows its tongue, which takes 1 minute.

Flailing Tentacles.name: 乱舞触手 Flailing Tentacles
Flailing Tentacles.description:
沼喉怪至多进行四次触手打击，每次对不同的目标。这些计入沼喉怪的多重攻击减值，但多重攻击减值在所有攻击完成后才会增加。

The froghemoth makes up to four tentacle Strikes, each against a different target. These count toward the froghemoth's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.

Retract Tongue.name: 收回舌头 Retract Tongue
Retract Tongue.description:
沼喉怪将被其舌头擒抱的生物拉向自己。沼喉怪掷骰一次 @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] 检定，对抗该生物的强韧DC。成功时，沼喉怪将该生物拉入一个相邻的空间；若其大成功，则在拉拽后还可以对该生物进行一次啮咬打击。

The froghemoth pulls a creature grabbed by its tongue toward itself. The froghemoth rolls an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the creature's Fortitude DC. On a success, the froghemoth pulls the creature into an adjacent space, and if it critically succeeds it can also make a bite Strike against the creature after the pull.

Swallow Whole.name: 活吞 Swallow Whole
Swallow Whole.description:
大型，@Damage[(3d6+9)[bludgeoning]] 伤害，破裂 24

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Large, @Damage[(3d6+9)[bludgeoning]] damage, Rupture 24

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Bog-Rotted Froghemoth.publicNotes:
沼喉怪是一种由牙齿、触手与无拘无束的狂怒构成的可怖畸形怪物；所幸，即便在最深的沼泽地或最偏远的幽暗地域洞窟中，也很少会遇到它。它能够吞食恐龙，甚至连巨龙也不在话下；作为一名令人胆寒而高效的伏击猎手，它会把自己浸没在淤泥中，只让眼柄露出水面，并以诡异的精准度同时朝各个方向观察。

A terrifying abomination of teeth, tentacles, and unbridled rage, the froghemoth is thankfully rarely encountered even in the deepest swamplands or most remote Darklands caverns. Capable of devouring dinosaurs and even dragons, it is a frighteningly effective ambush hunter, immersing itself in the mire with only its eyestalk protruding and watching in every direction at once with uncanny precision.

Brood Leech Swarm.name: 育雏蛭虫群 Brood Leech Swarm
Brood Leech Swarm.tokenName: 育种水蛭虫群 Brood Leech Swarm

Tremorsense 30 feet.name: 震颤感知 30 尺 Tremorsense 30 feet

Blood Draining Bites.name: 吸血噬咬 Blood Draining Bites
Blood Draining Bites.description:
虫群空间内的每个敌人承受 @Damage[2d6[bleed]]，并暴露于育群水蛭虫群毒液。

Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[2d6[bleed]] and is exposed to brood leech swarm venom.

Brood Leech Swarm Venom.name: 育雏水蛭群毒液 Brood Leech Swarm Venom
Brood Leech Swarm Venom.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}，以及速度受到-5英尺状态减值（1 轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}，以及速度受到-10英尺状态减值（1 轮）。

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and -5-foot status penalty to Speed (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and -10-foot status penalty to Speed (1 round).

Brood Leech Swarm.publicNotes:
大多数较小种类的水蛭通常不会成群结队，但育雏水蛭很容易聚集成翻涌起伏的垫状群体，充斥着蠕动的贪食。当它们聚集到足以形成虫群的数量时，它们会摒弃孤身水蛭进食方式的潜行，转而以迅捷而无情的方式进食。在这种情况下，它们的温和毒液能够影响比其平常猎物大得多的生物。

Most smaller species of leeches do not tend to swarm, but brood leeches are prone to gathering in seething, undulant mats of squirming gluttony. When they gather in sufficient numbers to swarm, they eschew the stealth of a lone leech's feeding methods in favor of swift and merciless feeding. In these situations, their mild venom can affect much larger creatures than their usual prey.
Brood Leech Swarm.prototypeToken: 育巢水蛭群 Brood Leech Swarm

Caligni Stalker.name: 卡利格尼潜行者 Caligni Stalker
Caligni Stalker.tokenName: 卡林吉潜行者 Caligni Stalker

Occult Innate Spells.name: 神秘先天法术 Occult Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光线在区域内穿透或发散。光线无法进入该区域，任何非魔法的光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内也不会发散任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外亦然。此效果也会压制你黑暗术的环阶或更低的魔法光亮。光线无法穿过，因此处于该区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它如同一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

See the Unseen (At Will).name: 看见隐形（意志） See the Unseen (At Will)
See the Unseen (At Will).description:
你的目光穿透幻觉并发现@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物与灵体。你可以看见隐形生物，如同它们并未隐形一般，不过它们的特征会显得模糊，使其处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态且难以辨认。你也能看见无实体的生物，比如幽灵（特征），它们能从距某个物体表面10尺以内的地方穿过物体，呈现为透过这些物体所见的模糊形状。更细微的线索也使你在进行识破幻觉的检定时获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 此法术的持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：看见不可见之物}

Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

Figment.name: 幻影 Figment
Figment.description:
你创造一个简单的幻觉声音或影像。声音会为该法术添加听觉（特征），且该声音不能包含可理解的词语或复杂的音乐。影像会添加视觉（特征），其大小不能超过一个 5 尺立方体，并且若在 15 尺内观看，会明显粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你可以用该幻觉尝试 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{制造佯动}，使你的欺瞒检定获得+2环境加值。若该尝试对某个生物失败，该生物会识破该幻景。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：幻景}

You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

Leather Armor.name: 皮甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
由柔韧与定型的煮制皮革混合制成，这种护甲在提供一定防护的同时，仍能保持最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Darkening Poison.name: 暗化毒素 Darkening Poison
Darkening Poison.description:
许多卡利格尼斯会随身携带数剂暗化毒素，这是一种由幽暗地域蜘蛛毒液制成的非普通伤害毒素，用来使敌人失去行动能力。

豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]]（1 轮）

阶段 2 1d6 毒素伤害，且你只能通过黑暗视觉看见的生物对你处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}（1 轮）

阶段 3 1d6 毒素伤害，且你只能通过黑暗视觉看见的生物对你处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐匿}（1 轮）。

Many calignis keep several doses of darkening poison, an uncommon injury poison made from Darklands spider venom, on hand to incapacitate foes.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 poison and creatures you can see only with darkvision are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from you (1 round)

Stage 3 1d6 poison and creatures you can see only with darkvision are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from you (1 round).

Greater Darkvision.name: 强化黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Final Fate.name: 最终命运 Final Fate
Final Fate.description:
当猎手死亡时，其灵魂会在一阵灵性能量的爆炸中离开其身体。所有位于一个@Template[burst|distance:20]内的生物受到@Damage[5d6[spirit]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:19|basic]意志豁免）。

猎手的物品会留在其死亡处堆成一堆。

When the hunter dies, their soul leaves their body in an explosion of spiritual energy. All creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:20] take @Damage[5d6[spirit]] damage (@Check[will|dc:19|basic] save).

The hunter's possessions are left in a pile where they died.

Double Slice.name: 双重斩击 Double Slice
Double Slice.description:
黑影猎手对同一目标进行两次打击，各用一把短剑。猎手将任何命中的攻击的伤害合并，并且精准伤害、抗力与弱点只结算一次。两次攻击都计入猎手的多重攻击减值，但减值只在两次攻击都完成后才会增加。

The caligni hunter makes two Strikes against the same target, one with each of their shortswords. The hunter combines the damage of any attacks that hit and applies precision damage, resistances, and weaknesses only once. Both attacks count toward the hunter's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty increases only after both attacks.

Encircling Command.name: 环绕命令术 Encircling Command
Encircling Command.description:
潜伏者 @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30尺} 内的每个卡利格尼潜伏者都可以踏步。每个爬行者每轮只能从包围命令术中获益一次。

Each caligni skulker within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} of the skulker can Step. Each creeper can benefit from Encircling Command only once per round.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
卡利尼猎手对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物造成额外1d6点精准伤害。

The caligni hunter deals 1d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Caligni Stalker.publicNotes:
尽管卡琳吉猎人常常被迫领导他们的潜行者同族，大多数猎人仍更喜欢在幽暗地域游荡或袭击地表，以摆脱这些责任。他们偏好的突袭通常由单独行动的卡琳吉猎人执行，或由两到三人组成的小队进行。

卡琳吉潜伏在地下的城市中，每个卡琳吉都会成长为一个由卡琳吉社会中的超自然影响所决定的特定职责与形态。无论其体型或职责如何，所有卡琳吉都骨瘦如柴，皮肤苍白，眼睛雪白。许多人乐于在夜间潜行到地表，窃取资源，幽影他们的地表同类，或仅仅是恶作剧。

Although caligni hunters are often pressed into leading their skulker kin, most hunters prefer to wander the Darklands or raid the surface free from those responsibilities. Their preferred assaults are usually done by solo caligni hunters or in small groups of two or three.

Calignis lurk in subterranean cities, with each caligni growing into a specific role and form determined by supernatural influences in caligni society. Regardless of their size or role, all calignis are gaunt, with pale flesh and white eyes. Many relish the chance to creep above ground at night to steal resources, shadow their surface counterparts, or simply make mischief.
Caligni Stalker.prototypeToken: 卡利格尼潜行者 Caligni Stalker

Chuul.publicNotes:
这些大型、覆有护甲板的甲壳类掠食者也被称为chu'ulothis，它们潜伏在水潭、沼泽泥淖与池塘的水面下，等待用巨大的螯钳攫住猎物，再用触手将其麻痹。到那时，它们便开始进食，把猎物活生生吃掉。

甲伏怪既能生活在淡水也能生活在海水中，确实遍布世界各地的水栖环境——甚至包括幽暗地域的地下海洋与湖泊。尽管甲伏怪很擅长游泳，它们却更偏爱陆地猎物。它们偏好的狩猎方式是从水中猛然扑出，用涂满毒素的触手麻痹受害者，然后兴高采烈地把抽搐的食物拖回水里，若不能直接把这些小点心活吃掉，就将其淹死。栖居地表的甲伏怪更喜欢以蜥蜴人为食，而在幽暗地域地下湖泊中游弋的那些则几乎什么都吃，唯独不吃地蜥人（特征）——它们觉得那种味道与臭气令人反胃。

甲伏怪能够说话也具备理性，但这些生物很少与其物种之外的对象交谈，除非是为了嘲弄自己的食物。在开始吞食猎物之前，一只甲伏怪常会用一种咕噜作响、几乎难以理解的方言，讲述它将如何享受啃食这生物的血肉。也许甲伏怪相信侮辱与贬低会让食物更嫩、更美味，但真相很可能永远不会被知晓；几乎所有甲伏怪都固执地拒绝任何有意义的对话，即使被囚禁，并在奖赏或痛苦的逼迫下亦然。

除了它们狂乱的交配季节之外，是否存在甲伏怪社会尚不得而知。甲伏怪的智力似乎只用于进食、对有感知的生物造成心理痛苦、用最喜欢的餐食与胜利的纪念品装饰巢穴，以及繁殖。

Also known as chu'ulothis, these large, armor-plated, crustacean predators lurk beneath the surface of pools, mires, and ponds, waiting to snatch up prey with their massive claws before paralyzing them with their tentacles. At that point, they begin to feed, eating their quarry alive.

Chuuls can live in fresh or saltwater, and indeed are found in aquatic environs the world over-even in the subterranean oceans and lakes of the Darklands. While chuuls are good swimmers, they prefer terrestrial prey. Their preferred method of hunting is by lunging out of the water, paralyzing their victims with their poison-coated tentacles, then gleefully dragging their twitching food into the water to drown if they cannot simply eat such morsels alive. Chuuls that dwell aboveground prefer to dine on lizardfolk, while those swimming the subterranean lakes of the Darklands readily eat anything but xulgaths, whose flavor and stink they find off-putting.

Chuuls are capable of speech and reason, but these creatures rarely speak with those outside their species except to taunt their food. Before it begins consuming its prey, a chuul often speaks in a gurgling, nearly incomprehensible dialect about how it will enjoy feasting on the creature's flesh. Perhaps chuuls believe that insults and degradation lead to more tender and tastier food, but the truth will likely never be known; almost all chuuls stubbornly refuse any meaningful conversation, even when imprisoned and compelled by treats or pain.

It is unknown if a chuul society exists beyond their frenzied mating season. Chuuls' intellects seem devoted only toward eating, causing psychological pain to sentient creatures, decorating their lairs with mementos of their favorite meals and victories, and breeding.

Obscuring Spores.name: 遮蔽孢子 Obscuring Spores
Obscuring Spores.description:
每当盗袭瘤菌受到至少10点挥砍伤害时，它会释放一团褐色孢子云，其效果如同@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}，持续1分钟，以盗袭瘤菌为中心。这团孢子云不会随盗袭瘤菌移动，也不会因其移动而被移位。

Whenever the drakauthix takes at least 10 slashing damage, it releases a cloud of brown spores that has the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist} for 1 minute, centered around the drakauthix. This cloud of spores does not move with the drakauthix, nor is it displaced by its movement.

Reel In.name: 卷回 Reel In
Reel In.description:
盗袭瘤菌将其所有已@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{抓住}的生物拉向自身，距离缩短15尺。

The drakauthix pulls all creatures it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 15 feet closer to itself.

Spore Tendrils.name: 孢子卷须 Spore Tendrils
Spore Tendrils.description:
覆盖盗袭瘤菌身体的触须向外伸出并侵染相邻生物，造成 @Damage[4d6[poison]] 伤害以及 @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] 伤害。生物可以尝试一次 @Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] 豁免以减少此伤害，但被盗袭瘤菌以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{被擒抱} 的生物在此豁免上承受 -4 环境减值。

The tendrils that cover the drakauthix's body reach out and infest adjacent creatures, dealing @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] damage. A creature can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] save to reduce this damage, but one @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the drakauthix takes a -4 circumstance penalty to this save.

Whirlwind of Hooks.name: 钩镰旋风 Whirlwind of Hooks
Whirlwind of Hooks.description:
盗袭瘤菌旋动，鞭甩其周围的生物。盗袭瘤菌对其触及范围内的每个生物各进行一次触手打击。

The drakauthix whirls, whipping creatures around it. The drakauthix makes a tentacle Strike against every creature within its reach.

Drakauthix.publicNotes:
盗袭瘤菌是一种巨大的真菌，漂浮在幽暗地域最大洞窟的高处，由会喷射空气与孢子的囊泡推动前进。作为一种贪婪却行动迟缓的猎手，盗袭瘤菌偏好从上方伏击多肉的生物，用其带钩的附肢将受害者向上拖拽以便进食。盗袭瘤菌的消化过程完全发生在体外——它会紧贴在受害者身上，而其布满孢子的表面会缓慢地啃食并在血肉中生长，随后将被孢子侵染的残骸丢弃。当这具被侵染的尸体撞击到下方地面时，它会爆裂并释放一团孢子云，放出一群被称为孢子幼体的幼体，它们会立刻沿洞壁疾爬上去，附着在洞顶并继续生长。

盗袭瘤菌的行为并不比多数食肉动物更聪明，它常常利用一种共生式的食腐手段来确保猎物：借助它常出没的大型洞穴系统中泥怪与害兽的狩猎方式来坐享其成。当某种相对无脑的生物杀死了一个受害者时，盗袭瘤菌便会漂落下来，用触须钩住刚被杀死的尸体，并将自己的餐食卷回去。那只刚被偷走食物的无脑泥怪或其他生物很少会记恨，只会滑走去寻找新的猎物，让盗袭瘤菌安静地消化尸体。当然，盗袭瘤菌也不排斥享用更活跃的猎物；在探索神秘洞穴网络时，若某名冒险者疏于抬头留意上方的危险，它也可能发动攻击。

一些栖居幽暗地域的生物，例如灰矮人，会猎杀盗袭瘤菌以获取其肉，因为其肉质风味独特，带有胡椒般的回味。地下种族也会用盗袭瘤菌制作墨水：先焚烧其尸体，再将灰烬长时间研磨并压制，直到一种银色物质凝结。

The drakauthix is a massive fungus that floats through the heights of the largest Darklands caverns, propelled by bladders that spray air and spores. A voracious but slow-moving hunter, the drakauthix prefers to ambush meaty creatures from above, using its hooked appendages to pull its victims upward to feed. The drakauthix's digestive process is entirely external-it clings to victims, and its spore-laden surface slowly feeds on and grows through the flesh before the spore-infested carcass is discarded. As the infested body strikes the ground below, it bursts and releases a cloud of spores, unleashing a host of young called sporelings that immediately scuttle up the cavern walls to cling to its ceiling and grow.

The drakauthix behaves no more intelligently than most predatory animals, and often uses a sort of symbiotic scavenger method to secure prey by capitalizing on the hunting methods of oozes and vermin found in the large cave systems it frequents. When a relatively mindless creature kills a victim, the drakauthix drifts down, hooks the freshly slain carcass with its tendrils, and reels in its meal. The mindless ooze or other creature that just had its food stolen rarely holds a grudge and simply slithers off to find a new quarry, letting the drakauthix digest the corpse in peace. Of course, the drakauthix isn't above feasting on more active prey as well, and might attack an adventurer who neglects to look upward for danger when exploring a network of mysterious caves.

Some Darklands-dwelling creatures, such as duergars, hunt drakauthixes for their flesh, which has a unique flavor with a peppery aftertaste. Subterranean races also make ink from drakauthixes by burning their carcasses, then grinding and pressing the ashes for a long time until a silvery substance congeals.

Draining Presence.name: 枯竭威仪 Draining Presence
Draining Presence.description:
10英尺。进入该灵光的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:26] 豁免，否则将成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失（状态） 1}。在其离开该灵光1分钟后恢复。此流失（状态）值会与吸取生命导致的流失值累加，但不会与多个吸取存在灵光累加。

成功通过其豁免的生物会对吸取存在获得24小时的暂时免疫。

10 feet. A creature entering the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. It recovers after it has been out of the aura for 1 minute. This drained condition value is cumulative with the drained value caused by drain life, but not with multiple draining presence auras.

A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to draining presence for 24 hours.

Sunlight Powerlessness.name: 阳光虚弱 Sunlight Powerlessness
Sunlight Powerlessness.description:
一只惧栗缚灵在阳光下被照到时会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}。

A dread wraith caught in sunlight is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}.

Absorb Wraith.name: 吸收缚灵 Absorb Wraith
Absorb Wraith.description:
惧栗缚灵将手伸向100尺内的另一名缚灵生物。该目标缚灵溶解并沿直线疾驰向惧栗缚灵，对该直线上的每个生物造成 @Damage[6d10[void]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] 豁免）。

惧栗缚灵吸收目标缚灵的精华，变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}，并在等同于被吸收缚灵等级数量的轮内，其飞行速度获得+10尺状态加值。它只能使用其额外动作来飞行或打击。

不愿意的目标可以尝试进行一次 @Check[will|dc:28] 意志豁免，以抗拒被吸收。

The dread wraith extends its hand toward another wraith creature within 100 feet. The target wraith dissolves and streaks toward the dread wraith in a straight line, dealing @Damage[6d10[void]] damage to each creature along the line (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save).

The dread wraith absorbs the essence of the target wraith, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and gaining a +10-foot status bonus to its fly Speed for a number of rounds equal to the level of the absorbed wraith. It can use its extra action only to Fly or Strike.

An unwilling target can attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save to resist being absorbed.

Drain Life.name: 汲取生命 Drain Life
Drain Life.description:
当惧栗缚灵以其幽灵之手打击对活体生物造成伤害时，缚灵获得[[/r 10 #Temporary Hit Points]]{10 临时生命值}，且目标必须成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:28]豁免，否则将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 1（状态）}。缚灵造成的后续伤害会在豁免失败时使流失（状态）值增加1，最大至流失 4（状态）。

When the dread wraith damages a living creature with its spectral hand Strike, the wraith gains [[/r 10 #Temporary Hit Points]]{10 temporary Hit Points} and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Further damage dealt by the wraith increases the drained condition value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

Wraith Spawn.name: 缚灵爪牙 Wraith Spawn
Wraith Spawn.description:
被缚灵的幽魂之手打击杀死的活体类人生物，会在[[/gmr 1d4 #Wraith Spawn Transformation]]{1d4轮}后升起为一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.Gu0cJHGwPd547OtC]{缚灵衍体}。该缚灵衍体受杀死它的惧栗缚灵的命令术控制。它不具有汲取生命或缚灵衍体。如果该缚灵衍体的创造者死亡，缚灵衍体会变为一个完整的、自治的缚灵；它恢复其自由意志，并获得汲取生命与缚灵衍体。

A living humanoid slain by a wraith's spectral hand Strike rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.Gu0cJHGwPd547OtC]{Wraith Spawn} after [[/gmr 1d4 #Wraith Spawn Transformation]]{1d4 rounds}. This wraith spawn is under the command of the dread wraith that killed it. It doesn't have drain life or wraith spawn. If the creator of the wraith spawn dies, the wraith spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous wraith; it regains its free will and gains drain life and wraith spawn.

Dread Wraith.publicNotes:
这些邪恶军阀或嗜血将军所残留的威胁性灵体遗迹，是高耸的幽魂，由幽影与死亡凝成。与其他缚灵一样，惧栗缚灵盘踞在世界的阴暗之处，但惧栗缚灵更可能为了散播恐怖或积累影响力而旅行更远的距离，穿越洒满阳光的土地时也常贴着阴暗的林间空地或不祥的废墟前行。惧栗缚灵往往傲慢，很少与同类结成群体，反而更偏好以支配术统御一群普通的缚灵。然而，特别强大的死灵法师或许能迫使成群的惧栗缚灵为其效命；而某个格外恶毒的目标——例如根除一处光与生命的堡垒——也可能使数个惧栗缚灵为共同目的而聚集。

These menacing spiritual remnants of wicked warlords or bloodthirsty generals are towering specters of shadow and death. Like other wraiths, dread wraiths haunt the shadowy places of the world, but dread wraiths are more likely to travel greater distances to sow terror or amass influence, often sticking to dark glades or sinister ruins when journeying across sun-dappled lands. Dread wraiths tends to be arrogant and rarely form a pack with others of their kind, preferring instead to dominate groups of ordinary wraiths. A particularly powerful necromancer might compel packs of dread wraiths into service, however, while a particularly malevolent goal-such as to eradicate a bastion of light and life-might draw several dread wraiths together in a common purpose.
Dread Wraith.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. vitality

Drow Hunter.name: 卓尔猎手 Drow Hunter

Divine Innate Spells.name: 天生神圣法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光线穿透或在区域内发散。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源，如火把或提灯，在区域内时都不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外。这同样会压制你施放的黑暗术法术位阶或更低的魔法光亮。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

增幅（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将通过黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
当你施放该法术时，区域内的所有生物在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的绚丽、无热火焰勾勒。可见的生物在受妖火术影响时不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。如果这些生物是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的，它们在受妖火术影响时会处于隐蔽状态，而不是处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉}状态。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮(术)，彼此之间任意两者相距不超过10尺。每个都像火把一样照明。当你维持法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮(术)移动至多60尺。每个光亮(术)必须保持在你120尺范围内，并且与所有其他光亮(术)保持在10尺以内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
有时也被称为锁子甲长衫，这是一件由与链甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。不过，它比链甲轻得多，并且只保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭的箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中由一端的羽翎保持稳定，另一端装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免检定获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗精神效果的所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Deft Evasion.name: 灵巧反射 Deft Evasion
Deft Evasion.description:
当猎人在反射豁免上掷骰获得成功时，他们改为获得大成功。

When the hunter rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead.

Hunter's Wound.name: 猎手之伤 Hunter's Wound
Hunter's Wound.description:
频率 每轮一次

先决条件 猎手正持用一把装填为0的远程武器

效果 猎手对其猎物进行两次远程打击。若两次都命中并造成伤害，则目标额外承受 @Damage[1d8[bleed]]。

Frequency once per round

Prerequisites The hunter is wielding a ranged weapon with a reload of 0

Effect The hunter makes two ranged Strikes against their prey. If both hit and deal damage, the target takes an additional @Damage[1d8[bleed]].

Skirmish Strike.name: 快速战斗 Skirmish Strike
Skirmish Strike.description:
猎人可以先迈步再打击，或先打击再迈步。

The hunter can Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.

Drow Hunter.publicNotes:
猎人会搜寻猎物，以维持卓尔社群的供给与运作。

卓尔因其主要聚居地对恶魔的崇拜而背负邪恶的名声。然而，和任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔也可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主的阴险影响时。

Hunters seek out game to keep drow communities fed and functioning.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Drow Hunter.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Drow Warden.name: 卓尔卫士 Drow Warden

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一团黑暗帷幕，阻止光线在区域内穿透或发散。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内时都不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外亦然。这也会压制你黑暗术法术位阶或更低的魔法光亮。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外界。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时处于区域内的所有生物，会在持续时间内被你选择颜色的绚丽、无热火焰勾勒轮廓。受妖火术影响时，可见生物不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。若这些生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形} 状态，则它们在受妖火术影响时处于 Concealed 状态，而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} 状态。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光球，任意两个之间相距不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样散发光亮(术)。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光球移动至多60英尺。每个光球必须保持在你120英尺以内，并且与所有其他光球保持在10英尺以内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Elven Curve Blade.name: 精灵曲刃剑 Elven Curve Blade

Chain Mail.name: 铁链甲 Chain Mail
Chain Mail.description:
一套锁子甲由数件护甲构成，这些护甲由相互连接的小金属环组成，形成防护网。它通常包括一件链甲衫、护腿、一对护臂和一顶头罩，共同保护身体的大部分。

A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Lethargy Poison.name: 昏睡毒 Lethargy Poison
Lethargy Poison.description:
昏睡毒常被卓尔和其他希望让受害者活着的人用于打了就跑的战术；伏击者会撤退，直到毒素生效、受害者陷入昏迷。进一步接触昏睡毒不会要求目标进行额外的豁免投掷；只有在对持续暴露的豁免投掷中失败，才会推进其阶段。

启动 2 交互（伤害）

豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

最大持续时间 4小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}（1轮）

阶段 2 迟缓 1（1分钟）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷}，且无法通过察觉检定苏醒（1轮）

阶段 4 昏迷，且无法通过察觉检定苏醒（[[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4小时}）。

Lethargy poison is commonly used in hit-and-run tactics by drow and others who want their victims alive; the ambusher retreats until the poison sets in and the victim falls unconscious. Further exposure to lethargy poison does not require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing an saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Activate 2 Interact (Injury)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 slowed 1 (1 minute)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours}).

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗精神的所有豁免检定获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Hampering Slash.name: 妨碍劈砍 Hampering Slash
Hampering Slash.description:
被守卫者的近战打击伤害的一个目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:21] 豁免，否则将获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}，直到守卫者下一回合结束。

A target damaged by the warden's melee Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of the warden's next turn.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
守卫对处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 状态的生物造成额外 1d6 伤害。

A warden deals an extra 1d6 damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Drow Warden.publicNotes:
卫士守望着卓尔营地，并且经常以小队形式行动。

由于在他们的主要聚居地中崇拜恶魔，卓尔以邪恶闻名。然而，和任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主的阴险影响时。

Wardens watch over drow encampments and often work in small groups.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Drow Warden.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Dulac.name: 杜拉克 Dulac

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能天生法术 Occult Innate Spells

Read Omens.name: 阅读机运 Read Omens
Read Omens.description:
你窥视未来。选择一个你计划在 1 周内进行的特定目标或行动，或一个你预计可能在 1 周内发生的事件。你会得知一条隐晦的线索或建议，可能有助于所选事件，通常以押韵句或征兆的形式呈现。

You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
你甜如蜜的言辞让生物难以抗拒。你对目标提出一个行动方针的暗示术，其措辞必须让目标觉得这是合乎逻辑的行动方针，且不能是自我毁灭或明显违背目标自身利益的内容。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是正常在和它说话，而不是对它施放法术。

失败 目标立刻遵从你的暗示术。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标完成一个有限的暗示术内容，或该暗示术内容变得自我毁灭，或产生其他明显的负面效果为止。

大成功或大失败失败 同失败，但基础持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你可以以最多10个生物为目标。

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Haste.name: 加速术 Haste
Haste.description:
魔法赋予目标更快行动的力量。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷（状态）}状态，并且每轮只能将额外动作用于打击和迈步动作。

升阶（7环） 你最多可以以6个生物为目标。

Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你在目标的运动冲动离开其心智之前将其阻断，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}，持续 1 轮。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标获得 麻痹，持续 4 轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，使剩余持续时间减少 1 轮，或在大成功或大失败 成功时将其完全结束。

升阶（7环） 你最多可以以 10 个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Vampiric Touch.name: 吸血鬼之触 Vampiric Touch
Vampiric Touch.description:
你的接触从一个目标身上汲取生命血液以强化自身。你对该目标造成 6d6 虚空伤害。你获得等同于该目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果之后）。1 分钟后，你失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Darkness.name: 黑暗 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光线穿透或在区域内发出。光线不会进入该区域，任何非魔法的光源，如火把或提灯，在区域内也不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也一样。这也会压制你黑暗术法术环级或更低的魔法光亮。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它表现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光线穿透或在区域内发出。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内时都不会发出任何光亮，即使它们的光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外亦是如此。这也会压制你黑暗术法术环位或更低环位的魔法光亮。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Ghoulish Cravings.name: 食腐渴望 Ghoulish Cravings
Ghoulish Cravings.description:
你接触目标，使其染上食尸鬼热，让饥饿侵蚀其身，并使其与生命能量的连接逐渐减弱；目标必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在第1阶段染上食尸鬼热。

失败 目标在第2阶段染上食尸鬼热。

大失败 目标在第3阶段染上食尸鬼热。

食尸鬼热（疾病）；等级 3

阶段 1 携带者，无不良效果（1天）

阶段 2 3d8 虚空伤害，且该生物从所有治疗中恢复的生命值减半（1天）

阶段 3 如阶段2（1天）

阶段 4 3d8 虚空伤害，且该生物无法从治疗中获得任何益处（1天）

阶段 5 如阶段4（1天）

阶段 6 该生物死亡，并在下一个午夜作为食尸鬼（特征）复起

You touch the target to afflict it with ghoul fever, infesting it with hunger and a steadily decreasing connection to vitality energy; the target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 1.

Failure The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 2.

Critical Failure The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 3.

Ghoul Fever (disease); Level 3

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effects (1 day)

Stage 2 3d8 void damage and the creature regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 3d8 void damage and the creature gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 the creature dies and rises as a ghoul at the next midnight

Obscuring Mist (At Will).name: 隐雾术（随意） Obscuring Mist (At Will)
Obscuring Mist (At Will).description:
你召唤出一团薄雾。所有处于薄雾中的生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，且所有处于薄雾外的生物对薄雾内的生物而言变为隐蔽。你可以解消这团云雾。

You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智变得混乱，并用一次精神冲击让其陷入眩晕术。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，则它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

增幅（+2） 伤害增加1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，以登记周遭是否存在魔法。你得到的信息仅限于魔法的存在或不存在。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。

你只有在该魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到幻术系魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果强度相同，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知精确位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体范围内（若来源大于该范围，则为最接近的范围）。
