You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法力场护盾术。这视为使用【举盾】动作，使你在AC上获得+1环境加值，持续至你下个回合开始，但不需要空出一只手来使用。

在法术生效期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡}反应动作（）。该护盾具有硬度5。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。与普通的盾牌格挡不同，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）来对抗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{力场弹幕}法术。

法术升阶会提高该护盾的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（3环） 该护盾具有硬度10。

升阶（5环） 该护盾具有硬度15。

升阶（7环） 该护盾具有硬度20。

升阶（9环） 该护盾具有硬度25。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个松散的、无人持用的物体投掷向目标，该物体必须在射程内且负载为1或更低。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——由你投掷的物体决定——其数值等于1d6加上你的施法能力调整值。被投掷的物品不具有任何会影响该攻击或伤害的特定特征或魔法属性。

大成功或大失败 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

强化 (+1) 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
这种护甲有时被称为锁子长衫，是一件由与锁子甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。不过，它比锁子甲轻得多，并且只保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Greater Darkvision.name: 高等黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

At-Will Spells.name: 随意法术 At-Will Spells
At-Will Spells.description:
Dulac可以施放她的随意法术任意次数，而无需消耗法术位。

Dulac can cast her at-will spells any number of times without using up spell slots.

Death Shadows.name: 死亡幽影 Death Shadows
Death Shadows.description:
当杜拉克死亡时，她的躯体在一阵刺骨的幽影爆发中被摧毁。所有位于@Template[burst|distance:20]内的生物受到@Damage[8d8[cold]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]豁免）。

杜拉克的道具和宝藏不受幽影影响，并会留在她死亡之处堆成一堆。

When Dulac dies, her body is destroyed in a burst of chilling shadows. All creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:20] take @Damage[8d8[cold]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save).

Dulac's gear and treasure are unaffected by the shadows and are left in a pile where she died.

Opportune Step.name: 适时快步 Opportune Step
Opportune Step.description:
触发 一名处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 状态的生物，或一名具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{强光致盲} 的生物，在杜拉克相邻处结束其移动

效果 杜拉克快步。

Trigger A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} creature, or a creature with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{Light Blindness}, ends its move adjacent to Dulac

Effect Dulac Steps.

Warding Shove.name: 防护推撞 Warding Shove
Warding Shove.description:
触发 杜拉克触及内的一名盟友成为一名她能看见的攻击者进行远程或近战攻击的目标

效果 该盟友对触发的攻击的AC获得+2环境加值，且该盟友可以在该攻击后移动一步（Step）。

Trigger An ally within Dulac's reach is targeted with a ranged or melee attack by an attacker she can see

Effect The ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack, and the ally can Step after the attack.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
Dulac 对 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 的生物造成额外 1d6 精确伤害。

Dulac deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Dulac.blurb:
女性卡利格尼邪教首领
Female caligni cult leader

Elder Child of Belcorra.name: 贝科拉的年长子嗣 Elder Child of Belcorra
Elder Child of Belcorra.tokenName: 贝科拉的长子 Elder Child of Belcorra

Primal Prepared Spells.name: 原初预备法术 Primal Prepared Spells

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原初天生法术 Primal Innate Spells

Air Walk.name: 空行术 Air Walk
Air Walk.description:
目标可以在空气中行走，仿佛空气是坚实的地面。它可以用这种方式以最大45度角上升和下降。

The target can walk on air as if it were solid ground. It can ascend and descend in this way at a maximum of a 45-degree angle.

Freedom of Movement.name: 行动自如 Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
你排斥那些会妨碍生物或减缓其移动的效果。在此法术的效果下，目标无视那些会给予其速度环境减值的效果。当其尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}使其处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{定身}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}的效果时，其自动成功，除非该效果是魔法且阶位高于行动自如法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{法术效果：行动自如}

You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the freedom of movement spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Freedom of Movement}

Plant Growth.name: 植物生长 Plant Growth
Plant Growth.description:
你使区域内的植物变得更加健康且更有产出。除了健康植物的其他益处之外，根据你的成功程度，这会提高农场的作物产量。如果你在 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{枯萎病害} 的区域内施放该法术，植物生长会尝试反制该枯萎病害，而不是产生其通常的效果。

大成功或大失败 成功 使区域内的作物产量翻倍，或将区域扩大至1英里半径。

成功 使区域内的作物产量提高三分之一。

失败 该仪式没有效果。

大成功或大失败 失败 区域内的植物群以一种未预料的方式改变，由GM决定，但通常尽可能与你真正的愿望相反（例如，当你希望增产作物时却使其枯萎）。

You cause the plants within the area to be healthier and more fruitful. In addition to other benefits of healthy plants, this increases the crop yield for farms, depending on your success. If you cast it in the area of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight}, plant growth attempts to counteract the blight instead of producing its usual effect.

Critical Success Double the crop yield in the area, or increase the area to a 1-mile radius.

Success Increase the crop yield in the area by one-third.

Failure The ritual has no effect.

Critical Failure The flora in the area changes in an unanticipated way, determined by the GM but generally as contradictory to your true desires as possible (for instance, blighting crops when you would prefer to enrich them).

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标目盲。该效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。然后目标在1分钟内暂时免疫。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 直到其下一回合开始。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大失败 目标永久目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Glyph of Warding.name: 守卫刻文 Glyph of Warding
Glyph of Warding.description:
你通过将一个敌对法术束缚进一个符号来制作一个陷阱。在施放此法术时，你还要施法一个更低法术环阶的法术以储存在该刻文中。被储存的法术必须以3个动作或更少施放，具有敌对效果，并以一个生物为目标或具有一个区域。你可以为刻文设定一个口令、一个触发，或两者皆有。任何生物只要移动、打开或触碰目标容器，或进入目标区域，且没有说出口令或符合触发条件，就会启动刻文，释放其中的有害法术。

一旦一个法术被储存在刻文中，该刻文获得该法术的所有特征。若被储存的法术以一个或多个生物为目标，则其目标为触发刻文的生物。若其具有区域，则该区域以触发刻文的生物为中心。守卫刻文的持续时间在刻文被触发时结束。该刻文视为一个魔法陷阱，使用你的法术DC来进行察觉检定以注意到它，以及使用巧手检定以解除它；两项检定都要求尝试者受训方可成功。

你可以解消守卫刻文。你在同一时间可维持生效的守卫刻文最大数量等于你的施法关键能力调整值。

You craft a trap by binding a hostile spell into a symbol. While Casting this Spell, you also Cast a Spell of a lower spell rank to store in the glyph. The stored spell must take 3 actions or fewer to cast, have a hostile effect, and target one creature or have an area. You can set a password, a trigger, or both for the glyph. Any creature that moves, opens, or touches the target container or enters the target area that doesn't speak the password or that matches the trigger activates the glyph, releasing the harmful spell within.

Once a spell is stored in the glyph, the glyph gains all the traits of that spell. If the stored spell targets one or more creatures, it targets the creature that set off the glyph. If it has an area, that area is centered on the creature that set off the glyph. Glyph of warding's duration ends when the glyph is triggered. The glyph counts as a magical trap, using your spell DC for both the Perception check to notice it and the Thievery check to disable it; both checks require the creature attempting them to be trained in order to succeed.

You can Dismiss glyph of warding. The maximum number of glyphs of warding you can have active at a time is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

Meld into Stone.name: 融入石中 Meld into Stone
Meld into Stone.description:
你与一块相邻的石块融合，这块石头必须有足够的体积容纳你以及你穿戴和持有的物品。你在施放法术时必须接触石头。你可以听见，但不能看见石头外发生的事情；并且当你在石头内时，你可以施放法术，只要这些法术不需要穿出石头之外的效果线。

当你在石头内时，若石头受到显著的物理伤害，会将你排出，并对你造成10d6伤害。穿墙术会将你排出而不造成伤害，并结束与石为一。你可以解消此法术。

You merge with an adjacent block of stone with enough volume to fit you and your worn and held possessions. You must touch the stone when you Cast the Spell. You can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the stone, and you can cast spells while in the stone as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the stone.

Significant physical damage to the stone while you are inside it expels you and deals 10d6 damage to you. Passwall expels you without dealing damage and ends one with stone. You can Dismiss this spell.

Acid Arrow.name: 酸液箭 Acid Arrow
Acid Arrow.description:
你召唤一支酸液箭矢，在命中后持续腐蚀目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击。命中时，你造成3d8酸液伤害，外加@Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]]伤害。大成功时，将初始伤害加倍，但不包括持续伤害。

升阶 (+2) 初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸液伤害增加1d6。

You conjure an arrow of acid that keeps corroding the target after it hits. Make a spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]] damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

Barkskin.name: 树肤术 Barkskin
Barkskin.description:
目标的皮肤被树皮覆盖。目标获得对钝击与穿刺伤害的抗力2，以及对火焰的弱点3。在目标受到火焰伤害后，它可以以因受到该伤害为触发条件的自由动作（）解消该法术；如此做不会减少目标所受的火焰伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HoOujAdQWCN4E6sQ]{法术效果：橡木韧性}

升阶（+2） 抗力提高2，且弱点提高3。

The target's skin becomes covered in bark. The target gains resistance 2 to bludgeoning and piercing damage and weakness 3 to fire. After the target takes fire damage, it can Dismiss the spell as a free action triggered by taking the damage; doing so doesn't reduce the fire damage the target was dealt.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HoOujAdQWCN4E6sQ]{Spell Effect: Oaken Resilience}

Heightened (+2) The resistances increase by 2, and the weakness increases by 3.

Entangle.name: 纠缠 Entangle
Entangle.description:
区域 20英尺爆发内所有包含植物或真菌的方格

区域内的植物和真菌会缠绕生物。该区域视为困难地形。每一轮当生物在该区域内开始其回合时，它必须尝试一次反射豁免。失败时，它的速度在离开该区域前受到-10英尺的环境减值；大成功或大失败时，它还会在1轮内获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{定身}。生物可以以缠绕的DC尝试逃脱以移除这些效果。

Area all squares in a 20-foot burst that contain plants or fungi

Plants and fungi in the area entangle creatures. The area counts as difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to Escape at entangle's DC to remove these effects.

Glitterdust.name: 闪光尘 Glitterdust
Glitterdust.description:
区域内的生物会被闪烁的尘埃勾勒出轮廓。每个生物必须尝试一次反射豁免。若某个生物的隐形术被此法术抵消，则它处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。无论该生物原本就处于 Invisible，或是在此法术的隐形术抵消效果结束前从新的隐形术效果中受益，此规则都适用。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的隐形术被抵消2轮。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} 1分钟，且其隐形术被抵消1分钟。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} 1轮，并陷入Dazzled 10分钟。其隐形术被抵消10分钟。

Creatures in the area are outlined by glittering dust. Each creature must attempt a Reflex save. If a creature has its invisibility negated by this spell, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This applies both if the creature was already Invisible and if it benefits from new invisibility effects before the end of the invisibility negation effect from this spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's invisibility is negated for 2 rounds.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute and its invisibility is negated for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and Dazzled for 10 minutes. Its invisibility is negated for 10 minutes.

Acid Splash.name: 酸液飞溅 Acid Splash
Acid Splash.description:
你泼洒出一团酸液，飞溅到你的目标及其附近的生物身上。进行一次法术攻击。若你命中，你造成1d6酸性伤害，外加1点飞溅酸性伤害。在大成功或大失败时，目标还会受到@Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]]伤害。

升阶（3环） 初始伤害提升至2d6，持续伤害提升至2。

升阶（5环） 初始伤害提升至3d6，持续伤害提升至3，且飞溅伤害提升至2。

升阶（7环） 初始伤害提升至4d6，持续伤害提升至4，且飞溅伤害提升至3。

升阶（9环） 初始伤害提升至5d6，持续伤害提升至5，且飞溅伤害提升至4。

You splash a glob of acid that splatters your target and nearby creatures. Make a spell attack. If you hit, you deal 1d6 acid damage plus 1 splash acid damage. On a critical success, the target also takes @Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (3rd) The initial damage increases to 2d6, and the persistent damage increases to 2.

Heightened (5th) The initial damage increases to 3d6, the persistent damage increases to 3, and the splash damage increases to 2.

Heightened (7th) The initial damage increases to 4d6, the persistent damage increases to 4, and the splash damage increases to 3.

Heightened (9th) The initial damage increases to 5d6, the persistent damage increases to 5, and the splash damage increases to 4.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你释放出一道脉冲，用以登记魔法的存在。你获得的信息仅限于是否存在魔法。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。

你只有在幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术阶位时，才能侦测到该幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环）你得知该法术在射程内侦测到的、最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若多个效果同等强大，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环）同3环，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但能将来源缩小到一个5英尺立方体之内（若其大于该范围，则为最接近的范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你创造一道幻觉，使你看起来像另一种体型相同的生物，并且与你自身的身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）大致相近。该伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以冒充某个特定个体。此法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物与穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一件礼服。手持物品不受影响，而任何你移除的穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视同为以欺瞒进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{冒充}用途的伪装准备；它无视你因将自己伪装成不相似生物而可能承受的任何环境减值；它给予你+4状态加值于欺瞒检定，以防止他人看穿你的伪装；并且即使你未受训也能加上你的等级。你可以解消此法术。

升阶（2环） 该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

升阶（3环） 你可以看起来像任何体型相同的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过某个个体才能变为其外观。该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{法术效果：幻象伪装}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法会听从你的指令。只要你维持法术，你就可以施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持法术时，你可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹饪 冷却、加热或为1磅非生命材料调味。
  • 提起 缓慢将一个无人持用、负载为光亮负载或更低的物体抬离地面1英尺。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质制成。该物体看起来粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——不能用作工具、武器或法术材料。
  • 整理 为一个负载为光亮负载或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以以10轮的专注影响一个负载为1的物体，而影响更大的物体则需要每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩无法造成伤害或导致不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（超出上述注明者）仅在你维持法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the Spell. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or spell component.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the Spell.

Produce Flame.name: 燃火术 Produce Flame
Produce Flame.description:
一团小小的火焰球出现在你掌心之中，你用它进行一次近战或远程的抽击。对你的目标的AC进行一次法术攻击掷骰。这通常是一次远程攻击，但你也可以对你徒手触及内的一名生物进行一次近战攻击。

成功时，你造成2d4点火焰伤害。大成功时，目标承受双倍伤害并承受@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]]伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d4，且大成功时的持续伤害增加1d4。

A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开思维以感知魔法灵光。施法完成后，你知道该物品是否具有魔法；如果是，你还会得知其魔法学派。

如果该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的等级低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以以10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震感（模糊）30 尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Breath of the Bog.name: 沼泽之息 Breath of the Bog
Breath of the Bog.description:
30英尺。一个在该区域内开始其回合的生物感觉仿佛肺部正在充满水，必须在一次@Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免中成功，否则将无法说话或呼吸。该生物仍然可以屏住呼吸，并且可以在其回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免。成功的生物获得24小时的暂时免疫。

30 feet. A creature that begins its turn within the area feels as if its lungs were filling with water and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or be unable to speak or breathe. The creature can still hold its breath and can attempt a new save at the end of its turn. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Rise Up.name: 崛起 Rise Up
Rise Up.description:
触发 一个生物走到埋在下方泥浆或泥炭中的沼泽木乃伊（特征）上方

需求 尚未进行先攻掷骰

效果 沼泽木乃伊（特征）在掷先攻之前自动注意到该生物并进行掘穴。

Trigger A creature walks on top of a bog mummy that lies buried in the mud or peat below

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled

Effect The bog mummy automatically notices the creature and Burrows before rolling initiative.

Bog Rot.name: 沼腐症 Bog Rot
Bog Rot.description:
该苦难无法被降低到第1阶段以下，并且在使用移除诅咒或类似效果成功治疗之前，由其造成的伤害也无法被治疗；此后，该苦难便可如同疾病一般正常移除。被沼腐症杀死的生物会融化成恶臭的烂泥，且除非使用7环起死回生仪式或类似魔法，否则无法起死回生

豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

阶段 1 携带者且无不良效果（1分钟）

阶段 2 @Damage[3d6[void]] 伤害以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}（1天）

This affliction can't be reduced below stage 1, nor can the damage from it be healed, until it's successfully treated with remove curse or a similar effect; the affliction can then be removed as normal for a disease. A creature killed by bog rot melts into a noxious sludge and can't be resurrected except by a 7th-rank resurrect ritual or similar magic

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 minute)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 day)

Elder Child of Belcorra.blurb:
变体沼泽木乃伊（特征）
Variant bog mummy
Elder Child of Belcorra.prototypeToken: 贝科拉的长子 Elder Child of Belcorra

Empty Death Bodak.name: 空无之死 菩达克 Empty Death Bodak
Empty Death Bodak.tokenName: 空无之死 波达克 Empty Death Bodak

Lifesense 60 feet.name: 生命感知 60 尺 Lifesense 60 feet

Draining Glance.name: 汲取一瞥 Draining Glance
Draining Glance.description:
触发 博达克能以其 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.sebk9XseMCRkDqRg]{生命感知} 感知到的、30尺内的一名活体生物开始其回合

效果 目标必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:23] 豁免。若其失败，博达克恢复 @Damage[5[healing]] 生命值，且目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{力竭 1}。

Trigger A living creature within 30 feet that the bodak can perceive with its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.sebk9XseMCRkDqRg]{Lifesense} starts its turn

Effect The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save. If it fails, the bodak regains @Damage[5[healing]] Hit Points and the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Sunlight Vulnerability.name: 阳光弱点 Sunlight Vulnerability
Sunlight Vulnerability.description:
如果暴露在直射阳光下，博达克无法使用带有死亡（特征）的动作，并且它会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}。每当博达克在阳光下结束其回合时，迟缓值增加1。如果博达克以这种方式失去所有动作，它会被摧毁。

If exposed to direct sunlight, the bodak can't use actions with the death trait and it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. The slowed value increases by 1 each time the bodak ends its turn in sunlight. If the bodak loses all its actions this way, it is destroyed.

Bodak Spawn.name: 博达克孽生体 Bodak Spawn
Bodak Spawn.description:
任何在被博达克施加的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drain}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}状态下死亡的类人生物，会在其死亡后24小时以一个自主的博达克身份再度复起。

Any humanoid who dies while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} by a bodak rises as an autonomous bodak 24 hours after its death.

Death Gaze.name: 死亡凝视 Death Gaze
Death Gaze.description:
博达克凝视其30尺内、能以其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.sebk9XseMCRkDqRg]{生命感知}察觉到的一名活体生物。该生物必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:26]豁免。若目标变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失（状态）}，博达克获得数量等于目标获得的流失（状态）数值×5的临时生命值。

多次暴露于此能力可将一名生物的流失（状态）提高至最高4。若博达克被摧毁，任何生物因死亡凝视而获得的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭（状态）}将被移除。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 1}。

失败 该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭 1}与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 2}。

大成功或大失败 该生物获得毁灭1与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 4}。

The bodak stares at a living creature within 30 feet that it can sense with its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.sebk9XseMCRkDqRg]{Lifesense}. That creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save. If the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, the bodak gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to 5 times the value of the drained condition the target gained.

Multiple exposures to this ability can increase a creature's drained condition to a maximum of 4. If the bodak is destroyed, any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition a creature has gained from Death Gaze are removed.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is doomed 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4}.

Empty Death Bodak.publicNotes:
当一个活着的、具有知性的类人生物暴露于超自然邪恶的极端表现之下时，这段经历能无可挽回地将受害者打入永罚，碾碎其心智并撕裂其灵魂，在一种骇人而亵渎的转化中，使其变成一种对生命而言是禁忌的生物——波达尸。

在这场彻底腐化中幸存下来的些许物质性残片，只会进一步强化这类类人生物极度令人不安的外表。波达尸的身体可怖地扭曲，仿佛被锁死在痛苦与恐惧的痉挛之中。它干枯无毛的皮肉带着异界的、珍珠般的光泽，紧绷地覆在畸形的骷髅（特征）上，使它的步态沦为缓慢的蹒跚。但最令人不安的，莫过于它的双眼——嵌在一张下垂、融化般的面孔上，几乎不剩它曾经的面部结构。这双眼睛深陷眼眶之中，却仍以亵渎的光亮(术)发光，以不懈的恶意凝视，并不断淌出有毒的蒸汽。

被对生者的复仇憎恨所滤过的、支离破碎的前生记忆，会驱使波达尸试图回到它曾经熟悉的那些地方。若得逞，它会用其杀人的凝视，以及夹杂着卑劣诅咒、指控与威胁的、令人无法理解的胡言乱语洪流，去袭击旧日的朋友、熟人和挚爱之人——而这样的袭击往往会导致受害者自己也作为新生的波达尸再度爬起。

When a living, sentient humanoid is exposed to an extreme expression of supernatural evil, the experience can irrevocably damn the victim, crushing their mind and ripping out their soul in an appalling, unholy transformation that results in a creature that's anathema to life-the bodak.

The shreds of physicality that survive this absolute corruption serve only to enhance the humanoid's profoundly disturbing appearance. The bodak's body is horrifically twisted, as though it's locked in a convulsion of agony and terror. Its desiccated and hairless flesh bears an otherworldly, pearlescent sheen, strung taut across a malformed skeleton that reduces its gait to a slow shamble. But most disturbing of all are its eyes, set in a drooping, melted visage with scant remains of its former facial structure. These eyes, sunken deep into their sockets, nevertheless glow with an unholy light, stare with unremitting malevolence, and constantly weep noxious vapor.

Fragmented memories of a prior existence filtered through a vengeful hatred of the living lead the bodak to try to return to those places it once knew. If successful, it assaults former friends, acquaintances, and loved ones with its murderous gaze and an incomprehensible torrent of gibberish laced with vile curses, accusations, and threats-an assault that often leads to the victims rising as newly formed bodaks themselves.
Empty Death Bodak.prototypeToken: 空无之死 波达克 Empty Death Bodak

Ghonhatine.name: 地蜥兽 Ghonhatine

Stench.name: 恶臭 Stench
Stench.description:
30尺。进入该灵光或在该灵光内开始其回合的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:26] 豁免，否则将成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1（状态）}（若大失败，则在其恶心期间还会额外获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}）。

在该灵光范围内，受影响的生物对抗疾病的豁免以及从恶心（状态）中恢复的检定承受-2环境减值。成功通过其豁免的生物获得1分钟暂时免疫。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wX9L6fbqVMLP05hn]{效果：恶臭}

30 feet. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for as long as it's sickened on a critical failure).

While within the aura, affected creatures take a -2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wX9L6fbqVMLP05hn]{Effect: Stench}

Feed.name: 喂养 Feed
Feed.description:
需求 地蜥兽与一具在过去1小时内死亡的生物尸体相邻

效果 地蜥兽吞食尸体的一块。持续1分钟，地蜥兽获得快速治疗5以及对伤害掷骰的+2状态加值。它从任何一具特定尸体中只能获得这些增益一次。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wPW6kVscJgBLPVKZ]{Effect: Ghonhatine Feed}

Requirements The ghonhatine is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour

Effect The ghonhatine devours a chunk of the corpse. For 1 minute, the ghonhatine gains fast healing 5 and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls. It can gain these benefits from any given corpse only once.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wPW6kVscJgBLPVKZ]{Effect: Ghonhatine Feed}

Fleshgout.name: 血肉外翻 Fleshgout
Fleshgout.description:
地蜥兽的呕吐物携带一种可怕的疾病，会随着时代推移使受害生物的皮肉长出疼痛的脓疱，最终脱落，留下张开的伤口

豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:28]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良效果（[[/r 1d4 #Incubation]]{1d4 小时}）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1} 与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{汲取 1}（1 天）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 2} 与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{汲取 2}（1 天）

阶段 4 虚弱 2 与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{汲取 3}（1 天）

阶段 5 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{汲取 4}、虚弱 2，以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷}（1 天）

阶段 6 死亡

A ghonhatine's vomit carries an awful disease that, over time, can cause a suffering creature's flesh to develop painful boils that eventually slough away, leaving gaping wounds

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:28]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect ([[/r 1d4 #Incubation]]{1d4 hours})

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 day)

Stage 4 enfeebled 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 day)

Stage 5 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4}, enfeebled 2, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} (1 day)

Stage 6 dead

Ghonhatine.publicNotes:
在改造地蜥人（特征）时，卓尔塑肉者并非试图创造一种全新的生物类型，而是想要重现一种被认为已在格拉利昂彻底消失的地蜥人（特征）祖先形态。地蜥兽便是这一成果——魁梧的爬行类巨兽，更喜欢四肢着地爬行，并以兽性的狂怒撕扯敌人。

这里介绍的两种塑肉体，是被卑劣的炼金魔法重塑的可怖憎邪，由卓尔所创造；他们将俘获的精灵或地蜥人（特征）改造成扭曲的怪物，然后将其释放以造成破坏与恐怖。

In transforming xulgaths, drow fleshwarpers sought not to create a new type of creature but to recapture a form of xulgath predecessor believed entirely vanished from Golarion. Ghonhatines are the result-hulking reptilian beasts who prefer to crawl on all fours and tear at their foes with bestial fury.

Horrid abominations reshaped by vile alchemical magic, the two fleshwarps presented here were created by drow, who transform captured elves or xulgaths into twisted monstrosities that can then be loosed to cause havoc and terror.

Goliath Spider.name: 巨硕蜘蛛 Goliath Spider

Web Sense.name: 蛛网术感知 Web Sense
Web Sense.description:
巨硕蜘蛛拥有不精确的震颤感知，以探测触碰其蛛网术的生物所产生的振动。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

The goliath spider has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

Spring Upon Prey.name: 扑向猎物 Spring Upon Prey
Spring Upon Prey.description:
需求 尚未掷先攻。

触发 当巨硕蜘蛛在蛛网术上时，一个生物触碰巨硕蜘蛛的蛛网术。

效果 巨硕蜘蛛会自动注意到该生物，并在掷先攻之前沿蛛网术步行、攀爬或下降。

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled.

Trigger A creature touches the goliath spider's web while the spider is on it.

Effect The goliath spider automatically notices the creature and Strides, Climbs, or Descends on a Web before it rolls initiative.

Descend on a Web.name: 降临于蛛网术 Descend on a Web
Descend on a Web.description:
巨硕蜘蛛沿直线向下移动至多120尺，由一条蛛网术丝线悬吊。它可以悬挂在蛛网术上或脱落。它以蛛网术下降的距离不计入坠落伤害。

成功打击蛛网术（AC 20，硬度 5，20 HP）的生物会将其切断，使蜘蛛坠落。

The goliath spider moves straight down up to 120 feet, suspended by a web line. It can hang from the web or drop off. The distance it Descends on a Web doesn't count for falling damage.

A creature that successfully Strikes the web (AC 20, Hardness 5, 20 HP) severs it, causing the spider to fall.

Goliath Spider Venom.name: 巨硕蜘蛛毒液 Goliath Spider Venom
Goliath Spider Venom.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] 伤害 并 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[3d8[poison]] 伤害 并 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 2}（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[3d10[poison]] 伤害 并 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹} [[/br 2d4 #hours]]{2d4 小时}

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d10[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for [[/br 2d4 #hours]]{2d4 hours}

Web Tether.name: 蛛网术系绳 Web Tether
Web Tether.description:
被蜘蛛的蛛网术打击命中的生物将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}状态，并被系连在蜘蛛身上，使其无法移动到离蜘蛛更远的位置。

蜘蛛一次只能系连一个生物。对蛛网术进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{破拆}的DC为30。系带可以用一次打击切断（AC 20，硬度5，HP 20），但这不会让被束缚的生物获得自由。

A creature hit by the spider's web Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} and tethered to the spider, preventing it from moving farther away from the spider.

The spider can have one creature tethered at a time. The DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the web is 30. The tether can be severed with a Strike (AC 20, Hardness 5, HP 20), but this doesn't free the restrained creature.

Goliath Spider.publicNotes:
巨硕蜘蛛栖息于最深邃的丛林之中，在那里它们编织出如神殿般巨大的蛛网术，并以大如河马的猎物为食。

没有多少日常害虫能像臭名昭著的蜘蛛那样令人胆寒。

Goliath spiders dwell in the deepest jungles, where they build webs as big as temples and feast on prey as large as hippopotami.

Few everyday vermin inspire as much dread as the infamous spider.

Gorsalthith.name: 戈尔萨尔西斯 Gorsalthith

Primal Prepared Spells.name: 原初已准备法术 Primal Prepared Spells

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原始先天法术 Primal Innate Spells

Air Walk.name: 凌空而行 Air Walk
Air Walk.description:
目标可以在空中行走，仿佛那里是坚实的地面。它可以以这种方式上升和下降，最大角度为45度。

The target can walk on air as if it were solid ground. It can ascend and descend in this way at a maximum of a 45-degree angle.

Freedom of Movement.name: 行动自如 Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
你会排斥那些会妨碍生物或使其移动变得缓慢的效果。在此法术效果期间，目标无视那些会使其速度受到环境减值的效果。当其尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}一个使其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}的效果时，除非该效果是魔法且其阶级高于行动自如法术，否则其自动成功。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{法术效果：行动自如}

You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the freedom of movement spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Freedom of Movement}

Plant Growth.name: 植物生长 Plant Growth
Plant Growth.description:
你使区域内的植物更健康、更丰产。除了健康植物的其他益处之外，根据你的成功程度，这会提高农场的作物产量。如果你在一个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight} 的区域内施放它，plant growth 会尝试反制该 blight，而不是产生其通常的效果。

大成功 使区域内的作物产量翻倍，或将区域扩大为半径1英里。

成功 使区域内的作物产量提高三分之一。

失败 该仪式没有效果。

大失败 区域内的植物群以一种未预料的方式发生变化，由GM决定，但通常尽可能与你真正的愿望相矛盾（例如，当你希望增产时却使作物枯萎）。

You cause the plants within the area to be healthier and more fruitful. In addition to other benefits of healthy plants, this increases the crop yield for farms, depending on your success. If you cast it in the area of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight}, plant growth attempts to counteract the blight instead of producing its usual effect.

Critical Success Double the crop yield in the area, or increase the area to a 1-mile radius.

Success Increase the crop yield in the area by one-third.

Failure The ritual has no effect.

Critical Failure The flora in the area changes in an unanticipated way, determined by the GM but generally as contradictory to your true desires as possible (for instance, blighting crops when you would prefer to enrich them).

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标目盲。效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。随后目标在1分钟内获得暂时免疫。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，直到其下一回合开始。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大失败 目标永久目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Glyph of Warding.name: 守卫刻文 Glyph of Warding
Glyph of Warding.description:
你通过将一个敌对法术绑定进一个符号来制作陷阱。在你施放此法术时，你还要施放一个法术环位更低的法术以将其储存在刻文中。被储存的法术必须以3个动作或更少即可施放，具有敌对效果，并以一个生物为目标或具有一个区域。你可以为刻文设置一个口令、一个触发，或两者皆有。任何移动、打开或触碰目标容器，或进入目标区域，且没有说出口令或符合触发条件的生物，都会启动刻文，释放其中的有害法术。

一旦法术被储存在刻文中，刻文获得该法术的所有特征。若被储存的法术以一个或更多生物为目标，则其目标为触发刻文的生物。若其具有区域，则该区域以触发刻文的生物为中心。守卫刻文的持续时间在刻文被触发时结束。该刻文视为一个魔法陷阱，使用你的法术DC来进行用于察觉它的察觉检定，以及用于解除它的盗贼检定；两种检定都要求尝试的生物受训才能成功。

你可以解消守卫刻文。你在同一时间能够维持生效的守卫刻文最大数量等于你的施法能力调整值。

You craft a trap by binding a hostile spell into a symbol. While Casting this Spell, you also Cast a Spell of a lower spell rank to store in the glyph. The stored spell must take 3 actions or fewer to cast, have a hostile effect, and target one creature or have an area. You can set a password, a trigger, or both for the glyph. Any creature that moves, opens, or touches the target container or enters the target area that doesn't speak the password or that matches the trigger activates the glyph, releasing the harmful spell within.

Once a spell is stored in the glyph, the glyph gains all the traits of that spell. If the stored spell targets one or more creatures, it targets the creature that set off the glyph. If it has an area, that area is centered on the creature that set off the glyph. Glyph of warding's duration ends when the glyph is triggered. The glyph counts as a magical trap, using your spell DC for both the Perception check to notice it and the Thievery check to disable it; both checks require the creature attempting them to be trained in order to succeed.

You can Dismiss glyph of warding. The maximum number of glyphs of warding you can have active at a time is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

Meld into Stone.name: 遁入石中 Meld into Stone
Meld into Stone.description:
你与一块相邻的石块融合，该石块的体积足以容纳你以及你穿戴和持用的物品。你在施放法术时必须接触该石块。你可以听到但无法看到石块外发生的事情，并且你可以在石块内施放法术，只要这些法术不需要穿过石块之外的效果线。

当你在石块内时，若该石块受到显著的物理伤害，会将你排出并对你造成10d6伤害。穿墙术会将你排出但不会造成伤害，并结束与石合一。你可以解消此法术。

You merge with an adjacent block of stone with enough volume to fit you and your worn and held possessions. You must touch the stone when you Cast the Spell. You can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the stone, and you can cast spells while in the stone as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the stone.

Significant physical damage to the stone while you are inside it expels you and deals 10d6 damage to you. Passwall expels you without dealing damage and ends one with stone. You can Dismiss this spell.

Acid Arrow.name: 酸液箭 Acid Arrow
Acid Arrow.description:
你召唤出一支酸液箭矢，在命中后持续腐蚀目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击。命中时，你造成3d8点酸蚀伤害外加@Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]]点伤害。大成功时，初始伤害加倍，但持续伤害不加倍。

升阶（+2） 初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸蚀伤害增加1d6。

You conjure an arrow of acid that keeps corroding the target after it hits. Make a spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]] damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

Barkskin.name: 树肤术 Barkskin
Barkskin.description:
目标的皮肤被树皮覆盖。目标获得钝击与穿刺伤害抗力2，以及火焰弱点3。在目标受到火焰伤害后，它可以以因受到该伤害而触发的自由动作解消该法术；如此做不会减少目标所受的火焰伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HoOujAdQWCN4E6sQ]{法术效果：橡木韧性}

升阶（+2） 抗力各增加2，弱点增加3。

The target's skin becomes covered in bark. The target gains resistance 2 to bludgeoning and piercing damage and weakness 3 to fire. After the target takes fire damage, it can Dismiss the spell as a free action triggered by taking the damage; doing so doesn't reduce the fire damage the target was dealt.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HoOujAdQWCN4E6sQ]{Spell Effect: Oaken Resilience}

Heightened (+2) The resistances increase by 2, and the weakness increases by 3.

Entangle.name: 纠缠 Entangle
Entangle.description:
区域 以20尺爆发范围内所有包含植物或真菌的方格

区域内的植物与真菌会缠绕生物。该区域视为困难地形。每一轮，当生物在该区域内开始其回合时，它必须进行一次反射豁免。失败时，它的速度在离开该区域前承受-10尺环境减值；大失败时，它还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}状态，持续1轮。生物可以尝试以缠绕的DC进行逃脱，以移除这些效果。

Area all squares in a 20-foot burst that contain plants or fungi

Plants and fungi in the area entangle creatures. The area counts as difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to Escape at entangle's DC to remove these effects.

Glitterdust.name: 闪光尘 Glitterdust
Glitterdust.description:
区域内的生物会被闪烁的尘埃勾勒出轮廓。每个生物都必须进行一次反射豁免。如果某个生物的隐形术被此法术抵消，那么它将处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} 状态。这既适用于该生物原本就处于Invisible状态的情况，也适用于在此法术的隐形术抵消效果结束前，该生物从新的隐形术效果中获益的情况。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的隐形术被抵消2轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} 状态1分钟，且其隐形术被抵消1分钟。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} 状态1轮，并获得Dazzled状态10分钟。其隐形术被抵消10分钟。

Creatures in the area are outlined by glittering dust. Each creature must attempt a Reflex save. If a creature has its invisibility negated by this spell, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This applies both if the creature was already Invisible and if it benefits from new invisibility effects before the end of the invisibility negation effect from this spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's invisibility is negated for 2 rounds.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute and its invisibility is negated for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and Dazzled for 10 minutes. Its invisibility is negated for 10 minutes.

Acid Splash.name: 酸液飞溅 Acid Splash
Acid Splash.description:
你泼洒一团酸液，飞溅到你的目标及其附近的生物身上。进行一次法术攻击。若你命中，你造成1d6点酸性伤害外加1点飞溅酸性伤害。在大成功或大失败时，目标还会受到@Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]]伤害。

升阶（3环） 初始伤害提高至2d6，且持续伤害提高至2。

升阶（5环） 初始伤害提高至3d6，持续伤害提高至3，且飞溅伤害提高至2。

升阶（7环） 初始伤害提高至4d6，持续伤害提高至4，且飞溅伤害提高至3。

升阶（9环） 初始伤害提高至5d6，持续伤害提高至5，且飞溅伤害提高至4。

You splash a glob of acid that splatters your target and nearby creatures. Make a spell attack. If you hit, you deal 1d6 acid damage plus 1 splash acid damage. On a critical success, the target also takes @Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (3rd) The initial damage increases to 2d6, and the persistent damage increases to 2.

Heightened (5th) The initial damage increases to 3d6, the persistent damage increases to 3, and the splash damage increases to 2.

Heightened (7th) The initial damage increases to 4d6, the persistent damage increases to 4, and the splash damage increases to 3.

Heightened (9th) The initial damage increases to 5d6, the persistent damage increases to 5, and the splash damage increases to 4.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你释放出一道脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除了魔法存在或不存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。

只有当幻术魔法的效果等级低于你侦测魔法法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到幻术魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（第3）你会得知该法术在射程内所侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果强度相同，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（第4）同第3等级，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的来源。如同模糊感官一样，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源范围缩小到一个5尺立方体之内（若来源大于该范围，则缩小到最接近的范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你创造一个幻象，使你看起来像另一个与自己身体构造相同、且身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）大致相近的生物。此伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以冒充特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物与穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一件连衣裙。手持物品不受影响，而任何你脱下的穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视为为欺瞒的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}用途进行伪装；它无视你因将自己伪装成不相似生物而可能承受的任何环境减值；它给予你+4状态加值，用于进行欺瞒检定以防止他人看穿你的伪装；且即使你未受训，你也将你的等级加入其中。你可以解消该法术。

升阶（2环） 该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

升阶（3环） 你可以看起来像任何与自己体型相同的生物，甚至是特定个体。你必须见过某个个体才能采用其外貌。该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{法术效果：幻象伪装}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法会听从你的命令。你可以在你维持该法术期间施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹饪 冷却、加热或为1磅的非生物材料调味。
  • 抬升 缓慢地将一个无人看管、负载为光亮或更轻的物体抬离地面1英尺。
  • 制作 创造一个临时的、负载可忽略不计的物体，由凝结的魔法物质构成。该物体看起来粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——它不能用作工具、武器或法术成分。
  • 整理 为一个负载为光亮或更轻的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以用10轮的专注来影响一个负载为1的物体，而更大的物体则需要每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩无法造成伤害或导致不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（除了上述注明者之外）只会在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the Spell. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or spell component.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the Spell.

Produce Flame.name: 燃火术 Produce Flame
Produce Flame.description:
一团小小的火焰球出现在你手掌中，你用它进行近战或远程抽击。对你的目标的AC进行一次法术攻击掷骰。这通常是一次远程攻击，但你也可以对你徒手触及内的一个生物进行一次近战攻击。

成功时，你造成2d4火焰伤害。大成功时，目标承受双倍伤害，并承受@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]]伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d4，且大成功时的持续伤害增加1d4。

A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你将注意力集中在目标物体上，敞开你的心灵以感知魔法灵光。当施法完成时，你会知道那个物品是否具有魔法；若其具有魔法，你还会得知其魔法学派。

如果该物体是幻觉，你只有在该效果的等级低于你的阅读灵光法术的阶位时，才能侦测出这一点。

升阶（3环）你可以以最多10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环）你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震感（不精确）30尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Breath of the Bog.name: 沼泽吐息 Breath of the Bog
Breath of the Bog.description:
30尺。一个生物在其回合开始时位于该区域内，会感觉仿佛肺部正在灌满水，必须在一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免中成功，否则将无法说话或呼吸。该生物仍然可以屏住呼吸，并可在其回合结束时尝试进行一次新的豁免。豁免成功的生物在24小时内暂时免疫。

30 feet. A creature that begins its turn within the area feels as if its lungs were filling with water and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or be unable to speak or breathe. The creature can still hold its breath and can attempt a new save at the end of its turn. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Rise Up.name: 崛起 Rise Up
Rise Up.description:
触发 一个生物走到一具埋在下方泥浆或泥炭中的沼泽木乃伊（特征）上方

需求 尚未投掷先攻

效果 该沼泽木乃伊（特征）在投掷先攻前自动注意到该生物并进行掘地。

Trigger A creature walks on top of a bog mummy that lies buried in the mud or peat below

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled

Effect The bog mummy automatically notices the creature and Burrows before rolling initiative.

Bog Rot.name: 沼腐症 Bog Rot
Bog Rot.description:
该苦难无法被降低至第1阶段以下，也无法治疗其造成的伤害，直到使用祛除诅咒或类似效果成功治疗；此后，该苦难便可像普通疾病一样正常移除。被沼腐症杀死的生物会融化成恶臭的污泥，除非通过第7阶起死回生仪式或类似魔法，否则无法起死回生

豁免掷骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良效果（1分钟）

阶段 2 @Damage[3d6[void]] 虚空伤害并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}（1天）

This affliction can't be reduced below stage 1, nor can the damage from it be healed, until it's successfully treated with remove curse or a similar effect; the affliction can then be removed as normal for a disease. A creature killed by bog rot melts into a noxious sludge and can't be resurrected except by a 7th-rank resurrect ritual or similar magic

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 minute)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 day)

Gorsalthith.blurb:
变体：沼泽木乃伊（特征）
Variant bog mummy

Huglu.name: 胡格鲁 Huglu

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你熄灭一个濒死生物的生命。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。如果这杀死了它，你获得10点临时HP，以及在10分钟内对攻击和伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死} 数值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{法术效果：死亡丧钟}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

Feather Fall (Self only).name: 羽落术（仅自身） Feather Fall (Self only)
Feather Fall (Self only).description:
触发 射程内的一个生物正在坠落

你令空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落速度减缓至每轮60英尺，并且在法术持续时间内发生的坠落部分在计算坠落伤害时不计入。如果目标在法术效果持续期间到达地面，它不会因这次坠落受到伤害。目标一落地，法术立刻结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道能够汲取敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标尝试一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，则该生物进行一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你在攻击掷骰中大成功或大失败，则将其豁免的结果视为降低一个成功等级的结果。

Critical Success 目标不受影响。

Success 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1}。

Failure 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 2}。

Critical Failure 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 3}。

A ray with the power to sap a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save in order to determine the spell's effect. If you critically succeed on your attack roll, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这种皮质护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还会加上小块金属板，在提供与皮质护甲几乎同等灵活性的同时，具备更坚固的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭的箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中通过一端的箭羽保持稳定，另一端装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当一名透肌魔人死亡时，其隐形的血肉会迅速腐烂并升华成一股恶臭气体，充满尸体周围的@Template[emanation|distance:5]。

这股气体会对该区域内的生物造成@Damage[3d6[void]]伤害，因为它们的血肉也会同样凝结并腐烂（@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic]豁免）。

When an urdefhan dies, its invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around the body.

This gas deals @Damage[3d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save).

Ravenous Attack.name: 贪婪攻击 Ravenous Attack
Ravenous Attack.description:
透肌魔人对单一生物进行一次双叉剑打击和一次啃咬打击。其多重攻击减值在完成两次攻击后才会增加。

The urdefhan makes one rhoka sword Strike and one jaws Strike against a single creature. Its multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 透肌魔人在其上个动作中以一次啃咬打击对一个生物造成了伤害

效果 透肌魔人保持接触，使该生物伤口部位周围的血肉变得半透明。透肌魔人从以下两个选项中选择一个，每个选项都需要进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20] 豁免。若该次啃咬打击是大成功或大失败，则该生物承受两种效果，并对两种效果使用同一次豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 透肌魔人饮用该生物的一些鲜血。豁免失败时，该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[5[治疗]] HP（或在大成功或大失败时，该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}，且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[10[治疗]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力 透肌魔人抽离该生物的一部分生命精粹。豁免失败时，该生物在1小时内陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}（或在大成功或大失败时，在1小时内陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}）。

Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on its last action

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The urdefhan chooses one of two options, each of which requires a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[5[healing]] HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Huglu.publicNotes:
从出生的那一刻起，透肌魔人就为战争做好准备。透肌魔人武者是你在他们诡异的地下城市之外可能遭遇的最弱小的透肌魔人之一。

From the moment they are born, urdefhans are prepared for war. Urdefhan warriors are among the least powerful urdefhans one might encounter outside of their eerie underground cities.

Hunting Spider.name: 猎蛛 Hunting Spider

Web Sense.name: 蛛网术感知 Web Sense
Web Sense.description:
猎蛛拥有不精确的震动感知，以侦测触碰其蛛网术的生物所产生的振动。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

The hunting spider has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

Spring Upon Prey.name: 扑向猎物 Spring Upon Prey
Spring Upon Prey.description:
需求 尚未掷先攻。

触发 当猎蛛在蛛网术上时，一个生物触碰到猎蛛的蛛网术。

效果 猎蛛在掷先攻之前自动注意到该生物，并在蛛网术上大步行走、攀爬或下降。

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled.

Trigger A creature touches the hunting spider's web while the spider is on it.

Effect The hunting spider automatically notices the creature and Strides, Climbs, or Descends on a Web before it rolls initiative.

Descend on a Web.name: 降临于蛛网术 Descend on a Web
Descend on a Web.description:
猎蛛沿直线向下移动至多40尺，由一条蛛网术线悬挂。它可以挂在蛛网术上或脱离。它在蛛网术上下行的距离不计入坠落伤害。

成功打击蛛网术的生物（AC 20，硬度3，5 HP）会将其切断，导致猎蛛坠落。

The hunting spider moves straight down up to 40 feet, suspended by a web line. It can hang from the web or drop off. The distance it Descends on a Web doesn't count for falling damage.

A creature that successfully Strikes the web (AC 20, Hardness 3, 5 HP) severs it, causing the spider to fall.

Hunting Spider Venom.name: 猎蛛毒 Hunting Spider Venom
Hunting Spider Venom.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

最大持续时间 6轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]]伤害且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}（1轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}，且措手不及（1轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2}，且措手不及（1轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and off-guard (1 round)

Web Trap.name: 网捕 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被猎蛛的蛛网术打击命中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{定身}状态，并粘在最近的表面上，直到其[[/act escape dc=17]]{逃脱（DC 17）}。

A creature hit by the hunting spider's web Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it [[/act escape dc=17]]{Escapes (DC 17)}.

Hunting Spider.publicNotes:
猎蛛是最常见的巨蜘蛛类型，尽管并非体型最大。

在日常害虫中，很少有能像臭名昭著的蜘蛛那样激起如此多的恐惧。

Hunting spiders are the most common type of giant spider, though not the largest.

Few everyday vermin inspire as much dread as the infamous spider.

Iribo.name: 伊瑞铂 Iribo

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光线穿透或在该区域内发出。光不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在该区域内都不会散发任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也是如此。这也会压制你黑暗术法术等级或更低的魔法光亮。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时位于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的缤纷、无热火焰勾勒。受妖火术影响的可见生物不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。如果这些生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态，则在受妖火术影响期间它们处于隐蔽状态，而不是处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未被侦测}状态。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮(术)，彼此之间任意两个相距不超过10尺。每个都像火把一样发光。你维持该法术时，可以将任意数量的光亮(术)移动至多60尺。每个光亮(术)必须保持在你120尺之内，且与所有其他光亮(术)相距不超过10尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Repeating Hand Crossbow.name: 连发手弩 Repeating Hand Crossbow
Repeating Hand Crossbow.description:
装填 2 用于弹匣装填（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oJZe5rRitvioUgRh]{射手弹带}）

Reload 2 for magazine reload (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oJZe5rRitvioUgRh]{Shootist Bandolier})

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这套皮制护甲以金属铆钉加固，有时还嵌有小型金属板，在保有皮制护甲大部分灵活性的同时提供更坚实的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Shootist Bandolier.name: 射手弹带 Shootist Bandolier
Shootist Bandolier.description:
这条皮制射手弹带在可用拇指轻轻一拨便弹开的皮革口袋中，最多可容纳三只 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xk9bw9ccupAIx7xT]{连发手弩弹匣}。你将从射手弹带为连发手弩弹匣进行装填的时间减少 1，总计为 2 个动作。你一次只能佩戴一条射手弹带。

This leather bandolier holds up to three @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xk9bw9ccupAIx7xT]{Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazines} in leather pockets that pop open with the quick flick of a thumb. You reduce the reload time for a repeating hand crossbow magazine from the bandolier by 1, to a total of 2 actions. You can wear only one shootist bandolier at a time.

Stupor Poison.name: 迷梦毒 Stupor Poison
Stupor Poison.description:
启动 2 交互

迷梦毒是对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{昏睡毒}更强效的蒸馏物。进一步暴露于迷梦毒不需要目标尝试额外的豁免掷骰；只有在对持续暴露进行豁免掷骰时失败，才会使其阶段推进。

豁免掷骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

最大持续时间 6小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1} 与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}（1轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 2} 与 措手不及（1轮）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷}，且无法通过察觉检定醒来（1轮）

阶段 4 昏迷，且无法通过察觉检定醒来（[[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6小时}）

Activate 2 Interact

Stupor poison is a more potent distillation of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison}. Further exposure to stupor poison doesn't require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing a saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

Maximum Duration 6 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6 hours})

Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine.name: 连发手弩弹匣 Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时，所有豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗精神效果的所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Shootist's Luck.name: 射手的幸运 Shootist's Luck
Shootist's Luck.description:
触发 射手豁免失败

频率 每日一次

效果 射手重骰该次豁免并采用较好的结果。

Trigger The shootist fails a save

Frequency once per day

Effect The shootist rerolls the save and uses the better result.

Distracting Shot.name: 干扰射击 Distracting Shot
Distracting Shot.description:
枪手瞄准并进行一次远程打击。若该攻击命中并造成伤害，则目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 直到枪手回合结束；若为大成功或大失败，则改为直到枪手下个回合结束。

The shootist takes aim and makes a ranged Strike. If the attack hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of the shootist's turn, or until the end of the shootist's next turn on a critical hit.

Reloading Trick.name: 装填诀窍 Reloading Trick
Reloading Trick.description:
需求 枪手正持握一把未装填的连发手弩

效果 枪手进行一次交互以装填该连发手弩，并用其进行一次打击。

Requirements The shootist is holding an unloaded repeating hand crossbow

Effect The shootist Interacts to reload the repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it.

Shootist's Draw.name: 射手快拔 Shootist's Draw
Shootist's Draw.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 射手进行交互以抽出一把连发手弩并用其进行打击，或用其正持有的一把已装填的连发手弩进行打击，然后进行交互以将其收起。

Frequency once per round

Effect The shootist Interacts to draw a repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it, or Strikes with a loaded repeating hand crossbow they're holding then Interacts to stow it.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
射手对 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 的生物额外造成 2d6 精确伤害。

The shootist deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Iribo.publicNotes:
极少数专精于连发手弩命令术的卓尔不仅因其技能而受人尊敬，也因其好运与傲气而受人敬重。

由于在其主要聚居地崇拜恶魔，卓尔背负着邪恶的名声。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主的阴险影响时。

The rare few drow who specialize in the repeating hand crossbow command respect not only for their skills but for their luck and swagger.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Iribo.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Krooth.name: 克鲁斯 Krooth

+4 Status to All Saves vs. Fear.name: 对所有针对恐惧(术)的豁免获得+4状态加值 +4 Status to All Saves vs. Fear

Pain Frenzy.name: 痛苦狂乱 Pain Frenzy
Pain Frenzy.description:
每当克鲁斯被大成功的命中造成伤害时，它获得+2状态加值加于攻击和伤害掷骰，直到其下个回合结束。在这股狂乱持续期间，它不能使用反应动作（）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.tJx9B2e3AET6PbJD]{效果：痛苦狂乱}

Whenever the krooth is damaged by a critical hit, it gains a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls until the end of its next turn. It can't use reactions while this frenzy lasts.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.tJx9B2e3AET6PbJD]{Effect: Pain Frenzy}

Reactive Strike (Tail Only).name: 反应打击（仅尾击） Reactive Strike (Tail Only)

Poison Tooth.name: 毒牙 Poison Tooth
Poison Tooth.description:
需求 本回合中，krooth在其最近一次动作中用其啃咬对一个生物造成了伤害；

效果 krooth将自己的一颗牙折断并留在它命中的生物体内。该生物受到@Damage[1d6[bleed]]{1d6持续流血伤害}并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失（状态） 1}。只要牙齿还留在体内，双方都无法被治疗。

要安全移除牙齿，需要成功进行一次@Check[medicine|dc:26|traits:action:administer-first-aid]检定以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{施行急救}。这不会结束流血或稳定伤势，而是移除牙齿和流失（状态），但不会自动结束流血伤害。

Requirements The krooth damaged a creature with its jaws on its most recent action this turn;

Effect The krooth snaps off one of its teeth in the creature it hit. The creature takes @Damage[1d6[bleed]]{1d6 persistent bleed damage} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Neither can be healed while the tooth remains.

Removing the tooth safely requires a successful @Check[medicine|dc:26|traits:action:administer-first-aid] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}. Instead of ending bleeding or stabilizing, this removes the tooth and the drained condition, but it doesn't automatically end the bleed damage.

Krooth.publicNotes:
克鲁斯，有时也被称为鳄鱼食者，是沼泽与湿地中迅捷而凶残的猎手。尽管它们以捕猎并吞食鳄鱼、短吻鳄，以及几乎任何有血肉的生物而闻名，但它们最喜欢的猎物是蜥蜴人、沼蜍人（特征）和恐龙。

克鲁斯可能独居，也可能结成群体。雄性克鲁斯是独居且具有领地性的生物——凶猛、大胆、嗜血。另一方面，雌性克鲁斯更可能回避潜在的掠食者，但当它们的育群受到威胁时，会迅速变得暴烈。由于它们的后代极其脆弱，雌性克鲁斯会聚集成群来抚育幼崽，派出较小的队伍外出狩猎食物，而其余群体则守夜育群。克鲁斯每隔4或5年才交配一次，而交配过程是一场诡异而血腥的奇观。整群雌性会结队追猎一只落单的雄性克鲁斯，在一场可能持续整整一天一夜的狂乱中夺取它们的战利品。交配结束后，雌性会杀死配偶并吞食他富含营养的血肉，尤其是他的内脏。这些器官含有一种对妊娠至关重要的独特化学化合物。许多博物学家会为新鲜的雄性克鲁斯遗骸支付高价，以便研究这种生物血液与器官的奇异性质。此外，克鲁斯拥有有毒的中空牙齿。当这些生物咬住猎物时，牙齿会折断并留在伤口中，使受害者大量出血，因为血液会通过中空的牙齿涌出。

无论雄性还是雌性，克鲁斯似乎都会被类地精的血肉所排斥，尤其是熊地精（特征）的血肉。这并不意味着克鲁斯不会杀死类地精，尤其是那些威胁它们幼崽的家伙，但它们通常只用爪子和尾巴来这么做，并且在这样的杀戮之后会极其仔细地把自己清理干净。

Krooths, sometimes called crocodile eaters, are fast and vicious hunters of bogs and wetlands. While they are known to hunt and eat crocodiles, alligators, and virtually any creature with flesh, their favorite prey are lizardfolk, boggards, and dinosaurs.

Krooths are found alone or in packs. Male krooths are solitary and territorial creatures—fierce, bold, and bloodthirsty. Female krooths, on the other hand, are more likely to shy away from potential predators but swiftly turn violent when their brood is threatened. Because their offspring are so vulnerable, female krooths gather in packs to raise their young, sending smaller groups to hunt for food while the rest of the pack watches the brood. Krooths mate only once every 4 or 5 years, and the mating process is a curiously gruesome spectacle. An entire pack of females will hunt as a group for a lone male krooth, claiming their prize in a frenzy that can last for an entire day and night. After the mating has finished, the females slay their mate and devour his nutrientrich flesh, and his organs in particular. These organs contain a unique chemical compound vital to gestation. Many naturalists will pay handsomely for the fresh remains of a male krooth so they can study the strange properties of the creature's blood and organs. In addition, krooths have poisonous, hollow teeth. When these creatures bite their prey, a tooth breaks off and causes the victim to bleed profusely as their blood pours through the hollow tooth.

Whether male or female, krooths seem to be repelled by goblinoid flesh, especially that of bugbears. This doesn't mean krooths won't kill goblinoids, especially those threatening their young, but they typically do so using only their claws and tails, and they take great care to clean themselves thoroughly after such a killing.
Krooth.allSaves: +4 status to all saves vs. fear
