Hallucination.name: 镜花水月 Hallucination
Hallucination.description:
目标会持续地将某样事物侦测为另一种事物、无法侦测到实际存在的某物，或侦测到实际上不存在的某物，不过这不会改变其信念。你选择其中一种效果适用，并决定镜花水月的具体内容。例如，你可以让目标把所有精灵看成是人类、无法侦测到其兄弟的存在、即使护身上并没有也能看到自己心爱的幸运护符在身上，或看到城镇中心有一座高塔。

目标可以进行一次初始意志豁免，效果如下。每当他们进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜寻}或直接与镜花水月互动时，他们也会获得一次意志豁免来不相信该镜花水月。例如，目标每次与精灵互动、意外撞到其兄弟、试图检查其护符或研究那座高塔时，都可以尝试不相信该镜花水月。由GM决定，在某些情况下目标尝试不相信时可以获得较大的环境加值，例如目标试图攀爬那座不存在的高塔时。

大成功或大失败 成功 该生物不受影响。

大成功或大失败 成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物会感知你所选择的内容，直到它不相信为止，但它知道镜花水月是什么。

失败 该生物会感知你所选择的内容，直到它不相信为止。

大成功或大失败 失败 该生物会感知你所选择的内容，直到它不相信为止，并且它信任其虚假的感官，在用于不相信的豁免上承受-4环境减值。

强化（6环） 选择以下之一：目标最多10个生物，或将该法术的持续时间改为直到你的下次每日准备。

强化（8环） 选择以下之一：目标为任意数量的生物，或将该法术的持续时间改为无限。

The target consistently detects one thing as another, can't detect something that's there, or detects something that's not there, though it doesn't alter their beliefs. You choose which of these effects applies, and you determine the specifics of the hallucination. For example, you could make the target see all elves as humans, be unable to detect the presence of their brother, see their beloved good luck charm on their person even when it isn't, or see a tower in the center of town.

The target can attempt an initial Will save, with effects below. They also receive a Will save to disbelieve the hallucination every time they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or directly interact with the hallucination. For example, the target could attempt to disbelieve the hallucination each time they interacted with an elf, bumped into their brother accidentally, tried to check their charm, or studied the tower. The target can attempt to disbelieve with a large circumstance bonus in situations determined by the GM, such as if the target attempted to climb the nonexistent tower.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves, but it knows what the hallucination is.

Failure The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves.

Critical Failure The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves, and it trusts its false senses, taking a -4 circumstance penalty to saves to disbelieve.

Heightened (6th) Choose to either target up to 10 creatures or change the spell's duration to until your next daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) Choose to either target any number of creatures or change the spell's duration to unlimited.

Mind Probe.name: 精神质询 Mind Probe
Mind Probe.description:
你将思绪投射入一个生物的心智之中，筛查信息。你获得目标的记忆与知识的许可，除非其以一次意志豁免将你击退。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 在该法术的持续时间内的每轮，你都可以维持该法术以提出一个不同的问题，并尝试揭示答案。针对每个问题，目标都可以尝试进行一次欺瞒检定，对抗你的法术DC；若目标成功，你不会得知答案；若为大成功或大失败中的大成功，目标会给你一个你相信为真实的虚假答案。一旦你向目标问过某个特定问题，再次询问同一问题，即使通过另一次精神质询的独立施放，也会产生相同的结果。

大成功或大失败中的大失败 同失败，并且目标在对抗你提问的欺瞒检定上承受–4环境减值。

You cast your thoughts through a creature's mind, sifting for information. You access the target's memories and knowledge unless it fends you off with a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure Each round of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to ask a different question and attempt to uncover the answer. For each question, the target can attempt a Deception check against your spell DC; if the target succeeds, you don't learn the answer, and on a critical success, the target gives you a false answer that you believe is truthful Once you've asked the target a given question, asking it again, even with a separate casting of mind probe, produces the same result.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes a –4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against your questions.

Wave of Despair.name: 绝望灵光波动 Wave of Despair
Wave of Despair.description:
你对区域内的生物施加绝望灵光。每个生物的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功或大失败成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物无法使用反应动作（），并且必须在其回合开始时再次尝试一次豁免；若失败，则该生物在该回合中因无法控制地抽泣而成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大成功或大失败失败 同失败，且该生物在1分钟内自动变为 slowed 1。

强化（第7环） 区域增至60尺锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Confusion.name: 困惑术 Confusion
Confusion.description:
你用奇异的冲动迷惑你的目标，使其随机行动。其效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标语无伦次地胡言乱语，且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑术} 1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免，以结束该困惑术。

大失败 目标陷入困惑术 1分钟，且无法通过豁免提前结束。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Flicker.name: 闪动 Flicker
Flicker.description:
你在当前位面与另一个位面之间迅速闪动。你获得对所有伤害的抗力5，除了力场。在你的每个回合结束时，你会自动向一个随机方向传送10英尺，方向由GM决定。你可以维持该法术，以这种方式传送。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{法术效果：闪动}

升阶（+2） 抗力提高3。

You flicker quickly between your current plane and another. You gain resistance 5 to all damage, except force. At the end of each of your turns, you automatically teleport 10 feet in a random direction, as determined by the GM. You can Sustain the spell to teleport in this way.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Flicker}

Heightened (+2) The resistance increases by 3.

Nightmare.name: 梦魇术 Nightmare
Nightmare.description:
你向你的目标送去令人不安的梦魇术。目标下一次入睡时，必须尝试一次意志豁免。若你仅知道目标的名字且从未见过对方，目标在此次意志豁免上获得+4环境加值。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不遭受任何不利效果，并在1周内暂时免疫。

成功 目标经历这些梦魇术，但除令人不快的记忆外不承受任何不利效果。

失败 目标经历这些梦魇术，并醒来时获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标经历这些梦魇术，醒来时获得Fatigued，并在不再处于Fatigued之前处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}。

You send disturbing nightmares to your target. The next time the target falls asleep, it must attempt a Will save. If you know the target only by name and have never met them, the target gets a +4 circumstance bonus to the Will save.

Critical Success The target suffers no adverse effects and is temporarily immune for 1 week.

Success The target experiences the nightmares but suffers no adverse effects other than unpleasant memories.

Failure The target experiences the nightmares and awakens @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Critical Failure The target experiences the nightmares, awakens Fatigued, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} until it is no longer Fatigued.

Dream Message.name: 梦境传讯术 Dream Message
Dream Message.description:
你向你的目标的梦境中发送一则传讯术。该传讯术为单向，至多包含1分钟的讲话（约150个词）。如果目标正在睡觉，他们会立刻收到这则传讯术。否则，他们会在下次睡觉时收到。一旦他们收到，法术结束，而你会知道传讯术已发送。

升阶（4环） 你可以将最多10个你知晓其姓名且曾亲自见过的生物作为目标。你必须向他们所有人发送相同的传讯术；法术会对每个生物分别结束

You send a message to your target's dream. The message is one-way, up to 1 minute of speech (roughly 150 words). If the target is asleep, they receive the message instantly. If not, they receive it the next time they sleep. As soon as they receive it, the spell ends, and you know the message was sent.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures you know by name and have met in person. You must send the same message to all of them; the spell ends for each creature individually

Mind Reading (At Will).name: 读心术（随意） Mind Reading (At Will)
Mind Reading (At Will).description:
通过一次粗略的精神接触，你尝试读取目标的思想。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。随后目标在1小时内对你的读心术获得暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 当你施放法术时，目标会从你那里感知到模糊的表层想法。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层想法，并且你得知它的智力是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大成功或大失败 如同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持该法术以再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).name: 隐形术（意志， 仅自身） Invisibility (At Will, Self Only)
Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).description:
幻术会令光线绕过目标，使其变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这会使其对所有生物而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未被察觉}状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对他们而言改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐蔽}状态。若目标使用敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但若目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声默念词句，但它们不会从你口中发出，而是直接传递到目标的耳中。其他人听不到你说的话，效果并不比你平常只动嘴唇更好；但目标能像站在你身旁一样听清你的话。若目标愿意，他们可以用反应动作（）作出简短回应，或在其下一回合用自由动作（）作出回应，但他们必须能够看见你且在射程内才能这么做。若他们回应，他们的回应会像最初的传讯术一样，直接送到你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你将注意力集中在目标物体上，敞开心灵以感知魔法灵光。当施法完成时，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何你就该灵光进行指点的人，在该物品上进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法}时获得+2环境加值。若该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的阶位低于你的阅读灵光法术的阶位时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你可以以最多10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一道力场的魔法护盾。这算作用于“举起护盾”动作，使你在AC上获得+1环境加值，持续到你下个回合开始，但它不需要一只手来使用。

当该法术处于效果中时，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}反应动作（）。该护盾具有硬度5。你可以用该法术的反应动作（）来减少来自任何法术或魔法效果的伤害，即使其不造成物理伤害也可以。在你使用Shield Block后，该法术结束，且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 护盾的硬度增加5。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造一只漂浮的魔法之手，它要么是隐形的，要么呈幽灵般的半透明形态，抓住目标物体并将其缓慢用浮空术朝任意方向移动最多20英尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以使该物体额外移动20英尺。若该法术结束时物体在空中，则该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以将目标设为一个无人持用且负载为1或更低的物体。

升阶（5环）射程提升至60英尺，且你可以将目标设为一个无人持用且负载为1或更低的物体。

升阶（7环）射程提升至60英尺，且你可以将目标设为一个无人持用且负载为2或更低的物体。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 英尺 Telepathy 100 feet

Mind Crush.name: 心灵粉碎 Mind Crush
Mind Crush.description:
需求 虐戾怪擒抱了一个生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

效果 虐戾怪将手探入被擒抱生物的心智，植入受害者最糟恐惧与梦魇术的支离破碎的影像。被擒抱的生物受到 @Damage[6d6[mental]] 伤害，并进行一次 @Check[will|dc:31|basic] 豁免。若大成功或大失败为大失败，则该目标还会如同受到 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5BbU1V6wGSGbrmRD]{Never Mind} 影响一般，并且必须针对该效果再尝试一次第二次意志豁免。

Requirements The nilith has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Effect The nilith reaches into the mind of the grabbed creature and implants disjointed images of the victim's worst fears and nightmares. The grabbed creature takes @Damage[6d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:31|basic] save. On a critical failure, the target is also affected as though by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5BbU1V6wGSGbrmRD]{Never Mind}, and it must attempt a second Will save against that effect.

Nilith.publicNotes:
光滑、深色的虐戾怪看起来像是无毛、瘦骨嶙峋的树懒。这些生物极其危险且令人胆寒，拥有发光的红眼、阴毒的利爪，以及布满针状尖牙的嘴。虐戾怪以活物的情绪、恐惧与血肉为食；民间传说认为，梦见这些生物陷入梦魇术的人，注定有朝一日会被它们吞食。虐戾怪从折磨有智慧的生物中获得强烈的快感，常将捕猎目标锁定在虔信者与正直之人身上，从他们那里引出最原始的恐惧与最恶劣的念头，并沉溺于受害者随后产生的惊恐之中。通常，这些卑劣的操纵者希望将受害者逼入疯狂，甚至走向自杀。大多数虐戾怪缺乏耐心，不愿花太多时代彻底摧毁某个个体；当虐戾怪厌倦了手头的玩物，对其特定的思想与恐惧感到无聊时，它便会先杀死猎物，再啃食其血肉，转而寻找下一个受害者。

虐戾怪实际上是栖居于梦境之外、遥远异界中更致命生物的延伸——从某种意义上说，虐戾怪不过是与其相连的未知外星实体的远程进食机器。学者与位面旅行者曾试图揭开这种神秘联系的确切机制，但至今仍未破译真相。确实，许多调查虐戾怪纽带本质的人，往往在接近任何答案之前就被逼入疯狂。与异界存在的这种怪异联系，或许能解释这些生物的长寿，因为人们相信虐戾怪能存活数千年。

对他者而言值得庆幸的是，虐戾怪是独居生物，憎恶与同类为伍；这很可能是因为这些梦魇术的预兆者并不想品尝它们带给他者的恐怖。

The sleek, dark niliths resemble hairless, emaciated tree sloths. These creatures are intensely dangerous and fearsome, with glowing red eyes, wicked claws, and mouths full of needlelike teeth. Niliths feed off the emotions, fears, and flesh of the living, and folktales posit that those who have nightmares of these creatures are fated to one day be eaten by them. Niliths draw intense joy from tormenting sapient creatures, often focusing their predations on the pious and the just, from whom they draw forth their most basic fears and worst thoughts and revel in their victims' subsequent terror. More often than not, these despicable manipulators wish to drive their victims into madness and even to suicide. Most niliths lack the patience to spend too much time fully tearing down an individual, and when a nilith tires of its current plaything and becomes bored with its particular thoughts and fears, it murders the quarry before feeding on its flesh and moving onto the next victim.

Niliths are actually extensions of much deadlier creatures that dwell in a distant dimension beyond dreams—in a way, niliths are little more than remote feeding machines for the unknown alien entities to which they are connected. Scholars and dimensional travelers have attempted to uncover the exact mechanisms of this mysterious connection, but they have yet to decipher the truth. Indeed, many who investigate the nature of a nilith's bond are driven to madness before getting anywhere close. The odd connection to otherworldly beings might help explain the longevity of these creatures, as it is believed that niliths can live for thousands of years.

Thankfully for others, niliths are solitary creatures that hate the company of their own kind, likely because these harbingers of nightmares have no wish to taste the horrors they bring to others.

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能天生法术 Occult Innate Spells

Plane Shift (Self Only) (To Or From The.name: 位面转移（仅自身）（仅限往返幽影位面） Plane Shift (Self Only) (To Or From The Shadow Plane Only)
Plane Shift (Self Only) (To Or From The.description:
你和你的盟友穿越存在诸位面之间的屏障。各个目标移动到另一个位面，例如火之位面、冥界或外域裂隙。你必须对目的地位面有特定的了解，并使用一把由该位面的材料制成的魔法调谐音叉，作为该法术的施法专注物。虽然大多数显著位面的调谐音叉都很罕见，就像位面转移这个法术一样，更隐秘的位面与半位面往往拥有稀有的调谐音叉。该法术极其不精确，你会出现在距离某个目标（由你选择）上一次旅行到该位面时所在位置1d20x25英里处。若对所有目标而言这是第一次旅行到某个位面，你会出现在该位面的随机位置。位面转移不提供返回旅行的手段，不过再次施放位面转移会让你返回到先前的位面，除非存在特殊情况。

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must have specific knowledge of the destination plane and use a magic tuning fork created from material from that plane as a focus for the spell. While the tuning forks for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell plane shift, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare tuning forks. The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20x25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Plane shift doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting plane shift again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.

Shadow Blast.name: 幽影爆破 Shadow Blast
Shadow Blast.description:
你将幽影位面那近似真实的物质塑造成一次爆发。选择强酸、钝击、寒冷、电击、火焰、力场、穿刺、挥砍或音波伤害，并选择一个 @Template[cone|distance:30]、一个位于120尺内的 @Template[burst|distance:15]，或一个 @Template[line|distance:50]。该爆发对区域内的每个生物造成5d8点你所选择类型的伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高1d8。

You shape the quasi-real substance of the Shadow Plane into a blast. Choose acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, force, piercing, slashing, or sonic damage, and choose a @Template[cone|distance:30], a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet, or a @Template[line|distance:50]. The blast deals 5d8 damage of the type you chose to each creature in the area.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

Shadow Walk.name: 幽影行走 Shadow Walk
Shadow Walk.description:
你获得对幽影位面的许可，利用其扭曲的本质来延展你的旅行。目标进入幽影位面的边缘地带，也就是它与材料位面接壤之处。目标在幽影位面上时无法看见材料位面（尽管该位面的要素有时会是材料位面的朦胧倒影）。当处于幽影位面时，目标会暴露于与该位面住民发生潜在遭遇的风险之中。位面之间边界上的幽影会扭曲空间，使你相对于材料位面的移动加速。目标沿着该边界每旅行3分钟，便能移动相当于他们在材料位面中1小时所能行进的距离。在任何时刻，某个目标都可以解除法术效果，尽管这只会影响该目标。幽影的弯折并不精确，因此当法术结束时，目标会出现在距离他们在材料位面上预期位置约1英里的地方（不过，那些一起旅行并在幽影位面上的同一点解除法术的人会一起出现）。

You access the Shadow Plane, using its warped nature to spread your travels. The targets enter the edge of the Shadow Plane where it borders the Material Plane. Targets can't see the Material Plane while on the Shadow Plane (although elements of that plane can sometimes be a hazy reflection of the Material Plane). While on the Shadow Plane, the targets are exposed to potential encounters with that plane's denizens. The shadows on the border between the planes bend space, speeding up your movement with respect to the Material Plane. Every 3 minutes the targets travel along this border, they move as far as they would through the Material Plane in 1 hour. At any point, a target can Dismiss the spell's effects, although this affects only that target. The shadow bending is inexact, so when the spell ends, the targets appear roughly 1 mile from their intended location on the Material Plane (though those who are traveling together and Dismiss the spell at the same point on the Plane of Shadow appear together).

Mind Reading (At Will).name: 读心术（随意） Mind Reading (At Will)
Mind Reading (At Will).description:
通过一次粗浅的精神接触，你尝试读取目标的思想。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。随后，目标对你的读心术获得1小时的暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 成功当你施放法术时，目标会从你这里感知到模糊的表层想法。

成功你得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于或低于你的。

失败当你施放法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层想法，并且你得知其智力调整值是高于、等于或低于你的。

大成功或大失败 失败同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持法术以再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the Spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造出一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光线穿透或在区域内发散。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内时都不会发出任何光亮，即使它们的光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外。该效果也会压制你黑暗术的环位或更低的魔法光亮。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外面看去，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

强化（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括强效黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将通过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
披覆在幻象之中，目标变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言都处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未被侦测}状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对它们而言改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐藏}状态。若目标使用敌对动作，该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但目标使用敌对动作时不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入体内，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并扰乱不死生物，甚至可能迫使它们逃离。其效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物该法术造成等同于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标尝试一次基础强韧豁免，但在大失败时还会在1轮内受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。
  • 不死生物目标在强韧豁免失败时，在1轮内受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}。在大失败时，除非其成功通过一次意志豁免，否则目标还会在1轮内受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}。

增幅（+1）对活体生物造成的虚空伤害提高1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智变得混沌，并用一次心灵冲击使其陷入眩晕术。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在该豁免中大失败，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心灵以感知魔法灵光。当施法完成时，你知道该物品是否为魔法物品；若是，你会得知其魔法学派。

若该物体为幻象，你仅在该效果的等级低于你的阅读灵光法术的阶位时才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以以10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一道魔法力场护盾术。这视为使用举起护盾术动作，使你在下个回合开始前获得AC+1环境加值，但不需要空出一只手来使用。

当该法术的效果持续期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡}反应动作（）。该护盾术的硬度为5。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，并且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。与普通的盾牌格挡不同，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）来对抗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{力场弹幕}法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾术的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

升阶（3环） 该护盾术的硬度为10。

升阶（5环） 该护盾术的硬度为15。

升阶（7环） 该护盾术的硬度为20。

升阶（9环） 该护盾术的硬度为25。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100尺 Telepathy 100 feet

Curse of Darkness.name: 黑暗诅咒 Curse of Darkness
Curse of Darkness.description:
幽暗之魂对一个因其燃烧的冰冷打击而承受持续性寒冷伤害的生物施加诅咒，窃取受害者的活力。该生物必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:23] 豁免。

在一次失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{强光致盲}，并且其体色变为褪色的灰色阴影，其携带、持用或穿戴的所有装备也同样如此。这些效果具有无限的持续时间。无论其豁免结果如何，该生物获得 1 分钟的暂时免疫。

如果幽暗之魂对一个卡利格尼使用该能力，除非施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{许愿术}或类似的强大魔法，否则该诅咒无法被移除。

The owb inflicts a curse on one creature taking persistent cold damage from their burning cold Strike, stealing the victim's vibrancy. The creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

On a failure, the creature gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{Light Blindness} and its coloration turns to washed out shades of gray, along with all equipment it carries, wields, or wears. These effects have an unlimited duration. Regardless of the result of its save, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

If the owb uses this ability on a caligni, the curse can't be removed short of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} or similar powerful magic.

Owb.publicNotes:
通常被称为幽暗之魂，或被更强大的幽暗之魂先知称为次级幽暗之魂，这些神秘生物中的大多数都专注于操纵卡利格尼文化。在卡利格尼人之中，幽暗之魂会对它们认为低于自身的凡人进行躲藏——甚至包括它们所负责照看的卡利格尼人。幽暗之魂更喜欢挑选一名卡利格尼领袖，在幽影之中控制对方，利用魅力与魔法操弄其行事。通过胁迫这些代理人，幽暗之魂得以在社群政治中保持稳定的影响力：它们要么为与其他生物的盟约赐福或将其撕毁，要么充当卡利格尼人与强大外部实体之间的中间人和使节。

这些来自幽影位面的古老住民，看起来像灰白色的人形上半身，周身覆着半透明的幽影殓葬隐匿之纱。它们沉默而神秘地漂浮着，没有双腿来支撑自身悬空。它们从不当众说话，而是将触及伸入周围生物的心智之中，低声呢喃与含糊嘟囔诅咒、威胁，以及一些怪异而凄凉的卜筮术片段。

这些令人不安的生物被卡利格尼人奉为被遗忘者的代理者——被遗忘者是一群怪异的、如同祖灵般的半神，许多卡利格尼人崇拜他们。有些人甚至相信幽暗之魂正是被遗忘者的显现。

大量幽暗之魂会造访，甚至留下来为卡利格尼社群提供建议；它们的性格如同被遗忘者一般多种多样。所有幽暗之魂都共享对光亮(术)与色彩的憎恨，唯独例外的是它们能投掷为武器的、燃烧般冰冷的魔法所闪烁的发光。居住在卡利格尼人之中的幽暗之魂往往会禁止使用光亮(术)与色彩；若有必要，它们会用自己的黑暗术诅咒来熄灭违逆者。所有幽暗之魂之间唯一的另一共同点，是它们根深蒂固地渴望通过读心术与欺骗来操纵自己所照看的对象——而这种操纵既可能隐蔽，也可能公开。

Commonly called owbs, or lesser owbs by more powerful owb prophets, most of these mysterious creatures focus on manipulating caligni culture. Among calignis, an owb hides from mortals they deem beneath them-even including calignis in their charge. An owb prefers to select one caligni leader to control from the shadows, manipulating them using charisma and magic. Through coersion of such agents, owbs maintain a steady hand in the politics of the community, either blessing and breaking pacts with other creatures or acting as intermediaries and ambassadors between calignis and powerful external entities.

These ancient denizens of the Shadow Plane appear as grayish humanoid torsos covered in translucent funeral veils of shadow. Silent and mysterious, they float about, absent legs to hold them aloft. Never speaking a word aloud, they instead reach into the minds of creatures around them to whisper and mumble curses, threats, and strange bits of forlorn augury.

These haunting creatures are revered by calignis as proxies of the Forsaken-a strange array of ancestor-like demigods whom many calignis worship. Some even believe owbs are the Forsaken manifested.

A multitude of owbs visit and even remain to advise caligni communities, as varied in personality as the Forsaken. All owbs share a hatred of light and color, except for the flickering glow of the burning cold magic they can hurl as a weapon. Owbs who live among calignis tend to prohibit the use of light and color, using their curse of darkness to quench violators if necessary. The only other similarity across all owbs is their entrenched desire to manipulate their charges through mind-reading and deception, though such manipulation can be either subtle or overt.

Padli.name: 帕德利 Padli

Occult Innate Spells.name: 天赋秘法法术 Occult Innate Spells

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
你甜言蜜语的话语令生物难以抗拒。你向目标提出一个行动方案，该方案必须以一种对目标而言看起来合乎逻辑的方式来措辞，并且不能是自我毁灭的或明显违背目标自身利益的。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是在正常地对它说话，而不是对它施放法术。

失败 目标立刻遵从你的暗示术。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标完成一个有限的暗示术内容，或该暗示术变得自我毁灭，或具有其他明显的负面效果为止。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，但基础持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标目盲。效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。随后目标在1分钟内获得暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 直到其下个回合开始。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标永久目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Enthrall.name: 注目术 Enthrall
Enthrall.description:
你的言辞令你的目标迷魂。你在施放与持续时间内必须不间断地说话或歌唱。注意到你说话或歌唱的目标可能会给予你全神贯注的注意；每个目标都必须尝试一次意志豁免。若目标属于相对立的宗教、族裔或政治倾向，或因其他原因不太可能同意你的言论，GM 可能会给予一个环境加值（最高 +4）。

每个进入射程内的生物在你维持法术时都必须尝试一次豁免。若你是在说话，注目术获得语言（特征）。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响，并注意到你试图使用魔法。

成功 目标无需注意，但不会注意到你试图使用魔法（它可能会注意到其他目标被迷魂）。

失败 目标对你处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂} 状态。若它目睹其不同意的动作或说话，它可以再尝试一次意志豁免。若它成功，则不再迷魂，并在 1 小时内暂时免疫。若目标遭受敌对行为，或若另一名生物对其进行一次交涉或威吓检定并成功，则该迷魂效果立即结束。

大成功或大失败：失败 同失败，但若它不同意你，目标不能尝试豁免以结束该迷魂效果。

Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the Spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer Fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你阻断了目标的运动冲动，使其无法从心智中传出，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}，持续 1 轮。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标麻痹，持续 4 轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，使剩余的持续时间减少 1 轮，或在大成功或大失败 成功时完全结束该效果。

升阶（7环） 你最多可以以 10 个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Darkness.name: 黑暗术 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你创造一团黑暗帷幕，阻止光线在该区域内穿透或散发。光线无法进入该区域，任何非魔法的光源，例如火把或提灯，在区域内也不会散发任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外。这也会压制你黑暗术的环阶或更低的魔法光亮。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗（意志） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造出一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光线穿透或在区域内发出。光线不会进入该区域，而任何非魔法的光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内也不会发出任何光，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外。这同样会压制你黑暗术法术等级或更低的魔法光亮(术)。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看到外面。从外部看，它就像一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
披覆在幻术之中，目标变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物都处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉}状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，从而使其对它们改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐蔽}状态。若目标使用敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但若目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Obscuring Mist (At Will).name: 隐雾术（随意） Obscuring Mist (At Will)
Obscuring Mist (At Will).description:
你召唤出一团薄雾。薄雾中的所有生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽} 状态，且薄雾外的所有生物对薄雾内的生物而言为隐蔽。你可以解消这团云雾。

You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入自身，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活体并使不死生物迷失方向，甚至可能迫使它们逃离。该效果取决于目标是活体还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物 该法术造成等于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但在大失败时还会在1轮内@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1}。
  • 不死生物 若强韧豁免失败，目标在1轮内@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。在大失败时，目标还会在1轮内@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃离}，除非它成功通过一次意志豁免。

升阶（+1） 对活体生物造成的虚空伤害增加1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标心智混乱，并用一次精神冲击令其眩晕。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害提高 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你释放出一道脉冲，以登记魔法的存在。你除了魔法是否存在之外，不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。

你只有在该魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的阶位时，才能侦测到幻术学派的魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果同等强大，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你也会定位最高等级魔法的来源。如同模糊感官一样，你不会得知其精确位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体之内（若来源大于此范围，则为与之最近的该尺寸范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成2d4精神伤害以及1d4持续精神伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到全部初始伤害，但不受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标受到全部初始伤害与持续伤害，且目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

升阶 (+1) 伤害增加2d4，持续伤害增加1d4。

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{缩放持续精神伤害}

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and 1d4 persistent mental damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一道魔法力场护盾。这相当于使用了举起护盾动作，使你在下一回合开始前获得对AC的+1环境加值，但不需要空出一只手来使用。

当该法术处于效果中时，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应动作（）。该护盾的硬度为5。在你使用Shield Block后，该法术结束，且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。不同于普通的Shield Block，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）对抗 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} 法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（3环） 该护盾的硬度为10。

升阶（5环） 该护盾的硬度为15。

升阶（7环） 该护盾的硬度为20。

升阶（9环） 该护盾的硬度为25。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Leather Armor.name: 皮革护甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
由柔软与定型的煮制皮革混合制成，这种护甲提供一定保护，同时保持最大灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

这根警棍长约一英尺，内含一个法术。其外观通常与其中的法术相关。

启动 施法

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Craft Requirements Supply a listed-level casting of the spell.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Death Flame.name: 死之白焰 Death Flame
Death Flame.description:
当帕德利死亡时，他的身体在一道炽白的火焰闪光中燃烧殆尽。所有在一个@Template[burst|distance:20]内的生物受到@Damage[6d10[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]豁免）。

他的道具不受火焰影响，并在他死去之处留下一堆。

When Padli dies, his body combusts in a flash of white-hot flame. All creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:20] take @Damage[6d10[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save).

His gear is unaffected by the flames and is left in a pile where he died.

Occult Ward.name: 秘法结界 Occult Ward
Occult Ward.description:
触发 帕德利尝试对一名他能看见的生物施放的法术进行一次豁免

效果 帕德利在触发的豁免上获得+2环境加值。

Trigger Padli attempts a saving throw against a spell cast by a creature he can see

Effect Padli gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering save.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
帕德利对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物造成3d6额外精准伤害。

Padli deals 3d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Padli.blurb:
男性卡灵尼副指挥官
Male caligni subcommander

Roper.name: 夺缠怪 Roper

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对所有豁免检定获得+2状态加值（对抗魔法） +2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Reactive Lash.name: 反应鞭击 Reactive Lash
Reactive Lash.description:
触发 绳怪触须的触及范围内的一名生物在其正在使用的移动动作期间离开一个方格。

效果 绳怪对触发生物进行一次触须打击。

Trigger A creature within reach of the roper's strand leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The roper makes a strand Strike against the triggering creature.

Extend Strands.name: 延伸丝缕 Extend Strands
Extend Strands.description:
蟠绕怪从其身体伸出或收回六条细薄而黏稠的触须。当触须伸出时，蟠绕怪在隐匿检定中承受 -4 环境减值；当触须收回时，它无法使用其触须打击。

The roper extends or retracts six thin, sticky tendrils from its body. While the strands are extended, the roper takes a -4 circumstance penalty to Stealth checks, and while they're retracted, it can't use its strand Strikes.

Flurry of Strands.name: 丝缕连击 Flurry of Strands
Flurry of Strands.description:
掠夺者使用其每条触须进行一次触须打击（除去那些正在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{定身}生物的触须）。每次攻击必须针对不同的目标。这些攻击计入掠夺者的多重攻击减值，但在所有攻击完成之前，其多重攻击减值不会增加。

The roper makes a strand Strike with each of its strands (except those that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilizing} creatures). Each attack must be against a different target. These attacks count toward the roper's multiple attack penalty, but its multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.

Pull the Strands.name: 拉动丝线 Pull the Strands
Pull the Strands.description:
蟹钳怪将所有被其触须@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}的生物拉向自己。蟹钳怪进行一次@Check[athletics]检定，并将结果与每个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{定身}生物的强韧DC进行比较。蟹钳怪将其成功对抗的每个生物拉近至多25英尺，将其大成功对抗的每个生物拉近至多50英尺。

The roper pulls every creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by its strands toward itself. The roper rolls a single @Check[athletics] check and compares the result to each @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} creature's Fortitude DC. The roper pulls each creature it succeeds against up to 25 feet closer and each creature it critically succeeds against up to 50 feet closer.

Sticky Strand.name: 黏性丝线 Sticky Strand
Sticky Strand.description:
任何被缠绕怪的触丝命中的生物将获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭（状态） 1}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{被抓住}。每次额外被触丝命中会使力竭（状态）值增加1（最高至力竭（状态）4）。该力竭（状态）值每8小时降低1。当缠绕怪用触丝抓住所抓住的生物时，它仍然可以移动，但如果它移动到超出触丝的触及范围，它会自动释放该生物。缠绕怪可以以自由动作（）释放一个被抓住的生物。生物可以用一次以触丝为目标的攻击切断触丝；该攻击命中AC 27且造成至少18点挥砍伤害。此举不会对缠绕怪自身造成任何伤害，但它不能再用被切断的触丝进行攻击。

Any creature hit by a roper's strand is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. Each additional hit from a strand increases the enfeebled condition value by 1 (to a maximum of enfeebled 4). This enfeebled value decreases by 1 every 8 hours. The roper can move while it has a creature grabbed with a strand, but it automatically releases the creature if it moves beyond the strand's reach. The roper can release an grabbed creature as a free action. A creature can sever a strand with a target attack that hits AC 27 and deals at least 18 slashing damage. This doesn't deal any damage to the roper itself, though it can no longer attack with a severed strand.

Roper.publicNotes:
对除最目光敏锐的地下探险者之外的所有人而言，岩索怪看起来不过是一根巨大的钟乳石、石笋，或冰柱。作为狡猾而耐心的伏击型掠食者，岩索怪会利用这一点为己所用。

岩索怪不会形成大型社会（尽管它们经常被发现与其他深渊栖居的生物一同生活），但它们常会聚集成小型簇群，有时也会结队狩猎。岩索怪对生与死的哲学、以及世界上更残酷更阴险的宗教之精微细节尤为感兴趣；它原本只打算吃掉的对象，却可能被它拉着谈话或争论数小时。反应敏捷的洞穴探险者有时能用故事或哲学讨论取悦岩索怪，从而暂时抑制它的食欲，但岩索怪不会心甘情愿地让如此引人入胜的猎物活着逃脱。传说中，特别善辩的辩手与哲学家会被岩索怪簇群当作宠物或谈话伙伴豢养数天，甚至数年；但到头来，若这些宠物最终没能逃脱，岩索怪的食欲便会压过其智识上的好奇心——尤其是在宠物不断以机智与耐性胜过看守者的情况下。岩索怪身高9英尺，体重2,200磅。

To all but the most sharp-eyed underground explorers, a roper appears to be nothing more than a large stalactite, stalagmite, or pillar of ice. Cunning and patient ambush predators, ropers use this to their advantage.

Ropers do not form large societies (although they can often be found living alongside other deep-dwelling denizens), but they often congregate in small clusters and sometimes hunt in groups. Particularly interested in the philosophy of life and death and the flner points of the more cruel and sinister religions of the world, a roper can talk or argue for hours with those it initially sought merely to eat. Quick-thinking spelunkers can sometimes stave off a roper's appetite by entertaining it with stories or discussions of philosophy, but ropers do not willingly allow such intriguing prey to escape alive. Stories speak of particularly skilled debaters and philosophers who have been kept for days or even years as pets or conversational companions by roper clusters, but in the end, if such pets don't eventually escape, the ropers' appetites win out over their intellectual curiosity-especially in cases where the pets constantly outmaneuver their keepers' wits and patience. A roper is 9 feet tall and weighs 2,200 pounds.
Roper.allSaves: +2 status to all saves vs. magic

Broad Swipe.name: 横扫 Broad Swipe
Broad Swipe.description:
巨人用其爪对两个相邻的敌人各进行一次打击，这两个敌人都在其触及范围内。这两次攻击都计入巨人的多重攻击减值，但减值直到两次攻击都完成后才会增加。

The giant makes two Strikes with its claw against two adjacent foes, both of whom are within its reach. Both attacks count toward the giant's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks..

Massive Rush.name: 大规模冲锋 Massive Rush
Massive Rush.description:
巨灵迈步并进行一次爪击打击，该打击的伤害获得+4环境加值。若该打击命中，巨灵自动将目标推开10英尺。

The hulk Strides and makes a claw Strike with a +4 circumstance bonus to damage. If the strike hits, the hulk automatically pushes the target 10 feet.

Skeletal Hulk.publicNotes:
巨型巨人与其他庞大的生物能制成强大的骷髅（特征）。

被赋予动画的骷髅（特征）是最常见的亡灵类型之一。

Huge giants and other enormous creatures make powerful skeletons.

Animated skeletons are among the most common types of undead.
