Thundering.name: 雷鸣 Thundering
Thundering.description:
这把武器在命中时会发出一声雷鸣，在成功的打击中造成额外1d6点音波伤害。若大成功，目标必须在@Check[type:fortitude|dc:24]豁免中成功，否则耳聋1分钟（若大失败则为1小时）。

This weapon lets out a peal of thunder when it hits, dealing an extra 1d6 sonic damage on a successful Strike. On a critical hit, the target has to succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:24] save or be deafened for 1 minute (or 1 hour on a critical failure).

Bravo's Brew (Moderate).name: 布拉沃的佳酿（中等） Bravo's Brew (Moderate)
Bravo's Brew (Moderate).description:
启动 A 交互

这瓶起泡啤酒赋予勇气。饮用这瓶药剂后的接下来1小时内，你的意志豁免获得+2物品加值；若进行对抗恐惧(术)的意志豁免，则为+3。

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.wTZnKkT0K4Tdy8mD]{效果：勇士佳酿（中等）}

Activate A Interact

This flask of foaming beer grants courage. For the next hour after drinking this elixir, you gain a +2 item bonus to Will saves, or +3 when attempting Will saves against fear.

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.wTZnKkT0K4Tdy8mD]{Effect: Bravo's Brew (Moderate)}

Healing Potion (Moderate).name: 治疗药水（中等） Healing Potion (Moderate)
Healing Potion (Moderate).description:
治疗药水是一小瓶宝石红色液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时会感到一阵刺痛。当你喝下治疗药水时，你恢复[[/r (3d8+10)[healing]]]{3d8+10 生命值}。

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain [[/r (3d8+10)[healing]]]{3d8+10 Hit Points}.

Barkskin Potion.name: 树肤药水 Barkskin Potion
Barkskin Potion.description:
你喝下这杯苦涩的饮剂后，你的皮肤会像树皮一样增厚。你获得2级@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{Barkskin}法术的效果，持续10分钟。

After you drink this bitter draft, your skin thickens like bark. You gain the effects of a 2nd-level @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{Barkskin} spell for 10 minutes.

Piece of Onyx.name: 一块缟玛瑙 Piece of Onyx

Murderer's Knot.name: 谋杀者之结 Murderer's Knot
Murderer's Knot.description:
使用 固定于一把武器上

启动 F 命令术

触发 你使用已固定的武器进行一次打击，对一个措手不及的生物造成伤害

需求 你对已固定的武器为专家

这条黑色皮革细绳被系成看起来像和平结的样子，当武器收起时会呈现出来，但不会妨碍拔出武器。当你启动该结时，你所伤害的生物承受 @Localize[PF2E.PersistentDamage.Bleed1d6.success]。

如果你拥有 @Compendium[pf2e.feats-srd.5Jc2ySGLVi053qpz]{Twist the Knife} 专长，则该护符改为造成等同于你偷袭伤害的持续流血伤害。

Usage affixed to a weapon

Activate F Command

Trigger You damage a flat-footed creature with a Strike using the Affixed weapon

Requirements You are an expert with the affixed weapon

This black strand of leather is tied to look like a peace knot when the weapon is stowed, but it doesn't hamper drawing the weapon. When you activate the knot, the creature you damaged takes @Localize[PF2E.PersistentDamage.Bleed1d6.success].

If you have the @Compendium[pf2e.feats-srd.5Jc2ySGLVi053qpz]{Twist the Knife} feat, the talisman instead deals persistent bleed damage equal to your sneak attack damage.

Potion of Quickness.name: 加速药水 Potion of Quickness
Potion of Quickness.description:
饮用这瓶银色药水会使你获得@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{加速术}的效果，持续1分钟。

Drinking this silver potion grants you the effects of @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} for 1 minute.

Javelin of Lightning.name: 闪电标枪 Javelin of Lightning
Javelin of Lightning.description:
启动 D 命令, 交互

这件物品看起来像一支刻有闪电束纹饰的普通标枪。若在未启动的情况下投掷，它会在空中摇摆，无法准确命中。

当你启动标枪时，你的命令使这些雕刻噼啪作响、迸发电流。你随后掷出标枪。它在离开你手后立刻粉碎，并从你的空间释放其魔法，效果如同一个4环@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.9AAkVUCwF6WVNNY2]{闪电束}。

该闪电束造成[[/r 5d12[electricity]]] 伤害，并具有一个@Check[type:reflex|dc:25|basic:true] 豁免。

Activate D Command, Interact

This item looks like a normal javelin carved with lightning-bolt motifs. If thrown without being activated, it wobbles in the air and fails to strike true.

When you Activate the javelin, your command makes the carvings crackle with electricity. You then hurl the javelin. It shatters immediately after leaving your hand and unleashes its magic as a 4th-level @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.9AAkVUCwF6WVNNY2]{Lightning Bolt} originating from your space.

The bolt deals [[/r 5d12[electricity]]] damage and has a @Check[type:reflex|dc:25|basic:true] save.

Wand of Fireball (Level 3).name: 一根火球术魔杖（等级 3） Wand of Fireball (Level 3)
Wand of Fireball (Level 3).description:
这根指挥棒长约一英尺，内含一个单独的法术。其外观通常与其中的法术相关。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你以所示等级施放该法术。

制造需求 提供一次所列等级的该法术施放。

注：要制作某个特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料库或资料库浏览器拖入PC、NPC或战利品演员的物品栏中。

@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated level.

Craft Requirements Supply a listed-level casting of the spell.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Bracers of Missile Deflection (Greater).name: 偏斜飞弹护臂（强效） Bracers of Missile Deflection (Greater)
Bracers of Missile Deflection (Greater).description:
这些护腕由坚固的秘银板制成，闪耀如夏日的太阳。

启动 R 交互

频率 每10分钟一次

触发 一次远程武器攻击命中你但未造成重击

需求 你察觉到该次攻击且未处于措手不及

效果 护腕使飞射物偏离轨道。你对抗该次触发攻击的AC获得+2环境加值。若这会使该次攻击变为失败，则该次攻击未命中你。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.PeiuJ951kkBPTCSM]{效果：飞射物偏斜护腕}

These bracers are made from plates of durable mithral and gleam like the summer sun.

Activate R Interact

Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger A ranged weapon attack hits you but doesn't critically hit

Requirements You are aware of the attack and not flat-footed

Effect The bracers send the missile off-course. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If this would cause the attack to be a failure, the attack misses you.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.PeiuJ951kkBPTCSM]{Effect: Bracers of Missile Deflection}

Bhazrade.name: 巴兹拉德 Bhazrade

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 秘法自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Commune.name: 通神术 Commune
Commune.description:
你呼唤一个未知的异界实体来回答问题；若你有自己的神祇并使用宗教，这是你神祇的仆从。你最多可以提出七个能用“是”或“否”回答的问题。该实体很可能知道与其权能相关的答案；例如，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.swwwP7eVmlNuWTb7]{哥兹莱}的仆从很可能知道关于不自然的天气模式，而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JgqH3BhuEuA4Zyqs]{黛丝娜}的仆从很可能知道某人的旅行路线。实体会用“是”“否”“可能”“未知”等单词作答，但其回答总是反映它自己的意图，且可能具有欺骗性。

大成功或大失败 成功你联系到一个更强大的实体，它与你的利益高度一致，甚至可能就是你的神祇。该实体不会试图欺骗你，不过它仍然可能不知道答案。当需要提供更明确的信息时，该实体会用最多五个词回答你的问题，例如“如果你立刻出发”或“那曾经是真的”。

成功你可以提出问题并获得回答。

失败你未能联系到异界实体。

大成功或大失败 失败你暴露于宇宙的浩瀚之中，并在1周内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}状态（无法以任何方式移除）。

You call upon an unknown planar entity to answer questions; this is a servitor of your deity if you have one and use Religion. You can ask up to seven questions that could be answered with "Yes" or "No." The entity is likely to know answers related to its purview; a servitor of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.swwwP7eVmlNuWTb7]{Gozreh} would likely know about unnatural weather patterns and a servitor of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JgqH3BhuEuA4Zyqs]{Desna} would likely know someone's travel route. The entity answers with one word answers such as "Yes," "No," "Likely," and "Unknown," though its answers always reflect its own agenda and could be deceptive.

Critical Success You contact a more powerful entity aligned strongly with your interests, possibly even your deity. The entity won't attempt to deceive you, though it still might not know the answers. When it's important to provide clarity, the entity will answer your questions with up to five words, such as "If you leave immediately" or "That was true once."

Success You can ask your questions and receive answers.

Failure You fail to contact a planar entity.

Critical Failure You are exposed to the enormity of the cosmos and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} for 1 week (can't remove by any means).

Black Tentacles.name: 黑触手 Black Tentacles
Black Tentacles.description:
区域 贴近一处平坦表面的20尺爆发

油腻的黑触手升起并尝试捕捉区域内的生物。对区域内每个生物的强韧DC进行法术攻击掷骰。你对其成功的任意生物都会被@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}并受到3d6钝击伤害。每当一个生物在区域内结束其回合时，若触手尚未抓住该生物，则触手尝试抓住它；并且触手对任何已被Grabbed的生物造成@Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]伤害。

触手的逃脱DC等于你的法术DC。一个生物可以攻击一根触手以尝试解除其束缚。其AC等于你的法术DC，并且若它受到12点或更多伤害则会被摧毁。即使被摧毁，额外的触手仍会在区域内继续生长，直到持续时间结束。你可以解消该法术。

Area 20-foot burst adjacent to a flat surface

Oily black tentacles rise up and attempt to capture creatures in the area. Make spell attack rolls against the Fortitude DC of each creature in the area. Any creature you succeed against is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage. Whenever a creature ends its turn in the area, the tentacles attempt to grab that creature if they haven't already, and they deal @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage to any creature already Grabbed.

The tentacles' Escape DC is equal to your spell DC. A creature can attack a tentacle in an attempt to release its grip. Its AC is equal to your spell DC, and it is destroyed if it takes 12 or more damage. Even if destroyed, additional tentacles continue to grow in the area until the duration ends. You can Dismiss the spell.

Ectoplasmic Expulsion.name: 灵质驱散 Ectoplasmic Expulsion
Ectoplasmic Expulsion.description:
你召唤出转瞬即逝的灵质触须，穿过目标并带走一种有害的精神苦难。你立即尝试反制目标身上的单个具有情绪或占据（特征）的效果，或使目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂（状态）} 状态的效果。若你反制该效果失败，你仍会建立一种共鸣，使目标能够更好地自行逃脱该效果；在接下来1小时内，目标对抗你未能反制的该效果时，其意志豁免获得+2状态加值（例如，为摆脱 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{占据术} 法术造成的控制所进行的意志豁免）。

You call upon tendrils of ephemeral ectoplasm to pass through the target and carry away a harmful psychic affliction. You immediately attempt to counteract a single effect on the target with the emotion or possession trait, or an effect giving the target the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} condition. If you fail to counteract the effect, you nevertheless set up a resonance that allows the target to more ably escape the effect on its own; for the next hour, the target gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves to shrug off the effect you failed to counteract (such as Will saves to shake off control by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} spell).

Prying Eye.name: 窥探之眼 Prying Eye
Prying Eye.description:
你在你能看见且距离你500英尺内的位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}、漂浮的眼睛，直径1英寸。它以你正常的视觉感官向所有方向观察，并持续将其所见传输给你。每轮你第一次维持法术时，你可以选择将眼睛移动至多30英尺（只能看见眼睛前方的事物），或将其移动至多10英尺（能看见其周围所有方向的一切）。眼睛能离你移动多远没有限制，但如果你与眼睛曾经不再处于同一存在位面，该法术会立刻结束。若你想用它进行察觉检定，你可以通过眼睛尝试搜寻动作。任何对眼睛造成的伤害都会摧毁它并结束该法术。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, floating eye, 1 inch in diameter, at a location you can see within 500 feet. It sees in all directions with your normal visual senses and continuously transmits what it sees to you. The first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can either move the eye up to 30 feet, seeing only things in front of the eye, or move it up to 10 feet, seeing everything in all directions around it. There is no limit to how far from you the eye can move, but the spell ends immediately if you and the eye ever cease to be on the same plane of existence. You can attempt Seek actions through the eye if you want to attempt Perception checks with it. Any damage dealt to the eye destroys it and ends the spell.

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立刻将自己以及你所穿戴和持握的任何物品从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的、在射程内的一处空旷空间。若这会把另一个生物一同带来——即使你正将其装在一个异次元容器中携带——该法术会失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。你会暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Globe of Invulnerability.name: 法术无效结界 Globe of Invulnerability
Globe of Invulnerability.description:
你在自己周围创造一个固定不动的球体，尝试反制任何来自球体外、其区域或目标进入球体内的法术，如同该球体是一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}法术，但其环位比该法术的实际环位低1。

若反制尝试成功，它只会阻止本应进入球体内的那一部分法术（因此若该法术也有位于球体外的目标，或其区域的一部分超出球体之外，则那些目标或那部分区域仍会正常受到影响）。

你必须在一片连续且开阔的空间中形成该球体，使其边缘不会穿过任何生物或物体，否则该法术将失效（不过法术施放后，生物可以进入球体）。

You create an immobile globe around yourself that attempts to counteract any spell from outside the globe whose area or targets enter into the globe, as if the globe were a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} spell 1 rank lower than its actual spell rank.

If the counteract attempt succeeds, it prevents only the portion of the spell that would have entered the globe (so if the spell also has targets outside the globe, or part of its area is beyond the globe, those targets or that area is affected normally).

You must form the sphere in an unbroken open space, so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost (though creatures can enter the globe after the spell is cast).

Outcast's Curse.name: 流放诅咒 Outcast's Curse
Outcast's Curse.description:
你用一个诅咒折磨目标，使其存在感变得令人不适、惹人厌烦。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 持续10分钟，目标在尝试欺瞒、交涉、威吓或表演检定时，必须掷骰两次并使用较差的结果，并且他们在遭遇到的生物对其的初始态度为降低一级（例如，以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{不友好} 取代 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{不关心}）。

失败 同成功，但效果为永久。

大成功或大失败 同失败，且目标在遭遇到的生物对其的初始态度为降低两级。

You afflict the target with a curse that makes its presence abrasive and off-putting. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 10 minutes, the target must roll twice and use the worse result whenever attempting a Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check, and creatures they encounter have an initial attitude toward them of one step worse (for instance, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent}).

Failure As success, but the effect is permanent.

Critical Failure As failure, and creatures that the target encounters have an initial attitude toward them of two steps worse.

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标目盲。效果取决于目标的强韧豁免。随后目标在1分钟内暂时免疫。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，直到其下一回合开始。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大失败 目标永久目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Geas.name: 指使术 Geas
Geas.description:
你对一个自愿的目标施加一条魔法规则，迫使其要么执行、要么避免执行某个特定行为。要求执行某个行为的指使术通常带有条件，例如：“永远为寻求落脚之处的陌生人提供款待。”无条件地要求执行某个特定行为的指使术并不要求目标只能执行该行为，但它必须将该任务置于一切休闲消遣之上优先处理。最常见的“避免执行某行为”的指使术是明确要求不得违反某个契约。在这些情况下，次要施法者通常负责确保契约措辞与该仪式的魔法正确契合。由于目标是自愿的，指使术可以具有持续时间，并且可持续到目标同意为止。如果目标无法履行指使术，它会变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心（状态） 1}，并且每连续一天被阻止遵循指使术，该恶心（状态）就增加1，最高至恶心（状态）4。当它再次遵循指使术时，恶心（状态）立即结束；它不能以任何其他方式移除该恶心（状态）。只有强大的魔法，例如@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{许愿术}仪式，才能从自愿目标身上移除指使术的效果。

大成功或大失败 指使术成功，且目标在直接维护该指使术的技能检定上获得+1状态加值（由GM酌情决定）。

成功 指使术成功。

失败 指使术失败。

大成功或大失败 指使术失败，且你反而受到你正试图施加在目标身上的指使术影响。你被视为非自愿目标，因此该指使术可以被@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{净化苦难}法术反制。

升阶（5环） 你可以将指使术用于非自愿生物；它可以尝试进行一次意志豁免以使效果无效。如果目标在此次意志豁免中失败，该指使术最多持续1周。除了诸如许愿术仪式等强大魔法之外，净化苦难法术也可以反制施加在非自愿生物身上的指使术。聪明的非自愿生物可以通过人为制造使其无法遵从的局面来破坏指使术，但在这种情况下它会变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心（状态）}（如上所述）。

升阶（7环） 如5环，但指使术在非自愿生物身上最多持续1年。

升阶（9环） 如5环，但指使术在非自愿生物身上持续你选择的持续时间（甚至无限）。

You enforce a magic rule on a willing target, forcing it to either perform or refrain from carrying out a certain act. A geas to perform an act is usually conditional, such as, "Always offer hospitality to strangers seeking a place to stay." An unconditional geas to perform a certain act doesn't require the target to perform that act exclusively, though it must prioritize the task above all leisurely pursuits. The most common geas to refrain from carrying out an act is a specification to avoid violating a contract. In those cases, the secondary caster usually takes charge of making sure the wording of the contract is attuned correctly with the ritual's magic. Because the target is willing, geas can have a duration that lasts for as long as the target agrees to. If the target is unable to fulfill the geas, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and the sickened condition increases by 1 for each consecutive day it is prevented from following the geas, to a maximum of sickened 4. The sickened condition ends immediately when it follows the geas again; it can't remove the sickened condition in any other way. Only powerful magic such as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual can remove the effects of geas from a willing target.

Critical Success The geas succeeds, and the target receives a +1 status bonus to skill checks that directly uphold the geas (at the GM's discretion).

Success The geas succeeds.

Failure The geas fails.

Critical Failure The geas fails, and you are instead affected by the geas you were attempting to place on the target. You are considered an unwilling target, so the geas can be counteracted with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} spell.

Heightened (5th) You can use geas on an unwilling creature; it can attempt a Will save to negate the effect. If the target fails this Will save, the geas lasts up to 1 week. A cleanse affliction spell can counteract a geas on an unwilling creature, in addition to powerful magic such as a wish ritual. A clever unwilling creature can subvert the geas by contriving situations that prevent it from complying, but in that case it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} (as described above).

Heightened (7th) As 5th rank, but the geas lasts for up to 1 year on an unwilling creature.

Heightened (9th) As 5th rank, but the geas lasts for a duration you choose (even unlimited) on an unwilling creature.

Heroism.name: 英雄气概 Heroism
Heroism.description:
你唤起目标内在的英雄气概，使其在攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免掷骰和技能检定上获得+1状态加值。

升阶（6环） 状态加值提高至+2。

升阶（9环） 状态加值提高至+3。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{法术效果：英雄气概}

You tap into the target's inner heroism, granting it a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.

Heightened (9th) The status bonus increases to +3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{Spell Effect: Heroism}

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
你使目标周围的时代流动被拉伸，从而减缓其动作。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 状态，持续1轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 状态，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} 状态，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Wanderer's Guide.name: 旅者向导 Wanderer's Guide
Wanderer's Guide.description:
你呼唤彼岸来指引你的路线。当你施放该法术时，选择一个目的地；你会获得一条通往该目的地的灵感路线，使你以及与你一同进行陆上旅行的盟友在持续时间内将来自困难地形的移动减值减半，只要你们不偏离这条灵感路线。此法术对遭遇中的移动没有任何效果。若你在持续时间结束前再次使用此能力，此效果结束，并被新路线的效果所取代。

You call upon the beyond to guide your route. When you Cast this Spell, choose a destination; you receive an inspired route to that destination, allowing you and allies who travel overland with you to reduce the movement penalty from difficult terrain by half for the duration, as long as you don't deviate from the inspired route. This doesn't have any effect on movement during encounters. If you use this ability again before the duration is over, this effect ends and is replaced by that of the new route.

Augury.name: 卜筮术 Augury
Augury.description:
你获得对未来的模糊一瞥。在施放该法术期间，询问某个特定行动方案的结果。该法术可以预测未来30分钟内的结果，并揭示GM对下列结果中最可能发生者的最佳猜测：

  • 顺遂 结果将会很好。
  • 厄运 结果将会很糟。
  • 顺遂与厄运 结果将好坏参半。
  • 无事 不会出现特别好或特别坏的结果。

GM进行一次秘密 @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]。在一次失败时，结果总是“无事”。这使得无法判断“无事”的结果是否准确。如果在额外的一次施放中，有人就与第一次施放卜筮术相同的主题进行询问，GM使用第一次施放的秘密掷骰结果。然而，如果情况发生改变，则有可能得到不同的结果。

You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes:

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results.

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（意志） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光线在区域内穿透或发散。光不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内时都不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也一样。该效果也会压制你黑暗术法术等级或更低的魔法光亮。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看到外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
当你施放该法术时，区域内的所有生物都会在持续时间内被你选择颜色的、无热的彩色火焰勾勒轮廓。可见的生物在受妖火术影响时不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。若这些生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态，则它们在受妖火术影响时为隐蔽，而非@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未被察觉}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

False Life.name: 虚假生命 False Life
False Life.description:
你从死灵法术能量中创造一股活力储备，获得等于6加上你的施法能力调整值数量的临时生命值。

强化（+1） 临时生命值增加3。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{法术效果：虚假生命}

You create a reservoir of vitality from necromantic energy, gaining a number of temporary Hit Points equal to 6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points increase by 3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Life}

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
披覆在幻术之中，目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未被察觉} 状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对他们而言改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐藏} 状态。若目标使用敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续 1 分钟，但若目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Paranoia.name: 狂乱偏执 Paranoia
Paranoia.description:
你使目标将所有其他生物都视为可怕的威胁。目标对周围所有生物产生强烈的狂乱偏执，必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标相信它看到的每个人都是潜在威胁。它对所有它原本并非敌对的生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{不友好}，即使那些先前是盟友的也一样。它不把任何人视为盟友。该法术在1轮后结束。

失败 同成功，但效果持续1分钟。

大成功或大失败 同失败，但目标相信它看到的每个人都是不共戴天的死敌。由GM决定，它会对所有人使用它的反应动作（）和自由动作（），不论他们先前是否为它的盟友。除此之外，它仍像平常一样理性行事，并且很可能更倾向于攻击那些正在攻击或阻碍它的生物，而不是那些对它置之不理的生物。

升阶（6环） 你可以指定最多5个生物为目标。

You cause the target to see all other creatures as dire threats. The target is stricken by intense paranoia toward all creatures around it and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target believes everyone it sees is a potential threat. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} to all creatures to which it wasn't already hostile, even those that were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally. The spell ends after 1 round.

Failure As success, but the effect lasts 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target believes that everyone it sees is a mortal enemy. It uses its reactions and free actions against everyone, regardless of whether they were previously its allies, as determined by the GM. It otherwise acts as rationally as it normally does and likely prefers to attack creatures that are actively attacking or hindering it over those leaving it alone.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 5 creatures.

Sound Burst.name: 音鸣爆 Sound Burst
Sound Burst.description:
一阵刺耳的噪音爆发而出，造成 2d10 音波伤害。每个生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并在 1 轮内处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，在 1 分钟内处于耳聋，并且处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is Deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Bless.name: 祝福术 Bless
Bless.description:
来自彼界的祝福帮助你的伙伴精准打击。你和你的盟友在该放射范围内时，攻击掷骰获得+1状态加值。从你施放祝福术后的下一回合开始，每回合一次，你可以使用一个具有专注（特征）的单动作，使该放射的半径增加5尺。

祝福术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{绝望术}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RfCEHpMoEAZvB9IZ]{光环：祝福术}

Blessings from beyond help your companions strike true. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls while within the emanation. Once per turn, starting the turn after you cast bless, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet.

Bless can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RfCEHpMoEAZvB9IZ]{Aura: Bless}

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入体内，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并扰乱不死生物，甚至可能使其逃离。效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物 该法术造成等于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但在大失败时还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} 1轮。
  • 不死生物 若强韧豁免失败，目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 1轮。若大失败，除非其成功进行一次意志豁免，否则目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 1轮。

升阶（+1） 对活体生物造成的虚空伤害增加1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你大喊一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标靠近你、逃离（如同其具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）} 状态）、放开其正拿着的东西、卧倒 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{俯卧}，或原地不动。在其服从你的命令之前，它不能延迟或进行任何反应动作（）。其效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在其下个回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须使用一个单动作来照你命令行事。

大成功或大失败 目标必须在其下个回合使用全部动作来服从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你可以以至多10个生物为目标。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光源，任意两个之间相距不超过10尺。每个都像火把一样照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光源移动至多60尺。每个光源必须保持在你120尺之内，并且与所有其他光源保持在10尺之内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智变得混乱，并以一次心灵震荡对其施加眩晕术。该震荡造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害提高 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你放出一道脉冲，用以确认周围是否存在魔法。你不会获得除魔法存在与否之外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你已完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。

只有当该魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到幻术系魔法。然而，带有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如一瓶隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环）你会得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若多个效果强度相同，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环）同3环，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的来源。类似于模糊感官，你不会得知精确位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体之内（若目标大于该范围，则缩小到最近的位置）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗的卷须从你的指尖蜷曲伸出，并在空中疾驰。你对线状范围内的活体生物造成2d4虚空伤害和@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]伤害。线状范围内的每个活体生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半的虚空伤害且不会受到持续性流血伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害。

大失败 该生物受到双倍虚空伤害和双倍持续性流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4，持续性流血伤害增加1。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Know Direction.name: 指北术 Know Direction
Know Direction.description:
在你的心眼中，你看到一条向北的路径。你立刻知道北方是哪个方向（如果在你当前位置存在北方）。

升阶（7环） 你可以改为知晓通往一个熟悉地点的方向，例如以前的家或常去的酒馆。

In your mind's eye, you see a path northward. You immediately know which direction is north (if it exists at your current location).

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a previous home or a favorite tavern.

Mending.name: 修复术 Mending
Mending.description:
你修复目标物品。你每个法术环阶为目标恢复5点生命值，这可能会在将其修复至超过该物品的破损阈值时移除 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} 破损（状态）。你无法替换遗失的部件，也无法修复已被完全摧毁的物体。

升阶（2环） 你可以以负载1或更低的非魔法物体为目标。

升阶（3环） 你可以以负载2或更低的非魔法物体为目标，或以负载1或更低的魔法物体为目标。

You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一道魔法力场护盾。这算作用了举起护盾动作，使你在直到你下个回合开始前的AC获得+1环境加值，但不需要用手。

当该法术处于效果中时，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡} 反应动作（）。该护盾具有硬度5。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，且你在10分钟内不能再次施放它。不同于普通的盾牌格挡，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）来对抗 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{力场弹幕} 法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾免疫}

升阶（3环） 该护盾具有硬度10。

升阶（5环） 该护盾具有硬度15。

升阶（7环） 该护盾具有硬度20。

升阶（9环） 该护盾具有硬度25。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Wand of Manifold Missiles (1st-Rank Spel.name: 连发飞弹魔杖（1环法术） Wand of Manifold Missiles (1st-Rank Spell)
Wand of Manifold Missiles (1st-Rank Spel.description:
这根魔杖的顶端雕刻着龙首，中段镶嵌着一颗抛光的金属球。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你以1环阶施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}。

在你施放该法术后，在你每个回合开始时，魔杖都会额外释放一枚或多枚飞弹，如同你施放了魔法飞弹的1动作版本。每次都选择目标。此效果持续1分钟，直到你不再持用该魔杖，或直到你试图再次启动该魔杖为止。

制作需求 提供一次施放适当环阶的魔法飞弹。

This wand features a carved dragon's head at its top and a polished metal sphere set in its midsection.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency Once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} at 1st rank.

After you cast the spell, an additional missile or missiles are released from the wand at the start of each of your turns, as though you cast the 1-action version of magic missile. Choose targets each time. This lasts for 1 minute, until you're no longer wielding the wand, or until you try to activate the wand again.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of magic missile of the appropriate rank.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status To All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对所有对抗精神的豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status To All Saves vs. Mental

Stone Defense.name: 岩石防御 Stone Defense
Stone Defense.description:
触发 一名敌人即将以钝击伤害或带有土（特征）的法术对洞窟先知造成伤害

效果 洞窟先知获得抗力10，以对抗触发的伤害。

Trigger An enemy is about to damage the cavern seer with bludgeoning damage or with a spell that has the earth trait

Effect The cavern seer gains resistance 10 against the triggering damage.

Cavern Distortion.name: 洞穴扭曲 Cavern Distortion
Cavern Distortion.description:
频率 每日一次

需求 洞窟先知在地下

效果 碎石和尘土从岩石中升起以阻碍视线。洞窟先知及其60尺内的盟友在1分钟内变为隐蔽。

这种隐蔽不能用于躲藏或潜行。

Frequency once per day

Requirements The cavern seer is underground

Effect Pebbles and dust rise from the stone to impede vision. The cavern seer and their allies within 60 feet become concealed for 1 minute.

This concealment can't be used to Hide or Sneak.

Underground Stride.name: 地底阔步 Underground Stride
Underground Stride.description:
洞窟先知在地下时无视困难地形。

The cavern seer ignores difficult terrain while underground.

Bhazrade.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Bright Walker.name: 光明行者 Bright Walker

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Bright Release.name: 光明爆发 Bright Release
Bright Release.description:
当一名光明行者被降至0生命值时，他们会在一阵光亮(术)的爆发中闪耀消逝，获得了死亡时被剥夺的炽烈终末。这团烈焰对处于@Template[emanation|distance:20]{20英尺}内的生物造成@Damage[10d6[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。

豁免失败的生物还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}1分钟（大成功或大失败中的大失败则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}1分钟）。

When a bright walker is reduced to 0 Hit Points, they flash out in a burst of light, obtaining the blazing end they were denied at death. This blaze deals @Damage[10d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save) to creatures within @Template[emanation|distance:20]{20 feet}.

Creatures who fail this save are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute on a critical failure).

Light Aura.name: 光亮灵光 Light Aura
Light Aura.description:
30尺。光明行者发出明亮光照。任何在光环中开始其回合的生物都必须尝试进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:24]豁免。

大成功或大失败成功 该生物获得24小时的暂时免疫。

成功 该生物在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}。

失败 该生物在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{失明}。

大成功或大失败失败 该生物失明1小时。

30 feet. The bright walker sheds bright light. Any creature that starts its turn in the aura must attempt at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The creature is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 hour.

Suppress Aura.name: 压制灵光 Suppress Aura
Suppress Aura.description:
光明行者压制其光亮灵光1轮，使其降低为昏暗光照中微弱、幽灵般的发光。

The bright walker suppresses their light aura for 1 round, reducing it to a faint, ghostly glow of dim light.

Landbound.name: 受缚于地 Landbound
Landbound.description:
光明行者不能飞到离地面超过 1 英尺的高度。如果他们飞得高于这个距离，他们会坠落，但不会因坠落而受到任何伤害。

A bright walker can't fly higher than 1 foot above the ground. If they fly higher than this distance, they fall but don't take any damage from falling.

Light Flare.name: 闪光 Light Flare
Light Flare.description:
需求 光明行者的光亮灵光被压制

效果 光明行者以一阵爆发性的强光重新点燃其光亮灵光，对位于一个 @Template[burst|distance:20] 内的生物造成 @Damage[5d6[fire]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] 豁免）。

处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 状态或具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{强光致盲} 的生物会觉得这道强光耀斑格外痛苦；此类生物的豁免结果比其掷出的结果低一级成功。

Requirement The bright walker's Light Aura is suppressed

Effect The bright walker reignites their Light Aura with a burst of brightness that deals @Damage[5d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save) to creatures within a @Template[burst|distance:20].

Creatures who are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} or with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{Light Blindness} find this flare particularly painful; such a creature's save result is one degree of success worse than the result it rolled.

Shadow Jump.name: 暗影跳跃 Shadow Jump
Shadow Jump.description:
需求 光明行者的光亮灵光被压制

效果 光明行者传送到其能看见的60英尺内一个方格，该方格不在明亮光照区域中。光明行者在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Shadow Jump]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用暗影跳跃。

Requirement The bright walker's Light Aura is suppressed

Effect The bright walker teleports to a square it can see within 60 feet that is not in an area of bright light. The bright walker can't use again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Shadow Jump]]{1d4 rounds}.

Bright Walker.publicNotes:
那些在遭遇中遇到卡利格尼斯的人很快就会明白，他们的死亡是燃尽而非失血而亡。有时，这种戏剧性的焚化会被剥夺，于是卡利格尼斯会以光明行者的形态复起。与卡利格尼斯社会紧密相连，这些生物并不理解它们的发光会伤害并驱斥活着的卡利格尼斯。尽管得名如此，这些不死生物并不会行走；相反，它们会漂浮在离地面几英寸的高度。

Those who encounter calignis quickly learn that their deaths involve burning out instead of bleeding out. At times, this dramatic immolation is denied to a caligni, so they arise as a bright walker. Tied to caligni society, these creatures don't understand that their glow damages and repels living calignis. Despite their name, these undead don't walk; they instead float a few inches above the ground.

Caligni Defender.name: 卡利格尼防御者 Caligni Defender
Caligni Defender.tokenName: 卡林吉防御者 Caligni Defender

Occult Innate Spells.name: 天赋异能秘法法术 Occult Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（意志） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一层黑暗的帷幕，阻止光线在该区域内穿透或散发。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源，例如火把或提灯，在区域内都不会散发任何光，即使其光照半径本应延伸至黑暗之外。这也会压制与你的黑暗术法术位阶相同或更低的魔法光亮(术)。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它如同一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括强效黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强透过黑暗看清。他们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Obscuring Mist (At Will).name: 隐雾术（随意） Obscuring Mist (At Will)
Obscuring Mist (At Will).description:
你召唤出一团雾云。雾中的所有生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，而雾外的所有生物对雾中的生物而言也变为隐蔽。你可以解消该云雾。

You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你放出一道脉冲，用以记录魔法的存在。你获得的信息仅限于魔法存在与否。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。

你只有在幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的阶位时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（第3）你会得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果同样强，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（第4）同第3等级，但你还会定位最高等级魔法的来源。如同模糊感官一样，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体之内（或若来源大于此，则缩小到最近的等效范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Chain Mail.name: 铁链甲 Chain Mail
Chain Mail.description:
一套锁子甲由若干件护甲组成，这些护甲由许多小金属环相互连接成保护性的网状结构。它通常包括一件链甲衫、护腿、一对臂甲和一顶头巾式护甲，共同保护身体的大部分部位。

A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.

Black Smear Poison.name: 黑涂毒 Black Smear Poison
Black Smear Poison.description:
许多幽影矮人使用一种由地下真菌调制的致残毒药。

豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:16|traits:alchemical,injury,poison]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害 且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 同阶段 1

阶段 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害，且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 2}（1 轮）

Many calignis use a debilitating poison crafted from subterranean fungi.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:16|traits:alchemical,injury,poison]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 As stage 1

Stage 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭的箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中通过一端的羽翎保持稳定，另一端装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Greater Darkvision.name: 高等黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Bravery.name: 英勇 Bravery
Bravery.description:
当卡利格尼防御者在对抗恐惧(术)效果的意志豁免中掷骰获得成功时，改为获得大成功或大失败。此外，每当他们获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧（状态）} 状态时，将其数值减少1。

When the caligni defender rolls a success on a Will save against a fear effect, they get a critical success instead. In addition, any time they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition, reduce its value by 1.

Death Flame.name: 死之白焰 Death Flame
Death Flame.description:
当卡利格尼防御者死亡时，他们的身体会在一道炽白的火焰闪光中燃烧殆尽。@Template[burst|distance:20]内的所有生物受到@Damage[6d10[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]豁免）。他们的道具和宝藏不受火焰影响，并会留在他们死亡之处堆成一堆。

When the caligni defender dies, their body combusts in a flash of white-hot flame. All creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:20] take @Damage[6d10[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save). Their gear and treasure are unaffected by the flames and are left in a pile where they died.

Shoulder to Shoulder.name: 肩并肩 Shoulder to Shoulder
Shoulder to Shoulder.description:
当与一个或多个他们能看见的防御者相邻时，该防御者用其打击造成额外2d6 伤害。

When adjacent to one or more defenders they can see, the defender deals an additional 2d6 damage with their Strikes.

Caligni Defender.prototypeToken: 卡林吉防御者 Caligni Defender

Calinth Narogblom.name: 卡林斯·纳罗格布洛姆 Calinth Narogblom
Calinth Narogblom.tokenName: 卡林斯·纳罗格布洛姆 Calinth Narogblom

Primal Prepared Spells.name: 原始准备法术 Primal Prepared Spells

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原初先天法术 Primal Innate Spells

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标目盲。效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。目标随后在1分钟内获得暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 状态，直到其下一回合开始。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大成功或大失败失败 目标永久目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

One with Stone.name: 与石为一 One with Stone
One with Stone.description:
你可以选择变成一块石头或与石头融合。处于变形状态时，你无法移动或影响石头外的任何事物，但只要所施放的法术不需要超出石头之外的效果线，你就可以施放法术。你可以解消此法术。

  • 与石头融合 该法术的持续时间为10分钟。施放该法术时，你必须接触一块体积足以容纳你与自身所有占有物的石头，否则法术会被扰乱。融合期间，你可以听见但无法看见石头外正在发生的事情。若你在其中时石头受到伤害，你会被从石头中排出并受到10d6伤害。魔法通行会将你排出而不造成伤害。若你在任何时候处于石头之外，法术结束。
  • 变成一块石头 该法术的持续时间为8小时。你变成一块大型石头。察觉检定无法揭示你的真实本质，但针对你的法术DC进行一次成功的自然或生存检定会揭示你看起来像是一块对该区域而言异常崭新的石头。处于此形态时，你可以使用你正常的感官观察你周围的一切。作为一块石头，你的AC为23，且只有状态加值、状态减值、环境加值与环境减值会影响你。你在反射豁免上掷出的任何成功与大成功或大失败都视为失败

You can either transform into a stone or merge with stone. While transformed, you can't move or affect anything outside the stone, but you can cast spells as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the stone. You can Dismiss this spell.

  • Merge with Stone The spell's duration is 10 minutes. While casting the spell, you must touch a stone with enough volume to fit you and your possessions or the spell is disrupted. While merged, you can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the stone. If the stone takes damage while you're inside it, you're expelled from the stone and take 10d6 damage. Magic passage expels you without dealing damage. The spell ends if you're ever outside the stone.
  • Turn into a Stone The spell's duration is 8 hours. You become a Large stone. Perception checks don't reveal your true nature, but a successful Nature or Survival check against your spell DC reveals that you appear to be a stone that is strangely new to the area. While in this form, you can observe everything around you, using your normal senses. As a stone, your AC is 23, and only status bonuses, status penalties, circumstance bonuses, and circumstance penalties affect you. Any successes and critical successes you roll on Reflex saves are failures

Acid Grip.name: 酸蚀之握 Acid Grip
Acid Grip.description:
一只短暂显现、带爪的手抓住目标，用魔法酸液灼烧它。目标根据其反射豁免承受2d8酸液伤害外加@Damage[floor(@item.level/2)d6[persistent,acid]]伤害。一名因该法术承受持续伤害的生物，其速度承受–10英尺的状态减值。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.6TGcfVyzzVHEo7ke]{法术效果：酸蚀抓握}

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害且不承受持续伤害，并且爪子将其朝你选择的方向移动至多5英尺。

失败 该生物承受全部伤害与持续伤害，并且爪子将其朝你选择的方向移动至多10英尺。

大失败 该生物承受双倍伤害与全部持续伤害，并且爪子将其朝你选择的方向移动至多20英尺。

升阶（+2） 初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸液伤害增加1d6。

An ephemeral, taloned hand grips the target, burning it with magical acid. The target takes 2d8 acid damage plus @Damage[floor(@item.level/2)d6[persistent,acid]] damage depending on its Reflex save. A creature taking persistent damage from this spell takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.6TGcfVyzzVHEo7ke]{Spell Effect: Acid Grip}

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and no persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 5 feet in a direction of your choice.

Failure The creature takes full damage and persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and full persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 20 feet in a direction of your choice.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

Deafness.name: 失聪 Deafness
Deafness.description:
目标失去听觉；它必须尝试一次强韧豁免。随后，目标获得持续 1 分钟的暂时免疫。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}，持续 1 轮。

失败 目标 Deafened，持续 10 分钟。

大失败 目标永久 Deafened。

The target loses hearing; it must attempt a Fortitude save. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Failure The target is Deafened for 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The target is Deafened permanently.

Gecko Grip.name: 壁虎攀附 Gecko Grip
Gecko Grip.description:
细小的附着毛发在生物的手脚上生长出来，使其几乎能在任何表面上找到支点。目标获得等同于其速度的攀爬速度。

强化（5环） 持续时间增加至1小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.qn7uO5Ih01yLJot7]{法术效果：壁虎之握}

Tiny clinging hairs sprout across the creature's hands and feet, offering purchase on nearly any surface. The target gains a climb Speed equal to its Speed.

Heightened (5th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.qn7uO5Ih01yLJot7]{Spell Effect: Gecko Grip}

Ant Haul.name: 负重术 Ant Haul
Ant Haul.description:
你强化目标的肌肉骨骼系统以承受更多重量。目标在变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{负担过重}之前，可以比正常多携带3点负载，最多可多携带6点负载。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.5yCL7InrJDHpaQjz]{法术效果：负重术}

You reinforce the target's musculoskeletal system to bear more weight. The target can carry 3 more Bulk than normal before becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} and up to a maximum of 6 more Bulk.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.5yCL7InrJDHpaQjz]{Spell Effect: Ant Haul}

Caustic Blast.name: 腐蚀爆破 Caustic Blast
Caustic Blast.description:
你掷出一大团酸液，它会立刻爆炸，喷溅附近的生物。区域内的生物受到 1d8 点酸蚀伤害，并进行一次基础反射豁免；若大失败，该生物还会受到 @Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]] 点伤害。

升阶 (+2) 初始伤害增加 1d8，并且在大失败时的持续伤害增加 1。

You fling a large glob of acid that immediately detonates, spraying nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take 1d8 acid damage with a basic Reflex save; on a critical failure, the creature also takes @Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a critical failure increases by 1.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你放出一道脉冲，登记魔法的存在。除魔法的存在与否外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。你仅在该魔法的效果阶位低于你的侦测魔法法术的阶位时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形术药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

强化（3环） 你得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的阶位或等级，由 GM 判定。

强化（4环） 同 3 环，但你还会锁定最高阶位魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但能将来源缩小到一个 5 尺立方体之内（若来源大于此范围，则缩小到最近的等效范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Ignition.name: 点燃 Ignition
Ignition.description:
你打一个响指并指向一个目标，目标开始闷燃。对目标的AC进行一次法术攻击掷骰，命中时造成2d4点火焰伤害。若目标在你的近战触及范围内，你可以选择用火焰进行一次近战法术攻击而非远程法术攻击，这会将该法术的所有伤害骰提升为d6。

大成功 目标受到双倍伤害并受到1d4点持续火焰伤害。

成功 目标受到全额伤害。

升阶 (+1) 初始伤害增加1d4，且大成功命中时的持续火焰伤害增加1d4。

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage (Melee)}

You snap your fingers and point at a target, which begins to smolder. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 2d4 fire damage on a hit. If the target is within your melee reach, you can choose to make a melee spell attack with the flame instead of a ranged spell attack, which increases all the spell's damage dice to d6s.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and 1d4 persistent fire damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d4 and the persistent fire damage on a critical hit increases by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage (Melee)}

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你制造一个幻觉，使目标看起来像另一只具有相同身体结构的生物，且身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）大致相近。该伪装通常足以隐藏其身份，但不足以冒充某个特定个体。该法术会改变其外貌与声音，但不会改变其举止。你可以改变其衣物与穿戴物品的外观，例如让其护甲看起来像一件连衣裙。手持物品不受影响，并且任何从该生物身上取下的穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装等同于为欺瞒的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{冒充}用途进行伪装准备；它无视目标在将自己伪装成与自身不同类生物时可能承受的任何环境减值，为防止他人看穿伪装的欺瞒检定提供+4状态加值，并允许目标在此类欺瞒检定中即使未受训也能将其等级加入检定。你可以解消此法术。

升阶（3环）目标可以显现为任何与其体型相同的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过该个体才能复制其外貌，并且必须听过其声音才能复制其声音。

升阶（4环）你可以以最多10个自愿生物为目标。若你以多个生物为目标，你可以为每个目标选择不同的伪装，但都不能冒充某个特定个体。你可以分别解消每个伪装或一并全部解消。

升阶（7环）同4环，但你可以选择能够冒充特定个体的伪装。你必须见过该个体才能复制其外貌，并且必须听过其声音才能复制其声音。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{法术效果：幻象伪装}

You create an illusion that causes the target to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise is typically good enough to hide their identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell changes their appearance and voice, but not mannerisms. You can change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties the target might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar creature, gives a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets the target add its level to such Deception checks even if untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The target can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 willing creatures. If you target multiple creatures, you can choose a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. You can Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but you can choose disguises that impersonate specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法会听从你的命令。只要你维持该法术，你就能施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹饪 冷却、加热或调味1磅的非生物材料。
  • 提起 缓慢将一个无人看管且负载为光亮负载或更低的物体抬离地面1英尺。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质制成。该物体看起来粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——它不能用作工具、武器或法器，也不能作为法术的耗费。
  • 整理 为一个负载为光亮负载或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏它。你可以用10轮的专注影响一个负载为1负载的物体，而更大的物体则需要每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或引发不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（除上述所注明者之外）仅在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心灵以感知魔法灵光。施放完成后，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何接受你关于该灵光建议的人，在该物品上进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法} 时获得+2环境加值。如果该物体是虚幻的，只有当该效果的阶位低于你的阅读灵光法术的阶位时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你可以以最多10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Thunderstrike.name: 雷霆打击 Thunderstrike
Thunderstrike.description:
你召下一条伴随雷鸣炸裂的闪电触须，对目标造成1d12电击伤害和1d4音波伤害，目标需进行一次基础反射豁免。穿着金属护甲或由金属构成的目标在其豁免上承受–1环境加值，且若被该法术造成伤害，则获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12电击以及1d4音波。

You call down a tendril of lightning that cracks with thunder, dealing 1d12 electricity damage and 1d4 sonic damage to the target with a basic Reflex save. A target wearing metal armor or made of metal takes a –1 circumstance bonus to its save, and if damaged by the spell is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 electricity and 1d4 sonic.

Ventriloquism.name: 腹语术 Ventriloquism
Ventriloquism.description:
每当你说话或用声音发出任何其他声响时，你可以让你的发声看起来来自60尺内的其他地方，并且在你发声时可以自由改变该表观位置。任何听到该声音的生物都可以尝试识破你的幻觉。

增幅（2环） 该法术的持续时间增加至1小时，并且你还可以改变你声音的语调、音质与其他性相。在生物能够尝试识破你的幻觉之前，它必须主动尝试一次察觉检定，或以其他方式使用动作与该声音互动。

Whenever you speak or make any other sound vocally, you can make your vocalization seem to originate from somewhere else within 60 feet, and you can change that apparent location freely as you vocalize. Any creature that hears the sound can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The spell's duration increases to 1 hour, and you can also change the tone, quality, and other aspects of your voice. Before a creature can attempt to disbelieve your illusion, it must actively attempt a Perception check or otherwise use actions to interact with the sound.

Hide Armor.name: 躲藏 护甲 Hide Armor
Hide Armor.description:
这种护甲由毛皮、坚韧的皮革以及有时模制的煮制皮革混合制成。其多层皮革结构提供防护，但由于笨重，会减慢穿戴者的行动并降低机动性。

A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

Primal Symbol.name: 原始符号 Primal Symbol
Primal Symbol.description:
原初施法者，尤其是德鲁伊，常常佩戴由天然材料制成的饰物来象征他们与自然的联系，例如编织植物制成的戒指、用动物部位制成的护符，或与德鲁伊教团或自然哲学相关的其他象征物。

Primal spellcasters, especially druids, often wear adornments of natural materials to symbolize their connection to nature, such as rings of woven plants, tokens made from animal parts, or other symbols related to a druidic order or nature philosophy.

Sling Bullets.name: 投石索弹丸 Sling Bullets
Sling Bullets.description:
这些是小型金属球，通常由铁或铅制成，设计用于作为投石索的弹药。

These are small metal balls, typically either iron or lead, designed to be used as ammunition in slings.

Scroll of Veil of Privacy (Rank 3).name: 隐私隐匿之纱卷轴（3环） Scroll of Veil of Privacy (Rank 3)
Scroll of Veil of Privacy (Rank 3).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{隐匿之纱}

从卷轴施法需要你一手持握卷轴，并以施法（行动）将其激活，所需动作数与该法术正常施放所需的动作数相同。

该法术必须出现在你的法术列表上。由于是你在施法，请使用你的法术攻击调整和法术DC。该法术也会获得与你的根源相应的特征（奥术、神圣、秘术或原初）。

任何实体成本都会在制作卷轴时提供，因此你从卷轴施法时无需再提供这些成本。如果该法术需要法器，你必须持有该法器才能从卷轴施法。

注：要制作特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料集或资料集浏览器拖入PC、NPC或战利品角色的物品栏中。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy}

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when casting from a scroll. If the spell requires a locus, you must have that locus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Calinth Narogblom.publicNotes:
影幽地侏儒岩卫遵循德鲁伊的教诲，并以通神术与幽暗地域的自然元素影响及其居民交流。

侏儒以富有创造力与好奇心而闻名。他们身高约3英尺，鲜明的个性与其天生鲜艳的发色与瞳色相得益彰。侏儒与其祖先的故乡——第一世界——有着天然的联系。他们渴望冒险与新体验，以对抗一种族裔范围的苦难——褪色症。那些无法继续做梦与创新的侏儒，会开始缓慢失去自己的色彩，并陷入深度抑郁。

侏儒中有一个著名的分支称为影幽地侏儒，他们通常拥有灰色或棕色、带有石质纹理的皮肤，以及稀薄的浅色头发或光秃的头顶。影幽地侏儒在幽暗地域数量最多，在那里他们被称作drathnelar。影幽地侏儒常将这些生理变化归因于一位侏儒神祇——被视为其族类之初的妮维·菱彩炫光（Nivi Rhombodazzle）。妮维原本是一名地表侏儒，她深入幽暗地域旅行，并在与矮人神祇托拉格（Torag）交换一颗特定宝石后，最终被奖赏为半神。妮维对褪色症免疫，而影幽地侏儒也往往对其免疫或具有抗性。

Umbral gnome rockwardens follow druidic teachings and commune with the natural elemental influences and denizens of the Darklands.

Gnomes are known for being creative and curious. They stand at around 3 feet tall, and their vivid personalities match their naturally vivid hair and eye color. Gnomes possess a natural connection to their ancestral home, the First World. They crave adventure and new experiences to fight off an ancestry-wide affliction known as the Bleaching. Gnomes who fail to dream and innovate begin to slowly lose their color and fall into a deep depression.

A notable subgroup of gnomes called umbral gnomes typically have gray or brown skin with a stony texture, and thin, pale hair or bald pates. Umbral gnomes are most numerous in the Darklands, where they go by the name drathnelar. Umbral gnomes often attribute these physical changes to the gnome deity regarded as the first of their kind, Nivi Rhombodazzle. Nivi was a surface gnome who traveled deep into the Darklands and was ultimately rewarded with demigodhood when she exchanged a particular gemstone with the dwarven deity, Torag. Nivi is immune to the Bleaching, and umbral gnomes are often immune or resistant to it as well.
Calinth Narogblom.prototypeToken: 卡林斯·纳罗格布洛姆 Calinth Narogblom

Cauthooj.name: 迷音鸟 Cauthooj

Thoughtsense (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 思维感知（不精确）60尺 Thoughtsense (Imprecise) 60 feet
Thoughtsense (Imprecise) 60 feet.description:
迷音鸟在所列射程内感知所有非无心智的生物。

The cauthooj senses all non-mindless creatures at the listed range.

Hop-Dodge.name: 跳闪 Hop-Dodge
Hop-Dodge.description:
触发 迷音鸟成为一次近战打击的目标，且与另一名敌人相邻，而该敌人也在这次近战打击的触及范围内。

效果 迷音鸟敏捷地跳到一旁，将触发的打击改为攻击相邻的敌人。迷音鸟以至多其速度的一半进行疾行，此次移动不会触发反应动作（）。

Trigger The cauthooj is the target of a melee Strike and is adjacent to another enemy that is also within the reach of the melee Strike.

Effect The cauthooj nimbly hops aside, redirecting the triggering Strike against the adjacent enemy. The cauthooj Strides up to half its Speed, and this movement does not trigger reactions.

Staccato Strike.name: 断奏打击 Staccato Strike
Staccato Strike.description:
通过对其歌声的音高与音调进行细微改变，迷音鸟以其颤音之歌引导一个生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 进行一次打击。这与其他困惑生物进行的打击相同，但迷音鸟选择目标。若触及或射程内没有目标，或该生物因任何其他原因无法进行打击，则该能力没有效果。

With subtle alterations in the pitch and tone of its song, the cauthooj directs one creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} by its Warbling Song to make a Strike. This works like other Strikes made by confused creatures, except that the cauthooj chooses the target. If no target is in reach or range, or the creature is unable to Strike for any other reason, this ability has no effect.

Warbling Song.name: 啭鸣之歌 Warbling Song
Warbling Song.description:
迷音鸟发出一种奇异、哀婉的啼叫，导致附近的生物失控般暴力抽打。每个在@Template[emanation|distance:120]内且能听见迷音鸟的生物都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:32]意志豁免以抵抗该效果。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响，并在1分钟内暂时免疫。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑术}，持续1轮。

大成功或大失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑术}，持续1轮，并立刻攻击自身（按困惑时攻击自身的正常方式进行）。此次打击不会使该生物获得进行纯骰检定以从困惑术中恢复的机会。

The cauthooj gives a strange, ululating cry that causes nearby creatures to lash out violently and without control. Each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:120] that can hear the cauthooj must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32] save to resist the effect.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round and immediately attacks itself (in the normal fashion for attacking oneself while confused). This Strike doesn't give the creature a flat check to recover from the confusion.

Cauthooj.publicNotes:
这些体型庞大、无法飞行的鸟类，尽管身体修长、跳跃般的步态笨拙，却出奇地敏捷。它们是独行的掠食者，会用催眠般的颤音歌声令猎物陷入狂乱，操纵它们互相攻击，让迷音鸟随后得以享用残骸。

一些学者称它们为“傀儡主鸟”，另一些则称之为“尖啸伯劳”。迷音鸟被大多数有智慧的人形生物广泛憎恶，部分原因在于它们似乎更偏好以人形生物为猎物。目击事件通常会促成狩猎队伍的组建，以在它再次杀戮前追踪并猎杀该生物；而那些想要狩猎的人往往会把耳朵塞满蜡，试图避免受到它尖鸣的影响。曾从该生物歌声中幸存的人报告称，那种经历令人不安到无以复加；几乎所有记述都一致认为，没有任何其他声音同样可怖。

尽管人们可能会以为迷音鸟只是缺乏智慧的动物，但这些生物比它们看起来更聪明。迷音鸟会在偏远聚居地的外围潜行徘徊，希望找到可供它们饱餐一顿的孤身旅者。它们甚至能听懂一些仙灵语中极其基础的词汇，尽管它们自身无法清晰地说话。这并不会阻止迷音鸟去模仿它所听见的声音；但当它这么做时，那股诡异的原始本性会强化这种尝试，进而引发这只鸟的标志性能能力：操纵心智、鼓动冲突——而迷音鸟勉强聪明到足以理解这一点，并且乐在其中

These large, flightless birds are deceptively agile, considering their long bodies and awkward, hopping gait. Solitary predators, they use their hypnotic warbling song to drive prey into a wild frenzy, manipulating them into attacking one another so that the cauthooj can then feast on the remains.

Known to some scholars as the puppet master bird, and to others as the shrill shrike, cauthoojs are widely reviled by most intelligent humanoids, in part because they seem to prefer humanoids as prey. Sightings typically lead to the creation of hunting parties to track the creature down before it can kill again, with would-be hunters typically stuffing their ears full of wax in an effort to avoid being affected by its cry. Those who have survived the creature's song report that the experience is uniquely unnerving, and almost all accounts agree that there is no other sound as terrible.

While one might assume the cauthooj is an unintelligent animal, these creatures are smarter than they look. Cauthoojs stalk the perimeter of remote settlements in hopes of finding a lone traveler they can feast upon. They can even understand a few rudimentary words in Fey, although they are incapable of clearly speaking themselves. This doesn't stop the cauthooj from attempting to mimic the sounds it hears, but when it does so, its eerie primal nature enhances the attempt, leading to the bird's signature ability to manipulate minds and encourage conflict, a trait the cauthooj is just barely smart enough to understand—and enjoy
