The dragon recharges its Breath Weapon whenever it scores a critical hit with a Strike

Ravirex.publicNotes:
作为沼泽、湿地、泥沼与泥炭沼地的嗜杀暴君，黑龙以炽烈的狂热恐吓它们的领域。它们欣然施虐，从深邃洞穴或沼泽中其他与世隔绝之处统治其恶臭的公国，兼用闪电般迅捷的突袭与诡计。它们对其他生物的憎恨如同其吐息般酸蚀，并且很少容忍哪怕同类的其他龙——除非为了交配，或暂时合作以击倒共同的敌人。

黑龙是两栖的——虽然它们呼吸空气，但鳃也使其能够在水下呼吸。它们的颈褶与鳍使其成为娴熟的游泳者，非常适应其湿地环境与水下巢穴。它们对因其腐化水体的魔法能力而产生的恶臭污水免疫。

黑龙的巢穴如同它们的灵魂一般污秽。地面散落着腐烂的肉块，被掠夺的宝藏沿着它们阴湿洞穴中的淤泥与黏液铺陈，周围尽是扭曲的根系与蔓生植物。这些地方常常爬满害虫、蛇与黏液怪。若有可能，它们会占据天然洞窟；否则便在沼泽中浓密而扭曲的植被区域里将就。黑龙的宝藏堆主要由宝石与昂贵的玻璃工艺品构成，因为质地更柔软的贵重物无法在巨龙酸蚀性的存在中幸存。

龙的类型繁多，从强大的位面龙到奇异的秘奥龙不一而足，但很少有龙的品类像五色龙那样广为人知且理所当然地令人畏惧。它们以鳞片的色泽区分，每一种颜色的龙都会释放其独有的嗜杀残酷——无论借助利爪、尖牙还是吐息——并且不同于大多数生物，龙只会随着年代增长而愈发强大。它们对宝藏、食物、流血与掌控的渴求已成传奇。它们体魄强横，自负亦相匹配；这些龙往往在道德上堕落，充当犯罪主脑、残暴暴君或贪婪的劫掠者。

Murderous tyrants of marshes, swamps, bogs, and fens, black dragons terrorize their domains with intense fervor. Gleefully sadistic, they rule their fetid principalities from a deep cave or otherwise isolated part of the swamp with a mix of lightning-quick raids and subterfuge. Their hatred for other creatures is as acidic as their breath weapons, and they rarely tolerate even other dragons of their kind-except perhaps to mate or temporarily collaborate to take down a mutual enemy.

Black dragons are amphibious-although they breathe air, their gills also allow them to breathe water. Their frills and fins make them accomplished swimmers, well suited to their wetland environments and submerged lairs. They're immune to the fetid water that comes as a result of their magical ability to corrupt water.

Black dragon lairs are as foul as their souls. The floors are littered with rotting meat, and plundered treasures line the muck and slime of their dank caves amid twisted roots and creepers. Such places are often crawling with pests, snakes, and slimes. Though they claim natural caverns when they can, they make do with areas of dense, twisted vegetation within a swamp. Black dragon treasure hoards primarily consist of gems and expensive glass work, as valuables of softer substance can't survive the dragon's acidic presence.

While there are many types of dragons, from the powerful planar dragons to the strange esoteric dragons, few dragon varieties are as well-known and as rightly feared as the chromatic dragons. Differentiated by the hue of their scales, each color of dragon unleashes its own flavor of murderous cruelty-be it by claw, tooth, or breath-and unlike most creatures, dragons only become more powerful as they age. Their lust for treasure, food, bloodshed, and control are legendary. Physically powerful with egos to match, these dragons are often morally depraved and act as criminal masterminds, vicious tyrants, or voracious raiders.
Ravirex.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Reaper Skull Puffball.name: 割颅尘菌 Reaper Skull Puffball
Reaper Skull Puffball.tokenName: 割颅尘菌 Reaper Skull Puffball

Motion Sense 60 feet.name: 动态感知 60 尺 Motion Sense 60 feet
Motion Sense 60 feet.description:
该怪物通过振动和空气移动来感知动作。

The monster senses motion through vibrations and air movement.

Spore Explosion.name: 孢子爆炸 Spore Explosion
Spore Explosion.description:
当割颅尘菌死亡时，它会爆炸，对@Template[emanation|distance:20]内的每个生物造成@Damage[8d8[poison]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] 豁免）。

豁免失败的生物会暴露于颅骨热疫。

When the reaper skull puffball dies, it explodes, dealing @Damage[8d8[poison]] damage to each creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save).

Creatures that fail their save are exposed to skull rot.

Paralysis.name: 麻痹 Paralysis
Paralysis.description:
被泡芙球的触须命中的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免，否则将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}。麻痹的生物可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免。

A creature hit by the puffball's tendril must succeed a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. The paralyzed creature can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns.

Skull Rot.name: 颅骨热疫 Skull Rot
Skull Rot.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:28]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] 伤害外加 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 2}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[2d8[poison]] 伤害外加虚弱 2和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drain 1}（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[3d8[poison]] 伤害外加虚弱 2和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drain 2}（[[/gmr 1d4 #Duration 颅骨热疫]]{1d4 轮}）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:28]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d8[poison]] damage plus enfeebled 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d8[poison]] damage plus enfeebled 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} ([[/gmr 1d4 #Duration Skull Rot]]{1d4 rounds})

Spore Cloud.name: 孢子云 Spore Cloud
Spore Cloud.description:
马勃释放出一个 @Template[cone|distance:30] 的孢子锥形区域，对锥形区域内的生物造成 @Damage[4d8[poison]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] 豁免）。

未通过此豁免的生物也会暴露于颅骨热疫。

The puffball releases a @Template[cone|distance:30] of spores that deals @Damage[4d8[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save) to creatures in the cone.

Creatures that fail this save are also exposed to skull rot.

Reaper Skull Puffball.publicNotes:
许多良性的马勃菌附着在幽暗地域洞窟中的森林地面残骸上。这些真菌的巨型版本更加灵活且危险。

当这种真菌侦测到猎物时，它的触须会扭动并分泌一种麻痹毒素。

Many benign puffball fungi cling to the detritus of forest floors in Darklands caverns. These fungi's giant versions are more mobile and dangerous.

When this fungus detects prey, its tendrils writhe and exude a paralytic toxin.
Reaper Skull Puffball.prototypeToken: 割颅尘菌 Reaper Skull Puffball

Riding Lizard.name: 骑乘蜥蜴 Riding Lizard

Intimidating Display.name: 威吓展示 Intimidating Display
Intimidating Display.description:
巨伞蜥进行【Stride】移动。如果它在该次【Stride】结束时相邻至少一个其他生物，它会突然展示色彩斑斓的颈部褶边并发出骇人的嘶鸣。每个相邻生物必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 意志豁免中成功，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}（若为大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}）。

随后，该生物对 Intimidating Display 获得 1 分钟的暂时免疫。

The giant frilled lizard Strides. If it ends that Stride adjacent to at least one other creature, it suddenly displays its colorful neck frills and issues a frightening hiss. Each adjacent creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure).

The creature is then temporarily immune to Intimidating Display for 1 minute.

Riding Lizard.publicNotes:
栖息于温暖的热带森林与稀树草原之中，这些巨大的蜥蜴对毫无防备的旅人而言是致命威胁。巨伞蜥不在睡觉或潜行追猎时，便会一次在阳光下晒上数小时。探险者有时会误以为它们与龙类有关，原因在于它们的大型（体型）、华丽的颈部褶边（在展示攻击性与支配地位时展开，可能被误认成翅膀），以及用来吓退那些大到无法吞食的生物的凶猛嘶嘶叫声。

巨伞蜥的主要食物来源是体型过大的节肢动物与其他无脊椎动物，但它也不会犹豫用脊椎动物来补充饮食，包括其他蜥蜴、猴子，以及几乎任何它能塞进嘴里的东西——甚至类人生物。尽管能够在短时间内爆发速度，巨伞蜥在狩猎时通常会一动不动地躺着，希望伏击猎物。

蜥蜴的外观与能力差异很大，但大多数都有基本的爬行动物体型——长尾巴、宽大的利齿嘴与四条腿。虽然有少数物种能在短暂的时代内以两条腿移动，但大多数严格以四足行走。此处展示的三个物种代表了更大型物种中最常见、也最为人熟知的种类。

Found in warm and tropical forests and savannas, these immense lizards are a deadly threat to the unsuspecting traveler. When they aren't sleeping or stalking prey, giant frilled lizards bask in the sunlight for hours at a time. Explorers sometimes mistakenly think they are related to dragons due to their large size, elaborate neck frills (which, when displayed in a show of aggression and dominance, can be mistaken for wings), and ferocious hissing vocalizations used to frighten away creatures too large to eat.

A giant frilled lizard's primary food sources are oversized arthropods and other invertebrates, but it won't hesitate to augment its diet with vertebrates, including other lizards, monkeys, and just about anything it can fit into its mouth—even humanoids. Although capable of short bursts of speed, a giant frilled lizard normally lies perfectly still while hunting, hoping to ambush its prey.

Lizards have a wide range of appearances and abilities, but most share a basic reptilian shape—long tails, wide toothy mouths, and four legs. While a few species are capable of movement on two legs for short periods of time, most are strictly quadrupedal. The three species presented here represent the most common and well-known of the larger species.

Rikizlia.name: 里基兹利亚 Rikizlia

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你制造一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光线穿透或在区域内发出。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源，例如火把或提灯，在区域内时都不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外亦是如此。这也会压制你黑暗术的环阶或更低环阶的魔法光亮。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

强化（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括强效黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时位于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的多彩、无热火焰勾勒出轮廓。受妖火术影响时，可见的生物不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽} 状态。如果这些生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形} 状态，则在受妖火术影响时它们处于隐蔽状态，而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮(术)，彼此之间任意两者相距不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样散发光亮。当你维持法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮(术)移动至多60英尺。每个光亮(术)必须保持在你120英尺以内，并且与所有其他光亮(术)保持在10英尺以内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
有时也被称为锁子长衫，这是一件由与链甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。然而，它比链甲轻得多，并且仅保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭的箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中由一端的箭羽稳定，另一端则装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗精神效果的所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Deft Evasion.name: 灵巧反射 Deft Evasion
Deft Evasion.description:
当猎人进行反射豁免掷骰并获得成功时，他们改为获得大成功。

When the hunter rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead.

Hunter's Wound.name: 猎手之伤 Hunter's Wound
Hunter's Wound.description:
频率 每轮一次

先决条件 猎人正持用一把装填为0的远程武器

效果 猎人对其猎物进行两次远程打击。若两次攻击均命中并造成伤害，则目标额外受到 @Damage[1d8[bleed]]。

Frequency once per round

Prerequisites The hunter is wielding a ranged weapon with a reload of 0

Effect The hunter makes two ranged Strikes against their prey. If both hit and deal damage, the target takes an additional @Damage[1d8[bleed]].

Skirmish Strike.name: 快速战斗 Skirmish Strike
Skirmish Strike.description:
猎人可以先迈步再打击，或先打击再迈步。

The hunter can Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.

Rikizlia.publicNotes:
猎人会去寻找猎物，以维持卓尔社群的供给与运转。

由于在其主要聚居地中崇拜恶魔，卓尔因此背负邪恶的名声。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主的阴险影响时更是如此。

Hunters seek out game to keep drow communities fed and functioning.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Rikizlia.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Salaisa Malthulas.name: 萨莱莎·马尔苏拉斯 Salaisa Malthulas
Salaisa Malthulas.tokenName: 萨莱莎·马尔苏拉斯 Salaisa Malthulas

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光线在该区域内穿透或发散。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在该区域内也不会发散任何光线，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也一样。这也会压制你黑暗术法术环阶或更低环阶的魔法光亮(术)。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一团纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时在区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的、无热的彩色火焰勾勒出轮廓。受妖火术影响的可见生物不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。如果这些生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态，则在受妖火术影响期间它们处于隐蔽状态，而非处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未探明}状态。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光源，彼此之间任意两盏相距不超过10尺。每个都如同火把般照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光源移动至多60尺。每个光源必须保持在距你120尺以内且与所有其他光源相距不超过10尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

+1 Striking Corrosive Longsword.name: +1 强袭蚀刻长剑 +1 Striking Corrosive Longsword
+1 Striking Corrosive Longsword.description:
长剑可以是单刃或双刃的剑。它们的剑身厚重，长度在3到4英尺之间。

Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 feet in length.

Breastplate.name: 胸甲 Breastplate
Breastplate.description:
虽然被称为胸甲，但这种护甲由数块板甲或半身板甲组成，保护躯干、胸部、颈部，有时还包括髋部和小腿。它策略性地提供了部分板甲的防护，同时允许更高的灵活性和速度。

Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or half-plate armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

Salaisa's Key.name: 萨莱莎的钥匙 Salaisa's Key

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Stupor Poison.name: 迷梦毒 Stupor Poison
Stupor Poison.description:
迷梦毒是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{昏睡毒}更为强效的蒸馏物。进一步暴露于迷梦毒不需要目标进行额外的豁免投掷；只有在对持续暴露的豁免投掷失败时，才会使其阶段推进。

豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:alchemical,incapacitation,injury,poison,sleep]

最大持续时间 6小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}（1轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 2}与措手不及（1轮）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷}，无法通过察觉检定醒来（1轮）

阶段 4 昏迷，无法通过察觉检定醒来（[[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6小时}）

Stupor poison is a more potent distillation of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison}. Further exposure to stupor poison doesn't require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing a saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:alchemical,incapacitation,injury,poison,sleep]

Maximum Duration 6 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6 hours})

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对所有对抗魔法的豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status To All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对所有 豁免 检定获得+2状态加值（对抗精神） +2 Status To All Saves vs. Mental

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Attack Now!.name: 立即攻击！ Attack Now!
Attack Now!.description:
莎莱莎大喊，30英尺内一名能够看见或听见莎莱莎的卓尔盟友可以以反应动作进行一次近战或远程打击。

Salaisa shouts, and a drow ally within 30 feet that can see or hear Salaisa makes a melee or ranged Strike as a reaction.

Storm of Blades.name: 剑刃风暴 Storm of Blades
Storm of Blades.description:
萨莱莎以她的速度行进。她可以在此次移动的任意时点进行至多三次长剑打击，每次对触及内的不同目标。这些攻击计入她的多重攻击减值，但多重攻击减值直到她完成所有攻击后才会增加。如果她在剑刃风暴期间移动不超过她速度的一半，该移动不会触发反应动作（）。

Salaisa Strides up to her Speed. She can make up to three longsword Strikes at any point during this movement, each against a different target within reach. These attacks count toward her multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after she makes all of her attacks. If she moves half her speed or less during Storm of Blades, that movement doesn't trigger reactions.

地鼠怪可以像在泥土或松散碎石中一样，钻掘进坚实岩石以及任何硬度低于精金的金属，留下一个直径10英尺的隧道。

Shulns can burrow into solid rock and any metal with a hardness less than that of adamantine like it is soil or loose rubble, leaving a tunnel 10 feet in diameter.

Shuln.publicNotes:
作为幽暗地域上层的天灾，这些巨大的类鼹怪诞物凭借粗壮的前臂与堪比精金坚硬的利爪，能够劈开并掘穿坚实的岩石。地鼠怪可长至约20英尺，拥有四只微小到几乎难以察觉的眼睛；一条修长、苍白的口鼻部；四条肌肉粗壮的腿，末端是又长又带锯齿的爪；以及一截短粗的粉色尾巴。随着幼年地鼠怪成熟，其独特的新陈代谢会生成精金，并逐渐渗入其整个骨骼系统。除了让它们的利爪与獠牙几乎无法折断外，这种独特的生理特征还使地鼠怪成为无与伦比的掘洞者，并令其在希望从尸体中采收珍贵材料的怪物猎人中备受追捧。

地鼠怪食欲极其旺盛，几乎吃掉任何它们能抓到的东西，但其偏好的食谱几乎完全由大型无脊椎动物组成，尤其是洞穴蠕虫。它们依靠覆盖口鼻部的微小感知触须，在不使用视觉的情况下侦测空气与地面中细微的移动。当它们探测到合适的猎物时，地鼠怪会在第一时间咬住其目标，将唾液中强效的麻痹毒素注入其中。这种毒素强到甚至足以制服几乎不可阻挡的洞穴蠕虫，使地鼠怪成为任何深入幽暗地域蠕虫成灾地区进行远行者的宝贵（但危险的）同伴。地鼠怪以脾气暴躁闻名，再加上它们总爱把洞挖到地下聚居地中本不该挖掘的区域，这让它们成为令人沮丧的饲养对象；但当另一种选择是某次无法预测却致命的、来自巨大饥饿洞穴蠕虫的造访时，这些烦恼完全值得。

在土位面与体型大得多的类地鼠怪实体的遭遇表明，这些生物可能起源于那里。更大的地鼠怪仍保留其元素特质，聪明得多，并拥有一整套以土为主题的天生原初法术——但即便如此，它们仍然钟爱洞穴蠕虫的滋味。

Scourges of the upper Darklands, these enormous, mole-like monstrosities slice and burrow through solid stone with massive forearms and adamantine-strong claws. Shulns grow to about 20 feet long and have four tiny, nearly imperceptible eyes; a long, pale snout; four thick-muscled legs that end in long, serrated claws; and a stubby pink tail. As a young shuln matures, its unique metabolism produces adamantine that becomes infused throughout its skeletal system. In addition to making their claws and fangs nearly unbreakable, this unique physiological trait makes shulns unparalleled burrowers and highly sought by monster hunters who hope to harvest the precious material from their corpses.

Shulns have a ravenous appetite and eat nearly anything they can catch, but their preferred diet consists almost entirely of large invertebrates, especially cave worms. They rely on tiny sensory whiskers that cover their snouts and allow them to detect subtle movements in the air and ground without the use of vision. When they detect suitable prey, shulns bite their target at the first opportunity, injecting it with a potent paralytic toxin present in their saliva. So strong is this poison that it's capable of subduing even the near-unstoppable cave worm, making shulns a valuable (if dangerous) companion to anyone making excursions into worm-infested regions of the Darklands. Shulns' notoriously ill-tempered dispositions and their knack for digging into areas of an underground settlement where digging ought not to occur make them frustrating creatures to keep around, but when the alternative is an unpredictable but deadly visit from an enormous, hungry cave worm, the annoyances are well worth the trouble.

Encounters with much larger shuln-like entities on the Plane of Earth suggest that these creatures may have originated from there. The larger shulns still retain their elemental qualities, are quite a bit smarter, and have their own suite of earth-themed innate primal spells—but for all that, they still love the taste of cave worm.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光线穿透或在该区域内发散。光线不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源（例如火把或提灯）在该区域内时都不会发出任何光，即使它们的照明半径本应延伸到黑暗之外。这也会压制你黑暗术的环位或更低环位的魔法光亮(术)。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外面看，它如同一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括强效黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时位于区域内的所有生物，都会在持续时间内被你选择颜色的缤纷、无热的火焰勾勒。受妖火术影响时，可见的生物不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。如果这些生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形} 状态，那么在受妖火术影响时它们处于 Concealed 状态，而不是 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光源，彼此之间任意两个相距不超过10尺。每个光源都像火把一样照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光源移动至多60尺。每个光源必须保持在你120尺内，并且与所有其他光源之间不超过10尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Chain Mail.name: 铁链甲 Chain Mail
Chain Mail.description:
一套锁子甲由若干件护甲组成，这些护甲由相互连接的小金属环编织成保护性的网状结构。它通常包括一件链甲衫、护腿、一对护臂和一顶头套，合起来能保护身体的大部分部位。

A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.

Bolts.name: 弩箭 Bolts
Bolts.description:

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Taklitur.publicNotes:
卫士守望着卓尔营地，并且常常以小队行动。

由于在他们的主要聚居地中崇拜恶魔，卓尔以邪恶著称。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主阴险影响时。

Wardens watch over drow encampments and often work in small groups.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.

Stupor poison is a more potent distillation of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison}. Further exposure to stupor poison doesn't require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing a saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

Maximum Duration 6 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6 hours})

Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine.name: 连发手弩弹匣 Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对所有对抗精神效果的豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Shootist's Luck.name: 射手的幸运 Shootist's Luck
Shootist's Luck.description:
触发 神射手豁免失败

频率 每天一次

效果 神射手重骰该豁免并采用较好的结果。

Trigger The shootist fails a save

Frequency once per day

Effect The shootist rerolls the save and uses the better result.

Distracting Shot.name: 干扰射击 Distracting Shot
Distracting Shot.description:
枪手瞄准并进行一次远程打击。若该攻击命中并造成伤害，则目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 状态，持续至枪手回合结束；若为大成功或大失败，则持续至枪手下一回合结束。

The shootist takes aim and makes a ranged Strike. If the attack hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of the shootist's turn, or until the end of the shootist's next turn on a critical hit.

Reloading Trick.name: 装填诀窍 Reloading Trick
Reloading Trick.description:
需求 枪手正持握一把未装填的连发手弩

效果 枪手使用【交互】为连发手弩装填并用其进行【打击】。

Requirements The shootist is holding an unloaded repeating hand crossbow

Effect The shootist Interacts to reload the repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it.

Shootist's Draw.name: 射手快拔 Shootist's Draw
Shootist's Draw.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 神射手进行交互来拔出一把连发手弩并以其进行打击，或以其所持有的一把已装填的连发手弩进行打击，然后进行交互将其收起。

Frequency once per round

Effect The shootist Interacts to draw a repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it, or Strikes with a loaded repeating hand crossbow they're holding then Interacts to stow it.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
神射手对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物造成额外2d6精准伤害。

The shootist deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Tanieth.publicNotes:
极少数专精于连发手弩命令术的卓尔，不仅因其技能而受人尊敬，也因其好运与趾高气扬的派头而受人尊敬。

由于在其主要聚居地崇拜恶魔，卓尔背负着邪恶的名声。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔也可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主阴险影响的时候。

The rare few drow who specialize in the repeating hand crossbow command respect not only for their skills but for their luck and swagger.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Tanieth.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Urdefhan Blood Mage.name: 透肌魔人血法师 Urdefhan Blood Mage
Urdefhan Blood Mage.tokenName: 透肌魔人血法师 Urdefhan Blood Mage

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 神秘自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Call The Blood.name: 唤血术 Call The Blood
Call The Blood.description:
随着一句咒语与一个手势，你使鲜血从目标的口中、鼻孔、耳朵或其他面部开口喷涌而出，并急速涌入你的口中。你对目标造成 8d4 虚空伤害。

如果目标受到伤害，它的血会流入你的口中。如果你是活体生物且没有虚空治疗，你将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。如果你是不死生物（或是活体但拥有虚空治疗），你可以选择要么获得等同于目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果后），并在 1 轮内陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{加速}；要么放弃这些临时生命值，并在 1 分钟内陷入加速。你只能用这个额外动作进行垫步、疾行或打击。你会在 1 分钟后失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d4。

With a word and gesture, you cause streams of blood to erupt from the target's mouth, nostrils, ears, or other facial openings and come rushing into your mouth. You deal 8d4 void damage to the target.

If the target takes damage, its blood flows into your mouth. If you're a living creature and don't have void healing, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}. If you're undead (or living but have void healing), you can choose to either gain temporary Hit Points equal to half of the void damage the target takes (after applying resistance and the like) and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round, or forgo the temporary Hit Points and become quickened for 1 minute. You can use this extra action only to Step, Stride, or Strike. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4.

Confusion.name: 困惑术 Confusion
Confusion.description:
你用奇异的冲动使你的目标陷入迷乱，导致其随机行动。其效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标语无伦次地胡言乱语，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}，持续1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免以结束该困惑术。

大失败 目标陷入Confused，持续1分钟，且无法通过豁免提前结束。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你立刻将自己以及你穿戴和持握的所有物品从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的、射程内的一处空旷空间中。若这会把另一名生物也带上——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器里搬运——该法术将失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的方位与距离即可。你暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Phantasmal Killer.name: 魅影杀手 Phantasmal Killer
Phantasmal Killer.description:
你为目标创造出一幅幻影，呈现出目标所能想象的最可怕的生物。只有该法术的目标能看见这名杀手，不过你能看见这道幻象在疾驰向前发动攻击时的模糊轮廓。杀手的效果基于目标的意志豁免结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到4d6点精神伤害，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标受到8d6点精神伤害，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大失败 目标惊恐至极，可能会死去。它必须尝试一次强韧豁免；若目标失败，则其死亡。在强韧豁免成功时，目标受到12d6点精神伤害，获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 直到其下个回合结束，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}。此效果具有失能（特征）。

升阶（+1） 在失败时伤害增加2d6，在大失败时伤害增加3d6。

You create a phantasmal image of the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target. Only the spell's target can see the killer, though you can see the vague shape of the illusion as it races forth to attack. The effect of the killer is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes 8d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is so afraid it might die. It must attempt a Fortitude save; if the target fails, it dies. On a successful Fortitude save, the target takes 12d6 mental damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}. This effect has the incapacitation trait.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and by 3d6 on a critical failure.

Haste.name: 加速术 Haste
Haste.description:
魔法赋予目标更快行动的力量。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷（状态）}状态，并且每轮只能将额外的动作用于打击与迈步动作。

升阶（7环） 你可以以多达6个生物为目标。

Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

Levitate.name: 浮空术 Levitate
Levitate.description:
你违抗重力，让目标施放浮空术，离地5英尺。于法术的持续时间内，你可以用一个带有专注（特征）的单动作，使目标向上或向下移动10英尺。因浮空术而漂浮在空中的生物，其攻击掷骰承受-2环境减值。漂浮的生物可以花费一个交互动作来稳定自身，并在其回合剩余时间内无视该减值。若目标邻接于一个固定的物体或足够稳固的地形，它可以通过攀爬（若表面为垂直，如墙壁）或匍匐（若表面为水平，如天花板）沿该表面移动。由GM决定哪些表面可以被攀爬或匍匐通过。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{法术效果：浮空术}

You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. For the duration of the spell, you can move the target up or down 10 feet with a single action, which has the concentrate trait. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你在目标的运动冲动离开其心智之前将其阻断，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹} 1轮。

大失败 目标麻痹4轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，将剩余持续时间减少1轮，或在大成功时完全结束该效果。

升阶（第7环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
你使 目标 周围的 时代 流动扩张，减缓其 动作。

大成功或大失败成功 目标 不受影响。

成功 目标 获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，持续 1 轮。

失败 目标 获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，持续 1 分钟。

大成功或大失败失败 目标 获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}，持续 1 分钟。

升阶（6环） 你可以以最多 10 个 生物 为 目标。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Vampiric Touch.name: 吸血鬼之触 Vampiric Touch
Vampiric Touch.description:
你的接触会从一个目标身上吸取生命精华来强化你自己。你对目标造成6d6虚空伤害。你获得等同于目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果之后）。1分钟后，你失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

高度强化（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你将一名濒死生物的生命之火掐灭。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。若此法术杀死了它，你获得10点临时HP，并在10分钟内，攻击掷骰与伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 数值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{法术效果：死亡丧钟}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你解开一个法术或效果背后的魔法。尝试一次反制检定对抗该目标。若你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品在10分钟内变为其类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。若该目标是神器或类似物品，你自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Ghoulish Cravings.name: 食腐渴望 Ghoulish Cravings
Ghoulish Cravings.description:
你接触目标，使其感染食尸鬼热，让饥饿侵蚀其身，并使其与活力能量的连接逐渐减弱；目标必须进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在阶段1感染食尸鬼热。

失败 目标在阶段2感染食尸鬼热。

大失败 目标在阶段3感染食尸鬼热。

食尸鬼热（疾病）；等级 3

阶段1 携带者，无不良效果（1天）

阶段2 3d8 虚空伤害，且该生物从所有治疗中恢复的生命值减半（1天）

阶段3 同阶段2（1天）

阶段4 3d8 虚空伤害，且该生物无法从治疗中获得任何益处（1天）

阶段5 同阶段4（1天）

阶段6 该生物死亡，并在下一个午夜作为食尸鬼（特征）复起

You touch the target to afflict it with ghoul fever, infesting it with hunger and a steadily decreasing connection to vitality energy; the target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 1.

Failure The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 2.

Critical Failure The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 3.

Ghoul Fever (disease); Level 3

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effects (1 day)

Stage 2 3d8 void damage and the creature regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 3d8 void damage and the creature gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 the creature dies and rises as a ghoul at the next midnight

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
笼罩在幻术之中，目标变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，从而使其对他们而言改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}状态。如果目标使用敌对动作，则在该敌对动作完成后法术结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但即使目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Touch of Idiocy.name: 愚者之触 Touch of Idiocy
Touch of Idiocy.description:
你使目标的心智迟钝；目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 2}。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 4}。

You dull the target's mind; the target must attempt a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}.

Bane.name: 绝望术 Bane
Bane.description:
你使敌人的心智充满怀疑。

区域内的敌人必须在意志豁免中成功，否则只要他们还在该区域内，就会在攻击掷骰上承受 -1 状态减值。

每回合一次，从你施放绝望术后的下一回合开始，你可以使用一个带有专注（特征）的单动作，将该放射的半径增加 5 尺，并迫使区域内尚未受影响的敌人再尝试一次豁免。

绝望术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{祝福术}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{法术效果：绝望术}

You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt.

Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a -1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area.

Once per turn, starting the turn after you cast bane, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入自身，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并使不死生物失去方向，甚至可能导致它们逃离。其效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物 该法术造成等于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但在大失败时，还会在1轮内获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1}。
  • 不死生物 在强韧豁免失败时，目标在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。在大失败时，目标还会在1轮内获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃窜}，除非它在一次意志豁免中成功。

升阶（+1） 对活体生物造成的虚空伤害增加1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智变得混乱，并用一次精神冲击令其陷入眩晕术。该冲击造成等同于你的施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，则其还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害提高 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Fear.name: 恐惧(术) Fear
Fear.description:
你在目标心中种下恐惧(术)；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以选择五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).name: 羽落术（随意）（仅自身） Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only)
Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).description:
触发 射程内的一名生物正在坠落

你令空气本身制止坠落。目标的坠落速度减缓为每轮60英尺，并且在该法术持续时间内的坠落距离在计算坠落伤害时不计入。如果目标在法术生效期间触地，它不会因坠落而受到任何伤害。目标一着地该法术立刻结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗术的卷须从你的指尖卷出并在空中疾驰。你对线内的活体生物造成2d4点虚空伤害以及@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]点伤害。线内的每个活体生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半的虚空伤害且不承受持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物承受全部伤害。

大失败 该生物承受双倍虚空伤害以及双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4，持续流血伤害增加1。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声默念词句，但它们不会从你口中说出，而是直接传到目标的耳中。其他人听不见你的话，听到的程度并不比你平常只动嘴型时更清楚；而目标却能像站在你身旁一样听清你的话。

目标可以以反应动作作出简短回应，或者如果他们愿意，也可以在其下个回合以自由动作回应，但他们必须能看见你且处于射程内才能这么做。若他们回应，他们的回应会像原本的传讯术一样，直接传到你的耳中。

高度强化（3环） 法术的射程提高至500尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you.

The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成2d4精神伤害和1d4持续精神伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害但不承受持续伤害，且法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害与持续伤害，且目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，持续伤害结束且法术结束。

大失败 同失败，但目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d4，持续伤害增加1d4。

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{缩放持续精神伤害}

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and 1d4 persistent mental damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，该生物进行一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功或大失败，则使用其豁免结果降低一个成功等级的结果。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法的力场护盾。这算作使用举起护盾动作，使你在下个回合开始前获得AC+1环境加值，但它不需要空出一只手来使用。

当法术处于效果期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}反应动作（）。该护盾具有硬度5。你在使用Shield Block后，法术结束，并且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。与普通的Shield Block不同，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）对抗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（3环） 护盾具有硬度10。

升阶（5环） 护盾具有硬度15。

升阶（7环） 护盾具有硬度20。

升阶（9环） 护盾具有硬度25。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个在射程内、散落且无人看管、负载为1或更少的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，则你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——视你掷出的物体而定——其数值等于1d6加上你的施法能力调整值。被掷出物品的任何特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功或大失败 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Greater Darkvision.name: 高等黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当透肌魔人死亡时，它的隐形血肉会迅速腐烂并升华为一股恶臭气体，充满尸体周围的 @Template[emanation|distance:5]。

当该区域内的生物血肉同样凝结并腐烂时，这股气体会对其造成 @Damage[8d6[void]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] 豁免）。

When an urdefhan dies, its invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around the body.

This gas deals @Damage[8d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] save).

Blood Offering.name: 鲜血驱能 Blood Offering
Blood Offering.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 血法师割伤自己并受到 @Damage[8[slashing]] 伤害。如果血法师的下一个动作是施法，则该动作不能被打断；并且如果该法术具有射程，血法师可以将该法术的射程增加30尺。

Frequency once per round

Effect The blood mage cuts themself and takes @Damage[8[slashing]] damage. If the blood mage's next action is to Cast a Spell, the action can't be disrupted, and if the spell has a range, the blood mage can increase that spell's range by 30 feet.

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 透肌魔人在其上一动作中用啃咬打击对一个生物造成了伤害

效果 透肌魔人保持接触，使该生物的血肉在伤口处变得半透明。透肌魔人从以下两个选项中选择其一，每个选项都需要进行一次强韧豁免。若啃咬打击是一次大成功或大失败，则该生物同时承受两种效果，并对两者使用相同的豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 @Check[fortitude|dc:26] 透肌魔人饮用该生物的一些鲜血。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[10[healing]] HP（或在大成功或大失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}，且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[20[healing]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力（死灵系）@Check[fortitude|dc:26|traits:necromancy] 透肌魔人抽取该生物的一部分生命精华。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}，持续1小时（或在大成功或大失败时获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}，持续1小时）。

Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on its last action

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The urdefhan chooses one of two options, each of which requires a fortitude save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood @Check[fortitude|dc:26] The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[20[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality (necromancy) @Check[fortitude|dc:26|traits:necromancy] The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Urdefhan Blood Mage.publicNotes:
作为玄秘力量的坚韧大师，透肌魔人血法师用自己的鲜血换取魔法伟力。伤痕累累的血法师在他们的同族透肌魔人中备受敬重，因为这表明他们在与诡异的玄秘赞助者进行的众多交易中幸存了下来。

透肌魔人是幽暗地域半透明皮肤的灾厄化身，他们是毫无怜悯的杀手，也是世界终结的步兵。

Hardened masters of occult power, urdefhan blood mages trade their blood for magical might. A heavily scarred blood mage is held in esteem by their fellow urdefhans, as it shows they have survived many bargains with eerie occult patrons.

Translucent-skinned scourges of the Darklands, urdefhans are remorseless killers and foot soldiers of the world's end.
Urdefhan Blood Mage.prototypeToken: 透肌魔人血法师 Urdefhan Blood Mage

Urdefhan Death Scout.name: 透肌魔人死亡斥候 Urdefhan Death Scout
Urdefhan Death Scout.tokenName: 透肌魔人死亡斥候 Urdefhan Death Scout

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你掐灭一名濒死生物的生命。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。如果这会杀死它，你获得10点临时HP，并在10分钟内获得+1状态加值于攻击与伤害掷骰。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 数值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{法术效果：死亡丧钟}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

Invisibility (Self Only).name: 隐形术（仅自身） Invisibility (Self Only)
Invisibility (Self Only).description:
幻术披覆之下，目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物而言为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉}，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对他们而言改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐藏}。如果目标使用敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续 1 分钟，但如果目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).name: 羽落术（意志）（仅自身） Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only)
Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).description:
触发 射程内的一名生物正在坠落

你令空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落速度减缓至每轮60尺，并且在法术持续时间内的坠落部分在计算坠落伤害时不计入。如果目标在法术生效期间落地，则不会因这次坠落而受到任何伤害。目标一落地，法术立即结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标尝试一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，则该生物尝试一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功或大失败，则使用其豁免结果差一级的结果。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Necrotic Bomb (Moderate).name: 暗蚀炸弹（中型） Necrotic Bomb (Moderate)
Necrotic Bomb (Moderate).description:
启动 1 打击

暗蚀炸弹将大多数人认为至多令人作呕、最坏则亵渎不洁的试剂混合在一起，在与空气接触时产生吸取生命的瘴气。暗蚀炸弹造成所列的虚空伤害与溅射伤害，并在大成功或大失败时使主要目标陷入恶心。此伤害仅会伤害活体生物。

你获得+1物品加值于攻击掷骰。

炸弹造成2d6虚空伤害与2点虚空溅射伤害。若大成功或大失败，目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

Activate 1 Strike

Necrotic bombs combine reagents most people consider disgusting at best and unholy at worst, creating a life-sucking miasma upon contact with air. A necrotic bomb deals the listed void damage and splash damage, and it sickens the primary target on a critical hit. This damage harms only living creatures.

You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

The bomb deals 2d6 void damage and 2 void splash damage. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Leather Armor.name: 皮革护甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
由柔韧与定型的煮制皮革混合制成，此类护甲既提供一定防护，又具备最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当一名透肌魔人死亡时，其隐形的血肉会迅速腐烂并升华成一股恶臭气体，充满尸体周围的@Template[emanation|distance:5]。

当该气体使此区域内的生物血肉也凝结并腐烂时，会造成@Damage[6d6[void]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic]豁免）。

When an urdefhan dies, its invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around the body.

This gas deals @Damage[6d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (@Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic] save).

Shauth Bite.name: 牙刃之噬 Shauth Bite
Shauth Bite.description:
死亡斥候使用牙刃时会额外造成 @Damage[1d6[bleed]] 伤害，并且可以通过魔法牙刃武器打击来使用其秽恶之啮。

The death scout deals an additional @Damage[1d6[bleed]] with shauth blades and can use their Wicked Bite through magical shauth weapon Strikes.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
死亡斥候对处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 状态的生物造成额外 2d6 精确伤害。

The death scout deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 透肌魔人在其上一动作中以一次啃咬打击对一个生物造成了伤害

效果 透肌魔人保持接触，使该生物的血肉在伤口处周围变得半透明。透肌魔人从以下两个选项中选择一个，每个选项都需要一次强韧豁免。若啃咬打击为大成功或大失败的重击，则该生物同时承受两种效果，并对两者使用相同的豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 @Check[fortitude|dc:24] 透肌魔人啜饮该生物的一些鲜血。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} 且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[5[healing]] HP（或在大成功或大失败的重失败时，其获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} 且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[10[healing]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力 (死灵术) @Check[fortitude|dc:24|traits:necromancy] 透肌魔人抽离该生物的一部分生命精粹。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} 持续1小时（或在大成功或大失败的重失败时获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} 持续1小时）。

Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on its last action

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The urdefhan chooses one of two options, each of which requires a fortitude save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood @Check[fortitude|dc:24] The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[5[healing]] HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality (necromancy) @Check[fortitude|dc:24|traits:necromancy] The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Urdefhan Death Scout.publicNotes:
死亡斥候受训成为其教团的间谍与刺客。其他透肌魔人鄙夷他们隐秘的手段，但无人能否认他们的成果。

作为幽暗地域的半透明皮肤天谴者，透肌魔人是无情的杀手，也是世界终末的步兵。

Death scouts train as spies and assassins for their cult. Other urdefhans scorn their stealthy methods, but none can argue with their results.

Translucent-skinned scourges of the Darklands, urdefhans are remorseless killers and foot soldiers of the world's end.
Urdefhan Death Scout.prototypeToken: 透肌魔人死亡斥候 Urdefhan Death Scout

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Death Knell.description:
你将一个濒死边缘的生物的生命熄灭。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。若这使其死亡，你获得10点临时HP，以及在10分钟内对攻击与伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值。

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

Chain Shirt.description:
这种护甲有时也被称为锁子甲袍，是由与链甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。然而，它比链甲轻得多，并且仅保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Shauth Seize.description:

从年幼年代起就接受使用奇异而强大的沙乌斯鞭训练的透肌魔人鞭笞者，宁死也不愿从战斗中撤退。

作为幽暗地域中皮肤半透明的鞭挞者，透肌魔人是无情的杀手，也是世界终结的步兵。

Trained from a young age with the strange and powerful shauth lashes, urdefhan lashers would rather die than retreat from combat.

Translucent-skinned scourges of the Darklands, urdefhans are remorseless killers and foot soldiers of the world's end.

Darkness.name: 黑暗 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你创造一片黑暗的帷幕，阻止光线在该区域内穿透或散发。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在区域内都不会散发任何光，即使其光照半径本应延伸至黑暗之外也是如此。这也会压制你施放的黑暗术的环级或更低环级的魔法光亮(术)。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你熄灭一名濒死边缘生物的生命。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。如果这杀死了它，你获得10点临时HP，以及对攻击和伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值，持续10分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 数值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{法术效果：死亡丧钟}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

False Life.name: 虚假生命 False Life
False Life.description:
你将死灵法术能量转化为一股生命力储备，获得等同于6加上你的施法能力调整值的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 临时生命值增加3点。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{法术效果：虚假生命}

You create a reservoir of vitality from necromantic energy, gaining a number of temporary Hit Points equal to 6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points increase by 3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Life}

Daemonic Pact.name: 邪魔契约 Daemonic Pact
Daemonic Pact.description:
你祈求末日荒原的力量赐予你一名邪魔的协助。你可以呼唤一名等级不超过邪魔契约法术环阶两倍的邪魔；或呼唤两名邪魔，其等级各自至少比法术环阶两倍低2；或呼唤三名邪魔，其等级各自至少比法术环阶两倍低3。

大成功或大失败你召唤出该邪魔或这些邪魔，且它们不要求任何回报便为你服务。

成功你召唤出该邪魔或这些邪魔，它们自愿为你服务，但要求以洒落的鲜血作为祭品（可以是另一名生物的，或你自己的）。

失败你未能召唤出任何邪魔。

大成功或大失败你未能召唤出任何邪魔，并且用于执行该仪式所需的自我牺牲使你陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{枯竭 1}（若法术环阶为5或更高，则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{枯竭 2}）。

You call upon the powers of Abaddon to grant you the assistance of a daemon. You call upon a daemon whose level can be no more than double daemonic pact's spell rank, two daemons whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three daemons whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success You conjure the daemon or daemons, and they require nothing in return for their service.

Success You conjure the daemon or daemons, who serve you willingly, but require a sacrifice in the form of spilled blood (either another creature's or your own).

Failure You don't conjure any daemons.

Critical Failure You don't conjure any daemons, and the self-sacrifice required to perform the ritual leaves you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} if the spell rank is 5 or higher).

Feather Fall (Self only).name: 羽落术（仅自身） Feather Fall (Self only)
Feather Fall (Self only).description:
触发 射程内的一名生物正在坠落

你令空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落速度减缓至每轮60尺，并且在法术持续时间内发生的坠落部分在计算坠落伤害时不计入。若目标在法术效果生效期间到达地面，则不会因这次坠落受到任何伤害。目标一落地，法术立即结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗的触须从你的指尖卷出，穿过空气疾驰。你对线中的活体生物造成2d4点虚空伤害和@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]点伤害。线中的每个活体生物都必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半的虚空伤害且不受到持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害。

大失败 该生物受到双倍虚空伤害和双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4点，持续流血伤害增加1点。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Harm.name: 伤害术 Harm
Harm.description:
你引导虚空能量来伤害活物或治疗亡灵。若目标为活体生物，你对其造成1d8点虚空伤害，并且它须进行一次基础强韧豁免。若目标为自愿的亡灵生物，你恢复等量生命值。你在施放此法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标、射程、区域及其他参数。

1 (姿势) 该法术的射程为接触。

2 (言语, 姿势) 该法术的射程为30尺。若你在治疗一名亡灵生物，使恢复的生命值增加8点。

3 (材料, 言语, 姿势) 你在30尺的散发内散布虚空能量。这会以区域内所有活体与亡灵生物为目标。

增幅（+1） 治疗或伤害的数值增加1d8，并且2动作版本的额外治疗增加8点。

You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (material, verbal, somatic) You disperse void energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道带有削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，则该生物进行一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你在攻击掷骰上大成功或大失败，则使用比其豁免结果差一级成功度的结果。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 3}。

A ray with the power to sap a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save in order to determine the spell's effect. If you critically succeed on your attack roll, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强化黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当一名透肌魔人死亡时，它的隐形血肉会迅速腐烂并升华为一股恶臭气体，充满尸体周围的 @Template[emanation|distance:5]。

这股气体会对该区域内的生物造成 @Damage[5d6[void]] 伤害，因为它们的血肉也随之凝结并腐烂（@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic] 豁免）。

When an urdefhan dies, its invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around the body.

This gas deals @Damage[5d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic] save).

Void Healing.name: 虚空 治疗 Void Healing

Stoke the Fervent.name: 点燃狂热 Stoke the Fervent
Stoke the Fervent.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 透肌魔人发出战吼，使其自身与盟友陷入狂热的疯狂之中。每个听到呼唤的盟友获得对攻击掷骰、伤害掷骰与豁免检定的+1状态加值，并对AC承受-1状态减值。受影响的盟友每轮必须使用至少1个动作进行一次打击，只要他们做得到（即便这意味着攻击一名盟友、物体或空气）。

此效果持续[[/gmr 2d4 #rounds]]{2d4轮}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.eE3FEpjk2HdZDzSA]{效果：激发狂热}

Frequency once per day

Effect The urdefhan lets out a battle cry, sending itself and its allies into a fanatical frenzy. Each ally that hears the call gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws, and takes a -1 status penalty to AC. Affected allies must use at least one of their actions to Strike each round, if they are able (even if it means attacking an ally, object, or thin air).

This lasts for [[/gmr 2d4 #rounds]]{2d4 rounds}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.eE3FEpjk2HdZDzSA]{Effect: Stoke the Fervent}

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 透肌魔人在其上一动作中用啃咬打击对一名生物造成了伤害

效果 透肌魔人保持接触，使该生物在伤口处周围的血肉变得半透明。透肌魔人从以下两个选项中选择其一，每个选项都需要一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:22] 豁免。若该啃咬打击为大成功，则该生物承受两种效果，并对两者使用相同的豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 透肌魔人饮用该生物的一些鲜血。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，且透肌魔人回复 @Damage[5[治疗]] HP（或在大失败时，其获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}，且透肌魔人回复 @Damage[ 10[治疗]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力 透肌魔人抽取该生物的一些生命精华。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}，持续1小时（或在大失败时获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}，持续1小时）。

Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on its last action

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The urdefhan chooses one of two options, each of which requires a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[5[healing]] HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[ 10[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Urdefhan Tormentor.publicNotes:
拥有神圣天赋的透肌魔人施法者无一例外都是恶魔族类的邪秽崇拜者，通常会选择末日荒原的末日四骑士之一作为他们的守护神祇。凭借他们的邪秽赋礼，这些透肌魔人折磨者会召唤恶魔投入战斗，并以亵渎魔法强化盟友，更倾向于待在后方而非直接投身战局。

Urdefhan spellcasters with a knack for the divine are invariably unholy worshippers of daemonkind, typically taking on one of Abaddon's Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse as their patron deity. With their unholy gifts, these urdefhan tormentors summon daemons into battle and bolster their allies with profane magic, preferring to stick to the sidelines rather than enter the fray directly.
Urdefhan Tormentor.prototypeToken: 透肌魔人折磨者 Urdefhan Tormentor
