Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这套皮制护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还会加装小型金属板，在保留皮制护甲大部分灵活性的同时，提供更强的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭的箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中由一端的羽翎保持稳定，另一端则带有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Greater Darkvision.name: 高等黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当一名透肌魔人死亡时，它的隐形血肉会迅速腐烂并升华为一股恶臭气体，充满尸体周围的一个@Template[emanation|distance:5]。

这股气体会对该区域内的生物造成@Damage[3d6[void]]伤害，因为它们的血肉也会凝结并腐烂（@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic]豁免）。

When an urdefhan dies, its invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around the body.

This gas deals @Damage[3d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save).

Ravenous Attack.name: 贪婪攻击 Ravenous Attack
Ravenous Attack.description:
透肌魔人对单一生物进行一次双叉剑打击和一次啃咬打击。它的多重攻击减值在两次攻击都完成后才会增加。

The urdefhan makes one rhoka sword Strike and one jaws Strike against a single creature. Its multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 透肌魔人在其上一动作中用一次啃咬打击对一名生物造成了伤害

效果 透肌魔人保持接触，使该生物伤口部位周围的血肉变得半透明。透肌魔人从以下两个选项中选择其一，每个选项都需要一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20] 豁免。若该次啃咬打击为大成功或大失败命中，则该生物同时承受两种效果，并对两者使用相同的豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 透肌魔人饮用该生物的一些鲜血。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[5[healing]] HP（或在大成功或大失败失败时，其获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}，且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[10[healing]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力 透肌魔人抽取该生物的一些生命精华。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}，持续1小时（或在大成功或大失败失败时，其获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}，持续1小时）。

Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on its last action

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The urdefhan chooses one of two options, each of which requires a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[5[healing]] HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Urdefhan Warrior.publicNotes:
从诞生的那一刻起，透肌魔人就为战争做好了准备。透肌魔人武者是在他们诡异的地下城市之外可能遭遇到的最不强大的透肌魔人之一。

From the moment they are born, urdefhans are prepared for war. Urdefhan warriors are among the least powerful urdefhans one might encounter outside of their eerie underground cities.
Urdefhan Warrior.prototypeToken: 透肌魔人战士 Urdefhan Warrior

Yrorix.name: 伊罗里克斯 Yrorix

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光线在区域内穿透或散发。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内都不会散发任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也是如此。这也会压制与你的黑暗术法术等级相同或更低的魔法光亮。光线无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外面看去，它呈现为一团纯粹的黑暗球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有暗视（但不包括高等暗视）的生物也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。他们将通过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时区域内的所有生物都会在持续时间内被你选择颜色的、无热的彩色火焰勾勒。受妖火术影响的可见生物不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。如果这些生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态，它们在受妖火术影响时为隐蔽，而不是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未被察觉}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮，其间任意两者相距不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样散发光亮。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮移动至多60英尺。每个光亮必须保持在距离你120英尺之内，并且与所有其他光亮相距不超过10英尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Repeating Hand Crossbow.name: 连发手弩 Repeating Hand Crossbow
Repeating Hand Crossbow.description:
弹匣装填的装填 2（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oJZe5rRitvioUgRh]{射手弹带}）

Reload 2 for magazine reload (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oJZe5rRitvioUgRh]{Shootist Bandolier})

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这件皮质护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还会加上小型金属板，在保有皮质护甲大部分灵活性的同时，提供更强的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Shootist Bandolier.name: 射手弹带 Shootist Bandolier
Shootist Bandolier.description:
这条皮质射手弹带在会随着拇指快速一拨而弹开的皮革口袋中可容纳多达三个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xk9bw9ccupAIx7xT]{连发手弩弹匣}。你将从该射手弹带为连发手弩弹匣进行装填所需的时间减少1，总计为2个动作。你一次只能穿戴一条射手弹带。

This leather bandolier holds up to three @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xk9bw9ccupAIx7xT]{Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazines} in leather pockets that pop open with the quick flick of a thumb. You reduce the reload time for a repeating hand crossbow magazine from the bandolier by 1, to a total of 2 actions. You can wear only one shootist bandolier at a time.

Stupor Poison.name: 迷梦毒 Stupor Poison
Stupor Poison.description:
启动 2 交互

迷梦毒是对 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{昏睡毒} 更强效的蒸馏物。进一步暴露于迷梦毒不需要目标进行额外的豁免；只有对持续暴露的豁免失败才会推进其阶段。

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

最大持续时间 6小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}（1轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 2} 和措手不及（1轮）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷}，且无法通过察觉检定醒来（1轮）

阶段 4 昏迷，且无法通过察觉检定醒来（[[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6 hours}）

Activate 2 Interact

Stupor poison is a more potent distillation of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison}. Further exposure to stupor poison doesn't require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing a saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

Maximum Duration 6 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6 hours})

Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine.name: 连发手弩弹匣 Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗精神效果的所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Shootist's Luck.name: 射手的幸运 Shootist's Luck
Shootist's Luck.description:
触发 枪手豁免失败

频率 每天一次

效果 枪手重骰该豁免并使用更好的结果。

Trigger The shootist fails a save

Frequency once per day

Effect The shootist rerolls the save and uses the better result.

Distracting Shot.name: 干扰射击 Distracting Shot
Distracting Shot.description:
射手瞄准并进行一次远程打击。若该攻击命中并造成伤害，则目标在射手的回合结束前处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态；若为大成功或大失败，则持续至射手下一个回合结束。

The shootist takes aim and makes a ranged Strike. If the attack hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of the shootist's turn, or until the end of the shootist's next turn on a critical hit.

Reloading Trick.name: 装填诀窍 Reloading Trick
Reloading Trick.description:
需求 射手正持有一把未装填的连发手弩

效果 射手进行【交互】以装填连发手弩并用其进行【打击】。

Requirements The shootist is holding an unloaded repeating hand crossbow

Effect The shootist Interacts to reload the repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it.

Shootist's Draw.name: 射手快拔 Shootist's Draw
Shootist's Draw.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 神射手进行交互动作以拔出一把连发手弩并用其进行打击，或用其所持的一把已装填的连发手弩进行打击，然后进行交互动作将其收起。

Frequency once per round

Effect The shootist Interacts to draw a repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it, or Strikes with a loaded repeating hand crossbow they're holding then Interacts to stow it.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
枪手对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物额外造成2d6精准伤害。

The shootist deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Yrorix.publicNotes:
极少数专精于连发手弩命令术的卓尔，不仅因其技能而受到尊敬，也因其运气与傲气而受人敬重。

由于在其主要聚居地崇拜恶魔，卓尔背负着邪恶的名声。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主的阴险影响时。

The rare few drow who specialize in the repeating hand crossbow command respect not only for their skills but for their luck and swagger.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Yrorix.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Blast Tumbler.name: 爆炸门闩 Blast Tumbler

Force Blast.name: 力场爆炸 Force Blast
Force Blast.description:
触发 一个非不死生物打开门，或在尝试解除或解除该符文时大失败

效果 一道来自锁具的力场以 @Template[cone|distance:30] 喷涌而出。锥形区域内的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic|options:area-effect] 豁免，否则受到 @Damage[8d12[force]|options:area-damage] 伤害。豁免失败者被推开10英尺，大失败者被推开20英尺并且获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}。

Trigger A non-undead creature opens the door or critically fails an attempt to disarm or dispel the rune

Effect A @Template[cone|distance:30] of force issues forth from the lock. Creatures within the cone must succeed a @Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic|options:area-effect] saving throw or take @Damage[8d12[force]|options:area-damage] damage. Those who fail the save are pushed 10 feet, and those who critically fail are pushed 20 feet and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Blast Tumbler.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:32|name:解除符文|traits:action:disable-a-device]（大师）以解除符文，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（5环；反制DC 28）以反制符文的魔法。

@Check[thievery|dc:32|name:Disarm the Rune|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) to disarm the rune, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the rune's magic.
Blast Tumbler.hazarddescription:
一个难以触及的符文被刻在锁的转子上。当门被晃动时，它会释放一道力场爆炸。

A hard-to-reach rune is placed on the lock's tumbler. It emits a blast of force when the door is jostled.
Blast Tumbler.reset:
符文在其触发后1分钟重置。

The rune resets 1 minute after it triggers.

Bottomless Pit.name: 无底深坑 Bottomless Pit

Infinite Pitfall.name: 无限陷坑 Infinite Pitfall
Infinite Pitfall.description:
触发 一名生物走到活板门上

效果 触发生物坠入并继续坠落，可能永远坠落。该生物可以尝试 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{抓住边缘} 以避免坠落。攀爬墙壁或抓住边缘的DC为26。坑内有许多可抓握处，因此坠落的生物每6秒可以再次尝试抓住边缘一次。若生物成功，它可以从该处开始攀爬出去（不过根据生物坠落的距离，这可能是一段非常漫长的攀爬）。由于生物会无尽坠落，它可以在坠落时休息，甚至准备法术，但在坠落时掉落的物品通常会永远遗失。

Trigger A creature walks onto the trapdoor

Effect The triggering creature falls in and continues to fall, potentially forever. That creature can try to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} to avoid falling. The DC to Climb the walls or Grab an Edge is 26. The pit contains many handholds, so the falling creature can try to Grab an Edge again every 6 seconds. If the creature succeeds, it can start to Climb out from that point (though it might be a very long climb, depending on how far the creature fell). Since the creature falls endlessly, it can rest and even prepare spells while falling, though items dropped while falling are usually lost forever.

Bottomless Pit.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:28|name:移除活板门|traits:action:disable-a-device] (trained) 以移除活板门

@Check[thievery|dc:28|name:Remove Trapdoor|traits:action:disable-a-device] (trained) to remove the trapdoor
Bottomless Pit.hazarddescription:
一扇铁制活板门掩蔽着一个无限深、边长10英尺的方形深坑。

An iron trapdoor covers an infinitely deep 10-foot-square pit.
Bottomless Pit.reset:
陷阱仍会使生物一旦掉入便永远坠落，但必须手动重置活板门，陷阱才会再次变为隐蔽。

The trap still causes creatures to fall forever if they fall in, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become Hidden again.
Bottomless Pit.stealthdetails:
（或在活板门失效或损坏时为 0）或侦测魔法

(or 0 if the trapdoor is disabled or broken) or detect magic

Daemonic Fog.name: 邪魔之雾 Daemonic Fog

Gnawing Fog.name: 啃咬之雾 Gnawing Fog
Gnawing Fog.description:
触发 一个生物穿过洞穴的中点（地图上的虚线）

效果 该危害对触发生物以及20英尺内所有其他非邪魔生物造成 @Damage[9d6[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] 豁免）。豁免大失败的生物会陷入困惑状态，持续[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}。

Trigger A creature crosses the cavern's midpoint (the dotted line on the map)

Effect The hazard deals @Damage[9d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save) to the triggering creature and all other non-fiend creatures within 20 feet. A creature that critically fails the saving throw is confused for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Daemonic Fog.disable:
@Check[survival|dc:28|name:扰乱迷雾]（专家）以在危害触发前扰乱迷雾，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（第5等级；反制DC 26）以反制该魔法。

@Check[survival|dc:28|name:Disrupt the Fog] (expert) to disrupt the fog before the hazard triggers or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (5th level; counteract DC 26) to counteract the magic.
Daemonic Fog.hazarddescription:
迷雾凝结成微小、啃噬的生物，在消散回雾气之前吞噬其中的所有人。

The fog solidifies into tiny, gnawing creatures that devour everyone within before fading back into mist.
Daemonic Fog.reset:
该危害会在一小时内重置，因为恶魔污渍会为雾气重新充能。

The hazard resets over the course of an hour as the daemonic stain reenergizes the fog.

Green Slime.name: 绿史莱姆 Green Slime

Dissolving Ambush.name: 溶解伏击 Dissolving Ambush
Dissolving Ambush.description:
触发 一名生物从史莱姆下方走过。

效果 绿史莱姆滴落到生物身上，试图将其溶解成富有营养的浆液。目标必须尝试一次 @Check[reflex|dc:28] 豁免。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标跳跃躲开，因此不受影响。

成功 少量史莱姆溅到目标身上。目标获得 drained 1。

失败 史莱姆落在其目标身上。目标获得 drained 1，且在史莱姆被移除前，每轮在其回合结束时该状态值增加1。若目标达到 drained 4，则其 drained 值下一次将要增加时，它死亡并坍塌成一滩营养浆液。覆盖在目标身上的史莱姆无法再通过生存检定被移除，且对史莱姆造成的伤害也会同时对目标造成（应用目标的免疫、弱点与抗力，而非绿史莱姆的）。

大成功或大失败 失败 史莱姆完全裹住其目标。其效果与失败相同，但目标立即获得 drained 2，1轮后变为 drained 4，并在2轮后死亡。

Trigger A creature walks beneath the slime.

Effect The green slime drops on top of the creature, attempting to dissolve it into a nutritious slurry. The target must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:28] save.

Critical Success The target leaps out of the way, and it is unaffected.

Success A small amount of the slime splashes onto the target. The target is drained 1.

Failure The slime lands on its target. The target is drained 1, and this condition value increases by 1 at the end of its turn each round until the slime is removed. If the target reaches drained 4, the next time its drained value would increase, it dies and collapses into a slurry of nutrients. A slime covering a target can no longer be removed through Survival checks, and damage dealt to the slime is also dealt to the target (applying the target's immunities, weaknesses, and resistances rather than those of the green slime).

Critical Failure The slime completely coats its target. This has the same effect as a failure, except the target is immediately drained 2, becomes drained 4 after 1 round, and dies after 2 rounds.

Green Slime.disable:
@Check[survival|dc:33|name:将黏液从天花板上剥离]（专家）检定，以小心地将黏液从天花板上剥离而不触碰到它

@Check[survival|dc:33|name:Peel the Slime Off the Ceiling] (expert) to carefully peel the slime off the ceiling without touching it
Green Slime.hazarddescription:
一层腐蚀性的绿色薄膜附着在上方的天花板上，注视着猎物从其下方经过。

A caustic green film clings to the ceiling above, watching for prey to pass beneath it.
Green Slime.reset:
1小时，在黏液怪饱餐一顿后，又缓慢地爬回天花板上

1 hour, as the slime feasts and then slowly creeps back up to the ceiling

Warhammer.name: +1 战锤 Warhammer
Warhammer.description:
这把武器拥有一根木制柄杆，末端是一颗巨大而沉重的金属锤头。锤头可能是单面或双面，但它始终能够施加强力的钝击打击。

This weapon has a wooden shaft ending in a large, heavy metal head. Thehead of the hammer might be single‑sided or double‑sided, but it's always capable of delivering powerful bludgeoning blows.

Battle Axe.name: 战斧 Battle Axe
Battle Axe.description:
这些斧头明确被设计为武器，而非工具。它们通常重量更轻，斧柄以金属箍或螺栓加固，且刃口更锋利，使其更适合砍断肢体而非木材。

These axes are designed explicitly as weapons, rather than tools. They typically weigh less, with a shaft reinforced with metal bands or bolts, and have a sharper blade, making them ideal for chopping limbs rather than wood.

+2 Resilient Chain Shirt.name: +2 强韧链甲衫 +2 Resilient Chain Shirt
+2 Resilient Chain Shirt.description:
有时也被称为锁子长衫，这是一件由与链甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。然而，它比链甲轻得多，并且只保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Feather Token (Swan Boat).name: 羽毛符记（天鹅船） Feather Token (Swan Boat)
Feather Token (Swan Boat).description:
每枚羽毛代币看起来都像是某种奇异鸟类的一根普通羽毛。羽毛的羽轴浸镀黄金，其上刻有一道奥术符文。启动羽毛代币会使其转化为另一件物体，随后便可像该物体一样正常使用。每根羽毛只能启动一次，其中大多数会永久变为其描述中的物品。

启动 A 交互

这根羽毛只能在被投掷进一大片水域（如湖泊或宽阔河流）时启动。它会转化为一艘天鹅形小船，最多可承载32个中型生物、8个大型生物或2个超大型生物。小船在水面上的移动速度为50英尺，持续1天。

Each feather token appears to be a simple feather from some exotic bird. The feather's shaft, dipped in gold, bears a single arcane rune. Activating a feather token causes it to transform into another object, which then can be used as normal for that object. Each feather can be activated only once, with most of them permanently becoming the item in their description.

Activate A Interact

This feather can be activated only when tossed into a large body of water, such as a lake or broad river. It transforms into a swan-shaped boat capable of carrying up to 32 Medium creatures, 8 Large creatures, or 2 Huge creatures. The boat moves on the water at a Speed of 50 feet, and lasts 1 day.

Armor Potency (+2).name: 护甲强效（+2） Armor Potency (+2)
Armor Potency (+2).description:
魔法结界会偏斜攻击。将护甲的物品加值对AC提高2。该护甲可以刻蚀两枚属性符文。

你可以将一套护甲上已刻蚀的护甲威能符文升级为更强的版本，将现有符文的数值提高到新符文的数值。你必须拥有更强符文的配方才能这么做，且升级的价格为两枚符文价格之间的差额。

制造需求 你在制造中为大师。

Magic wards deflect attacks. Increase the armor's item bonus to AC by 2. The armor can be etched with two property runes.

You can upgrade the armor potency rune already etched on a suit of armor to a stronger version, increasing the values of the existing rune to those of the new rune. You must have the formula of the stronger rune to do so, and the Price of the upgrade is the difference between the two runes' Prices.

Craft Requirements You are an master in Crafting.

Dagger.name: 匕首 Dagger
Dagger.description:
这种小型带刃武器可单手持握，用于在近身战斗中刺击生物。它也可以被投掷。

This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

Cloak of Elvenkind.name: 精灵披风 Cloak of Elvenkind
Cloak of Elvenkind.description:
这件精灵披风呈深绿色，带有宽大的兜帽，以金色饰边与在精灵文化中意义重大的符号刺绣装饰。这件精灵披风允许你将@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{幻音术}戏法作为奥术先天法术施放。

当你调整精灵披风的搭扣（一个交互动作）时，精灵披风会变形以与周围环境相匹配，并将你的声音压低，使你在隐匿检定中获得+1物品加值。

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.eeGWTG9ZAha4IIOY]{效果：精灵披风}

启动 D 交互

频率 每日一次

效果 你将兜帽拉起并获得@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{隐形术}的效果，其持续时间为该法术的正常持续时间，或直到你把兜帽放下（以先发生者为准）。如果你也穿着@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.T00Xa9aDwHxd60Zh]{精灵靴}，你可以每日启动此能力两次。

This cloak is deep green with a voluminous hood, embroidered with gold trim and symbols significant in elven culture. The cloak allows you to cast the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{Ghost Sound} cantrip as an arcane innate spell.

When you adjust the cloak's clasp (an Interact action), the cloak transforms to match the environment around you and muffles your sounds, granting you a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks.

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.eeGWTG9ZAha4IIOY]{Effect: Cloak of Elvenkind}

Activate D Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You draw the hood up and gain the effects of @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}, with the spell's normal duration or until you pull the hood back down, whichever comes first. If you're also wearing @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.T00Xa9aDwHxd60Zh]{Boots of Elvenkind} you can activate this ability twice per day.

Boots of Elvenkind.name: 精灵靴 Boots of Elvenkind
Boots of Elvenkind.description:
这些高筒尖头靴由柔软、有弹性的黑色或绿色皮革制成，并以金色饰边与扣带装饰。穿上后，这双靴子让你行动更为灵巧，使你在特技动作检定上获得+1物品加值。

启动 F 想象

频率 每小时一次

效果 直到你回合结束，你在地面移动时无视困难地形。若你穿着@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.MNBnZn0b80Q7yHJM]{精灵披风}，你还会在你的回合结束前获得+5尺状态加值到你的陆地速度。

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.88kqcDmsoAEddzUt]{效果：精灵靴}

These tall, pointed boots are made from soft, supple black or green leather and are decorated with trim and buckles of gold. When worn, the boots allow you to move more nimbly, granting you a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Activate F envision

Frequency once per hour

Effect Until the end of your turn, you ignore difficult terrain when moving on the ground. If you're wearing a @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.MNBnZn0b80Q7yHJM]{Cloak of Elvenkind}, you also gain a +5-foot status bonus to your land Speed until the end of your turn.

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.88kqcDmsoAEddzUt]{Effect: Boots of Elvenkind}

Ravirex's Hoard.name: 拉维雷克斯的宝藏 Ravirex's Hoard
Ravirex's Hoard.tokenName: 拉维雷克斯的宝藏 Ravirex's Hoard

Mace.name: 钉头锤 Mace
Mace.description:
钉头锤有着粗壮的柄和沉重的金属锤头，十分结实，使其挥用者能够打出强力的打击并使护甲凹陷。

With a stout haft and a heavy metal head, a mace is sturdy and allows its wielder to deliver powerful blows and dent armor.

Iron Medallion.name: 铁奖章 Iron Medallion
Iron Medallion.description:
Usage 固定于护甲

Activate F 构想

Trigger 你尝试对抗恐惧(术)效果进行一次意志豁免，但尚未掷骰

Requirements 你在意志豁免上具有大师熟练度，或拥有英勇职业特性

这枚小型徽章被制成护盾术的形状。当你启动它时，你在1分钟内获得对抗恐惧(术)的豁免+2状态加值。在该次触发的豁免中，若你的掷骰结果为失败，则改为成功；若结果为大失败，则改为失败。

Usage affixed to armor

Activate F Envision

Trigger You attempt a Will save against a fear effect but haven't rolled yet

Requirements You have master proficiency in Will saves or have the bravery class feature

This small medallion is shaped like a shield. When you activate it, you gain a +2 status bonus to saves against fear for 1 minute. On the triggering save, if the outcome of your roll is a failure, you get a success instead or if the outcome is a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

Mummified Bat.name: 木乃伊蝙蝠 Mummified Bat
Mummified Bat.description:
使用 固定于一把武器上

启动 A 命令术

需求 你在察觉中为大师

这枚护符是一具经魔法处理的微型蝙蝠尸体，被纸草捆缚。你启动蝙蝠时，所固定的武器会侦测你周遭的震动并引导你的感知。你获得战士职业专长 @Compendium[pf2e.feats-srd.y2XeMe1F18lIyo59]{Blind-Fight} 的好处，持续1分钟。

如果你拥有 Blind-Fight 专长，你获得不精确回声定位，射程为30尺，持续1分钟。这会使那些因为你无法看见而本应对你处于“未察觉”的生物，改为处于“隐匿”。

Usage affixed to a weapon

Activate A Command

Requirements You are a master in Perception

This talisman is the magically treated corpse of a tiny bat bound in papyrus. When you activate the bat, the affixed weapon detects vibrations around you and guides your perception. You gain the benefits of the fighter @Compendium[pf2e.feats-srd.y2XeMe1F18lIyo59]{Blind-Fight} class feat for 1 minute.

If you have the Blind-Fight feat, you gain imprecise echolocation with a range of 30 feet for 1 minute. This makes creatures that would be undetected by you because you can't see them hidden instead.

Scroll of Spirit Blast (Level 6).name: 灵魂冲击卷轴（等级 6） Scroll of Spirit Blast (Level 6)
Scroll of Spirit Blast (Level 6).description:
从卷轴施放法术需要你用一只手握住卷轴，并用对应法术正常动作数量的施法（行动）来启用它。

要从卷轴施放法术，该法术必须出现在你的法术列表上。因为施法的是你本人，使用你的法术攻击掷骰和法术DC。该法术也会获得与你的根源相应的特征（奥术、神圣、异能或原初）。

卷轴在制作时已提供任何实体的材料成分与花费，因此从卷轴施放法术时你不需要再提供它们。你必须将该法术所需的任何材料成分替换为姿势成分。若该法术需要法器，你必须持有该法器才能从卷轴施法。

注：要制作特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料库或资料库浏览器拖入PC、NPC或战利品角色的物品栏中。

@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.PHVHBbdHeQRfjLmE]

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

To Cast a Spell from a scroll, the spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack roll and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when Casting a Spell from a scroll. You must replace any required material component for that spell with a somatic component. If the spell requires a focus, you must have that focus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Ravirex's Hoard.prototypeToken: 拉维雷克斯的宝藏 Ravirex's Hoard

Urdefhan Tribute.name: 透肌魔人贡礼 Urdefhan Tribute
Urdefhan Tribute.tokenName: 透肌魔人贡礼 Urdefhan Tribute
Urdefhan Tribute.prototypeToken: 透肌魔人贡品 Urdefhan Tribute

Vault of Secrets.name: 秘密宝库 Vault of Secrets
Vault of Secrets.tokenName: 秘密宝库 Vault of Secrets

Ring of Lies.name: 谎言戒指 Ring of Lies
Ring of Lies.description:
这枚朴素的银戒指带着近乎油腻的光泽。佩戴这枚戒指时，你在欺瞒检定上获得+2物品加值。

启动 D 交互

效果 在佩戴戒指的那只手上打个响指，会使戒指对你施放@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.JyxTmqjYYn63V5LY]{Glibness}，且不会有任何法术被施放的视觉显现。

This plain silver ring has an almost oily sheen. While wearing the ring, you gain a +2 item bonus to Deception checks.

Activate D Interact

Effect Snapping your fingers on the hand that wears the ring causes the ring to cast @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.JyxTmqjYYn63V5LY]{Glibness} on you with no visual manifestations of a spell being cast.

Pendant of the Occult (Greater).name: 秘传吊坠（强效） Pendant of the Occult (Greater)
Pendant of the Occult (Greater).description:
这枚护身符是中空的，形状如一只不眨眼的眼睛。其空腔通常容纳某段神秘学文本的碎片。佩戴吊坠期间，你获得+2物品加值于神秘学检定，并且你可以将@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance}戏法作为奥术先天法术施放。

该吊坠可以被启动。

启动 10分钟（施法）

频率 每日一次

效果 你施放一个4环的@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.yM3KTTSAIHhyuP14]{Dream Message}法术。

This amulet is hollow and shaped in the form of an unblinking eye. Its cavity typically holds some fragment of occult text. While wearing the pendant, you gain a +2 item bonus to Occultism checks, and you can cast the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} cantrip as an occult innate spell.

The pendant can be activated.

Activate 10 minutes (Cast a Spell)

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast a 4th-level @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.yM3KTTSAIHhyuP14]{Dream Message} spell.

Fulcrum Lattice.name: 支点晶格 Fulcrum Lattice
Fulcrum Lattice.description:
这个银铜框架被塑造成能够从小到大依次固定四枚聚焦镜片，一枚在另一枚之后。它带有一个带槽的底座，可安装在支架上，例如灯塔灯笼中的那种支架。支点晶格专门被设计用来从小到大（乌木、绯红、赭黄、翡翠）容纳四枚支点镜片，并且当其处于任意支点镜片10英尺范围内时会发出轻微的嗡鸣。嵌入支点晶格中的一枚支点镜片不占负载；晶格自身仍为1负载，且可轻松携带。将镜片插入或从支点晶格中移除需要一个交互动作。

支点晶格引导与其连接的支点镜片的力量。当你握持支点晶格时，嵌入其中的镜片在用于启动其能力时被视为在你手中。当你使用支点晶格中的镜片进行一次近战法术攻击时，你使用晶格中任意镜片的最高近战法术攻击调整；或者如果更高，你也可以使用你以简易武器进行近战攻击的调整值。

This silver and copper framework is shaped to hold four focusing lenses, one behind the other, from smallest to largest. It has a socketed base to be mounted into a stand, such as that found in a lighthouse lantern. The Fulcrum Lattice was specifically designed to hold the four fulcrum lenses from smallest to largest (ebon, crimson, ochre, emerald), and it hums slightly while within 10 feet of any fulcrum lens. A fulcrum lens slotted into the Fulcrum Lattice has no Bulk; the lattice remains at 1 Bulk and can be carried easily. Inserting or removing a lens from the Fulcrum Lattice requires a single Interact action.

The Fulcrum Lattice channels the power of fulcrum lenses joined with it. While you hold the Fulcrum Lattice, lenses socketed into it are considered to be in your hand for the purpose of activating their abilities. When you make a melee spell attack with a lens in the Fulcrum Lattice, you use the highest melee spell attack modifier of any lens in the lattice, or you can use your melee attack modifier with simple weapons if it's greater.

Vault of Secrets.prototypeToken: 秘密宝库 Vault of Secrets

Healer's Gloves (Greater).name: 治疗者手套（高等） Healer's Gloves (Greater)
Healer's Gloves (Greater).description:
这副洁白干净的手套即使在缝合伤口或治疗其他病痛时也从不显露血迹。它给予你进行医学检定时+2物品加值。

启动 A 交互

频率 每日1次

效果 你可以抚慰一名自愿、活着且与你相邻的生物的伤口，使该生物恢复[[/r (4d6+15)[healing]]]{4d6+15生命值}。这是一个正能量治疗效果。你不能用此治疗伤害不死生物。

These clean, white gloves never show signs of blood, even when used to stitch up wounds or treat other ailments. They give you a +2 item bonus to Medicine checks.

Activate A Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You can soothe the wounds of a willing, living, adjacent creature, restoring [[/r (4d6+15)[healing]]]{4d6+15 Hit Points} to that creature. This is a positive healing effect. You can't harm undead with this healing.

Cloak of Elvenkind.name: 精灵披风 Cloak of Elvenkind
Cloak of Elvenkind.description:
这件披风为深绿色，带有宽大的兜帽，以金色饰边与在精灵文化中意义重大的符号刺绣装饰。披风使你能够以奥术先天法术施放@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{幻音术}戏法。

当你调整披风的搭扣（一个交互动作）时，披风会变形以匹配你周围的环境，并使你的声音变得低沉，给予你进行隐匿检定时 +1 物品加值。

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.eeGWTG9ZAha4IIOY]{效果：精灵披风}

启动 D 交互

频率 每日一次

效果 你拉起兜帽，获得@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{隐形术}的效果，其持续时间为该法术的正常持续时间，或直到你把兜帽放下为止，以先发生者为准。若你同时穿着 @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.T00Xa9aDwHxd60Zh]{精灵靴}，你可以每日启动此能力两次。

This cloak is deep green with a voluminous hood, embroidered with gold trim and symbols significant in elven culture. The cloak allows you to cast the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{Ghost Sound} cantrip as an arcane innate spell.

When you adjust the cloak's clasp (an Interact action), the cloak transforms to match the environment around you and muffles your sounds, granting you a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks.

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.eeGWTG9ZAha4IIOY]{Effect: Cloak of Elvenkind}

Activate D Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You draw the hood up and gain the effects of @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}, with the spell's normal duration or until you pull the hood back down, whichever comes first. If you're also wearing @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.T00Xa9aDwHxd60Zh]{Boots of Elvenkind} you can activate this ability twice per day.

Belcorra Haruvex.tokenName: 贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯 Belcorra Haruvex
