Legend Lore.name: 通晓传奇 Legend Lore
Legend Lore.description:
你试图了解关于某个特定主题的有用传说，该主题必须是一位重要人物、地点或物品。若该主题在场，将你的主要技能检定的成功度提高一级。若你在尝试该仪式之前对该主题只有模糊的信息，将你的主要技能检定的成功度降低一级。若你在场的主题几乎没有到底线信息，则这些调整值彼此抵消。

大成功 在仪式结束后的1小时里，你吟诵关于该主题的传说、故事与见闻。信息大多连贯，更侧重于较为准确或更有用的传说，而非随时代被夸大的那些。

成功 在仪式结束后的1小时里，你吟诵关于该主题的神秘传说、故事与见闻。它们为进一步调查提供有用信息，但通常不完整或晦涩难解。正如传说的本质，你很可能会得知多个彼此矛盾的版本。

失败 你未能了解任何有用的传说。

大失败 你的心智迷失于过去。除了进行呼吸与睡眠等必要行为外，你在1周内无法感知或回应当下的任何事物。然而，当你回归时，你可以将你的一项技能重训为一项基于你所不受控制地目睹的过去知识的学识，仿佛你花费了1周进行重训一般。

You attempt to learn useful legends about a particular subject, which must be an important person, place, or thing. If the subject is present, increase the degree of success of your primary skill check by one step. If you have only vague information about the subject before attempting the ritual, decrease the degree of success of your primary skill check by one step. These modifiers cancel each other out if you have a subject present with little to no baseline information.

Critical Success You recite legends, tales, and lore about the subject over the course of an hour after the ritual ends. The information is mostly coherent, emphasizing more accurate or useful legends over those exaggerated over time.

Success You recite mysterious legends, tales, and lore about the subject over the course of an hour after the ritual ends. These provide useful information for further inquiry but are generally incomplete or enigmatic. As is the nature of legends, you are likely to learn multiple contradictory versions.

Failure You fail to learn any useful legends.

Critical Failure Your mind becomes lost in the past. You can't sense or respond to anything in the present for 1 week except to perform necessities like breathing and sleeping. When you return, however, you can retrain one of your skills into a Lore based on the knowledge of the past you were uncontrollably viewing, as if you had spent 1 week retraining.

Teleportation Circle.name: 传送法阵 Teleportation Circle
Teleportation Circle.description:
你在地面上创造一个直径10英尺的圆环，其作为通往在仪式进行时决定之目的地的传送门。你将传送的目的地作为仪式的一部分进行指定。该目的地无法更改。目的地必须位于1,000英里以内，并与传送法阵处于同一位面。你必须能够通过其相对于你创造传送法阵地点的位置，以及目的地的外观（或其他识别特征）来精确辨识该地点。目的地也必须是一个直径10英尺且不与任何坚固结构重叠的圆环，但它可以是一个有害或危险的地点。

进行此仪式并尝试进行生存检定的次要施法者，可以位于目的地的精确地点，而非与你一同在起始点。如果次要施法者在目的地的检定成功，且你掷骰获得成功，则该仪式改为大成功或大失败中的大成功。

在圆环处于激活状态时，任何移动至完全处于圆环内的生物都会立刻被传送至目的地。不愿被传送的生物可以尝试进行一次意志豁免以抵抗该效果。若其仍留在圆环内，则该生物必须在其每个回合结束时再次尝试此豁免。

传送法阵通常仅为单向，不过你可以将成本加倍，使传送能够双向运作。

大成功或大失败中的大成功 你创造传送法阵，且其极为精确，不论传送距离多远。旅行者会准确抵达指定点。

成功 同大成功或大失败中的大成功，但传送法阵的目的地略有偏差，其偏离目标约为所传送距离的1%，最大偏离10英里。

失败 传送法阵无法运作。

大成功或大失败中的大失败 传送法阵的偏差极大。它会通往一个距离起始点大致相同的随机目的地，并且发生其他异常意外的概率大幅提高。

升阶（9环） 成本提高至2,000 gp，持续时间提高至1个月，且目的地可以是同一行星上的任何地点。

升阶（10环） 成本提高至10,000 gp，持续时间为无限，且目的地可以是同一行星上的任何地点。

You create a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground, which acts as a portal to a destination determined at the time of the ritual. You designate the destination of the teleportation as part of the ritual. This destination can't be changed. The destination must be a location within 1,000 miles and be on the same plane as the teleportation circle. You must be able to identify the location precisely both by its position relative to the location where you create the teleportation circle and by the destination's appearance (or other identifying features). The destination must also be a 10-foot-diameter circle that doesn't overlap with any solid structures, but it can be a place that is harmful or dangerous.

A secondary caster attempting a Survival check for this ritual can be located at the exact site of the destination, instead of with you at the point of origin. If the secondary succeeds at their check at the destination and you roll a success, the ritual is a critical success instead.

While the circle is active, any creature that moves to be fully within the circle is instantly teleported to the destination. A creature that is unwilling to be teleported can attempt a Will save to resist the effect. If it remains in the circle, the creature must attempt this save again at the end of each of its turns.

The teleportation circle normally goes only in one direction, though you can double the Cost to make the teleportation work in both directions.

Critical Success You create the teleportation circle, and it's extremely precise, regardless of the distance traveled. Travelers arrive exactly at the designated point.

Success As a critical success, but the destination of the teleportation circle is slightly inaccurate, and is off target by roughly 1 percent of the distance traveled, to a maximum of 10 miles off target.

Failure The teleportation circle doesn't function.

Critical Failure The teleportation circle is wildly inaccurate. It leads to a random destination roughly the same distance from the origin point, and the chances of some other unusual mishap are much greater.

Heightened (9th) The cost increases to 2,000 gp, the duration increases to 1 month, and the destination can be anywhere on the same planet.

Heightened (10th) The cost increases to 10,000 gp, the duration is unlimited, and the destination can be anywhere on the same planet.

Feeblemind.name: 弱智术 Feeblemind
Feeblemind.description:
你极大地削弱目标的心智能力。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。此诅咒的效果只能通过移除诅咒或其他以诅咒为目标的效果移除。

大成功或大失败成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在1轮内处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}。

失败 目标处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}，持续时间为无限。

大成功或大失败失败 目标的智力永久降低到低于动物的水平，并将其魅力、智力与感知调整值视为-5。它失去所有需要心智能力的职业能力，包括所有施法能力。如果目标是一名PC，它将成为由GM控制的NPC。

You drastically reduce the target's mental faculties. The target must attempt a Will save. The effects of this curse can be removed only through remove curse or another effect that targets curses.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} with an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure The target's intellect is permanently reduced below that of an animal, and it treats its Charisma, Intelligence, and Wisdom modifiers as -5. It loses all class abilities that require mental faculties, including all spellcasting. If the target is a PC, they become an NPC under the GM's control.

Phantasmal Calamity.name: 魅影灾祸 Phantasmal Calamity
Phantasmal Calamity.description:
末日毁灭的幻象充斥区域内每个生物的心智。该幻象造成11d6心灵伤害（基础意志豁免）。在大失败时，该生物还必须在一次反射豁免中成功，否则会相信自己被困住了（卡在裂缝里、漂流在海上，或其他与其幻象相符的命运）。如果它第二次豁免也失败，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑（状态）} 1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的意志豁免，并在成功时识破该幻术并从震慑（状态）中恢复。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a Reflex save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the Stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Planar Binding.name: 异界誓缚 Planar Binding
Planar Binding.description:
你召唤一个等级不高于异界誓缚仪式等级两倍的异界生物，并尝试与其讨价还价。尝试进行制作检定的次要施法者会绘制一个防护法阵，以防该异界生物在谈判期间发动攻击或离开；若该施法者失败或大成功或大失败，则不适用次要技能检定失败或大成功或大失败的通常效果，而是该异界生物可以选择攻击或离开，而非进行谈判。你也可以省略此步骤，从而无需进行制作检定，并得到相同结果（例如，你正在召唤一个你信任的善良异界生物）。若你对其使用任何敌对动作，或防护法阵被破坏，该生物同样可以攻击或离开。一旦法阵完成，你与各名次要施法者各自站到法阵边缘魔力汇聚的特定位置上。

你在结界之内召现该异界生物，并与其谈判达成协议，通常是让其为你执行一项任务以换取报酬。完全不想谈判的生物可以尝试进行一次意志豁免，以留在其本位面。多数善良与中立的异界生物觉得自己有比迎合凡人心血来潮更好的事情要做，因此会要求一份可观的赋礼，尤其当你的任务带来显著风险时。邪恶的异界生物更可能以较低成本接受交易，只要这能让它们在材料位面制造浩劫，或在过程中对世界施加邪恶。以钱计的价格通常范围从：为短期且简单的任务，支付相当于该生物等级的消耗品物品成本；到为说服该生物与你并肩作战，支付相当于该生物等级或更高的永久魔法物品。然而，有些异界生物可能想要钱以外的报酬，例如允许其对你施放一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Q690d3mw3TUrKX7E]{指使术}以履行未来某个未指明的恩惠，或通过一份地狱契约取得你灵魂的所有权。若在你陈述理由后的一段合理时间内无法达成协议，该异界生物可在任何时候返回其来处。

大成功或大失败 你召来该异界生物，并将其束缚在结界中，最长可达整整一天，之后它才会回家；你可能借由威胁要将其关在结界中一整天来谈到更好的条件。

成功 你召来该异界生物。

失败 你未能召来该异界生物。

大成功或大失败 你召来了某种黑暗而可怖之物，它不受你的结界束缚，并立刻尝试摧毁你。

You call forth an extraplanar creature of a level no greater than double that of the planar binding ritual's level and attempt to bargain with it. The secondary caster attempting the Crafting check creates a warding diagram to prevent the extraplanar creature from attacking or leaving during the bargain; if that caster fails or critically fails, then instead of the usual effects of a failure or critical failure of the secondary skill check, the extraplanar creature can attack or leave instead of negotiate. You can also leave out this step, removing the need for a Crafting check, with the same result (if you're summoning a good extraplanar creature you trust, for example). The creature can also attack or leave if you use any hostile action against it or if the warding diagram breaks. Once the diagram is complete, you and the secondary casters each take your places at specific points at the diagram's edge where power concentrates.

You conjure the extraplanar creature within your wards and negotiate a deal with it, generally to perform a task for you in exchange for payment. A creature that doesn't wish to negotiate at all can attempt a Will save to stay on its home plane. Most good and neutral extraplanar creatures feel that they have something better to do than cater to the whims of mortals and require a significant gift, especially if your task poses significant risks. Evil extraplanar creatures are more likely to accept a bargain for a lower cost as long as it allows them to wreak havoc on the Material Plane or inflict evil upon the world along the way. Monetary prices usually range from the cost of a consumable item of the creature's level for a short and simple task to a permanent magic item of the creature's level or more to persuade the creature to fight alongside you. However, some extraplanar creatures may want payments other than money, such as permission to cast a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Q690d3mw3TUrKX7E]{Geas} on you to fulfill an unspecified later favor or obtain ownership of your soul via an infernal contract. If you can't come to an agreement in a reasonable length of time after you've made your case, the extraplanar creature can return from whence it came at any time.

Critical Success You call the extraplanar creature and bind it in the wards for up to a full day before it returns home, potentially allowing you to negotiate a better deal by threatening to leave it in the wards for the full day.

Success You call the extraplanar creature.

Failure You fail to call the extraplanar creature.

Critical Failure You call something dark and horrible, unbound by your wards, and it immediately attempts to destroy you.

True Seeing.name: 真视术 True Seeing
True Seeing.description:
你能看见60英尺内的事物真实的样子。GM会对区域内的任何幻术或变化系效果进行一次秘密的反制检定，但仅用于判定你是否能看穿它（例如，若该检定成功反制一个变形法术，你就能看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该变形法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion or transmutation in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Black Tentacles.name: 黑触手 Black Tentacles
Black Tentacles.description:
区域 20尺爆发，邻接于一个平坦表面

油腻的黑触手升起并试图捕获区域内的生物。对区域内每个生物的强韧DC进行法术攻击掷骰。任何你成功对抗的生物都会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{被擒抱}并受到3d6钝击伤害。每当一个生物在该区域内结束其回合时，若黑触手尚未尝试擒抱它，则黑触手会尝试擒抱该生物；并且黑触手会对任何已被擒抱的生物造成@Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]伤害。

黑触手的逃脱DC等于你的法术DC。一个生物可以攻击一条触手，试图迫使其松开。其AC等于你的法术DC，且若其受到12点或更多伤害则被摧毁。即使被摧毁，额外的触手仍会在区域内继续生长，直到持续时间结束。你可以解消该法术。

Area 20-foot burst adjacent to a flat surface

Oily black tentacles rise up and attempt to capture creatures in the area. Make spell attack rolls against the Fortitude DC of each creature in the area. Any creature you succeed against is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage. Whenever a creature ends its turn in the area, the tentacles attempt to grab that creature if they haven't already, and they deal @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage to any creature already Grabbed.

The tentacles' Escape DC is equal to your spell DC. A creature can attack a tentacle in an attempt to release its grip. Its AC is equal to your spell DC, and it is destroyed if it takes 12 or more damage. Even if destroyed, additional tentacles continue to grow in the area until the duration ends. You can Dismiss the spell.

Crushing Despair.name: 极度绝望 Crushing Despair
Crushing Despair.description:
你对区域内的生物施加绝望灵光。每个生物的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应动作（），且必须在其回合开始时再尝试一次豁免；若失败，则该回合中其为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓1}，因为它不受控制地抽泣。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败 同失败，且该生物自动为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓1}，持续1分钟。

升阶（7环） 区域增加为60尺锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Illusory Scene.name: 幻象场景 Illusory Scene
Illusory Scene.description:
你构成一个想象的场景，其中包含最多10个相互独立的生物或物体，体型各异，且都必须位于该法术的区域内。这些要素会产生恰当的声音与气味，并且在接触时手感逼真。幻象场景的要素不具备说话能力。与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature}法术不同，你场景中的生物缺乏战斗能力与数据。你的场景不包含其周围环境的变化，不过你可以将你的场景置于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage}法术的幻象环境之中。

当你创造该场景时，你可以选择让它静止或遵循一段程序。尽管静止场景是固定不动的，它仍包含基础的自然移动。例如，风吹过一张幻象纸会使其沙沙作响。程序最长可达1分钟，并在结束后重复。例如，你可以创造两名兽人互相战斗的场景，而这场战斗在每次重复时都会以相同方式进行。若你创造一个循环，这两名战士会在场景开始与结束时都处于同一位置，但你可以将程序衔接得更平滑，使人难以分辨循环何时结束与开始。任何人若观察该场景超过几分钟，几乎总会注意到它在循环。你在创造该幻象后无法更改该程序。

任何接触图像任意部分的生物，或使用搜寻动作来检查它的生物，都可以尝试不相信你的幻象。若他们与幻象的一部分互动，他们只会不相信那一部分。只有在大成功或大失败时，他们才会不相信整个场景。

升阶（6环）你场景中的生物或物体可以说话。在你创建程序时，你必须为每个角色说出其特定台词。该法术会为每个角色伪装你的声音。

升阶（8环）同6环版本，且持续时间为无限。

You form an imaginary scene that includes up to 10 discrete creatures or objects of various sizes, all of which must be within the spell's area. These elements generate appropriate sounds and smells, and they feel right to the touch. Elements of an illusory scene are incapable of speech. Unlike with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell, creatures in your scene lack combat abilities and statistics. Your scene doesn't include changes to the environment around it, though you can place your scene within the illusory environment of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage} spell.

When you create the scene, you can choose to have it be static or follow a program. Though a static scene is stationary, it includes basic natural movement. For example, wind blowing on an illusory piece of paper would rustle it. A program can be up to 1 minute long and repeats when finished. For instance, you could create a scene of two orcs fighting each other, and the fight would go the same way for each repetition. If you create a loop, the two fighters end up in the same place at the start of the scene and at the end of it, but you can smooth the program so it's hard to tell when the loop ends and begins. Anyone observing the scene for more than a few minutes almost always notices it looping. You're unable to alter the program after you create the illusion.

Any creature that touches any part of the image or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. If they interact with a portion of the illusion, they disbelieve only that portion. They disbelieve the entire scene only on a critical success.

Heightened (6th) Creatures or objects in your scene can speak. You must speak the specific lines for each actor when creating your program. The spell disguises your voice for each actor.

Heightened (8th) As the 6th-rank version, and the duration is unlimited.

Tongues.name: 巧言术 Tongues
Tongues.description:
目标可以理解所有词语，无论语言为何，并且还能说出其他生物的语言。当处于由不同生物组成的混合群体中时，每当目标开口说话，它都可以选择一个生物，并用该生物能理解的语言交谈，即使目标并不知道那是什么语言。

升阶（7环） 持续时间为 8 小时。

The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

Confusion.name: 困惑术 Confusion
Confusion.description:
你以奇异的冲动扰乱你的目标，使其随机行动。其效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标语无伦次地胡言乱语，并且处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 状态，持续1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免以结束困惑术。

大失败 目标陷入Confused状态，持续1分钟，且无法通过豁免提前结束。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Globe of Invulnerability.name: 法术无效结界 Globe of Invulnerability
Globe of Invulnerability.description:
你在自身周围创造一个静止不动的球形力场，尝试反制任何来自球体外部、其区域或目标进入球体内的法术，如同该球体是一个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法} 法术，但其法术阶级比实际法术阶级低1阶。

若反制尝试成功，它仅阻止本应进入球体的那部分法术效果（因此若该法术也有位于球体外的目标，或其区域有一部分在球体之外，则这些目标或那部分区域仍会照常受到影响）。

你必须在一个未被打断的开阔空间中塑造该球体，使其边缘不会穿过任何生物或物体，否则该法术将失效（不过在法术施放后，生物仍可以进入球体）。

You create an immobile globe around yourself that attempts to counteract any spell from outside the globe whose area or targets enter into the globe, as if the globe were a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} spell 1 rank lower than its actual spell rank.

If the counteract attempt succeeds, it prevents only the portion of the spell that would have entered the globe (so if the spell also has targets outside the globe, or part of its area is beyond the globe, those targets or that area is affected normally).

You must form the sphere in an unbroken open space, so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost (though creatures can enter the globe after the spell is cast).

Phantasmal Killer.name: 魅影杀手 Phantasmal Killer
Phantasmal Killer.description:
你创造出一个对目标而言最可怖的生物的幻象。只有该法术的目标能看见这个杀手，不过你能看见这幻象在疾驰向前进行攻击时那模糊的形状。杀手的效果取决于目标的意志豁免结果。

大成功或大失败成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到4d6点精神伤害，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标受到8d6点精神伤害，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大成功或大失败失败 目标恐惧到可能会死。它必须尝试一次强韧豁免；若目标失败，则其死亡。若强韧豁免成功，则目标受到12d6点精神伤害，获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 直到其下一回合结束，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}。此效果具有失能（特征）。

升阶（+1） 在失败时伤害增加2d6，在大成功或大失败失败时伤害增加3d6。

You create a phantasmal image of the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target. Only the spell's target can see the killer, though you can see the vague shape of the illusion as it races forth to attack. The effect of the killer is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes 8d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is so afraid it might die. It must attempt a Fortitude save; if the target fails, it dies. On a successful Fortitude save, the target takes 12d6 mental damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}. This effect has the incapacitation trait.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and by 3d6 on a critical failure.

Spell Immunity.name: 法术免疫 Spell Immunity
Spell Immunity.description:
你防护一个生物免受单一法术的效果影响。选择一个法术，并在言语成分的一部分中大声说出其名称。每当法术免疫的目标成为所命名法术的目标或处于该法术的区域内时，法术免疫就会尝试反制该法术。成功反制一个以区域或多个目标为目标的法术时，法术免疫仅使受法术免疫影响的目标免于其效果。

You ward a creature against the effects of a single spell. Choose a spell and name it aloud as part of the verbal component. Spell immunity attempts to counteract that spell whenever spell immunity's target is the target of the named spell or in that spell's area. Successfully counteracting a spell that targets an area or multiple targets with spell immunity negates the effects only for the target affected by spell immunity.

Aberrant Whispers.name: 怪异耳语 Aberrant Whispers
Aberrant Whispers.description:
你用一种未知的语言吟诵短句，冲击附近生物的心智。每个目标都必须尝试一次意志豁免。无论其豁免结果如何，每个目标随后都会获得持续 1 分钟的暂时免疫。

你可以增加施放法术所需的动作数量（最多总计 3 个动作）。每增加 1 个动作，放射半径增加 5 尺；若为 3 个动作，最多额外增加 10 尺。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}。

升阶 (+3) 初始半径增加 5 尺。

You utter phrases in an unknown tongue, assaulting the minds of those nearby. Each target must attempt a Will save. Regardless of the result of its save, each target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

You can increase the number of actions it takes to Cast the Spell (to a maximum of 3 actions total). For each additional action, increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet, to a maximum of 10 extra feet for 3 actions.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}.

Heightened (+3) The initial radius increases by 5 feet.

Mind Reading.name: 读心术 Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
通过一次粗略的精神接触，你试图施展读心术读取目标的心智。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。随后，目标对你的读心术获得暂时免疫1小时。

大成功或大失败 当你施放法术时，目标会从你这里感知到模糊的表层思绪。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层思绪，并且你得知其智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大成功或大失败 同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持法术以再次侦测目标的表层思绪。目标不会获得任何额外豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the Spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Nondetection.name: 回避侦测 Nondetection
Nondetection.description:
你竖立起防护结界，使目标难以通过魔法被侦测到。回避侦测会在持续时间内尝试反制所有针对目标或目标的道具进行的侦测、揭示与探知类预言系，且为此目的将戏法视为1环法术。若成功反制一个以区域或多个目标为目标的预言系，则仅使回避侦测的目标免受其效果影响。

You erect protective wards that make the target difficult to detect via magic. Nondetection attempts to counteract all detection, revelation, and scrying divinations made against the target or the target's gear throughout the duration, counting cantrips as 1st-rank spells for this purpose. Successfully counteracting a divination that targets an area or multiple targets negates the effects only for nondetection's target.

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你在目标的运动冲动离开其思维之前将其阻断，威胁将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}，持续 1 轮。

大失败 目标麻痹 4 轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，将剩余持续时间减少 1 轮，或在大成功时将其完全结束。

升阶（第7环） 你可以以最多 10 个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Vampiric Touch.name: 吸血鬼之触 Vampiric Touch
Vampiric Touch.description:
你的接触从一个目标身上汲取生命之血来强化自己。你对目标造成 6d6 虚空伤害。你获得等同于目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果之后）。1 分钟后，你失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你掐灭一个濒临死亡的生物的生命。该目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。若此举杀死它，你获得10点临时HP，以及持续10分钟的攻击与伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值。

大成功或大失败 该目标不受影响。

成功 该目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 数值增加1。

失败 该目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{法术效果：死亡丧钟}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你瓦解法术或效果背后的魔法。尝试对目标进行一次反制检定。若你成功反制一件魔法物品，该物品在10分钟内变为其类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。若目标为神器或类似物品，你自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

See Invisibility.name: 识破隐形 See Invisibility
See Invisibility.description:
你可以看见@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的生物和物体。它们在你眼中呈现为半透明的轮廓，并且对你而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。

升阶（5环）该法术的持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：看见未见}

You can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and objects. They appear to you as translucent shapes, and they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to you.

Heightened (5th) The spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

Telekinetic Maneuver.name: 念动战技 Telekinetic Maneuver
Telekinetic Maneuver.description:
伴随着一阵念动力量的迸发，你移动一个敌人或其所携带的某件物品。你可以用一次法术攻击掷骰来尝试对目标进行缴械、推撞或绊摔，而不是进行一次运动检定。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to Disarm, Shove, or Trip the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Touch of Idiocy.name: 愚者之触 Touch of Idiocy
Touch of Idiocy.description:
你使目标的心智迟钝；目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}。

You dull the target's mind; the target must attempt a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智变得混沌，并用一次精神冲击使其陷入眩晕术。冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在该豁免上大失败，则它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

高度化（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造一种简单声音的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个正常人同时喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格发出。你无法创造可辨识的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Mage Hand.name: 法师之手 Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
你创造出一只单独的魔法之手，可以是隐形或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并将其缓慢移动至多20尺。由于你是在使物体漂浮，你可以将其朝任意方向移动。当你维持法术时，你可以让该物体额外移动20尺。如果法术结束时该物体在空中，物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以一个负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60尺，且你可以以一个负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60尺，且你可以以一个负载为2或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声咕哝词句，但它们并不会从你的嘴里传出，而是直接传送到目标的耳中。其他人听到你的话并不会比你只是正常动嘴型更清楚，但目标听到你的话就如同他们站在你身旁一样。

目标可以用反应动作（）给出简短回复，或者如果他们愿意，也可以在其下一回合以自由动作（）回复，但他们必须能够看见你并且处于射程内才能这么做。如果他们回复，他们的回复会像原本的传讯术一样，直接送到你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加到500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you.

The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Mindlink.name: 讯息传递 Mindlink
Mindlink.description:
你将自己的心灵与目标的心灵相连，并在瞬间向该目标以心灵方式传达原本需要用10分钟才能交流的信息量。

You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击尝试。如果你成功，则该生物进行一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。如果你的攻击掷骰为大成功，则使用其豁免结果降低一级成功等级的结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你将注意力集中在目标物体上，敞开心灵以感知魔法灵光。当施法完成时，你知道该物品是否具有魔法，如果是，你会得知其魔法学派。

如果该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的等级低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时，你才会侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你可以以最多10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法力场护盾。这视为使用举起护盾动作，使你在下个回合开始前获得 AC +1 环境加值，但不需要手来使用。

当该法术处于效果期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应动作（）。该护盾的硬度为 5。在你使用 Shield Block 后，该法术结束，并且你在 10 分钟内无法再次施放它。与普通的 Shield Block 不同，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）来对抗 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} 法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（3环） 该护盾的硬度为 10。

升阶（5环） 该护盾的硬度为 15。

升阶（7环） 该护盾的硬度为 20。

升阶（9环） 该护盾的硬度为 25。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Spider Sting.name: 蜘蛛蜇刺 Spider Sting
Spider Sting.description:
你魔法般地复制了一只蜘蛛的毒刺。你对所触碰的生物造成1d4穿刺伤害，并使其感染蜘蛛毒液。目标必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到 @Damage[1d4[poison]] 伤害。

失败 目标在阶段1感染蜘蛛毒液。

大失败 目标在阶段2感染蜘蛛毒液。

蜘蛛毒液（毒素）

等级 1

最大持续时间 4轮

阶段1 1d4毒素伤害并 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱1}（1轮）

阶段2 1d4毒素伤害并 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱2}（1轮）

You magically duplicate a spider's venomous sting. You deal 1d4 piercing damage to the touched creature and afflict it with spider venom. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage.

Failure The target is afflicted with spider venom at stage 1.

Critical Failure The target is afflicted with spider venom at stage 2.

Spider Venom (poison)

Level 1

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 1d4 poison damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 1d4 poison damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将射程内一件松散的、无人持用的物体掷向目标，该物体的负载必须为1或更低。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——取决于你掷出的物体——其数值等于1d6加上你的施法能力调整值。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功或大失败 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Tentacular Limbs.name: 触手肢体 Tentacular Limbs
Tentacular Limbs.description:
你的手臂变为细长、柔韧的触手，使你在施放射程为接触的法术，以及用手臂进行徒手打击（例如拳击与爪击）时的触及提升至10英尺。这不会改变你的近战武器攻击的触及。在持续时间内，每当你施法时，你可以为该法术的施放额外加入一个动作，以暂时将你的触及延伸至20英尺来传递该法术。

强化（+2） 当你为法术额外加入一个动作以暂时延伸你的触及时，你的触及再额外增加10英尺来传递该法术。

Your arms turn into long, pliable tentacles, increasing your reach when you're delivering touch range spells and making unarmed Strikes with your arms (such as fist and claw Strikes) to 10 feet. This doesn't change the reach of your melee weapon attacks. During the duration, whenever you Cast a Spell, you can add an additional action to that spell's casting to temporarily extend your reach to 20 feet to deliver that spell.

Heightened (+2) When you add an additional action to a spell to temporarily extend your reach, your reach increases by an additional 10 feet to deliver that spell.

True Strike.name: 克敌机先 True Strike
True Strike.description:
对未来的一瞥确保你的下一次打击精准命中。在你回合结束前，你下一次进行攻击掷骰时，将该次攻击掷骰掷两次并取较好结果。该次攻击无视对攻击掷骰的环境减值，以及因目标处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐藏} 而需要进行的任何纯骰检定。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：精准一击}

A glimpse into the future ensures your next blow strikes true. The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll the attack twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}

Magic Sense.name: 魔法感知 Magic Sense
Magic Sense.description:
贝科拉能感知魔法灵光的存在，如同她始终在使用一个1环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{侦测魔法} 法术一般。当她进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{（Seeks）动作} 时，她对自己所见之物获得一个3环侦测魔法法术的益处。

Belcorra can sense the presence of magic auras as though she were always using a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} spell. When she @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seeks}, she gains the benefits of a 3rd-rank detect magic spell on things she sees.

Site Bound.name: 束缚之地 Site Bound
Site Bound.description:
憎恨魔窟最低的三层等级

一只典型的幽灵（特征）只能离开它被杀死的地点或它盘踞的地方一小段距离。一个典型的限制是120英尺。有些幽灵（特征）则不是绑定在某个地点上，而是绑定在对它而言特别的房间、建筑、物品或生物上。

Lowest three levels of the Abomination Vaults

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当贝科拉被摧毁时，她会在空无之窟内于[[/br 2d4 #复生]]{2d4天}后重新形成（不过她可以通过使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.CTiLugp5ptSItEqN]{乌木支点镜片}以宁布洛斯本质的微光强化自身来缩短这段时代）。

贝科拉只有在她对艾巴萨罗姆施行完全的复仇，或宁布洛斯吞噬她的灵魂时，才能被永久摧毁。

When Belcorra is destroyed, she re-forms in [[/br 2d4 #Rejuvenation]]{2d4 days} within the Empty Vault (though she can reduce that time by empowering herself with glimmers of Nhimbaloth's essence using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.CTiLugp5ptSItEqN]{Ebon Fulcrum Lens}).

Belcorra can only be permanently destroyed if she enacts her full revenge on Absalom or if Nhimbaloth devours her soul.

Blood Magic.name: 血统奥秘 Blood Magic
Blood Magic.description:
每当贝科拉施放术士血脉法术或异怪血脉授予法术时，她可以给予自己或该法术的一个目标在1轮内对抗意志豁免检定获得+2状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.4GAJHkurmZ1ttKDv]{效果：血统奥秘}

Each time Belcorra casts a sorcerer bloodline spell or an aberrant bloodline granted spell, she can grant herself or a target of the spell a +2 status bonus to Will saving throws for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.4GAJHkurmZ1ttKDv]{Effect: Blood Magic}

Corrupting Gaze.name: 腐化凝视 Corrupting Gaze
Corrupting Gaze.description:
贝科拉凝视30尺内她可见的一名生物。目标受到 @Damage[9d6[mental]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:33|basic] 意志豁免）。

豁免失败的生物还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} 状态，持续1分钟。

Belcorra stares at a creature she can see within 30 feet. The target takes @Damage[9d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:33|basic] save).

A creature that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.

Haunted Lighthouse.name: 作祟灯塔 Haunted Lighthouse
Haunted Lighthouse.description:
频率 每10分钟一次

效果 贝科拉将她的存在延伸至凄凉灯塔最底下三层，直至她下个回合结束。她能以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.9qV49KjZujZnSp6w]{全域视野}的增益进行视物，并且能从该区域内的任何表面发起幽灵手攻击或使用源自该区域内任何表面的特殊能力。

Frequency once every 10 minutes

Effect Belcorra extends her presence throughout the lowest three levels of Gauntlight until the end of her next turn. She can see with the benefits of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.9qV49KjZujZnSp6w]{All-Around Vision} and can make ghostly hand attacks or use special abilities originating from any surface in this area.

Quickened Casting.name: 迅捷施法 Quickened Casting
Quickened Casting.description:
频率 每日一次

效果 如果贝科拉的下一个动作是施放一个4环或更低环位的术士法术，她将施放该法术所需的动作数量减少1（最少1个动作）。

Frequency once per day

Effect If Belcorra's next action is to cast a sorcerer spell of 4th rank or lower, she reduces the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

Belcorra Haruvex.privateNotes:
在他们穿越憎恨魔窟最低层的跋涉中，英雄们很可能会在最终获得他们用来彻底击败贝科拉所需的支点镜片之前，多次与她交锋。她从她的微灵盟友那里得知他们的情报，此后你便可以在她的现身最能制造紧张感时随时使用她。她应当在地下城的每个等级至少发动一次攻击，频率高到每隔几天一次也不为过。在冒险的最终章之前，你不应让贝科拉与其他生物并肩作战——她独自就已经足够棘手！

每一次贝科拉发动攻击，她都会更多了解英雄们的战斗方式，并调整她的战术与准备。她可能施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tgIhRUFtgDSELpJE]{法术免疫}来保护自己免受英雄最有效的法术影响，施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}来确保能持续看见他们，或施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}来反制他们的魔法防护。她会嘲弄英雄们的失败，并对他们的成功暴怒——记住，自从她在“凄凉灯塔遗迹”中试射凄凉灯塔光束以来，她就一直知晓他们的存在。

第一次攻击贝科拉一旦察觉到英雄的存在，便会主动搜寻他们，穿行于凄凉灯塔印记之中（区域A37与B28）。她会在远处施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0XP2XOxT9VSiXFDr]{魅影灾祸}后撤退，必要时穿墙移动，以免英雄追上。

第二次攻击贝科拉想让英雄们畏惧她，因此第二次她会更接近，并使用单一目标法术，例如@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5BbU1V6wGSGbrmRD]{Never Mind}与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tlcrVRqW1MSKJ5IC]{魅影杀手}，同时要求英雄从她的憎恨魔窟中逃离。传达完她的“传讯术”后，她只会再多纠缠几个回合便撤退。

后续攻击一旦英雄取回了一枚支点镜片或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JwHNSaiwwqF7VCC5]{支点晶格}，贝科拉便会将英雄视为真正的威胁，但她的怒火会压过谨慎。她会全力出手，使用她的腐化凝视与幽灵之手并配合法术。如果她击败了一名英雄，她便会撤退，自信他们会因此不再打扰她。

利用代理人贝科拉在憎恨魔窟内有数个活着的盟友，包括透肌魔人教团与贝科拉之子。她可能会派这些团体去追击英雄，并坚持要他们让英雄知道他们是在奉贝科拉之命行事。好在这两方都无法集结大量人数，因此英雄应能应付他们的袭击。

杀害盟友若英雄缔结同盟，例如与附近的卡利尼或卓尔结盟，贝科拉会得知此事。她很清楚不该去正面挑战如加卢杜或夸拉这般强大且根基稳固的首领，但她可能会谋杀几名守卫，或引导怪物前往最能对英雄盟友造成伤害之处。对贝科拉而言，留下某些证据（通常是一名受伤的幸存者）以让英雄知道这次攻击是她一手策划的，这点至关重要。

在印记中由于她的作祟灯塔能力，贝科拉在与进入凄凉灯塔印记（区域A37与B28）的英雄战斗时效果最佳。

最终攻击如果英雄在抵达空无之窟前不久击败了贝科拉，她会动用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.CTiLugp5ptSItEqN]{乌木支点镜片}的力量加速她的复苏，以便能在她的圣所面对他们。贝科拉在空无之窟中绝不会投降或逃跑。英雄有可能在尚未具备永久击败她的能力之前就在那里遭遇她；在这种情况下，他们将不得不撤退，去收集支点镜片，再返回与她再战。只要英雄能够将宁布洛斯的凝视聚焦在贝科拉身上，他们便能彻底击败这名术士。

During their trek through the lowest levels of the Abomination Vaults, the heroes likely face Belcorra several times before they finally acquire the fulcrum lenses they need to defeat her for good. She learns about them from her wisp allies and you can thereafter use her whenever her appearance might cause the most tension. She should attack at least once on each dungeon level, as often as every couple of days. You shouldn't have Belcorra fight alongside other creatures until the adventure's finale-she's tough enough on her own!

Each time Belcorra attacks, she learns more about how the heroes fight and adapts her tactics and her preparations. She might cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tgIhRUFtgDSELpJE]{Spell Immunity} to protect herself from the heroes' most effective spells, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} to keep them in sight, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} to counter their magical defenses. She mocks the heroes for their failures and rages at their successes-remember, she has been aware of them since her test firing of Gauntlight's beam in "Ruins of Gauntlight."

First Attack As soon as Belcorra realizes the heroes' presence, she seeks them out, traveling through the Gauntlight footprint (areas A37 and B28). She casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0XP2XOxT9VSiXFDr]{Phantasmal Calamity} at a distance and retreats, moving through walls if necessary so the heroes can't follow.

Second Attack Belcorra wants the heroes to fear her, so she approaches them more closely the second time and uses single-target spells like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5BbU1V6wGSGbrmRD]{Never Mind} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tlcrVRqW1MSKJ5IC]{Phantasmal Killer} while demanding the heroes flee her Abomination Vaults. With her message delivered, she retreats after only a few rounds.

Later Attacks Once the heroes have recovered a fulcrum lens or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JwHNSaiwwqF7VCC5]{Fulcrum Lattice}, Belcorra considers the heroes an actual threat, but her anger overrides her caution. She attacks with her full might, using her Corrupting Gaze and ghostly hand along with her spells. If she defeats a hero, she retreats, confident that they'll leave her alone.

Leveraging Agents Belcorra has several living allies within the Abomination Vaults, including the urdefhan cult and the Children of Belcorra. She might send these groups after the heroes, insisting they let the heroes know they're acting on Belcorra's orders. Fortunately, neither group can muster large numbers, so the heroes should be able to manage an attack from them.

Killing Allies Belcorra learns if the heroes make alliances, such as with nearby calignis or drow. She knows better than to face powerful, entrenched leaders like Galudu or Quara, but she might murder a few guards or direct monsters where they can most damage the heroes' allies. It's important to Belcorra that she leave some evidence (usually a single, injured survivor) to let the heroes know she had orchestrated the attack.

In the Footprint Belcorra is most effective fighting the heroes who enter the Gauntlight footprint (areas A37 and B28) due to her Haunted Lighthouse ability.

The Final Attack If the heroes defeat Belcorra shortly before they reach the Empty Vault, she uses the power of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.CTiLugp5ptSItEqN]{Ebon Fulcrum Lens} to hasten her rejuvenation so she can face them in her sanctum. Belcorra doesn't ever surrender or flee in the Empty Vault. The heroes could possibly face her there without yet having the ability to permanently defeat her. In this case, they'll need to retreat to collect the fulcrum lenses and return to face her again. Once the heroes can focus Nhimbaloth's gaze upon Belcorra, they can defeat the sorcerer for good.

Telepathy (with spectral thralls only).name: 心灵感应（仅限幽魂奴仆） Telepathy (with spectral thralls only)

Pain Starvation.name: 痛苦饥渴 Pain Starvation
Pain Starvation.description:
一个幽魂若超过一个月未对活着的人形生物造成过任何虚空伤害，便会变得绝望且近乎野性。它的阵营从守序邪恶变为混乱邪恶，失去对其可能拥有的任何堕落奴仆的控制，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{加速} 状态。它只能使用这额外的动作，对人形目标进行邪恶接触打击。于任何它对活着的人形生物造成任意数量的虚空伤害的回合结束时，它会恢复为守序邪恶并不再处于加速状态，但它失去控制的任何奴仆仍保持自由。

A specter that goes for more than a month without dealing void damage to a living humanoid becomes desperate and almost feral. It changes alignment from lawful evil to chaotic evil, loses control of any corrupted thralls it might have, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. It can use its additional action only to make vile touch Strikes against humanoid targets. At the end of any turn in which it deals any amount of void damage to a living humanoid, it reverts to lawful evil and is no longer quickened, but any thralls it lost control of remain free.

Sunlight Powerlessness.name: 阳光虚弱 Sunlight Powerlessness
Sunlight Powerlessness.description:
被阳光照到的幽魂会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 2}，持续至其仍处于阳光之中。

A specter caught in sunlight is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for as long as it remains in the sunlight.

Spectral Corruption.name: 幽魂腐化 Spectral Corruption
Spectral Corruption.description:
幽魂进行一次邪秽接触打击。若其对一名活体生物造成伤害，幽魂获得5点临时生命值，且目标生物必须进行一次@Check[will|dc:24]豁免以避免被腐化。

大成功或大失败 成功该生物不受影响，且在1分钟内暂时免疫幽魂腐化。

成功该生物在1小时内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}。

失败该生物屈服于腐化并暂时成为幽魂奴仆。该生物被幽魂@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}，服从幽魂的心灵感应或口头命令，但幽魂奴仆不会服从明显自我毁灭的命令。此效果持续至奴仆下一回合结束，届时其不再受控制，但在1小时内变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}。

大成功或大失败 失败同失败，但持续时间为无限。奴仆可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的意志豁免；若成功，则其不再被幽魂控制，但在1小时内变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}。

The specter makes a vile touch Strike. If it damages a living creature, the specter gains 5 temporary Hit Points and the target creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save to avoid becoming corrupted.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to spectral corruption for 1 minute.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 hour.

Failure The creature succumbs to the corruption and becomes a spectral thrall temporarily. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} by the specter, obeying the specter's telepathic or spoken orders, though a spectral thrall does not obey obviously self-destructive orders. This lasts until the end of the thrall's next turn, at which point it is no longer controlled but becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 hour.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is unlimited. The thrall can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns; on a success, it is no longer controlled by the specter but becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 hour.

Cultist Specter.publicNotes:
当一名邪恶的凡人生物死亡时，它有时会以幽魂的形式回到其死亡的区域作祟，成为憎恨的残余，总是在寻求杀戮他者——尤其是类人生物——试图将自己的痛苦分摊到尽可能多的灵魂之中。幽魂会保留其先前身份的某种诡异表象，但其目的感已被腐化。它无法被说服讲理。

若幽魂被剥夺了对活着的类人生物造成伤害的机会，它会变得愈发痛苦且不理性，仿佛一个饥饿之人被永远剥夺了通过死亡从痛苦中解脱的途径一般。

When an evil mortal creature dies, it sometimes returns to haunt the area of its death as a specter, a hateful remnant, always seeking to slay others-particularly humanoids-in an attempt to distribute its pain among as many souls as it can. A specter maintains a strange semblance of its prior identity, but with a corrupted sense of purpose. It cannot be reasoned with.

A specter denied the opportunity to harm living humanoids grows increasingly agonized and irrational, akin to the mindset of a starving person forever denied a release from agony through death.

Dread Dhuthorex.name: 恐怖触鳍鱼怪 Dread Dhuthorex
Dread Dhuthorex.tokenName: 恐怖触鳍鱼怪 Dread Dhuthorex

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能天生法术 Occult Innate Spells

Mariner's Curse.name: 海员诅咒 Mariner's Curse
Mariner's Curse.description:
你以翻涌而无情的海洋之诅咒折磨目标。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1（状态）}。将其恶心（状态）降低至 0 会终止该诅咒。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1（状态）}，且在诅咒持续期间无法将其恶心（状态）降低到 1 以下。该诅咒可以通过移除诅咒或类似魔法解除。只要目标处于恶心（状态）并在离岸至少 1 英里的水域上，它也会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速 1}。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，但目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2（状态）}。

You afflict the target with the curse of the roiling, unforgiving sea. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. Reducing its Sickened condition to 0 ends the curse.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and can't reduce its Sickened condition below 1 while the curse remains. The curse can be lifted by remove curse or similar magic. Whenever the target is Sickened and on the water at least a mile from shore, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Hypnotic Pattern.name: 催眠图文 Hypnotic Pattern
Hypnotic Pattern.description:
你创造出一团几何状的色彩云雾，在空中悬浮并不断变换。生物在图案之内时处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}。此外，若生物在你施放该法术时位于图案内、进入图案、在图案内结束其回合，或对该图案使用搜寻或交互动作，它必须尝试一次意志豁免。当前被该图案迷魂的生物不再尝试新的豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标被该图案迷魂。

大成功或大失败 目标被该图案迷魂。在其仍处于迷魂期间，它不能使用反应动作（）。

You create a pattern of shifting colors that hovers in the air in a geometric cloud. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} while inside the pattern. In addition, a creature must attempt a Will saving throw if it is inside the pattern when you cast it, when it enters the pattern, when it ends its turn within the pattern, or if it uses a Seek or Interact action on the pattern. A creature currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the pattern doesn't attempt new saves.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is Fascinated by the pattern.

Critical Failure The target is Fascinated by the pattern. While it remains Fascinated, it can't use reactions.

Mind Reading.name: 读心术 Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
通过一次粗略的精神接触，你试图读取目标的思维。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。随后，该目标会对你的读心术暂时免疫1小时。

大成功 当你施放法术时，目标会从你那里感知到模糊的表层想法。

成功 你会得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层想法，并且你会得知其智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大失败 同失败，且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持法术以再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the Spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Wavesense (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 波感知（不精确）60尺 Wavesense (Imprecise) 60 feet

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Overpowering Jaws.name: 强力咬合 Overpowering Jaws
Overpowering Jaws.description:
恐怖触鳍鱼怪在其啃咬打击为失败（但非大成功或大失败）时，对其目标造成 @Damage[8[piercing]] 伤害。

A dread dhuthorex deals @Damage[8[piercing]] damage to its target if its jaws Strike is a failure (but not a critical failure).

Swallow Whole.name: 活吞 Swallow Whole
Swallow Whole.description:
大型，@Damage[(3d6+8)[bludgeoning],2d6[acid]]{3d6+8钝击伤害加2d6酸蚀伤害}，破裂 23

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Large, @Damage[(3d6+8)[bludgeoning],2d6[acid]]{3d6+8 bludgeoning plus 2d6 acid damage}, Rupture 23

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Dread Dhuthorex.publicNotes:
比起它们更低等的同类更为聪明，恐怖触鳍鱼怪拥有诡异而迷人的力量。

无日之海中游弋着许多怪异之物，但鲜有如鲨鱼般的触鳍鱼怪这般凶猛。这些野兽无所畏惧且顽强地追逐猎物。

More intelligent than their lesser kin, dread dhuthorexes possess eerie, enchanting powers.

Strange things swim in sunless seas, but few as fierce as the shark-like dhuthorexes. These beasts chase prey fearlessly and tenaciously.
Dread Dhuthorex.prototypeToken: 恐怖触鳍鱼怪 Dread Dhuthorex

Irlgaunt.name: 触手蟹 Irlgaunt

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原初天生法术 Primal Innate Spells

Stone Tell.name: 石之传言 Stone Tell
Stone Tell.description:
你可以向天然或经加工的石头提问并获得回答。尽管石头并不聪明，你是在与石头的自然灵性交谈；这些灵性具有由石头的类型所染上的人格，而对经加工的石头而言，还会受到其所属结构类型的影响。石头的视角、察觉与知识使其世界观与人类有足够的不同，以至于它不会认为相同的细节重要。石头大多能回答关于过去触碰过它们的生物，以及它们下方或其后方隐藏着什么的问题。

You can ask questions of and receive answers from natural or worked stone. While stone is not intelligent, you speak with the natural spirits of the stone, which have a personality colored by the type of stone, as well as by the type of structure the stone is part of, for worked stone. A stone's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Stones can mostly answer questions about creatures that touched them in the past and what is concealed beneath or behind them.

Meld into Stone (At will).name: 融入石中（随意） Meld into Stone (At will)
Meld into Stone (At will).description:
你与一块相邻的石块融合，该石块必须有足够的体积容纳你以及你穿戴和持握的物品。你在施放法术时必须接触该石块。你能听见，但无法看见石块外发生的事情，并且只要所施放的法术不需要穿过石块之外的效果线，你就可以在石块内施放法术。

当你在石块内时，若石块受到显著的物理伤害，会将你排出并对你造成10d6伤害。穿墙术会将你排出但不会造成伤害，并结束one with stone。你可以解消此法术。

You merge with an adjacent block of stone with enough volume to fit you and your worn and held possessions. You must touch the stone when you Cast the Spell. You can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the stone, and you can cast spells while in the stone as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the stone.

Significant physical damage to the stone while you are inside it expels you and deals 10d6 damage to you. Passwall expels you without dealing damage and ends one with stone. You can Dismiss this spell.

Shape Stone (At will).name: 塑石术（随意） Shape Stone (At will)
Shape Stone (At will).description:
你将石头塑造成你选择的一个粗略形状。塑形过程过于粗糙，无法制造复杂部件、精细细节、可动构件或类似内容。任何在你重塑石头时站在其上的生物都必须各自尝试一次反射豁免或特技检定。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物在石头上方倒下，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}。

大失败 该生物从石头上跌落（若适用），并以卧倒状态着地。

You shape the stone into a rough shape of your choice. The shaping process is too crude to produce intricate parts, fine details, moving pieces, or the like. Any creatures standing atop the stone when you reshape it must each attempt a Reflex save or Acrobatics check.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} atop the stone.

Critical Failure The creature falls off the stone (if applicable) and lands Prone.

Regurgitate Gastrolith.name: 反刍胃石 Regurgitate Gastrolith
Regurgitate Gastrolith.description:
触手蟹猛烈地反刍出一团西瓜大小的脆石凝块，超自然地灌注了消化酶。石块与酸液在射程30尺内撞击后爆炸，对@Template[burst|distance:20]内的生物造成@Damage[7d6[piercing]]伤害与@Damage[7d6[acid]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic]豁免）。

触手蟹在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用反刍胃石。

The irlgaunt violently regurgitates a melonsized clot of brittle stone supernaturally infused with digestive enzymes. The stone and acid explode on impact within a range of 30 feet, dealing @Damage[7d6[piercing]] damage and @Damage[7d6[acid]] damage to creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:20] (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save).

The irlgaunt can't Regurgitate Gastroliths for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Stone Step.name: 石之步 Stone Step
Stone Step.description:
触手蟹无视由岩石与石头构成的困难地形。

The irlgaunt ignores difficult terrain composed of rocks and stone.

Irlgaunt.publicNotes:
触手蟹看起来像巨型蜘蛛或螃蟹，但其覆有几丁质护甲的腿部末端会喷涌出章鱼般的触须。它们参差不齐的灰色甲壳使其能够融入高山隘口与深邃峡谷的岩壁之中，这些地方正是它们的狩猎场。尽管体型庞大，它们的移动却异常迅捷，能一跃越过深裂隙，并不停歇地攀爬近乎垂直的山崖。虽然它们在近战中已十分可怕，触手蟹却拥有更为强大的远程攻击。这些生物能通过强力反刍胃石来轰击对手——那是一团团甜瓜大小的岩块簇，被凝结的消化酶包裹，其强度足以分解血肉与骨骼。胃石十分脆弱，接触时便会爆裂，将区域内喷洒满岩石碎片与腐蚀性酸液。

人们或许很容易把触手蟹误认为只是蛮横的野兽，但它们具有敏锐的智力，并会运用阴险的狩猎策略。它们为旅人设下陷阱，且喜欢把从先前受害者处夺来的宝石与魔法物品当作诱饵。有人目击它们引发落石滑坡，或以其他方式封堵通道，将探险者改道引入其魔爪之中。它们也会用胃石来引导猎物的移动，迫使受害者走入裂隙或悬崖边缘的死胡同。

大体而言，触手蟹独居为主，可能是因为很难找到足够的食物来维持一个群体。然而，它们仍保有一种扩展的区域性群体意识，会在为战争集结或讨论影响其物种或共同领地的其他问题时主动聚集。据说它们偶尔会与巨人结为盟友，但这些停战协定通常十分暧昧不明。

Irlgaunts resemble titanic spiders or crabs, but with cephalopod-like tendrils erupting from the tips of their chitin-armored legs. Their jagged gray shells allow them to blend into the rocky walls of the high mountain passes and deep ravines that serve as their hunting grounds. Despite their size, they move with incredible alacrity, bounding across chasms and skittering up sheer mountain cliffs without pause. Though they are formidable in melee, irlgaunts have an even more powerful ranged attack. These creatures can pelt their opponents by forcefully regurgitating gastroliths-melon-sized clusters of rocks enveloped in coagulated digestive enzymes strong enough to break down flesh and bone. Gastroliths are fragile and explode on contact, spraying the area with shards of rock and caustic acid.

While one might easily mistake an irlgaunt for a simple brutish beast, they have a keen intelligence and use devious hunting strategies. They set traps for travelers and are fond of using gems and magical items taken from previous victims as bait. They have been known to start rockslides or otherwise block passages to reroute explorers into their clutches. They also use their gastroliths to direct the movements of their prey, forcing victims into dead ends at the edge of chasms or cliffs.

For the most part, irlgaunts live solitary lives, likely because finding enough food to sustain a community tends to be difficult. However, they still maintain a sense of extended, regional community, actively gathering when organizing for war or to discuss other issues that affect their species or shared territories. They have been known to occasionally ally with giants, but these truces are usually nebulous.

Isqulug.name: 伊斯库鲁格 Isqulug

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原初天生法术 Primal Innate Spells

Tangling Creepers.name: 纠缠蔓生藤 Tangling Creepers
Tangling Creepers.description:
浓密、抽动的蔓藤从每一处表面萌发，并充满区域内的任何水体。任何在地面上移动的生物，或在蔓藤中进行攀爬或游泳的生物，在区域内时其速度受到-10英尺的环境减值。每轮一次，你可以使用带有专注（特征）的单动作，使一条藤蔓从蔓藤扩展范围内的任意方格抽打而出。该藤蔓具有15英尺触及，并对目标进行一次近战法术攻击掷骰。若攻击成功，藤蔓将目标拉入蔓藤中，并使其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} 1轮，或直到该生物 逃脱（对抗你的法术DC），以先发生者为准。

Dense, twitching creepers sprout from every surface and fill any bodies of water in the area. Any creature moving on the land, or Climbing or Swimming within the creepers, takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds while in the area. Once per round, you can make a vine lash out from any square within the expanse of creepers by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait. This vine has a 15-foot reach and makes a makes a melee spell attack roll against the target. If the attack succeeds, the vine pulls the target into the creepers and makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round or until the creature Escapes (against your spell DC), whichever comes first.

Control Water.name: 操控水位 Control Water
Control Water.description:
通过将你的意志施加于水，你可以使所选区域中的水位上升或下降10英尺。区域内的水生物会受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WsUwpfmhKrKwoIe3]{缓慢术}的效果影响。

By imposing your will upon the water, you can raise or lower the level of water in the chosen area by 10 feet. Water creatures in the area are subjected to the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WsUwpfmhKrKwoIe3]{Slow}.

Entangle (At will).name: 纠缠（随意施放） Entangle (At will)
Entangle (At will).description:
区域内的植物会缠住生物。该区域视为困难地形。每一轮中，任何在区域内开始其回合的生物都必须尝试一次反射豁免。失败时，它的各项速度获得 -10 尺环境减值，直到它离开该区域为止；大成功或大失败时，它还会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} 1 轮。生物可以以缠绕的 DC 尝试 逃脱 来移除这些效果。

Plants in the area entangle creatures. The area counts as difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to Escape at entangle's DC to remove these effects.

Hallucinatory Terrain.name: 幻觉地形 Hallucinatory Terrain
Hallucinatory Terrain.description:
你创造一个幻象，使自然地形看起来、听起来、摸起来并闻起来都像另一种地形。这不会伪装区域内的任何建筑或生物。任何触碰该幻象或使用搜寻动作来检查它的生物都可以尝试识破你的幻象。

升阶（5环） 你的影像也可以伪装建筑或创造虚幻建筑（但仍不会伪装生物）。

You create an illusion that causes natural terrain to look, sound, feel, and smell like a different kind of terrain. This doesn't disguise any structures or creatures in the area. Any creature that touches the illusion or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (5th) Your image can also disguise structures or create illusory structures (but still doesn't disguise creatures).

Obscuring Mist (At will).name: 隐雾术（随意） Obscuring Mist (At will)
Obscuring Mist (At will).description:
你召唤出一团薄雾云。薄雾内的所有生物都变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，而薄雾外的所有生物对薄雾内的生物而言也变为隐蔽。你可以解消该云雾。

You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

Fly.name: 飞行 Fly
Fly.description:
目标可以在空中翱翔，获得等同于其速度或20英尺（以较高者为准）的飞行速度。

强化（7环） 持续时间增加至1小时。

The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮(术)，彼此之间任意两者相距不超过10尺。每个都像火炬一样发光。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮(术)移动至多60尺。每个光亮(术)必须保持在你120尺内，并且与其他所有光亮(术)之间相距不超过10尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Host Scent.name: 寄主气味 Host Scent
Host Scent.description:
伊斯克鲁格能够精确感知30英尺内任何感染了伊斯克鲁吉亚的生物，并知晓该疾病的当前阶段。

An isqulug can precisely sense any creature infected with isqulugia within 30 feet, and knows the current stage of the disease.

Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Cold).name: 再生 10（被寒冷停用） Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Cold)

Expel Infestation.name: 驱逐寄生虫群 Expel Infestation
Expel Infestation.description:
伊斯库鲁格从其头部的蜂巢思维中喷出幼虫，形成一个 @Template[cone|distance:30]。该区域内的生物在虫群啃食其血肉时受到 @Damage[6d10[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 豁免）。任何受到伤害的生物都会暴露于伊斯库鲁格菌。

伊斯库鲁格陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{目眩 1} 状态，持续 [[/gmr 1d4 #Stupified Duration]]{1d4 轮}，期间它无法使用“驱逐侵染”。

The isqulug expels larvae from the hivemind in its head in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. Creatures in this area take @Damage[6d10[piercing]] damage as the swarm feeds on their flesh (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). Any creature that takes damage is exposed to isqulugia.

The isqulug becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for [[/gmr 1d4 #Stupified Duration]]{1d4 rounds}, during which it can't Expel Infestation.

Isqulugia.name: 伊斯库鲁吉亚 Isqulugia
Isqulugia.description:
伊斯库卢吉亚的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓}, 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹} 状态在该苦难被移除前无法移除

豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}（1小时）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}（1天）

阶段 3 疲乏 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}（1天）

阶段 4 麻痹（1天）

阶段 5 该生物死亡，其躯体会猛烈地转化为一只新的伊斯库卢格。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{许愿术}、类似的魔法或一个9环的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{起死回生} 仪式可以让受害者复活。即使受害者被复活，新的伊斯库卢格仍会留存。

Isqulugia's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} conditions can't be removed until this affliction is removed

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (1 hour)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (1 day)

Stage 3 fatigued and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 day)

Stage 4 paralyzed (1 day)

Stage 5 the creature dies, and its body violently transforms into a new isqulug. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish}, similar magic, or a 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual can return the victim to life. The new isqulug remains even if the victim is brought back to life.

Malleability.name: 可塑性 Malleability
Malleability.description:
冰蠕龙能够像小型生物一样通过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{挤入空间}穿过狭窄空间。当它挤入空间时，它可以以其全额速度移动。冰蠕龙甚至可以挤入空间通过通常只适合超小型生物的空间，但会以挤入空间的标准速度这样做。

The isqulug can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} through tight spaces as if it were a Small creature. While Squeezing, it can move at its full Speed. The isqulug can even Squeeze through spaces that typically fit only a Tiny creature, but does so at the standard speed for Squeezing.

Swamp Stride.name: 沼泽阔步 Swamp Stride
Swamp Stride.description:
伊斯库鲁格会无视由沼泽的典型特征所造成的困难地形。

An isqulug ignores difficult terrain that's caused by typical features of swamps.

Isqulug.publicNotes:
伊斯库拉格的外表虽然令人不安，但或许只是它最不糟糕的性相。该生物看起来像一只双足两栖动物，用触手代替手臂，头部则由一团起伏不定的物质构成——看上去像是一堆不断变形、黏滑透明的卵，内里充满蠕动的幼虫。事实上，这些幼虫构成了伊斯库拉格的心智与意识——它的“身体”不过是一套有机外衣，由它吞噬之物的血肉制造而成，类似蜘蛛复杂的蛛网术或蜂群的巢穴，但依然完全具备移动与施暴的能力。

The isqulug's appearance, though unsettling, might be its least awful aspect. The creature resembles a bipedal amphibian with tentacles instead of arms and a head composed of an undulant mass of what appear to be shifting, slimy transparent eggs filled with writhing larvae. In truth, these larvae constitute the mind and consciousness of the isqulug-its "body" is little more than an organic suit manufactured from the flesh of those it has consumed, analogous to the complex web of a spider or the hive of a colony of bees, but fully capable of movement and violence.

Magma Scorpion.name: 熔岩蝎 Magma Scorpion

Smoke Vision.name: 烟雾视觉 Smoke Vision
Smoke Vision.description:
熔岩蝎无视由烟雾造成的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽（状态）}状态。

The magma scorpion ignores the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from smoke.

Magma Scorpion Venom.name: 熔岩蝎毒液 Magma Scorpion Venom
Magma Scorpion Venom.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[2d6[fire]] 伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[3d6[fire]] 伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 2}（1 轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Magma Scorpion.publicNotes:
无论是在深渊的荒原上窜行，还是在最深沙漠的灼热沙地中晒太阳，岩浆蝎的焦黑甲壳都会持续散发出扭曲视线的热浪。

Whether skittering through Abyssal wastelands or basking in the searing sand of the deepest deserts, magma scorpions have charred carapaces constantly emitting vision-warping waves of heat.

Nhimbaloth's Cutter.name: 宁布洛斯的切割者 Nhimbaloth's Cutter
Nhimbaloth's Cutter.tokenName: 宁布洛斯的切割者 Nhimbaloth's Cutter

Golem Antimagic.name: 魔像反魔法 Golem Antimagic
Golem Antimagic.description:
受到音波伤害（@Damage[6d6[untyped]]，来自区域或持续伤害的@Damage[2d6[untyped]]）；受到火焰治疗（区域 @Damage[2d6[healing]] HP）；被寒冷减速

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

Harmed by sonic (@Damage[6d6[untyped]], @Damage[2d6[untyped]] from areas or persistent damage); healed by fire (area @Damage[2d6[healing]] HP); slowed by cold

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

Spell Reflection.name: 法术反射 Spell Reflection
Spell Reflection.description:
触发 玻璃魔像成为一个法术的目标

效果 玻璃魔像调整其魔法般的反射表面，将法术反弹回施法者身上。它尝试以一次 @Check[acrobatics] 检定作为其反制检定来反制该法术。若它成功反制该法术，则该效果会被反弹回施法者。

Trigger The glass golem is targeted by a spell

Effect The glass golem positions its magical, reflective surfaces to turn the spell back on the caster. It tries to counteract the spell by attempting an @Check[acrobatics] check for its counteract check. If it successfully counteract the spell, the effect is turned back on the caster.

Vulnerable to Shatter.name: 易受粉碎影响 Vulnerable to Shatter
Vulnerable to Shatter.description:
玻璃魔像受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter}法术的影响，如同该魔像是一个无人看管的物体。

A glass golem is affected by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter} spell as though the golem were an unattended object.

Dazzling Brilliance.name: 炫目光辉 Dazzling Brilliance
Dazzling Brilliance.description:
玻璃魔像创造出阵阵闪烁的光辉波动，在@Template[emanation|distance:60]范围内投射出明亮光照（并在接下来的60尺内提供昏暗光照）。该光照持续到玻璃魔像下个回合开始为止；之后，玻璃魔像在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Dazzling Brilliance]]{1d4轮}内无法使用炫目光辉。处于明亮光照内或进入明亮光照的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:23]意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}。

大失败 该生物在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{失明}，随后再额外目眩4轮。

The glass golem creates waves of scintillating luminosity that cast bright light in a @Template[emanation|distance:60] (and dim light for the next 60 feet). The light lasts until the start of the glass golem's next turn, after which the glass golem can't use Dazzling Brilliance for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Dazzling Brilliance]]{1d4 rounds}. A creature within the bright light or that enters the bright light must attempt a @Check[will|dc:23] save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and then dazzled for an additional 4 rounds.

Grim Glimmering.name: 恐怖闪光 Grim Glimmering
Grim Glimmering.description:
魔像制造出一波波不祥的光亮，投射出昏暗光照，范围为 @Template[emanation|distance:60]。该光亮持续至魔像下一回合开始，之后魔像在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Grim Glimmering]]{1d4 轮}内无法使用恐怖闪光。处于该光亮中或进入该光亮的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:23|name:Grim Glitter|traits:damaging-effect] 意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物在 1 轮内处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}。

大失败 该生物在 1 轮内处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{末日 1}和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{失明}。

The golem creates waves of baleful light that cast dim light in a @Template[emanation|distance:60]. The light lasts until the start of the golem's next turn, after which the golem can't use Grim Glimmering for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Grim Glimmering]]{1d4 rounds}. A creature within the light or that enters the light must attempt a @Check[will|dc:23|name:Grim Glitter|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Nhimbaloth's Cutter.publicNotes:
由硬化玻璃制成，并以经魔法处理的铅加以固定，玻璃魔像既是致命的守卫者，也是精美绝伦的艺术品。玻璃魔像最常守护宏伟的大教堂或奢华的宫殿——这些都是它们所侍奉、或曾侍奉之人的财富与权势的见证。一旦在其创造者的命令术驱使下行动，玻璃魔像比大多数其他魔像更迅捷、更灵活。它们锋利如刃的肢体能轻易切断静脉与动脉，造成大量出血的创口。

在各式各样的魔像之中，玻璃魔像最接近一件艺术作品。正如强大的贵族可能会用冰魔像来调节温度，或用木魔像作为抬高自我价值的雕像一样，玻璃魔像那色彩斑斓的玻璃构造仅凭其存在，便能提升任何厅室的美感。

Crafted of hardened glass and held together by magically treated lead, glass golems are both deadly guardians and works of exquisite art. Glass golems most often protect grand cathedrals or opulent palaces-testaments to the wealth and power of those they serve, or once served. Once spurred into action by the commands of their creators, glass golems are quicker and more agile than most other golems. Their sharp, blade-like limbs can easily sever veins and arteries, creating wounds that bleed profusely.

Of all the various types of golems, the glass golem is the one most akin to a work of art. Just as powerful aristocrats might use an ice golem for temperature regulation or a wood golem as an ego-boosting statue, a glass golem's colorful glass construction can elevate the beauty of any chamber by its mere presence.
Nhimbaloth's Cutter.blurb:
变体玻璃魔像
Variant glass golem
Nhimbaloth's Cutter.prototypeToken: 宁布洛斯的切割者 Nhimbaloth's Cutter

Soul Feeder.name: 灵魂吞噬者 Soul Feeder

Dread Flickering.name: 恐怖闪烁 Dread Flickering
Dread Flickering.description:
20尺。恐怖鬼火虽然天生处于隐形状态，但会发光，散发灰白色照明，在灵光中投射昏暗光照并使其可见。活体生物若在灵光中结束其回合，必须通过一次 @Check[will|dc:25] 豁免检定，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}（若为大成功或大失败中的失败则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}）。

大成功或大失败中的大成功者将获得10分钟的暂时免疫。

20 feet. A dread wisp, though naturally invisible, glows with a grayish illumination, casting dim light in the aura and making them visible. Living creatures that end their turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:25] saving throw or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

Those that critically succeed are temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Magic Immunity.name: 魔法免疫 Magic Immunity
Magic Immunity.description:
恐怖鬼火免疫除@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{妖火术}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DyiD239dNS7RIxZE]{Holy Light}以及具有命能（特征）的法术之外的所有法术。

A dread wisp is immune to all spells except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DyiD239dNS7RIxZE]{Holy Light}, and spells with the vitality trait.

Feed on Despair.name: 吞食恐惧 Feed on Despair
Feed on Despair.description:
频率 每轮一次

要求 恐怖鬼火15英尺内的一名敌人正处于恐惧(术)效果影响下、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drain}，或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}
