原产于幽暗地域的鬼火比那些在上界荒凉沼泽与地表起伏飘荡的鬼火更加不祥且邪恶。这些恐怖鬼火以诡异的光亮变化灌输恐惧(术)，并吞噬它们制造出的恐惧(术)，在此过程中从受害者身上汲取生命能量。尽管恐怖鬼火能在幽暗地域的任何地方生存，它们更偏爱潮湿的区域，例如部分被水淹没的洞穴、地下河的河岸，以及高耸的真菌花园。

恐怖鬼火不会像地表鬼火那样发光得那么明亮，因为在地下，即便最微弱的光亮(术)也会引来注意。它们是长寿且充满憎恨的生物，能记住关于自身生活、旅行，以及最美味猎物的鲜明细节。尽管恐怖鬼火本可以分享大量传说与独特经历，但它们并不会这么做，因为它们以他人的无知为乐。

Will-o'-wisps native to the Darklands are more ominous and malevolent than those that bob about in the lonely marshes and surfaces of the upper world. These dread wisps instill terror with eerie shifts of light and consume the fear they create, drawing life energy from their victims in the process. While dread wisps can survive anywhere within the Darklands, they prefer moist areas like partially submerged caves, the banks of underground rivers, and towering fungus gardens.

Dread wisps don't glow as brightly as surface will-o'-wisps because even the dimmest light attracts notice underground. Long-lived and hateful creatures, they remember vivid details about their lives, travels, and most delicious prey. Although dread wisps could share extensive lore and unique experiences, they don't, as they find amusement in others' ignorance.

Stone Golem.publicNotes:
石魔像是缓慢而坚定的构装体，通常由大理石或花岗岩雕刻而成。它们在休息时往往被制作成艺术品，因此一些魔像匠会雇用雕刻大师，以确保这些构装体成为美丽的雕像。较古老的石魔像可能会经历风化，表面有磨损或裂纹，或缺少鼻子与指节，但这种风化大多只是外观上的，并不会对魔像的功能造成不利影响。

传说中，有格外巨大的石魔像栖居在某些古代遗迹之中。它们是来自被时间遗忘的文明的幸存者，一心执行早已逝去的主人所下达的命令；这些巨型石魔像比大多数石魔像强大得多。它们总是等级15或更高，体型从不小于超大型——多数为巨型。由于它们的体型过于庞大，而其栖身的建筑又极其破败，唤醒这样的石魔像可能导致周围结构崩塌、古老地基弯折，并使天花板轰然砸落在敌人头上。除了此处的统计数据外，这些庞大的石魔像还会以宽阔的横扫打击进行攻击，能够一次击倒多个目标。

以普通材料打造，并以魔法赋予其强大的守卫之力，传说中的魔像是一种活体构装体，会毫无思考地服从其创造者的命令术——往往在其创造者死后仍持续服从数年，甚至数个世纪。已知有两种让魔像获得动作的方式。传统方法是在新制成的容器雕像中采集并植入元素的灵魂或精粹；对于重视灵魂神圣性的人而言，这一过程被视为卑劣且亵渎，而邪恶或缺乏道德感的魔像匠往往偏好此法。另一种不那么受诟病的技术，则是将纯粹的生命力能量导入雕像，人为地模拟灵魂的创造。其结果并不会赋予魔像真正的灵魂，并且通常是一种成本更高、耗时更久的创造方式。无论采用哪种方法，最终的魔像运作方式都相同。魔像独特的驱动力使其易受某些形式的魔法影响，但除了这些少数弱点外，它对魔法免疫，并且难以用武器造成伤害。

在游戏中，魔像最适合作为需要被击败的敌人，而非作为与玩家角色一同进行冒险的盟友。创造魔像的过程耗时、昂贵且困难，只有最有天赋的施法者或工匠才有希望完成这样的壮举。据说某些魔法文本——所谓的“魔像手册”——能援助魔像匠，但总体而言，创造魔像应当留给游戏主持人处理。

魔像具有可被采集作为战利品或魔法材料的部件；其价值取决于具体的魔像。可从魔像身上采集的部件示例列在边栏中。

Stone golems are slow and steady constructs typically carved from marble or granite. They're often made to serve as works of art when at rest, so some golem crafters employ master sculptors to ensure the constructs make beautiful statues. Older stone golems might be weathered, with scuffed or cracked surfaces or missing noses and digits, but this weathering is largely cosmetic and doesn't adversely impact the golems' functionality.

Tales tell of particularly immense stone golems residing in certain ancient ruins. Survivors from time-lost civilizations bent on carrying out orders from long-gone masters, these immense stone golems are much more powerful than most stone golems. They are always level 15 or higher and never smaller than Huge in size-most are Gargantuan. Because their size is so great and the structures they dwell in so dilapidated, the awakening of such a stone golem can cause surrounding structures to collapse, ancient foundations to buckle, and ceilings to come crashing down on foes. In addition to the statistics here, these massive stone golems attack with wide, sweeping strikes capable of knocking down multiple targets at once.

Crafted of base materials and then magically animated into a powerful guardian, the legendary golem is a living construct that mindlessly obeys its creator's commands-often continuing to do so for years or even centuries after its creator's death. There exist two known methods of animating a golem. The traditional method involves harvesting and implanting an elemental soul or essence within the newly crafted host statue, a procedure seen as vile and blasphemous to those who value the sanctity of the soul; evil or amoral golem crafters tend to prefer this method. The other, less disreputable technique involves siphoning pure vitality energy into the statue to artificially imitate the creation of a soul. The result does not give the golem a true soul and is generally a more costly and time-consuming method of creation. Regardless of the method used, the resulting golem functions the same. A golem's unique animating force leaves it susceptible to certain forms of magic, but apart from these few weaknesses, it is impervious to magic and difficult to damage with weapons.

Golems work best in play as foes to vanquish rather than allies to accompany player characters on adventures. The process of creating a golem is time-consuming, expensive, and difficult, and only the most talented spellcasters or artisans can even hope to accomplish such an undertaking. While certain magical texts-so-called "golem manuals"-are said to aid golems crafters, for the most part the creation of a golem should be something left in the hands of the Game Master.

Golems have components that can be harvested as trophies or magical components; the value depends on the golem in question. Examples of components that can be harvested from golems are listed in the sidebars.

This effect lasts for 1 week and can be ended by effects that remove curses.

@Check[occultism|dc:32|name:削弱幻象]（大师）或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（第5等级；反制DC 26）以削弱幻象；需要三次成功才能使陷阱失效

@Check[occultism|dc:32|name:Weaken the images] (master) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (5th level; counteract DC 26) to weaken the images; three successes are required to disable the trap
Images of Failure.hazarddescription:
心灵强化的幻象淹没了40英尺长、15英尺宽走廊（地图上的白色虚线框）内生物的心智，使其充满对过去失败的记忆。

Psychically enhanced illusions flood the minds of creatures in the 40-foot-long, 15-foot-wide hallway (the white dotted box on the map) with memories of their past failures.
Images of Failure.reset:
该陷阱会立即重置，并且能在生物的回合内多次影响同一个生物。

The trap resets immediately and can affect the same creature multiple times on the creature's turn.
Images of Failure.stealthdetails:
（专家）以察觉这些幻象图像掩藏着一个魔法陷阱（注意到这些图像的 DC 为 0）

(expert) to realize the illusory images conceal a magical trap (noticing the images has a DC of 0)

Images of Powerlessness.tokenName: 无力的幻象 Images of Powerlessness

Flood of Despair.name: 绝望的洪流 Flood of Despair
Flood of Despair.description:
触发 一名生物在陷阱的区域内结束一个移动动作

效果 触发生物在思虑自己未来的失败时，受到 @Damage[(2d10+10)[mental]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:32|basic] 意志豁免）。受到伤害的生物会听见一阵轻柔的低语在诱惑它：“让我从你身上拿走点什么，我就能止住这份痛苦。”同意的生物会失去一个随机的、且并非其他专长前置条件的职业专长的许可，并且该生物不会再受到绝望的洪流造成的进一步伤害。此效果持续1周，并可被移除诅咒的效果终止。该生物也会立刻侦测到走廊尽头的暗门，不论它离走廊尽头有多远。

Trigger A creature ends a move action within the trap's area

Effect The triggering creature takes @Damage[(2d10+10)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:32|basic] save) as it considers its future failures. A creature that takes damage hears a soft whisper offering, "Let me take something from you and I can stop the pain." A creature who agrees loses access to a random class feat that isn't a prerequisite for another feat, and the creature doesn't take further damage from Flood of Despair. This effect lasts for 1 week and can be ended by effects that remove curses. The creature also immediately detects the secret door at the end of the hall, no matter how far away from the end of the hall they are.

Images of Powerlessness.disable:
@Check[occultism|dc:32|name:削弱幻象] (大师) 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（第5等级；反制DC 26）以削弱幻象；需要三次成功才能解除该陷阱

@Check[occultism|dc:32|name:Weaken the images] (master) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (5th level; counteract DC 26) to weaken the images; three successes are required to disable the trap
Images of Powerlessness.hazarddescription:
受心灵强化的幻象淹没了那条95英尺长、15英尺宽的走廊（地图上的白色虚线框）内的生物的心智，让他们看见自己尚未到来的失败。

Psychically-enhanced illusions flood the minds of creatures in the 95-foot-long, 15-foot-wide hallway (the white dotted box on the map) with visions of their failures yet to come.
Images of Powerlessness.reset:
陷阱会立即重置，并且可以在该生物的回合中多次影响同一生物。

The trap resets immediately and can affect the same creature multiple times on the creature's turn.

Carman Rajani.name: 卡曼·拉贾尼 Carman Rajani

Cooperative Blade.name: 合作之刃 Cooperative Blade
Cooperative Blade.description:
这把+1 强击长剑的剑刃如镜面般光亮，尽管已有数千年之久却毫无锈蚀。

当你挥舞它时，你在进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{援助} 的检定时获得 +2 物品加值。如果你在用于援助的技能或攻击掷骰上是专家，且你大成功，则你给予你的盟友对触发检定的 +3 环境加值，而非 +2 加值。

This +1 striking longsword has a mirror-like blade free of tarnish despite being millennia old.

While wielding it, you gain a +2 item bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid}. If you're an expert with the skill or attack roll you're using to Aid and you critically succeed, you grant your ally a +3 circumstance bonus to the triggering check instead of a +2 bonus.

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这套皮制护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还会加装小型金属板，在保有皮护甲大部分灵活性的同时提供更为坚固的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Thieves' Tools.name: 盗贼工具 Thieves' Tools
Thieves' Tools.description:
你需要盗贼工具才能使用贼活（技能）进行开锁或解除装置（某些类型）。

如果你的盗贼工具损坏了，你可以用适合你工具的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Sw7MBLASN3xK4Y44]{替换镐}来更换开锁镐以修复它们；这不需要使用修理动作。

You need thieves' tools to Pick Locks or Disable Devices (of some types) using the Thievery skill.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Sw7MBLASN3xK4Y44]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action.

Skillful Catch.name: 熟练接物 Skillful Catch
Skillful Catch.description:
触发 Carman 被投掷武器进行的远程攻击选为目标，且有一只手空着

效果 Carman 对抗触发的攻击时，其 AC 获得 +2 环境加值。若该攻击未命中，Carman 接住该武器，并可立即用其进行一次远程 Strike。

Trigger Carman is targeted with a ranged attack by a thrown weapon and has a hand free

Effect Carman gains a +2 circumstance bonus to his AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, Carman catches the weapon and can immediately make a ranged Strike with it.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
Carman 对 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 生物额外造成 2d6 精确伤害。

Carman deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Sudden Throw.name: 突然投掷 Sudden Throw
Sudden Throw.description:
卡曼迅速拔出一把投掷武器，并用其进行一次远程打击。他的目标必须在一次 @Check[perception|dc:22] 察觉检定中成功，否则会因该次攻击而被 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

Carman quickly draws a thrown weapon and makes a ranged Strike with it. His target must succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:22] check or be caught @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} by the attack.

Surprise Attacker.name: 突然袭击 Surprise Attacker
Surprise Attacker.description:
在战斗的第1轮中，尚未行动的生物对卡曼处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态。

On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to Carman.

Carman Rajani.blurb:
男性人类流氓
Male human scoundrel

Lasda Venkervale.name: 拉斯达·范克维尔 Lasda Venkervale
Lasda Venkervale.tokenName: 拉斯达·范克维尔 Lasda Venkervale

Barkeep's Apron.name: 酒保围裙 Barkeep's Apron
Barkeep's Apron.description:
这套护甲仅仅是一层厚重的绗缝布料，但有时会因为极其廉价而被使用。衬垫护甲比其他类型的护甲更容易受损与被摧毁。重型护甲的价格中包含一层衬垫护甲内衬，但当其穿在重型护甲之下时，会失去舒适特征。若你的重型护甲被摧毁，或在其他未穿着整套重型护甲的情况下，你可以只穿那套衬垫护甲或内衬来睡觉。这样你可以让护甲保持灌注状态，并从与之关联的重型护甲上的任何符文之力中获益，但没有这层衬垫内衬，其他人无法穿上你的重型护甲。

This armor is simply a layer of heavy, quilted cloth, but it is sometimes used because it's so inexpensive. Padded armor is easier to damage and destroy than other types of armor. Heavy armor comes with a padded armor undercoat included in its Price, though it loses the comfort trait when worn under heavy armor. You can wear just that padded armor or undercoat to sleep in, if your heavy armor is destroyed, or when otherwise not wearing the full heavy armor. This allows you to keep the armor invested and benefit from the power of any runes on the associated heavy armor, but no one else can wear your heavy armor without the padded undercoat.

Flask of Whiskey.name: 威士忌酒壶 Flask of Whiskey
Flask of Whiskey.description:
酒精是一种常见物质，品类繁多。一剂酒精的价格取决于具体饮品。受其影响期间，你无法从酒精导致的恶心（状态）中恢复。

如果你在对抗酒精的豁免中失败（初始豁免以外的豁免），该苦难的阶段不会提高；提高酒精苦难阶段的唯一方式是摄入更多酒精。

启动 A 交互（摄入）

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:12|name:Alcohol]

潜伏期 10分钟

阶段 1 对抗恐惧(术)的豁免获得+1物品加值（10分钟）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}，对抗恐惧(术)效果的豁免获得+1物品加值（10分钟）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}，off-guard，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}（10分钟）

阶段 4 clumsy 2且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}（10分钟）

阶段 5 clumsy 2，sickened 2，且stupefied 2（10分钟）

阶段 6 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}（8小时）

阶段 7 死亡

Alcohol is a common substance available in stunning variety. The Price of a dose of alcohol depends on the specific beverage. You can't recover from the sickened condition from alcohol while affected.

If you fail a saving throw against alcohol other than initial saves, the affliction's stage doesn't increase; the only way to increase the stage of alcohol's affliction is to consume more alcohol.

Activate A Interact (Ingested)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:12|name:Alcohol]

Onset 10 minutes

Stage 1 +1 item bonus to saving throws against fear (10 minutes)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, +1 item bonus to saving throws against fear effects (10 minutes)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, off-guard, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (10 minutes)

Stage 4 clumsy 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (10 minutes)

Stage 5 clumsy 2, sickened 2, and stupefied 2 (10 minutes)

Stage 6 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} (8 hours)

Stage 7 death

Bar Brawler.name: 酒吧斗殴者 Bar Brawler
Bar Brawler.description:
酒保经历过足够多的酒吧斗殴，知道如何挥出几拳。当在他们的酒吧里战斗并进行一次非致命攻击时，酒保在攻击掷骰上获得+1环境加值，并额外造成[[/r {1d4}]]{1d4伤害}。

The barkeep has been in enough bar fights to know how to throw a few punches. When fighting in their bar and making a nonlethal attack, the barkeep gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and deals an additional [[/r {1d4}]]{1d4 damage}.

Barkeep's Advice.name: 酒保的忠告 Barkeep's Advice
Barkeep's Advice.description:
频率 每日一次

效果 酒保向除自己以外的一个生物提供一些切题的建议。在24小时内，当该生物在一次技能检定或豁免检定中失败时，他们可以回想起这条建议并重骰该检定，改用第二次结果。一旦该生物使用了该能力，其效果结束。

接受“酒保的建议”的生物会在1个月内暂时免疫该能力。

Frequency once per day

Effect The barkeep gives some pertinent advice to a single creature other than themself. For 24 hours, when that creature fails a skill check or saving throw, they can recall this advice and reroll the check, using the second result instead. Once that creature uses this ability, its effect ends.

A creature that receives the Barkeep's Advice is temporarily immune to the ability for 1 month.

Lasda Venkervale.publicNotes:
酒馆老板往往是社区中的朋友和导师，一边供应酒水，一边倾听他人倾诉。最优秀的酒馆老板还擅长讲故事，并传授宝贵的建议。

无数场冒险都始于酒馆或小酒馆。也许是因为这种地方会吸引喜欢冒险的人，也许是因为在他们决定去对付一群横冲直撞的食人魔之前，每个人都需要一点液体勇气。

Barkeeps are often friends and mentors within a community, lending an ear while supplying libations. The best barkeeps have some talent for storytelling and passing on valuable advice.

Countless adventures begin in a tavern or a pub. Maybe it's because such places attract the risk-prone, or maybe it's because everyone needs a little liquid courage before they decide to take on a group of rampaging ogres.
Lasda Venkervale.prototypeToken: 拉斯达·范克维尔 Lasda Venkervale

Morlibint.name: 莫里宾特 Morlibint

Arcane Prepared Spells.name: 奥术备妥法术 Arcane Prepared Spells

Comprehend Language.name: 通晓语言 Comprehend Language
Comprehend Language.description:
当你施放该法术时，目标可以理解它正在听到或阅读的一种语言的含义。这不会让它理解密码、用隐喻表达的语言等类似内容（由GM酌情裁定）。如果目标能听到多种语言并且知道这一点，它可以选择要理解哪一种语言；否则，随机选择一种语言。

升阶（3环） 目标也可以说该语言。

升阶（4环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标，且目标也可以说该语言。

The target can understand the meaning of a single language it is hearing or reading when you cast the spell. This doesn't let it understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). If the target can hear multiple languages and knows that, it can choose which language to understand; otherwise, choose one of the languages randomly.

Heightened (3rd) The target can also speak the language.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures, and targets can also speak the language.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你拆解法术或效果背后的魔法。对目标进行一次反制检定。若你对法术效果成功，则你将其反制。若你对魔法物品成功，该物品在10分钟内变为其类型的非魔法物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。若目标为神器或类似物品，你将自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you succeed against a spell effect, you counteract it. If you succeed against a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Illusory Creature.name: 幻象生物 Illusory Creature
Illusory Creature.description:
你创造一个大型或更小体型的生物的幻象影像。它会产生相应的声音与气味，并且接触时感觉足够逼真。如果你与该影像之间的距离在任何时候超过500英尺，法术结束。

该影像无法说话，但你可以用你的动作通过该生物说话，法术会适当地将你的声音伪装起来。你可能需要尝试一次欺瞒或表演检定来模仿该生物，由GM决定。若你试图模仿某个特定的人，并与认识那个人的对象互动时，这尤其常见。

在战斗中，该幻觉每回合可以使用2个动作，你在维持该法术时由它使用。它的攻击检定使用你的法术攻击掷骰，它的AC使用你的法术DC。它的豁免调整值等于你的法术DC - 10。它足够具有实体感，因此可以夹击其他生物。如果该影像被一次攻击命中或一次豁免失败，法术结束。

该幻觉可以通过让目标相信幻觉的攻击是真实的来造成伤害，但除此之外它不能直接影响物理世界。若该幻象生物以一次打击命中，目标受到等同于1d4加上你的施法关键能力调整值的精神伤害。这是一个精神效果。该幻觉的打击为非致命。若该伤害与怪物影像不相符——例如，一个幻象大型巨龙只造成5点伤害——GM可能允许目标以自由动作（）进行一次察觉检定以A:识破该法术。任何相关的抗力与弱点，只要目标认为它们适用，就会如GM裁定般生效。例如，若幻觉挥舞一把+1 战锤并攻击一个对钝击伤害具有抗力的生物，该生物将受到更少的精神伤害。然而，幻觉伤害不会使再生失效，也不会触发其他需要特定伤害类型的效果。GM应记录该幻觉造成的幻觉伤害。

任何接触该影像的生物，或使用搜寻动作来检查它的生物，都可以尝试A:识破你的幻觉。当一个生物A:识破该幻觉时，它从其已受到的一半伤害中恢复（若有），并且不再受到来自该幻觉的任何进一步伤害。

升阶（+1） 该影像的打击伤害提高1d4，并且你能创造的生物最大体型提高一级（最高至超巨型）。

You create an illusory image of a Large or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the image are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

The image can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through the creature, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person and engage with someone that person knows.

In combat, the illusion can use 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Sustain the Spell. It uses your spell attack roll for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC - 10. It is substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The illusion can cause damage by making the target believe the illusion's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the illusory creature hits with a Strike, the target takes mental damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. This is a mental effect. The illusion's Strikes are nonlethal. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the monster-for example, if an illusory Large dragon deals only 5 damage-the GM might allow the target to attempt a Perception check to disbelieve the spell as a free action. Any relevant resistances and weaknesses apply if the target thinks they do, as judged by the GM. For example, if the illusion wields a warhammer and attacks a creature resistant to bludgeoning damage, the creature would take less mental damage. However, illusory damage does not deactivate regeneration or trigger other effects that require a certain damage type. The GM should track illusory damage dealt by the illusion.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. When a creature disbelieves the illusion, it recovers from half the damage it had taken from it (if any) and doesn't take any further damage from it.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the image's Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan).

Color Spray.name: 七彩喷射 Color Spray
Color Spray.description:
旋转的色彩会根据观者的意志豁免产生影响。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 1轮。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 1轮，并且目眩 1分钟。

大失败 该生物陷入震慑 1轮，并且目盲 1分钟。

Swirling colors affect viewers based on their Will saves.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round, and Dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned for 1 round and Blinded for 1 minute.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮(术)，它们彼此之间的距离不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮(术)移动至多60英尺。每个光亮(术)必须保持在你120英尺以内，并且与所有其他光亮(术)保持在10英尺以内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智变得混沌，并用一次心灵震荡使其眩晕术。该震荡造成等同于你的施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。如果目标在该豁免中大失败，它还会受到 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶 (+2) 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你释放出一道脉冲，登记魔法的存在。除了魔法存在或不存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和你盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。

你只有在该魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到幻术系魔法。然而，具有幻术系灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果同样强，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你也会定位最高等级魔法的源头。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将源头缩小到5尺立方体范围内（或若源头大于该范围，则缩小到最接近的范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Hand of the Apprentice.name: 学徒之手 Hand of the Apprentice
Hand of the Apprentice.description:
你利用魔法中最基础的课程之一来使你的武器浮空并推动它。你将一把你正持握且你受训的近战武器掷向目标，进行一次法术攻击掷骰。成功时，你造成该武器的伤害，如同你以一次近战打击命中一般，但将你的施法能力调整值加到伤害上，而非你的力量调整值。大成功或大失败时，你造成双倍伤害，并加入该武器的重击专精效果。无论结果如何，武器都会飞回你身边并回到你的手中。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MsXuzUrCGVuRGWK7]{法术效果：学徒之手}

You take advantage of one of the most fundamental lessons of magic to levitate and propel your weapon. You hurl a held melee weapon with which you are trained at the target, making a spell attack roll. On a success, you deal the weapon's damage as if you had hit with a melee Strike, but adding your spellcasting ability modifier to damage, rather than your Strength modifier. On a critical success, you deal double damage, and you add the weapon's critical specialization effect. Regardless of the outcome, the weapon flies back to you and returns to your hand.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MsXuzUrCGVuRGWK7]{Spell Effect: Hand of the Apprentice}

Mage Hand.name: 法师之手 Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
你创造一只单一的魔法之手，它可以是隐形或幽灵般的，抓住目标物体并缓慢地将其移动最多20英尺。由于你在使该物体漂浮，你可以将其向任何方向移动。当你维持该法术时，你可以额外移动该物体20英尺。如果该法术结束时物体仍在空中，物体会落下。

升阶（3环） 你可以以负载为1或更低的无主物体为目标。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以负载为1或更低的无主物体为目标。

升阶（7环） 射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以负载为2或更低的无主物体为目标。

You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Magic Missile.name: 魔法飞弹 Magic Missile
Magic Missile.description:
你射出一枚力场飞镖，拖着光痕飞向你能看见的一名生物。它自动命中并造成 1d4+1 点力场伤害。你在施放法术时每额外使用 1 个动作，你射出的飞弹数量增加 1 枚，最多在使用 3 个动作时射出 3 枚飞弹。你分别为每一枚飞弹选择目标。如果你将多枚飞弹射向同一目标，在应用伤害加值或减值、抗力、弱点等之前，先将伤害合并。

强化（+2） 你每花费 1 个动作就额外射出 1 枚飞弹。

You send a dart of force streaking toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of missiles you shoot by one, to a maximum of three missiles for 3 actions. You choose the target for each missile individually. If you shoot more than one missile at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You shoot one additional missile with each action you spend.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个松散、无人持用且在射程内、负载为1或更少的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——由你掷出的物体决定——其数值等于1d6加上你的施法能力调整值。被掷出的物品不具有任何会影响该次攻击或伤害的特定特征或魔法属性。

大成功或大失败 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Unseen Servant.name: 隐形仆役 Unseen Servant
Unseen Servant.description:
你召唤一个隐形仆役，你可以在维持法术时作为其中的一部分对其下达命令术。它为你效劳，直到其生命值降至0，此时该法术结束，或直到你停止维持法术。该隐形仆役获得被召唤（特征）特征。

隐形仆役 [生物] [-1] [无阵营] [中型]

AC 13, Fort +0, Ref +4, 意志 +0 HP 4

免疫 疾病，心灵，非魔法攻击，麻痹，毒素，精准，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷}

抗力 所有伤害 5（除力场或幽冥）

速度 飞行 30 尺

力场之躯 隐形仆役的实体躯体由力场构成。它不能使用攻击动作。它可以移动并使用交互动作来做诸如双身物体、打开未卡住或未上锁的门、扶住椅子以及清洁之类的事情。它不能穿过固体物体。

You summon an unseen servant, which you can command as part of Sustaining the Spell. It serves you until its Hit Points are reduced to 0, at which point the spell ends, or until you stop Sustaining the Spell. The unseen servant gains the summoned trait.

Unseen Servant [Creature] [-1] [No Alignment] [Medium]

AC 13, Fort +0, Ref +4, Will +0 HP 4

Immunities disease, mental, non-magical attacks, paralysis, poison, precision, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}

Resistances all damage 5 (except force or ghost touch)

Speed fly 30 feet

Force Body An unseen servant's physical body is made of force. It can't use attack actions. It can move and use Interact actions to do things such as fetch objects, open unstuck or unlocked doors, hold chairs, and clean. It can't pass through solid objects.

+1 Staff.name: +1 法杖 +1 Staff
+1 Staff.description:
这根长木棍可以在行走时提供援助，并能打出强力一击。

This long piece of wood can aid in walking and deliver a mighty blow.

Healing Potion (Minor).name: 治疗药水（次级） Healing Potion (Minor)
Healing Potion (Minor).description:
治疗药水是一小瓶宝石红色的液体，饮用者的伤口迅速愈合时会产生刺痛感。当你饮用治疗药水时，你恢复 @Damage[1d8[healing]] 生命值。

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When you drink a healing potion, you regain @Damage[1d8[healing]] Hit Points.

Scroll of Knock (Level 2).name: 敲击卷轴（等级2） Scroll of Knock (Level 2)
Scroll of Knock (Level 2).description:
从卷轴施放法术需要用一只手持握卷轴，并用一个施法（行动）来启动它，使用该法术通常所需数量的动作。

要从卷轴施法，该法术必须出现在你的法术列表中。由于你是施法者，使用你的法术攻击掷骰和法术DC。该法术还会获得与你的根源相应的特征（奥术、神圣、秘传或原能）。

卷轴在制作时已提供任何实体材料成分及其花费，因此你在从卷轴施法时无需再提供它们。你必须将该法术所需的任何材料成分替换为一个姿势成分。如果该法术需要一个法器，你必须拥有该法器才能从卷轴施法。

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

To Cast a Spell from a scroll, the spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack roll and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when Casting a Spell from a scroll. You must replace any required material component for that spell with a somatic component. If the spell requires a focus, you must have that focus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Scroll of Invisibility (Level 2).name: 隐形术卷轴（等级 2） Scroll of Invisibility (Level 2)
Scroll of Invisibility (Level 2).description:
从卷轴施放法术需要你用一只手持握卷轴，并用施法（行动）来启动它，使用该法术通常所需的动作数量。

要从卷轴施放法术，该法术必须出现在你的法术列表上。因为施法者是你自己，使用你的法术攻击掷骰和法术DC。该法术还会获得与你的根源相应的特征（奥术、神圣、秘法或原能）。

卷轴在制作时已提供任何实体的材料成分与费用，因此当你从卷轴施放法术时不需要再提供它们。你必须将该法术所需的任何材料成分替换为姿势成分。若该法术需要法器，你必须持有该法器才能从卷轴施法。

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

To Cast a Spell from a scroll, the spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack roll and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when Casting a Spell from a scroll. You must replace any required material component for that spell with a somatic component. If the spell requires a focus, you must have that focus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Scholarly Journal Compendium (Fictional.name: 学术期刊合集（虚构文学） Scholarly Journal Compendium (Fictional Literature)

Call Bonded Item.name: 召回契约物品 Call Bonded Item
Call Bonded Item.description:
莫里宾特将他的学术日志从至多1英里外传送到自己手中。

Morlibint teleports his scholarly journal into his hand from up to 1 mile away.

Drain Bonded Item.name: 汲取契合物品 Drain Bonded Item
Drain Bonded Item.description:
频率 每天两次

需求 莫里宾特在他的回合中尚未行动

效果 莫里宾特从他的学术日志中汲取了一些力量。他获得能力，无需消耗法术位即可施放一个他今天已准备并已施放过的法术。他仍必须施放该法术并满足该法术的其他需求。

Frequency twice per day

Requirements Morlibint hasn't acted yet on his turn

Effect Morlibint draws some of the power in his scholarly journal. He gains the ability to cast one spell he prepared today and already cast, without spending a spell slot. He must still Cast the Spell and meet the spell's other requirements.

Morlibint.blurb:
男性人类法师
Male human wizard

Shad Nunder.name: 沙德·努德尔 Shad Nunder
Shad Nunder.tokenName: 沙德·努恩德尔 Shad Nunder

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
囚犯对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物造成额外1d6精准伤害。

The prisoner does an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Surprise Attack.name: 突然袭击 Surprise Attack
Surprise Attack.description:
在战斗的第一轮中，尚未行动的生物对囚犯处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 状态。

On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the prisoner.

You're Next.name: 下一个就是你 You're Next
You're Next.description:
触发 囚犯将一个生物的生命值降至0。

效果 囚犯尝试进行一次威吓检定，并获得+2环境加值，以对其可见且也能看见他们的单一生物使用[[/act demoralize options=youre-next]]。

Trigger The prisoner reduces a creature to 0 hit points.

Effect The prisoner attempts an Intimidation check with a +2 circumstance bonus to [[/act demoralize options=youre-next]] a single creature it can see and that can see them.

Shad Nunder.publicNotes:
大多数最终进了监狱、地牢或牢房的人，只是在等待他们的监禁结束，想方设法熬过那些漫长到无尽的无聊与匮乏时日。然而，也有人会利用他们在里面的时间来巩固自己的犯罪关系。他们用武力与恐吓在其他囚犯中赢得地位，制作临时武器来打倒敌人，并在可能逃脱时取得优势。即便是那些没有卷入牢房政治世界的囚犯，学会为自己挺身而出并摆出一副强硬的姿态，也可能成为在一个人们几乎无所可失的地方求生所必需的。

不幸的是，每个社会都有生活在边缘的人。虽然良善的社区会努力为受压迫者提供援助与喘息之机，但有时——由于经济衰退、饥荒或战争——不幸者的人数会超过社区支援他们的能力。在冷酷的中立与邪恶社会中，贫困被视为一种永远无法真正根除的必然，或者更糟的是，被当作可为政治利益而加以操弄的工具。

Most who end up in a jail, dungeon, or prison are just biding their time until their imprisonment ends, trying to find ways to make it through interminable days of boredom and deprivation. Some, however, may use their time on the inside to strengthen their criminal connections. Using force and intimidation to gain status among other prisoners, they create makeshift weapons to take down their enemies and give them an edge if escape becomes possible. Even for prisoners who don't become involved in the world of prison politics, learning to stand up for themselves and projecting an air of toughness can become essential for survival in a place where people have little left to lose.

Unfortunately, every society has people living on its fringes. While good communities work to grant aid and respite to their downtrodden, sometimes-due to economic downturn, famine, or war-the ranks of the less fortunate exceed the community's capacity to support them. In heartless neutral and evil societies, poverty is seen as an inevitability that can never be truly eradicated, or even worse, as a tool to be manipulated for political gain.

Otari Guard.name: 奥塔里卫兵 Otari Guard

Dagger.name: 匕首 Dagger
Dagger.description:
这种小型刃器武器可单手持握，用于在近战中刺击生物。它也可以投掷。

This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

Scale Mail.name: 鳞甲 Scale Mail
Scale Mail.description:
鳞甲由许多金属鳞片缝在加固的皮革衬底上构成，通常制成长衫的形式，保护躯干、手臂和腿部。

Scale mail consists of many metal scales sewn onto a reinforced leather backing, often in the form of a long shirt that protects the torso, arms, and legs.

Signal Whistle.name: 信号哨子 Signal Whistle
Signal Whistle.description:
吹响后，信号哨可以在开阔地形上清晰地传到半英里外。

When sounded, a signal whistle can be heard clearly up to half a mile away across open terrain.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩所使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

+1 Bonus on Perception to Find concealed.name: 察觉检定以寻找隐蔽物体时获得+1加值 +1 Bonus on Perception to Find concealed objects

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Otari Guard.publicNotes:
卫兵是城镇巡逻队或城市卫队的基层成员，受训以察觉麻烦、制服罪犯并服从命令。他们只能与最初出道的冒险者和罪犯匹敌，但，随着时代推移，聚居地通常能集结足够数量的他们来消除大多数威胁。

更大的社会依赖那些拥有权威与能力来解读并执行法律的人。在善良阵营的社会中，这些官员会公正地履行职责。在中立与邪恶的社会中，这些官员可能严苛而残忍（其阵营会相应调整以反映这一点），对那些无法花钱买到宽恕的人施以严重惩罚。

Guards are rank-and-file members of a town watch or city guard, trained to look for trouble, take down criminals, and follow orders. They are a match for only the most fledgling of adventurers and criminals, but, given time, the settlement can usually muster them in numbers sufficient to neutralize most threats.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. In good-aligned societies, these officials carry out their duties fairly. In neutral and evil ones, these officials can be harsh and cruel (with an altered alignment to reflect this), imposing severe punishments on those who can't pay for mercy.

Wrin Sivinxi.name: 瓦琳·希温尼斯 Wrin Sivinxi
Wrin Sivinxi.tokenName: 瓦琳·希温尼斯 Wrin Sivinxi

Primal Spontaneous Spells.name: 原始自发法术 Primal Spontaneous Spells

Enthrall.name: 注目术 Enthrall
Enthrall.description:
你的言辞令你的目标迷魂。你在整个施法和持续时间内不间断地说话或歌唱。注意到你的演说或歌唱的目标可能会全神贯注；每个目标都必须尝试一次意志豁免。若目标属于对立的宗教、族裔或政治倾向，或以其他方式不太可能同意你所说的内容，GM 可能会给予环境加值（最高 +4）。

每个进入射程的生物在你维持法术时都必须尝试一次豁免。若你在说话，注目术获得语言（特征）。

大成功 目标不受影响，并注意到你试图使用魔法。

成功 目标不必注意，但不会注意到你试图使用魔法（它可能会注意到其他人被迷魂）。

失败 目标对你处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂} 状态。若它目睹了它不同意的动作或言辞，它可以再尝试一次意志豁免。若其成功，它不再迷魂，并在 1 小时内暂时免疫。若目标遭受敌对行为，或若另一名生物对其进行一次交涉或威吓检定并成功，则迷魂立即结束。

大失败 如失败，但若目标不同意你，它无法尝试豁免来结束迷魂。

Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the Spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer Fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.

Remove Disease.name: 移除疾病 Remove Disease
Remove Disease.description:
治疗魔法从生物的身体中清除疾病。你尝试反制一个折磨目标的疾病。

Healing magic purges disease from a creature's body. You attempt to counteract one disease afflicting the target.

Glitterdust.name: 闪光尘 Glitterdust
Glitterdust.description:
区域内的生物会被闪耀的尘埃勾勒出轮廓。每个生物都必须尝试一次反射豁免。若某生物的隐形术被该法术抵消，则其为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。无论该生物原本已处于Invisible状态，还是在该法术造成的隐形术抵消效果结束前获得新的隐形术效果，此规则均适用。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的隐形术被抵消2轮。

失败 目标在1分钟内为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}，且其隐形术被抵消1分钟。

大失败 目标在1轮内为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}，并在10分钟内为Dazzled。其隐形术被抵消10分钟。

Creatures in the area are outlined by glittering dust. Each creature must attempt a Reflex save. If a creature has its invisibility negated by this spell, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This applies both if the creature was already Invisible and if it benefits from new invisibility effects before the end of the invisibility negation effect from this spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's invisibility is negated for 2 rounds.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute and its invisibility is negated for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and Dazzled for 10 minutes. Its invisibility is negated for 10 minutes.

Hideous Laughter.name: 狂笑术 Hideous Laughter
Hideous Laughter.description:
目标被无法控制的大笑所淹没。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标被无法控制的大笑所折磨。它不能使用反应动作。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}且不能使用反应动作。

大失败 目标倒下并处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}，并且在1轮内不能使用动作或反应动作。之后它承受失败效果。

The target is overtaken with uncontrollable laughter. It must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is plagued with uncontrollable laughter. It can't use reactions.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and can't use actions or reactions for 1 round. It then suffers the failure effects.

Restoration.name: 复原术 Restoration
Restoration.description:
复原性的魔法用于对抗毒素的效果或阻止生物以最佳状态运作的状态。当你施放复原术时，选择降低一种状态或减轻一种毒素的效果。一名生物每天只能从一个复原术法术中获益一次，且对于同一种毒素的同一次暴露，它不能多次从复原术中获益以降低其阶段。

  • 减轻毒素 将目标所承受的一种毒素的阶段降低1个阶段。这不能将阶段降低到低于阶段1，也不能治愈苦难。
  • 降低状态 将目标的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}呆滞（状态）的状态值降低2。你也可以改为将列表中的两种状态各降低1。

升阶（4环） 将@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}加入你可降低的状态列表。当你减轻一种毒素时，将其阶段降低2个阶段。你还获得第三个选项，允许你将目标的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}毁灭（状态）的状态值降低1。你不能用此选项来降低永久的毁灭（状态）。

升阶（6环） 如同4环复原术，但如果你在施放法术时额外加入一个施法动作与一个材料成分，并在此过程中提供价值100 gp的钻石粉尘作为代价，你就可以降低永久的毁灭（状态）。

Restorative magic counters the effects of toxins or conditions that prevent a creature from functioning at its best. When you cast restoration, choose to either reduce a condition or lessen the effect of a toxin. A creature can benefit from only one restoration spell each day, and it can't benefit from restoration more than once to reduce the stage of the same exposure to a given toxin.

  • Lessen a Toxin Reduce the stage of one toxin the target suffers from by one stage. This can't reduce the stage below stage 1 or cure the affliction.
  • Reduce a Condition Reduce the value of the target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition by 2. You can instead reduce two of the listed conditions by 1 each.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} to the list of conditions you can reduce. When you lessen a toxin, reduce the stage by two. You also gain a third option that allows you to reduce the target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} value by 1. You can't use this to reduce a permanent Doomed condition.

Heightened (6th) As the 4th-rank restoration, but you can reduce a permanent Doomed condition if you add a spellcasting action and a material component while Casting the Spell, during which you provide 100 gp worth of diamond dust as a cost.

Web.name: 蛛网术 Web
Web.description:
你在区域内创造出一片黏稠的蛛网术，每当生物试图穿过时都会阻碍其移动。被蛛网术填满的方格为困难地形。每个方格都可以通过一次攻击或效果清除，只要其造成至少5点挥砍伤害或1点火焰伤害。一个方格的AC为5，并且其豁免会自动失败。

每当蛛网术中的生物开始使用一个移动动作，或在移动动作期间进入蛛网术时，它必须尝试一次运动检定或反射豁免，对抗你的法术DC，以避免其各项速度受到环境减值或变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足（状态）}。生物一旦离开蛛网术，便不再承受来自蛛网术的对其速度的环境减值。

大成功 该生物不受影响，并且在本回合中不需要再对蛛网术进行进一步的运动检定或豁免。若其使用了运动检定，则在离开一个方格后，会清除它所离开的每个方格中的蛛网术。

成功 该生物在其动作期间不受影响。若其使用了运动检定，则在离开一个方格后，会清除它所离开的每个方格中的蛛网术。

失败 该生物的各项速度受到-10尺环境减值，持续至其下一回合开始。

大失败 该生物禁足（状态），持续至其下一回合开始；之后，其各项速度受到-10尺环境减值，持续1轮。它可以尝试逃脱以移除其禁足（状态）。

升阶（4环） 该法术的区域增至20尺爆发，且其射程增至60尺。

You create a sticky web in the area that impedes creatures' movement each time they try to move through it. Squares filled with the web are difficult terrain. Each square can be cleared of the web by a single attack or effect that deals at least 5 slashing damage or 1 fire damage. A square has AC 5, and it automatically fails its saving throws.

Each time a creature in the web begins to use a move action or enters the web during a move action, it must attempt an Athletics check or Reflex save against your spell DC to avoid taking a circumstance penalty to its Speeds or becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. A creature that gets out of the web ceases to take a circumstance penalty to its Speed from the web.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected, and it doesn't need to attempt further Athletics checks or saving throws against the web this turn. If it used an Athletics check, it clears the web from every square it leaves after leaving the square.

Success The creature is unaffected during its action. If it used an Athletics check, it clears the web from every square it leaves after leaving the square.

Failure The creature takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is Immobilized until the start of its next turn, after which it takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape to remove its Immobilized condition.

Heightened (4th) The spell's area increases to a 20-foot burst, and its range increases to 60 feet.

Charm.name: 魅惑术 Charm
Charm.description:
对目标而言，你的话语如蜜般甜美，你的容貌仿佛笼罩在梦幻般的薄雾中。它必须尝试一次意志豁免；如果你或你的盟友最近威胁过它或对它使用了敌对动作，则该豁免获得+4环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。如果你对目标使用敌对动作，则法术结束。当法术结束时，目标未必会意识到自己曾被魅惑术影响，除非它对你的友谊或你说服它采取的动作与它的预期相冲突；这意味着你有可能通过普通手段说服目标继续当你的朋友。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响，并且知晓你试图对它施展魅惑术。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害的东西而非魅惑术，除非它辨识出该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友善}。若它原本为友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于助人}。它不能对你使用敌对动作。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标对你的态度变为乐于助人，并且它不能对你使用敌对动作。

升阶（4环） 持续时间持续到你下次进行每日准备为止。

升阶（8环） 持续时间持续到你下次进行每日准备为止，且你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮(术)，彼此之间任意两者相距不超过10英尺。每个都如同火把般发光。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮(术)移动至多60英尺。每个光亮(术)必须保持在你120英尺内，并且与所有其他光亮(术)相距不超过10英尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Disrupt Undead.name: 打击死灵 Disrupt Undead
Disrupt Undead.description:
你用能量刺击目标。你造成2d6活力伤害。目标必须进行一次基础强韧豁免。如果该生物在豁免中大失败，它还会在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You lance the target with energy. You deal 2d6 vitality damage. The target must attempt a basic Fortitude save. If the creature critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Faerie Dust.name: 仙子之尘 Faerie Dust
Faerie Dust.description:
你在法术的区域中撒下魔法尘土，使其中的目标更容易被欺骗。区域内的每个生物都必须尝试一次意志豁免。你每额外用一个动作施放该法术，爆发的半径便增加5英尺。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物不能使用反应动作（）并在察觉检定与意志豁免中承受-2状态减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.LHREWCGPkWsc4GGJ]{法术效果：仙子之尘（失败）}

大失败 同失败，且该生物在1分钟内还会在察觉检定与意志豁免中承受-1状态减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.pcK88HqL6LjBNH2h]{法术效果：仙子之尘（大失败）}

升阶（+3） 初始半径增加5英尺。

You sprinkle magical dust in the spell's area, making those within easier to trick. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. For each additional action you use Casting the Spell, the burst's radius increases by 5 feet.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature can't use reactions and takes a -2 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.LHREWCGPkWsc4GGJ]{Spell Effect: Faerie Dust (Failure)}

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature also takes a -1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.pcK88HqL6LjBNH2h]{Spell Effect: Faerie Dust (Critical Failure)}

Heightened (+3) The initial radius increases by 5 feet.

Feather Fall.name: 羽落术 Feather Fall
Feather Fall.description:
触发 射程内的一名生物正在坠落

你使空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落速度减缓至每轮60英尺，并且在法术持续时间内的坠落部分在计算坠落伤害时不计入其中。若目标在法术生效期间到达地面，则不会因这次坠落受到伤害。目标一落地，法术立即结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造一个简单声音的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个正常人同时喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法创造可理解的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

强化（3环） 射程增加至60英尺。

强化（5环） 射程增加至120英尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Gust of Wind.name: 造风术 Gust of Wind
Gust of Wind.description:
一阵猛烈的狂风从你的手掌中喷涌而出，从你施放该法术时所在的位置吹向线形区域的另一端。风会熄灭微小的非魔法火焰，驱散浓雾与薄雾，吹动负载为轻或更低的物体，并推动更大的物体。区域内大型或更小的生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。之后移动进入这阵劲风的大型或更小的生物，在进入时必须尝试该豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物无法逆风移动。

失败 该生物被击倒为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}。若其处于飞行状态，则改为承受大失败的效果。

大失败 该生物被沿风向推动30英尺，被击倒为Prone，并受到2d6点钝击伤害。

A violent wind issues forth from your palm, blowing from the point where you are when you cast the spell to the line's opposite end. The wind extinguishes small non-magical fires, disperses fog and mist, blows objects of light Bulk or less around, and pushes larger objects. Large or smaller creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save. Large or smaller creatures that later move into the gust must attempt the save on entering.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't move against the wind.

Failure The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If it was flying, it suffers the effects of critical failure instead.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 30 feet in the wind's direction, knocked Prone, and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

Heal.name: 治疗术 Heal
Heal.description:
你引导活力能量以治疗活物或伤害亡灵。若目标为自愿的活体生物，你恢复1d8生命值。若目标为亡灵，你对其造成等量的活力伤害，并且它需进行一次基础强韧豁免。你在施放此法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标、射程、区域以及其他参数。

1 (姿势) 该法术的射程为接触。

2 (言语, 姿势) 该法术的射程为30尺。若你在治疗一名活体生物，将恢复的生命值提高8点

3 (材料, 姿势, 言语) 你在一个30尺散发中散布活力能量。这会以爆发为目标影响其中所有活体与亡灵生物。

升阶（+1） 治疗或伤害的数值提高1d8，且2动作版本的额外治疗提高8点。

You channel vitality energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8

3 (material, somatic, verbal) You disperse vitality energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Pest Form.name: 害兽形态 Pest Form
Pest Form.description:
你变形为一种超小型动物的战斗形态，例如猫、昆虫、蜥蜴或老鼠。你可以决定动物的具体种类（例如老鼠或螳螂），但这不会影响该形态的体型或数据。在该形态下，你获得动物（特征），并且你不能进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{打击}。你可以解消该法术。

你获得以下数据与能力：

  • AC = 15 + 你的等级。忽略你护甲的检定减值与速度减值。
  • 速度 20 尺。
  • 对物理伤害弱点 5。（若你在该形态下受到物理伤害，你会额外受到 5 点伤害。）
  • 昏暗视觉与 30 尺不精确嗅觉。
  • 特技与隐匿调整值为 +10，除非你自己的调整值更高；运动调整值 -4。

升阶（4环） 你可以变为一种会飞的生物，例如鸟类，这会给予你 20 尺飞行速度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ydsLEGjY89Akc4oZ]{法术效果：害兽形态}

You transform into the battle form of a Tiny animal, such as a cat, insect, lizard, or rat. You can decide the specific type of animal (such as a rat or praying mantis), but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the animal trait, and you can't make @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strikes}. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities:

  • AC = 15 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • Speed 20 feet.
  • Weakness 5 to physical damage. (If you take physical damage in this form, you take 5 additional damage.)
  • Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.
  • Acrobatics and Stealth modifiers of +10, unless your own modifier is higher; Athletics modifier -4.

Heightened (4th) You can turn into a flying creature, such as a bird, which grants you a fly Speed of 20 feet.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ydsLEGjY89Akc4oZ]{Spell Effect: Pest Form}

Ray of Frost.name: 霜冻射线 Ray of Frost
Ray of Frost.description:
你发射一道寒冰射线。进行一次法术攻击掷骰。该射线造成 2d4 点寒冷伤害。

大成功 目标受到双倍伤害，并在 1 轮内其所有速度承受 -10 尺的状态减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{法术效果：霜冻射线}

成功 目标受到正常伤害。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You blast an icy ray. Make a spell attack roll. The ray deals 2d4 cold damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Spell Effect: Ray of Frost}

Success The target takes normal damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Stabilize.name: 稳定伤势 Stabilize
Stabilize.description:
活力能量关上死亡之门。目标失去 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死}（状态），但仍在0生命值时保持 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷}。

Vitality energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.

Harrow Fortune-Telling Deck.name: 圣骰算命牌组 Harrow Fortune-Telling Deck
Harrow Fortune-Telling Deck.description:
赌徒与占卜师都使用这种牌组，这副纸牌有数种不同的款式。

常见的哈罗牌组由更高品质的纸张制成，并带有插图——哈罗解牌者通常使用这些牌组。

Used by gamblers and seers alike, this deck of cards comes in several varieties.

Common harrow decks are made from higher-quality paper and feature illustrations-harrow readers typically use these decks.

Religious Symbol (Silver).name: 宗教圣徽（银制） Religious Symbol (Silver)
Religious Symbol (Silver).description:
这块木头或白银上印有代表某位神祇的图像。一些神圣施法者（例如牧师）可以将其神祇的宗教圣徽作为神圣法器，以使用某些能力并施放一些法术。使用宗教圣徽时，必须将其持于一只手中。

This piece of wood or silver is emblazoned with an image representing a deity. Some divine spellcasters, such as clerics, can use a religious symbol of their deity as a divine focus to use certain abilities and cast some spells. A religious symbol must be held in one hand to use it.

Claustrophobia.name: 幽闭恐惧 Claustrophobia
Claustrophobia.description:
当Wrin在地下，或当她处于直径小于10英尺的室内空间时，她会不堪重负。

在这些时候，她处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心（状态） 2}，并且在她离开封闭区域之前无法降低她的恶心（状态）。

Wrin becomes overwhelmed when she's underground, or when she's in an indoor space that's smaller than 10 feet in diameter.

At these times, she is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and can't reduce her sickened condition until she's outside of the enclosed area.

Spirit Sight (Precise) 30 feet.name: 灵视（精确）30尺 Spirit Sight (Precise) 30 feet
Spirit Sight (Precise) 30 feet.description:
无论是否能被肉眼看见，Wrin都能在30尺内看见具有精魂（特征）的生物。此能力有时还允许Wrin察觉其他超自然灵光，例如凄凉灯塔顶部聚集的灵性能量。

Wrin can see creatures with the spirit trait within 30 feet, regardless of whether they are visible to the naked eye. This ability sometimes allows Wrin to notice other supernatural auras, such as the buildup of spiritual energy atop Gauntlight.

Blood Magic.name: 血统奥秘 Blood Magic
Blood Magic.description:
当Wrin施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{魅惑术}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{注目术}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkS3lDGUpIOMug7v]{仙子之尘}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{幻音术}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tlSE7Ly8vi1Dgddv]{Laughing Fit}时，妖精的华彩幻饰会在Wrin周围或法术的一个目标周围舞动，使其在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。这种明显的隐蔽无法用于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{躲藏}。

When Wrin casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkS3lDGUpIOMug7v]{Faerie Dust}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{Ghost Sound}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tlSE7Ly8vi1Dgddv]{Laughing Fit}, fey glamours dance around Wrin or one target of the spell, causing them to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} for 1 round. Such obvious concealment can't be used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.

Read the Stars.name: 占星 Read the Stars
Read the Stars.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 Wrin 试图通过花费 1 小时研究夜空来从群星中阅读未来——她无法在白天、阴云密布的夜晚，或在她无法以其他方式观测星辰时使用此能力。尽管 Wrin 通常会为某个个体进行这次阅读，或用来回答她所关心的紧迫问题，但在本战役中，她为整个队伍进行占星。她进行一次 @Check[astrology-lore] 检定，使用与英雄当前等级相符的 DC。

大成功或大失败成功 Wrin 的占星读数产生 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pkcOby5prOausy1k]{阅读机运} 的效果，并且英雄在 24 小时内的豁免检定获得 +1 环境加值。

成功 Wrin 的占星读数产生 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{卜筮术} 的效果，但可以预测至多未来 24 小时内的结果。

失败 没有读数。

大成功或大失败失败 Wrin 触及敌对的灵体力量，并且 1 周内无法占星。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.rbgXQqXbpaQCcNNx]{效果：占星（大成功或大失败成功）}

Frequency once per day

Effect Wrin attempts to read the future in the stars by spending an hour studying the night sky-she can't use this ability during the day, on an overcast night, or when she can't otherwise study the stars. Although Wrin usually performs this reading for an individual person or to answer a pressing question she has, for the purposes of this campaign she reads the stars for the party as a whole. She attempts an @Check[astrology-lore] check, using the DC appropriate for the heroes' current level.

Critical Success The results of Wrin's astrological readings have the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pkcOby5prOausy1k]{Read Omens}, and the heroes gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws for 24 hours.

Success The results of Wrin's astrological readings have the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury}, but can predict results up to 24 hours into the future.

Failure No reading.

Critical Failure Wrin brushes against hostile spiritual forces, and cannot Read the Stars for 1 week.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.rbgXQqXbpaQCcNNx]{Effect: Read the Stars (Critical Success)}

Wrin Sivinxi.blurb:
女性魔裔精灵古董商人
Female tiefling elf oddities merchant
Wrin Sivinxi.prototypeToken: 瓦琳·希温尼斯 Wrin Sivinxi

Graveyard Skeleton.name: 墓地骷髅（特征） Graveyard Skeleton
Graveyard Skeleton.tokenName: 墓园骷髅（特征） Graveyard Skeleton
Graveyard Skeleton.publicNotes:
最常见的骷髅（特征）仆从只是守卫。

骷髅（特征）由邪恶的死灵法术将骨骼黏合在一起制成，是最常见的亡灵类型之一，常出没于古老地城与被遗忘的墓地。

The most common skeletal minions are mere guardians.

Made from bones held together by foul necromancy, skeletons are among the most common types of undead, found haunting old dungeons and forgotten cemeteries.
Graveyard Skeleton.prototypeToken: 墓园骷髅（特征） Graveyard Skeleton

Barbazu Vanguard.name: 胡须魔先锋 Barbazu Vanguard

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立刻将自己以及你所穿戴和持有的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到你能看见且在射程内的一处空旷空间中。若这会将另一名生物一同带来——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器里携带——该法术将失效。

升阶（5环） 射程提升至1英里。你不需要能够看见你的目的地，只要你过去去过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。你在1小时内暂时免疫。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dimension Door (At Will).name: 次元门（随意） Dimension Door (At Will)
Dimension Door (At Will).description:
开启一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立即将自己以及你穿戴和持握的所有物品从你当前的空间传送到射程内你能看见的一处空旷空间中。若这会让另一名生物与你一同到达——即使你正将其携带在一个异次元容器中——则该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并知道其相对于你的位置与距离即可。你在1小时内暂时免疫。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Infernal Pact.name: 炼狱契约 Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description:
你向一位强大的魔鬼提出请求，要求它将其部分下属束缚为你服务。如果你成功，魔鬼会派遣它所选择的以下之一给你：1个魔鬼，其等级不超过地狱契约环阶的两倍；2个魔鬼，其等级各自至少比法术环阶两倍低2；或3个魔鬼，其等级各自至少比法术环阶两倍低3。

大成功 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你服务[[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你服务[[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大失败 不仅你的提出请求被拒绝，强大的魔鬼还会将其不悦之情传达给你的主人。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you its choice of one devil whose level is no more than double infernal pact's rank, two devils whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three devils whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Hellforged Glaive.name: 地狱锻造长柄刀 Hellforged Glaive

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Avernal Fever.name: 阿弗纳斯热病 Avernal Fever
Avernal Fever.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:23]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良效果（1天）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{衰弱 1}（1天）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{衰弱 2}（1天）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:23]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 day)

Infernal Wound.name: 地狱创伤 Infernal Wound
Infernal Wound.description:
有髯魔的长柄刀打击还会造成 @Damage[1d6[bleed]]，这会抵抗尝试治疗它的行为。

止血的纯骰检定起始为 @Check[flat|dc:20]。只有在流血的生物或一名盟友成功援助其恢复时，DC 才会降低至 @Check[flat|dc:15]。对带有地狱创伤的生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{施以急救} 的 DC 增加 5。

施法者或物品尝试对遭受地狱创伤的生物使用治疗魔法时，必须成功通过 DC 21 的反制检定，否则该魔法无法治疗该生物。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.inLBsuLRE5xmVHdn]{效果：地狱创伤}

A bearded devil's glaive Strike also deals @Damage[1d6[bleed]] that resists attempts to heal it.

The flat check to stop the bleeding starts at @Check[flat|dc:20]. The DC is reduced to @Check[flat|dc:15] only if the bleeding creature or an ally successfully assists with the recovery. The DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid} to a creature with an infernal wound is increased by 5.

A spellcaster or item attempting to use healing magic on a creature suffering from an infernal wound must succeed at a DC 21 counteract check or the magic fails to heal the creature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.inLBsuLRE5xmVHdn]{Effect: Infernal Wound}

Reposition.name: 重新定位 Reposition
Reposition.description:
触发 魔鬼以关刀打击命中一个生物。

效果 魔鬼将该生物向任意方向移动5尺。其目的方格必须在魔鬼关刀的触及范围内。

此移动不会触发反应动作（）。

Trigger The devil hits a creature with a glaive Strike.

Effect The devil moves the creature 5 feet in any direction. The destination square must be within reach of the devil's glaive.

This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Wriggling Beard.name: 蠕动胡须 Wriggling Beard
Wriggling Beard.description:
频率 每轮一次。

效果 胡须魔进行一次胡须打击。此次打击无视其多重攻击减值，且不计入该减值。

Frequency once per round.

Effect The barbazu makes a beard Strike. This Strike ignores their multiple attack penalty and doesn't count toward that penalty.

Barbazu Vanguard.publicNotes:
胡须魔，也被称为胡须魔鬼或步兵魔鬼，是嗜杀的邪魔，它们通过充当地狱军团的步兵来满足自己对毁灭的渴望，常常带领小魔鬼与莱穆雷等较低等的魔鬼大军投入战斗。胡须魔鬼挥舞带锯齿的长柄刀，造成参差不齐、难以被治疗魔法治愈的撕裂伤口，导致惊人的失血。当敌人靠得太近时，胡须魔鬼会用其蠕动胡须上的尖刺打击，传播一种名为阿弗纳斯热的可怕瘟疫，并享受目睹受害者的力量从体内被缓慢蚕食殆尽的景象。

胡须魔会残忍地满足来自地狱各层的邪恶炼狱领主的怪念头，随心所欲地散播谋杀、苦难与痛楚，并为此欢欣鼓舞。

作为腐化的大师与征服的缔造者，魔鬼既寻求诱惑凡人加入它们对一切亵渎之物的追逐，也寻求将暴政散布到所有世界。它们提供给凡人的诱惑多种多样——从签署一份炼狱契约而被授予的强大力量，到对一位恶魔赞助者低声立誓后得到的扭曲恩惠，或是无数更加隐晦的交换。那些屈服于这些诱惑的人，会被打入地狱深坑中无尽折磨的来世；在那里，唯一的逃脱希望在于有机会被擢升，成为炼狱阶序中的一名魔鬼。每个魔鬼在维持这台冷酷无情的官僚机器——地狱——的运转中都有其特定职责，从士兵与学者到审问官、律师、法官与刽子手。卑微的莱穆雷与小魔鬼为更强大且更专业的魔鬼（如契约魔鬼与厄里倪厄斯）从事卑贱劳役，而最强大的深坑邪魔则命令整支炼狱军队。

Barbazus, known also as bearded devils or infantry devils, are murderous fiends who satiate their lust for annihilation by serving as the foot soldiers of Hell's armies, often leading hordes of lesser devils such as imps and lemures into battle. Bearded devils wield serrated glaives to inflict jagged gashes that resist healing magic, resulting in tremendous blood loss. When enemies come too close, bearded devils strike with the spines of their wriggling beards to deliver a wretched contagion called Avernal fever, savoring the sight of their victim's strength being slowly devoured from within.

Barbazus can be found savagely indulging the whims of evil infernal lords from all layers of Hell, rejoicing as they disseminate murder, misery, and anguish as they see fit.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks. Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly lemures and imps perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as contract devils and erinyes, while the greatest pit fiends command entire infernal armies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.TEzLEXBZzNCp6flg]{效果：本能修补（大成功）}

The morlock Strides up to twice its Speed, during which it attempts a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}. The morlock then can't use Leap Attack for 1 round.

A morlock can share the same space as another morlock, but no more than two morlocks can occupy the same space. When morlocks share the same space, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls.

Warped Brew Morlock.publicNotes:
摩洛克源自早已从光明世界消失的人类，是居住在幽暗地域上层错综复杂隧道中的残暴怪物。它们瘦削的躯体掩盖了四肢的力量与迅捷的反应动作，而它们的手臂长到足以让其以一种怪诞的四肢拖行姿态行动，以提升速度或便于潜行。它们已不再记得祖先曾在地表过着怎样的生活，尽管许多摩洛克仍栖居在其远古家园的破碎废墟之中。一些摩洛克将这些久远年代里人类的雕像奉为神祇，但另一些则转而崇拜拉玛什图、罗伐古格，或其他暴力的神祇。

摩洛克幼崽贪得无厌，为了哪怕最微小的一口食物也会争抢喧闹，若无其他食物可得，甚至会吞食同胞手足。大多数摩洛克都鼓励这种做法，以确保其整个祖裔族群变得更强大。

典型的摩洛克略高于5英尺，体重大约150磅。

Originating from humans long lost from the world of light, morlocks are brutal monsters that dwell in the tangled tunnels of the upper reaches of the Darklands. Their wiry frames mask the strength of their limbs and their swift reactions, and their arms are long enough that they can drop into an uncanny, four-limbed shuffle for speed or stealth. They no longer remember the lives their ancestors led on the surface, although many morlocks still dwell in the shattered ruins of their ancient homes. Some morlocks worship the statues of humans from these bygone eras as gods, but others now worship Lamashtu, Rovagug, or other violent deities.

Morlock young are insatiable and clamor for even the slightest morsel of food, even consuming their siblings if no other meal presents itself. Most morlocks encourage the practice to ensure their ancestral group as a whole grows stronger.

A typical morlock stands just over 5 feet tall and weighs roughly 150 pounds.

Child of Belcorra.publicNotes:
将死者制成木乃伊的文化习俗并不是让尸体得以保存的唯一方式，也不是催生这些传播疾病的不死怪物的唯一途径。

沼泽木乃伊（也被称为泥炭木乃伊或沼泽木乃伊）极少——如果说有的话——离开它们的沼泽领地。比起更臭名昭著、经由人为保存的同类，沼泽木乃伊要弱得多；它们并非靠在仪式中引入的药剂保存，而是由泥炭沼泽或泥泞湿地那种无空气、酸性的泥沼中自然存在的元素所保存。以这种方式保存下来的尸体，当然也可能因邪恶力量施加的诅咒或死灵法师的定向影响而从泥沼中起身成为沼泽木乃伊；但其中绝大多数是出于沸腾的复仇渴求，或为追逐某种在死亡时未竟的可怕计划而自行活动——通常因为该生物被杀害或以其他方式遭到背叛。与生命之间这种情感纽带的本质，以及亡者的情感力量，迫使它们在死亡之后仍延续不死之身；而其尸体被弃置其中的沼泽所具备的防腐特性，则完成了其余的一切。

尽管大多数沼泽木乃伊的动机是复仇，但也有许多只是以一般性的暴力来满足其黑暗渴望。它们充满对生者的愤怒与憎恨，会无情地攻击任何胆敢踏入其阴郁领域的活体生物。它们痛苦的呻吟在其腐臭的栖所上空回荡，驱散了其中大多数自然生命，也常常提醒旅人：在水面之下潜藏着危险。

The cultural practice of mummifying the dead is not the only way a body can become preserved, nor is it the only route that gives rise to these disease-spreading undead monstrosities.

Bog mummies (also called peat mummies or mire mummies) rarely, if ever, leave their marshy realms. Less powerful than their more notorious artificially preserved kin, bog mummies are preserved not by agents introduced during rituals but by the natural elements present in the airless, acidic morass of a peat bog or muddy swamp. While corpses preserved in this manner can certainly rise from the mire as bog mummies as the result of a curse by fell powers or the directed influence of a necromancer, the vast majority of them animate from a seething need for vengeance or to pursue some dire agenda left unfinished at the time of death-often because the creature was slain or otherwise betrayed. The nature of tthis emotional tie to life and the emotional power of the deceased compel unlife beyond death, while the preservative qualities of the bog within which the body was disposed of does the rest.

Although most bog mummies are motivated by vengeance, many fulfill their dark yearnings with general violence. Filled with wrath and hatred for the living, they mercilessly attack any living creatures that dare to venture into their dismal domains. Their agonized moans echo over their putrid homes, driving away most natural life dwelling therein and often alerting travelers to the potential danger that lies beneath the surface.

Murmur.publicNotes:
美杜莎是形似人类、却以群蛇代发的怪异类人生物，以其能将注视者石化的凝视而闻名——若被其目光逗留，便可能将凡人永久化为石像。美杜莎狡诈且善于操控，是精明的对手；她们收集并觊觎秘密，借由威胁与诡计来利用弱小生物的恐惧(术)。美杜莎可能会搜寻强大的魔法物品，运用预言系魔法发现隐秘知识并解锁禁忌力量，或潜入某个社会以蛊惑有影响力的政客。她们渗入强大组织的能力使其自然成为犯罪团伙与盗贼公会的领袖；而她们对魔法现象的兴趣，则促使其中一些人追求成为神谕者的生涯，宣称能帮助冒险者找到他们所搜寻之物——只要付出价格。当然，若机智与欺骗仍不足以奏效，美杜莎也总能仅凭一道冷冽目光，就把对手变成华丽的石质装饰品。

美杜莎异常敏捷，且出乎意料地强韧，即使在走投无路时也很少会从冲突中退缩。许多自以为已准备好抵抗美杜莎凝视效果的冒险者，仍然败倒在美杜莎手下；因为这些生物往往还是致命的弓手，能在远距离用覆有毒液的箭矢将敌人射成蜂窝。尽管如此，若别无选择，美杜莎也可能为保命而讨价还价；而这些强大恶徒所携带的秘密，往往足以让人觉得饶怪物一命大有价值。

Monstrous humanoids that resemble humans with snakes instead of hair, medusas are best known for their petrifying gazes that-if lingered upon-can permanently transform mortals to stone. Medusas are shrewd and manipulative adversaries who collect and covet secrets, and who use threats and guile to exploit the fears of weaker creatures. A medusa may seek out powerful magic items, use divination magic to discover secret knowledge and unlock forbidden power, or infiltrate a society to beguile influential politicians. Their ability to worm their way into powerful organizations makes them natural leaders of criminal outfits and thieves' guilds, and their interest in magical phenomena leads some to pursue careers as oracles who offer to help adventurers find what they seek-for a price. Of course, if wit and deception proves insufficient, a medusa can always simply turn rivals into ornate stone decorations with little more than a glare.

Exceptionally agile and surprisingly hardy, a medusa rarely backs down from a conflict even when cornered. Many adventurers who thought themselves readied to resist the effects of a medusa's gaze have nevertheless fallen to a medusa, as these creatures are also often deadly archers able to riddle their foes with venom-coated arrows from a distance. Still, a medusa may barter for their life if no alternatives remain, and the secrets carried by these powerful villains often make it more than worth sparing the monster's life.

Female feebleminded medusa (Pathfinder Bestiary 234)
