Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮穿透或在该区域内发散。光亮不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源，例如火把或提灯，在该区域内都不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也一样。此效果也会压制你的黑暗术法术位阶或更低的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它像一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

强化（4环） 即便是具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
当你施放该法术时，区域内的所有生物在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的、绚丽且无热的火焰勾勒。可见的生物在受妖火术影响期间不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。若这些生物为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}，则它们在受妖火术影响期间为隐蔽，而非@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮(术)，它们彼此间距不超过10英尺。每个都如同火把般照明。你维持该法术时，可以将任意数量的光亮(术)移动至多60英尺。每个光亮(术)必须保持在你120英尺范围内，并且与其他所有光亮(术)之间的距离不超过10英尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
有时也被称为锁子甲袍，这是一件由与锁子甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。然而，它比锁子甲轻得多，并且只保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Nyzuros's Keys.name: 尼祖罗斯的钥匙 Nyzuros's Keys

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭的箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中由一端的箭羽稳定，另一端装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对所有针对魔法的豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗精神的所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Deft Evasion.name: 灵巧反射 Deft Evasion
Deft Evasion.description:
当猎人进行反射豁免并掷骰获得成功时，他们改为获得大成功。

When the hunter rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead.

Hunter's Wound.name: 猎手之伤 Hunter's Wound
Hunter's Wound.description:
频率 每轮一次

先决条件 猎人正持用一把装填为 0 的远程武器

效果 猎人对其猎物进行两次远程打击。若两次都命中并造成伤害，则目标额外承受 @Damage[1d8[bleed]]。

Frequency once per round

Prerequisites The hunter is wielding a ranged weapon with a reload of 0

Effect The hunter makes two ranged Strikes against their prey. If both hit and deal damage, the target takes an additional @Damage[1d8[bleed]].

Skirmish Strike.name: 快速战斗 Skirmish Strike
Skirmish Strike.description:
猎人可以先以步法移动再打击，或先打击再以步法移动。

The hunter can Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.

Nyzuros.publicNotes:
猎人会去搜寻猎物，以维持卓尔社群的供给与运作。

由于在其主要聚居地中崇拜恶魔，卓尔因而背负邪恶的名声。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主阴险影响的时候。

Hunters seek out game to keep drow communities fed and functioning.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Nyzuros.blurb:
男性卓尔猎手
Male Drow Hunter
Nyzuros.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Urthagul.name: 乌塔古尔 Urthagul

Crimson Fulcrum Lens.name: 猩红支点镜片 Crimson Fulcrum Lens
Crimson Fulcrum Lens.description:
这枚凹透镜内漂浮着一团猩红云雾，宛如缓慢旋转的血液。当你已投入猩红支点镜片时，你会因几乎无法遏制的恶意狂怒而沸腾。你获得对抗恐惧(术)效果的+2物品加值的豁免掷骰，以及你的近战打击伤害获得+2物品加值（若该近战打击为啃咬攻击，则该伤害加值提升为+4物品加值）。你也可以用以下方式启动该镜片。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.ytqvHyF0oMKbo65P]{效果：猩红支点镜片}

启动 2 交互

频率 每日一次

效果 你用一只手握住猩红支点镜片，并进行一次不需要那只手的打击。该打击造成额外1d8精准伤害（若你进行的是啃咬打击，则为2d8精准伤害），且不计入你的多重攻击减值。

启动 2 交互（攻击，占据术）

效果 当你握住镜片时，进行一次近战法术攻击掷骰，其调整值为[[/r 1d20+18]]{+18}。命中时，你迫使镜片中宁布洛斯的一缕本质碎片占据目标。你不再对该镜片投入，而目标获得如同其已对镜片投入时的益处，但无法启动镜片的其他能力。此效果为永久，但可被任何移除占据术效果的效果终止。在占据术效果结束前，镜片不具有任何魔法能力；当其结束时，本质会回到镜片中。

This concave lens has a drifting crimson cloud resembling slowly swirling blood within it. While you have the Crimson Fulcrum Lens invested, you seethe with malevolent fury you can barely contain. You gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against fear effects and a +2 item bonus to your melee Strike damage (this increases to a +4 item bonus to damage if the melee Strike is a jaws attack). You can also activate the lens in the following ways.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.ytqvHyF0oMKbo65P]{Effect: Crimson Fulcrum Lens}

Activate 2 Interact

Frequency once per day

Effect You grasp the Crimson Fulcrum Lens in one hand and make a Strike that doesn't require that hand. The Strike deals an additional 1d8 precision damage (or 2d8 precision damage if you make a jaws Strike) and doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.

Activate 2 Interact (attack, possession)

Effect While grasping the lens, make a melee spell attack roll with a modifier of [[/r 1d20+18]]{+18}. On a hit, you force the splinter of Nhimbaloth's essence from the lens to possess the target. You're no longer invested in the lens, and the target gains the benefits as though it had invested the lens but can't activate the lens's other abilities. This effect is permanent, but it can be ended by any effect that removes a possession effect. The lens doesn't have any magical abilities until the possession effect ends; when it does, the essence returns to the lens.

Effect: Crimson Fulcrum Lens.name: 效果：猩红支点镜片 Effect: Crimson Fulcrum Lens
Effect: Crimson Fulcrum Lens.description:
由 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.yAqGhT0GuZrkvWZl]{猩红支点镜片} 授予

你对抗恐惧(术)效果的豁免检定获得+2物品加值，且你的近战打击伤害获得+2物品加值（若该近战打击是啃咬攻击，则此伤害加值提高至+4物品加值）。

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.yAqGhT0GuZrkvWZl]{Crimson Fulcrum Lens}

You gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against fear effects and a +2 item bonus to your melee Strike damage (this increases to a +4 item bonus to damage if the melee Strike is a jaws attack).

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Eerie Flexibility.name: 诡异柔韧性 Eerie Flexibility
Eerie Flexibility.description:
尽管体型庞大，古格巨人的多个关节使其能够像一只中型生物一样穿过狭窄空间。当它进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{挤入}时，它可以以其全速度移动。

Despite its size, the gug's multiple joints allow it to fit through tight spaces as if it were a Medium creature. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeezing}, it can move at its full Speed.

Furious Claws.name: 狂怒利爪 Furious Claws
Furious Claws.description:
古格巨人至多进行四次爪击打击，每次针对不同的目标。这些攻击都计入古格巨人的多重攻击减值，但减值直到古格巨人完成所有攻击后才会增加。

The gug makes up to four claw Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks all count toward the gug's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after the gug makes all its attacks.

Urthagul.publicNotes:
古格巨人最骇人的特征是其桶状头颅，头颅会纵向裂开，露出层层锋利的黄色尖牙与敞开的咽喉。位于其头颚两侧的眼睛虽小却敏锐。骨质嵴脊保护着它的双眼，使其免受猎物疯狂扑腾的伤害；与真菌和霉菌相比，它更偏好生吃蠕动的鲜肉。它用强有力的手臂抓握猎物，而手臂会在肘部一分为二，形成一对前臂，使其拥有四只带爪的兽掌。这些怪物般的蛮力巨兽覆盖着蓬乱的黑毛，常常结着血迹与碎肉。

尽管古格巨人看似兽性十足，但它们拥有敏锐而邪恶的智识。古格巨人栖身于地下深处，但有时会在黑暗的夜晚来到地表狩猎，或独行，或小群出没。由于它们食欲贪婪，多数古格巨人会吞食所捕获的生物；但也有一些会绑走受害者并退回地下，只留下挥之不去的恶臭与怪异的带爪兽掌足印。受害者被带到腐臭的巢穴中，那里刻着奇异的符文，并被献祭给古格巨人那嗜血、崇拜黑暗与梦魇术的邪恶神祇。可怕的传闻提到，地下深处存在无光的古格巨人城市，由巨大的石块垒砌而成；在那里，强大的古格巨人首领向嚎叫成群的古格巨人宣讲其卑劣教义。

古格巨人与食尸鬼有着奇特的关系，这似乎可追溯至它们在遥远的地下世界共同的起源。古格巨人畏惧食尸鬼，尽管它们的身躯远高于对方；然而，这种古怪的恐惧并不适用于尸妖，古格巨人会像吞食其他生物一样贪婪地吞食尸妖。

古格巨人高达16英尺，重2,000磅，然而它们诡异而优雅的步态与其惊人的体型形成反差。它们轻巧的脚步，以及挤入空间穿过极其狭小缝隙的能力，使古格巨人在关于离奇失踪或血腥屠杀的故事中成为常见的床下怪物。

某些尤其嗜血的古格巨人会从其诡秘的庇护者处获得可怖的赋礼而得到强大力量。这些怪物被称为“贤者”，其力量从不低于第12等级，并会获得数个秘法自发法术。尽管每名贤者所拥有的具体法术组合各不相同，但通常这些法术能赋予隐形术、提供操控并改变岩石的力量，或对活体血肉召唤骇人且具毁灭性的能量。

A gug's most horrid feature is its barrel-shaped head, which splits vertically to reveal numerous rows of sharp, yellow teeth and an open throat. Its eyes on either side of its head-jaw are small but keen. Bony ridges protect its eyes from the frantic flailing of its prey, as it prefers meals of raw and writhing meat over fungi and molds. It grips said prey with powerful arms that split at the elbow into a pair of forearms, giving it four clawed paws. These monstrous brutes are covered with shaggy black fur, often crusted with blood and gore.

Although gugs may seem bestial, they have keen and wicked intellects. Gugs lair far underground, but they sometimes come to the surface to hunt during dark nights, either alone or in small groups. As they possess voracious appetites, most gugs consume the creatures they catch, but some instead kidnap their victims and retreat below the surface, leaving only a lingering stench and odd, clawed paw-prints. Victims are taken to rancid lairs marked with strange runes and sacrificed to the gugs' wicked gods of blood, darkness, and nightmares. Dire rumors tell of lightless gug cities made of titanic blocks of stone far underground, where powerful gug leaders preach their vile doctrines to mobs of howling gugs.

Gugs have a strange relationship with ghouls, which seems to date from their shared origin in a distant subterranean world. Gugs live in fear of ghouls, despite towering over them; however, this strange fear doesn't apply to ghasts, whom gugs consume as voraciously as they do other creatures.

Gugs stand 16 feet tall and weigh 2,000 pounds, although they have an eerie, graceful gait that belies their immense size. Their light step and ability to squeeze through very small crannies makes gugs common bogeymen in tales of strange disappearances or bloody massacres.

Some particularly bloodthirsty gugs gain awful powers as gifts from their eldritch patrons. These monsters are known as savants, are never less than 12th level in power, and gain several occult innate spells. Though each savant's precise mix of spells varies, normally, these spells grant invisibility, offer power to manipulate and change rock, or invoke awful and destructive energies upon living flesh.
Urthagul.blurb:
雄性古格巨人（《Pathfinder 怪物图鉴》198）
Male gug (Pathfinder Bestiary 198)

Beluthus.name: 贝卢斯 Beluthus

Occult Innate Spells.name: 秘法先天法术 Occult Innate Spells

Feeblemind.name: 弱智术 Feeblemind
Feeblemind.description:
你会大幅削弱目标的心智能力。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。此诅咒的效果只能通过移除诅咒或其他以诅咒为目标的效果来移除。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}，持续1轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}，持续时间为无限。

大成功或大失败 目标的智力永久降低到低于动物的水平，并将其魅力、智力与感知调整值视为-5。它失去所有需要心智能力的职业能力，包括所有施法能力。若目标为PC，则其成为由GM控制的NPC。

You drastically reduce the target's mental faculties. The target must attempt a Will save. The effects of this curse can be removed only through remove curse or another effect that targets curses.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} with an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure The target's intellect is permanently reduced below that of an animal, and it treats its Charisma, Intelligence, and Wisdom modifiers as -5. It loses all class abilities that require mental faculties, including all spellcasting. If the target is a PC, they become an NPC under the GM's control.

True Seeing.name: 真视术 True Seeing
True Seeing.description:
你能如其真实模样般看见60尺内的事物。GM会针对区域内的任何幻术或变化系效果进行一次秘密的反制检定，但仅用于判定你是否能看穿它（例如，若该检定成功对抗一个变形法术，你就能看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该变形法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion or transmutation in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Confusion.name: 困惑术 Confusion
Confusion.description:
你用怪异的冲动使你的目标困惑术，使其随机行动。其效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标语无伦次地胡言乱语，并且获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}，持续1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免以结束该困惑术。

大失败 目标获得Confused，持续1分钟，且无法进行豁免以提前结束。

升阶（8环） 你可以以最多10个生物为目标。

You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
你甜言蜜语，令生物难以抗拒。你对目标施加一个行动方向的暗示术，该暗示术必须以对目标而言看似合乎逻辑的方式措辞，且不能是自我毁灭或明显违背目标自身利益的内容。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响，并知道你试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是在正常与其交谈，而不是对其施放法术。

失败 目标立刻遵从你的暗示术。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标完成一个有限的暗示术，或该暗示术变为自我毁灭，或产生其他明显的负面效果为止。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，但基础持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Bind Undead.name: 束缚死灵 Bind Undead
Bind Undead.description:
随着一句力量之词，你夺取对目标的控制。它获得仆从（特征）特征。如果你或一名盟友对目标使用任何敌对动作，则该法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rVkUzqS4rpZp9LS3]{法术效果：束缚死灵}

With a word of power, you seize control of the target. It gains the minion trait. If you or an ally uses any hostile actions against the target, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rVkUzqS4rpZp9LS3]{Spell Effect: Bind Undead}

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你在目标的运动冲动离开其心智之前将其阻断，威胁将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}，持续1轮。

大失败 目标陷入麻痹，持续4轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，将剩余持续时间减少1轮，或在大成功时完全结束该效果。

升阶（7环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Create Undead.name: 唤起死灵 Create Undead
Create Undead.description:
你将目标转化为不死生物，其等级上限如表 7-1 所允许。此仪式有许多版本，每个版本都针对一种特定类型的不死生物（例如：一个适用于所有丧尸（特征）的仪式、一个适用于骷髅（特征）的仪式、一个适用于食尸鬼（特征）的仪式，等等），而能创造稀有不死生物的仪式同样也是稀有的。某些不死生物形态（如巫妖）会以其自身独特的方法成形，无法用任何版本的唤起死灵来创造。

表 7-1：生物创造仪式

生物等级 所需法术阶位 花费

1 2 60 gp
2 3 105 gp
3 3 180 gp

5 4 480 gp

7 5 1,080 gp

9 6 2,100 gp

大成功 目标成为相应类型的不死生物。若其等级至少比你低 4 级，你可以让它成为仆从（特征）。这会使其获得仆从（特征），意味着当你对其施放命令术时，它可以使用 2 个动作，而对其施放命令术是一个具有听觉与专注（特征）的单动作。你最多可以同时控制四个仆从（特征）。如果它具有智能且未成为仆从（特征），该不死生物会因你将其唤醒而对你有益，尽管它仍是可憎且邪恶的生物。若它不具智能且未成为仆从（特征），你可以给予它一道简单的命令。它会一心一意追求该目标，无视你之后的任何命令术。

成功 同大成功，但未成为你仆从（特征）的智能不死生物只会对你保持友善；未成为你仆从（特征）的无智能不死生物会放过你，除非你攻击它。它会在当地区域肆虐，而不是遵从你的命令术。

失败 你未能创造出不死生物。

大失败 你创造出了不死生物，但它的灵魂被你污秽的死灵术折磨，心中充满对你的仇恨。它会尝试摧毁你。

You transform the target into an undead creature with a level up to that allowed in Table 7-1. There are many versions of this ritual, each specific to a particular type of undead (one ritual for all zombies, one for skeletons, one for ghouls, and so on), and the rituals that create rare undead are also rare. Some forms of undead, such as liches, form using their own unique methods and can't be created with a version of create undead.

Critical Success The target becomes an undead creature of the appropriate type. If it's at least 4 levels lower than you, you can make it a minion. This gives it the minion trait, meaning it can use 2 actions when you command it, and commanding it is a single action that has the auditory and concentrate traits. You can have a maximum of four minions under your control. If it's intelligent and doesn't become a minion, the undead is helpful to you for awakening it, though it's still a horrid and evil creature. If it's unintelligent and doesn't become a minion, you can give it one simple command. It pursues that goal single-mindedly, ignoring any of your subsequent commands.

Success As critical success, except an intelligent undead that doesn't become your minion is only friendly to you, and an unintelligent undead that doesn't become your minion leaves you alone unless you attack it. It marauds the local area rather than following your command.

Failure You fail to create the undead.

Critical Failure You create the undead, but its soul, tortured by your foul necromancy, is full of nothing but hatred for you. It attempts to destroy you.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你将一名濒死边缘的生物的生命掐灭。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。如果这杀死了它，你获得10点临时HP，并在10分钟内对攻击掷骰与伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死} 值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{法术效果：死亡丧钟}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

Harm.name: 伤害术 Harm
Harm.description:
你引导虚空能量来伤害活物或治疗亡灵。如果目标是活的生物，你对其造成1d8点虚空伤害，并且它必须进行一次基础强韧豁免。如果目标是自愿的亡灵生物，你恢复等量的生命值。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标、射程、区域及其他参数。

1 (姿势) 该法术的射程为接触。

2 (言语, 姿势) 该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个亡灵生物，使恢复的生命值增加8点。

3 (材料, 言语, 姿势) 你在30尺的涌散中散布虚空能量。这将以该区域内所有活物与亡灵生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或伤害的数值增加1d8，并且2动作版本的额外治疗增加8点。

You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (material, verbal, somatic) You disperse void energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Spell Deflection.name: 法术偏转 Spell Deflection
Spell Deflection.description:
一名施法者以精神法术、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{放逐术}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{夺魂}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{神圣敕令}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hVU9msO9yGkxKZ3J]{神圣狂怒}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{占据术}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PHVHBbdHeQRfjLmE]{灵魂爆破}或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ht35SDf9PDStJfoC]{灵魂之歌}以吞噬者为目标时，可以尝试一次反制检定，以解放吞噬者用“吞噬灵魂”所困住的灵魂。若此次反制尝试成功，被困的灵魂将被释放（尽管该生物仍然死亡），并且吞噬者无法使用来自该生物的任何灵魂充能。

除此之外，吞噬者免疫这些法术。

A spellcaster who targets a devourer with a mental spell, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{Divine Decree}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hVU9msO9yGkxKZ3J]{Divine Wrath}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PHVHBbdHeQRfjLmE]{Spirit Blast}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ht35SDf9PDStJfoC]{Spirit Song} can attempt a counteract check to free a soul the devourer has trapped with Devour Soul. If this counteract attempt succeeds, the trapped soul is released (though the creature remains dead), and the devourer can't use any soul charges from that creature.

Devourers are otherwise immune to these spells.

Devour Soul.name: 吞噬灵魂 Devour Soul
Devour Soul.description:
吞噬者触碰一名位于其触及范围内的生物，造成 @Damage[8d6[void]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:31|basic] 豁免）。如果一名生物被此攻击杀死，其灵魂会被困在吞噬者体内。当其灵魂被困时，该生物无法被复活，除非借助强大的魔法，例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} 法术。摧毁吞噬者或成功反制 Devour Soul（见法术偏折）会释放灵魂。吞噬者一次只能容纳一个灵魂。

一个灵魂每来自一名生物的每个等级拥有5点灵魂充能（见下方灵魂法术能力）。吞噬者可以消耗这些充能来施放法术。如果灵魂被释放且该生物回到生命中，则该生物每消耗5点灵魂充能就会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}。如果灵魂充能降至0点，灵魂将被吞噬，只能通过强大的魔法（例如许愿术）才能恢复生命。

The devourer touches a creature within reach, dealing @Damage[8d6[void]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:31|basic] save). If a creature is slain by this attack, its soul becomes trapped within the devourer. While its soul is trapped, a creature can't be resurrected except by powerful magic such as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} spell. Destroying the devourer or successfully counteracting Devour Soul (see spell deflection) releases the soul. The devourer can hold only one soul at a time.

A soul has 5 soul charges per level of the originating creature (see the soul spells ability below). The devourer can expend these charges to cast spells. If the soul is freed and the creature returns to life, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} for every 5 soul charges expended. If reduced to 0 soul charges, the soul is consumed and can be restored to life only by powerful magic such as wish.

Drain Life.name: 汲取生命 Drain Life
Drain Life.description:
当吞噬者用其爪击打击对一名活体生物造成伤害时，吞噬者获得10点临时生命值，且该生物必须在一次@Check[fortitude|dc:24]豁免中成功，否则将成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}。吞噬者之后造成的伤害会在该豁免失败时使该状态值增加1，最大增加至drained 4。

When the devourer damages a living creature with its claw Strike, the devourer gains 10 temporary Hit Points and the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Further damage dealt by the devourer increases the condition value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

Soul Spells.name: 灵魂法术 Soul Spells
Soul Spells.description:
吞噬者施展异能天生法术，但要这么做，它必须消耗等同于该法术环阶数量的灵魂充能（类似于使用法杖中的充能来施展法术）。它可以在施放法术时通过消耗更多充能将任意法术升阶至最高6环。当遭遇时，吞噬者通常有一个被困的灵魂，带有10点灵魂充能。

A devourer casts occult innate spells, but to do so it must expend a number of soul charges equal to the spell's rank (similar to casting a spell using charges from a staff). It can heighten any spell to a maximum of 6th level by expending more charges as it Casts the Spell. When encountered, a devourer typically has one trapped soul with 10 soul charges.

Beluthus.publicNotes:
当恶魔和强大的邪恶施法者迷失在多元宇宙最遥远的边界之外时，他们有时会以名为吞噬者的骇人亡灵之姿归来，吞食生者的灵魂以为其奥术图谋提供燃料。他们的躯体被毁坏又重塑，空洞而扭曲；与此同时，他们的心智也经历灵性的蜕变。他们获得将其他灵魂束缚于自身并汲取其精髓以换取魔法力量的能力，却永远无法在对这种力量的追逐中得到满足。扭曲的幽魂形体在其空洞的肋骨笼中翻涌——那是吞噬者最近吞食之灵魂的具现。

When fiends and powerful evil spellcasters are lost beyond the farthest reaches of the multiverse, they sometimes return as horrific undead called devourers that consume the souls of the living to fuel their arcane machinations. Their bodies are ruined and rebuilt, hollow and twisted, even as their minds undergo a spiritual transformation. They gain the ability to bind other souls to their own and drain their essence for magical power, yet can never be sated in their pursuit of it. Seething masses of distorted ghostly shapes surge within their hollow rib cages-manifestations of the devourers' most recently consumed souls.
Beluthus.blurb:
雄性吞噬者（《Pathfinder 怪物图鉴 2》78）
Male devourer (Pathfinder Bestiary 2 78)
Beluthus.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Caliddo Haruvex.name: 卡利多·哈鲁维克斯 Caliddo Haruvex
Caliddo Haruvex.tokenName: 卡利多·哈鲁维克斯 Caliddo Haruvex

Composite Longbow.name: 复合长弓 Composite Longbow
Composite Longbow.description:
这种投射武器由角、木材和筋腱层压组合而成，以增强其拉力的威力与投射物的冲击力。与所有长弓一样，其巨大的体型也提升了弓的射程与威力。你必须用双手才能射击它，并且在骑乘时无法使用。任何明确仅限用于长弓的能力（例如埃拉斯蒂尔的偏好武器），除非另有说明，同样适用于复合长弓。

This projectile weapon is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Like all longbows, its great size also increases the bow's range and power. You must use two hands to fire it, and it cannot be used while mounted. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a longbow, such as Erastil's favored weapon, it also applies to composite longbows unless otherwise stated.

Greatsword.name: 巨剑 Greatsword
Greatsword.description:
这把巨大的双手剑几乎与其持用者一样高。它的下半截剑刃往往会被略微磨钝，以便在近身战斗中可以握住它来获得额外的杠杆力。

This immense two-handed sword is nearly as tall as its wielder. Its lower blade is often somewhat dulled to allow it to be gripped for extra leverage in close-quarter fights.

Full Plate.name: 全身板甲 Full Plate
Full Plate.description:
板甲由相互扣合的甲片组成，以钢铁甲壳包覆几乎整个身体。它昂贵且沉重，穿戴者通常需要他人协助才能正确穿上，但它提供了护甲所能提供的最佳防护之一。这套护甲包含一件内衬的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zBYEU9E7034ENCmh]{软甲} 以及一副 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ix2vicchE79d6Cl3]{护手}。

Plate mail consists of interlocking plates that encase nearly the entire body in a carapace of steel. It is costly and heavy, and the wearer often requires help to don it correctly, but it provides some of the best defense armor can supply. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zBYEU9E7034ENCmh]{Padded Armor} and a pair of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ix2vicchE79d6Cl3]{gauntlets}.

Caliddo's Keys.name: 卡利多的钥匙 Caliddo's Keys

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭的箭杆由木材制成。它在飞行中由一端的箭羽保持稳定，另一端则装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Frost Composite Longbow.name: 霜冻复合长弓 Frost Composite Longbow

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当死墓骑士被摧毁时，它的护甲会在[[/gmr 1d10 #days]]{1d10天}的过程中重建它的身体——如果护甲被活体宿主穿戴，则会更快。如果身体在此之前被摧毁，该过程会重新开始。

死墓骑士只能通过彻底毁灭其护甲（例如使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{解离术}）、将其运送至造物熔炉，或将其投入火山之心来永久摧毁。

When a graveknight is destroyed, its armor rebuilds its body over the course of [[/gmr 1d10 #days]]{1d10 days}-or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating its armor (such as with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

Sacrilegious Aura.name: 亵渎灵光 Sacrilegious Aura
Sacrilegious Aura.description:
30英尺。当灵光内的一名生物使用活力法术或能力时，死墓骑士会自动尝试反制它，反制调整值为[[/r 1d20+17 #Counteract]]{+17}。

30 feet. When a creature in the aura uses a vitality spell or ability, the graveknight automatically attempts to counteract it, with a counteract modifier of [[/r 1d20+17 #Counteract]]{+17}.

Devastating Blast.name: 毁灭性爆破 Devastating Blast
Devastating Blast.description:
死墓骑士释放出一个@Template[cone|distance:30]的能量。区域内的生物受到@Damage[6d12[cold]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic]豁免）。

死墓骑士每[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Devastating Blast]]{1d4轮}可以使用一次此能力。

The graveknight unleashes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of energy. Creatures in the area take @Damage[6d12[cold]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic] save).

The graveknight can use this ability once every [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Devastating Blast]]{1d4 rounds}.

Graveknight's Curse.name: 死墓骑士的诅咒 Graveknight's Curse
Graveknight's Curse.description:
此诅咒影响任何穿戴死墓骑士护甲至少1小时的人。

豁免 @Check[will|dc:33] 豁免

潜伏期 1小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}且无法移除护甲（1天）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}，生物的速度减少10，且无法移除护甲（1天）

阶段 3 死亡并转化为护甲的死墓骑士。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.6rnB7nK6J6zF4vea]{效果：死墓骑士的诅咒}

This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour.

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:33] save

Onset 1 hour

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}, the creature's Speed is reduced by 10, and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.6rnB7nK6J6zF4vea]{Effect: Graveknight's Curse}

Phantom Mount.name: 魅影坐骑 Phantom Mount
Phantom Mount.description:
HP 58；AC 27，Fort +17，Ref +15，意志 +14

死墓骑士如同 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ]{Marvelous Mount} 一般召唤一匹超自然的坐骑，并将该法术升阶至等于死墓骑士等级一半的等级。

不同于魅影（特征）战马，战马的AC与豁免加值均比死墓骑士低4，且战马拥有死墓骑士三分之一的生命值（向下取整）。

如果战马被摧毁，死墓骑士必须等待1小时后才能再次使用此能力。

HP 58; AC 27, Fort +17, Ref +15, Will +14

The graveknight summons a supernatural mount as per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ]{Marvelous Mount}, heightened to a level equal to half the graveknight's level.

Unlike phantom steed, the steed's AC and saving throw bonuses are all 4 lower than the graveknight's, and the steed has one-third the graveknight's Hit Points (rounded down).

If the steed is destroyed, the graveknight must wait 1 hour before using this ability again.

Weapon Master.name: 武器大师 Weapon Master
Weapon Master.description:
死墓骑士拥有其所持用的任何武器的大成功或大失败专精效果的许可。

The graveknight has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapons it wields.

Caliddo Haruvex.publicNotes:
死墓骑士是不死武者，由一套被诅咒的护甲赐予不死之身。

Graveknights are undead warriors granted unlife by a cursed suit of armor.
Caliddo Haruvex.blurb:
男性死墓骑士
Male graveknight
Caliddo Haruvex.prototypeToken: 卡利多·哈鲁维克斯 Caliddo Haruvex

Shrine Corpselight.name: 圣坛尸火 Shrine Corpselight

Corpse Sense (Precise) 30 feet.name: 尸体感知（精确）30 尺 Corpse Sense (Precise) 30 feet
Corpse Sense (Precise) 30 feet.description:
尸火可以感知射程内的尸体。这是一种精确感官，可穿透厚度小于5英尺的固体障碍。

A corpselight can sense dead bodies within range. This is a precise sense that functions through solid barriers less than 5 feet thick.

Sunlight Powerlessness.name: 阳光虚弱 Sunlight Powerlessness
Sunlight Powerlessness.description:
暴露在阳光下的尸火会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}，且无法Claim a Corpse。

A corpselight exposed to sunlight is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and cannot Claim a Corpse.

Wisp Form.name: 鬼火形态 Wisp Form
Wisp Form.description:
当尸火在与一具尸体融合时被降至0生命值，它会改为被降至1生命值；尸体倒塌在地，尸火以其鬼火形态显现。

在鬼火形态下，尸火为超小型，且除了占据尸体或飞行之外不能采取任何动作。

以鬼火形态开始其回合的尸火必须在其回合结束时尝试一次@Check[type:flat|dc:16|immutable:true]；若失败，它失去1生命值。处于鬼火形态时被降至0生命值的尸火会被摧毁。

When a corpselight is reduced to 0 Hit Points while merged with a corpse, it is instead reduced to 1 Hit Point as the corpse collapses to the ground and the corpselight emerges in its wisp form.

While in wisp form, a corpselight is Tiny and can take no actions other than Claim Corpse or Fly.

A corpselight that starts its turn in wisp form must attempt a @Check[type:flat|dc:16|immutable:true] at the end of its turn; if it fails, it loses 1 Hit Point. A corpselight reduced to 0 Hit Points while in wisp form is destroyed.

Claim Corpse.name: 占据尸体 Claim Corpse
Claim Corpse.description:
先决条件 尸火处于鬼火形态，并且与一具中型或小型尸体相邻；该尸体在过去24小时内未曾被尸火占据过

效果 尸火与尸体融合，使尸体起立，并恢复[[/r 3d6[healing]]]{3d6生命值}。

@UUID[Item.xkt9CKO2VR32gAYf]{效果：占据尸体 - 血肉}

@UUID[Item.qxNwICP84dBEsuS4]{效果：占据尸体 - 骷髅}

Prerequisites The corpselight is in wisp form and is adjacent to a Medium or Small corpse that hasn't been claimed by a corpselight in the past 24 hours

Effect The corpselight merges with the corpse, causes the corpse to Stand, and regains [[/r 3d6[healing]]]{3d6 Hit Points}.

@UUID[Item.xkt9CKO2VR32gAYf]{Effect: Claim Corpse - Flesh}

@UUID[Item.qxNwICP84dBEsuS4]{Effect: Claim Corpse - Skeletal}

Death Light.name: 死亡之光 Death Light
Death Light.description:
先决条件 尸火在一具尸体内

效果 尸火从口中和眼中发出令人作呕的蓝色光束，形成一个 @Template[type:cone|distance:20]。该区域内所有活着的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:18|traits:damaging-effect] 豁免。若至少有1个生物豁免失败，尸火恢复[[/r 2d6[healing]]]{2d6生命值}，超过其最大值的部分转为临时生命值，持续1分钟。

尸火在[[/br 1d4 #Recharge Death Light]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用死亡之光。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到[[/r 1d6[negative]]]伤害。

失败 该生物受到[[/r 2d6[negative]]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐惧 1}。

大失败 该生物受到[[/r 4d6[negative]]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐惧 3}。

Prerequisites The corpselight is in a corpse

Effect The corpselight emits a sickly blue beam of light from its mouth and eyes in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20]. All living creatures in this area must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:18|traits:damaging-effect] saving throw. If at least 1 creature fails its save, the corpselight regains [[/r 2d6[healing]]]{2d6 Hit Points}, gaining any that exceed its maximum as temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.

The corpselight can't use again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Death Light]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes [[/r 1d6[negative]]] damage.

Failure The creature takes [[/r 2d6[negative]]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes [[/r 4d6[negative]]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Effect: Claim Corpse - Skeletal.name: 效果：占据尸体 - 骷髅 Effect: Claim Corpse - Skeletal

Shrine Corpselight.publicNotes:
一只因饥饿而死的鬼火可能会作为一种冰冷、蓝色、发光的海绵状湿润球体复生——尸火。尸火会本能地寻找一具宿主尸体栖身，因为如果不藏在死去的生物体内，它的物理形态会迅速恶化。

A will-o'-wisp that starves to death might rise as a cold, blue, glowing sphere of spongy wetness-a corpselight. A corpselight instinctively seeks out a host corpse to dwell within, as its physical form quickly deteriorates if not hidden within a dead creature.

Chandriu's Remains.name: 钱德里乌的遗骸 Chandriu's Remains
Chandriu's Remains.tokenName: 钱德留的遗骸 Chandriu's Remains

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
有时也被称为锁子长衫，这是一件由与锁子甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。然而，它比锁子甲轻得多，并且只保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Portrait of Volluk Azrinae.name: 沃鲁克·阿兹里尼的肖像 Portrait of Volluk Azrinae
Portrait of Volluk Azrinae.description:
这幅镶框肖像既捕捉了卓尔的美貌，也呈现出他那专横而自负的得意笑容。他的名字刻在肖像底座上一块小小的金色铭牌上。

This framed portrait captures the drow's beauty as well as his imperious, vain smirk. His name appears on a tiny gold plaque at the portrait's base.

Chandriu's Remains.prototypeToken: 钱德里乌的遗骸 Chandriu's Remains

Gorul Vetters.name: 戈鲁尔·缚枷者 Gorul Vetters
Gorul Vetters.tokenName: 戈鲁尔·维特斯 Gorul Vetters

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
该囚犯对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物造成额外1d6精准伤害。

The prisoner does an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Surprise Attack.name: 突然袭击 Surprise Attack
Surprise Attack.description:
在战斗的第1轮，尚未行动的生物对囚犯处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 状态。

On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the prisoner.

You're Next.name: 下一个就是你 You're Next
You're Next.description:
触发 囚犯将一个生物的生命值降至0。

效果 囚犯尝试一次威吓检定，并获得+2环境加值，对其能看见且能看见它的一个生物进行[[/act demoralize options=youre-next]]。

Trigger The prisoner reduces a creature to 0 hit points.

Effect The prisoner attempts an Intimidation check with a +2 circumstance bonus to [[/act demoralize options=youre-next]] a single creature it can see and that can see them.

Gorul Vetters.publicNotes:
大多数最终进了监狱、地牢或牢房的人，都只是在等着他们的监禁结束，试图找到办法熬过那些无尽的、充斥着无聊与匮乏的日子。然而，有些人可能会利用他们在里面的时间来强化自己的犯罪人脉。他们用武力与恐吓在其他囚犯中获取地位，制作临时的武器来击倒敌人，并在有可能逃脱时让自己占得先机。即便是那些不卷入牢房政治世界的囚犯，在一个人们已几乎无所可失的地方，学会为自己挺身而出并展现出强硬的气场，也可能成为生存所必需的能力。

不幸的是，每个社会都有一些人生活在其边缘。尽管良善的社群会努力给予困苦之人援助与喘息之机，但有时——由于经济衰退、饥荒或战争——不幸者的人数会超过社群支援他们的能力。在冷酷的中立与邪恶社会中，贫穷被视为一种永远无法真正根除的必然，或者更糟的是，被当作可被操弄以谋取政治利益的工具。

Most who end up in a jail, dungeon, or prison are just biding their time until their imprisonment ends, trying to find ways to make it through interminable days of boredom and deprivation. Some, however, may use their time on the inside to strengthen their criminal connections. Using force and intimidation to gain status among other prisoners, they create makeshift weapons to take down their enemies and give them an edge if escape becomes possible. Even for prisoners who don't become involved in the world of prison politics, learning to stand up for themselves and projecting an air of toughness can become essential for survival in a place where people have little left to lose.

Unfortunately, every society has people living on its fringes. While good communities work to grant aid and respite to their downtrodden, sometimes-due to economic downturn, famine, or war-the ranks of the less fortunate exceed the community's capacity to support them. In heartless neutral and evil societies, poverty is seen as an inevitability that can never be truly eradicated, or even worse, as a tool to be manipulated for political gain.
Gorul Vetters.prototypeToken: 戈鲁尔·缚镣者 Gorul Vetters

Ziskilly Theed.name: 兹斯基利·席德 Ziskilly Theed
Ziskilly Theed.tokenName: 兹斯基利·西德 Ziskilly Theed

Crystal Sense.name: 水晶感知 Crystal Sense
Crystal Sense.description:
该角色可以感知60英尺内的水晶或宝石，如同使用不精确的嗅觉，射程为60英尺。

This character can sense crystals or gems within 60 feet as if using imprecise scent, with a range of 60 feet.

Effect: Claim Corpse - Flesh.name: 效果：占据尸体 - 血肉 Effect: Claim Corpse - Flesh

Effect: Claim Corpse - Skeletal.name: 效果：占据尸体 - 骷髅 Effect: Claim Corpse - Skeletal

Pharasma's Favor.name: 法莱斯玛的眷顾 Pharasma's Favor
Pharasma's Favor.description:
法莱斯玛赐予摧毁波波灵魂宝石的英雄一个恩惠，其形式为对其命运的短暂、预言性一瞥。这使该英雄在一次检定中获得+2状态加值，即使在其确定该检定的结果之后也可以应用。英雄有1个月时间使用这项恩赐。

Pharasma grants a hero who destroys Borbo's soul gem a favor in the form of a momentary, prophetic glimpse of their fate. This allows that hero to gain a +2 status bonus to a single check, which they can apply even after they determine the check's result. The hero has 1 month to use this boon.

Caliddo's Keys.name: 卡利多的钥匙 Caliddo's Keys

Defaced Iron Key.name: 污损的铁钥匙 Defaced Iron Key
Defaced Iron Key.description:
这把铁钥匙曾刻有奥罗登的徽记，但已被毁损。

This iron key once bore a symbol of Aroden, but has been defaced.

Four-pronged Key.name: 四叉钥匙 Four-pronged Key
Four-pronged Key.description:
这把精致的钥匙采用四叉设计。

This elaborate key has a four-pronged design.

Large Silver Key.name: 大型银钥匙 Large Silver Key
Large Silver Key.description:
这把大型银钥匙若出售，价值10gp。

This large silver key is worth 10gp if sold.

Librarian's Key.name: 图书管理员之钥 Librarian's Key

Nyzuros's Keys.name: 尼祖罗斯的钥匙 Nyzuros's Keys

Round Key.name: 轮钥匙 Round Key
Round Key.description:
这把不寻常的钥匙有一个轮形的钥匙柄，末端带有数个长短不一的齿。

This unusual key has a round shaft tipped with several teeth of varying length.

Rusted Ring of Keys.name: 锈蚀的钥匙环 Rusted Ring of Keys
Rusted Ring of Keys.description:
这串钥匙环上的四把钥匙已经锈蚀得无法修复，但有两把由青铜制成，仍保持良好状态。

Four of the keys on this ring are rusted beyond repair, but two are made of bronze and remain good condition.

Simple Iron Key.name: 简易铁钥匙 Simple Iron Key

Tarnished Silver Key.name: 黯淡的银钥匙 Tarnished Silver Key

Tiny Iron Key.name: 微型铁钥匙 Tiny Iron Key

Bejeweled Spyglass.name: 镶宝石望远镜 Bejeweled Spyglass

Morningstar.name: +1 钉头锤 Morningstar
Morningstar.description:
这件武器有一根短柄，末端是一颗镶满尖钉的金属球。

This weapon has a short shaft ending in a metal ball studded with spikes.

Valuable Parts.name: 珍贵部件 Valuable Parts
Valuable Parts.description:
一组稀有金属与精密道具。

A collection of rare metals and delicate gears.

Black Onyx Gemstone.name: 黑玛瑙宝石 Black Onyx Gemstone

Incomplete Soulbound Doll.name: 未完成的缚魂娃娃 Incomplete Soulbound Doll
Incomplete Soulbound Doll.description:
这具未完成的缚魂娃娃看起来像一个没有手臂和腿的地精。

This unfinished soulbound doll resembles an armless, legless goblin.

Sword Cane.name: 剑杖 Sword Cane
Sword Cane.description:
这把纤细、类似+1 细剑的剑隐藏在一根作为剑鞘的木制或金属手杖之中，使其成为一种不起眼的武器，容易在检查中蒙混过关，或带入上流社会活动。剑杖在入鞘时通常长4英尺，其剑柄末端通常饰有木制或金属装饰盖。

This slender, rapier-like sword is concealed within a wooden or metal cane that serves as a sheath, making it an inconspicuous weapon easy to slip past inspections or into high-society events. A sword cane is typically 4 feet long when sheathed, and its hilt is usually capped with a wooden or metal decoration.

Warhammer.name: +1 战锤 Warhammer
Warhammer.description:
这把武器有一根木制柄杆，末端是一个巨大而沉重的金属锤头。锤头可能是单面或双面，但始终能够造成强力的钝击打击。

This weapon has a wooden shaft ending in a large, heavy metal head. Thehead of the hammer might be single‑sided or double‑sided, but it's always capable of delivering powerful bludgeoning blows.

Hatchet.name: 短柄斧 Hatchet
Hatchet.description:
这把小斧既可用于近身战斗，也可掷出。

This small axe can be used in close combat or thrown.

Pick.name: 镐 Pick
Pick.description:
一把专为战斗而设计的镐具有坚固的木制柄和沉重的尖头，能够造成毁灭性的打击。

A pick designed solely for combat has a sturdy wooden shaft and a heavy, pointed head to deliver devastating blows.

Valuable Books.name: 珍贵书籍 Valuable Books
Valuable Books.description:
@UUID[JournalEntry.PrAuOqj2BsexgBgU.JournalEntryPage.0SO6cXvfRTtHZM6m]{怪谈故事}的莫里宾特会为任何特别稀有或有趣的典籍向英雄们付款。他会为从憎恨魔窟中找回的每1负载书籍支付5金币。包含此类书籍的房间会列出可从中回收多少负载的书籍。

Morlibint of @UUID[JournalEntry.PrAuOqj2BsexgBgU.JournalEntryPage.0SO6cXvfRTtHZM6m]{Odd Stories} will pay the heroes for any especially rare or interesting tomes. He will pay five gold for each Bulk of books recovered from the Abomination Vaults. Rooms which contain such books will list how many bulk of books can be salvaged from them.

Wand of Quench.name: 灭火术魔杖 Wand of Quench
Wand of Quench.description:
这根短杖约一英尺长，并包含一个法术。其外观通常与其中的法术相关。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你以所示的等级施放该法术。

制作需求 提供一次该法术的所列等级施放。

注：要创建特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料库或资料库浏览器拖入PC、NPC或战利品演员的物品栏中。

@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.02J0rDTk37KN2sjt]

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated level.

Craft Requirements Supply a listed-level casting of the spell.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Whip.name: 长鞭 Whip
Whip.description:
这条厚皮革的长绳通常编成辫状，可在一定距离外造成疼痛但非致命的抽打伤害，通常伴随着独特的噼啪爆裂声。

This long strand of thick leather, often braided, delivers a painful but nonlethal slash at a distance, usually accompanied by a distinctive cracking sound.

Composite Shortbow.name: 复合短弓 Composite Shortbow
Composite Shortbow.description:
这把短弓由角、木材和筋腱层压而成，以增强其拉力与弹丸的冲击力。其紧凑的体型与强劲的威力使其成为骑射手的最爱。任何时候，一项能力若被明确限制为仅适用于短弓，那么除非另有说明，它也同样适用于复合短弓。

This shortbow is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Its compact size and power make it a favorite of mounted archers. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a shortbow, it also applies to composite shortbows unless otherwise stated.

Old Law Whiskey.name: 旧法威士忌 Old Law Whiskey
Old Law Whiskey.description:
这瓶早已被遗忘的威士忌被发现藏在走私者避难所一处铺满卵石的壁龛里。

This long-forgotten bottle of whiskey was found hidden in a pebble-covered niche of the Smuggler's Refuge.

Tamchal Chakram.name: 飞轮刃 Tamchal Chakram
Tamchal Chakram.description:
这些环状武器是透肌魔人使用的众多奇异武器之一。锋利的金属圆环上带有大量凸出的刀刃，而倾斜的中央握柄提供了良好的握持，投掷时会带动武器旋转。

These circular weapons are among the many strange weapons used by urdefhans. The sharp metal circle contains numerous protruding blades, while an angled central handle provides a decent grip that spins the weapon as it's thrown.

+1 Resilient Scale Mail.name: +1 强韧鳞甲 +1 Resilient Scale Mail
+1 Resilient Scale Mail.description:
鳞甲由许多金属鳞片缝在加固的皮革衬底上组成，通常为一件长衫的形式，可保护躯干、手臂和腿部。

Scale mail consists of many metal scales sewn onto a reinforced leather backing, often in the form of a long shirt that protects the torso, arms, and legs.

Leng Ruby.name: 冷原红宝石 Leng Ruby
Leng Ruby.description:
启动： 10分钟（构想）；

频率： 每天一次；

效果： 你将注意力集中在红宝石上，它施放一个5级的@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{定位术}法术，该法术只以伊松德赫利为目标。

Activate: 10 minutes (envision);

Frequency: once per day;

Effect: You focus on the ruby, which casts a 5th-level @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate} spell that only targets Ysondkhelir.

Rare Silver Piece.name: 稀有银币 Rare Silver Piece

Ruby of Locate.name: 定位术红宝石 Ruby of Locate
Ruby of Locate.description:
这颗红宝石作为一根形状古怪的魔法魔杖运作，并包含一个法术。

启动 施法

频率 每天一次，外加过载

效果 你以标明的等级施放该法术。

制造需求 提供一次所列等级的该法术施放。

@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]

This ruby operates as an oddly-shaped magic wand, and contains a single spell.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated level.

Craft Requirements Supply a listed-level casting of the spell.

Seugathi Research Notes.name: 双尾虫怪研究笔记 Seugathi Research Notes
Seugathi Research Notes.description:
双尾虫怪的书中包含数幅塑肉残渣巨兽的素描，以及用邪灵语写就的关于其本质的笔记（它包含蛛化精灵与透肌魔人的部分，因此衍生出相应能力）、它对正能量的弱点，以及它在竞技场中被以持续投喂失败实验体的方式保持温顺。此书不只是关于某一只特定怪物的文本，还包含若干对其他生物同样适用的普遍见解。对稀有典籍的收藏家（如莫里宾特）而言，它价值25 gp。

The seugathi’s book contains several sketches of the shanrigol behemoth and notes in Aklo about its nature (it includes parts of, and therefore derives abilities from, driders and urdefhans), its weakness to positive energy, and that it’s kept docile in the arena by a steady diet of failed experiments. More than just a text about one specific monster, this book contains several insights of general applicability to other creatures. It’s worth 25 gp to a collector of rare tomes, such as Morlibint.

Velvet Curtain.name: 天鹅绒帷幕 Velvet Curtain
Velvet Curtain.description:
这幅天鹅绒帷幕的状态非常好，价值10 gp，尽管它重达5 负载，并且隐约散发着地蜥人（特征）的恶臭。

The velvet curtain is in very good condition and worth 10 gp, although it weighs 5 Bulk and smells vaguely of xulgath stink.

Scroll of Dream Message.name: 梦境传讯术卷轴 Scroll of Dream Message
Scroll of Dream Message.description:
从卷轴施放法术需要用一只手持握卷轴，并以施法（行动）启动它，所需动作数与该法术的正常动作数相同。

要从卷轴施法，该法术必须出现在你的法术列表上。因为施法者是你本人，使用你的法术攻击掷骰与法术DC。该法术也会获得与你的根源相对应的适当特征（奥术、神术、灵术或原能）。

卷轴在制作时就已提供任何实体材料成分与费用，因此你从卷轴施法时不需要再提供它们。你必须将该法术所需的任何材料成分替换为一个姿势成分。若该法术需要法器，你必须拥有该法器才能从卷轴施法。

注：要制作特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料集或资料集浏览器拖入PC、NPC或战利品角色的物品栏。

@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.yM3KTTSAIHhyuP14]

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

To Cast a Spell from a scroll, the spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack roll and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when Casting a Spell from a scroll. You must replace any required material component for that spell with a somatic component. If the spell requires a focus, you must have that focus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Game Board.name: 游戏棋盘 Game Board
Game Board.description:
这块游戏棋盘尚未完工，但镶嵌着半宝石。

This game board is incomplete, but inlaid with semiprecious stones.

Dark Chase set.name: 黑暗追逐套装 Dark Chase set

Drow Harrow Deck.name: 卓尔哈罗牌组 Drow Harrow Deck
Drow Harrow Deck.description:
同样被赌徒与占卜师使用，这副牌有数种不同的款式。

精制哈罗牌组由多种材料制成，例如高品质纸张、木材、骨头、象牙或金属。

Used by gamblers and seers alike, this deck of cards comes in several varieties.

Fine harrow decks are made from a variety of materials, such as high-quality paper, woods, bone, ivory, or metal.

Drow Trade Goods.name: 卓尔贸易货物 Drow Trade Goods
Drow Trade Goods.description:
这些贸易货物包括香料、干燥真菌和布料，它们在地表都很罕见。

These trade goods include spices, dried fungus, and cloth that are all uncommon on the surface.

Ruby Idol.name: 红宝石偶像 Ruby Idol
Ruby Idol.description:
这尊红宝石神像描绘了邪神马兹梅兹。

This ruby idol depicts the evil god Mazmezz.

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
此效果旨在用于当 @UUID[Actor.EN3mp0sVObP8ou3p]{杰尔·梅兹勄} 使用他的 @UUID[Actor.EN3mp0sVObP8ou3p.Item.C2q1zvPuwqgQMvwX]{变形} 动作时。它会自动执行以下效果：

  • 调整他的指示物图像以匹配他所选择的形态
  • 在狼形态下，将他的基础速度调整为40
  • 在狼形态下，在他的啃咬攻击上添加一条注记，提醒使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{击倒}。

提醒一下，改变形态也会修改杰尔的打击。他的角色卡上列出的攻击默认他处于混合形态。若他处于其他形态，他可能获得不同的攻击，如其 变形 动作中所述。

人形：

  • 杰尔不能使用他的啃咬或爪攻击。取而代之的是，他的徒手攻击为拳击攻击。

狼形态：

  • 他的啃咬攻击获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{击倒}。他不能使用武器。

This effect is intended to be used when @UUID[Actor.EN3mp0sVObP8ou3p]{Jaul Mezmin} uses his @UUID[Actor.EN3mp0sVObP8ou3p.Item.C2q1zvPuwqgQMvwX]{Change Shape} action. It automates the following effects:

  • Adjusts his token artwork to fit the form he chooses
  • In wolf form it modifies his base speed to 40
  • In wolf form it adds a note to his jaws attack as a reminder to use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{Knockdown}. 

As a reminder, changing shape also modifies Jaul's strikes. The attacks listed on his character sheet assume that he is in his Hybrid form. If he is another form, he may have access to different attacks, as explained in his Change Shape action.

Human:

  • Jaul cannot use his Jaws or Claw attacks. Instead, his unarmed attacks are Fist attacks.

Wolf:

  • His Jaw attacks gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{Knockdown}. He cannot use weapons.

Padli's Key.name: 帕德里的钥匙 Padli's Key

I01. Guarded Intersection.name: I01. 设防的路口 I01. Guarded Intersection
I01. Guarded Intersection.text:
通往农场等级的向上通道相当安全，但谨慎的卓尔仍会在此安排守卫。

遭遇

琐碎 9

@Actor[NNpEVaXJBRAQYV5b]{Rikizlia}

一名名叫Rikizlia的阴沉卓尔猎手坐在这里的一张凳子上，用一把小雕刻刀刻着一小块菌木。若英雄们在没有护送的情况下到来，她会加速赶往区域 @UUID[.0VqYZ7IHaN7iM1Up]{I02} 寻求帮助。若有其他卓尔陪同英雄，她会带着明显的好奇心观察他们，但不会停止削刻。

The passage upward to the Farm level is fairly secure, but the cautious drow keep a guard here regardless.

Encounter

Trivial 9

@Actor[NNpEVaXJBRAQYV5b]{Rikizlia}

A surly drow hunter named Rikizlia sits here on a stool, carving a bit of fungus wood with a small carving knife. If the heroes arrive without escort, she speeds toward area @UUID[.0VqYZ7IHaN7iM1Up]{I02} for help. If other drow accompany the heroes, she watches them with open curiosity but doesn’t stop her whittling.

I02. Caravan Staging.name: I02. 商队驿站 I02. Caravan Staging
I02. Caravan Staging.text:
数个袋子、木桶与箱子沿着这座洞窟三处出口之间的墙壁摆放成排。

往返于伊尔达里斯与洛扎丁的商队会在这座洞窟里装卸货物。这里并不总是繁忙，因为商队的行程安排不定，但通常至少会有几名卓尔逗留于此。向东的通道通向一片由幽暗地域蜿蜒洞窟构成的网络。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[OqoWbYOyHDGHEeHV]{卓尔猎手（2）} @Actor[DawBQWRyrM4cKfGI]{卓尔卫士（4）} @Actor[QRjjE4TJNfaDhhQC]{骑乘蜥蜴（2）}

60 XP

英雄们初到时，六名卓尔正从一只套着挽具的大型驮运蜥蜴上卸下货物。若英雄们处于护送之下，或已以其他方式获得了伊尔达里斯的信任，卓尔不会与他们对峙或质问；否则，他们会迅速组织防御。一名卫士需要用2个交互动作解开一只骑乘蜥蜴的系缚，让它与自己并肩作战。战斗开始时，其中一名猎手会冲向区域 @UUID[.i2uY8kRc2Y2TgMRy]{I03}，召集那里的生物加入攻击。若卓尔一方在人数上明显处于劣势或受伤严重，他们会逃入东侧洞窟，并在几天内不再返回。

宝藏

@Item[TaJnEqurF4EwfZBU]{贸易货物}

这些贸易货物包括香料、干燥真菌与布料，都是地表上较为少见的物品。这批货物共计18负载，总价值100 gp。

Several bags, barrels, and crates line the walls between this cavern’s three exits.

Caravans going between Yldaris and Lozardyn load and unload in this cave. It isn’t always busy, as the caravans are on an erratic schedule, but usually at least a few drow linger here. The passage east leads to a network of twisting Darklands caverns.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[OqoWbYOyHDGHEeHV]{Drow Hunters (2)} @Actor[DawBQWRyrM4cKfGI]{Drow Wardens (4)} @Actor[QRjjE4TJNfaDhhQC]{Riding Lizards (2)}

60 XP

When the heroes first arrive, six drow are unloading cargo from a large, harnessed pack lizard. If the heroes are under guard, or have otherwise gained the trust of Yldaris, the drow don’t confront or question them; otherwise, they mobilize a quick defense. A warden takes 2 Interact actions to unhitch a riding lizard to fight alongside it. When combat starts, one of the hunters races to area @UUID[.i2uY8kRc2Y2TgMRy]{I03} to rally the creatures there to join the attack. Drow who are badly outnumbered or injured flee into the caverns to the east and don’t return for a few days.

Treasure

@Item[TaJnEqurF4EwfZBU]{Trade Goods}

These trade goods include spices, dried fungus, and cloth that are all uncommon on the surface. The 18 Bulk of goods is worth 100 gp in total.

I03. Stable.name: I03. 稳定 I03. Stable
I03. Stable.text:
这个洞窟里有半打巨蜥的围栏。畜栏附近堆着一堆杂乱的挽具。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[DawBQWRyrM4cKfGI]{卓尔卫士 (3)} @Actor[QRjjE4TJNfaDhhQC]{骑乘蜥蜴 (6)}

60 XP

三名卓尔卫士通常在这里，守卫并喂养伊尔达里斯的骑乘蜥蜴。这些蜥蜴可以沿着墙壁爬出围栏，但除非被指挥去战斗，否则它们不会这么做。

This cavern contains pens for half a dozen giant lizards. A jumbled pile of harnesses sits near the corrals.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[DawBQWRyrM4cKfGI]{Drow Wardens (3)} @Actor[QRjjE4TJNfaDhhQC]{Riding Lizards (6)}

60 XP

Three drow wardens are usually here, guarding and feeding Yldaris’s riding lizards. The lizards can climb out of the pens along the walls, but they don’t do so unless directed to fight.

I04. Secret Tunnel.name: I04. 秘密隧道 I04. Secret Tunnel
I04. Secret Tunnel.text:
探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{侦测魔法}

这条隧道看起来在南端被岩石堵死，但这处伪装的塌方遮住了一扇秘密门，伊尔达里斯猎人用它在洞窟间进出。对这处死路进行 Search 的角色，可以通过一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:26|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定发现这扇秘密门。任何正在 侦测魔法 的角色或在生存方面为专家的角色都会自动找到它，因为这扇秘密门本质上带有魔法，而且有数道细微的足迹直接通往它。

当有人在说话时说出任何精灵语词句并触碰到一块隐形的魔法墙板，碎石便会向旁摆开。魔法加固了这扇秘密门，因此不可能强行破开。你可以使用 @Macro[89K07qIwYq8bPTmT]{I04 - Secret Door} 在门打开时切换该地块的状态。

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{Detect Magic}

This tunnel appears to come to a rocky end in the south, but this ersatz collapse hides a secret door the Yldaris hunters use to come and go from the caverns. Characters who Search this dead end can discover the secret door with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:26|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. Any character who is Detecting Magic or is an expert in Survival automatically finds it, as the secret door is magical in nature, and there are several subtle tracks leading right to it.

The rubble swings aside when an invisible magical wall panel is touched by someone speaking any words in Elven. Magic reinforces the secret door, so it’s impossible to break through. You can use the @Macro[89K07qIwYq8bPTmT]{I04 - Secret Door} to toggle the tile's state when the door opens.

I05. Yldaris Entry.name: I05. 伊尔达里斯条目 I05. Yldaris Entry
I05. Yldaris Entry.text:
铁皮覆盖着西侧门的外侧，在卓尔眼睛高度的位置有一道狭槽，内侧用一块可滑动的板盖住。门没有钥匙孔或把手，并由沉重的横杆加固。任何想要进入的人必须要么撞破这扇门（硬度 15，生命值 60），要么提供前哨所有卓尔都知道的秘密敲门暗号（偶尔会更换），并等待卫兵为其开门。

东侧通往伊尔达里斯的门采用相同的结构，但通常是敞开且不插横杆的。

遭遇

琐碎 9

@Actor[fxNawCH81AZKWHuR]{Taklitur}

一名名为 Taklitur 的卓尔卫士在门内站岗，准备让任何给出正确敲门暗号的人进入。若卫士听到错误的敲门声，他起初会置之不理，认为只是某个卓尔记错了节奏。若敲击声持续不断，或若他意识到有人正试图破门而入，他就会打开狭槽朝另一侧的人开枪，然后将其关上，并拉响魔法警报。

Iron sheets cover the outside of the western door, with a slot at drow eye level covered by a sliding plate on the inside. The door has no keyhole or handle and is reinforced by heavy bars. Anyone seeking entrance must either burst through the door (Hardness 15, Hit Points 60) or supply the secret knock known to all of the outpost’s drow (which occasionally changes) and wait for the guard to open it.

The door to the east, leading into Yldaris, uses the same construction, but it’s normally open and unbarred.

Encounter

Trivial 9

@Actor[fxNawCH81AZKWHuR]{Taklitur}

A drow warden named Taklitur stands guard inside the door, ready to admit anyone who gives the proper knock. If the warden hears the wrong knock, he first ignores it, thinking another drow is just misremembering. If the beats persist, or if he realizes someone is trying to break down the door, he opens the slot to take a shot at anyone on the other side, shuts it, and raises the alarm.

I06. Watch Chamber.name: I06. 监控室 I06. Watch Chamber
I06. Watch Chamber.text:
一张桌子和几把椅子摆在这间大房间的东北角。墙上刻着一些以流畅字母书写的文字，文字下方还有一排排刻痕。在通往这间房室外的四扇门中，通往西边的那扇门看起来比其他门更结实。

墙上的文字是用精灵语写成的卓尔格言，内容与保持警惕以及守护家园有关。那些刻痕记录了卓尔击退入侵者、并践行这些格言的次数。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[Eu8oqypfXVR7kGIN]{伊罗里克斯} @Actor[OqoWbYOyHDGHEeHV]{卓尔猎手（2）} @Actor[pFPLCspUfJ2FUMcj]{法尔西·奥申迪尔}

70 XP

当英雄们初次抵达时，一名名叫伊罗里克斯的卓尔射手与一对卓尔猎手正在玩纸牌，使用的是一副卓尔版的《哈罗》算命牌组。若遭到袭击，他们会敲响通往伊尔达里斯更深处的三扇门来警告更多守卫，但他们会在此处坚守。

如果英雄们是伊尔达里斯的盟友，卓尔会愉快地邀请英雄加入他们的牌局。赌注并不高，卓尔却会毫不留情地作弊，但这或许会成为英雄们消磨时间的一种有趣方式。

如果英雄们曾在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.fcEo2VAIF0ShGLVB]{F12} 救出卓尔盗贼法尔西·奥申迪尔，他也会在这里参与赌博。法尔西因是伊尔达里斯领袖的远房表亲而颇受看重，但他本质上非常懒散。他会热情地向英雄们打招呼，并坚持向自己的伙伴表示他们可以信任。

和平会面

如果有任何卓尔带领英雄们去与奎娅拉会面，他们会在此停下，并要求英雄在那次会面的持续时间内留下他们的武器。法尔西（或若他不在，则由伊罗里克斯）寄望亲自看管他们的道具。由于禁止将携带武器的陌生人带到领袖面前，卓尔不会在这一点上讨价还价。若英雄们犹豫不决，卓尔会将他们请出门外，并邀请他们在改变主意后再回来。

宝藏

@Item[FyUsI8mE3ZkbmDiT]{哈罗牌组}

这副哈罗牌已经十分磨损，但上面有着不寻常的卓尔遗珍图样。它价值 15 gp。桌旁还放着几摞赌注，总值 24 sp。

A table and chairs sit in the northeast corner of this large room. The walls feature words carved in a flowing script underscored with hash marks. Of the four doors leading out of this chamber, the door leading west looks sturdier than the others.

The words on the wall are drow aphorisms in Elven about staying alert and protecting one’s home. The hash marks record times the drow have repelled invaders and lived up to these sayings.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[Eu8oqypfXVR7kGIN]{Yrorix} @Actor[OqoWbYOyHDGHEeHV]{Drow Hunters (2)} @Actor[pFPLCspUfJ2FUMcj]{Falxi Orshendiel}

70 XP

When the heroes first arrive, a drow shootist named Yrorix and a pair of hunters are playing cards with a drow version of a harrow fortune-telling deck. In the event of an assault, they knock on the three doors leading deeper into Yldaris to alert more defenders, but they make their stand here.

If the heroes are allies of Yldaris, the drow cheerfully invite the heroes into their game. The stakes aren’t high, and the drow cheat relentlessly, but it might be an enjoyable way for the heroes to pass the time.

If the heroes rescued the drow rogue Falxi Orshendiel from area @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.fcEo2VAIF0ShGLVB]{F12}, he’s also here gambling. Falxi is well-regarded because he’s a distant cousin of Yldaris’s leader, but he’s fundamentally lazy. He greets the heroes warmly and insists to his companions that they can be trusted.

A Peaceful Meeting

If any drow led the heroes to meet with Quara, they stop here and ask the heroes to leave their weapons for the duration of that meeting. Falxi (or, in his absence, Yrorix) promises to watch over their gear personally. As it’s forbidden to bring armed strangers before their leader, the drow don’t negotiate this point. If the heroes balk, the drow usher them out and invite them to return if they change their minds.

Treasure

@Item[FyUsI8mE3ZkbmDiT]{Harrow Deck}

The deck of harrow cards is well worn but features unusual drow iconography. It's worth 15 gp. Stacks of wagers worth 24 sp sit around the table.

I07. Tanieth’s Abode.name: I07. 塔尼思的住所 I07. Tanieth’s Abode
I07. Tanieth’s Abode.text:
这间小房间里有一张床，旁边挨着一张桌子。床边放着一个陶瓷杯和一把改装过的手弩。

这里是一名名叫塔尼思的独行枪手的寝室。塔尼思是个独来独往的人；当他不在这里休息时，他就会用另一把无法使用的连发手弩上的零件，摆弄并修理自己的连发手弩；除此之外，他会独自一人在狩猎场巡游。他俊朗的外表与疏离的气质，使他在一些伊尔达里斯卓尔之中颇受追捧。

遭遇

微不足道 9

@Actor[u0Y8kY7CpnrXSHsI]{塔尼思}

塔尼思不喜欢被打扰。他往往先开枪后问话，即使来烦他的是另一名卓尔也是如此。

宝藏

@Item[FZgXiDJeW59vI0rA]{蛋白石（3）}

塔尼思把几件宝藏藏在床垫下面，包括一个装有 50 gp 的小袋子，以及三颗每颗价值 100 gp 的蛋白石。

This small room has a bed and table next to it. A ceramic mug and a modified hand crossbow sit next to the bed.

This is the sleeping quarters for a solitary shootist named Tanieth. Tanieth is a loner; when he isn’t resting here, tinkering with his repeating hand crossbow with parts from another, inoperable repeating hand crossbow, he’s ranging the Hunting Grounds alone. His good looks and remote demeanor make him something of a heartthrob among some Yldaris drow.

Encounter

Trivial 9

@Actor[u0Y8kY7CpnrXSHsI]{Tanieth}

Tanieth doesn’t like being disturbed. He tends to shoot first and ask questions later, even if it’s another drow who bothers him.

Treasure

@Item[FZgXiDJeW59vI0rA]{Opals (3)}

Tanieth has hidden several treasures under his mattress, including a small sack with 50 gp and three opals worth 100 gp each.

I08. Hunters’ Mess.name: I08. 猎人的烂摊子 I08. Hunters’ Mess
I08. Hunters’ Mess.text:
桌子、椅子、脏盘子、空瓶子和餐具散落在这个房间里。很明显，生物在这里用餐，但之后很少收拾清理。

伊尔达里斯的猎手精于其业，并将他们的装备保持在良好状态，但在日常生活中往往很邋遢。除非在吃饭，他们通常会避开这个地方。

Tables, chairs, dirty dishes, empty bottles, and utensils litter this chamber. It’s evident that creatures eat their meals here but very rarely clean up afterwards.

Yldaris’s hunters are skilled at their craft and keep their equipment in good working order but tend to be slobs in their day-to-day living. They usually avoid this place unless they’re eating.

I09. Hunters’ Quarters.name: I09. 猎人宿舍 I09. Hunters’ Quarters
I09. Hunters’ Quarters.text:
这个区域的五张双层床被毯子和毛皮弄得一团糟。每张床脚都堆叠着三只储物柜箱。

虽然不像相邻的食堂那样完全乱成一团，但这间房仍然非常不整洁。床铺没有固定分配；猎手们只要有机会就随便抢一张床。与床铺不同的是，每个上了挂锁的储物柜箱都属于某位特定的猎手。每把挂锁需要进行五次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:30|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃} 检定才能解锁，或进行一次 @Check[type:athletics|dc:30|traits:action:force-open]{运动} 检定来进行破拆。大多数猎手把钥匙随身携带。

遭遇

低威胁 9

@Actor[OqoWbYOyHDGHEeHV]{卓尔猎手（3）}

60 XP

通常至少有三名猎手在此休息。他们会迅速惊醒并直面危险。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.UnDjPxFOs6bldlcM]{木乃伊蝙蝠}

每个上锁的箱子里都有一些私人物品、[[/r 2d10]] gp，以及 [[/r 4d10]] sp。另有一个箱子里装着一只木乃伊蝙蝠。

The five bunk beds in this area are a mess of blankets and furs. A trio of locker boxes is stacked at the foot of each bunk.

While not in the total disarray of the adjacent mess hall, this room is remarkably untidy. The beds are unassigned; hunters simply grab a bunk when they can. Unlike the beds, each padlocked locker box belongs to a specific hunter. Each padlock requires five successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:30|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks to unlock or a single @Check[type:athletics|dc:30|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check to Force Open. Most hunters carry their keys on their person.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[OqoWbYOyHDGHEeHV]{Drow Hunters (3)}

60 XP

At least three hunters are usually resting here. They’re quick to rouse and confront danger.

Treasure

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.UnDjPxFOs6bldlcM]{Mummified Bat}

Each locked box has some personal items, [[/r 2d10]] gp, and [[/r 4d10]] sp. One contains a mummified bat.

I10. Target Practice.name: I10. 练习靶场 I10. Target Practice
I10. Target Practice.text:
一簇凳子占据了这间房的一角，但大部分都是空旷的空间，南墙的天花板上垂挂着几个塞满芦苇的假人。假人上布满孔洞，还有几支弩矢仍然卡在其中。

卓尔射手在这里进行近距离的练习靶场。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜查}

一扇密门隐藏着西侧的储藏室；一名英雄若对房间进行搜查并在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功，便能定位术到它。用于悬挂假人的其中一个挂钩被拉动时，会使门滑开。储藏室里放着废弃的假人，以及一些骇人的菌菇酒。

遭遇

低威胁 9

@Actor[rArZ2y5xqSWeUU0G]{卓尔射手（2）}

60 XP

这里通常有一对卓尔射手在练习。它们竞争极其激烈，因过度专注而无视这间房外的任何声响。

A cluster of stools takes up one corner of this room, but most of it’s empty space with several reed-stuffed dummies dangling from the ceiling on the south wall. The dummies are full of holes, a few bolts still lodged in them.

The shootists engage in close-range target practice here.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A secret door conceals a storage closet to the west; a hero who Searches the room and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{Perception} check locates it. One of the hooks for hanging dummies, when pulled, causes the door to slide open. The closet holds discarded dummies and some atrocious fungus wine.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[rArZ2y5xqSWeUU0G]{Drow Shootists (2)}

60 XP

There are typically a pair of shootists practicing here. Fiercely competitive, they ignore any sounds outside this room, as they’re so focused.

I11. Shootists’ Quarters.name: I11. 射手宿舍 I11. Shootists’ Quarters
I11. Shootists’ Quarters.text:
四张双层床被硬塞进这间房间。每张床前都摆着三只结实的上锁箱子。

卓尔射手往往比猎人更有条理，但这里仍是公共空间。卓尔射手在伊尔达里斯内外不做其他任务时便会进进出出，并随意选择想睡的地方。上锁箱与区域 @UUID[.yPrIOIwi1MtHQGco]{I09} 中的类似。

遭遇

低威胁 9

@Actor[rArZ2y5xqSWeUU0G]{卓尔射手（2）}

60 XP

通常任意时刻都会有一对卓尔射手在此休息。他们会迅速对任何魔法警报或麻烦的声响作出反应。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.1DHjXJEdJ7GlGSzg]{锐锋油}

每只上锁箱里都有个人物品、[[/r 3d10]] gp，以及[[/r 5d10]] sp。其中一只装有锐锋油。

Four bunk beds are crammed into this room. In front of each sits a trio of sturdy, padlocked boxes.

The shootists tend to be much more orderly than the hunters, but this is still a communal space. Shootists come and go when they aren’t doing other tasks in and outside of Yldaris and sleep where they’d like. The lockboxes are similar to those in area @UUID[.yPrIOIwi1MtHQGco]{I09}.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[rArZ2y5xqSWeUU0G]{Drow Shootists (2)}

60 XP

There are typically a pair of shootists resting here at any given time. They’re quick to respond to any alarm or sounds of trouble.

Treasure

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.1DHjXJEdJ7GlGSzg]{Oil of Keen Edges}

Each locked box has personal items, [[/r 3d10]] gp, and [[/r 5d10]] sp. One contains an Oil of Keen Edges.

I12. Warden Barracks.name: I12. 卫士军营 I12. Warden Barracks
I12. Warden Barracks.text:
这个房间里有两张双层床和一张矮桌。

与猎手和枪手一样，卓尔卫士也住在这些兵营里。更守纪律的卫士坚持分配床位，但他们没有带锁的箱子，因此会把贵重物品随身带着，并把个人物品塞在毯子里。

遭遇

微不足道 9

@Actor[DawBQWRyrM4cKfGI]{卓尔卫士（5）}

通常每个房间里至少有一名卫士在休息。当任何一名卫士遇到危险时，他们会呼喊其他人，后者会迅速从自己的房间出来。将这些卫士一并遭遇，对9级角色而言构成一次微不足道的挑战（若萨莱莎·马尔苏拉斯在区域 @UUID[.G6wHEAz23uGrMSdy]{I14}，她会加入战斗，使其成为一次严重的挑战）。

This room contains a pair of bunks and a low table.

Like the hunters and the shootists, drow wardens dwell in these barracks. The more regimented wardens insist on assigned bunks, but they don’t have lockboxes and thus keep their valuables with them and their personal items tucked inside their blankets.

Encounter

Trivial 9

@Actor[DawBQWRyrM4cKfGI]{Drow Wardens (5)}

There’s typically at least one warden resting in each room. When any are in danger, they call out for the others, who quickly come out of their rooms. Encountering these wardens together constitutes a Trivial challenge for 9th-level characters (if Salaisa Malthulas is present in area @UUID[.G6wHEAz23uGrMSdy]{I14}, she joins the fight, making this a severe challenge).

I13. Overflow Lodging.name: I13. 客房 I13. Overflow Lodging
I13. Overflow Lodging.text:
这间房里有一对双层床铺，每张床的床垫上都放着一卷仔细折叠的铺盖。在每张床的床尾各放着一对带有挂锁与钥匙的坚固箱。

与任何边境前哨一样，伊尔达里斯的人口会随着商队在任意时刻的往来而增减。这些房间预留给访客，夸拉将它们提供给英雄们。空置的储物柜箱与挂锁与区域 @UUID[.yPrIOIwi1MtHQGco]{I09}中的相同。

This room contains a pair of bunks, each with a carefully folded bedroll atop the mattress. At the foot of each sits a pair of strongboxes with padlocks and keys.

As with any border outpost, Yldaris’s population waxes and wanes with caravans coming and going at any given time. These rooms are set aside for visitors, and Quara offers them to the heroes. The empty locker boxes and padlocks are like those in area @UUID[.yPrIOIwi1MtHQGco]{I09}.

I14. Master Warden’s Quarters.name: I14. 卫队长卧室 I14. Master Warden’s Quarters
I14. Master Warden’s Quarters.text:
卫士长萨莱莎·马尔苏拉斯会把自己卧室的门锁上，并携带唯一的钥匙。要解锁需要五次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:30|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} 检定，或进行一次 @Check[type:athletics|dc:33|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} 检定以破拆。

这间房间整洁干净。里面有一张床、一张小书桌和一个大箱子。

伊尔达里斯的卓尔在夸拉不在时都会依靠萨莱莎来领导。如果夸拉出了什么事，萨莱莎就会成为伊尔达里斯的下一任领袖。

书桌里有大量关于伊尔达里斯卫士的笔记：他们的名字、日程、个人怪癖，以及其他能证明萨莱莎正密切监视他们所有人的证据。箱子里只装有个人物品。

萨莱莎一直在四处活动，除了睡觉外几乎不用她的房间做任何事。英雄们可能在伊尔达里斯内或其附近的任何地方遭遇萨莱莎。她不像夸拉那样对英雄们友善，并且担心让身份不明的地表住民待在伊尔达里斯会使整个社群陷入风险。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[bif3iQcDPi27rx6x]{萨莱莎·马尔苏拉斯}

80 XP

在战斗中，萨莱莎会迅速向附近的任何卓尔（Seeks）动作以寻求援助。她不愿让对手逃走，因为她不想之后再与他们交战。她对伊尔达里斯绝对忠诚，并会战至死以保护它。

宝藏

@Item[jhpu9VZ9JreQaZOO]{红宝石神像}

萨莱莎的书桌里有从访客身上没收的可疑物品，其中包括一尊邪神马兹梅兹的红宝石神像，价值 40 gp。

Master Warden Salaisa Malthulas keeps the door to her bedroom locked and carries the only key. It requires five successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:30|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks to unlock or a single @Check[type:athletics|dc:33|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check to Force Open.

This room is tidy and clean. It contains a bed, a small desk, and a large trunk.

Yldaris drow all look to Salaisa for leadership when Quara isn’t around. If something happens to Quara, Salaisa becomes Yldaris’s next leader.

The desk contains extensive notes about the wardens of Yldaris: their names, schedules, personal quirks, and other evidence that Salaisa is watching them all very closely. The trunk contains only personal items.

Salaisa is continuously on the move and rarely uses her room for anything but sleep. The heroes might encounter Salaisa anywhere in or near Yldaris. She isn’t nearly as friendly with the heroes as Quara is, and she’s concerned that having unknown surface dwellers in Yldaris puts the whole community at risk.

Encounter

MODerate 9

@Actor[bif3iQcDPi27rx6x]{Salaisa Malthulas}

80 XP

In a fight, Salaisa quickly seeks aid from any nearby drow. She’s reluctant to let opponents flee because she doesn’t want to fight them again later. She’s utterly loyal to Yldaris, and she fights to the death to protect it.

Treasure

@Item[jhpu9VZ9JreQaZOO]{Ruby Idol}

Salaisa’s desk contains suspicious items confiscated from visitors, including a ruby idol of the evil god Mazmezz worth 40 gp.

I15. Common Area.name: I15. 公共区域 I15. Common Area
I15. Common Area.text:
这间大房间里有几张配长凳的桌子，以及几把带软垫的椅子。墙上挂着并被填充、装裱起来的奇异生物头颅。

这些头颅是狩猎场中被杀死的生物战利品。包括一只白化石化蜥蜴、一只甲伏怪、一只以太蜘蛛，以及一只双尾虫怪。

南墙上的暗门是单向的；它无法从这一侧打开，也无法在这里被侦测到。

遭遇

微不足道 9

@Actor[DawBQWRyrM4cKfGI]{卓尔卫士（2d4）}

这里在任何时候都有 [[/r 2d4]] 名卫士，在吃饭或交换故事。

This large room contains several tables with benches and a few padded chairs. Heads of strange creatures hang stuffed and mounted on the walls.

The heads are trophies of creatures slain in the Hunting Grounds. They include an albino basilisk, a chuul, an ether spider, and a seugathi.

The secret door on the south wall is one-way; it doesn’t open from this side and can’t be detected here.

Encounter

Trivial 9

@Actor[DawBQWRyrM4cKfGI]{Drow Wardens (2d4)}

There are [[/r 2d4]] wardens here at any time, eating meals or swapping stories.

I16. Kitchen.name: I16. 厨房 I16. Kitchen
I16. Kitchen.text:
数个火坑与带烟道的小烤炉嵌在这间洞室的岩壁上。餐盘与器具堆放在中央的一张桌子上。角落里放着一盆水，水面浮着一层肥皂膜。成摞的木桶与箱子摇摇欲坠地倚在南侧墙边。

伊尔达里斯没有专职的炊事人员。卓尔会自己准备食物，或说服别人替他们做饭（这是输掉赌局或体育竞赛后常见的减值）。

遭遇

微不足道 9

@Actor[DawBQWRyrM4cKfGI]{卓尔卫士（1d4）}

这里通常有[[/r 1d4]]名卫士正在准备餐食。

Several fire pits and small ovens with flues bored into the rock walls stand about this chamber. Dishes and utensils are stacked on a central table. A basin of water stands in one corner, a soapy film across the top. Stacks of barrels and crates totter precariously against the south wall.

Yldaris has no dedicated cooking staff. Drow prepare their own food or talk others into cooking for them (a common penalty for losing at gambling or an athletic contest).

Encounter

Trivial 9

I17. Great Chamber.name: I17. 大房间 I17. Great Chamber
I17. Great Chamber.text:
这间巨大的厅室有着高耸的拱形天花板。中央立着一座小熔炉、铁砧与摆满各式工具的工作台。几张长凳沿着墙壁摆放。

这间房间一室两用，既是前哨的工坊，也是集会厅。卓尔有时会把桌子搬到这里，用于宴会或会议。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.Dlsv1n0Bk1zVJaJM]{Repeating Crossbow Magazine} @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.aDsdYMPpVc8hOnM5]{Superb Repair Kit}

工作台上放着一份连发弩弹匣和一套精良修理工具。

和卓尔做朋友

卓尔的帮助

赢得卓尔的信任，会为英雄们在狩猎场及更远处的任务带来巨大助益。他们不仅能获得一处安全的休息地点，还可以使用前哨的熔炉与工作区（区域 @UUID[.hcb926Op2PfYoVwj]{I17}）来修理，甚至制作物品。此外，商人还能向他们出售任何7级及以下的常见物品，包括来自冒险工具箱的炼金物品、道具与武器。他们手边没有的物品，需要花一周左右时间从洛扎丁取来。

最后，从伊尔达里斯的射手们那里学习的英雄，会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.NwMiszlcqNZWtezq]{卓尔射手}变体的许可。

如果英雄以和平方式处理了与卓尔的接触并赢得了与夸拉会面的机会，谨慎的卓尔卫士会护送他们到此并要求他们等候。几名仆役从公共区（区域 @UUID[.sOpC75joa7ldQh6s]{I15}）搬来椅子，又从厨房（区域 @UUID[.o1v9itp6Cep45ZOE]{I16}）端来食物与菌菇酒。由于几乎没有与地表住民打交道的经验，卫士们既好奇又健谈，但他们会避免让对话听起来像审讯——那是夸拉的特权。如果英雄沉默寡言或无礼，卓尔就会安静等待。如果英雄不明智地发动攻击，卫士会呼叫增援。

不久，夸拉前来问候英雄，周身散发着沉着的掌控力与好奇心。她身旁跟着神情严厉的萨莱萨·马尔苏拉斯——前哨卫士的指挥官；以及两名古怪的卓尔洞窟先知双子：巴兹拉德与克拉索尔。他们静静地站在远处。由夸拉负责交谈。

“你们看起来像地表住民。我从未见过你们这种人，但我见过艺术作品。真奇怪，你们一点也不像我们的画里那么丑。我是夸拉·奥申迪尔，这座前哨的领袖。让我们弄清楚彼此能否互相帮助。”

如果英雄救出了法尔克西，夸拉会补充致谢，感谢他们把她的表亲从“他总把自己卷进去的那些麻烦之一”中救了出来。

夸拉的言语与目标都很真诚。先知们预言地表住民将作为潜在盟友到来，而夸拉愿意相信这一点。

夸拉邀请英雄讲述他们的故事。她会同情艰难之处，在幽默处发笑，在不理解时提问。如果英雄提到支点镜片或向她展示一枚，她会表现出明显的兴趣。夸拉会忽略琐碎的冒犯或粗鲁，但会冷静地斥责任何公然的侵略行为——仅一次。她的耐心并非无限，过分讨人厌的英雄会被要求离开伊尔达里斯，且不得返回。

谈话结束时，夸拉说：“你们给了我一些需要思考的事。谢谢。”随后她邀请英雄在客房（区域 @UUID[.uEordq4ZgyMwVB7O]{I13}）暂住，直到她下定决心。夸拉花了几小时思考，随后押注于结盟。

她把英雄召回这间房间——要么数小时后，要么他们下次回到伊尔达里斯时。巴兹拉德与克拉索尔像之前一样，潜伏在房间边缘。夸拉解释如下。

“我相信你们没有对我说谎，所以我也要对你们坦诚。伊尔达里斯只因贝科拉的意愿而存在。她最初创造那座庞大地城时，这里就已在此；当时，我的祖父是这里的领袖。贝科拉与数个团体结盟，包括卓尔、位于西方的透肌魔人，以及上方那些拥抱了不死的深地侏儒。她给了每一方一枚拥有奇异力量的大型魔法镜片。我想，是为了妥善保管。我们这一枚是赭石支点镜片，它能操纵情绪。
 “但镜片还不止如此。我的祖父告诉了我的父亲劳拉索斯，他继任成为伊尔达里斯的领袖。但我的父亲从未告诉我。”夸拉叹息道，“我本不该成为领袖。我的姐姐才应继承父亲。他们二人在几年前展开了一次秘密远征。在大湖中的一座岛上，透肌魔人军阀库尔费尔抓住并杀了他们。我相信那次远征与镜片有关，我怀疑父亲将它带在身边。也许他把它藏在某处；也许库尔费尔夺走了它。我不知道。”
 “之后不久，贝科拉以幽灵（特征）之身来见我。她坚持要我宣誓伊尔达里斯将支持并援助一场令她至死仍执迷的地表入侵。为了伊尔达里斯的利益，我重申了祖父立下的誓言。但我从不觉得自己会被几句誓词束缚。我不会帮她。我会帮你们。只要你们愿意，你们在伊尔达里斯永远受欢迎。”

英雄若愿意，可以向夸拉提出更多问题，但她所知甚少。不过在谈话将要结束前，巴兹拉德与克拉索尔开口了。

“还有更多……”双子之一说道。他们的嘴同步开合，让人很难分辨究竟是谁在说话。
 “……你们应该知道，”另一名卓尔继续道。
 这显然勾起了夸拉的兴趣，她示意兄弟俩继续。
 “赭石镜片 леж在一个黑暗而潮湿之处。库尔费尔并未夺走它。劳拉索斯将它丢入水中，以免落入敌手。他死于试图了解其真正用途——比我们所知的残缺真相更多，”其中一人说道。
 “我们在异象中看见，这些石片既能强化幽灵女王，也握有她毁灭的关键。它们是某种古老、异质、邪恶而饥饿之物的碎片，”另一人继续。
 “我们看见了空亡之眼！”他们齐声喊道。
 “她将镜片分开，是因为它们若聚在一起，会引来空亡的凶恶注视。即使幽灵女王也无法在诸力合一并汇聚于她体内时抵挡空亡。镜片的秘密藏于那座俯瞰湖面的古老宝藏库。”
 “找到镜片，也找到劳拉索斯所追寻的答案。”

双子先知再次陷入沉默，夸拉回头看向英雄们。她解释道：“我本想说你们会习惯巴兹拉德和克拉索尔，但人永远不会。请相信我，当他们开口时，事情很重要。这些对我而言也是新消息，但他们的话既对伊尔达里斯有利，也对你们有利。”

查阅《呓语芦苇》：

英雄可能在憎恨魔窟更高层找回了一本名为《呓语芦苇》的宁布洛斯传说之书。查阅此书的英雄无需进行回忆知识的检定，也不会遭受书本诅咒的影响，却能找到关于支点镜片的记载。《呓语芦苇》提到，支点镜片中存在宁布洛斯本质的碎片，也许可作为与外神接触的手段。支点镜片拥有不同且强大的（但在文本中并未具体说明的）能力。然而，支点镜片在近距离相互接近时很危险，即便是宁布洛斯的崇拜者也害怕将两到三枚以上聚在一起。使用它们的力量会引来宁布洛斯的审视，并招致毁灭。

XP奖励：

与夸拉以及伊尔达里斯的卓尔结盟后，给予英雄120 XP。

支线任务：

寻找支点镜片并用它们对抗贝科拉，是《憎恨魔窟》冒险路径的主要目标。但夸拉还有一项对她个人而言很重要的旁支任务：她希望库尔费尔被杀，并将他的罗卡剑作为战利品带给她。尽管夸拉十分务实，她仍背负着卓尔常见的恶习——复仇。她会向英雄强调，只要库尔费尔尚有一口气在，就绝不会与镜片分离，因此无论如何，击败他都是必要的。

This massive chamber has a high, vaulted ceiling. At its center stands a small forge, anvil, and worktable with various tools. A few benches line the walls.

This room serves double duty as the outpost's workroom and meeting hall. The drow sometimes move tables here for banquets or meetings.

Treasure

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.Dlsv1n0Bk1zVJaJM]{Repeating Crossbow Magazine} @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.aDsdYMPpVc8hOnM5]{Superb Repair Kit}

A repeating crossbow magazine and a superb repair kit are on the worktable.

Befriending the Drow

Drow Aid

Gaining the drow’s trust is a tremendous boon to the heroes’ mission in the Hunting Grounds and beyond. Not only do they gain a safe place to rest, but they can also use the outpost’s forge and workspace (area @UUID[.hcb926Op2PfYoVwj]{I17}) to repair or even craft items. Furthermore, traders can sell them any common items up to 7th level including alchemical items, gear, and weapons from the Adventure Toolbox. Items they don’t have on hand require a week or so to fetch from Lozardyn.

Lastly, heroes who learn from Yldaris’s shootists gain access to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.NwMiszlcqNZWtezq]{Drow Shootist} archetype.

If the heroes dealt peacefully with the drow and earned an audience with Quara, wary drow wardens escort them here and ask them to wait. Various staff bring in chairs from the common area (area @UUID[.sOpC75joa7ldQh6s]{I15}) and food and fungus wine from the kitchen (area @UUID[.o1v9itp6Cep45ZOE]{I16}). The wardens are curious and talkative, as they have little experience with surface-dwellers, but they avoid conversation that sounds like an interrogation—that’s Quara’s prerogative. If the heroes are reticent or rude, the drow simply wait in silence. If the heroes unwisely attack, the wardens call for backup.

Before long, Quara arrives to greet the heroes, radiating calm command and curiosity. She’s joined by the stern-looking Salaisa Malthulas, commander of the outpost's wardens, and the strange twin drow cavern seers, Bhazrade and Klathor, who remain quietly at a distance. Quara does the talking.

"You have the look of surface dwellers. I've never met any of your kind, but I've seen artwork. Strange, you are not nearly as ugly as our art makes you out to be. I am Quara Orshendiel, leader of this outpost. Let’s figure out whether or not we can help one another."

If the heroes rescued Falxi, Quara adds her thanks for rescuing her cousin from "one of the scrapes he keeps getting himself into."

Quara is sincere in her words and her goals. The seers foretold that surface dwellers would come as potential allies, and Quara wants to believe it.

Quara invites the heroes to tell their story. She sympathizes with hardships, laughs at humorous parts, and asks questions when she doesn't understand something. If the heroes mention the fulcrum lenses or show her one, she takes an obvious interest. Quara overlooks petty slights or rudeness, but she chastises any overt aggression calmly- once. Her patience isn't infinite, and overly obnoxious heroes are asked to leave Yldaris and not return.

At the end of the conversation, Quara says, "You've given me some things to think about. Thank you." She then invites the heroes to stay in the overflow lodging (area @UUID[.uEordq4ZgyMwVB7O]{I13}) until she makes up her mind. Quara spends a few hours thinking, then gambles on an alliance.

She calls the heroes back into this room, either a few hours later or the next time they return to Yldaris. Bhazrade and Klathor are, as before, lurking at the edges of the room. Quara explains the following.

"I believe you've been truthful with me, so I'm going to be truthful with you. Yldaris only exists at Belcorra's pleasure. It was here when she first created her vast dungeons; at the time, my grandfather was its leader.
