搜查宾客的遗骸可发现 48 gp、一个冲刺手镯，以及一支蝰蛇箭。

A pair of brightly glowing chandeliers illuminates a long banquet table surrounded by luxurious, high-backed chairs. The table is still set as if for a grand meal, but some of the place settings are scattered and toppled, as are a few of the chairs. Four skeletons in tattered finery are scattered about the room, some of them clutching their own necks.

When the Roseguard assaulted Gauntlight Keep so many years ago, Belcorra was dining here with representatives of a now-extinct Absalomian thieves’ guild whom she was courting as potential allies against the city. When word came that the Roseguard was handily overcoming the keep’s defenses, Belcorra took no chances. She politely excused herself, bade her guests finish their meal, and magically commanded her chef to poison them all and murder the other servants before taking his own life.

Stairs beyond the north door lead up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.ct0oaB12kXiKf42Y]{C29}.

Encounter

Moderate 4

@Actor[HBRz8BVLVN9u9Odp]{Corpselights (4)}

80 XP

The guests died in excruciating pain, then later became havens for corpselights seeking hosts. When a living creature other than Volluk enters this room, the corpselights within the skeletons begin to glow, and then the skeletons stagger to their feet and attack. Each time a corpselight is forced into wisp form, it flees to one of the adjoining rooms (areas @UUID[.5bfMemKThz7OVUOz]{D02}, @UUID[.pnwZz9VrIshgPSMZ]{D03}, or @UUID[.Ez1TchVZQSMOMh9A]{D06}) to claim another corpse host and return to the fight.

Treasure

@Actor[e2P51BCKzDposq6L]{Guests' Remains}

A search of the guests' remains reveals 48 gp, a bracelet of dashing, and a viper arrow.

D02. Kitchen.name: D02. 厨房 D02. Kitchen
D02. Kitchen.text:
一座怪异、矮胖的铸铁炉子没有烟囱，放在房间的西南角；而北侧，一张覆满烹饪用具的大橡木桌紧贴墙壁。西墙一排橱柜的底部倚着一具骷髅。

炉子会以魔法将从炉火中涌出的烟雾转化为洁净空气，但它嵌入了这间屋子的石造结构之中，且重得不值得费事把它从地城里搬走。那具尸体曾是贝科拉的厨师；在执行贝科拉以魔法下达的命令术——毒杀宾客并杀死其他仆役——之后，他自杀身亡。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜查}

一名英雄若对该房间进行搜查，并在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:19|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功，便会发现北侧有一扇暗门。一些烹饪用具被固定在墙上；以正确的顺序操作它们即可打开暗门。

A strange, squat cast-iron stove with no chimney sits in the southwest corner of this room, while to the north, a large oak table covered with cooking utensils sits against a wall. A skeletal body slumps at the base of the cupboards along the western wall.

The stove magically transmutes smoke welling up from its fire into clean air, but it’s built into the stone of this room and far too heavy to be worth the trouble of hauling away from the dungeon. The body was once Belcorra’s cook, who died by suicide after carrying out Belcorra’s magical commands to poison the guests and kill the other servants.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A hero who Searches this room and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:19|traits:action:search]{Perception} check spots a secret door to the north. Some cooking utensils are affixed to the wall; manipulating them in the correct order opens the secret door.

D03. Storage.name: D03. 储藏室 D03. Storage
D03. Storage.text:
这个房间的墙边排列着橱柜、架子和柜子。房间中央放着几个桶。两具骷髅（特征）瘫倒在桶旁。

这两具骷髅（特征）曾是另外两名仆人，在被厨师谋杀前退到了这间储藏室。这里已经没有任何有价值的东西了。

The walls of this chamber are lined with cupboards, shelves, and cabinets. A few barrels sit in the middle of the room. Two skeletons lie slumped near the barrel.

The skeletons were two other servants who retreated to this storage room before being murdered by the chef. Nothing of value remains.

D04. Wine Cellar.name: D04. 酒窖 D04. Wine Cellar
D04. Wine Cellar.text:
一个高大的酒架靠着北墙，上面的酒瓶在漫长岁月后都积了厚厚一层灰尘。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

这批酒几乎都已变质，但一次成功的 @Check[type:society|dc:18]{社会} 检定足以注意到三瓶 @Item[y7I4CGQOEDY08rTW]{贵重酒瓶}，每瓶价值20 gp。

A tall wine rack, its bottles thick with dust after so many years, stands against the north wall.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Nearly all of this wine has gone bad, but a successful @Check[type:society|dc:18]{Society} check is enough to note three @Item[y7I4CGQOEDY08rTW]{Valuable Bottles} worth 20 gp each.

D05. Level 4 Portal Chamber.name: D05. 等级 4 传送门密室 D05. Level 4 Portal Chamber
D05. Level 4 Portal Chamber.text:
传送网络

憎恨魔窟中的一些@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{传送法阵}构成了一个更大网络的一部分。通过描摹墙上符文的特定图案，有人可以将这些房间中的任意一间内的所有人传送到憎恨魔窟中另外九个传送门房间之一——前提是出发房间与目的地中的传送法阵都已通过@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{唤醒传送门仪式}唤醒（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}）。

这九个房间分别是区域@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}、@UUID[.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}、@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}、@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}、@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}、@UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}以及@UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

该房间的墙壁装饰着扭曲盘绕的符文，这些符文雕刻在墙上，并填充了黯淡的银色金属。地板与天花板几乎完全被巨大的抛光金属圆盘覆盖。

此房间内有一座惰性的传送法阵，与区域@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}和@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}中的相同。必须使用隐藏在区域@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}中的唤醒传送门仪式重新激活这座传送法阵，才能将其连接到地城中其他传送门房间。

XP奖励

英雄们激活此传送门后，奖励30 XP。

Teleportation Network

Some of the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} within the Abomination Vaults form a part of a larger network. By tracing specific patterns on the wall runes, someone could transport everyone in any one of these chambers to one of nine other portal chambers in the Abomination Vaults- so long as the teleportation circles in both the departure chamber and destination have been awakened by the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal} ritual (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}).

The nine chambers are areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}, @UUID[.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}, @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}, @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}, @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}, @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

The walls of this chamber are decorated with twisting runes carved into the wall and filled with dull, silvery metal. The floor and ceiling are almost completely covered with large, polished metal discs.

This room contains an inert teleportation circle like the ones in areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17} and @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}. This teleportation circle must be reactivated with the Awaken Portal ritual hidden in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35} to connect it to other portal chambers in the dungeon.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for activating this portal.

D06. Washing Room.name: D06. 清洗间 D06. Washing Room
D06. Washing Room.text:
这个房间里靠着一张矮架子放着一个满是灰尘的金属洗衣盆，盆里躺着一具小骷髅。

当区域 @UUID[.owO8Ie1yNfI2amxK]{D01} 的客人们正在因中毒而死时，其中一人设法刺伤了一名半身人仆役；那仆役踉跄着爬进这个大型洗碗盆里并死去。

宏

@Macro[yRrjA4MDVSV1ifvW]{D06 - Bath}

如果骷髅被惊扰，盆子会短暂地显得干净并装满肥皂水，然后又恢复为其实际的满是灰尘的状态。刺鼻的洗碗皂气味会黏附一小会儿，约一分钟后才会散去。

这里的宏会播放一段简短序列：在溅水声响起时将盆子注满水，然后在片刻后恢复正常。

A dusty metal washtub with a small skeleton lying inside sits next to a low shelf in this room.

As the guests in area @UUID[.owO8Ie1yNfI2amxK]{D01} were dying of poison, one of them managed to stab a halfling servant who staggered into this large dish washing tub and died.

Macro

@Macro[yRrjA4MDVSV1ifvW]{D06 - Bath}

If the skeleton is disturbed, the tub momentarily appears to be clean and filled with soapy water before returning to its actual dusty state. The scent of harsh dish soap clings for a minute before fading.

The macro here will play a short sequence, filling the tub with water as the sound of splashing plays, then reverting back to normal a few moments later.

D07. Disposal Room.name: D07. 处理室 D07. Disposal Room
D07. Disposal Room.text:
东墙边的地板上有一扇敞开的金属舱口。北侧和南侧各有一个储藏箱，每个都堆满了旧骨头、破损工具和石块。

遭遇

低 4

@Actor[k3Lt3bWBadXvlIbG]{骚灵}

60 XP

在此意外身亡的仆役之灵带着满腔愤懑，化作了骚灵归来。它潜伏在此，处于隐形状态，但在被发现或有人靠近滑槽边缘之前不会发动攻击。它会从垃圾箱中掷出碎片，或使用念动战技将敌人@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}进敞开的舱口。它会战斗到被摧毁为止，但无法离开这间房间。

只要以尊重的方式处理它的遗骸（例如将其火化，或在其上方说一句祝福的话），就能让这只骚灵安息。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

其中一个垃圾箱里的几根骨头属于人类，调查行动这些骨头的英雄可以轻易判断出来。一名仆役在垃圾箱旁滑倒并死在这里，时间是贝科拉在区域@UUID[.owO8Ie1yNfI2amxK]{D01}享用最后一餐的两天前。其他仆役只是把她的尸体抬起来丢进了箱子。

滑入舱口

舱口通向一条长长的滑槽，通往区域@UUID[.JNKEdzHec3VixqB8]{D17}的处理池。任何进入滑槽的人都会迅速滑落到处理池，在这段颠簸的旅程中落地时受到[[/r 3d6[bludgeoning]]]伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:20|basic:true]{基础反射}豁免）。在滑槽中的任何人若不想滑下去，可以通过成功的@Check[type:reflex|dc:18]{反射}豁免来抓住边缘以止住下坠，或通过成功的@Check[type:acrobatics|dc:18|traits:action:grab-an-edge]{特技}或@Check[type:athletics|dc:18|traits:action:grab-an-edge]{运动}检定来撑住身体稳在原地。无论哪种情况，都需要成功的@Check[type:athletics|dc:18]{运动}检定才能安全穿越滑槽。

An open metal hatch lies in the floor against this room’s east wall. Storage bins sit to the north and south, each heaped with old bones, broken tools, and lumps of stone.

Encounter

Low 4

@Actor[k3Lt3bWBadXvlIbG]{Poltergeist}

60 XP

The spirit of the servant who accidentally died here has returned as a poltergeist wracked with indignation. It's lurking here, invisible, but it doesn't attack until it's spotted or someone approaches the lip of the chute. It hurls debris from the trash bins or uses telekinetic maneuver to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} foes into the open hatch. It fights until destroyed but can't leave this room.

The poltergeist can be put to rest by disposing of its remains in a respectful manner, such as cremating them or saying a word of blessing over them.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Several bones in one of the trash bins belong to a human, which a hero Investigating the bones can easily determine. A servant slipped against a trash bin and died here two days before Belcorra's last meal in area @UUID[.owO8Ie1yNfI2amxK]{D01}. The other servants simply hefted her body into the bin.

Down the Hatch

The hatch opens into a long chute that leads to the disposal pond at area @UUID[.JNKEdzHec3VixqB8]{D17}. Anyone who enters the chute swiftly slides down to the pond in a rough trip that deals [[/r 3d6[bludgeoning]]] damage (@Check[type:reflex|dc:20|basic:true]{Basic Reflex} save) upon landing. Anyone in the chute who doesn’t want to slide down can arrest their fall with a successful @Check[type:reflex|dc:18]{Reflex} save to Grab an Edge or with a successful @Check[type:acrobatics|dc:18|traits:action:grab-an-edge]{Acrobatics} or @Check[type:athletics|dc:18|traits:action:grab-an-edge]{Athletics} check to brace in place. In either case, a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:18]{Athletics} check is required to safely traverse the chute.

D08. Lounge.name: D08. 休息室 D08. Lounge
D08. Lounge.text:
这间宽敞厅室的墙上挂满了令人毛骨悚然的绘画，画中描绘各种幽魂般的存在在残破的街区、杂草丛生的沼泽与雾气弥漫的墓园间嬉戏。三张宽大的软垫扶手椅旁配着小茶几，茶几上摆着空酒杯。南侧是一张凌乱的写字桌与其配套的椅子；西侧则能透过立式屏风看见一只巨大的铁浴缸，屏风上绘着阴影朦胧的沼泽。

这间大型休息室曾是贝科拉放松之处，但如今却成了她昔日学徒——卓尔沃鲁克·阿兹里尼——的巢穴。

遭遇

严重 4

@Actor[ZAXuvUW6kl6v3SuW]{沃鲁克·阿兹里尼}

120 XP

与贝科拉时代居住在憎恨魔窟中的大多数居民不同，沃鲁克——某种意义上——仍然活着。他把自己献给一缸经仪式处理的水蛭后，便以可憎的蠕虫行者形态继续存活。沃鲁克看起来像一个大致呈卓尔轮廓的团块，由数千条蠕动的水蛭组成。他一直与如今栖身于@UUID[.nGQeeoAEGLcgnwNz]{贝科拉的旧居所}的虚空暴食者合作，试图修复凄凉灯塔，但他因贝科拉的幽灵（特征）不直接与他交谈而感到沮丧。这个骄傲的秘术师被迫通过虚空暴食者的意志去执行女主人的命令，这令他倍感屈辱。

英雄初到时，沃鲁克正坐在书桌前阅读。他一察觉英雄的闯入，便站起身来——一团扭动、可怖的烂摊子——并质问他们是谁、为何而来。他对建设性的对话毫无兴趣，但如果英雄让他先说，他会用威吓来掷骰先攻。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

暗门

一名英雄在房间内进行搜索，且成功通过一次@Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定后，会发现东墙上的暗门：一幅栩栩如生的墓园画作，可向外摆开。大约每10分钟，暗门另一侧就会传来一声微弱的尖叫，但听起来像是从画中发出的。第一次尖叫之后，寻找此门的DC降为12。

隐藏钥匙

一名英雄在此房间进行搜索，且成功通过一次@Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定后，会发现一把@Item[LJiBdnb79queTNvM]{铁钥匙}，它藏在书桌一条桌腿上的暗槽里；它能打开拉斯达的镣铐（区域@UUID[.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D09}）。

宝藏

@Actor[S75QQzSaqjyjOc2f]{休息室书桌}

书桌上的大多数纸张都是沃鲁克杂乱无章的笔记。对英雄更有用的是，其中还包含憎恨魔窟最上面三个等级的详细蓝图，包括所有暗门。

沃鲁克的纸张中有一张通晓语言卷轴、一张麻痹术卷轴，以及一张蠕虫盛宴卷轴。

写字桌上放着一盏空光提灯。沃鲁克在地面上的旅途中会携带这盏提灯，而他并不知道自己由此引发了关于“提灯陌客”的流言。

The walls of this large chamber are hung with grisly paintings depicting various spectral beings cavorting among ruined neighborhoods, overgrown swamps, and foggy graveyards. Three large overstuffed chairs pair with small end tables, upon which sit empty wine glasses. To the south stands a cluttered writing desk with its own chair, while a large iron tub to the west is visible between standing screens depicting shadowy marshes.

This large lounge once served as a place for Belcorra to relax, but today it functions as a den for her one-time apprentice, the drow Volluk Azrinae.

Encounter

Severe 4

@Actor[ZAXuvUW6kl6v3SuW]{Volluk Azrinae}

120 XP

Unlike most of the denizens who dwelt in the Abomination Vaults in Belcorra's day, Volluk is still alive- after a fashion. After feeding himself to a vat of ritually prepared leeches, he lives on as a hideous worm that walks. Volluk resembles a roughly drow-shaped mass composed of thousands of slithering leeches. He has been working with the voidglutton that now dwells in @UUID[.nGQeeoAEGLcgnwNz]{Belcorra’s Old Chambers} to restore Gauntlight, but he's frustrated that Belcorra's ghost doesn't speak to him directly. Being forced to do his mistress's bidding through the will of the voidglutton galls the proud occultist.

Volluk is reading at his desk when the heroes first arrive. As soon as he notices the heroes' intrusion, he rises up- a squirming, awful mess- and demands to know who they are and why they've come. He has little interest in constructive discourse, but if the heroes let him talk, he uses Intimidation to roll initiative.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Secret Door

A hero Searching the room and who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check finds the secret door in the east wall: a lifelike graveyard painting that swings outward. Every 10 minutes or so, a faint scream issues from the other side of the secret door, though it sounds like it’s emanating from the picture. After the first scream, the DC to find the door drops to 12.

Hidden Key

A hero Searching this room who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{Perception} check finds an @Item[LJiBdnb79queTNvM]{Iron Key} hidden in a secret slot in one of the desk's legs; it opens Lasda's manacles (area @UUID[.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D09}).

Treasure

@Actor[S75QQzSaqjyjOc2f]{Lounge Desk}

Most papers on the desk are Volluk's disjointed notes. More usefully to the heroes, the papers also include detailed blueprints of the top three levels of the Abomination Vaults, including all secret doors.

Among Volluk's papers are a scroll of comprehend language, a scroll of paralyze, and a scroll of worm's repast.

A lantern of empty light sits on the writing desk. Volluk takes this lantern on his journeys above ground, where he unknowingly spawned the rumors of the lantern-carrying stranger.

D09. Lasda’s Lament.name: D09. 拉斯达的哀叹 D09. Lasda’s Lament
D09. Lasda’s Lament.text:
这间圆形厅室的墙壁光滑而灰暗。房间中央翻涌着一缕闪烁、令人作呕的淡蓝色光带。光亮触及天花板之处，石头鼓起气泡，仿佛被感染的血肉。下方，这道光带照在一名被绑在金属桌上的矮人身上，他尖叫着挣扎，身上布满水疱。

如同区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8pbhSFgv71lvCz9M]{B35}，这道光带是凄凉灯塔日益增长力量的显现。这诡异的光亮在房间中央形成一个直径5英尺的爆发。任何活着的生物在其中结束其回合都会受到[[/r 5d6[negative]]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:18|basic:true]{基础反射}豁免），而不死生物则恢复等量。

为了重新启动凄凉灯塔，并在奥塔里墓园进行试射，沃卢克与虚空暴食者需要一个活体生物作为光带的锚点。其他接触光带者会遭受负能量伤害，但光带会以伤害他们同样迅速的速度治疗其锚点，使此人永远处于持续的痛苦之中。

这名受害者是一位名叫@Actor[u36SRb3lyB4beHCN]{拉斯达·范克维尔}的矮人，曾是奥塔里喧闹的石斑鱼的酒保。沃卢克在一年多前绑架了拉斯达，进行邪恶的实验；当时这名矮人正像往常一样在黎明前从石斑鱼步行前往墓园。沃卢克将拉斯达囚禁在@UUID[.u6H893WYAlzxntns]{区域 D11}中数月之久，并因矮人的坚韧而印象深刻，决定用他作为凄凉灯塔的锚点。

遭遇

中等 4

@Actor[wRQ7TZdd0n5UIIao]{鬼火}

80 XP

英雄们若不先击败一只一直以拉斯达的恐惧为食的鬼火，就无法专心营救拉斯达。英雄们初到时它处于隐形，但一旦英雄试图援助这名矮人，它就会在愤怒的蓝色发光中骤然显现。它会追击逃跑的敌人，并战斗至死。

要将拉斯达从可怕的能量光带中移走，英雄们必须先解开束缚他的四副镣铐。镣铐的钥匙可在区域 @UUID[.NHY0hh539X658iSG]{D08}找到，或者英雄们也可以对每副镣铐各自进行三次@Check[type:thievery|dc:22|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃}检定以进行开锁。除非英雄拥有某种从远处操作锁具的手段，否则在每个回合中只要有英雄尝试解开一副镣铐（用钥匙或其他方法），该英雄就会暴露在这条死灵能量光带之下。

一旦脱困并被从能量光带中移开，拉斯达在[[/r 2d4]]回合喘息后恢复行动能力。拉斯达可以向英雄讲述他被囚禁的骇人经历，并对D1至D11区域作出部分描述。

将拉斯达从光带中移走，会使此处以及区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8pbhSFgv71lvCz9M]{B35}与@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.eOv6LI3wvIuKyyNJ]{C15}中的死灵能量消失。虽然这能阻止贝科拉再次将凄凉之光射线射向奥塔里，但这份喘息只是暂时的。正如英雄将从奥塔里的幽灵（特征）那里得知，贝科拉仍在更深处继续为凄凉灯塔的真正目的做准备。

此外，一旦拉斯达被移走，憎恨魔窟上方四个等级中的闹鬼在被停用或被击败后将不会重置。若沃卢克与虚空暴食者都幸存，并获得数天时间去寻找并安置新的受害者，这些效果将会回归。若他们这么做，新受害者应当是某位NPC，其遭绑架将促使英雄采取行动！

支线任务

若英雄曾在@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.OzOCiM2tgNi3nN8f]{喧闹石斑鱼}与拉斯达忧心忡忡的母亲布蕾达交谈过，他们可能已听闻拉斯达失踪一事。若英雄将拉斯达带回喧闹石斑鱼，他的母亲欣喜若狂，并将一件家族传家宝塞给英雄作为奖赏：一面较小的@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.f9ygr5Cjrmop8LWV]{结实的护盾}，其上饰有一条怒目而视的石斑鱼。

The walls of this circular chamber are smooth and gray. A flickering, nauseating ribbon of pale blue light churns in the center of the room. Where the light touches the ceiling, the stone bubbles as if it were infected flesh. Below, the light bathes a screaming, thrashing dwarf bound onto a metal table, his body covered in blisters.

As in area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8pbhSFgv71lvCz9M]{B35}, the ribbon of light is a manifestation of Gauntlight’s growing power. This eerie light churns in a 5-foot-diameter burst at the room’s center. Any living creature ending its turn in it takes [[/r 5d6[negative]]] damage (@Check[type:reflex|dc:18|basic:true]{Basic Reflex} save) and undead creatures regain the same amount.

To reactivate Gauntlight for its test firing on Otari’s graveyard, Volluk and the voidglutton needed a living creature as an anchor for the light. While others who touch the light suffer negative damage, the light simultaneously heals its anchor as swiftly as it harms them, keeping the person in a perpetual state of agony.

This victim is a dwarf named @Actor[u36SRb3lyB4beHCN]{Lasda Venkervale}, once the bartender at the Rowdy Rockfish in Otari. Volluk abducted Lasda just over a year ago for nefarious experiments while the dwarf was on one of his customary predawn walks from the Rockfish up to the graveyard. Volluk kept Lasda a prisoner in @UUID[.u6H893WYAlzxntns]{Area D11} for many months and, impressed by the dwarf’s hardiness, decided to use him as Gauntlight’s anchor.

Encounter

Moderate 4

@Actor[wRQ7TZdd0n5UIIao]{Will-o'-Wisp}

80 XP

The heroes can't focus on rescuing Lasda without first defeating a will-o’-wisp that has been gorging itself on Lasda’s terror. It’s invisible when the heroes first arrive, but it flares up in an angry blue glow as soon as the heroes attempt to aid the dwarf. It pursues foes who flee and fights to the death.

To remove Lasda from the terrible ribbon of energy, the heroes must first unlock the four manacles that bind him. The key to these manacles can be found in area @UUID[.NHY0hh539X658iSG]{D08}, or the heroes can succeed at three @Check[type:thievery|dc:22|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks to Pick a Lock on each manacle. Unless the heroes have some means of working on the locks from a distance, each round a hero works to unlock a manacle (by the key or otherwise), that hero is exposed to the ribbon of necromantic energy.

Once freed and removed from the energy ribbon, Lasda recovers his mobility after [[/r 2d4]] rounds of gasping for breath. Lasda can tell the heroes the harrowing tale of his imprisonment and give a partial description of areas D1 to D11.

Removing Lasda from the ribbon of light causes the necromantic energy here and in areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8pbhSFgv71lvCz9M]{B35} and @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.eOv6LI3wvIuKyyNJ]{C15} to vanish. While this prevents Belcorra from firing Gauntlight's beam upon Otari again, the reprieve is only temporary. As the heroes will learn from Otari's ghost, Belcorra continues to prepare Gauntlight for its true purpose far below.

In addition, once Lasda is removed, the haunts on the upper four levels of the Abomination Vaults don't reset if they're deactivated or defeated. These effects return if both Volluk and the voidglutton survive, and they're given several days to find and install a new victim. If they do so, this should be an NPC whose kidnapping spurs the heroes into action!

Side Quest

The heroes might have heard of Lasda's disappearance if they've spoken to his worried mother, Brelda, at the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.OzOCiM2tgNi3nN8f]{The Rowdy Rockfish}. If the heroes return Lasda to the Rowdy Rockfish, his mother is overjoyed and presses upon the heroes a family heirloom, a minor @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.f9ygr5Cjrmop8LWV]{Sturdy Shield} emblazoned with an angry-looking rockfish, as a reward.

D10. Scalathrax Pen.name: D10. 油鳞蛛畜栏 D10. Scalathrax Pen
D10. Scalathrax Pen.text:
这座粗凿洞穴的地面上散落着骨头以及金属与布料的碎片。

通往该区域外的三条不规则岩石通道都以暗门告终。从洞穴内部看，这三扇暗门都很明显。

遭遇

中等 4

@Actor[Nkz8Z5TrEqRePGlk]{油鳞蛛（2）}

80 XP

这座洞穴过去仅仅连接着本等级的西南与东北两翼，但如今它成了三只油鳞蛛的围栏。其中一只已经在第2章中通过凄凉灯塔的凄凉之光射线从区域@UUID[.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D09}被传送至奥塔里，但另外两只仍留在这里，等待沃鲁克的下一次凄凉灯塔测试。它们食不果腹，会在看见英雄时立即发动攻击，并对其穷追不舍。

The floor of this rough-hewn cavern is strewn with bones and scraps of metal and cloth.

All three irregular, rocky passages out of this area end in secret doors. All three secret doors are obvious from within the cavern.

Encounter

Moderate 4

@Actor[Nkz8Z5TrEqRePGlk]{Scalathraxes (2)}

80 XP

This cavern once merely connected the southwestern and northeastern wings of the level, but it now serves as a pen for a trio of scalathraxes. One of these has already been transported from area @UUID[.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D09} via Gauntlight's beam to Otari in Chapter 2, but the other two remain here, awaiting Volluk's next Gauntlight test. They're poorly fed and attack the heroes on sight, pursuing them relentlessly.

D11. Torture Chamber.name: D11. 拷问室 D11. Torture Chamber
D11. Torture Chamber.text:
三只边长五尺的铁笼悬挂在这间房间的中央，笼条内侧排列着尖钉。西侧墙上，沾满干涸血迹的镣铐从铁链上垂落。西南角放着一张结实的木桌，上面固定着更多镣铐；桌上放着一条血红皮革制成、银色握柄的鞭子。

在这里，贝科拉囚禁并折磨那些不具备她在塑肉仪式实验或下方楼层竞技场战斗中所寻求特质的人。一旦她确信囚犯再无可供利用之处，或是一旦她感到厌倦，她就会把他们送到 @UUID[.CGaM81kBLtYIxmqu]{区域 D13} 作为祭品。矮人酒保拉斯达曾在中央悬挂的笼子里待了许多个月。

北侧的笼子外部刻着镶银的符文。这个笼子是不活跃的传送法阵（位于 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.VZPc5GsIN5eRKSVE]{C05} 区域）的目的地。它可以通过唤醒传送门仪式恢复；若恢复，这会成为囚禁任何被推入 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.VZPc5GsIN5eRKSVE]{C05} 区域壁龛中的人的实用手段。

遭遇

中等 4

@Actor[OuimMwM3yFRy5tRK]{瓦格丽斯特}

80 XP

一名名为瓦格丽斯特的颂教链魔被贝科拉的魔法束缚在此已达数个世纪。漫长到无休无止的岁月让这名拷问者滋生出一种倦怠感，她甚至很少在房间里走动。当她有拉斯达可供玩弄时，她对残酷消遣的希望曾短暂复燃；但她才刚开始为折磨他打下几个月的基础，他就被带走了。她的倦怠如今比以往更甚。

起初，瓦格丽斯特几乎懒得理会英雄们。她阴郁地邀请他们离开这间密室并且永不返回。这里没有诡计——若英雄立刻离开，链魔会放他们走。若他们坚持不走或质问她，她会烦躁地叹气并发动攻击；她无意交谈。她会战斗至被摧毁，但不会离开此区域。由于此处遍布镣铐，瓦格丽斯特可以在本房间内任意位置使用她的活化锁链能力。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜查}

暗门

进行搜查桌子的英雄若在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功，会在桌子底部发现一个隐藏的开关，它会打开通往南侧的暗门。

宝藏

@Item[si9MKXmMqkjwrffE]{+1 幽冥鞭子}

桌上的鞭子是一条+1 幽冥鞭子。它曾是瓦格丽斯特最喜欢的武器之一，但她不再使用它了。若有英雄保留这条鞭子，请留意，因为它在 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.oBe9I7ccu1SIxdsG]{E02} 区域可能对他们有所帮助。

Three five-foot-square iron cages, the bars lined with spikes on the inside, hang from chains in the middle of this room. Blood-crusted manacles dangle from chains on the west wall. A stout wooden table with more manacles anchored to it stands in the southwest corner, and on it sits a whip made of blood-red leather with a silver handle.

Here, Belcorra imprisoned and tortured those lacking the qualities she sought for fleshwarping experiments or arena battles in the levels below. Once she was satisfied her prisoners had nothing left to offer, or once she grew bored, she sent them to @UUID[.CGaM81kBLtYIxmqu]{Area D13} for sacrifice. The dwarf bartender Lasda inhabited the central hanging cage for many months.

The northern cage has silver-lined runes carved into its exterior. This cage is the destination of the inactive teleportation circle in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.VZPc5GsIN5eRKSVE]{C05}. It can be restored with the awaken portal ritual; if so, it makes a useful way to imprison anyone pushed into the alcove in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.VZPc5GsIN5eRKSVE]{C05}.

Encounter

Moderate 4

@Actor[OuimMwM3yFRy5tRK]{Vaulgrist}

80 XP

An evangelist velstrac named Vaulgrist has been bound here by Belcorra's magic for centuries. The interminable years instilled a sense of listlessness in the torturer, and she rarely even moves about the room. Her hope of cruel amusements was briefly rekindled when she had Lasda to toy with, but she'd only just begun a few months of laying the groundwork for his torment when he was taken away. Her ennui has returned even stronger than before.

At first, Vaulgrist can hardly stir herself to bother with the heroes. She morosely invites them to depart this chamber and never return. There's no trick here- if the heroes simply leave at once, the velstrac lets them go. If they persist or question her, she sighs in frustration and attacks; she has no interest in talking. She fights until destroyed but doesn't leave this area. With all the manacles present here, Vaulgrist can use her animate chains ability from anywhere in this room.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Secret Door

A hero who Searches the table and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check spots a hidden switch on its underside that opens the secret door to the south.

Treasure

@Item[si9MKXmMqkjwrffE]{+1 Ghost Touch Whip}

The whip on the table is a +1 Ghost Touch Whip. It was once one of Vaulgrist's favorite weapons, but she doesn't use it any longer. Pay attention if a hero keeps the whip, as it might have some use for them in area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.oBe9I7ccu1SIxdsG]{E02}.

D12. The Ghostwalk.name: D12. 幽灵之路 D12. The Ghostwalk
D12. The Ghostwalk.text:
这座宽阔大厅的天花板高达二十五英尺。沿着墙壁的壁龛里，竖立着石制石棺，其上雕刻着饱受折磨、骨瘦如柴的人形。东北侧有一段十五英尺宽的墙体已经崩塌，形成一连串向下延伸至洞窟的突沿。北侧与南侧各有诡异的蓝光发光——南侧的光更明亮且恒定，而北侧的光则柔和地闪动。

这条长走廊曾是一处骇人的战利品陈列厅。除最北端的两个壁龛以及通往区域 @UUID[.df69jJ0DznVnWMAb]{D10} 的壁龛外，每一具石棺都装着贝科拉某位敌人被亵渎的遗骸；他们被剥去道具并陈列示众。只要有人走近任一石棺，石棺的石盖就会变得透明，让人能看见其中早已死去的躯体。每具尸体都衣衫褴褛，身上带着明显致命的创口。这里大多是与《憎恨魔窟》冒险路径故事并无重要关联的久逝英雄遗骸。此处的尸体过去与被奴役的幽灵（特征）相连，那些幽灵（特征）曾守卫走廊，但它们的不死存在已被意外吸入这条走廊南端的魔法墙中。

南侧有一段巨大的楼梯向下通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.GtX8UuzhtARfLdsq]{E01}。目前，通往该等级的进展被一面闪烁的灵质之墙所阻挡。偶尔会有无声尖啸的幽灵（特征）掠过这面墙旋涡般的薄雾。楼梯井另一侧仍清晰可见，却挑衅般地无法抵达。这面墙作为一个 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.7Iela4GgVeO3LfAo]{力场墙}，并以 9 环高度强化，而且它由陈列在整条走廊中的英雄们痛苦的灵魂锻造而成——他们是被困在墙内、在无声痛号的幽灵（特征）。这面墙的形成，是凄凉灯塔在沉寂许久后进行测试射击所造成的意外副作用。不过就目前而言，这面墙阻止了继续深入地城的道路。只有贝科拉的杀手之遗珍才能将其降下，正如区域 @UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18} 中奥塔里·伊瓦什提的幽灵（特征）可以解释的那样。

西北侧墙体的崩塌处通向一连串 5 英尺高的突沿，向下延伸至区域 @UUID[.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14}。

遭遇

中等 4

@Actor[sMNqIHHxcVBXG08h]{石冢尸妖（2）}

80 XP

最北端的两具石棺中装着叛徒学徒，他们已被转化为石冢尸妖。若有人接近它们 15 英尺内，两具棺盖都会弹开，石冢尸妖现身发动攻击。它们会在此等级内不知疲倦地追击敌人。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜查}

壁龛中的暗门通往区域 @UUID[.df69jJ0DznVnWMAb]{D10}，其结构被隐藏在唯一一具空石棺的背面。进行搜查空石棺的英雄若在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功，便会发现用于将石棺像门一样向外摆开的门闩。

The ceiling of this wide hall rises to a height of twenty-five feet. Stone sarcophagi carved with tormented, emaciated figures stand upright in alcoves along its walls. To the northeast, a fifteen-foot-wide portion of the wall has crumbled away into a series of ledges that drop down into a cavern. Eerie blue lights glow to the north and south—the light to the south is brighter and constant, while the light to the north flickers softly.

This long hallway served as a gruesome trophy hall. With the exception of the two northernmost alcoves and the alcove leading to area @UUID[.df69jJ0DznVnWMAb]{D10}, each sarcophagus contains the defiled remains of one of Belcorra’s enemies, stripped of gear and put on display. As soon as anyone steps up to a sarcophagus, its stone lid becomes transparent, providing a view of the long-dead body within. Each corpse is dressed in rags and marked with obviously fatal wounds. Most of these are the remains of long-dead heroes with no significant relation to the story of the Abomination Vaults Adventure Path. The corpses here used to be linked to enslaved ghosts that guarded the hall, but their undead presences have been inadvertently drawn into the magical wall at the south end of this hallway.

A large flight of stairs to the south leads down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.GtX8UuzhtARfLdsq]{E01}. For now, progress to this level is blocked by a shimmering wall of ectoplasm. Now and then, silently shrieking ghosts flit through the swirling mist of this wall. The stairwell beyond remains visible yet tauntingly inaccessible. This wall acts as a @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.7Iela4GgVeO3LfAo]{Wall of Force} heightened to 9th level and has been forged from the agonized souls of the heroes displayed throughout this hallway—they’re the trapped ghosts who silently cry out in agony within the wall. This wall’s creation was an unintended side effect of Gauntlight’s test firing after it had lain dormant for so long. For now, though, the wall blocks progress deeper into the dungeon. Only the icons of Belcorra’s killers can bring it down, as the ghost of Otari Ilvashti in area @UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18} can explain.

The collapse in the northwest wall leads to a series of 5-foot-high ledges that drop down to area @UUID[.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14}.

Encounter

Moderate 4

@Actor[sMNqIHHxcVBXG08h]{Cairn Wights (2)}

80 XP

The two northernmost sarcophagi contain traitorous apprentices transformed into cairn wights. If anyone approaches within 15 feet of them, both lids pop open and the cairn wights emerge to attack. They relentlessly pursue foes through this level.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

The secret door in the alcove, which leads to area @UUID[.df69jJ0DznVnWMAb]{D10}, is built into the back of the only empty sarcophagus. A hero who Searches the empty sarcophagus and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check discovers the latch to swing the sarcophagus open like a door.

D13. Upper Temple of Nhimbaloth.name: D13. 宁布洛斯的上层神殿 D13. Upper Temple of Nhimbaloth
D13. Upper Temple of Nhimbaloth.text:
这间巨大的八角形厅室大多空旷。墙壁被雕刻并绘制成一片广袤的墓园，半沉入泥泞的沼泽淤潭之中，然而壁画中的所有坟墓都敞开且空无一物。尖啸的幽灵雕像向上游行，直至没入此室顶端那只恶意之眼饥渴的瞳孔中，位于上方三十英尺处。房间中央是一座直径十五英尺的圆形平台，高出周围地面三英尺。平台上立着一块祭坛石——一块形状不规则的岩石石板，上面有七处深深的凹痕，几乎像是一只巨大的七指手以足够的力量攫握石头，从而留下沟槽。偶尔，其中某个凹痕内会闪动并脉动着微弱的蓝光。祭坛上堆着一小堆物体。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout}

若英雄从房间入口处进行一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:16|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定并成功，便能辨认出祭坛上的物体是四只被切断的手。

进行一次成功的 @Check[type:religion|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{宗教}检定以回忆知识，可识别此厅室是一处供奉宁布洛斯——掌管绝望、幽灵与沼泽的外神——的神龛。她的神龛通常不摆放额外的陈设，例如雕像或长椅，以象征死亡本身的空无。信徒通常跪伏在石质地面上，而祭司在祭坛前主持布道与献祭。

遭遇

严重 4

@Actor[x3eOZvKUginj5Blh]{闪火（4）} @Actor[oSQ3Q9tzTohksAtf]{精英伏行只手（4）}

120 XP

当英雄进入此房间时，祭坛的不死守卫会迅速爬出并发动攻击。当只手活化时，四只闪火会从祭坛侧面的凹痕中滑出，加入它们的攻击。闪火与伏行只手不会从神龛房间追击敌人。若房内没有敌人，它们会返回祭坛上的原位。它们会战斗至被摧毁。

绝望灵光

整座神龛都浸透着压倒性的绝望与无助感。任何进入此房间的活体生物都必须成功通过一次 @Check[type:will|dc:22]{意志}豁免，否则获得惊惧（状态）1（若为大失败则为惊惧（状态）2）。活体生物在此厅室内无法降低其惊惧（状态）。大成功使该生物获得24小时的临时免疫。

祭坛之光

祭坛每天黄昏会产出一只新的闪火，但此厅室中同时存在的闪火不超过四只。恶意灵光与闪火生成会持续，直到英雄依照奥塔里的幽灵（特征）的指示，将四件玫瑰团遗珍置于祭坛石上（区域 @UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}）。此后，房间内令人惊惧的绝望将结束，祭坛也不再产出任何闪火。

This vast octagonal chamber is mostly empty. The walls are carved and painted to resemble a sprawling graveyard half-sunken into a swampy morass, yet all the graves in the mural are open and empty. Carved images of shrieking ghosts parade upward and into the hungry pupil of a malevolent eye at the apex of this room, thirty feet above. A circular fifteen-foot-diameter platform sits in the middle of the room, raised three feet off the surrounding floor. The platform supports an altar stone made of an irregular slab of rock marked by seven deep indentations, almost as if a huge, seven-fingered hand had gripped the stone with enough force to leave grooves behind. Now and then, a faint blue light flickers and pulses inside one of these indentations. Small objects lie heaped atop the altar.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout}

A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:16|traits:action:search]{Perception} check from the room's entrance identifies the objects on the altar as four severed hands.

A successful @Check[type:religion|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Religion} check to Recall Knowledge identifies this chamber as a shrine dedicated to Nhimbaloth, the Outer God of despair, ghosts, and swamps. Her shrines are often empty of additional furnishings, such as statues or benches, symbolizing the emptiness of death itself. Worshipers typically kneel or prostrate themselves on the stone floor while priests lead sermons and sacrifices at the altar.

Encounter

Severe 4

@Actor[x3eOZvKUginj5Blh]{Flickerwisps (4)} @Actor[oSQ3Q9tzTohksAtf]{Elite Crawling Hands (4)}

120 XP

The altar's undead guardians scuttle forth and attack when the heroes enter this room. When the hands animate, four flickerwisps slither out from indentations on the altar's sides and join in their attack. The flickerwisps and crawling hands don't pursue foes from the shrine room. If no foes are present, they return to their original places on the altar. They fight until destroyed.

Aura of Despair

The entire shrine is infused with an overwhelming sense of despair and hopelessness. Any living creature who enters this room must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:22]{Will} save or become frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure). A living creature can't reduce its frightened condition while in this chamber. A critical success grants the creature temporary immunity for 24 hours.

Lights from the Altar

The altar produces a new flickerwisp each day at dusk, but no more than four flickerwisps can exist in this chamber at one time. The malevolent aura and flickerwisp generation persist until the heroes place the four Roseguard icons atop the altar stone, as directed by Otari's ghost (area @UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}). At this point, the frightening despair in the room ends, and the altar produces no more flickerwisps.

D14. Pavilion.name: D14. 石亭 D14. Pavilion
D14. Pavilion.text:
这个巨大的洞窟阴冷潮湿。水从上方凝结的水汽中滴落，落入一片宽广而平静的湖泊。湖的西岸长着一片片厚密的湿润蘑菇，有些几乎高达四英尺；而南边的一条隧道则有一股狭窄的水流注入湖中。湖中央矗立着一座长三十五英尺的石亭，十余根石柱将其托起，使其比水面高出十英尺。整座石亭都覆着潮湿、苍白的真菌。两座石桥从石亭拱出——一座连接北墙上的一扇门，另一座连接东侧的一扇门。石亭中央燃着一堆微微闪烁的营火，烟雾盘旋着升向洞顶。

这里生长的真菌看起来也许不祥，但实际上无害。湖岸陡峭，向下坠入几乎一致的15英尺水深。

贝科拉建造这座石亭作为冥想之所。憎恨魔窟的居民不来这里，因为奥塔里的幽灵（特征）在区域@UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}残留的存在会在潜意识中影响他们远离此地。活物（例如石亭目前的居住者）不会感受到这些影响。

杰尔·梅兹勄

变形者

尽管玩家初次见到杰尔时他处于人类形态，但他可以使用变形动作变成一只狼，或采取人类/狼的混合形态。

要在他变形时调整其插画，你可以将随附的@UUID[Item.VWkbHywZAaWr3Uqx]{变形}效果拖到他的指示物或角色卡上。

石亭里住着一个毛发蓬乱、野性十足的男人。他是杰尔·梅兹勄，一个暴力的罪犯与嗜杀的狼化人，因30年前在奥塔里杀害数名当地人而被通缉。杰尔的最后一名受害者是一位名叫艾拉·拉瑟纳的女子，她是基莱诺·拉瑟纳的妻子，而基莱诺是@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.jPieo4zoajYJyrbg]{奥塔里市场}的主人。杰尔在行凶期间，伪装成@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.ZztVKvKiqxCzfSfA]{石环池}的德鲁伊之一，藏身于众目睽睽之下；但当他的身份暴露时，他从奥塔里的悬崖跃入海中，逃过抓捕。潮汐把他卷入海蚀洞里，几乎将他淹死；但在接下来的数周里，他逐渐恢复，并找到了来到此地的路。

从那时起杰尔就一直住在这里。他的皮肤蜡黄苍白，身上散发着蘑菇味和酸臭的汗味。洞穴蟋蟀构成了他饮食的负载。他多年来唯一的伙伴是一群忠诚的狼；当其中一只死去时，杰尔就会从洞窟出去，与另一只建立羁绊。起初，他计划回到奥塔里，但在这个洞里生活了这么多年后，杰尔已不知别样人生。

然而，英雄们打破了这种生活。当杰尔注意到他们时，他踉跄地走到石亭边缘，疯狂地嚎叫与吠叫，警告他们离开。他身旁的狼也以自己的嚎声附和。一名英雄若在@Check[type:society|dc:27|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{社会}检定以回忆知识中成功，就会意识到此人正是那位一代人以前从奥塔里消失的凶手。由你酌情决定：若英雄熟悉杰尔的恶名，则将这次检定结果视为比掷骰结果高一级成功度。

遭遇

严重 4

@Actor[EN3mp0sVObP8ou3p]{杰尔·梅兹勄} @Actor[xj1Qn0VA4H4aKSjW]{杰尓的狼}

120 XP

如果英雄们攻击杰尔或试图进入他的石亭，他就会采取混合形态并发动攻击。如果英雄们按兵不动，他会继续吠叫与嚎叫，直到有人能让他冷静下来。一旦英雄们在杰尔身上成功使用任何带有语言（特征）的技能（例如编造一个令人信服的说谎、用交涉建立印象，或尝试胁迫他），他就会停止嚎叫，闪现术般地眨几下眼，仿佛想起自己也能说话。片刻之后，他用结结巴巴的声音喊话，警告英雄这里是他的地盘，他们不受欢迎。他的初始态度为敌对；如果英雄们试图与他交谈太久，他会变得烦躁，并用他的魔法从远处发动攻击。取决于英雄们提出的问题，杰尔可能会透露自己的名字或身份，但这多半只是时间问题——多疑的狼化人终究会失去耐心并发动攻击。

如果杰尔被压到30点或更少生命值，他会乞求饶命，并承诺英雄若放过他就给他们奖励。这个奖励是艾拉的项链。对杰尔施以仁慈的英雄可以让他进一步开口；杰尔对该等级的东半部略有了解（区域D14到D19）。例如，他能警告英雄南方岛上的@UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{"阴影幽灵"}，并告诉他们：如果他们进入北方的@UUID[.elYnvao8KPxWdGdp]{“梦魇术阶梯”}，若想有朝一日能逃脱，最好把眼睛闭上。如果英雄们放他走，他会穿过海蚀洞离开并逃离该地区。至于他是否会重操旧业继续杀人，则由你决定。

支线任务

英雄们可以将杰尔（死或活）带回奥塔里领取50 gp的悬赏。如果英雄们一开始没意识到他是谁，就允许一名英雄查看他项链上的铭文后，尝试一次@Check[type:society|dc:18]{社会}检定（如果该英雄与@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.jPieo4zoajYJyrbg]{奥塔里市场}有关联，则DC为13）。成功时，英雄认出那名字是艾拉·拉瑟纳——奥塔里市场商人基莱诺·拉瑟纳已故的妻子。向基莱诺出示狼化人已死的证据——这位怨恨深重的男人不会接受自己妻子的凶手仍然活着——将使英雄们在奥塔里市场的所有购物终生获得八折优惠。

This immense cavern is cold and damp. Water drips from condensation above into a large, still lake. Thick patches of moist mushrooms, some nearly four feet tall, grow along the western shore of the lake, while a narrow trickle of water feeds in from a tunnel to the south. A thirty-five-foot-long pavilion made of stone stands in the middle of the lake, elevated ten feet above the water level by more than a dozen stone columns. The entire pavilion is encrusted with damp, pale fungus. Two stone bridges arch from the pavilion—one connecting it to a door set in the northern wall and another to a door to the east. A faintly flickering campfire burns in the middle of the pavilion, its smoke curling to the ceiling.

The fungus growing here might look ominous, but it’s harmless. The lake has steep banks that drop away into a nearly uniform depth of 15 feet.

Belcorra built this pavilion as a place to meditate. The denizens of the Abomination Vaults don’t visit here, as the lingering presence of Otari’s ghost in area @UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18} subconsciously influences them to stay away. Living creatures (such as the pavilion’s current inhabitants) don’t feel these influences.

Jaul Mezmin

Shapeshifter

Although Jaul is in his human form when the players meet him, he can use his Change Shape action to turn into a wolf or assume a human/wolf hybrid form.

To adjust his artwork when he transforms, you can use the included @UUID[Item.VWkbHywZAaWr3Uqx]{Change Shape} effect by dragging it onto his token or character sheet.

A grizzled, feral-looking man lives in the pavilion. He’s Jaul Mezmin, a violent criminal and murderous werewolf wanted in the town of Otari for the slaying of several locals 30 years ago. Jaul’s last victim was a woman named Ayla Lathenar, wife of Keeleno Lathenar, the owner of the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.jPieo4zoajYJyrbg]{Otari Market}. Jaul hid in plain sight as one of the druids of @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.ZztVKvKiqxCzfSfA]{Stone Ring Pond} while he committed his murders, but when he was found out, he escaped capture by leaping from the Otari cliffs into the sea. The tides pulled him into sea caves, leaving him nearly drowned, but over the following weeks, he recovered and found his way here.

Jaul’s been living here ever since. His skin is pasty and pale, and he reeks of mushrooms and sour sweat. Cave crickets make up the bulk of his diet. His only companions over the years have been a series of loyal wolves; when one perishes, Jaul simply makes his way out through the caves to bond with another. At first, he made plans to return to Otari, but after living in this cave for so many years, Jaul knows no other life.

The heroes disrupt that life, though. When Jaul notices them, he staggers up to the edge of his pavilion and howls and barks wildly to warn them away. The wolf at his side accompanies his howls with its own. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:society|dc:27|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} check to Recall Knowledge realizes this man is the killer who disappeared from Otari a generation ago. At your discretion, a hero familiar with Jaul’s legacy treats the result of this check as one degree of success greater than the rolled result.

Encounter

Severe 4

@Actor[EN3mp0sVObP8ou3p]{Jaul Mezmin} @Actor[xj1Qn0VA4H4aKSjW]{Jaul's Wolf}

120 XP

If the heroes attack Jaul or attempt to enter his pavilion, he assumes his hybrid form and attacks. If the heroes hang back, he continues to bark and howl until someone can calm him down. As soon as the heroes successfully use any skill with the linguistic trait on Jaul (such as to create a convincing Lie, use Diplomacy to Make an Impression, or try to Coerce him), he stops howling and blinks several times as he remembers that he can talk as well. A few moments later, he calls out in a halting voice, warning the heroes that this is his territory and they aren’t welcome. His initial attitude is hostile, and if the heroes try to talk to him too much, he grows frustrated and uses his magic to attack from afar. Depending on the questions the heroes ask, Jaul might reveal his name or who he is, but it’s likely only a matter of time before the paranoid werewolf loses patience and attacks.

If Jaul is reduced to 30 or fewer Hit Points, he begs for mercy and promises to give the heroes a reward if they spare him. This reward is Ayla’s necklace. Heroes who show Jaul mercy can get him to talk further; Jaul is somewhat familiar with the eastern half of this level (areas D14 to D19). For example, he can warn the heroes of the @UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{"Shadowy Ghost"} on the island to the south and tell them that if they enter the @UUID[.elYnvao8KPxWdGdp]{“Nightmare Stairs”} to the north, they’d do well to keep their eyes closed if they want to ever escape them. If the heroes let him go, he exits through the sea caves and flees the region. Whether or not he resumes his murderous ways is left for you to decide.

Side Quest

The heroes can bring Jaul in, dead or alive, to Otari for a 50 gp bounty. If the heroes don’t realize who he is right away, allow a hero who looks over the inscription on his necklace to attempt a @Check[type:society|dc:18]{Society} check (DC 13 if the hero is affiliated with the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.jPieo4zoajYJyrbg]{Otari Market}). On a success, the hero recognizes the name as Ayla Lathenar, the dead wife of the Otari Market merchant, Keeleno Lathenar. Approaching Keeleno with proof that the werewolf is dead- as the bitter man won't accept his wife's murderer remaining alive- earns the heroes a 20 percent discount for all purchases at the Otari Market for life.

D15. Twisting Tunnel.name: D15. 扭曲的隧道 D15. Twisting Tunnel
D15. Twisting Tunnel.text:
几处湿滑的岩棚向上延伸并通往区域 @UUID[.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14} 之外，连接到一组小型洞窟群，横跨雾隐沼泽与海岸之间。杰尔·梅兹勄正是通过这些隧道来到此地，并且他偶尔也会从这里离开以猎取食物。这些隧道通向奥塔里以西海岸的一处海蚀洞——即便在低潮时也完全没在水下。本洞窟群的具体内容不在本次冒险的范围内，但其中很可能还有其他掠食者与危险。若英雄们想要探索这些洞窟并且需要额外的XP，你可以随意扩展这里的内容。

Several slippery ledges lead up and out of area @UUID[.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14}, joining a small complex of caverns that stretches between Fogfen and the coast. It was via these tunnels that Jaul Mezmin arrived, and he leaves through them occasionally to hunt for food. The tunnels connect to the coastline west of Otari in a sea cave that’s underwater even at low tide. The actual contents of these caverns are beyond the scope of this adventure, but they likely contain other predators and dangers. Feel free to expand them if the heroes wish to explore them and are in need of additional XP.

D16. Haunted Stairs.name: D16. 闹鬼的楼梯 D16. Haunted Stairs
D16. Haunted Stairs.text:
一段楼梯从这处狭窄的平台向上延伸。面向楼梯的南墙闪动并发光，浮现出一缕缕诡异的绿色冷光。

这些楼梯向上通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.tTVIrzNZtjKG1XVb]{C33}。

在他穿越憎恨魔窟的逃亡途中，奥塔里·伊瓦什提在这段楼梯上做了他最后几次停留之一。他只在此等待了一个小时，用来包扎一些伤口并重振勇气，随后穿过通往区域 @UUID[.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14} 的门继续前进，希望能找到一条逃脱路线。不幸的是，他从未抵达海蚀洞出口——当时栖居在那座洞窟里的巨型食腐怪立刻袭击了他。奥塔里被迫向南逃离，并抵达区域 @UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}。那只食腐怪体型太大，无法触及到他，但又固执得不肯离开；奥塔里最终死于食腐怪施加在他身上的一种疾病。

如同在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.BHmLYQVCwzBneNFu]{B28} 与 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.LSGUFeDZHwsJMxev]{C03} 一样，奥塔里的灵性能量仍残留于此。当英雄们到达这里时，又一道传讯术在墙上的发光光亮(术)中显现：“凄凉灯塔是一件武器，其建造目的在于夷平艾巴萨罗姆——必须将它摧毁！”当传讯术被读出后，文字向下滑落，化作一条扭动的脚印丝带，通向区域 @UUID[.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14}，随后又以惊慌而曲折的路线向下穿过区域 @UUID[.JNKEdzHec3VixqB8]{D17}，进入区域 @UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}。

这道幽灵般的显现每天可出现一次。

A staircase leads upward from this narrow landing. The south wall, facing the stairs, flickers and glows with ribbons of eerie green luminescence.

These stairs lead up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.tTVIrzNZtjKG1XVb]{C33}.

During his flight through the Abomination Vaults, Otari Ilvashti made one of his final stops on this staircase. He waited here for only an hour to patch some wounds and regain his courage, then moved on through the door to area @UUID[.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14}, hoping to find an escape route. Unfortunately, he never made it to the sea cave exit, for the enormous otyugh that dwelt in the cavern in those days attacked him at once. Otari was forced to flee south and made it to area @UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}. The otyugh was too large to reach him there but too stubborn to leave, and it’s there that Otari finally perished from a disease the otyugh inflicted upon him.

As in areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.BHmLYQVCwzBneNFu]{B28} and @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.LSGUFeDZHwsJMxev]{C03}, Otari’s spiritual energy remains here. When the heroes reach this point, another message manifests in the glowing light on the wall: “Gauntlight is a weapon, built to raze Absalom—it must be brought down!” After the message is read, the words slide down into a writhing ribbon of footprints that leads into area @UUID[.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14}, then makes a panicked, twisting route down through area @UUID[.JNKEdzHec3VixqB8]{D17} and into area @UUID[.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}.

This spectral manifestation can appear once per day.

D17. Disposal Pond.name: D17. 处理池 D17. Disposal Pond
D17. Disposal Pond.text:
一条生锈的金属滑槽从此处西侧的天花板伸出，在一汪黏滑的积水上方戛然而止。一大堆真菌堆积在管道下方、贴着西墙，呈现出一种怪异而可怖的形状，仿佛某种怪物正在其中休息。

这条滑槽向上通往区域 @UUID[.n4wmzdIYH9Eu0rVy]{D07}，但它十分湿滑，需要一次成功的 @Check[type:athletics|dc:18|traits:action:climb]{Athletics} 检定才能 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}。被倾倒进此处水池的角色会发现水又冷又令人不适，但水深只有3英尺。所幸，曾被关在这里用于处理垃圾的巨大食腐怪早在很久以前就死了。它那保存得颇为怪异的尸体被真菌包裹， леж在管道下方。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

任何检查这只巨大食腐怪遗骸的人，都可以通过一次成功的 @Check[type:occultism|dc:23|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism} 检定来进行回忆知识，从而辨认出它。

A rusty metal chute protrudes from the ceiling to the west here, coming to an end over a pool of slimy water. A huge mound of fungus lies under the tube against the west wall, resting in a strangely monstrous shape.

This chute leads up to area @UUID[.n4wmzdIYH9Eu0rVy]{D07}, but it’s slick and requires a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:18|traits:action:climb]{Athletics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}. Characters who are dumped into the pool of water here find it cold and unpleasant, but it’s only 3 feet deep. Fortunately, the immense otyugh once kept here for trash disposal purposes died long ago. Its strangely preserved body lies encased in fungus under the pipe.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Anyone who examines the remains of the Huge otyugh can identify it with a successful @Check[type:occultism|dc:23|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism} check to Recall Knowledge.

D18. Otari’s Doom.name: D18. 奥塔里的末日 D18. Otari’s Doom
D18. Otari’s Doom.text:
此区域的水很暗，但只有3英尺深。

一座低矮的岩石小岛在此处从周围的水面上升起，不到1英尺高，表面覆盖着一层细薄的浅绿色蘑菇与霉菌。一具人类骷髅身着腐烂的皮革护甲、紧握一把细剑，蜷成一堆躺在小岛中央。

岛上的骷髅曾是奥塔里·伊瓦什提。他在与贝科拉的战斗以及穿越憎恨魔窟上层的绝望逃亡中幸存下来，却最终被困于此——因为在区域@UUID[.JNKEdzHec3VixqB8]{D17}有一头巨大的秽兽在等待。奥塔里在与秽兽战斗中感染了腐热症；在此之前他已因磨难而虚弱不堪。奥塔里在这座小小的礁岛上又苟延残喘了两天便死去了。

如今，他的灵魂仍徘徊不去：既化作遍布憎恨魔窟墙壁上的奇异警告，也化作一个被两种相连欲望所吞噬的幽灵——对贝科拉的复仇，以及对凄凉灯塔也许仍会被用来施放伤害术、危及他在艾巴萨罗姆的家乡的恐惧(术)。当英雄们靠近时，奥塔里的幽灵从他的骷髅中升起，外观与他在腐热症晚期时相差无几，只是带着半透明的绿色阴影。奥塔里无法离开此区域，而由于英雄们是首批前来拜访他这片闹鬼遗骸、且可能提供帮助的冒险者，他急切地想要伸出援手。

遭遇

严峻 4

@Actor[wRQ7TZdd0n5UIIao]{鬼火} @Actor[x3eOZvKUginj5Blh]{闪火（2）}

120 XP

在奥塔里能与英雄们交谈之前，一只鬼火与两只闪火——它们多年来一直折磨着他——会疾冲而出，保护这个被恐惧(术)笼罩的受害者。奥塔里在它们俯冲发动攻击之前，所能做的不过是警告英雄们“小心空死之眼”。

奥塔里的援助

一旦战斗开始，奥塔里会尽其所能提供援助。那些异怪很久以前就学会了躲在幽灵触及不到的地方，但奥塔里会通过短暂附身于英雄们的影子，对它们进行鬼影打击。微灵被击败后，奥塔里会提供更多信息，如下所述。

奥塔里所知

奥塔里的作用，是向众人提出通过@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.5MfX6RVIF7rOroV3]{幽灵封印}、抵达憎恨魔窟更下层所必需完成的任务。

一旦英雄们遭遇奥塔里的幽灵并赶走折磨他的微灵，他便会讲述自己的悲惨经历，概要见@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.hmllmOvUuS2wnnVT]{此处}。他对自己生前的大多数事记忆模糊，但若他得知玫瑰团的其他成员幸存下来，并建立了一座以他命名的城镇，他会变得极为激动。

奥塔里的装备

@Actor[EwEHsQB88dUbcmeE]{奥塔里的装备}

奥塔里鼓励英雄们在他与他们交谈完毕后，取走并使用他的道具。他的高等盗贼工具是克服区域@UUID[.QCU2xefly79ZVBxj]{D12}障壁所需的四个图标之一。他的其他道具包括：剧毒匕首、一把隐秘钥匙，以及+1铆钉皮甲。

奥塔里的结局

一旦英雄们承担起面对并击败贝科拉的重担，并打开通往憎恨魔窟更深层的道路，奥塔里的灵魂便能获得自由，前往最终的归宿。你应确保在他淡化之前，他已将以上所有信息传达给英雄们。

不过，如果你愿意，你也可以让事情走向更黑暗的版本——奥塔里的灵魂并未获得自由，而是被憎恨魔窟底部宁布洛斯的神殿所捕获。在这种情况下，英雄们应通过一次幻象或梦魇术得知奥塔里的结局，或甚至亲眼目睹他受折磨的幽灵违背其意志被拖向下方。奥塔里的幽灵会一直被困住，直到英雄们最终击败贝科拉。

The water in this area is dark but only 3 feet deep.

A low rocky isle rises less than a foot above the surrounding water here, its surface covered with a fine layer of pale green mushrooms and mold. A human skeleton dressed in rotten leather armor and clutching a rapier lies in a heap at the center of the isle.

The skeleton on the island was once Otari Ilvashti. He survived the battle with Belcorra and a desperate flight through the upper levels of the Abomination Vaults only to become trapped here by the immense otyugh waiting in area @UUID[.JNKEdzHec3VixqB8]{D17}. Already weakened from his ordeal before contracting filth fever from the fight with the otyugh, Otari lingered on the tiny islet only two days before he perished.

Today, his spirit lingers on, both in the form of the strange warnings on the walls throughout the Abomination Vaults and also as a ghost consumed by two linked desires- vengeance on Belcorra and fear that Gauntlight might yet be used to harm his hometown of Absalom. As the heroes draw near, Otari’s ghost rises up from his skeleton, appearing much as he did during the late stages of filth fever, albeit with a transparent green shade. Otari can’t leave this area, and since the heroes are the first potentially helpful adventurers to visit his haunted remains, he's eager to provide help.

Encounter

Severe 4

@Actor[wRQ7TZdd0n5UIIao]{Will-o'-Wisp} @Actor[x3eOZvKUginj5Blh]{Flickerwisps (2)}

120 XP

Before Otari can speak to the heroes, a will-o'-wisp and two flickerwisps that have tormented him for years dart forth to protect their fear-laden victim. Otari can do little more than warn the heroes about the "Eyes of the Empty Death" before they swoop forth to attack.

Otari's Aid

Once combat begins, Otari provides what aid he can. The aberrations long ago learned to stay out of the ghost's reach, but Otari makes Infested Shadow Strikes against them by momentarily possessing the heroes' shadows. After the wisps are defeated, Otari provides much more information, as described below.

What Otari Knows

Otari's role is to present the tasks necessary to pass the @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.5MfX6RVIF7rOroV3]{Spectral Seal} and reach the lower levels of the Abomination Vaults.

Once the heroes encounter Otari's ghost and drive off the wisps that torment him, he relates his tale of woe, as outlined @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.hmllmOvUuS2wnnVT]{here}. He has difficulty remembering much of his life but becomes very emotional if he learns that the other members of the Roseguard survived and founded a town they named after him.

Otari's Equipment

@Actor[EwEHsQB88dUbcmeE]{Otari's Equipment}

Otari encourages the heroes to claim and use his gear once he's done speaking with them. His infiltrator thieves' tools are one of the four icons required to overcome the barrier in area @UUID[.QCU2xefly79ZVBxj]{D12}. His other gear consists of a dagger of venom, a sneaky key, and +1 studded leather armor.

Otari's Fate

Once the heroes take on the burden of facing and defeating Belcorra and open the way to the deeper levels of the Abomination Vaults, Otari's soul is free to travel to its final reward. You should ensure he has imparted all of the above information to the heroes before he fades away.

If you wish, though, you can put a darker spin on things- rather than have Otari's spirit achieve freedom, it could instead be captured by the temple of Nhimbaloth at the bottom of the Abomination Vaults. In this case, the heroes should learn about Otari's fate through a vision or nightmare, or perhaps even see his tormented ghost pulled downward against his will. Otari's ghost remains trapped until the heroes finally defeat Belcorra.

D19. The Forever Stairs.name: D19. 无尽楼梯 D19. The Forever Stairs
D19. The Forever Stairs.text:
这条五英尺宽的走廊墙壁闪烁并起伏着淡淡的浅蓝色能量涡纹。西侧的楼梯向上通行，东侧的楼梯向下通行。无论上行还是下行的阶梯，都会通往小小的转台。

乍看之下这条走廊似乎并不起眼，但一旦英雄们开始在其中旅行，很快就会发现确实有某种极其怪异的事情正在发生。这条走廊会自我回环；例如，若英雄们选择顺时针前进，楼梯将总是向上，但在绕行一整圈后，他们最终会回到起点。贝科拉在她建造憎恨魔窟的早期制造了这种扭曲空间的效果，当时她正在试验数种魔法手段，以将她的怪物直接投送到艾巴萨罗姆的街道上。尽管她最终放弃了空间扭曲——认为其效率过低，无法在足够大的规模上使用——但她保留了这条自己建造的扭曲走廊，作为环绕其私人住处的一种防御性“护城河”。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

通往区域 @UUID[.CGaM81kBLtYIxmqu]{D13} 与 @UUID[.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14} 的外侧门始终存在，但通往区域 @UUID[.nGQeeoAEGLcgnwNz]{D20} 的壁龛与门则被一面幻象墙所掩藏，该墙由一个5级 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]{幻象物品} 法术创造。识破该幻象的意志 DC 为26，但英雄们也可能以其他方式发现这面墙。一名英雄在搜索北侧走廊时若成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，或在调查北侧走廊时若成功通过一次 @Check[type:arcana|dc:20|traits:action:investigate]{奥秘学} 或 @Check[type:occultism|dc:20|traits:action:investigate]{神秘学} 检定，便会发现蓝色能量中的异常之处，提示那段墙壁有些不寻常。

XP 奖励

英雄们首次设法抵达 @UUID[.nGQeeoAEGLcgnwNz]{区域 D20} 时，给予他们30 XP。

The walls of this five-foot-wide hallway shimmer and ripple with faint whorls of pale blue energy. A staircase to the west leads upward, and the one to the east leads down. Both the ascending and descending stairs reach small landings.

While at first glance this hallway might seem unremarkable, it should quickly become clear that something truly strange is going on once the heroes start to travel it. The hallway loops back upon itself; for example, if the heroes choose to go clockwise, the stairs will always lead upward, but they end up at the same place they started after making a complete circuit. Belcorra created this distorted spatial effect in the early days of her construction of the Abomination Vaults as she was experimenting with several magical methods of delivering her monsters directly into the streets of Absalom. While she ultimately abandoned spatial warping as too inefficient to be used on a sufficiently large scale, she kept this warped hall she constructed as a sort of defensive “moat” around her personal quarters.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

The outside doors to areas @UUID[.CGaM81kBLtYIxmqu]{D13} and @UUID[.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14} are always present, but the alcove and door to area @UUID[.nGQeeoAEGLcgnwNz]{D20} are concealed by an illusory wall created by a 5th-level @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]{Illusory Object} spell. The Will DC to disbelieve the illusion is 26, but the heroes might find the wall in other ways. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check while Searching the north hallway or a @Check[type:arcana|dc:20|traits:action:investigate]{Arcana} or @Check[type:occultism|dc:20|traits:action:investigate]{Occultism} check while Investigating the north hall identifies anomalies in the blue energy that indicate something unusual about that section of the wall.

XP Award

Grant the heroes 30 XP the first time they manage to reach @UUID[.nGQeeoAEGLcgnwNz]{Area D20}.

D20. Belcorra’s Suite.name: D20. 贝科拉的套房 D20. Belcorra’s Suite
D20. Belcorra’s Suite.text:
这四个带角度的房间拥有相同的基本描述；请根据房间内任意门的位置需要，对下文进行相应调整。西侧房间D20d还在一面墙上有一道朴素的石拱门，拱门内填满了空白石料。这是一道通往《憎恨魔窟》深处的未激活传送门。

一对门提供了离开该房间的出口，其中一扇门比房间布满尘土的地面高出一英尺，门前有一级半圆形台阶。

当贝科拉最初开始建造《憎恨魔窟》时，这些房间曾作为她的私人套间。她在此居住了许多年，一边监督上层与下层地城的建造；但工程一完工，她便抛弃了这处居所，转而前往更深的地下。她也将自己的物品一并搬到了更深处，使这些房间被遗弃而空无一物；然而当她成为幽灵（特征）后，她的灵性能量以与奥塔里相近的方式产生反应——在这些她度过无数时光的房间里显现出挥之不去的残影。

因此，每当英雄踏入这四个房间中的任意一间时，都会被一段短暂的幽灵（特征）景象迎接：房间昔日的模样。每一次，他们也都会在房间里看到贝科拉本人的幻象。各房间幻象的描述如下；你在朗读这些描述时，可以使用每个链接的宏，让令人不安的发光短暂充满房间。

当然，英雄很可能一开始没有时间细看这些景象——见下方的遭遇。

北侧房间（D20a）

@Macro[WwpFApLBtTEwVg4W]{Vision - A}

这房间曾是一间舒适的起居室，摆着两把椅子，椅子之间有一张矮几。在短暂的幻象中，贝科拉正在与卓尔沃卢克会面（如同他生前那样，作为一名卓尔）。虽然影像没有声音，但贝科拉正情绪激昂地谈论某事，而沃卢克则专注地聆听。

东侧房间（D20b）

@Macro[ZiZZJYiahnOQKS0n]{Vision - B}

这房间原本是一间休息室，内有两张柔软的长榻；房间闪现出一幅影像：贝科拉正放松地阅读一本巨大的厚书。成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定的英雄会看到书名是《呓语芦苇》（此书目前位于区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}）。

南侧房间（D20c）

@Macro[tNrLnJiGgEFdLIGi]{Vision - C}

一张摆设完备的餐桌显示这里曾是贝科拉的私人餐厅。在影像中，她独自坐在桌旁，饮着一杯葡萄酒，享用一只装盘精致的烤手臂——那手臂看上去令人不适地近似人类。

西侧房间（D20d）

@Macro[Txz4sUakBGtaxdvo]{Vision - D}

贝科拉的卧室在西墙边摆着一张大床。北侧的石拱门泛起波光，传送门开启，贝科拉嘴角噙着残忍的微笑、双手沾满鲜血，从门中踏出。

遭遇

极端 4

@Actor[ceLvlSQsYNORH8oM]{虚空暴食者}

180 XP

自贝科拉抛弃这些房间以来，一种名为虚空暴食者的强大而骇人的实体便盘踞于此。与贝科拉的许多爪牙不同，虚空暴食者是出于自身意愿来到她身边的——它被宁布洛斯存在的回响从诸多次元彼端引来。它自愿援助贝科拉，担任上层神殿的守卫（区域 @UUID[.CGaM81kBLtYIxmqu]{D13}）；但当她将个人物品迁往《憎恨魔窟》更深处后，它便占据了这些房间。它沉浸在地城骚灵与幽灵（特征）所残留的恐惧与痛苦之中。

当贝科拉以幽灵（特征）之姿复起时，虚空暴食者便注意到了，并前去拜访她，得知她计划重启凄凉灯塔，同时意识到唤醒这件沉眠的遗物需要时间。虚空暴食者帮助她完善测试凄凉灯塔的计划，并在近期在沃卢克的援助下付诸实行（正如英雄在第2章开头所经历的那样）。自那以后，虚空暴食者一直潜伏在此，明白贝科拉再次联络它以执行计划下一阶段只是时间问题。

虚空暴食者会在此区域的各房间间游走，因为它觉得贝科拉灵魂的回响能令它安宁。因此，当英雄到来时，它同等概率出现在D20a、D20b、D20c或D20d区域。然而，它会立刻注意到英雄的闯入，并迅速前去对抗他们。该生物无意谈判；它会立刻发动攻击，并战斗至死，但不会追击逃离这些房间的英雄。若虚空暴食者显然在一群入侵者面前占尽上风，它或许会提出放大多数人逃走的条件——只要他们留下一个幸存者，让它在几个月里慢慢折磨至死。

These four angled rooms have identical basic descriptions; adjust the following as needed to account for the location of any doors in the room. The western chamber, room D20d, also features a plain stone archway in one wall filled with blank stone. This is an inactive portal to the depths of the Abomination Vaults.

A pair of doors provide exits from this room, one of which is set a foot higher than the room’s dusty floor on a semicircular step.

When Belcorra first began construction of the Abomination Vaults, these chambers served as her personal suite. She lived here for many years as she oversaw the construction of the dungeons both above and below, but once the project was complete, she abandoned this home for one even deeper underground. She moved her belongings deep below as well, leaving these chambers abandoned and empty, but when she became a ghost, her spiritual energy reacted in much the same way Otari’s did by manifesting lingering images within these rooms where she spent so many hours.

As a result, each time the heroes step into one of these four rooms, they're greeted with a brief ghostly image of the room as it once was. Each time, they also see a vision of Belcorra herself within the room. Descriptions of each room's visions are given below, and as you read them, you can use each linked macro to briefly allow an eerie glow to fill the room.

Of course, the chances are good that the heroes won't have time to study the scenes at first- see the Encounter below.

North Room (D20a)

@Macro[WwpFApLBtTEwVg4W]{Vision - A}

This room was once a comfortable sitting room with two chairs and a low end table between them. In the brief vision, Belcorra is meeting with the drow Volluk (as he was in life, as a drow). Although the image has no sound, Belcorra is speaking animatedly about something, and Volluk is listening attentively.

East Room (D20b)

@Macro[ZiZZJYiahnOQKS0n]{Vision - B}

Originally a lounge with two plush divans, this room flashes an image of Belcorra relaxing while reading a large tome. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check sees that the book is titled The Whispering Reeds (this book is currently in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}).

South Room (D20c)

@Macro[tNrLnJiGgEFdLIGi]{Vision - C}

A well-set table reveals this to have once been Belcorra’s private dining room. In the image, she sits alone at the table, drinking a glass of wine and enjoying an elegantly plated roast arm that looks disturbingly human.

West Room (D20d)

@Macro[Txz4sUakBGtaxdvo]{Vision - D}

Belcorra’s bedroom features a large bed along the west wall. The stone archway to the north shimmers as a portal opens and Belcorra steps through with a cruel smile on her lips and blood on her hands.

Encounter

Extreme 4

@Actor[ceLvlSQsYNORH8oM]{Voidglutton}

180 XP

A powerful and horrific entity known as a voidglutton has dwelt within these chambers since Belcorra abandoned them. Unlike many of Belcorra's minions, the voidglutton came to her of its own free will, drawn from across the dimensions by echoes of Nhimbaloth's presence. It volunteered to aid Belcorra as a guardian of the upper shrine (area @UUID[.CGaM81kBLtYIxmqu]{D13}), but once she relocated her personal effects to deeper within the Abomination Vaults, it took over these rooms. It basks in the latent fears and pains of the dungeon's haunts and ghosts.

When Belcorra rose as a ghost, the voidglutton took note and visited her, learning of her plans to reactivate Gauntlight and realizing it would take time to awaken the dormant artifact. The voidglutton helped her refine the plans to testing Gauntlight and has recently done so with Volluk's aid (as the heroes experienced at the beginning of Chapter 2). Since then, the voidglutton has lurked here, understanding that it's just a matter of time before Belcorra contacts it again to enact the next stage of her plan.

The voidglutton moves from room to room in this area, as it finds the echoes of Belcorra's spirit soothing. It therefore has an equal chance of being in area D20a, D20b, D20c, or D20d when the heroes arrive. It notes the heroes' intrusion immediately, however, and swiftly moves to confront them. The creature has no interest in negotiation; it attacks at once and fights to the death, but it doesn't pursue heroes who flee these rooms. If the voidglutton clearly has the upper hand over a group of intruders, it might offer to let most of them flee if they leave it a single survivor to torment to death over a few months.

D21. Trophy Vault.name: D21. 战利品储藏室 D21. Trophy Vault
D21. Trophy Vault.text:
这座八角形房间的墙壁覆着一层令人作呕、潮湿的覆盖物，由丝状的半透明黏液构成。三具生物的尸体被镶嵌在墙上的这层覆盖物中，仿佛被陈列展示：一名淡紫色皮肤的精灵、一具无腿的蛛形类人躯体，以及一名透明血肉的丑陋类人生物。

贝科拉离开时带走了她所有的宝藏，但虚空暴食者多年来一直把这里当作巢穴，并在此摆放了它最喜欢的几件战利品——它曾吞食其心智并觉得格外美味的生物尸体，以及它们的一些强力道具与宝藏。尸体本身被虚空暴食者的灵质蛛网术封在墙上，必须先将其切割解放，才能进行搜查。一旦解放，尸体便会迅速开始衰败，因为不再受到虚空暴食者蛛网术效果的停滞保存。

宝藏

@Actor[uQ6VezqcETteigVY]{战利品储藏室}

来自憎恨魔窟第六等级塑肉仪式实验室的一名蛛化精灵的上半身携带着一支装有次等雾化灵药的小瓶。来自憎恨魔窟第九等级伊尔达里斯前哨的一名卓尔流亡者在一侧手腕上戴着一串神圣祈祷念珠。同一等级的一名透肌魔人的尸体在匣中携带着一把+1 强击复合长弓。

The walls of this octagonal chamber are sheathed in a foul-looking, moist webbing made of stringy, semi-transparent slime. The bodies of three creatures have been mounted on the walls in this webbing, as if on display: a lavender-skinned elf, the legless body of a spider-like humanoid, and a hideous humanoid with transparent flesh.

Belcorra took all of her treasure with her when she left, but the voidglutton has used this place as a den for many years and has placed a few of its favorite trophies here—bodies of creatures whose minds it fed upon and found to be particularly delightful, along with some of their potent gear and treasures. The bodies themselves are encased on the walls by the voidglutton’s ectoplasmic webbing and must be cut free before they can be searched. Once freed, the bodies swiftly begin to decay, no longer held in stasis by the effects of the voidglutton’s webs.

Treasure

@Actor[uQ6VezqcETteigVY]{Trophy Vault}

The upper torso of a drider from the fleshwarping labs on the sixth level of the Abomination Vaults carries a vial with a lesser mistform elixir. A drow outcast from the outpost of Yldaris on the ninth level of the Abomination Vaults wears a strand of holy prayer beads on one wrist. The body of an urdefhan from the same level carries a +1 striking composite longbow in a case.

Chapter 4: Long Dream The Dead.name: 第4章：死者永眠 Chapter 4: Long Dream The Dead
Chapter 4: Long Dream The Dead.text:
章节概要

憎恨魔窟的第四层被设计为贝科拉的避难所，用以让贝科拉放松，并敬奉她那冷漠无情的神祇宁布洛斯。如今，没有任何重要派系在贝科拉的避难所拥有主导地位。取而代之的是，数名强大的个体分别占据了本层的不同区域。英雄们能够获得的最重要盟友，是奥塔里·伊瓦什提的幽灵（特征）——这位陨落的英雄为奥塔里镇留下了其名。

环境线索：

凉爽但舒适的温度，精美却陈旧而奢华的陈设，鬼屋效果，例如门自行关闭或椅子滑动，繁盛的真菌，尘土与淡淡香料的气味，房间在500年前模样的幽影幻视。

贝科拉的避难所

憎恨魔窟的第四层总体而言是较小的一层，但也属于最精致的区域之一，因为它曾作为贝科拉的私人避难所。

特征

本层走廊的天花板高10英尺，房间的天花板高15英尺。除非另有说明，房间均无照明。门为铁箍木门；短暂的灵体会温柔地关上任何敞开超过一分钟的门。

Chapter Synopsis

The fourth level of the Abomination Vaults was designed as a retreat for Belcorra to relax and to revere her uncaring deity Nhimbaloth. No faction of significance holds sway over Belcorra’s Retreat today. Instead, several powerful individuals claim separate portions of this level. The most significant ally the heroes can acquire is the ghost of Otari Ilvashti, the fallen hero who gave the town of Otari its name.

Environmental Cues:

Cool but comfortable temperature, fine furnishings that are old yet luxurious, haunted house effects such as closing doors or sliding chairs, profusions of fungi, smells of dust and faint spices, spectral visions of rooms as they looked 500 years ago.

Belcorra's Retreat

The fourth level of the Abomination Vaults is one of the smaller ones overall, yet it's among the finest, as it once served as Belcorra's personal retreat.

Features

Ceilings in this level are 10 feet tall in halls and 15 feet in rooms. Unless otherwise indicated, rooms are unlit. The doors are iron-banded wood; ephemeral spirits gently shut any door left open for more than a minute.

Deadly Rivalries.name: 致命宿怨 Deadly Rivalries
Deadly Rivalries.text:
贝科拉巨型地城的上层主要供她个人使用，而她将中层设计为工作区。贝科拉在幽暗地域搜寻危险的掠食者与嗜血的异怪，但它们的野性力量仍不足以满足她。她需要将它们塑造成一支军队，用以进攻大都会艾巴萨罗姆。在中层，她让这些力量在身体与心智上都被锻造成战士。因此，第五层包含一座巨大的竞技场与训练场，角斗士们在此为争夺率领她那群怪物部队的资格而战。

在幽暗地域，贝科拉遇到了一种名为双尾虫怪的蠕虫状异怪，它们对侍奉她表现出奇特的热切。随后，她将第六层——原本作为她的怪物与其训练者的支援房间，以及她饲养大型野兽的“保留地”——改作实验室。在那里，双尾虫怪在其首领@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.qrb0F1AQ3iIR7Xni]{贾法基}的指导下，试图完善塑肉仪式，以创造完美无瑕的怪物。

贝科拉将较小的第七层建造成一座牢房。她并不打算囚禁太多俘虏，因为惹她不快的生物要么可以作为贾法基实验的原始血肉，要么作为她的怪物的食物。然而，贝科拉的一位主要行政官——契约魔@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.t9SSGAP5pW2NpkWh]{乌瑞维安}——坚持要建造这座牢房。不久之后，这一层便成了地狱的扭曲镜像。

贝科拉之死

在建造她的地城并打磨她的准备工作约十年后，贝科拉死于英勇的玫瑰团之手，而他们对这些地下的阴谋诡计一无所知。憎恨魔窟几乎立刻陷入混乱。乌瑞维安试图夺取控制权，但贾法基那些异怪造物与魔鬼的势力战至僵持。某种僵局笼罩了中层，而控制疆界在数个世纪里仅略有变动。贾法基只想要和平以继续其实验；乌瑞维安则按其契约所要求，漫不经心地为地表入侵做准备，尽管他知道由于贝科拉已死，他几乎不可能完成契约。

双尾虫怪高超的塑肉仪式技艺之名传播开来。不久，傲慢或绝望的生物来到憎恨魔窟，寻求非凡的改造，尽管最终很少有人认为这些变化算得上改善。奥塔里的人们并不知道这条“客流”存在，因为它是从远在下方的幽暗地域进入地城中层的。

贝科拉的归来

当贝科拉在数年前以带有幽灵（特征）的形态归来时，憎恨魔窟随着她的回归之力而嗡鸣。这一事件的重要性被专注研究的贾法基忽视了，但乌瑞维安没有；这名魔鬼意识到自己如今终于能够履行与那位术士的契约。然而，乌瑞维安早在数个世纪里就一直思索一条精心拟定的漏洞，能让他无需对她提供任何援助便可直接返回地狱。为此，乌瑞维安需要一个特定的凡人灵魂：玫瑰团成员之一沃尔·拉贾尼的灵魂。当然，沃尔早已死亡，但若乌瑞维安获得沃尔最后一位后裔——卡曼·拉贾尼——的灵魂，该条款仍可适用。贝科拉仅仅处于死亡状态时，乌瑞维安无法收取那灵魂；但如今她已归来，只要有人能为他取得卡曼的灵魂，乌瑞维安愿意放弃他大量的准备工作——而他选择让来自奥塔里的地城探险者代他处理此事。

While the upper levels of Belcorra’s massive dungeon were primarily for her personal use, she designed the middle levels for work. Belcorra trawled the Darklands for dangerous predators and bloodthirsty aberrations, but their feral power wasn’t enough for her. She needed to mold them into an army to assault the metropolis of Absalom. In the middle levels, she had these forces forged for battle, in body and in mind. The fifth level thus included a massive arena and training grounds where gladiators would fight for the right to lead her monstrous troops.

In the Darklands, Belcorra encountered wormlike aberrations called seugathis, who had a curious eagerness to serve her. She then repurposed the sixth level—formerly support rooms for her monsters and their trainers as well as a "preserve" where she kept large beasts—as laboratories. There, the seugathis sought to perfect fleshwarping to create flawless monsters under the guidance of their leader, @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.qrb0F1AQ3iIR7Xni]{Jafaki}.

Belcorra constructed the smaller seventh level as a prison. She didn’t intend to keep many captives, since creatures who displeased her could serve as raw flesh for Jafaki’s experiments or as food for her monsters. However, one of Belcorra’s chief administrators, the contract devil @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.t9SSGAP5pW2NpkWh]{Urevian}, insisted on building the prison. Before long, the level became a warped mirror of Hell.

Belcorra's Death

A decade into building her dungeon and honing her preparations, Belcorra died at the hands of the heroic Roseguard, who had no idea about these subterranean machinations. The Abomination Vaults fell into disarray almost immediately. Urevian attempted to assert control, but Jafaki’s aberrant creations fought the devil’s forces to a standstill. A sort of stalemate settled over the middle levels, and the borders of control have shifted only slightly over the centuries. Jafaki merely wanted peace to continue their experiments; Urevian idly prepared for the surface invasion as his contract required of him, even though he knew it was almost impossible for him to complete his contract because Belcorra had died.

Word of the seugathis’ skilled fleshwarping spread. Before long, arrogant or desperate creatures came to the Abomination Vaults seeking remarkable transformations, though few ultimately considered their changes to be improvements. The people of Otari have no idea that this traffic exists, because it comes from the Darklands far below into the dungeon’s middle levels.

Belcorra's Return

When Belcorra returned as a ghost only a few years ago, the Abomination Vaults hummed with the power of her return. The significance of this event was lost on the research-focused Jafaki, but not on Urevian; the devil realized he could now finally fulfill his contract with the sorcerer. Yet Urevian had already spent centuries contemplating a well-drafted loophole that would allow him to simply return to Hell without providing her any aid at all. To do so, Urevian needs a specific mortal soul: that of Vol Rajani, one of the Roseguard. Vol is long dead, of course, but the clause can still apply if Urevian receives the soul of Vol’s last descendant, Carman Rajani. Urevian couldn’t collect the soul while Belcorra was merely dead, but now that she has returned, Urevian is willing to abandon his extensive preparations if someone can get Carman’s soul for him—and he selects the dungeon delvers from Otari to handle this matter on his behalf.

G01. Lower Shaft.name: G01。下轴段 G01. Lower Shaft
G01. Lower Shaft.text:
螺旋楼梯的尽头是一间圆形房间，地面由红色石材铺成。四条宽阔的通道向相反方向延伸，其中三条尽头是一扇门。西侧通道拥有这些门中最令人印象深刻的一扇，高达15英尺，上面刻着一枚燃烧的五芒星。西南侧的楼梯从这间房间向下延伸，但看起来被巨石、碎石与尘土堵塞。

此房间提供通往牢房的牢房区的便捷许可。离开此房间的大多数门都未上锁且容易打开，只有两扇例外，分别在其对应地点中描述：通往区域 @UUID[.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02} 的暗门既隐蔽又上锁；而通往区域 @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10}、刻有五芒星的门则被魔法封印。

向下延伸的楼梯连接到下方100英尺处的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.L9JdFdozxxuly8RY]{H01}。当前无法通行的楼梯至少需要一周的劳动才能清理。此等级的居民很可能不会不骚扰英雄们就给他们这么多时间，因此只要魔鬼与其他敌对生物仍在，就无法有效清除碎石。若英雄与乌瑞维安协商谈判，乌瑞维安同意为他们清出道路，如区域 @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10} 所述。

盯着竖井的眼睛

这间房没有任何守卫，但北侧区域 @UUID[.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03} 中正在操练一支铁骨怪小队的胡须魔，很可能会看见任何进入此处的人。那名胡须魔会鼓动他的士兵发动攻击。

The spiral staircase bottoms at a circular chamber’s red stone floor. Four wide passages lead away in opposite directions, three of them ending at a door. The west passage features the most impressive of these doors, which are fifteen feet high and inscribed with a blazing pentagram. The southwest stairway descends from this room and appears choked with boulders, rubble, and dust.

This chamber provides easy access to the prison’s cell blocks. Most doors leading from this room are unlocked and open easily, except for two described in their respective locations: the secret door to area @UUID[.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02} is both hidden and locked, and the pentagram-inscribed doors to area @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10} are magically sealed.

The stairs leading downward connect to area @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.L9JdFdozxxuly8RY]{H01}, 100 feet below. The currently impassable stairs take at least a week of labor to clear. This level’s denizens likely won’t give the heroes this time without harrying them, so they can’t effectively clear away the rubble while the devils and other hostile creatures remain. Urevian agrees to clear the way for the heroes if they negotiate with him, as described in area @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10}.

An Eye on the Shaft

This room doesn’t have any guards, but the barbazu drilling the unit of dreshkans in area @UUID[.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03} to the north likely sees anyone entering it. That barbazu exhorts his soldiers to attack.

G02. Level 7 Portal Chamber.name: G02. 等级 7 传送门厅室 G02. Level 7 Portal Chamber
G02. Level 7 Portal Chamber.text:
探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

一名英雄在一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中会发现通往此房间的秘密门。按下门上方的某块特定石头会使其向内旋转，但只转动一英寸左右——刚好露出一个由金属圆筒组成的密码锁。

密码早已失传，但英雄可以通过一次成功的 @Check[type:athletics|dc:25|traits:action:force-open]{运动} 检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{破拆} 打开门，或进行四次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗贼} 检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{开锁}。若英雄的盗贼熟练度为大师，则能认出弹子是锁最脆弱的部分，并能以一次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗贼} 检定将其打开。

传送网络

憎恨魔窟中的某些 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{传送法阵} 构成了更大网络的一部分。通过描摹墙上符文的特定图案，某人可以将这些房间中任意一间里的所有人传送到憎恨魔窟中另外九个传送门房间之一——前提是出发房间与目的地中的传送法阵都已通过 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{唤醒传送门}仪式唤醒（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}）。

这九个房间分别是区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}、@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}、@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}、@UUID[.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}、@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}、@UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}、以及 @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

这间房间的地面在一层薄薄的尘土下闪着微光。墙壁上刻着填入银质镶嵌的符文。

此房间含有一座惰性的传送法阵，与憎恨魔窟中其他地方的那些相同（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}）。这座传送法阵也必须通过唤醒传送门仪式重新启动。

XP 奖励

为激活此传送门，奖励英雄们 30 XP。

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{Perception} check spots the secret door to this room. Pressing a particular stone above the door causes it to rotate inward, but only an inch or so and just enough to reveal a combination lock made of metal cylinders.

The combination is long lost, but a hero can open the door with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:25|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open}, or four successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock}. A hero who’s a master in Thievery recognizes the tumblers as the lock’s most vulnerable part and can open it with a single successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} check.

Teleportation Network

Some of the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} within the Abomination Vaults form a part of a larger network. By tracing specific patterns on the wall runes, someone could transport everyone in any one of these chambers to one of nine other portal chambers in the Abomination Vaults- so long as the teleportation circles in both the departure chamber and destination have been awakened by the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal} ritual (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}).

The nine chambers are areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}, @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}, @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}, @UUID[.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}, @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}, @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

This room's floor gleams under a thin layer of dust. Runes filled with silver inlay have been carved into the walls.

This room contains an inert teleportation circle like the ones elsewhere in the Abomination Vaults (area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}). This teleportation circle must also be reactivated with the awaken portal ritual.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for activating this portal.

G03. Drill Field.name: G03. 操练场 G03. Drill Field
G03. Drill Field.text:
这间房间磨损严重的地面表明它一直在被频繁使用。墙壁向上倾斜，连接到头顶二十英尺高的天花板。北墙有一座矿井升降梯，但通往其中的通道被一面闪烁的橙色能量墙阻挡。

贝科拉曾在此迎接来自幽暗地域的客人，然后带他们上楼享受娱乐与茶点。这间房间的奢华随着时代流逝而黯淡。数百年的军事操练、对练及其他摧残损坏了墙壁，墙面上溅满了血液与脓血。

贾法基并未太在意那些被魔鬼击败的众多胶化人，他以为魔鬼把它们全都杀了。事实上，乌瑞维安的部队已训练胶化人站在他们一边，对抗其造物主。由于胶化人是无心智的生物，训练它们是个格外缓慢术的过程，但魔鬼们有大把时间可用。

遭遇

中等 7

@Actor[A4MusxxoLxwMVZua]{胡须魔教官军士}, @Actor[K9Hw43co8fhwmKkM]{胶化人（6）}

80 xp

目前，一名胡须魔正在此操练六名胶化人。他用自己的魔法护腕来促使它们服从，而胶化人会遵从他的命令。魔鬼对胶化人可怜的呻吟声免疫。这些部队一看到入侵者就会发动攻击，这很可能发生在英雄们抵达区域 @UUID[.2aDFWQZkq3nA7KPT]{G01} 时。

世界状态

@Macro[6RFoXgFGwaBWdNIm]{G03 - 炼狱屏障}

乌瑞维安从下方的农场等级获得食物来喂养他的人类士兵，但他并不怎么关心那里的居民或他们的谋划。自贝科拉的归来以来，乌瑞维安看见越来越多的透肌魔人、卓尔等在牢房等级里穿行游行，他已经受够了。他最近用瓦砾封堵了通往下层的楼梯（区域 @UUID[.2aDFWQZkq3nA7KPT]{G01}）。此外，他还动用了炼狱联系人欠下的人情，创造出一道永久、发光的@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.7Iela4GgVeO3LfAo]{力场墙}，封住升降梯的井道，并在整个房间内投下昏暗光照。

他无法亲自控制这面墙；它与乌瑞维安的契约本质相连。只有当乌瑞维安与贝科拉的契约履行完毕，或他被杀死时，它才会立刻消失。乌瑞维安知道，他对这些屏障的掌控很可能让他在与英雄交涉时握有一些筹码，从而进一步让他受益。他希望说服他们接受他的@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.dVEJIxBXK6Mr30Cn]{提议}，因为他需要他们成为他在地表的代理之手。

当你的玩家准备好穿透屏障时，此宏将移除升降梯井道的力场墙与光照效果，使他们能够通过。

当升降梯运作时，它会下降100英尺至区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.4gMUpcEFebuDe1Tf]{H17}；其功能在该处描述，因为它处于较低位置。

This chamber’s well-worn floor attests to its constant use. The walls angle up to the ceiling twenty feet overhead. The northern wall has a mine shaft elevator, but a wall of shimmering orange energy blocks the passage leading into it.

Belcorra welcomed her guests from the Darklands here before leading them upstairs for entertainment and refreshments. The chamber’s opulence has diminished over time. Centuries of military drills, sparring, and other abuses have damaged the walls, which are splattered in blood and ichor.
