Jafaki doesn’t pay much attention to the many grothluts whom the devils defeated, assuming that the devils slew them all. In truth, Urevian’s forces have trained the grothluts to fight on their side against their creators. As grothluts are mindless creatures, training them is an exceptionally slow process, but the devils have had a lot of time on their hands.

Encounter

Moderate 7

@Actor[A4MusxxoLxwMVZua]{Barbazu Drill Sergeant}, @Actor[K9Hw43co8fhwmKkM]{Grothluts (6)}

80 xp

A barbazu is currently drilling six grothluts here. He uses his magical bracers to encourage compliance, and the grothluts follow his orders. The devil is immune to the grothluts’ piteous moaning. These troops attack as soon as they see intruders, which likely occurs when the heroes arrive in area @UUID[.2aDFWQZkq3nA7KPT]{G01}.

World State

@Macro[6RFoXgFGwaBWdNIm]{G03 - Infernal Barrier}

Urevian receives food from the farm level below to feed his mortal soldiers but cares little for the denizens there or their machinations. Since Belcorra’s return, Urevian has seen an increase in urdefhans, drow, and more parading through the prison level, and he has had enough. He recently blocked the stairs leading down to the lower level with rubble (area @UUID[.2aDFWQZkq3nA7KPT]{G01}). In addition, he pulled in favors from infernal contacts to create a permanent, glowing @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.7Iela4GgVeO3LfAo]{Wall of Force} that blocks the elevator’s shaft and sheds dim light throughout the chamber.

He has no personal control over the wall; it’s tied to the essence of Urevian’s contract. It disappears immediately only when Urevian’s contract with Belcorra is fulfilled, or if he’s slain. Urevian knows that his control over these barriers probably gives him some leverage with the heroes, which further benefits him. He hopes to convince them to take his @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.dVEJIxBXK6Mr30Cn]{Offer}, as he needs them to be his hands on the surface.

When your players are ready to pierce the barrier, this macro will remove the wall and lighting effects from the elevator shaft, allowing them to pass.

When it operates, the elevator descends 100 feet to area @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.4gMUpcEFebuDe1Tf]{H17}; its function is described there, as its in the lower position.

G04. Storage Cells.name: G04. 储藏室 G04. Storage Cells
G04. Storage Cells.text:
这些房间从一条长廊分岔出去，显然曾用作牢房，但门都敞开着。牢房里堆着成摞的木箱、桶，以及装满箭矢的箭袋。

这些旧牢房里存放着沥青桶、灯油壶、纠缠线、燧石与打火钢，以及数百支箭——足以摧毁一个小村庄的储备。

遭遇

低危 7

@Actor[uyGxJOnJ1gYwOpy5]{阿兹瓦维甘德} @Actor[DnAeqlJRZc5N7hve]{铁骨怪（4）}

60 XP

一名名为阿兹瓦维甘德的斥控魔负责为这些装备逐项登记，而乌瑞维安打算用它们来对付奥塔里。这个爱挑剔的斥控魔已经把清单核对了两遍，现在又再核对一次，以确保自己没有犯任何错误。四只铁骨怪帮她承担粗重劳动并负责防卫。

宝藏

阿兹瓦维甘德携带乌瑞维安坠饰五块@UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{碎片}之一（见区域 @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10}）

只有一扇牢门上了锁——东侧的隔离牢房（区域 G4a）。这条走廊里的斥控魔持有钥匙；该门也可以由一名英雄通过在@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{开锁}时成功完成三次 @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃}检定来打开，或通过一次 @Check[type:athletics|dc:25|traits:action:force-open]{运动}检定以@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{破拆}打开。

宝藏

@Actor[nwef3ap1ATjGYdvx]{炼狱军械库}

上锁的储藏室里存放着为对奥塔里的必然袭击而准备的贵重且具破坏性的装备：1支标准爆炸箭、3支III型法袭箭、3瓶青年红龙之息药水，以及10瓶中等炽火胶。

These rooms stem off a long hall and obviously functioned as prison cells, but the doors stand open. The cells contain stacks of crates, barrels, and quivers full of arrows.

These former prison cells hold barrels of pitch, jugs of lantern oil, fuse cord, flint and steel, and hundreds of arrows—sufficient supplies to destroy a small village.

Encounter

Low 7

@Actor[uyGxJOnJ1gYwOpy5]{Azvalvigander} @Actor[DnAeqlJRZc5N7hve]{Dreshkans (4)}

60 XP

A zebub named Azvalvigander is responsible for itemizing this equipment, which Urevian intends to use against Otari. The fussy zebub has checked the inventory twice over, doing so again to ensure she didn’t make any mistakes. Four dreshkans help her with brute labor and defense.

Treasure

Azvalvigander carries one of the five @UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{Fragments} of Urevian's pendant (see area @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10})

Only one cell door is locked—the isolation cell to the east (area G4a). The zebub in this hall holds the key; the door can also be opened by a hero who succeeds at three @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} or a @Check[type:athletics|dc:25|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}.

Treasure

@Actor[nwef3ap1ATjGYdvx]{Infernal Armory}

The locked storage room contains valuable, destructive equipment stored for the inevitable assault on Otari: a standard explosive arrow, three type III spellstrike arrows, three young red dragon's breath potions, and 10 moderate alchemist's fires.

G05. Hellforge.name: G05. 地狱熔炉 G05. Hellforge
G05. Hellforge.text:
这间房间的墙壁被熏得焦黑。铁链从二十英尺高的天花板上垂下，悬挂着放有工具与金属锭的架子。北墙的壁龛里塞着一座熔炉；炉口大张，布满如同巨兽般的参差利齿，内部烈火咆哮。巨兽熔炉的双角之间，天花板上的一个洞口将从其鼻孔喷出的浓烟吸走。熔炉旁放着一座铁砧。西墙边紧贴着一个装满煤灰污水的水槽，南墙的双开门两侧摆着武器架。

这间房间曾经是一间拷问室，但乌瑞维安将其改作更高效的用途：为他对地表不可避免的进攻制造武器。

狭小的通风井向上延伸数百英尺，尽头是土中的一间巨大的空室，烟雾被困在那里，直到沉降下来。

乌瑞维安把锻造工作交给了一名名叫巴坎布克的狂怒魔——一位技艺高超的铁匠，但他对不得不制造凡俗武器颇为不满。他更为那种费时费力、流程冗长的地狱熔炉武器锻造工艺感到自豪，因此数个世纪以来他的总体产出一直相对有限。

遭遇

中等 7

@Actor[8Iozx4jbIGHxK4yf]{Barcumbuk} @Actor[vX4SBXIICKfrM4pF]{Hellforge Barbazu}

80 XP

魔鬼们意识到英雄们能到这里，必然已经击败了阿兹瓦维甘德及其护卫；他们对这名一丝不苟的斥控魔的死亡毫不掩饰地表示赞赏。然而，他们仍会攻击英雄。巴坎布克使用炽热的熔炉铁锤战斗；他拥有狂怒魔常见的火焰之怒能力，因此他手中持握的任何武器在他持握期间都会获得焰爆符文的效果。胡须魔使用一把魔法的地狱熔炉长柄刀（使其伤害远高于典型的胡须魔）。这些魔鬼将战斗至死。

宝藏

巴坎布克携带着乌瑞维安吊坠的五个 @UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{Fragments} 之一（见区域 @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10}）

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

地狱熔炉

英雄们缺乏将这座邪恶的地狱熔炉用于普通熔炉以外用途的技能，但他们当然可以摧毁它。一名英雄在进行 @Check[type:crafting|dc:22|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Crafting} 或 @Check[type:religion|dc:22|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{宗教} 检定以回忆知识并成功后，会记起即便只需将少量圣水泼洒在一座炼狱熔炉上，也能将其摧毁（若为大成功或大失败，该英雄还会记起这样做会释放一股能量爆冲）。

若英雄们用圣水泼洒地狱熔炉，它会在一声沉重的呻吟中从中间裂开。它对房间内的生物造成 [[/r 4d6[sonic]]] 伤害与 [[/r 4d6[evil]]] 伤害（@Check[type:fort|dc:23|basic:true]{Basic Fortitude} 豁免）。

XP 奖励

摧毁地狱熔炉时，给予英雄们 30 XP。

宝藏

@Actor[TXnAx3WaWHSn8nBy]{Hellforge Materials}

巴坎布克尚未来得及锻造的特殊金属整齐地堆放在铁砧附近。

• 五块寒铁（每块 10 gp）

• 两块银（每块 10 gp）

• 一块精金（500 gp）

This chamber’s walls are charred black. Chains hang from the twenty-foot-tall ceiling, suspending shelves holding tools and metal ingots. A forge fills an alcove in the north wall; its mouth yawns open, filled with jagged teeth like those of a great beast, and a blazing fire roars inside. Between the beast-forge’s horns, a hole in the ceiling captures the smoke belching from its nostrils. An anvil rests near the forge. The west wall has a trough of sooty water pushed up against it, and weapon racks flank the double door on the south wall.

This room once served as a torture chamber, but Urevian repurposed it for a more efficient use: creating weapons for his inevitable assault on the surface.

The tiny ventilation shaft extends upwards hundreds of feet before ending in a large, empty chamber in the earth, where smoke is trapped until it settles.

Urevian assigned forge duty to an erinys named Barcumbuk, a skilled smith who bristles at having to produce mundane weapons. He derives more pride from the laborious and lengthy process of creating hellforged weapons, so his overall productivity over the centuries has been relatively modest.

Encounter

Moderate 7

@Actor[8Iozx4jbIGHxK4yf]{Barcumbuk} @Actor[vX4SBXIICKfrM4pF]{Hellforge Barbazu}

80 XP

The devils realize that the heroes must have defeated Azvalvigander and her bodyguards to get here, and they’re openly appreciative of the exacting zebub’s demise. They still attack the heroes, however. Barcumbuk fights with his fiery forge hammers; he has the flames of fury ability common to erinyes, so any weapon he holds gains the effects of the flaming rune while he holds it. The barbazu uses a magical hellforged glaive (making its damage considerably greater than that of a typical barbazu). The devils fight to the death.

Treasure

Barcumbuk carries one of the five @UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{Fragments} of Urevian's pendant (see area @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10})

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

The Hellforge

The heroes lack the skills to use the evil hellforge as anything but an ordinary forge, but they can certainly destroy it. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:crafting|dc:22|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Crafting} or @Check[type:religion|dc:22|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Religion} check to Recall Knowledge remembers that even a small amount of holy water splattered on an infernal forge can destroy it (on a critical success, the hero also remembers that doing so releases a blast of energy).

If the heroes splatter the hellforge with holy water, it cracks down the middle with a mighty groan. It deals [[/r 4d6[sonic]]] damage and [[/r 4d6[evil]]] damage (@Check[type:fort|dc:23|basic:true]{Basic Fortitude} save) to creatures in the room.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for destroying the hellforge.

Treasure

@Actor[TXnAx3WaWHSn8nBy]{Hellforge Materials}

Special metals Barcumbuk hasn’t gotten around to forging are stacked neatly near the anvil.

• Five cold iron chunks (10 gp each)

• Two silver chunks (10 gp each)

• An adamantine chunk (500 gp)

G06. Guard Chamber.name: G06. 守卫室 G06. Guard Chamber
G06. Guard Chamber.text:
这间朴素的石室有两扇双开门，一扇在北墙，另一扇在南墙。东墙与西墙上布满了细小的雕刻。

这里的守卫制作这些雕刻来打发时间。每一幅雕刻都以炼狱语写着一个荒诞的形而上学问题，例如“如果你谁都不是，你是谁？”以及“当你的灵魂被吞噬时，你会吞噬你自己吗？”这名生物喜欢在审讯时抛出这类问题，让受害者为追寻更深层的含义而绞尽脑汁，并在找不到任何意义时感到自己很愚蠢。

遭遇

中等 7

@Actor[xjV0TmPNfKR7UcKu]{伊亚吉安}

80 XP

一名名为伊亚吉安的骨魔在乌瑞维安的命令下驻守于此。伊亚吉安不满于仅仅担任守卫，但仍受其服务契约条款所约束，于是它会以极其字面化的方式履行职责。它从不向召唤间里的艾琳耶丝通报任何麻烦，而且无论在别处听到什么动静都不会离开此室，除非它本人正遭到攻击。若有机会交谈，伊亚吉安会坦率说明自己的职责，并分享几段它那些荒诞的沉思。该恶魔会利用英雄们花在思考上的时间，借助其黄泉判官能力来提问。然而，伊亚吉安很快就会失去耐心，并坚持英雄们必须离开，否则就要承受它的怒火。若战斗开始，这名骨魔会死战到底。

This plain stone chamber has two double doors, one on the north wall and a second on the south wall. Tiny carvings cover the east and west walls.

The guardian here made these carvings to pass the time. Each carving represents a nonsense metaphysical question in Infernal, such as “Who are you if you are no one?” and “When your soul is consumed, do you consume yourself?” The creature likes to pose these types of questions during their interrogations to make victims puzzle over them in search of deeper meanings and feel foolish upon failing to find any.

Encounter

Moderate 7

@Actor[xjV0TmPNfKR7UcKu]{Iyagian}

80 XP

A bone devil named Iyagian stands watch here at Urevian’s command. Unhappy with serving as a mere guard, yet bound by the contractual terms of their service, Iyagian treats their charge very literally. They never warn the erinyes in the summoning chamber of any trouble and don’t leave this room no matter what they hear elsewhere unless they’re personally under attack. If given the chance to talk, Iyagian freely explains their role and offers some of their nonsense meditations. The devil uses the time the heroes spend contemplating to ask questions using their Stygian Inquisitor ability. Iyagian quickly loses patience, however, and insists the heroes must leave or risk their wrath. If combat begins, the bone devil fights to the death.

G07. Summoning Chamber.name: G07. 召唤间 G07. Summoning Chamber
G07. Summoning Chamber.text:
房间南端的一段楼梯向北通往一处平台，平台俯瞰着一间圆筒状的厅室。平台边缘立着一座石制祭坛，上面堆满了半融化的蜡烛。祭坛上方，天花板裂缝里缓慢滴下清水落到平台上，水滴在令人窒息的酷热中迅速蒸发。六条沉重的铁链将一块宽大的金属圆盘悬吊在岩浆池上方，岩浆池以橙色发光照亮整间厅室。圆盘顶面清晰可见一个炽焰五芒星。

贝科拉让地卜师改道一股天然岩浆流，使其在此处汇聚成池。随后她下令打造仪式祭坛与圆盘顶面的召唤法阵。贝科拉曾在这间厅室中召唤数名邪魔，并将每一个都束缚为自己效劳。其中最强大的是乌瑞维安，因为她与他的契约使她也获得了对所有侍奉乌瑞维安的魔鬼的许可。

这间房间门口处的天花板高20尺。楼梯下行至平台时，天花板仍保持同样高度，因此平台上方的天花板高达25尺。圆盘与平台处在同一高度，但其上方跨越岩浆的15尺缺口让人望而却步，难以触及。

炼狱酷热

此厅室内的空气受到魔法冷却，仅有酷热程度，每小时造成[[/r 1d6[fire]]]伤害。深达10尺的岩浆池危险更甚；浸入岩浆每轮造成[[/r 20d6[fire]]]伤害。一名英雄若成功通过一次@Check[type:crafting|dc:22|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{工艺}或@Check[type:religion|dc:23|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{宗教}检定，会意识到岩浆的热量为召唤法阵提供动力。

开裂的天花板

一名角色若成功通过一次@Check[type:nature|dc:23|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{自然}检定（或相关的学识（技能），例如采矿学识），会认出天花板上的裂缝使得正上方地下湖的水得以滴落（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.f7dzsMJc3BAy82zr]{F04}）。若英雄们扩大这道裂缝——这项任务需要合适的工具、能够触及天花板的能力，并花费数小时凿削石材——滴水将变成细流，继而化为洪水。涌入的水会使房间充满蒸汽，并在数小时内将岩浆冷却成石头。英雄也会知道，冷却岩浆会摧毁召唤法阵。

遭遇

严重 7

@Actor[ETNlci6VnSthx5V6]{狂怒魔（2）}

120 XP

一对狂怒魔姐妹正试图将召唤法阵改造成通往地狱的永久门扉。这对姐妹更关心异界传送门的理论而非实际应用，因此她们花大量时间讨论自己的工作，却几乎没做多少落实。若有人打断她们的讨论，她们会暴怒，并很可能攻击闯入者。然而，如果她们认为某位英雄与自己兴趣相近（例如她们看到英雄在战斗中召唤生物），她们会提议停止战斗，转而讨论异界学识的更深细节。当她们自认为已经学到所能学的一切后，狂怒魔会试图谋杀这位竞争学者。

宝藏

其中一名狂怒魔携带着一枚@UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{碎片}，属于乌瑞维安的坠饰（见区域@UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10}）。

A stairway at the room’s south end leads north to a platform overlooking a cylindrical chamber. Half-melted candles cover a stone altar perched on this platform’s edge. Above the altar, water slowly drips from a crack in the ceiling and onto the platform, the droplets rapidly evaporating in the stifling heat. Six heavy chains suspend a wide metal disk above a magma pool that illuminates the chamber with an orange glow. A fiery pentagram features visibly atop the disk.

Belcorra had geomancers divert a natural magma flow to pool here. She then commissioned the creation of the ritual altar and the summoning circle atop the disk. Belcorra summoned several fiends in this chamber, binding each to her service. The greatest of these was Urevian, as her contract with him gave her access to all the devils who serve Urevian as well.

The ceiling is 20 feet tall at the doors of this room. As the stairs descend to the platform, the ceiling stays the same height, so it’s 25 feet above the platform. The disk is at the same level as the platform, but the 15-foot gap over magma makes it daunting to reach.

Infernal Heat

The air in this chamber is magically cooled to only severe heat, dealing [[/r 1d6[fire]]] damage every hour. The 10-foot-deep magma pool presents a greater danger; immersion in the magma deals [[/r 20d6[fire]]] damage each round. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:crafting|dc:22|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Crafting} or @Check[type:religion|dc:23|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Religion} check realizes that the magma’s heat powers the summoning circle.

The Cracked Ceiling

A character who succeeds at a @Check[type:nature|dc:23|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Nature} check (or a related Lore skill, such as Mining Lore) recognizes that the crack in the ceiling allows water to drip down from the underground lake directly above (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.f7dzsMJc3BAy82zr]{F04}). If the heroes widen this crack—a task requiring appropriate tools, the ability to reach the ceiling, and several hours of chipping away the stone—the drips become a trickle, then a flood. The rush of water fills the room with steam and cools the magma to stone over a few hours. The hero also knows that cooling the magma destroys the summoning circle.

Encounter

Severe 7

@Actor[ETNlci6VnSthx5V6]{Erinyes (2)}

120 XP

Twin erinys sisters are trying to convert the summoning circle into a permanent gate to Hell. Concerned more with the theory of extraplanar portals than the application, the sisters spend a lot of time discussing their work but haven’t done much to enact it. Furious at interruptions to their discourse, they most likely attack intruders. However, if they think a hero shares their interests (such as if they see a hero summon a creature in a fight), they offer to cease combat to discuss the finer points of extraplanar lore. When they’ve learned all they think they can, the erinyes attempt to murder the rival scholar.

Treasure

One erinys has a @UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{Fragment} of Urevian’s pendant (see area @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10}).

G08. Isolation Chamber.name: G08. 隔离室 G08. Isolation Chamber
G08. Isolation Chamber.text:
这间牢房的门上，在与视线齐平的小型滑动栅格上方贴着一张便条。便条由小魔鬼泽克用通用语、地底语与炼狱语书写，内容是：“若你珍惜四肢，就别来打扰。”

此室的墙壁与地面都布满短尖钉，长度刚好足以让任何站立、坐下或倚靠其上的人感到不适。

这间房曾用于关押格外倔强或麻烦的囚犯，但直到最近都几乎没怎么使用。

这间隔离室已不再上锁，因此门能关上却不会扣住。任何人若挪开便条并将栅格滑到一旁窥视牢房，都会看见其中的古格巨人住客正在冥想；若她在栅格被滑开时通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:30]{察觉} 检定，她便会从冥想中醒来。

遭遇

严重 7

@Actor[zq18QX6CBJNeUIgG]{奥尔}

120 XP

贝科拉最近派出一名名为奥尔的古格巨人，前来查看乌瑞维安的进展。奥尔这次出其不意、令人不快的到访，是促使乌瑞维安最终封锁通往下层等级的许可的入侵事件之一。乌瑞维安一直拖着不去与奥尔交谈，因为他并不真想续签或重提自己与贝科拉的交易。奥尔已厌倦与乌瑞维安的部下说话，并要求她的下一次谈话必须与乌瑞维安本人进行。若英雄们惊扰了古格巨人，她会把他们误认为又一批走狗，并以突然而骇人的暴力反应。她会放任逃跑的敌人撤退，否则便战至死。

The door to this cell has a note affixed over a small sliding grate at eye level. Written by the imp Szek in Common, Undercommon, and Infernal, the note reads, “Do not disturb if you value your limbs.”

The walls and floor of this chamber are covered in short spikes just long enough to cause discomfort to anyone standing, sitting, or leaning on them.

Once a chamber to detain particularly headstrong or troublesome prisoners, this room has seen very little use until recently.

This isolation chamber no longer has a lock, so the door closes but doesn’t latch. Anyone moving the note and sliding the grate aside to look in the cell sees its gug occupant meditating; if she succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:30]{Perception} check when the grate slides aside, she awakens from her meditation.

Encounter

Severe 7

@Actor[zq18QX6CBJNeUIgG]{Aulr}

120 XP

Belcorra recently sent a gug named Aulr to check on Urevian’s progress. Aulr’s unexpected and unwelcome arrival was one of the intrusions that convinced Urevian to finally block access to the lower levels. Urevian has put off talking to Aulr because he doesn’t really want to renew or revisit his deal with Belcorra. Aulr has grown tired of speaking to Urevian’s underlings and demanded to have her next conversation with Urevian himself. If the heroes disturb the gug, she mistakes them for yet more lackeys and reacts with sudden and startling violence. She allows foes who flee to retreat, but she otherwise fights to the death.

G09. Observation Room.name: G09. 阅兵室 G09. Observation Room
G09. Observation Room.text:
这间高大的厅室高达30英尺。南侧墙壁由透明石材构成，墙外可见一间巨大房间：里面布满方形的透明立柱，周围环绕着一圈检修步道。透明墙边堆着一团金属废料。

从这一侧看去南墙是透明的，但从另一侧看去却是不透明的。谋士们可以俯瞰南边的停滞厅室，从中挑选要用凄凉灯塔传送的生物。那些金属废料曾是一条高架步道，但当乌瑞维安派一只胡须魔来递交简要报告、而非亲自与她会面时，区域 @UUID[.Aob08m2bfrkArmJ2]{G08} 的古格巨人在暴怒中将其彻底毁坏。

生物

一只名为泽克的小魔鬼在天花板附近扑扇飞舞，手里拿着小笔记本与木炭笔。她记录对各个囚犯的观察，并提出在即将到来的对奥塔里入侵中如何利用他们的建议。示例条目包括：“呓语之喉——地面操控可使桥梁失能或被毁，例如河口附近的酒馆桥。”

当泽克察觉到英雄时，她会施放隐形术，并试图交涉而不是战斗。

“关门！关门！我可不想被逮到在跟你们说话——你们会害得我们全都被拷打。那……地表居民，是吧？见到你们真高兴。你们要收拾乌瑞维安，对吧？下流的恶魔。让他继续待着可不是什么好买卖——对，对，对。要不我们互不干涉，假装从没见过彼此，怎么样？”

尽管英雄们离开她也完全满意，但若有人主动搭话，泽克也会与他们交谈。她起始态度为不关心，并会一直保持隐形，直到英雄将她的态度改变为友善——这需要一名角色在一次 @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:17|traits:action:make-an-impression]{交涉} 检定中成功，以进行 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}（因为这是泽克的意志 DC）。

泽克厌倦了替乌瑞维安跑这些卑微的差事。她在寻找一个更易摆布、值得效劳的新主人，并希望与某人订立 @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.y0cRr28w57VapTcn]{魔鬼的幸运} 的地狱契约。若英雄们改善了她的态度，她不仅会提供这份契约，还会尽其所能回答问题（无论他们是否接受契约）。

泽克知道什么

乌瑞维安的交易
泽克知道乌瑞维安与贝科拉之间有某种安排，但他想抽身而退，即使这意味着要达成一笔交易来削弱贝科拉的行动。她建议去与乌瑞维安交谈以了解更多，但她知道他们需要五个五芒星护符部件，才能打开通往区域 @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10} 的门。
乌瑞维安的护符
若被问到碎片的位置，她推测碎片可能在以下对象手中：被派去破坏实验室楼层的溺亡魔（区域 F5）、军需官阿兹瓦维甘德（区域 @UUID[.JCRGIRMAhYyjkSvF]{G04}）、铁匠巴坎布克（区域 @UUID[.AeQmFFVsCUF02tzd]{G05}）、守卫伊亚吉安（区域 @UUID[.wOB4cnHVwICglnUc]{G06}；他们没有碎片）、铸门者们（区域 @UUID[.fK6B6GmATzvRIuh4]{G07}），或是那个诡异的“杂色人”——泽克偶尔会见到他，但他让她胆寒（她指的是区域 @UUID[.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18} 的伊松德赫利）。
关于下方楼层
泽克知道乌瑞维安厌倦了来自下层的访客，便用魔法封住了一条路，另一条路则干脆用碎石瓦砾塞满。她确信他要打开任意一条都很容易。
关于上方楼层
若被问到更高楼层，泽克兴高采烈地承认自己很久以前参与过乌瑞维安与“蠕虫怪物”之间的一场“大打斗”。她曾只用几枚岩钉就把一名强大的法师锁在房间里，至今仍为此自豪。那名法师——区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.5XJBjPHU2XkIZWtN]{E17} 的查夫肯姆——会很想知道将他囚禁起来的正是泽克。
关于牢房的布局
就牢房楼层的布局而言，泽克掌握的信息有限。她只知道区域 G1 到 G16，尽管她也知晓区域 @UUID[.9ggvXDV6BvojMVBZ]{G17} 有一个暴怒的绿色灵体。她对每个房间的力量有个粗略概念，但她不知道区域 @UUID[.WeTrPKqTCTHIoWRu]{G11s} 或 @UUID[.FzCW2srXAWImPK0v]{G16} 的陷阱；事实上，她认为区域 G16 闹鬼。

This tall chamber reaches a height of thirty feet. Transparent stone makes up the southern wall, which looks into a vast room filled with square, transparent pillars surrounded by a catwalk. A jumble of metal scrap lies against this transparent wall.

While transparent from this side, the southern wall appears opaque from the other side. Strategists could look out over the stasis chamber to the south to select creatures to transport with Gauntlight. The metal scrap used to be a high catwalk, but the gug in area @UUID[.Aob08m2bfrkArmJ2]{G08} wrecked it in a fury when Urevian sent a barbazu to provide a summary report rather than personally meeting with her.

Creature

An imp named Szek flutters near the ceiling, holding a small notebook and charcoal pencil. She records observations about the various prisoners with recommendations on how to use them in the upcoming invasion of Otari. Sample entries include “gibbering mouther—ground manipulation could disable or destroy bridges, such as the tavern bridge near river mouth.”

When Szek detects the heroes, she casts invisibility and attempts to parlay rather than fight.

“Close the door! Close the door! I don’t want to get caught talking to you—you’ll get us all tortured. So, surface dwellers, eh? Glad to see you. You’re taking down Urevian, right? Nasty devil. Bad business keeping him around—yup, yup, yup. How about we leave each other alone and pretend we never saw each other?”

Although perfectly happy if the heroes leave, Szek will speak to them if broached. Her starting attitude is indifferent, and she remains invisible until the heroes change her attitude to friendly, which requires a character to succeed at a @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:17|traits:action:make-an-impression]{Diplomacy} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} (as that’s Szek’s Will DC).

Szek tires of running menial errands for Urevian. She’s looking for someone more pliable to serve and hopes to enter into a @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.y0cRr28w57VapTcn]{Devil's Luck} infernal contract with someone. If the heroes improve her attitude, she not only offers this contract, but answers questions as best she can (whether or not they take the contract).

What Szek Knows

Urevian's Deal
Szek knows that Urevian has some sort of arrangement with Belcorra, but he wants to get out of it, even if it means making a deal to undercut Belcorra’s efforts. She suggests talking to Urevian to find out more, but she knows they’ll need the five parts of a pentagram amulet to open the door to area @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10}.
Urevian's Amulet
If asked about the pieces’ locations, she speculates that the fragments could be held by the sarglagon sent to sabotage the laboratories level (area F5), Azvalvigander the quartermaster (area @UUID[.JCRGIRMAhYyjkSvF]{G04}), Barcumbuk the smith (area @UUID[.AeQmFFVsCUF02tzd]{G05}), Iyagian the guard (area @UUID[.wOB4cnHVwICglnUc]{G06}; they don’t have one), the gate-forgers (area @UUID[.fK6B6GmATzvRIuh4]{G07}), or the strange Motley Man who Szek sees sometimes but who terrifies her (she refers to Ysondkhelir in area @UUID[.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18}).
On the floors below
Szek knows that Urevian got tired of visitors from the lower levels and blocked one route with magic and the other route by simply stuffing it full of rubble. She’s certain he could open either easily.
On the floors above
If asked about the higher levels, Szek gleefully admits to participating in a “big fight” between Urevian and “the worm-monsters” a long time ago. She locked a powerful wizard in his room with just a few pitons and still takes pride in the act. The wizard—Chafkhem in area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.5XJBjPHU2XkIZWtN]{E17}—would be keen to learn that Szek is the one who imprisoned him.
On the prison's layout
As far as the prison level's layout, Szek has limited information. She knows only about areas G1 through G16, although she’s aware of an angry green spirit in area @UUID[.9ggvXDV6BvojMVBZ]{G17}. She has a rough idea of each room's forces, but she doesn't know about the traps in areas @UUID[.WeTrPKqTCTHIoWRu]{G11s} or @UUID[.FzCW2srXAWImPK0v]{G16}; in fact, she believes area G16 is haunted.

G10. Urevian’s Domain.name: G10. 乌瑞维安的领域 G10. Urevian’s Domain
G10. Urevian’s Domain.text:
通往该房间的巨大门扉被魔法封印，其上镌刻着一个巨大而发光的五芒星。五芒星的中心有一个约人类手掌大小的圆形凹槽，周围还有五个更深的凹陷。英雄们可以辨认出有某种装置——例如护符——能够嵌入该凹槽。

开启大门

乌瑞维安的坠饰的五个 @UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{碎片}分别由下列对象持有：

  • • 区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.psfaf5Skhe3bMKsr]{F05} 的萨格拉贡
  • • 区域 @UUID[.JCRGIRMAhYyjkSvF]{G04} 的阿兹瓦维甘德
  • • 区域 @UUID[.AeQmFFVsCUF02tzd]{G05} 的巴坎布克
  • • 区域 @UUID[.fK6B6GmATzvRIuh4]{G07} 的一名狂怒魔
  • • 区域 @UUID[.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18} 的伊松德赫利

乌瑞维安的坠饰能够开启大门，但它目前被分成五个碎片，由他的副官们分别保管。一名魔鬼在接触着哪怕仅一块碎片的情况下对大门施放次元门，也能传送到门的另一侧。要打开大门，其他生物必须将全部五个碎片重新组装，并将坠饰接触到凹槽上。完成后，大门实际上将永久保持开启；乌瑞维安可以进行一个持续一年的仪式来重建大门与坠饰，但他很可能不会这么做。

乌瑞维安并未意识到：精明的使用者只需要四个坠饰碎片也能打开大门——将它们接触到门上，并在一次 @Check[type:religion|dc:25]{宗教} 检定中成功，以模仿缺失碎片的不洁能量。检定失败的生物会受到 [[/r 4d12[fire]]] 伤害，并在1小时内处于 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{痴愚 1}（大失败则受到 [[/r 8d12[fire]]] 伤害，并在1小时内处于 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{痴愚 3}）。五块碎片位于区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.psfaf5Skhe3bMKsr]{F05}、@UUID[.JCRGIRMAhYyjkSvF]{G04}、@UUID[.AeQmFFVsCUF02tzd]{G05}、@UUID[.fK6B6GmATzvRIuh4]{G07} 与 @UUID[.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18}。

乌瑞维安的领域内部

这是一间由天然石材构成的大型大厅，自北向南延伸；唯一的出口是一扇巨大的石制双开门。点燃的火盆在墙上投下怪异的影子，使房间浸没在阴森的光亮之中。北侧的凹室里摆满了书架与一张结实的书桌，旁边还有整齐卷起的卷轴和一摞摞羊皮纸。

乌瑞维安把这间房间当作自己的居所，并将其与地城其余部分隔离封闭，以便他能够安静工作。他为自己打造了这扇门，但他必须为贝科拉制作一枚魔法坠饰，好让她能够绕过门禁。就在贝科拉死亡前不久，乌瑞维安让小魔鬼赛兹克把坠饰偷了回来。乌瑞维安将其折断为五块，每块分别交给一名副官。他信任的魔鬼们可以随意出入，但就连他们也知道，若非公务在身，不要去打扰乌瑞维安。

书桌中放着报告、清单与地图，内容描绘了地表世界、凄凉灯塔以及周边的幽暗地域。对英雄们而言尤为重要的是：《憎恨魔窟》第五层、第六层与第七层的完整地图，其中包含这些楼层全部的秘密门。角色还能够找到数份炼狱契约的副本，其原件安全地存放在地狱的宝库之中。一名角色若调查书桌并在一次 @Check[type:society|dc:23|traits:action:investigate]{社会}或法律学识检定中成功，便会意识到乌瑞维安数代以来一直在密切关注沃尔·拉贾尼的血脉。

拟法魔乌瑞维安大部分时间都在根据大量预案修订攻击计划。他始终让两名胡须魔保镖守在身边，负责拦截来自副官的报告，并防止他被打扰。当英雄们打开大门时，胡须魔们立刻冲上前，但乌瑞维安制止了它们，并热情地向英雄们致意。朗读或转述下文。

一名粗犷俊美的魔鬼迈步上前，他角上垂挂的长长羊皮纸卷蜷曲起来，又再次舒展开来。
“朋友，朋友！把武器收起来。说真的，我很高兴见到你们。”魔鬼转向两名举起长柄刀的胡须魔保镖，“你们两个，退下。我怀疑他们还没自大到会与我们为敌。”
“我是乌瑞维安，拟法魔，也是贝科拉的签约代理人，但我向你们保证，我不是你们的敌人。你们想要击败她？终结她那杀人的幽魂，她对凡人生命造成的威胁，诸如此类、诸如此类？那么或许我们能谈一笔交易——一笔能让双方都大获其利、且牺牲的宝贵生命尽可能少的交易。”

如果英雄们已经遇到赛兹克并与她达成协议——乌瑞维安其实并不介意——他会补充道：“你们已经和赛兹克做了交易，所以我知道问题不在于‘会不会’，而在于‘价格是多少’。相信我，我给你们的是一笔极好的交易。”关于这场对话，请参阅下列常见问题与乌瑞维安的回应。

你是谁？

“我是乌瑞维安，一位颇有名望的契约魔鬼——至少我自己这么认为。”

你想从我们这里得到什么？

“简单来说，你们就是我需要的第三方代理人，帮我离开这可怕的地方并回到家。你看，我想要一样东西，但我不能亲自去取，也不能雇用任何炼狱代理人为我取回。不，必须由贝科拉的一名凡人敌手把奖品交到我手里。我的魔鬼在这一点上毫无价值，我的血肉改造士兵也同样如此。”

为什么必须是贝科拉的凡人敌手？

“这就是对契约条文进行法条式解读的乐趣。不能是我、我的任何爪牙，也不能是贝科拉的任何盟友。契约撰写时的意图是：只有贝科拉本人才能把奖品交给我，作为报酬。当然，在我提供了契约要求的全部服务之前，她不会这么做。然而，如果以极其技术性的方式去读，任何她的敌人也能提供它——而你们迄今为止已经明确地证明了你们反对她。”

你想要的是什么？

“我需要卡曼·拉贾尼的灵魂。如果可能的话，我希望连同他的活体一起。但若他……死去，我也能将就。”

你要卡曼的灵魂做什么？

“我欠某个比我强大得多的存在一个拉贾尼家族的灵魂。对我而言，若没有它就离开物质位面……是不明智的。卡曼是沃尔·拉贾尼的最后后裔。”

那个强大的存在会拿卡曼的灵魂做什么？

“我不知道；我的契约仅规定要将其交付。仅仅是安排这笔交易就已代价不菲，但若能完成，我将在地狱获得相当多的声望。”

如果他死了我们该怎么办？

“我知道一个仪式，可以将他的灵魂从灵魂之河召唤出来，并带回他死亡之处。在那里就能捕获它。如果你们与我签署协议，我就把它教给你们。”

我们不能把别人的灵魂交给你。这太邪恶了！

“是吗？我说，把一个堕落之人的灵魂交出去，是比任由整座城镇毁灭更小的恶。双方都会少流很多血。我不想夷平奥塔里，我也不想杀你们。然而，我与贝科拉的契约要求：只要我仍受雇于她，我就必须追求对地表世界的支配，并摧毁她的敌人。一旦我的契约终止，我对她的义务也随之结束。我所需要的仅仅是卡曼·拉贾尼的灵魂，以履行契约。”

卡曼·拉贾尼怎么就堕落了？

“哦，那个人渣。他的灵魂早就因撒谎、欺诈、盗窃、破坏、毁坏财物、纵火、滥用权力、敲诈——甚至谋杀——而注定受罚。他死后会去哪里再清楚不过。你们只是把官僚流程砍掉，直接把他交给我。”

如果我们把卡曼交出去，他就再也没有救赎的机会了。

“你们真这么认为吗？就在不久之前，他为了某个错误的阴谋——想赢得一个政治职位——烧了一座图书馆，还偷走了一件历史遗物；而他若真当选，只会用那职位进一步滥用权力并增加他的财富。若不是我为了这个特定目的需要他的灵魂，我甚至会雇用他。”

我们能从这个安排中得到什么？

“奥塔里的和平。我会离开，并带走我所有仍留在《憎恨魔窟》里的魔鬼。我离开之时，阻止你们前往更低层的屏障将会消失。如果你们愿意，我还能命令我的血肉改造爪牙清理被堵塞的楼梯，让你们多一条下行的路。我甚至还能在你们与我的魔鬼之间撮合进一步的协议。”

什么进一步的协议？

乌瑞维安可以为任何幸存的胡须魔（@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.wJOW9YfEp5RDYHc1]{鲜血协议}）或狂怒魔（@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.XgO0MTOXdpbfdzr6]{复仇权}）安排炼狱契约。由于这些协议由乌瑞维安代表其魔鬼草拟，解读契约的技能检定DC使用33（乌瑞维安的法律学识DC），而非契约的物品等级。

我们已经打败了你的魔鬼；你没有东西可以用来入侵了。

“啊，但我在杀了你们之后还能再征召更多。那点不便充其量只是暂时的。”

我们绝不会和你达成协议！

“你们确定吗？仔细想想。拒绝我的提议，很可能意味着你们的死亡。”乌瑞维安意味深长地朝他的胡须魔保镖示意。

如果英雄们接受 @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.dVEJIxBXK6Mr30Cn]{乌瑞维安的提议}，他会使用他的草拟契约能力，召唤出一份需要他们以鲜血签署的契约。乌瑞维安草拟的提议诚实无欺：在从英雄们手中收到卡曼·拉贾尼（或其灵魂）之后，他将离开物质位面，并带走所有仍留在《憎恨魔窟》里的魔鬼。他的离去会立刻移除区域 @UUID[.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03} 的屏障。在离开之前，若英雄们愿意，他会命令任何血肉改造体清理从区域 @UUID[.2aDFWQZkq3nA7KPT]{G01} 向下延伸的楼梯。除此之外，他的离去不会影响牢房中的血肉改造体或其他生物，让英雄们自行处理。签署的英雄将被迫朝着将卡曼交付给乌瑞维安的方向行动，如同一场 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.Q690d3mw3TUrKX7E]{指使术} 仪式所致。

如果英雄们最终拒绝乌瑞维安的提议，他会失望地叹气，然后说道：“我还能对凡人期待什么呢？”随后他命令他的胡须魔发动攻击。他会先施放 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.E3X2RbzWHCdz7gsk]{烈焰打击}，然后挥舞他的恶魔羽笔投入近战。

遭遇

严峻 7

@Actor[Mk6Uo4Vt1HkG9EvL]{乌瑞维安} @Actor[4bznEiwsJvInwZwA]{胡须魔先锋（2）}

120 XP

胡须魔确信英雄们不过是无法在战斗中战胜恶魔士兵的凡人，因此它们会战斗至死。乌瑞维安受伤越重，他就越会试图说服英雄们接受他的交易。然而，乌瑞维安只有在英雄们同意接受他的条款时，才会中止战斗。如果他被杀死，区域 @UUID[.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03} 的魔法屏障会消失，但楼梯仍然被堵塞。

The huge doors to this room are magically sealed and emblazoned with an enormous, glowing pentagram, The pentagram’s center has a circular indentation about the size of a human hand with five deeper indentations. The heroes can discern that some device, like an amulet, fits into the indentation.

Opening the Door

The five @UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{Fragments} of Urevian's pendant are held by:

  • • The Sarglagon in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.psfaf5Skhe3bMKsr]{F05}
  • • Azvalvigander in area @UUID[.JCRGIRMAhYyjkSvF]{G04}
  • • Barcumbuk in area @UUID[.AeQmFFVsCUF02tzd]{G05}
  • • An Erinys in area @UUID[.fK6B6GmATzvRIuh4]{G07}
  • • Ysondkhelir in area @UUID[.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18}

Urevian’s pendant opens the door, but it’s currently split into five fragments held by his lieutenants. A devil who casts dimension door while touching even a single fragment to the door can teleport to the other side. To open the door, other creatures must reassemble all five fragments and touch the pendant to the indentation. After doing so, the door effectively stays open for good; Urevian can enact a year-long ritual to recreate the door and the pendant, but he likely won’t do so.

Urevian doesn’t realize it, but a clever user can open the door with only four pendant fragments by touching them to the door and succeeding at a @Check[type:religion|dc:25]{Religion} check to mimic the unholy energies of the missing fragment. A creature who fails this check takes [[/r 4d12[fire]]] damage and is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 hour ([[/r 8d12[fire]]] damage and @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} for 1 hour on a critical failure). The five pieces are in areas @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.psfaf5Skhe3bMKsr]{F05}, @UUID[.JCRGIRMAhYyjkSvF]{G04}, @UUID[.AeQmFFVsCUF02tzd]{G05}, @UUID[.fK6B6GmATzvRIuh4]{G07}, and @UUID[.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18}.

Inside Urevian's Domain

A large chamber of natural stone runs north to south with an enormous stone double door as its only exit. Lit braziers cast strange shadows on the walls and bathe the room in a sinister light. Bookshelves and a sturdy desk, accompanied by neatly rolled-up scrolls and stacks of parchment, fill an alcove to the north.

Urevian made this room his home, sealed off from the rest of the dungeon so that he can work in peace. He fashioned the door for himself, but he had to manufacture a magical pendant for Belcorra so she could bypass it. Shortly before Belcorra’s death, Urevian had the imp Szek steal the pendant back. Urevian broke it into five pieces, giving one to each of his lieutenants. His trusted devils can come and go as they please, but even they know not to bother Urevian barring official business.

The desk contains reports, inventories, and maps that depict the surface world, Gauntlight, and the surrounding Darklands. Of particular note to the heroes are complete maps of the fifth, sixth, and seventh levels of the Abomination Vaults, including all secret doors on those levels. The characters can also find copies of several infernal contracts, the originals of which are safely stored in Hell’s vaults. A character who Investigates the desk and succeeds at a @Check[type:society|dc:23|traits:action:investigate]{Society} or Legal Lore check realizes that Urevian has kept tabs on Vol Rajani’s line for generations.

The phistophilus Urevian spends most of his time revising attack plans based on numerous contingencies. He keeps two barbazu bodyguards nearby at all times to intercept reports from his lieutenants and to keep him from being disturbed. When the heroes open the doors, the barbazus spring forward, but Urevian stops them and warmly greets the heroes. Read or paraphrase the following.

As a ruggedly handsome devil steps forward, as the long rolls of parchment hanging from his horns curl up, then unroll again.
"Friends, friends! Weapons away. Truly, I am happy to see you." The devil turns to the two bearded devil bodyguards, their glaives raised. "Stand down, you two. I doubt they are arrogant enough to fight us."
"I am Urevian, phistophilus and contracted agent of Belcorra, but I assure you I am no enemy of yours. You seek to vanquish her? Put an end to her murderous spirit, the threat she poses to mortal life, et cetera, et cetera? Then perhaps we can broker a deal- one that greatly benefits both of us with a minimal number of precious lives lost."

If the heroes already encountered Szek and made an agreement with her- which Urevian doesn't really mind- he adds, "You already struck a bargain with Szek, so I know it is not a matter of if, but of what price. Trust me when I say, I am offering you an excellent deal." For this conversation, refer to the following list of likely questions and Urevian responses.

Who are you?

"I am Urevian, a contract devil of some renown, if I do say so myself."

What do you want from us?

"Simply put, you are the third-party agents I need to get out of this dreadful place and return home. You see, there is something I want but am not allowed to go and get myself, nor can I employ any infernal agents to retrieve it. No, the hands of a mortal foe of Belcorra must deliver me my prize. My devils are valueless in this regard, as are my fleshwarp soldiers"

Why does it have to be a mortal foe of Belcorra?

"That is the delight of legalistic contract interpretation. It cannot be me, any of my minions, or any ally of Belcorra. The contract was written with the intent that Belcorra alone could give me the prize as my payment. Which, of course, she will not until I have given her the full measure of service the contract requires. However, a very technical reading means any of her foes can also provide it- and you have thus far conclusively demonstrated that you oppose her."

What is it that you want?

"I require the soul of Carman Rajani. In his living body, if possible, though I can make do should he... perish."

What do you want with Carman's soul?

"I owe the soul of a Rajani to someone much more powerful than myself. It would be... unwise for me to leave the Material Plane without it. Carman is the last descendant of Vol Rajani."

What will this powerful someone do with Carman's soul?

"I do not know; my contract merely stipulated to turn it over. Just arranging the deal proved considerably costly, but I stand to gain quite a bit of prestige in Hell if it is completed."

What do we do if he died?

"I know a ritual that can summon his spirit out of the River of Souls and back to the place where he died. There it can be captured. If you sign an agreement with me, I shall teach it to you."

We can't give you someone's soul. That's evil!

"Is it? I say it is a lesser evil to turn over the soul of one corrupted individual than to allow an entire town's destruction. Far less bloodshed on all sides. I do not want to raze Otari, and I don't want to kill you. However, the contract I have with Belcorra requires that as long as I remain within her employ, I must pursue the domination of the surface world and the destruction of her enemies. Once my contract ends, so does my obligation to her. All I need is the soul of Carman Rajani to fulfill the contract.

How's Carman Rajani corrupted?

"Oh, that bastard of a man. His soul is already damned for lying, cheating, theft, vandalism, destruction of property, arson, abuse of power, blackmail- even a murder. It is quite clear where he shall go in the afterlife. You would simply cut out the bureaucracy by giving him to me directly."

If we hand over Carman, he'll never have a chance at redemption.

"Do you honestly believe that? just recently he burned a library and stole a historical relic in some misguided ploy to win a political office, which he would just use to further abuse his power and increase his wealth. If I did not need his soul for this specific purpose, I would hire him."

What do we get out of this arrangement?

"Peace for Otari. I will leave, taking all of my devils with me. And when I go, the barrier preventing you from getting to the lower level will disappear. If you would like, I can direct my fleshwarp minions to clear away the blocked staircase, giving you a second way down. I can even broker further agreements between you my devils.

What further agreements?

Urevian can arrange for infernal contracts with any of his surviving barbazus (@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.wJOW9YfEp5RDYHc1]{Pact of Blood-Taking}) or erinyes (@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.XgO0MTOXdpbfdzr6]{Right of Retribution}). As Urevian drafts these agreements on his devils' behalf, skill checks to interpret the contracts use a DC of 33 (Urevian's Legal Lore DC), rather than the contracts' item levels.

We've already defeated your devils; you have nothing to invade with.

"Ah, but I can conscript more after I kill you. The inconvenience is, at best, temporary."

We'll never make an agreement with you!

"Are you sure about that? Consider carefully. Turning down my offer most likely means your death." Urevian gestures meaningfully to his barbazu bodyguards.

If the heroes take @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.dVEJIxBXK6Mr30Cn]{Urevian's Offer}, he uses his Draft Contract ability to summon a contract for them to sign in blood. Urevian drafts an honest offer: upon his receipt of Carman Rajani (or his soul) from the heroes, he will leave the Material Plane along with all his devils remaining in the Abomination Vaults. His departure immediately removes the barrier in area @UUID[.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03}. Before leaving, he will, if the heroes wish, order any fleshwarps to clear the staircase leading down from area @UUID[.2aDFWQZkq3nA7KPT]{G01}. His departure otherwise doesn’t affect the fleshwarps or other creatures in the prison, leaving the heroes to deal with them. Heroes who sign are compelled to work toward delivering Carman to Urevian, as from a @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.Q690d3mw3TUrKX7E]{Geas} ritual.

If the heroes ultimately decline Urevian’s offer, he sighs in disappointment before saying, “What more should I have expected from mortals?” He then orders his barbazus to attack. He casts @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.E3X2RbzWHCdz7gsk]{Flame Strike} before entering melee with his diabolic quill.

Encounter

Severe 7

@Actor[Mk6Uo4Vt1HkG9EvL]{Urevian} @Actor[4bznEiwsJvInwZwA]{Barbazu Vanguards (2)}

120 XP

Convinced the heroes are mere mortals who can’t overcome diabolic soldiers in combat, the barbazus fight to the death. The more injured Urevian becomes, the more he tries to convince the heroes to accept his deal. However, Urevian breaks off combat only if the heroes agree to accept his terms. If he’s slain, the magical barrier in area @UUID[.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03} vanishes, though the stairs remain blocked.

G11. Nexus.name: G11。交叉口 G11. Nexus
G11. Nexus.text:
这个房间呈巨大的八角形金字塔状，四面相对的墙上各有一个出口。明亮的血红色光束从金字塔顶部照下，在地面上形成一个完美的圆形光斑。

危害

低威胁 7

@Actor[E0FMRiGNCv5n7AVH]{麻痹之光陷阱}

60 XP

乌瑞维安在此构建了一处魔法陷阱，用以捕获入侵者并召来增援。

增援

当@UUID[.wemHETiO7mks9Clo]{G15}区域的魔法警报被触发时，兵营中的一半敌人（一个钢皮魔人与一个铁骨怪）会立刻赶来此处。若他们在3轮内未返回，@UUID[.wemHETiO7mks9Clo]{G15}区域内另外两名血肉畸变体会意识到情况不对，也会前来提供援助。

This chamber forms a large octagonal pyramid and has four exits on opposite walls. Bright, blood-red light shines down from the top of the pyramid in a perfect circle on the floor.

Hazard

Low 7

@Actor[E0FMRiGNCv5n7AVH]{Paralyzing Light Trap}

60 XP

Urevian constructed a magical trap here to capture invaders and summon reinforcements.

Reinforcements

When the alarm goes off in area @UUID[.wemHETiO7mks9Clo]{G15}, half of the enemies in the barracks (one mulventok and one dreshkan) make their way here immediately. If they don’t come back in 3 rounds, the other two fleshwarps in area @UUID[.wemHETiO7mks9Clo]{G15} realize something must be wrong and come to provide help as well.

G12. Arena Walk.name: G12. 竞技场通道 G12. Arena Walk
G12. Arena Walk.text:
一条长走廊南北延伸，尽头在南侧是一段楼梯，分别向左与向右分叉。北侧与东侧墙上各有一扇带小型滑窗的门。此处东北端有一座升起的闸门，其金属尖刺上结着干涸的血痂。

并非所有在贝科拉的竞技场里战斗的人都是自愿的。原本要参加角斗比赛的囚犯会被短暂关押在此，随后被送上楼迎接他们的命运。滑窗允许英雄偷看囚室内部。

楼梯通往上方的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.JhZf5mGUPNZqZSum]{F10}。

遭遇

低 7

@Actor[wRQ7TZdd0n5UIIao]{鬼火（2）}

60 XP

两只鬼火在这条走廊巡逻，杀死它们发现的任何不友好生物。它们在数十年前自发出现在憎恨魔窟中，并漂流到这一等级。当魔鬼以为它们效忠于贝科拉时，鬼火便干脆同意了，尽管它们从未见过她。乌瑞维安指派这些生物在此看守。它们还建议让区域F10里的肉体畸变体受到缓慢术诅咒，因为这能让它们尽情、频繁地啜食该生物的恐惧(术)。

鬼火会顽强地与入侵者战斗，以维持它们偏爱的驻守位置。若其中一只被摧毁，另一只会尝试逃往区域G15并警告那里的生物。

A long hallway, stretching north to south, ends in a staircase at the southern end that branches left and right. The north and east walls each have a door with small, sliding windows. A raised portcullis at the northeastern end here has metal points crusted with dried blood.

Not all combatants in Belcorra’s arena participated willingly. Prisoners intended for the gladiatorial games were kept here briefly before being sent upstairs to meet their fates. The sliding windows allow the heroes to peek into the cells.

The stairs lead up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.JhZf5mGUPNZqZSum]{F10}.

Encounter

Low 7

@Actor[wRQ7TZdd0n5UIIao]{Will-o'-Wisps (2)}

60 XP

Two will-o’-wisps patrol this corridor, killing whatever unfriendly creatures they find. They spontaneously appeared in the Abomination Vaults decades ago and drifted to this level. When the devils assumed they served Belcorra, the wisps simply agreed, even though they’ve never met her. Urevian assigned the creatures to keep watch here. They also suggested subjecting the fleshwarp in area F10 to the slow curse, as it lets them sup on the creature’s fear as often as they’d like.

The will-o’-wisps fight intruders tenaciously to maintain their favored position. If one is destroyed, the other attempts to flee to area G15 and warn the creatures there.

G13. Empty Cell.name: G13. 空牢房 G13. Empty Cell
G13. Empty Cell.text:
灰尘和蛛网掩蔽着这间被遗忘的牢房。英雄们发现它的门没有上锁。由于魔鬼从不对其进行检定，这间牢房虽狭窄，却是个安全的休息地点。

Dust and cobwebs cover this forgotten cell. The heroes find its door unlocked. Since the devils never check it, this cell makes for a safe, if cramped place to rest.

G14. Imprisoned Bounty Hunter.name: G14. 被囚禁的赏金猎人 G14. Imprisoned Bounty Hunter
G14. Imprisoned Bounty Hunter.text:
这间牢房在过去几十年里几乎无人照料，但墙上的镣铐似乎被精心擦拭过。

魔鬼最近又让这间牢房重新投入使用。一名名叫赛涅弥的魔裔赏金猎人倒吊着，她的脚踝被镣铐锁住。她显然因虐待与疏于照料而虚弱不堪。

通过炼狱契约，赛涅弥得知一名名叫乌瑞维安的契约魔鬼为某个特定的目标开出了高额赏金。赛涅弥一路来到这里，并同意以一笔可观的金额把卡曼·拉贾尼带回来。然而，卡曼狡猾得很，把赛涅弥的魔法护甲骗走，并把她丢在内海上一艘漏水的小船上。

等赛涅弥游回岸边时，她与乌瑞维安谈妥抓捕卡曼的时限已经结束，于是一名狂怒魔把她拖了回来。她从那以后就一直被关在这里，只有不定期的食物，还经常被倒吊着。她怀疑自己被囚禁了数个月甚至数年。她的镣铐很容易打开，但赛涅弥够不着。

支线任务

赛涅弥需要紧急救治，因为她已因脱水濒临死亡。一名英雄必须在为赛涅弥提供饮水与食物的同时，成功进行一次 @Check[type:medicine|dc:23]{Medicine} 检定来救下她；若为大成功或大失败中的大失败，则这名赏金猎人死亡。即便被救活，她仍会保持疏离与多疑；她的起始态度为不友好。若英雄们能将赛涅弥的态度改善到至少不关心（通常，一名英雄必须成功进行一次 @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:22|traits:action:make-an-impression]{Diplomacy} 检定来建立印象，不过你也可以允许其他技能以此DC让赛涅弥愿意开口），她就会分享自己的故事。她强调乌瑞维安多么迫切地想抓住卡曼·拉贾尼，以及这名契约魔鬼为了得到他几乎愿意为任何事达成交易。无论她对英雄们的态度如何，赛涅弥都希望英雄们帮助她重获自由，并尽快远离此地。

赛涅弥是艾巴萨罗姆当局通缉的罪犯。一名英雄若成功进行一次 @Check[type:society|dc:23|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} 检定，便会回忆知识想起见过她的通缉令（来自艾巴萨罗姆的英雄在此检定上获得+2环境加值）。当然，赛涅弥不会主动透露这一信息。

将赛涅弥带出憎恨魔窟——无论英雄们是否把她交由自己看管——即可完成此支线任务。

宝藏

若英雄们将赛涅弥交给奥塔里卫队，他们将获得30 gp的奖励。若他们得到了奥塔里卫队的支援，长鞍队长会额外给予30 gp。

Most of this cell has received very little care in the past several decades, but the manacles on the wall appear carefully polished.

The devils have recently put this cell back into service. A tiefling bounty hunter named Cynemi hangs upside down, her ankles bound by the manacles. She looks clearly weakened from ill treatment and neglect.

Through infernal contracts, Cynemi learned that a contract devil named Urevian had offered a high bounty for a specific target. Cynemi made her way here and agreed to retrieve Carman Rajani for a healthy sum. However, Carman proved too cunning, hustling Cynemi out of her magic armor and leaving her stranded on a leaky boat on the Inner Sea.

By the time Cynemi swam back to shore, the time she negotiated with Urevian to catch Carman had run out, so an erinys dragged her back. She has been here since, fed only irregularly and often hung by her feet. She suspects she has spent months or even years imprisoned. Her manacles open easily, but Cynemi can’t reach them.

Side Quest

Cynemi requires urgent care, as she’s on the verge of death from dehydration. A hero must succeed at a @Check[type:medicine|dc:23]{Medicine} check while providing water and food to Cynemi to save her; on a critical failure, the bounty hunter dies. Even if saved, she stays distant and suspicious; her starting attitude is unfriendly. If the heroes can improve Cynemi’s attitude to at least indifferent (usually, a hero must succeed at a @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:22|traits:action:make-an-impression]{Diplomacy} check to Make an Impression, although you might allow other skills at this DC to get Cynemi to open up), she shares her story. She emphasizes how urgently Urevian wants to capture Carman Rajani, and that the contract devil is willing to cut a deal for just about anything to get him. Regardless of her attitude toward the heroes, Cynemi wants the heroes to help free her and to get far away from here.

Cynemi is a criminal wanted by Absalom authorities. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:society|dc:23|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} check recalls seeing a wanted poster for her (heroes from Absalom gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check). Of course, Cynemi doesn’t volunteer this information.

Getting Cynemi out of the Abomination Vaults—whether or not the heroes place her in their custody—completes this side quest.

Treasure

If the heroes turn Cynemi over to the Otari Garrison, they earn a 30 gp reward. If they have the Otari Garrison’s support, Captain Longsaddle gives them an additional 30 gp.

G15. Barracks.name: G15. 兵营 G15. Barracks
G15. Barracks.text:
这处古老的牢房区已被改造成临时的兵营，几张粗制滥造的行军床被推进牢房内并靠着墙摆放。三扇牢门都被用铁链拴着保持敞开。每张行军床旁都放着脚柜。

遭遇

严重 7

@Actor[zsgW8hHm3JfZUgwF]{钢皮魔人 (2)} @Actor[DnAeqlJRZc5N7hve]{铁骨怪 (2)}

120 XP

当不与胡须魔一起操练或执行其他杂务时，魔鬼的血肉畸变士兵会在此放松。他们会战斗至死。

宝藏

[[/r 3d6 #silver]]{3d6 银币}

这七只破旧的脚柜里几乎没有任何值钱物品。每只脚柜内都有 3d6 枚银币。

This old prison block has been converted into a makeshift barracks with several shoddy cots pushed into the cells and against the walls. The three cell doors have been chained open. Foot lockers sit near each cot.

Encounter

Severe 7

@Actor[zsgW8hHm3JfZUgwF]{Mulventoks (2)} @Actor[DnAeqlJRZc5N7hve]{Dreshkans (2)}

120 XP

When not drilling with the barbazu or performing other menial tasks, the devils’ fleshwarped soldiers relax here. They fight to the death.

Treasure

[[/r 3d6 #silver]]{3d6 Silver Pieces}

The seven meager footlockers hold almost nothing of value. Each footlocker contains 3d6 silver pieces.

G16. Prison Office.name: G16. 监狱办公室 G16. Prison Office
G16. Prison Office.text:
这间老旧的监狱办公室充满污秽与蛛网。只有一扇门通往北方。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

英雄在搜索时，若成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，即可用定位术发现此房间内的暗门。若英雄们先清理掉房间里的灰尘与蛛网，则该DC降至24。

墙上有细小裂纹构成镣铐与铁链的隐约形状。铁链链环之间的空间是按钮，按下后会使暗门滑开。暗门之后是一条狭窄走廊，沿途有数个窥视孔，内嵌单向透明石材，用于监视牢房中的囚犯；走廊上还有一扇门通往区域 @UUID[.lNmEdSB5CToA5aKq]{G21}。角色能清楚看到从这条隐蔽走廊通往外部的暗门（通往区域 @UUID[.FzCW2srXAWImPK0v]{G16} 与 @UUID[.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18}）。

危害

@Actor[knoWZfTiLY7xGwhB]{痛苦暗示陷阱}

12 XP

伊松德赫利不喜欢有一条秘密通道直接通向他的套房，因此他安装了一道陷阱来阻止任何爱管闲事的生物靠近。他逼迫乌瑞维安协助这场骗局，于是那名恶魔让厄里倪厄斯散布关于这间监狱办公室闹鬼的传闻。几乎所有其他在牢房等级的生物都相信了这则传闻，尤其是就睡在房间外的血肉畸变体；这让伊松德赫利得以享受他渴望的安宁。

此房间内的魔法陷阱会在任何人踏入时触发。

This old prison office is full of filth and cobwebs. A single door exits to the north.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

A hero can locate the secret door in this room by succeeding at a @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{Perception} check while Searching. If the heroes clean the dust and cobwebs from this room first, this DC drops to 24.

Tiny cracks form the subtle shape of a manacle and chain on the wall. The spaces between the chain links are buttons that, when pressed, cause the secret door to slide open. Beyond the secret door, a narrow hallway has several peep holes filled with one-way transparent stone for spying on prisoners, along with a door to area @UUID[.lNmEdSB5CToA5aKq]{G21}. Characters can clearly see the secret doors leading out of this hidden hall (to areas @UUID[.FzCW2srXAWImPK0v]{G16} and @UUID[.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18}).

Hazard

@Actor[knoWZfTiLY7xGwhB]{Painful Suggestion Trap}

12 XP

Ysondkhelir didn’t like the fact that a secret tunnel led directly into his suite of rooms, so he installed a trap to keep any nosy creatures away. He pressed Urevian to help with the ruse, so the devil had the erinyes start a rumor about the prison office being haunted. Virtually all other creatures on the prison level believe this rumor, especially the fleshwarps who bunk just outside the room, which has given Ysondkhelir the peace he desires.

The magical trap in this room triggers when anyone steps inside.

G17. Stasis Chambers.name: G17. 静滞间 G17. Stasis Chambers
G17. Stasis Chambers.text:
十五根透明的石柱填满了这间30英尺高房间的中央。明亮光照照射进每个囚室的中心。离地10英尺高处有一条无扶手或栏杆的步道环绕房间边缘；在西侧，每段步道都在一处通往下方的楼梯前结束。

贝科拉在用凄凉灯塔的射线传送它们之前，把危险生物关在这间房里。每个囚室都是10英尺见方、20英尺高，由透明石材制成。每个生物都静止不动地立在自己的柱体中，被维持在时间流之外的停滞状态。只要仍被囚禁在各自的停滞囚室内，这些生物就不会衰老，并且会无视正常时间流造成的任何影响。不过，这类影响可以作用于石柱本身；石柱由透明、经魔法强化的石材制成（硬度18，HP 76）。

已占用囚室

十根石柱里关着东西。其中九根包含活体生物：一只@Actor[aD76W2uEQhFFUrom]{Chuul}，一只@Actor[B7eLG2k7qUo8HU6O]{蛛化精灵}，三只@Actor[xdIHvCBspeSXRL6A]{地蜥兽}，一只@Actor[dEAneTvoPuQXZoLR]{呓语之喉}，一只@Actor[T6vOuhM1KV5Fr75F]{狂跳跳}，以及两只@Actor[zq18QX6CBJNeUIgG]{古格巨人}。还有一根里是一只死掉的@Actor[IXen98RbUlbxDWBD]{高基特斯}，因为其囚室的魔法存在缺陷。

如果一名英雄打破了包住某个生物的石柱，进行一次@Check[type:flat|dc:3]{纯骰检定}；若成功，崩塌的停滞效果会把它血肉模糊地杀死。若失败，该生物会回到正常时间，并攻击视野内的任何目标直到被摧毁为止。（高等级怪物，比如地蜥兽，即使对7级角色而言也会构成严重威胁！）

空囚室

五个空的停滞囚室中，有两个值得注意。

西北角的囚室看上去被严重熏黑，仿佛里面堆满了烟灰。在高基特斯的失误之后，贝科拉任命了一名鬼婆（特征）来监管此处，她知道鬼婆的魔法专长在维持停滞囚室方面将无比宝贵——但她并不打算让鬼婆活着做这份工作。贝科拉将鬼婆囚在这根石柱中，把她活活烧死，并将她的灵魂束缚为巫火。一个生物进入与这根熏黑石柱相邻的方格时，会短暂地以心灵感应闪现出贝科拉活活烧死鬼婆的画面，并在1分钟内获得对抗巫火的法术与能力的豁免检定+1环境加值。与该石柱相邻的生物也能勉强辨认出柱内的物体（见下方宝藏）。必须砸开石柱才能取出它们。

第二个不同寻常的停滞囚室位于西南角，看起来与其他空囚室无异。然而，它的顶部与地面都是幻象。囚室“地面”下方的开阔空间通向一条5英尺宽的爬行通道，可抵达区域@UUID[.lNmEdSB5CToA5aKq]{G21}中的开启式活板门。内部的微灵会在隐形状态下通过这条路来去。

遭遇

中等 7

@Actor[aIDLQY5mBPyxTjZ2]{巫火守卫}

80 XP

巫火仍在守卫这间房间。任何人进入后的第3轮，她会实体化并发动攻击。必须经常穿过此处的生物，例如冷原居民伊松德赫利，或是向他汇报的斥控魔，会迅速通过。

乌瑞维安一再尝试与巫火达成交易，但巫火根本不愿听他讲话。他知道这些停滞中的生物对他的入侵计划很有价值，因此他推迟了入侵，直到想出如何可靠地释放它们为止。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.02q8s6sSicMkhs1l]{盔甲护腕 I} @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.JBMBaN9dZLytfFLQ]{Bag of Holding (Type II)}

那根被烟灰熏黑的石柱里仍有几件鬼婆死后留下的物品：I型盔甲护腕，以及一个II型bag of holding，里面装着一打廉价、坏掉的钟表。

Fifteen transparent pillars fill the center of this 30-foot-high room. A bright light shines down into the center of each chamber. A catwalk 10 feet above the ground circles around the edge of the room without handrail or banister; at the western side, each stops at a staircase leading down.

Belcorra kept dangerous creatures in this room prior to teleporting them via Gauntlight’s beam. Each cell is 10 feet square, 20 feet tall, and made of transparent stone. Each creature stands motionless in its own column, held in suspended animation outside the flow of time. The creatures haven’t aged and ignore any effect from the normal timestream as long as they stay imprisoned within their stasis chambers. However, such effects can work on the pillars, which are made of transparent, magically enhanced stone (Hardness 18, HP 76).

Occupied Chambers

Ten pillars are occupied. Nine contain living creatures: a @Actor[aD76W2uEQhFFUrom]{Chuul}, a @Actor[B7eLG2k7qUo8HU6O]{Drider}, three @Actor[xdIHvCBspeSXRL6A]{Ghonhatines}, a @Actor[dEAneTvoPuQXZoLR]{Gibbering Mouther}, a @Actor[T6vOuhM1KV5Fr75F]{Gibtanius}, and two @Actor[zq18QX6CBJNeUIgG]{Gugs}. One contains a dead @Actor[IXen98RbUlbxDWBD]{Gogiteth} because of a flaw in its chamber’s magic.

If a hero breaks the pillar around one of the creatures, roll a @Check[type:flat|dc:3]{Flat Check}; on a success, the collapsing stasis effect messily kills it. On a failure, the creature returns to normal time and attacks anything in sight until destroyed. (High-level monsters, such as the ghonhatines, pose a serious danger even for 7th-level characters!)

Empty Chambers

Of the five empty stasis chambers, two are noteworthy.

The northwest chamber appears badly blackened, as though from soot on the inside. After the error with the gogiteth, Belcorra appointed a hag to oversee this room, knowing that her magical expertise would prove invaluable in maintaining the stasis chambers, but she didn’t intend the hag to do this job in life. Belcorra trapped the hag in this pillar, burned her to death, and bound her spirit as a witchfire. A creature entering a square adjacent to this blackened pillar receives a brief telepathic flash of Belcorra burning the hag alive and gains a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the witchfire’s spells and abilities for 1 minute. A creature adjacent to that pillar can also just make out the objects inside it (see Treasure below). The pillar must be smashed open to retrieve them.

The second unusual stasis chamber, in the southwest, looks like the other empty chambers. However, its top and floor are both illusions. An open area below the chamber’s “floor” leads to a 5-foot-wide crawl space to the open trapdoor in area @UUID[.lNmEdSB5CToA5aKq]{G21}. The wisp within comes and goes this way while invisible.

Encounter

Moderate 7

@Actor[aIDLQY5mBPyxTjZ2]{Witchfire Warden}

80 XP

The witchfire still guards this room. Three rounds after anyone enters, she materializes and attacks. Creatures who must pass through this room regularly, such as the denizen of Leng Ysondkhelir or the zebubs who report to him, do so quickly.

Urevian has tried to make deals with the witchfire time and again, but the witchfire simply won’t listen to him. He knows the creatures in stasis are valuable to his invasion plans, so he has postponed his invasion until he figures out how to reliably free them.

Treasure

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.02q8s6sSicMkhs1l]{Bracers of Armor I} @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.JBMBaN9dZLytfFLQ]{Bag of Holding (Type II)}

The soot-blackened pillar still contains a few items left behind when the hag died: type I bracers of armor and a type II bag of holding containing a dozen cheap, broken clocks.

G18. War Room.name: G18. 作战大厅 G18. War Room
G18. War Room.text:
这间小房间的北墙上绘有一幅内海的大地图，但上面标注的国家显然早已过时。房间西南角放着一只大坐垫。西墙上，层层叠叠的纸片拼成了一张新得多的奥塔里镇及其周边区域的地图。

这间房间作为作战大厅几乎没怎么使用过，如今已被改作现居住者的个人用途——北墙上过时的地图证明了这一点，而西墙上更聚焦且更新的奥塔里地图同样说明了此事。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

这些纸质地图遮住了一道通往走廊的秘密门，而这条走廊连接到@UUID[.FzCW2srXAWImPK0v]{G16}与@UUID[.lNmEdSB5CToA5aKq]{G21}区域。搜索此房间的英雄以一次成功的@Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定可发现这道秘密门。若英雄们移开纸张，则DC降至24。这道秘密门的开启方式与@UUID[.FzCW2srXAWImPK0v]{G16}区域中的那一道相同。从隐藏走廊内部看，通往外部的秘密门（通往@UUID[.FzCW2srXAWImPK0v]{G16}与@UUID[.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18}区域）一目了然。

贝科拉任命名为伊松德赫利的、永葆年岁且神秘的冷原居民为她的首席战略家。贝科拉死后，伊松德赫利对规划部队移动失去了兴趣，但他仍说服乌瑞维安相信自己还在筹划，并声称等那名魔鬼决定向地表进军时，他就会准备好作战计划。伊松德赫利坚持让乌瑞维安的斥控魔继续侦察地表并向他回报，这也使得这名冷原居民得以绘制出这里这张异常详尽的地图。

伊松德赫利不再规划部队移动，转而寻找潜藏着强大灵能的灵能者，以便折磨他们，并借由玄奥祷文将其肉体送入幻梦境，让其他冷原居民能够利用他们。在过去五个时代里他几乎一无所获——不仅真正的灵能潜质极其罕见，而且伊松德赫利让受害者发疯的可能性并不比成功将其送往异位面的同族更低。他最近操控了神志恍惚的潜伏怪耶泽利（F12区域）。伊松德赫利将耶泽利视为无可挽回而弃置不顾，转而捕猎多瑞安娜·曼妮姆斯，而他针对她的阴谋也已接近完成。

遭遇

中等 7

@Actor[8AVy2qIK6vh13sSj]{伊松德赫利} @Actor[M4mDroIJlrBYfHkM]{伏行巨手}

80 XP

伊松德赫利喜欢从被他腐化的生物身上取走一只手作为战利品。由于他从未亲自见过多瑞安娜，他便窃取了她右手的灵能印记，并将其显化为一只巨大的、盘结扭曲的利爪。这只伏行巨手对伊松德赫利忠心耿耿，并竭尽所能保护他。

如果英雄们只是闯入，伊松德赫利与那只手会还击。巨手试图阻止敌人接近伊松德赫利；伊松德赫利则退到任一相邻房间的门口，以避免进入近战范围。他偏好削弱敌人的法术，如催眠图文与幻痛术。

宝藏

伊松德赫利携带着乌瑞维安吊坠的五块@UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{碎片}之一（见@UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10}区域）

如果英雄们带着关于多瑞安娜的情报来找他，这名冷原居民会意识到自己最新的阴谋已令他陷入极大险境。他试图安抚英雄们，并说服他们：只要其中一人自愿接受他的冷原红宝石，他就会将多瑞安娜从其掌控中释放——这彻头彻尾是在说谎。

如果英雄们上当，他会转移到牢房等级的另一处（由你决定）；他会继续折磨多瑞安娜，并开始同样折磨那名接受红宝石的英雄。

若伊松德赫利被杀，他最终会在冷原重塑形体，并暂时放弃自己在材料位面的阴谋。

恢复多瑞安娜

杀死伊松德赫利会解放多瑞安娜。摧毁伏行巨手会立刻使多瑞安娜的手恢复正常。其效果详见@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.6KJZ1Vc16h9vWbzU]{多瑞安娜的疯狂}页面。

This small chamber features a large map of the Inner Sea painted on the north wall, though the listed countries seem long out of date. A large cushion rests in the room’s southwest corner. On the west wall, overlapping scraps of paper create a much newer map of the town of Otari and the area around it.

This chamber has seen little use as a war room and has been repurposed for its current inhabitant’s personal agenda, as evidenced by the out-of-date maps on the north wall, but the much more focused and updated map of Otari on the west wall.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

The paper maps conceal a secret doorway to a hall that connects to areas @UUID[.FzCW2srXAWImPK0v]{G16} and @UUID[.lNmEdSB5CToA5aKq]{G21}. A hero Searching this room locates the secret door with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. If the heroes remove the papers, this DC drops to 24. This secret door opens the same way as the one in area @UUID[.FzCW2srXAWImPK0v]{G16}. The secret doors leading out of the hidden hallway (to areas @UUID[.FzCW2srXAWImPK0v]{G16} and @UUID[.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18}) are obvious from within it.

Belcorra appointed the ageless and mysterious denizen of Leng named Ysondkhelir as her chief strategist. After Belcorra died, Ysondkhelir lost interest in planning troop movements, though he convinced Urevian that he was still doing so and that he would have plans ready by the time the devil chose to march on the surface. Ysondkhelir insisted that Urevian’s zebubs keep scouting the surface and report back to him, which has allowed the denizen to make the exceptionally detailed map found here.

Instead of planning troop movements, Ysondkhelir seeks powerful latent psychics whom he can torment and, by means of eldritch invocations, send physically into the Dimension of Dreams so that other denizens of Leng can make use of them. He has had little success in the last five centuries—not only is true psychic potential very rare, but Ysondkhelir is as likely to drive his victims to insanity as to successfully send them to his extraplanar compatriots. He had most recently manipulated the addled skulk Jedzeli (area F12). Ysondkhelir abandoned Jedzeli as a lost cause to prey upon Dorianna Menhemes instead, and his schemes with her near completion.

Encounter

Moderate 7

@Actor[8AVy2qIK6vh13sSj]{Ysondkhelir} @Actor[M4mDroIJlrBYfHkM]{Giant Crawling Hand}

80 XP

Ysondkhelir likes to claim a hand from creatures he has corrupted. As he hasn’t ever met Dorianna in person, he instead stole a psychic imprint of her right hand and manifested it as a massive, gnarled claw. This giant crawling hand obeys Ysondkhelir loyally and does its best to defend him.

If the heroes simply barge in, Ysondkhelir and the hand fight back. The hand tries to keep foes from reaching Ysondkhelir, who retreats into the doorway of either adjacent room to keep out of melee range. He prefers spells that debilitate his foes, such as hypnotic pattern and phantom pain.

Treasure

Ysondkhelir carries one of the five @UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{Fragments} of Urevian's pendant (see area @UUID[.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10})

If the heroes come to him with knowledge of Dorianna, the denizen knows his latest plot has put him in significant jeopardy. He attempts to calm the heroes and convince them that he’ll release Dorianna from his clutches—an outright lie—if one of them willingly accepts his Leng ruby.

If the heroes fall for this ruse, he relocates to another part of the prison level (which you can determine); he continues to afflict Dorianna and begins tormenting the hero who took his ruby as well.

If Ysondkhelir is slain, he eventually reforms in Leng and gives up his Material Plane plots—for now.

Restoring Dorianna

Slaying Ysondkhelir frees Dorianna. Destroying the giant crawling hand immediately restores Dorianna’s hand to normal. The effects of this are described in the @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.6KJZ1Vc16h9vWbzU]{Dorianna's Madness} page.

G19. Hand Collection.name: G19. 手掌收藏 G19. Hand Collection
G19. Hand Collection.text:
一张小书桌靠着东墙，上面散落着烧过的蜡烛残端。西墙上钉着十多只生物的断手，每只都严重干瘪，手心朝外展示。

伊松德赫利在这间房里进行研究，但这里主要充当他骇人的战利品厅——墙上挂着他多年来腐化过的生物之手，其中也包括耶泽利的。他会花上数小时审视它们，被每只手上那些精细纹理所蛊惑；这些细节足以诉说一段完整的人生故事。

宝藏

@Item[8eTvo4AqRSBabPnz]{托梦术卷轴 (2)}

书桌抽屉里有两张托梦术卷轴。

A small desk covered in the stubs of burned candles stands against the east wall. The west wall has severed hands from more than a dozen creatures nailed to it, each badly withered and displayed palm outward.

Ysondkhelir performs his research in this room, but it primarily serves as his gruesome trophy hall—it bears the hands of creatures he has corrupted over the years, including Jedzeli’s. He spends hours examining them, mesmerized by the intricate details upon each hand that tell an entire life’s story.

Treasure

@Item[8eTvo4AqRSBabPnz]{Scrolls of Dream Message (2)}

The desk drawer contains two scrolls of dream message.

G20. Ritual Room.name: G20. 仪式间 G20. Ritual Room
G20. Ritual Room.text:
一个肮脏的丝绸枕头放在这间房间的中央，周围摆着几支未点燃的蜡烛。石墙上直接用木炭画了几幅同一个少女的画像。房间角落里放着一个小木箱，里面还有几支蜡烛。

伊松德赫利在这里进行他的梦境仪式，用他的魔法侵入并扭曲多里安娜·曼妮姆斯的梦境。他为她绘制的画像帮助他将注意力集中在她的心灵上。

宝藏

@Item[sECh4YAVtDGnmomm]{珍贵蜡烛}

箱子里装着几支由稀有蜡制成的蜡烛，总价值 50 gp。

A filthy silk pillow rests at the center of this room, surrounded by several unlit candles. Several charcoal depictions drawn directly on the stone walls feature the same teenage girl. A small wooden box sits in the corner of the room with a few more candles inside.

Ysondkhelir performs his dream rituals here, using his magic to invade and twist Dorianna Menhemes’s dreams. His drawings of her help him to focus on her mind.

Treasure

@Item[sECh4YAVtDGnmomm]{Valuable Candles}

The box contains several candles made of rare waxes worth 50 gp in total.

G21. The Secret Void.name: G21. 秘密虚空 G21. The Secret Void
G21. The Secret Void.text:
这间房室平坦的黑色墙壁映照出一种诡异的空寂。东墙边有一扇敞开的活板门，通向一条狭窄的爬行空间。

这间房室是为宁布洛斯的一位大祭司建造，用于睡眠与冥想。这里唯一的入口都被隐藏起来，而房间的黑墙模拟了虚无的虚空——那是被空无之死吞噬者所获赐的遗忘之境。

萨奎舒，一名宁布洛斯的鬼火祭司，占据着此处。她是一种变异的鬼火形态，因对空无之死的虔诚而获得了额外的力量。萨奎舒被从下层派来检查牢房，派遣者是女士的耳语——宁布洛斯一位耐心而沉默的仆役，可在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.TNQF4AlNpbjw191T]{I61} 找到。尽管古格巨人奥尔——像贝科拉一样愤怒、直率而唐突——在被那位术士派往牢房等级后，基本没能问出什么答案，但萨奎舒在她的探查中取得了更多成功。她了解了许多关于憎恨魔窟中层、甚至上层居民的情报，并在她隐形的外出之间在此休息。萨奎舒无法返回，因为乌瑞维安在区域 @UUID[.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03} 封锁了向下的道路，但她认为道路再次打开只是时间问题。

遭遇

中等 7

@Actor[3vn9W5SThovdsEnY]{萨奎舒}

80 XP

由于她频繁的游荡，你可以让萨奎舒几乎在任何地方与英雄们遭遇；她发动攻击以了解他们的战术与能力，但当生命值降至40以下时便会撤退回此区域。

在这里时，萨奎舒漂浮在天花板中央附近，一动不动，用苍白的发光洗亮整间房室，并沉浸于空寂之中。外来者出现在她这间秘密房间里会冒犯到她；她会立刻变暗并施放黑暗术，然后发起攻击。若英雄中有人公开携带典籍《呓语芦苇》，萨奎舒会因这本圣书落入不信者之手而骇然，并将携带者作为目标。

若生命值降至20或更少，萨奎舒会施放圣域术并撤退到区域 @UUID[.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03}，希望那里的道路已开启；若仍被封锁，她便会在那里做最后的抵抗。

The flat, black walls of this chamber reflect an eerie emptiness. An open trapdoor against the east wall leads to a narrow crawl space.

This chamber was built for a high priest of Nhimbaloth to sleep and meditate in. The only entrances are concealed and the room’s black walls simulate the void of oblivion granted to those consumed by the Empty Death.

Sacuishu, a will-o’-wisp priest of Nhimbaloth, occupies this chamber. She’s a variant form of will-o’-wisp who has gained extra powers from her devotion to the Empty Death. Sacuishu was sent from the lower levels to check on the prison by Lady’s Whisper, a patient and silent servitor of Nhimbaloth who can be found in area @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.TNQF4AlNpbjw191T]{I61}. While the gug Aulr—who’s angry, direct, and abrupt like Belcorra—has mostly failed to get any answers after being sent to the prison level by the sorcerer, Sacuishu found more success in her delving. She has learned a great deal about the inhabitants of the middle and even upper levels of the Abomination Vaults, and she rests here between her invisible excursions. Sacuishu can’t return, as Urevian blocked the ways down in area @UUID[.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03}, but she thinks it’s just a matter of time until the way opens again.

Encounter

Moderate 7

@Actor[3vn9W5SThovdsEnY]{Sacuishu}

80 XP

Because of her frequent wanderings, you can have Sacuishu encounter the heroes nearly anywhere; she attacks to learn their tactics and abilities but retreats to this area when reduced to fewer than 40 Hit Points.

While here, Sacuishu floats, very still, near the center of the ceiling, washing the room in a pale glow and basking in the emptiness. The presence of outsiders in her secret room offends her; she immediately Goes Dark and casts darkness before attacking. If any of the heroes openly carry the tome The Whispering Reeds, Sacuishu is appalled that the sacred book has fallen in the hands of a nonbeliever and targets whomever carries it.

If reduced to 20 or fewer hit points, Sacuishu casts sanctuary and retreats to area @UUID[.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03}, hoping it has opened; if it’s blocked, she makes her last stand there.

G22. Magical Communicator.name: G22. 魔法通讯器 G22. Magical Communicator
G22. Magical Communicator.text:
一碗肮脏的沼泽水放在一座粗陋的祭坛上。

祭司们曾用这只占卜碗在贝科拉死前与她沟通；在她死后它便失去作用。如今随着她的归来，它恢复了些许力量。第一个凝视其水面的生物会看到贝科拉憎恨的面容正怒视回望。该生物承受[[/r 9d6[mental]]] 伤害，并进行一次@Check[type:will|dc:33|basic:true]{基础意志}豁免。豁免失败的生物还会获得@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 1}，持续1分钟。初次显现之后，贝科拉的影像不再出现，但在未来的遭遇中，她会记住以这种方式召唤她的英雄。

宝藏

@Actor[AQh6XKPQLhxw4DVS]{惊惧献礼}

以下物品放在碗旁：一枚绞架之齿、一颗透明的元素宝石，以及一件惊惧战利品——由七只耳朵穿在钉子上构成。

A bowl of filthy swamp water rests upon a crude altar.

Priests once used this scrying bowl to communicate with Belcorra before it became inactive upon her death. It regained a fraction of its power now that she has returned. The first creature to look into its waters sees Belcorra’s hateful visage glaring back. The creature takes [[/r 9d6[mental]]] damage, with a @Check[type:will|dc:33|basic:true]{Basic Will} Save. A creature that fails its save is also @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute. After this initial appearance, Belcorra’s image doesn’t reappear, but she remembers the hero who called upon her in this way in future encounters.

Treasure

@Actor[AQh6XKPQLhxw4DVS]{Grim Offerings}

The following items lie next to the bowl: a gallows tooth, a transparent elemental gem, and a grim trophy in the form of seven ears impaled on a nail.

Chapter 7: Soul Keepers.name: 第7章：灵魂守护者 Chapter 7: Soul Keepers
Chapter 7: Soul Keepers.text:
章节概要

很久以前，贝科拉将牢房等级交给了契约魔鬼乌瑞维安和他的地狱爪牙。如今他们正勤勉筹备入侵地表，而该等级也处于相当高的警戒状态。英雄们必须一路杀穿众多魔鬼与血肉扭曲体爪牙。他们或许会找到一些令人意外的盟友，包括一名被囚禁的赏金猎人，以及一只渴望达成交易、名为泽克的小魔鬼。在这里，英雄们也能终结那只折磨多里安娜·曼妮姆斯的邪恶生物。当英雄们终于见到乌瑞维安时，他会提出一个提议，而这份提议包裹着艰难的道德抉择。

环境线索：

硫磺的恶臭，诡异的沉默术，闪动的火焰，烟雾，牢房门，表面刻着的地狱符文（乌瑞维安一直在窥探卡曼·拉贾尼，因此对英雄们略知一二。你可以让部分英雄的对手直呼其名，或预判他们的大致战术——尤其是他们在卡曼面前使用过或讨论过的任何内容——来强化这种不祥的氛围。）

牢房

整个牢房的天花板高度均为20英尺，由闪动的火焰或发光的魔鬼符号投下的昏暗红光照明。门都是铁包石门，且许多上了锁。作为无处不在的魔鬼影响所带来的副作用，所有门在开启或关闭时，边缘都会短暂地闪现火焰，使得在牢房等级潜行变得困难。受过宗教训练的英雄在开门时可以低声念出一句简短的祷文（不需要任何动作）来阻止这一效果。

Chapter Synopsis

Long ago, Belcorra handed over the prison level to the contract devil Urevian and his infernal minions. They now prepare diligently to invade the surface, and the level is on reasonably high alert. The heroes must fight their way through many devils and fleshwarp minions. They might find some surprising allies, including an imprisoned bounty hunter and an imp named Szek who’s eager to make a deal. Here, the heroes can also put an end to the malevolent creature tormenting Dorianna Menhemes. When the heroes finally meet Urevian, he extends an offer wrapped in a difficult moral choice.

Environmental Cues:

Stench of brimstone, eerie silence, flickering flames, smoke, cell doors, infernal runes carved on surfaces (Urevian has been spying on Carman Rajani and thus knows a little about the heroes. You can play up the ominous atmosphere by having some of the heroes' opponents call them by their names or predict their general tactics- particularly anything they've used or discussed around Carman.)

The Prison

Ceilings are 20 feet high throughout the prison, which is illuminated by dim, red light from flickering flames or glowing diabolic symbols. The doors are all stone bound in iron, and many are locked. As a side effect of pervasive, diabolic influence, all doors flicker briefly with fire around their edges when opened or closed, making sneaking in the prison level difficult. A hero trained in Religion can utter a brief incantation (which requires no action) when opening a door to prevent this effect.

Dorianna's Madness.name: 多瑞安娜的疯狂 Dorianna's Madness
Dorianna's Madness.text:
大约在英雄们完成实验室等级的探索并开始调查牢房等级时，多瑞安娜的状态突然恶化。她大多数时候都在梦游，对周遭发生的事毫无察觉，仿佛在朦胧的梦中看世界。她的右手无缘无故地枯萎。曼妮姆斯镇长把女儿带到晨花图书馆的万蒂·班得黛西那里，但那里的牧师无法援助她。

英雄们下次返回奥塔里时会听说这一切。曼妮姆斯一家其他人都悲痛欲绝。如果英雄们此前没有赢得多瑞安娜的信任，他们现在可以尝试用一次 @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:27|traits:action:make-an-impression]{Diplomacy} 检定来这么做，而且他们不会因为得到 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.WirKAYn5ZGirmgjb]{曼妮姆斯庄园} 的支援而获得任何加值——多瑞安娜已经不在乎她以前的朋友了。

杂衣人

如果英雄们获得了多瑞安娜的信任，她会描述自己与杂衣人在一片奇幻国度中的伟大冒险：那里有森林、宫殿与雪原。杂衣人告诉她，他们很快就会永远一起冒险，但他想要她的右手作为信物。多瑞安娜毫不犹豫地把它献给了他，而当她醒来时，她的手已经枯萎。她并不认为这是什么严重的损失，因为她最好的朋友那么想要它。多瑞安娜不知道自己还要多久才会与杂衣人永远在一起，而这个时间表故意保持模糊，这样你就能在不惩罚玩家没能迅速抵达伊松德赫利的情况下推动他们采取行动。至少在多瑞安娜消失前，他们应当还有一周时间。

定位伊松德赫利

多瑞安娜与伊松德赫利的联系如今强到英雄们可以通过这条连结发现他。一名受训于秘法学的英雄意识到，他们可以在多瑞安娜做梦时检查她的灵能模式来了解更多。这是一项探索行动，需要8小时，并要求进行一次 @Check[type:occultism|dc:23]{Occultism} 检定。检定成功时，英雄得知以下他们尚未知晓的第一条事实；大成功时得知两条事实；大失败时则会得知一条由你编造的错误事实。

  • • 多瑞安娜的心智与幻梦境之间存在强烈的连结。一名冷原居民强化了这条管道；除非那生物被消灭，否则多瑞安娜最终会被完全拖入那个维度，并从这个世界失落。

  • • 英雄获得那名冷原居民巢穴的影像：一间石室，墙上画着一张非常古老的内海地区地图；其对面是一张由数张破烂纸片拼成的地图，合在一起构成一张奥塔里的详尽地图。

  • • 英雄得知那名冷原居民名为伊松德赫利，并获得对他准确的心像。

  • • 英雄可以启动多瑞安娜所持有的 @Item[uoPAVVoQc95sdxTN]{冷原红宝石} 来定位伊松德赫利。即使多瑞安娜不在乎他们拿走它，它仍与她谐调，并会在每晚回到她身边。因此英雄们必须每天返回奥塔里将其取回。

奖励

@Item[H8nRd47rHQZdgyt9]{冷原红宝石}

英雄们击败伊松德赫利后，红宝石将不再回到多瑞安娜身边，并变成一根外形异常的定 位术魔杖。多瑞安娜随后迅速康复。奥瑟夫镇长热情洋溢地感谢英雄们，并安排由他出资，让他们每人从艾巴萨罗姆获得一件自选的7级或更低等级的物品。这些物品需要一周时间送达。

XP奖励

因将多瑞安娜从伊松德赫利的掌控中解救出来，给予英雄们120 XP。

About the time the heroes finish their exploration of the laboratories level and start to investigate the prison level, Dorianna’s condition suddenly gets worse. She sleepwalks most of the time and is unaware of events around her, as though seeing the world in a hazy dream. Her right hand withers for no discernible reason. Mayor Menhemes takes his daughter to Vandy Banderdash at the Dawnflower Library, but the clerics there can’t aid her.

The heroes hear about all of this on their next return to Otari. Everyone else in the Menhemes family is beside themselves with grief. If the heroes haven’t previously gained Dorianna’s trust, they can now attempt to do so with a @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:27|traits:action:make-an-impression]{Diplomacy} check, and they gain no bonus for having the support of @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.WirKAYn5ZGirmgjb]{Menhemes Manor}—Dorianna is beyond caring about her former friends.

The Motley Man

If the heroes have Dorianna’s trust, she describes great adventures with the Motley Man in a fantastical land of forests, palaces, and snowfields. The Motley Man told her they would soon be together on their adventures forever, but he wanted her right hand as a token. Dorianna didn’t hesitate to offer it to him, and when she awoke her hand was withered. She doesn’t consider it a particularly serious loss, since her best friend wanted it so much. Dorianna doesn’t know how long it will be until she and the Motley Man are together forever, and this timetable is intentionally left vague so you can prompt your players to action without punishing them if they fail to reach Ysondkhelir quickly. They should have, at a minimum, a week before Dorianna vanishes.

Locating Ysondkhelir

Dorianna’s connection to Ysondkhelir is now so strong that the heroes can discover him through this link. A hero trained in Occultism realizes they can learn more by examining Dorianna’s psychic patterns while she is dreaming. This is an exploration activity that takes 8 hours and requires a @Check[type:occultism|dc:23]{Occultism} check. With a successful check, the hero learns the first fact below they don’t already know; with a critical success they learn two facts; and with a critical failure, they learn a false fact of your invention.

  • • There is a strong link between Dorianna’s mind and the Dimension of Dreams. A denizen of Leng has strengthened this conduit; unless that creature is destroyed, Dorianna will eventually be drawn wholly into that dimension and lost to this world.

  • • The hero gains images of the denizen’s lair: a stone chamber with a very old map of the Inner Sea region painted on it across from a map consisting of several tattered pieces of paper that, together, constitute a detailed map of Otari.

  • • The hero knows the denizen’s name is Ysondkhelir and gains an accurate mental image of him.

  • • The hero can activate the @Item[uoPAVVoQc95sdxTN]{Leng Ruby} in Dorianna’s possession to locate Ysondkhelir. Even though Dorianna doesn’t care if they take it, it’s still attuned to her and returns to her each night. The heroes must therefore return to Otari to recover it each day.

Rewards

@Item[H8nRd47rHQZdgyt9]{Leng Ruby}

After the heroes defeat Ysondkhelir, the ruby no longer returns to Dorianna and becomes an unusually shaped wand of locate. Dorianna swiftly recovers afterward. Mayor Oseph effusively thanks the heroes and arranges for each of them to receive an item of 7th level or lower of their choice from Absalom at his expense. These items take a week to arrive.

XP Award

Award the heroes 120 XP for freeing Dorianna from Ysondkhelir’s clutches.

Urevian's Offer.name: 乌瑞维安的提议 Urevian's Offer
Urevian's Offer.text:
征求建议

你的玩家可能不会花太多时间认真思考是否要把卡曼·拉贾尼交给乌瑞维安这一道德问题。但也许他们会深思熟虑地辩论此事，甚至寻求其他人的意见。奥塔里的NPC们在这个问题上意见分裂。

万蒂·班得黛西认为，用另一个人的灵魂与魔鬼讨价还价是错误的。她相信每个人都应当有获得救赎的机会，哪怕是卡曼。然而，她对盗贼抱有特别的鄙视，因为多年前她的姐姐偷了她的东西背叛了她，她一直没能真正走出那段阴影。若英雄们不同意她，她也不会强迫他们。

瓦琳·希温尼斯也反对这笔交易，因为她认为限制灵魂自由令人憎恶。

长鞍队长很乐意把卡曼交给英雄们，好让他们把他交给魔鬼。他认为这是消除对小镇的严重威胁的一种直截了当的办法。

这一次，伊娜斯梅拉同意卫兵队长的看法。她过去与卡曼纠葛太多，也希望看到他离开，尤其是在知道这么做能拯救小镇的情况下。

市长欧瑟夫·曼妮姆斯不表态，但会支持英雄们做出的任何选择，尤其是如果他们一直在帮助他的女儿。市长相信英雄们有能力，也值得信赖，能做出正确决定。若他的意见能用来打破僵局，他更倾向于对卡曼施以仁慈。

莫里宾特不直接发表意见，但会推荐几则与魔鬼打交道的故事（几乎全部都以涉事凡人下场极惨而告终）。

找回卡曼

英雄们能多容易找回卡曼，取决于他在第5章中的结局。若他们释放了他，英雄们很可能会发现他仍在走私者避难所里闷闷不乐，因为他还没鼓起勇气离开。若英雄们说明想拿他做什么，他肯定不会自愿跟他们走，但英雄们可以骗他。若卡曼知道自己将面临什么，他会竭尽全力逃离该区域，而英雄们很可能不得不与乌瑞维安合作，通过占卜探知他的新的位置——而那位契约魔鬼肯定会让他们为此付出代价，不论以何种方式。

若卡曼在监狱里，英雄们可以直接从看押处把他双身出来。长鞍不介意把他交给英雄们，毕竟是他们最初抓到他的。若他们坦率说明为何想要卡曼，他出人意料地同意把这个无赖交给魔鬼。

若卡曼已死，英雄们必须前往他死亡之处以困住他的灵魂。乌瑞维安解释说，英雄们必须在握持一颗特制宝石（同样由他提供）的同时，施行@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.gsYEuWv04XTDxe91]{Call Spirit}仪式（他可以教他们）。英雄们负责施行该仪式并支付其花费。若他们召来卡曼的灵魂，它会自动被吸入宝石之中。

交付

若英雄们将活着的卡曼·拉贾尼带给乌瑞维安，或把装有卡曼灵魂的灵魂宝石交给他，乌瑞维安朝他的书桌一挥手。桌上所有东西都被魔法自动打包成越来越小的盒子，最终变成一个手提箱，由其中一名胡须魔拎起。另一名胡须魔牢牢抓住卡曼（或宝石），两名胡须魔随即一同消失。“与诸位做生意很愉快，”乌瑞维安说道，“我会再来找你们的，也许在几年或几十年后。要是那时你们已经死了……嗯，我也总能找到你们。你们真是令人愉悦地有用。我会保持联系的。”

XP奖励

若英雄们与乌瑞维安达成交易并让魔鬼离开，奖励英雄们120 XP。

Asking for Advice

Your players might not spent a lot of time heavily considering the moral question of whether to turn over Carman Rajani over to Urevian. But perhaps they thoughtfully debate the issue or even seek other opinions. NPCs in Otari are split on the matter.

Vandy Banderdash thinks it’s wrong to bargain with a devil using another person’s soul. She believes that everyone deserves a chance at redemption, even Carman. However, she holds a particular contempt for thieves, as she never really recovered from the betrayal of her sister stealing from her years ago. She doesn’t push the heroes if they disagree with her.

Wrin Sivinxi also opposes the deal since she finds limiting a soul’s freedom to be abhorrent.

Captain Longsaddle happily releases Carman to the heroes so they can turn him over to the devil. He considers this choice a straightforward way to eliminate a serious threat to his town.

For once, Yinyasmera agrees with the guard captain. She’s had so many past problems with Carman that she’d also like to see him gone, especially knowing that doing so would save the town.

Mayor Oseph Menhemes doesn’t take a position but backs whatever choice the heroes make, especially if they’ve been helping his daughter. The mayor believes that the heroes are capable and trustworthy decision-makers. If his opinion serves as a tie-breaker, he leans toward showing Carman mercy.

Morlibint doesn’t offer a direct opinion but recommends several stories about dealing with devils (virtually all of which turn out very poorly for the mortals involved).

Recovering Carman

How easily the heroes can recover Carman depends on his fate in Chapter 5. If they released him, the heroes likely find him still brooding in Smuggler’s Refuge, as he hasn’t yet summoned the courage to depart. He certainly won’t go with the heroes willingly if they explain what they want with him, but the heroes could trick him. If Carman knows what he’s in for, he does his best to flee the area, and the heroes probably have to work with Urevian to scry his new location—which the contract devil certainly makes them pay for, one way or another.

If Carman is in jail, the heroes can simply fetch him from custody. Longsaddle doesn’t mind turning him over to the heroes, as they captured him in the first place. If they’re up-front about why they want Carman, he’s surprisingly agreeable to turning the scoundrel over to the devil.

If Carman is dead, the heroes must go to the place of his death to trap his spirit. Urevian explains that the heroes must perform the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.gsYEuWv04XTDxe91]{Call Spirit} ritual (which he can teach them) while holding a specially-prepared gemstone (that he also provides). The heroes are responsible for performing the ritual and paying its cost. If they call Carman’s spirit, it’s automatically drawn into the gemstone.

Delivery

If the heroes bring Carman Rajani to Urevian alive or give him a soul gem with Carman’s soul inside, Urevian flicks a hand toward his desk. All the contents magically pack themselves into smaller and smaller boxes, eventually into a single valise that one of the barbazus picks up. The other barbazu takes Carman (or the gem) in a firm grip, and both barbazus disappear. “It was a pleasure doing business with you,” says Urevian, “I will look you up again, perhaps in a few years or decades. And if you have died in that time... well, I can come find you anyway. You are so delightfully useful. I shall be in touch.”

XP Award

Award the heroes 120 XP if they make a deal with Urevian and get the devil to depart.

01. A Light in the Fog.name: 01. 雾中的灯塔 01. A Light in the Fog

A01. Damp Entrance.name: A01. 潮湿入口 A01. Damp Entrance
A01. Damp Entrance.text:
大片霉斑与霉菌覆盖着这座瞭望塔潮湿的表面，在黯淡的石墙上形成绿色与黑色的污痕。北侧与南侧墙上的门框早已腐烂，只剩几把坍塌的椅子倒在地上，周围散落着几小堆散发恶臭的灰色团块。厚厚的积尘蛛网从上方垂落，遮蔽了对天花板的任何视线。

这座单层附属建筑曾是凄凉灯塔要塞的主要入口，由坚固的石材建成。不透明的积尘蛛网层在离地7尺处起到吊顶作用，在蛛网与上方石制天花板之间留出了3尺的空间。

生物

三只螨精潜伏在蛛网之上，但英雄们一进入下方房间，它们就忍不住想要折磨并戏弄他们。它们蹲伏在木板与藤蔓上，透过蛛网向下窥视，等到至少有两名英雄进入下方房间后，便用自己最擅长模仿的尖细小精灵嗓音呼喊。它们欢迎英雄进入“会客室”，警告他们附近要塞里住着刻薄的虫子，并建议来客去品尝地板上的“魔法小精灵泥”。当然，螨精完全不擅长说谎（它们的欺瞒调整值为–1），而且只能使用地底通用语交流，这意味着它们成功的机会微乎其微；但若真骗成了，它们会笑到前仰后合，甚至忍不住暴露自己的存在。

遭遇

低 1

@Actor[E0LCMHVp4sxAbQYa]{螨精（3）}

60 XP
