凄凉灯塔受到魔法保护，免于伤害，如@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{此处}所述。这种保护在一定程度上渗入了周围遗迹，在过去500年里减缓了通常的衰败速度。尽管如此，时代不可违逆，遗迹的其余部分仍在数个世纪的流逝中饱受摧残。

Chapter Synopsis

The upper level of the Abomination Vaults—and the only level aboveground—is the ruin of a large structure called Gauntlight Keep. Although the upper levels of the keep have collapsed into the lower level (filling many of the remaining rooms with rubble), one prominent structure remains: @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight}, a massive lighthouse placed incongruously in the middle of a large swamp called the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.dMyS4bNbb1diRzow]{Fogfen}. Here, the heroes can encounter hapless but vicious mitflits, dangers left from Belcorra’s day, and evidence that Gauntlight draws upon power from somewhere deep below.

Ruins of Gauntlight

As the heroes approach the ruins of @Scene[3Nat4ImT49niZUdr]{Gauntlight Keep} for the first time, read or paraphrase the following.

The sound of frogs and mosquitoes mixes with water sloshing against muddy shores, all muffled by the ever-present mists that linger in the aptly named Fogfen. As the mists clear, a shadow looms from the cloying swamp vapors- a sprawling ruin of stone and wood squats atop an island in the soggy marsh. The upper floors have largely collapsed, leaving only the stone walls of the ground floor intact. Above these ruins towers an out-of-place monument—a colossal lighthouse whose painted walls and iron-cased crown have resisted the corrosive effects of the surrounding swamp.

While the overgrown trail leads right to area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.tLAbtqjMjDw2qq1h]{A01}, the heroes can access the ruins through other entrances. Along the southern side, waters surrounding the ruins are relatively shallow, but on other sides, the depth ranges from 10 to 15 feet, requiring a boat or swimming to navigate.

Features

Environmental Cues:

Crude graffiti, evidence of prior squatters, mounds of rubble, overgrowth of mold and creeping plants, puddles of standing water, scuttling vermin, splashing water, swampy odors.

With the exception of Gauntlight's cupola, @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{A25}, the upper levels of Gauntlight Keep collapsed long ago, even falling to the ground floor in places. Areas denoted as rubble on the map of Gauntlight Keep are open to the sky above and considered difficult terrain. Where the roof hasn't caved in, ceilings are 10 feet high unless otherwise noted. The only illumination comes from whatever sunlight filters in through the constant fog. The doors on this level are all cracked and rotten except where indicated; handling them with any amount of force causes them to split or simply fall off their hinges with a wet splintering sound.

Gauntlight is magically protected from damage, as described @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{here}. This protection has bled into the surrounding ruins somewhat, slowing the usual rate of decay over the past 500 years. Nevertheless, time is inexorable, and the rest of the ruins have suffered in the passage of centuries.

The Mudlicker Gremlins.name: 舔泥小魔怪 The Mudlicker Gremlins
The Mudlicker Gremlins.text:
在这片废墟中活动的主要派系，是一小帮自称为舔泥佬的螨精小魔怪残党。舔泥佬由一名体型魁梧、留着胡须的小魔怪——@Actor[xAfkUwJYq5JLmSrW]{斯夸老大}——领导，他们相信自己曾在地下“辉煌”地生活过。然而，体型更大、更凶恶的幽灵女王摩洛克的到来将他们赶出了家园，从那以后他们一直在艰难地重新站稳脚跟。为此，斯夸老大迄今为止拟定了一个计划雏形：培养一支巨型昆虫大军来占领奥塔里。他已经兴高采烈地保证，会通过这个阴谋实现舔泥佬荣光的复原术，因此这帮小弟忠诚地追随斯夸老大，努力将像英雄们这样的入侵者挡在“他们的”废墟之外。

斯夸老大的计划

舔泥佬的首领斯夸老大有一个胆大妄为的计划。在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.9kxya2R9NYsSAA4G]{A05} 发现巨型蛆虫、并在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.yyUsiyd1QIMwin1X]{A06} 发现巨型苍蝇后，他命令自己的螨精开始训练并繁殖更多蛆虫。等这些昆虫完全长成后，他打算带领整支队伍，骑乘训练有素的巨型苍蝇战马，前往奥塔里进行劫掠并建立统治。

The main faction active in the ruins is what’s left of a small gang of mitflit gremlins who call themselves the Mudlickers. Led by a large, bearded gremlin named @Actor[xAfkUwJYq5JLmSrW]{Boss Skrawng}, the Mudlickers believe they once dwelt in “glory” underground. However, the arrival of the much larger and meaner Ghost Queen morlocks forced them out of their homes, and they’ve struggled to regain their footing ever since. Boss Skrawng has thus far formed the inkling of a plan to raise an army of giant insects to take over Otari. He has already exuberantly guaranteed the restoration of Mudlicker glory through this scheme, so the gang loyally follows Boss Skrawng, working hard to keep intruders—like the heroes—out of “their” ruins.

Boss Skrawng's Plan

The Mudlicker leader, Boss Skrawng, has an audacious plan. After discovering the giant maggots in area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.9kxya2R9NYsSAA4G]{A05} and the giant fly in the area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.yyUsiyd1QIMwin1X]{A06}, he ordered his mitflits to start training and breeding more maggots. Once the insects have fully grown, he intends on leading his entire group, mounted on trained giant fly war steeds, down to Otari to raid and rule.

02. The Forgotten Dungeon.name: 02. 被遗忘的魔窟 02. The Forgotten Dungeon

B01. Stairs Up.name: B01. 向上的楼梯 B01. Stairs Up
B01. Stairs Up.text:
这些紧密盘旋的楼梯向上通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.edLZ3shIoFN8nuur]{A21}。

These tightly spiraling stairs lead up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.edLZ3shIoFN8nuur]{A21}.

B02. Volluk’s Workshop.name: B02. 沃卢克的工坊 B02. Volluk’s Workshop
B02. Volluk’s Workshop.text:
这间房间的门上了锁。没有来自区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.OWxvfpXI9DIvPEM2]{A20} 的钥匙的英雄可以通过一次成功的 @Check[type:athletics|dc:20|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} 来@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}这扇门，或通过三次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery}检定来@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock}。

七个方形壁龛环绕着这间潮湿的石室，每个壁龛里都放着古怪的魔法器械或炼金工具组。北侧的壁龛里有一只装满液体的大玻璃槽。一具哥布林的尸体漂浮在其中，身上穿着过时的仆役制服。玻璃槽前摆着一张半圆形工作台，上面覆满工具、发霉的纸张，以及一本摊开的厚书。

沃鲁克·阿兹里尼曾将此室用作他的私人工作坊。玻璃槽前的工作台保存着沃鲁克大部分笔记。一名英雄在进行调查行动这些笔记时，若以 @Check[type:arcana|dc:12|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Arcana} 或 @Check[type:occultism|dc:12|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism}检定成功以回忆知识，便得知此工作坊同时致力于构装体的制造与死灵术。该检定若为大成功或大失败中的大成功，还会揭示此处尤其强调转移凡人灵魂，包括将灵魂转移进构装体或害虫虫群之中。

玻璃槽里的哥布林是波波保存完好的尸体，他曾是沃鲁克忠诚的仆从。波波自愿奉上自己的身体与灵魂，参与一项沃鲁克承诺能赐予不朽的技术——不过，被变成名为 @Actor[kzX588Hjb3w4QPOj]{喙先生} 的缚魂娃娃，并不是波波所想象的不朽。尽管如此，波波作为喙先生，至今仍忠于沃鲁克。尸体在槽内保存得很好；即便被取出，也要数月才会衰败。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

对其他壁龛的搜索几乎没有发现值得注意之处，只有两项例外：西南侧壁龛内的一扇暗门，以及西北侧壁龛内一个未完成的缚魂娃娃。

暗门

西南侧壁龛里有一扇暗门，通往下方区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.YhRSOC6JXrOhl9wU]{C10}，并从那里回到上方区域 @UUID[.8qZk6POeK6TgPon4]{B32}。一名英雄在搜索该壁龛时若以 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception}检定成功，便会发现墙上钉着一个工具箱。拉动其中的工具，连动的暗门就会打开。

未完成的娃娃

西北侧壁龛里有一件 @Item[CsnA44p9IJlw72rg]{未完成的缚魂娃娃}，外形像一只没有手臂与双腿的哥布林。它背后有一处凹槽，大小与喙先生的灵魂焦点宝石相同。将此宝石嵌入会启动该缚魂娃娃，使其能够说话，但在其构造完成前无法攻击、移动或施放法术。一名英雄可以付出足够的工时与花费来完成它，但波波依旧反复无常且暴力。

与波波说话

若波波被“送回”这具身体，他会很快苏醒并开始抽泣，用哥布林语哀叹主人背叛了他。他会一直无法被安抚，直到某位英雄要么以一次成功的 @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:16|traits:action:make-an-impression]{Diplomacy}检定来建立印象使他平静下来，要么以一次 @Check[type:intimidation|dc:16|traits:action:coerce]{Intimidate}检定来胁迫吓住他，或者直到有人将他置于能看见北侧壁龛里他旧身体的位置。无论哪一种情况，波波最终都会沉默下来，英雄们也就能用通用语、精灵语或哥布林语与他交谈。波波几乎说不出什么有用的话，常陷入自怜与对沃鲁克的刻毒咒骂，但若英雄问对问题，他们能从他那里得到四条关键信息。

• 本房间内暗门的位置。

• 在他旧房间（区域 @UUID[.KSCa8Wx2rSKuzHC1]{B04}）一块松动的砖后有一处秘密宝藏藏匿点。

• 沃鲁克大师是一位“强大的操盘手卓尔通灵术士艺术家工匠”，他与“下面的书女士”有关系，并为“贝科拉女士服务——她非常可怕，而且绝对不关我的事。”

• 沃鲁克大师既虚荣又残忍。若英雄向他展示一幅沃鲁克的好看画像（例如一幅画）并威胁要毁掉它，沃鲁克会失去冷静，并很可能犯下英雄可利用的战术错误。不幸的是，波波所知唯一一幅沃鲁克的画在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.OYCvTEvFFpv8zEql]{A22}，而且已被毁。事实上，憎恨魔窟中仅存的一幅沃鲁克图像位于区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.KDcIKiVRxWGTfQhK]{C36}。

当英雄们已得知他全部信息后，波波可怜巴巴地请求被释放。若英雄砸碎灵魂焦点宝石，波波的灵魂便会被解放。出于这份慈悲之举，法莱斯玛会赐予摧毁宝石的英雄一份 @Item[vOiDlHyPjYC56rIN]{Favor}：一次短暂的、预言般的命运一瞥。这使该英雄对一次检定获得+2状态加值，而且即便在他们得知该检定结果之后仍可应用。该英雄有1个月时间使用此恩惠。

The door to this room is locked. A hero without the key from area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.OWxvfpXI9DIvPEM2]{A20} can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the door with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:20|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} or @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} with three successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks.

Seven square alcoves, each containing strange magical apparatuses or alchemical sets of tools, ring this damp stone chamber. The alcove to the north contains a large glass tank filled with liquid. A goblin's corpse, clad in outdated servant's clothing, floats inside it. A semicircular worktable covered with tools, moldy papers, and a large open book stands in front of the tank.

Volluk Azrinae once used this chamber as his personal workshop. The worktable in front of the tank holds the bulk of Volluk’s notes. A hero Investigating these notes who succeeds at a @Check[type:arcana|dc:12|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Arcana} or @Check[type:occultism|dc:12|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism} check to Recall Knowledge learns that the workshop is devoted to both construct construction and necromancy. A critical success on this check also reveals the workshop's emphasis is transferring mortal souls, including into a construct or a swarm of vermin.

The goblin in the tank is the preserved corpse of Borbo, once Volluk's devoted servant. Borbo volunteered his body and soul for a technique that Volluk promised would grant immortality, though being turned into the soulbound doll named @Actor[kzX588Hjb3w4QPOj]{Mister Beak} wasn't exactly the immortality that Borbo had in mind. Still, Borbo, as Mister Beak, has thus far remained loyal to Volluk. The corpse is well-preserved in the tank; even if removed, it takes months to decay.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

A search of the other alcoves reveals little of interest, with two exceptions: a secret door in the southwestern alcove and an incomplete soulbound doll in the northwestern alcove.

Secret Door

The southwestern alcove contains a secret door leading down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.YhRSOC6JXrOhl9wU]{C10} and, from there, back up to area @UUID[.8qZk6POeK6TgPon4]{B32}. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check while Searching this alcove identifies a toolbox bolted to the wall. When the tools within it are pulled, the attached secret door opens.

Incomplete Doll

The northwest alcove contains an @Item[CsnA44p9IJlw72rg]{Incomplete Soulbound Doll} resembling an armless, legless goblin. It has an indentation in its back the same size as Mister Beak’s soul focus gem. Inserting this gem activates the soulbound doll, allowing it to speak but not attack, move, or cast spells until its construction is complete. A hero can complete it with enough work and expense, but Borbo remains erratic and violent.

Speaking to Borbo

If Borbo is "returned" to this body, he wakens quickly and begins to sob, lamenting in Goblin that his master betrayed him. He remains inconsolable until a hero can either calm him with a successful @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:16|traits:action:make-an-impression]{Diplomacy} check to Make an Impression or scare him with a @Check[type:intimidation|dc:16|traits:action:coerce]{Intimidate} check to Coerce him, or until someone places him in a position where he can see his former body in the north alcove. In any of these cases, Borbo finally goes silent and the heroes can speak to him in Common, Elven, or Goblin. Borbo has little useful to say and is prone to fits of self-pity and vitriol toward Volluk, but if the heroes ask the right questions, they can get four key pieces of information from him.

• The location of the secret door in this room.

• That there’s a secret treasure stash behind a loose brick in his old room (area @UUID[.KSCa8Wx2rSKuzHC1]{B04}).

• Master Volluk was a “powerful mastermind drow occultist artist craftsman” who had a relationship with a "book lady down below” and who worked for “Mistress Belcorra, who is very frightening and absolutely none of my business."

• Master Volluk is vain as well as cruel. If the heroes present a nice image of Volluk (such as a painting) to him and then threaten to destroy it, Volluk will lose his composure and likely make a tactical error the heroes can use. Unfortunately, the only painting of Volluk Borbo knows about is the one in area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.OYCvTEvFFpv8zEql]{A22}, and it’s destroyed. In fact, only one image of Volluk remains in the Abomination Vaults; it's in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.KDcIKiVRxWGTfQhK]{C36}.

Once the heroes have learned all of his information, Borbo pitifully asks to be released. If the heroes smash the soul focus gem, Borbo's soul is freed. For this act of compassion, Pharasma grants the hero who destroyed the gem a @Item[vOiDlHyPjYC56rIN]{Favor} in the form of a momentary, prophetic glimpse of their fate. This allows that hero to gain a +2 status bonus to a single check, which they can apply even after they determine the check's result. The hero has 1 month to use this boon.

B03. Volluk’s Chambers.name: B03. 沃鲁克的房间 B03. Volluk’s Chambers
B03. Volluk’s Chambers.text:
这间房间兼具卧室与书房的特征，不过装饰中没有任何私人物品或具有纪念意义的物品。

沃鲁克曾居住于此，但在成为蠕虫行者后搬到了楼下的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.NHY0hh539X658iSG]{D08}。搜查房间会发现一张纸片，上面列着书名《如虫所晓》、《墓地之宴》与《颅骨之秘》，底部还有一则便条写道：“誊抄将花上数月时间，但我会尽快把这些书还给你，吾爱！”

This room shares features of both a bedroom and a study, although the decor is devoid of any personal items or items of sentimental value.

Volluk once dwelt here but relocated downstairs to area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.NHY0hh539X658iSG]{D08} after becoming a worm that walks. A search of the room turns up a scrap of paper listing the book titles What The Worm Knows, Grave Feasts, and Secrets of the Skull, along with a note at the bottom indicating that “Transcription will take months, but I’ll try to have these books back to you as soon as possible, my love!”

B04. Borbo’s Room.name: B04. 波波的房间 B04. Borbo’s Room
B04. Borbo’s Room.text:
这个小房间里有一张被遗弃已久的稻草床、一只抽屉敞开、露出一堆过时仆役衣物的五斗柜，以及一个大木桶，桶上放着一把长柄勺。

这个房间曾属于沃卢克的地精仆人波波，但自从地精放弃生命成为喙先生后，这里便一直荒废。衣物与@UUID[.hOMUDNapQMRjV1kQ]{区域B02}中波波尸体所穿的相符。木桶里曾装着几十根腌黄瓜，但其中的盐水早在很久以前就已蒸发，腌黄瓜也都腐烂殆尽。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

@Actor[BhcCzIMpz9wD2PWh]{波波的藏匿处}

一位英雄在搜索此房间时，若成功通过一次@Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定，便会发现一块松动的砖头，后面藏着波波的小型宝藏：一片价值15 gp的翡翠碎片、一尊价值35 gp的双魅魔银质小雕像，以及一枚油光发亮的滑溜护甲符文。英雄们也许会从@UUID[.hOMUDNapQMRjV1kQ]{区域B02}的波波那里听说这处藏匿。

This small room has a long-abandoned straw bed, a dresser with open drawers revealing a jumble of out-of-date servant's clothing, and a large barrel with a ladle atop it.

This room once belonged to Volluk's goblin servant Borbo, but it has been abandoned since the goblin gave up his life to become Mister Beak. The clothing matches that worn by Borbo's corpse in @UUID[.hOMUDNapQMRjV1kQ]{Area B02}. The barrel once held dozens of pickles, but the brine inside evaporated long ago and the pickles have rotted away.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

@Actor[BhcCzIMpz9wD2PWh]{Borbo's Stash}

A hero Searching this room who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check finds a loose brick concealing Borbo's small treasure stash: a jade shard worth 15 gp, a silver statuette of two succubi worth 35 gp, and an oily-looking slick armor rune. The heroes might hear about this stash from Borbo in @UUID[.hOMUDNapQMRjV1kQ]{Area B02}.

B05. Volluk’s Machine.name: B05. 沃鲁克的机器 B05. Volluk’s Machine
B05. Volluk’s Machine.text:
一张巨大的金属桌子位于这间房间的中央，配有皮革束带与铁箍。桌子头部附近放着一台奇怪的装置，看起来一部分像望远镜，一部分像机械钻头。一颗闪耀的黑色宝石嵌在这台机器侧面的金属框架中，微光闪烁。

遭遇

中等 2

@Actor[k4fVLtVrgIEg9xij]{鲜血虹吸}

80 XP

沃鲁克的最后造物之一仍留在此处：一名由巨型水蛭造就的可怖不死守卫。沃鲁克称这生物为“鲜血虹吸”，并以它变得多么干瘪而取乐。鲜血虹吸看起来像一截干枯血肉的巨大木头，直到有人打扰或接近它；届时它便猛然扑出并发动攻击。它会追击敌人进入区域 B1 至 B4，但不会再往外追。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

这房间里的机器是沃鲁克在许多年代之前制作的虐待装置。若成功进行一次 @Check[type:occultism|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{神秘学} 或 @Check[type:religion|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{宗教} 检定以回忆知识，英雄便能判定该装置有助于施放 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{唤起死灵} 仪式（但这不会提供关于该仪式的知识）。钻孔装置会穿透被束缚受害者的头骨，而镜筒则聚焦该仪式的死灵能量。使用这台机器会使施放唤起死灵的技能检定获得 +2 物品加值。

宝藏

机器中的 @Item[xzW2AQzClc61ew9C]{黑玛瑙宝石} 可以相当容易地撬出。这样做会使装置失去作用，但这颗宝石价值 25 gp。

通往南方的楼梯向下通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.s64QwcHKFCGC7AR4]{C07}。

A large metal table fitted with leather straps and iron bands sits in the center of this room. A strange contraption that seems to be part spyglass and part mechanical drill sits near the head of the table. A sparkling black gemstone glitters in a metal framework built into this machine's side.

Encounter

Moderate 2

@Actor[k4fVLtVrgIEg9xij]{Bloodsiphon}

80 XP

One of Volluk's last creations remains here, a horrific undead guardian created from a giant leech. Volluk called the creature the "bloodsiphon" and was amused at how shriveled the thing became. The bloodsiphon appears to be a giant log of desiccated flesh until anyone disturbs or approaches it, at which point it lurches forth and attacks. It pursues foes into areas B1 to B4 but not beyond.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

The machine in this room is a sadistic device Volluk crafted ages ago. With a successful @Check[type:occultism|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism} or @Check[type:religion|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Religion} check to Recall Knowledge, a hero determines that the device aids in casting the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} ritual (this doesn't provide knowledge of that ritual). The drilling device penetrates the skull of a restrained victim, while the scope focuses the ritual's necromantic energies. Using this machine grants a +2 item bonus to skill checks to cast create undead.

Treasure

The @Item[xzW2AQzClc61ew9C]{Black Onyx Gemstone} in the machine can be pried out easily enough. Doing so renders the device useless, but the gem is worth 25 gp.

The stairs to the south lead down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.s64QwcHKFCGC7AR4]{C07}.

B06. Abandoned Guard Post.name: B06. 废弃的警卫室 B06. Abandoned Guard Post
B06. Abandoned Guard Post.text:
在这间除此之外空无一物的房间里，东墙边摆着三把朴素的木椅。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

贝科拉的走狗曾在此等候，以执行她可能需要的任何差事。从房间这一侧很容易发现通往东边、通向区域 @UUID[.jLBqZVP4Avhb2FXG]{B21} 的暗门，因为中间那把椅子斜靠在一段墙面上，而那段墙面会略微向外转动。英雄们可以通过成功进行一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:12|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定来发现这道暗门，或者移动中间那把椅子。

北门外的楼梯向上通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.yGP5XjaIq9ix9ac7]{A12}。

Three plain wooden chairs sit along the east wall of this otherwise empty room.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Belcorra’s lackeys once waited here to perform any tasks she might need. The secret door to the east that leads to area @UUID[.jLBqZVP4Avhb2FXG]{B21} is easy to discover from this side of the room, as the middle chair leans against a section of the wall that pivots slightly outward. The heroes can discover this secret door by succeeding at a @Check[type:perception|dc:12|traits:action:search]{Perception} check or by moving the middle chair.

Stairs beyond the north door lead up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.yGP5XjaIq9ix9ac7]{A12}.

B07. Meeting Room.name: B07. 会议室 B07. Meeting Room
B07. Meeting Room.text:
一张长木桌摆在这间房间的中央，周围环绕着几把木椅。只有北边那把椅子看起来格外舒适，尽管其开裂的皮革软垫大多已经腐坏。

贝科拉曾在这里向她的侍从人员训话。然而，几十年来一直没人来过这间房间；螨精和摩洛克都不知道它的存在。因此，这间房间（以及区域 @UUID[.MY61uS4Lk2va9xoZ]{B06}）可作为一个安全的地方用来躲藏或休息。

通往区域 @UUID[.CLm67CNpT0gNtor0]{B08} 的暗门从北侧看非常明显；任何从北侧接近这道暗门的人都会自动发现它。

A long wooden table sits in the center of this room, surrounded by several wooden chairs. Only the chair to the north seems particularly comfortable, although its cracked leather padding is mostly decayed.

Belcorra addressed her serving staff here. No one has been in this room in decades, though; neither the mitflits nor the morlocks know about it. This room (and area @UUID[.MY61uS4Lk2va9xoZ]{B06}) thus serves as a safe place to hide or rest.

The secret door leading to area @UUID[.CLm67CNpT0gNtor0]{B08} is obvious from the north side; anyone approaching this secret door from the north automatically spots it.

B08. Servants’ Rooms.name: B08. 仆人房间 B08. Servants’ Rooms
B08. Servants’ Rooms.text:
这个巨大的开阔区域肮脏不堪，甚至比南侧的坍塌更甚——那处坍塌用瓦砾堵住了房间的一部分。半吃剩的鱼、猫那么大的甲虫，以及些许水禽残骸散落一地，与更大型生物被啃咬过的骨头纠缠在一起。

这个大房间曾作为仆人们放松与用餐的公共区域。房间南半部（连同仆人的厕所与沐浴设施）在很久以前就被瓦砾掩埋。南侧坍塌的楼梯井曾通往上方的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.g363pURldvDgwmoc]{A08}。与该区域相连的八个未标记房间都是被毁坏的卧室，没有任何值得注意之处。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

在该区域进行搜索的英雄，若成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，便可发现通往北侧区域 @UUID[.BfcY0oh7YOtQeXzM]{B07} 的秘密门。拉动一个旧的墙壁烛台会使门打开。摩洛克至今尚未注意到它。

遭遇

严重 2

@Actor[KSFGGxU3qxYJzWpe]{摩洛克拾荒者（4）}

120 XP

幽灵女王的摩洛克在此处筑巢。英雄们第一次进入该区域时，有四名摩洛克拾荒者在场，正摆弄一架部分损毁的弩炮——他们把它拆成零件，从区域 @UUID[.jLBqZVP4Avhb2FXG]{B21} 拖了过来（那里它曾作为一个陷阱）。若被打断，摩洛克会咆哮嘶嘶作响，并战斗到只剩一名仍站着为止。幸存的摩洛克随后会试图逃往区域 @UUID[.38sQJNsnOb2GTdn5]{B12}，去警告他们的国王格劳格斯特。

This large open area is a filthy mess, even beyond the collapse to the south that clogs part of the room with rubble. Half-eaten fish, cat-sized beetles, and bits of waterfowl lie strewn about in a tangle amid gnawed bones of larger creatures.

This large room once served as a common area for servants to relax and take their meals. The southern half of the room (along with the servants’ toilets and bathing facilities) were buried under rubble long ago. The collapsed stairwell to the south once led to area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.g363pURldvDgwmoc]{A08} above. The eight unmarked rooms connecting to this area are ruined bedrooms with nothing of interest.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A hero Searching this area can discover the secret door leading north to area @UUID[.BfcY0oh7YOtQeXzM]{B07} with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. Pulling an old wall sconce causes the door to open. None of the morlocks have yet noticed it.

Encounter

Severe 2

@Actor[KSFGGxU3qxYJzWpe]{Morlock Scavengers (4)}

120 XP

The Ghost Queen morlocks lair here. The first time the heroes enter this area, four morlock scavengers are present, fiddling with a partially ruined ballista that they dragged, in pieces, from area @UUID[.jLBqZVP4Avhb2FXG]{B21} (where it once served as a trap). The morlocks snarl and hiss if theyre interrupted, fighting until only one of them is left standing. The surviving morlock then tries to flee to area @UUID[.38sQJNsnOb2GTdn5]{B12} to warn their king, Graulgust.

B09. Old Office.name: B09. 旧办公室 B09. Old Office
B09. Old Office.text:
一张带椅子的书桌位于这间房间的中央，墙上挂着三个空相框。

贝科拉的总管曾在这里工作。这些相框曾经装着上层地下城各等级的详细地图。沃鲁克很久以前就把它们拿走了。

遭遇

中等 2

@Actor[DYBZniwR1Ip4inVr]{摩洛克（2）}

80 XP

格劳格斯特命令一对幽灵女王的摩洛克守卫这间房间，但它们对捣鼓总管留下的损坏发条助手更感兴趣。它们的分心使其先攻检定承受-2减值。它们会与任何闯入者战斗，并在可能时对敌人进行夹击。

如果一名从@UUID[.CLm67CNpT0gNtor0]{区域 B08}逃跑的摩洛克拾荒者穿过此房间，这些摩洛克会转移到@UUID[.MT1JRD5WLtzSsUIv]{区域 B10}以构筑防线。

宝藏

@Item[3vlzBbKDkwV5Jpiu]{精巧齿轮}

摩洛克已将发条助手的内部构造暴露出来，其中包括一个价值40 gp的精巧齿轮。在保持其价值的同时取出齿轮需要一次成功的@Check[type:crafting|dc:16]{制作}检定。若为失败，齿轮仅价值20 gp；若为大失败，齿轮会损坏且一文不值。

A desk with a chair sits in the middle of this room, while three empty picture frames hang on the walls.

Belcorra's majordomo once worked here. The frames used to hold detailed maps of the upper dungeon levels. Volluk took them long ago.

Encounter

Moderate 2

@Actor[DYBZniwR1Ip4inVr]{Morlocks (2)}

80 XP

Graulgust commanded a pair of Ghost Queen morlocks to guard this room, but they're more interested in tinkering with the broken clockwork assistant the majordomo left behind. Their distraction gives them a -2 penalty to initiative checks. They fight any intruders, flanking foes when possible.

If a morlock scavenger fleeing from @UUID[.CLm67CNpT0gNtor0]{Area B08} runs through the room, these morlocks relocate to @UUID[.MT1JRD5WLtzSsUIv]{Area B10} to mount a defense.

Treasure

@Item[3vlzBbKDkwV5Jpiu]{Intricate Gear}

The morlocks have exposed the clockwork assistant’s inner workings, which include an intricate gear worth 40 gp. Removing the gear while preserving its value requires a successful @Check[type:crafting|dc:16]{Crafting} check. On a failure, the gear is worth only 20 gp; on a critical failure, the gear breaks and is worth nothing.

B10. Trapped Hall.name: B10. 陷阱大厅 B10. Trapped Hall
B10. Trapped Hall.text:
这条走廊的北墙和南墙装饰着令人眼花缭乱的一堆木材、金属零件、道具、齿轮、破损武器的碎片和垃圾。

贝科拉的总管曾将这间房间用于筹划与会议，但摩洛克已将这里的家具连同数件其他拾荒来的物品与装置一起拆解，搭建出一套陷阱长廊，用以防御通往他们国王王座室的通道。

危害

@Actor[6NijRSpkIuQpSxUp]{尖钉发射器（4）}

16 XP

这间房的墙壁中藏有4个尖钉发射器陷阱，由几乎隐形、离地1英尺、横跨房间的绊线触发。摩洛克知道绊线的位置，因此能在房间里移动而不触发尖钉发射器。每条绳线横跨一对自北向南的方格。

The north and south walls of this hall have been decorated with a bewildering array of timbers, metal parts, gears, bits of broken weapons, and trash.

Belcorra’s majordomo used this room for planning and meetings, but the morlocks have dismantled the furniture here, along with several other scavenged items and devices, to build a gauntlet of traps to defend the approach to their king's throne room.

Hazards

@Actor[6NijRSpkIuQpSxUp]{Spike Launchers (4)}

16 XP

Four spike launcher traps have been hidden in the walls of this room, activated by nearly invisible trip lines stretching across the room 1 foot off the ground. Morlocks can move through the room without triggering the spike launchers, as they know where the trip lines are. One cord crosses each pair of north-to-south squares.

B11. Washroom.name: B11. 洗手间 B11. Washroom
B11. Washroom.text:
这间洗手间的一面墙被锋利的爪子刨开，露出一条粗凿的隧道，通向西方。

这里曾是总管的洗手间。通往区域 @UUID[.VssoL9XVUnDo49OF]{B13} 的隧道起初是一道侵蚀形成的裂缝，随后被摩洛克扩宽。

One wall of this washroom has been gouged out by sharp claws, revealing a rough-hewn tunnel leading west.

This once served as the majordomo’s washroom. The tunnel to area @UUID[.VssoL9XVUnDo49OF]{B13} began as an eroding crack, then was widened by the morlocks.

B12. Graulgust’s Throne Room.name: B12. 格劳格斯特的王座厅 B12. Graulgust’s Throne Room
B12. Graulgust’s Throne Room.text:
这间房间北侧摆着一张类似沙发的王座，由一张旧床垫、几件重新拼装的家具以及数十根骨头拼成，横陈其上。南侧一条狭窄隧道里有一股细细的泥水涓流淌出，在房间中央汇成一滩水洼。

格劳格斯特，这位自封为幽灵女王摩洛克之王的家伙，把管家的旧卧室选作自己的王座厅。他将此区域里较旧的家具重建并拼成一座巨大的“王座”，并且时时刻刻都有一名摩洛克仆从侍奉，负责替格劳格斯特磨尖手指甲和脚趾甲、揉脚、喂他吃蠕虫，或做任何格劳格斯特要求的事。格劳格斯特偶尔会离开王座厅，巡逻幽灵女王的领地，并查看幽灵女王的圣龛（区域 @UUID[.xx0EOST0kN62qFg3]{B14}），但英雄们第一次造访地城时，会在这里遭遇他。

遭遇

严重 2

@Actor[lH2rdwiyOPStkQvZ]{Graulgust} @Actor[DYBZniwR1Ip4inVr]{Morlock}

120 XP

格劳格斯特自诩为见多识广的外交家，但由于他只会说邪灵语与地底通用语，与英雄们沟通可能很困难。若他无法建立沟通，格劳格斯特会恼怒起来，并派他的摩洛克仆从去与英雄们战斗。只有当仆从被杀，或他本人遭到直接攻击时，格劳格斯特才会加入战斗。若他的生命值降至30点，他会花费一个动作嚎叫，呼唤他在区域 @UUID[.VssoL9XVUnDo49OF]{B13} 的宠物胶化人。若那只滑行的怪物仍然活着，它会尽快通过通往西南的隧道前来援助主人。

当格劳格斯特被杀时，任何在场的摩洛克会获得 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑（状态）} 状态，持续1轮，并且成为 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐惧 3}。

支线任务

若他能与英雄们沟通，格劳格斯特会祝贺他们英勇无畏地前来寻他，并给他们一个选择——他们可以成为幽灵女王的祭品（此时他会指示他的摩洛克仆从杀死他们）；或他们可以通过杀死栖居在附近区域 @UUID[.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{B19} 的“水怪物”，并带回它的头来证明自己对幽灵女王的价值。

水怪物

若英雄们同意，格劳格斯特只允许他们通过通往区域 @UUID[.gKSMPRQZHVWaoL4d]{B18} 的隧道离开房间；并且若下次他们遭遇格劳格斯特时没有带着河栖龙兽的头作为功绩证明，他会因他们的失败立刻攻击英雄们。若英雄们带着河栖龙兽的头回来，格劳格斯特会欣喜若狂，因为摩洛克们如今有了一条轻松离开地城去觅食的通道。

他会以“幽灵女王的走狗”这一头衔作为奖励，并带领英雄们在幽灵女王领地里散步（穿过区域B10、B9、B8、B14、B21与B22）。当他与英雄们抵达区域 @UUID[.3prWqGPJfXW7MXX2]{B22} 后，他会给他们一个新选择——交出他们的道具并成为幽灵女王真正的奴隶（并被囚禁在区域 @UUID[.NyCn35Bdz6gaubNu]{B24}），或为他对溃烂教发起一场十字军——那是一群必须为了幽灵女王的荣耀而被屠戮的“异端食尸鬼”。

异端食尸鬼

若英雄们同意，格劳格斯特会命令他们通过区域 @UUID[.eAD9hbPpzj5aLBZY]{B16} 下到楼下，并命令他们在所有食尸鬼都被杀死前不得返回。

若英雄们照做了，格劳格斯特会意识到他们过于强大，无法简单处理掉；他会将他们命名为“幽灵女王的传教士”，并命令他们离开摩洛克区域，永远不要回来。

格劳格斯特所知之事

若英雄们与他合作，他们便能与格劳格斯特交谈，并进一步了解憎恨魔窟。摩洛克们尚未探索此等级的北部区域，但他可以告知英雄们通往区域 @UUID[.kdk3tW3OgViz0cw5]{B15} 的暗门，并提供一张涂鸦般的三层地图（包括区域C1、C6、C10、C11、C15与C33）。若被问及更深的等级，格劳格斯特会沉默不语，只说：“你们来自地表，不配知晓我们的故土。”由你决定，若英雄们使用精神控制或其他胁迫手段，他们或许能逼迫格劳格斯特透露更多关于憎恨魔窟更深等级的信息，但请注意：摩洛克们在贝科拉的归来之前就离开那里一段时间了，而自那之后已经发生了许多变化。

格劳格斯特从不在口中直呼幽灵女王之名；若英雄们在他面前说出“贝科拉”这个名字，他会愤怒尖叫，并警告英雄们永远别再说出她的名字。若他们再这样做，他就会攻击。

一旦英雄们获得格劳格斯特的信任，若他们突然反戈，摩洛克秘术师会大为震惊。若英雄们在他认为他们正为他效力之后的任何时候攻击格劳格斯特，他会获得 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}，持续2轮，因为他正在艰难接受自己已无法再命令他人服从这一事实。

A sofa-like throne made of an old mattress, several pieces of reconstructed furniture, and dozens of bones sprawls along the northern side of this room. A narrow rivulet of muddy water trickles from a narrow tunnel to the south and forms a puddle in the room's center.

Graulgust, the self-styled king of the Ghost Queen morlocks, has chosen the majordomo's old bedroom as his throne room. He has rebuilt the older furniture in this area into an immense throne of sorts, and he's attended at all times by a morlock servant tasked with sharpening Graulgust's fingernails and toenails, rubbing his feet, feeding him worms, or whatever else Graulgust demands. Now and then, Graulgust leaves his throne room to patrol the Ghost Queen's domain and to check up on the Ghost Queen's shrine (area @UUID[.xx0EOST0kN62qFg3]{B14}), but the first time the heroes visit the dungeon, they encounter him here.

Encounter

Severe 2

@Actor[lH2rdwiyOPStkQvZ]{Graulgust} @Actor[DYBZniwR1Ip4inVr]{Morlock}

120 XP

Graulgust fancies himself something of a worldly diplomat, but since he speaks only Aklo and Undercommon, communication with the heroes might be difficult. If he can't establish communication, Graulgust grows annoyed and sends his morlock servant to fight the heroes. Graulgust steps into the fight only once his servant is slain or if he's attacked directly. If he's reduced to 30 Hit Points, he spends an action to howl for his pet grothlut in area @UUID[.VssoL9XVUnDo49OF]{B13}. If the slithering monster still lives, it comes to its master's aid as soon as it can through the tunnel to the southwest.

Any morlocks present when Graulgust is slain gain the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition for 1 round and are @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Side Quest

If he can communicate with the heroes, Graulgust congratulates them for their bravery in seeking him out and gives them a choice—they can become sacrifices for the Ghost Queen (in which case he directs his morlock servants to kill them), or they can prove their worth to the Ghost Queen by slaying the “water monster” that dwells nearby in area @UUID[.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{B19} and bringing back her head.

The Water Monster

If the heroes agree, Graulgust allows them to leave the room only via the tunnel to area @UUID[.gKSMPRQZHVWaoL4d]{B18}, and if they don’t have the river drake’s head with them as proof of their deed the next time they encounter Graulgust, he attacks the heroes at once for their failure. If the heroes return with the river drake’s head, Graulgust is delighted that the morlocks now have an easy way out of the dungeon to go foraging.

He rewards the heroes by giving them the title of “lackeys of the Ghost Queen” and leads them on a stroll through Ghost Queen territory (through areas B10, B9, B8, B14, B21, and B22). Once he and the heroes reach area @UUID[.3prWqGPJfXW7MXX2]{B22}, he offers them a new choice—surrender their gear and become true slaves of the Ghost Queen (and be imprisoned in area @UUID[.NyCn35Bdz6gaubNu]{B24}) or begin a crusade for him against the Cult of the Canker—a group of “heretic ghouls” who must be slaughtered for the glory of the Ghost Queen. 

The Heretic Ghouls

If the heroes agree to this, Graulgust sends them downstairs through area @UUID[.eAD9hbPpzj5aLBZY]{B16} with a command to not return until all of the ghouls are slain.

If the heroes do so, Graulgust realizes they’re too powerful to simply dispose of; he names them “missionaries of the Ghost Queen” and commands them to leave the morlock areas and never return.

What Graulgust Knows

If they work with him, the heroes can speak to Graulgust and learn a bit more about the Abomination Vaults. The morlocks haven’t explored the northern part of this level, but he can inform the heroes of the secret door to area @UUID[.kdk3tW3OgViz0cw5]{B15} and provide a scribbled map of level three (including areas C1, C6, C10, C11, C15, and C33). If asked about deeper levels, Graulgust grows silent, saying “You are of the surface and do not deserve to know of our homeland.” At your discretion, if the heroes use mind control or other coercive methods, they might force Graulgust to divulge more information about deeper levels of the Abomination Vaults, but note that the morlocks left them a while ago and much has changed since Belcorra’s return.

Graulgust never speaks the Ghost Queen’s name aloud, and if the heroes speak the name “Belcorra” in his presence, he shrieks in anger and warns the heroes never to say her name again. If they do so, he attacks.

Once the heroes have secured Graulgust’s trust, the morlock occultist is shocked if they suddenly turn against him. If the heroes attack Graulgust at any point after he believes they’re working for him, he’s @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 2 rounds, as he grapples with the fact that he no longer commands obedience.

B13. Grothlut Den.name: B13. 胶化人巢穴 B13. Grothlut Den
B13. Grothlut Den.text:
水滴顺着这座洞窟的墙壁淌下，尤其是在南侧一丛杂乱下垂的苍白根须附近更为明显。根须下方是一处巨大、湿透的泥与骨巢。

遭遇

低威胁 2

@Actor[K9Hw43co8fhwmKkM]{胶化人}

60 XP

这座洞窟是多年侵蚀的结果，而其潮湿、带泥土气息的环境，使其成为摩洛克近期收养的宠物——一只胶化人塑肉体——的完美栖身地。格劳格斯特从憎恨魔窟更深处的一只笼子里救出了这只胶化人，而这头异怪对这名摩洛克的宠爱，就像一条忠犬爱戴它的主人一样。它会攻击任何进入此洞（格劳格斯特除外）的人，并战斗至死。

Water drips down the walls of this cavern, particularly along a jumble of dangling pallid roots to the south. Beneath them is a large, soggy nest of mud and bones.

Encounter

Low 2

@Actor[K9Hw43co8fhwmKkM]{Grothlut}

60 XP

This cavern is the result of years of erosion, and its damp, earthy environs make it a perfect home for the morlocks' recently acquired pet, a grothlut fleshwarp. Graulgust rescued the grothlut from a cage deeper in the Abomination Vaults, and the aberration dotes on the morlock the way a loyal dog adores its master. It attacks anyone who enters this cave other than Graulgust, fighting to the death.

B14. Shrine of the Ghost Queen.name: B14. 幽灵女王的圣坛 B14. Shrine of the Ghost Queen
B14. Shrine of the Ghost Queen.text:
虽然很明显这个大房间最初是厨房，但其中的陈设已被重建并重新摆放，以创造一个临时的圣龛。大厅西端原本有一座用于烹饪食物的大壁炉，如今则充当某种祭坛。一具人类尸体上方耸立着一尊高大的女性形态骨雕像，上面覆着成片腐朽的布料与垂挂的苔藓。房间北墙上一处裸露的斑点被泥与血装饰，描绘出与雕像相同的女性形象。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查行动}

圣龛

幽灵女王的摩洛克建造了这座圣龛以敬奉贝科拉，但由于摩洛克既敬畏她又同样惧怕这位幽灵（特征），他们很少进入此处，只会偶尔前来献上祭品——最近一次的祭品就是骗子之角的一名盗贼。

在调查这座圣龛时，若有英雄在一次 @Check[type:religion|dc:15|traits:action:investigate]{宗教} 检定中成功，便会推断这里崇拜的“神明”并非广为人知的女神，而暗门上方墙面的血腥涂鸦很可能意在描绘对该教团而言至关重要的人物。若英雄们见过贝科拉的图像，例如区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.OYCvTEvFFpv8zEql]{A22} 中的那幅画像，他们会认出这尊雕像是对同一名女子的粗糙描绘。

失踪的盗贼

尸体是一名人类男子，右肩上有鸟类纹身，表明他是鱼鹰俱乐部的成员（若以一次成功的 @Check[type:society|dc:16|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} 检定来进行回忆知识，英雄会辨认出该标记象征着盗贼公会的成员身份）。

暗门

北墙上的暗门比该区域内大多数暗门更容易找到：英雄检查那粗陋的彩绘装饰时，只需一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:18]{察觉} 检定便能注意到它。摩洛克在抵达不久后就发现了这扇门，但他们曾有一次打开门往里窥探，却被门内的幽影吓退。他们相信这扇暗门通向对幽灵女王而言神圣之地。他们装饰了暗门所在的墙面以安抚其庇护者，此后再也没有打开过。

宝藏

@Actor[Kc0uVS1nGVUJLIU8]{Shrine Offerings}

摩洛克在雕像底座周围散放了几件有价值的供物，包括一块价值 10 gp 的血石、一枚柔和发光的 +1 武器潜力符文，以及一颗病态绿色的恐惧宝石。

While it’s apparent that this large room was originally a kitchen, the furnishings have been rebuilt and repositioned to create an improvised shrine. The western end of the hall, where a large fireplace for cooking food once stood, now serves as an altar of sorts. Looming over a human corpse is a towering statue in a feminine shape made of bones, covered in sheets of moldering cloth and hanging moss. A bare spot on the room’s north wall has been decorated with mud and blood to depict the same feminine form as the statue.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

The Shrine

The Ghost Queen morlocks erected this shrine to honor Belcorra, but as the morlocks fear the ghost as much as they revere her, they only rarely enter to provide periodic sacrifices- the latest of which was one of the thieves from Crook's Nook.

A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:religion|dc:15|traits:action:investigate]{Religion} check when Investigating this shrine surmises that the “divinity” worshipped here isn’t a well-known goddess, but that the bloody scrawl on the wall over the secret door is likely meant to illustrate someone of importance to the cult. If the heroes have seen an image of Belcorra, such as the painting in area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.OYCvTEvFFpv8zEql]{A22}, they recognize the statue as a crude depiction of the same woman.

Lost Thief

The body is that of a human man with a bird tattoo on his right shoulder that marks him as a member of the Osprey Club (with a successful @Check[type:society|dc:16|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} check to Recall Knowledge, a hero identifies the mark as signifying membership in the thieves’ guild).

Secret Door

The secret door in the northern wall is easier to find than most of those in the area, and it takes only a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:18]{Perception} check for a hero examining the crudely painted decoration to notice it. The morlocks discovered this door shortly after they arrived, but the one time they opened it to look inside, they were scared off by the shadow within. They believe this secret door leads to a place sacred to the Ghost Queen. They decorated the wall where the secret door is located to placate their patron and haven’t opened it since.

Treasure

@Actor[Kc0uVS1nGVUJLIU8]{Shrine Offerings}

The morlocks have left a few valuable offerings strewn around the base of the statue, including a bloodstone worth 10 gp, a softly glowing +1 weapon potency rune, and a sickly green fear gem.

B15. Crypt.name: B15. 地穴 B15. Crypt
B15. Crypt.text:
这条五尺宽的走廊两侧各有三个壁龛。每个壁龛内都竖立着石制石棺。

贝科拉曾计划将她最喜欢的追随者安葬在这座小墓室中。由于她标准极高且难以取悦，最终只有一名仆从获得了葬于此处的荣誉——她的第一任总管。

遭遇

中等 2

@Actor[XrmHgbKgcHDi4OnK]{Majordomo}

80 XP

如今，这位总管以类似幽影的不死生物形态存在，保留着她生前的外貌，但除此之外其运作方式如同标准幽影。她的灵魂被她对贝科拉的忠诚与凄凉灯塔的死灵能量所束缚。总管会从西侧墙面中央的石棺中现身，攻击任何进入这座墓室的人，但她不会追击敌人离开这间房。

This five-foot-wide hallway features three alcoves along each side. Stone sarcophagi stand upright within each.

Belcorra planned to inter her favorite followers in this small crypt. Due to her high standards and hard-to-please nature, only one servant ever had the honor of being buried here—her first majordomo.

Encounter

Moderate 2

@Actor[XrmHgbKgcHDi4OnK]{Majordomo}

80 XP

Today, the majordomo exists as a shadow-like undead who retains her appearance from life but otherwise functions as a standard shadow. Her soul is bound by her loyalty to Belcorra and Gauntlight’s necromantic energies. The majordomo emerges from the central sarcophagus on the west wall to attack anyone entering this crypt, but it doesn’t pursue foes beyond this room.

B16. Pantry.name: B16. 储藏室 B16. Pantry
B16. Pantry.text:
曾经沿着这间储藏室墙壁排列的架子，如今只剩下少许碎片。

摩洛克最初就是通过这间房间进入地城第二等级的。曾经存放在这里的大部分道具和架子都被搜刮去用于其他工程（最显著的是格劳格斯特的王座）。

东北门外的楼梯向下通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.F229BVFENz1ZjmG1]{C01}。

Only a few fragments of the shelving that once lined the walls of this pantry remain today.

The morlocks first entered the dungeon’s second level through this room. Most of the gear and shelving once stored here has been scavenged for other projects (most notably Graulgust’s throne).

The stairs beyond the northeastern door lead down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.F229BVFENz1ZjmG1]{C01}.

B17. Level 2 Portal Chamber.name: B17。等级 2 传送门厅室 B17. Level 2 Portal Chamber
B17. Level 2 Portal Chamber.text:
传送网络

憎恨魔窟中的部分@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{传送法阵}构成了更大型网络的一部分。通过描摹墙上符文的特定图案，某人可以将这些房间中任意一个房间内的所有人传送到憎恨魔窟内另外九个传送门房间之一——前提是出发房间与目的地房间中的传送法阵都已通过@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{唤醒传送门}仪式唤醒（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}）。

这九个房间分别为区域@UUID[.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}、@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}、@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}、@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}、@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}、@UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}以及@UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

此房间的门已上锁，其钥匙早已遗失。英雄可以通过一次成功的@Check[type:athletics|dc:20|traits:action:force-open]{运动}检定来@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{破拆}，或通过三次成功的@Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗贼}检定来@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{开锁}。

这间八角形房室的墙壁上装饰着雕刻于石中、再以暗淡银色金属填充的盘旋符文。地面被打磨得光滑如镜，天花板也同样光洁，位于上方十尺处。

憎恨魔窟规模庞大，而贝科拉有时认为用常规方式穿行其中太过耗时，尤其是当她赶时间时。因此她在憎恨魔窟各处安装了传送法阵，既用于定向旅行，也用于更便捷的一般传送。随着时间推移，贝科拉的传送法阵所蕴含的魔法已逐渐衰退。

每个相互连接的传送法阵都必须先分别以唤醒传送门仪式单独重新启动后才能使用，因此英雄必须亲自旅行到一对相连传送门的两侧分别将其唤醒。较小的传送法阵（如区域@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.koVFvK0xxQMwKjaW]{A04}与@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.VZPc5GsIN5eRKSVE]{C05}中的那些）每个只连接到一个区域，但这个中转房间则连接到数个其他房间，如右侧所述。对于该网络，英雄可以在发现传送门时就将其唤醒，但已唤醒的传送门只会连接到网络中那些英雄此前已经唤醒过的其他传送门。

寻找仪式

唤醒传送门仪式记载在贝科拉的绝密藏书中的一本对开册里（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}），但木乃伊（特征）仪式师查夫肯姆（位于区域@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}）也懂得此仪式，因此英雄也可能从他那里学到。

XP奖励

英雄重新启动该传送门时，给予他们30 XP。

Teleportation Network

Some of the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} within the Abomination Vaults form a part of a larger network. By tracing specific patterns on the wall runes, someone could transport everyone in any one of these chambers to one of nine other portal chambers in the Abomination Vaults- so long as the teleportation circles in both the departure chamber and destination have been awakened by the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal} ritual (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}).

The nine chambers are areas @UUID[.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}, @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}, @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}, @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}, @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}, @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

The door to this room is locked, and its key is long lost. A hero can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open} with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:20|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check or @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} with three successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks.

The walls of this octagonal chamber are adorned with swirling runes carved into the stone and then filled with dull, silvery metal. The floor is polished smooth, as is the ceiling ten feet above.

The Abomination Vaults are vast, and Belcorra sometimes considered them too large to traverse by normal means, particularly when she was in a hurry. She therefore installed teleportation circles throughout the Abomination Vaults, both for directed travel and for more convenient general transport. Over time, the magic of Belcorra's teleportation circles has faded.

Each linked teleportation circle must each be individually reactivated with the awaken portal ritual before they can be used, so the heroes must physically travel to each side of a linked pair of portals to awaken them. Smaller teleportation circles, like those at areas @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.koVFvK0xxQMwKjaW]{A04} and @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.VZPc5GsIN5eRKSVE]{C05}, link to only one area each, but this transit chamber was linked to several others, as described on the right. For this network, the heroes can awaken the portals as they find them, but the awakened portals only connect to others in the network that the heroes have previously awakened.

Finding the Ritual

The awaken portal ritual is recorded in a folio in Belcorra’s secure collection (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}), but the mummy ritualist Chafkhem (in area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}) knows it as well, so the heroes might learn it from him.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for reactivating this portal.

B18. Ruined Boat Launch.name: B18. 废弃的小艇码头 B18. Ruined Boat Launch
B18. Ruined Boat Launch.text:
在这处小洞穴的北端，一处潮湿、被水淹没的洞窟入口豁然张开。几艘破败的划艇成堆地躺在洞窟地面上，旁边散落着纠缠成团的绳索。天花板上还悬挂着滑轮系统的残余部件。

当贝科拉的仆从尚在此居住时，他们会使用这个区域，通过一套滑轮系统将补给从@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.D4ufIAvRT4oTGO07]{船屋}运来，并在此处与码头之间摆渡一座漂浮平台，但那套装置早在很久以前就已失修。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

在这处洞窟与北面的被水淹没洞窟之间的泥泞地面上，散落着数道被扰动的土壤痕迹，仿佛是某个大型蛇形生物移动时留下的。一名英雄若调查这些足迹，并在一次@Check[type:arcana|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{奥术学}检定中成功以回忆知识，便会意识到这些痕迹由一只龙兽留下（若大成功，该英雄会知道它是一只河栖龙兽）。

At the north end of this small cave, the mouth of a swampy, flooded cavern yawns. A few ruined rowboats lie in heaps on the floor of this cavern, strewn next to tangled coils of rope. Remnants of a pulley system hang from the ceiling.

When Belcorra’s servants lived, they used this area to move supplies from the @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.D4ufIAvRT4oTGO07]{Boathouse} using a pulley system to ferry a floating platform between here and the pier, but that setup fell into disrepair long ago.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Several swaths of disturbed earth litter the muddy floor between this cavern and the flooded cavern to the north, as though left by the movement of a large, serpentine creature. A hero who Investigates the tracks and succeeds at a @Check[type:arcana|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Arcana} check to Recall Knowledge realizes they were left by a drake (on a critical success, the hero knows it’s a river drake).

B19. Flooded Cavern.name: B19. 被淹没的洞窟 B19. Flooded Cavern
B19. Flooded Cavern.text:
纠结的根须从这座被淹没洞窟的低矮天花板上垂下，洞顶离浑浊的水面仅有三尺高。

白天时，黯淡的阳光会从西北方向的一处出口滤入洞窟，但即便在罕见的晴天，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.zPMrDHV75TJzsGba]{A17} 上方伸出的码头与垂落的根须也让这间洞室保持昏暗。洞窟中的水平均深达10尺。

一只名为弗雷兹内尔凯什的河栖龙兽已在这座洞窟中栖居了将近两年。她谨慎地将狩猎范围限制在雾隐沼泽，因此奥塔里无人知道她的存在。骗子之角的盗贼们经过此地时，她正外出狩猎；但她不久后便返回，并切断了他们那条轻松的逃脱路线（最终导致他们被摩洛克捕获）。

遭遇

低2

@Actor[DX1xNtucLTenn3P3]{弗雷兹内尔凯什}

60 XP

弗雷兹内尔凯什很可能正睡在洞窟中央的水中；如果她听到上方有潜在食物游动溅起的水声，会迅速醒来。若其生命值降至10点以下，她会逃走，并在几天内不再返回。她会追击逃入区域B18或逃向沼泽的敌人，但她曾吃过区域B20危险霉菌的苦头，因此不会追入那里追逐潜在猎物。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

@Actor[S8VDmNHzkFEmjWfL]{龙兽的海箱}

这只河栖龙兽把她收集到的宝藏藏在西南侧尽头死胡同里一团纠结根须中的一只海箱里。在搜索时成功进行一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:16|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定，可在根须间找到该箱。龙兽的宝藏包括36 gp、一把复仇斧、一根魔法飞弹魔杖（1环），以及一枚寻路仪。

Tangles of roots hang from the low ceiling of this flooded cavern, the roof of which is a mere three feet above the murky water.

During the day, muted sunlight filters into this cavern from an exit to the northwest, but even on rare sunny days, the overhanging pier at area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.zPMrDHV75TJzsGba]{A17} and dangling roots keep this room dim. The water in the cavern is, on average, 10 feet deep.

A river drake named Freznelkesh has dwelt in this cavern for nearly two years. She's careful to limit her hunting to Fogfen, so no one in Otari knows she exists. She was out hunting when the Crook's Nook thieves came through, but she returned soon after and cut off their easy escape route (leading to their eventual capture by the morlocks).

Encounter

Low 2

@Actor[DX1xNtucLTenn3P3]{Freznelkesh}

60 XP

Freznelkesh is likely to be sleeping in the water in the middle of the cavern, and she swiftly wakes up if she hears the splashing of potential food swimming above. If reduced to fewer than 10 Hit Points, she flees and doesn't return for a few days. She pursues foes that flee into area B18 or out into the swamp, but she learned the hard way about the dangerous mold at area B20 and won't pursue potential prey there.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

@Actor[S8VDmNHzkFEmjWfL]{Drake's Sea Chest}

The river drake stashes what treasure she has gathered in a sea chest amid a tangle of roots in the southwestern cul-de-sac. A successful @Check[type:perception|dc:16|traits:action:search]{Perception} while Searching finds the chest amid the roots. The drake’s treasure consists of 36 gp, a retribution axe, a wand of magic missile (1st), and a wayfinder.

B20. Moldy Beach.name: B20. 长霉的海滩 B20. Moldy Beach
B20. Moldy Beach.text:
一大团粗壮盘结的根须从洞窟穹顶垂下，悬在一处泥泞的滩地上方。石阶从滩地向北延伸而上。

危害

@Actor[Q8bXKgDm8eguqThB]{褐霉菌}

8 XP

楼梯底部正南方的方格处在地图上以危害指示物标注，看起来只是一堆发霉的根须，但其实是褐霉菌。

A thick knot of roots hangs from the cavern roof over a muddy beach. Stone stairs lead up from the beach to the north.

Hazard

@Actor[Q8bXKgDm8eguqThB]{Brown Mold}

8 XP

The square just south of the bottom of the stairs, marked with a hazard token on the map, appears to contain only moldy roots but is brown mold.

B21: Processional.name: B21：游行 B21: Processional
B21: Processional.text:
这条狭长的走廊宽十英尺，拱形穹顶高达十二英尺。天花板上垂着三个破损的金属支架；一个在南侧，一个在北侧，还有一个在中央，但这些框架曾经固定着什么已难以分辨。地面散落着腐朽木片与扭曲的金属碎片。向北望去，紧闭门扇的门框周围闪烁着淡绿色光芒。

这些空框架曾在天花板上安装过小型、可旋转的弩炮，作为陷阱运作，但其组件已被摩洛克搜刮殆尽。如今只剩下摩洛克认为毫无价值的残渣。

门框透出的绿色光芒通往区域 @UUID[.BHmLYQVCwzBneNFu]{B28}，这是奥塔里不安之灵的迹象。摩洛克不会靠近这道光，因为他们相信那是幽灵女王震怒的征兆。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

通往区域 @UUID[.MY61uS4Lk2va9xoZ]{B06} 的暗门从这一侧几乎无从发现：其接缝在石墙上几乎只是些隐形的细裂纹。英雄在搜索这条走廊时，若成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，便会发现它。

This long, ten-foot-wide hallway has a vaulted ceiling arching to a dozen feet high. Three broken metal brackets hang from the ceiling; one to the south, one to the north, and one in the middle, although what the frames once held is unclear. The floor is strewn with pieces of rotten wood and twisted metal. To the north, pale green light shimmers around a closed door’s frame.

The empty frames used to house small, swiveling ballistas on the ceiling that functioned as traps, but morlocks have scavenged the components. Only detritus the morlocks deemed worthless remains.

The green light shining through the door frame to area @UUID[.BHmLYQVCwzBneNFu]{B28} is evidence of Otari’s unquiet spirit. The morlocks don’t approach this light, as they believe it to be a sign of the Ghost Queen’s wrath.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

The secret door leading to area @UUID[.MY61uS4Lk2va9xoZ]{B06} is exceptionally well hidden from this side, its seams all but invisible cracks in the stone. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{Perception} check while Searching this hall spots it.

B22. Workshop.name: B22. 工坊 B22. Workshop
B22. Workshop.text:
探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout}

在每位英雄进入这间房间之前，为其进行一次秘密 @Check[type:perception|dc:10]{察觉}，以听到金属叮当作响与木头碎裂的声音。若某位英雄在进入前特意聆听，则自动听到该声音。

这间长屋弥漫着铁锈与污垢的气味。沿着房间墙壁堆着一摞摞碎裂的家具、武器与护甲的零件、磨损的绳索线圈、参差锋利的金属碎片，以及其他杂物垃圾。一座冰冷、未点燃的锻炉坐落在西侧的壁龛里。北边，数根沉重的木梁被楔在一扇门前，以将其牢牢顶住。

遭遇

严重 2

@Actor[V73Oqm1EL1KOoXOl]{摩洛克工程师 (2)}

120 XP

两名幽灵女王的摩洛克工程师正忙于组装一对损坏的弩炮。尽管摩洛克具备重建这些装置的技能，但他们总会不断加入一些可疑的改良，导致不得不重新开始修理。工程师很快意识到，他们可以把闯入者献上，以平息格劳格斯特对其进度缓慢的恼怒。他们偏好尽可能长时间地在远处使用自己的垃圾发射器。

摩洛克会尽其所能活捉英雄；若成功，他们会没收英雄的道具，并把英雄与区域 @UUID[.NyCn35Bdz6gaubNu]{B24} 的盗贼关在一起，直到格劳格斯特告诉摩洛克该如何处置他们。格劳格斯特给英雄的提议描述于区域 @UUID[.38sQJNsnOb2GTdn5]{B12}。

世界状态

@Macro[aWZ3MUXFfN10sQVd]{B22 - Barricade}

移除阻挡通往区域 @UUID[.NyCn35Bdz6gaubNu]{B24} 之门的木梁，是一项足够简单的 3-轮行动。当你的玩家拆除障碍时，使用上方的宏！

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout}

Roll a secret @Check[type:perception|dc:10]{Perception} for each hero before they enter this room to hear the sound of metal clanging and wood splintering. A hero who specifically listens before entering automatically hears the sound.

This long room smells of rust and grime. Stacks of splintered furniture, pieces of weapons and armor, frayed coils of rope, jagged shards of metal, and other bits of trash lie in heaps along the walls of the room. A cold, unlit forge sits in an alcove to the west. To the north, several heavy timbers are wedged up against a door to keep it shut.

Encounter

Severe 2

@Actor[V73Oqm1EL1KOoXOl]{Morlock Engineers (2)}

120 XP

Two Ghost Queen morlock engineers toil at assembling a pair of broken ballistas. While the morlocks have the skill to rebuild the devices, they keep incorporating dubious improvements that require restarting their repairs. The engineers quickly realize they can present intruders to mollify Graulgust's frustration at their slow pace. They prefer to use their junk launchers from a distance for as long as they can.

The morlocks do their best to capture the heroes alive; if they do, they confiscate the heroes' gear and throw the heroes in with the thieves in area @UUID[.NyCn35Bdz6gaubNu]{B24} until Graulgust tells the morlocks what to do with them. Graulgust's offer to the heroes is described in area @UUID[.38sQJNsnOb2GTdn5]{B12}.

World State

@Macro[aWZ3MUXFfN10sQVd]{B22 - Barricade}

Removing the timbers from blocking the door to area @UUID[.NyCn35Bdz6gaubNu]{B24} is a simple-enough 3-round activity. Use the above macro when your players dismantle the obstacle!

B23. Well.name: B23。井 B23. Well
B23. Well.text:
这里的空气凉爽而潮湿。东边有一口低矮的石井。北边堆着成堆的护甲、武器和工具。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜寻}

这口井向下延伸40英尺，通往下方区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.2YRUhNAQ8UYfyHAU]{C40} 内一处天然蓄水池中的巨大水潭。任何人只要俯身探向井口，便可尝试一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:15]{察觉}检定，来聆听自下方飘上的奇怪声响——水花飞溅声与仿佛一小群人喧闹的声音交织在一起。这些噪音来自生活在下方的呓语之喉，但它始终不在任何向井下窥视之人的视野范围内。曾用于从下方提水的绳索和水桶早已不见踪影，但天花板上的金属支架足够坚固，可以作为锚点固定一根绳索以支撑英雄。

宝藏

@Actor[abNUVCJeb4uXcbS3]{道具堆}

这堆道具属于 @UUID[.NyCn35Bdz6gaubNu]{B24} 里的囚犯。它包含三套镶嵌皮甲、两把细剑、一把损坏的细剑、三套盗贼工具、一瓶次等治疗药水，以及13 gp。

The air here is cool and moist. A low stone well sits to the east. Armor, weapons, and tools lie in heaps in the north.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}

This well drops 40 feet down to a large pool of water in a natural reservoir in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.2YRUhNAQ8UYfyHAU]{C40} below. Anyone who leans over the well can attempt a @Check[type:perception|dc:15]{Perception} check to hear a strange sound drifting up from below- splashing combined with what sounds like a small crowd. These noises come from the gibbering mouther that lives below, but it remains out of sight of anyone peering down the well. The rope and bucket once used to draw water up from below are long gone, but the metal bracket in the ceiling is sufficiently strong to anchor a rope supporting the heroes.

Treasure

@Actor[abNUVCJeb4uXcbS3]{Heap of Gear}

The heap of gear belongs to the prisoners in @UUID[.NyCn35Bdz6gaubNu]{B24}. It consists of three suits of studded leather armor, two rapiers, one broken rapier, three sets of thieves' tools, a lesser healing potion, and 13 gp.

B24. Prison.name: B24. 牢房 B24. Prison
B24. Prison.text:
沿着墙壁的壁龛曾经可能是储藏室，但石制搁架全都空空如也。房间里散发着恶臭。

这股恶臭源于这个房间曾被用作牢房。在四名从骗子之角潜入地城的鱼鹰俱乐部盗贼中，只有三人幸存——@UUID[Actor.X5VrdEHl829hvoXU]{Gorul Vetters}、@UUID[Actor.p94aKz7KsiAQJscm]{Shad Nunder}和@UUID[Actor.9rDG1Sxs7pPaS6qM]{Ziskilly Theed}。

三人都衣衫褴褛，正遭受营养不良与恐惧(术)的折磨。每人右肩都有一只鸟的纹身，表明其属于@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.sdNti6BHkPTeO5fC]{鱼鹰俱乐部}（通过一次成功的@Check[type:society|dc:16|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society}检定来进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}，英雄便可辨认出该纹身的含义）。

若被问起，盗贼们会讲述他们作为摩洛克囚犯时那段骇人的经历，并渴望有人带他们离开地城。若提供，他们会感激地收下自己的道具（来自区域@UUID[.vKXFtG7SrIcibaif]{B23}），但他们真正只想回到奥塔里。若英雄带他们回到地表，盗贼们就能自行安全返回奥塔里；否则，他们很可能遭遇悲惨的命运。另一方面，伊娜斯梅拉会为他们的获救支付丰厚报酬；详情见区域@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.zPMrDHV75TJzsGba]{A17}中的支线任务。

Alcoves along the walls might once have been storerooms, but the stone shelves are all empty. The room smells foul.

The foul odor is due to the room’s use as a prison. Of the four Osprey thieves who stole into the dungeon from Crook’s Nook, only three survive—@UUID[Actor.X5VrdEHl829hvoXU]{Gorul Vetters}, @UUID[Actor.p94aKz7KsiAQJscm]{Shad Nunder}, and @UUID[Actor.9rDG1Sxs7pPaS6qM]{Ziskilly Theed}.

All three are clad in rags and are suffering from malnutrition and fear. Each bears a bird tattoo on the right shoulder that indicates membership in the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.sdNti6BHkPTeO5fC]{Osprey Club} (with a successful @Check[type:society|dc:16|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, a hero identifies the tattoo’s significance).

The thieves recount their harrowing time as the prisoners of the morlocks if asked and are eager to be led out of the dungeon. They thankfully accept their gear (from area @UUID[.vKXFtG7SrIcibaif]{B23}) if offered but really only want to return to Otari. If the heroes lead them up to the surface, the thieves can safely return to Otari on their own; otherwise, chances are good that a dire fate meets them. On the other hand, Yinyasmera pays well for their rescue; see the Side Quest in area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.zPMrDHV75TJzsGba]{A17} for details.

B25. Cleaning Supplies.name: B25. 清洁用品 B25. Cleaning Supplies
B25. Cleaning Supplies.text:
架子沿着这间房间的墙壁排列，上面摆满了用于清洁或修理工作的工具。一根银头手杖 леж在一堆拖把、扫帚和水桶的缠结之中。

@UUID[.sqvGeda8OYK1pIzj]{B27}区域内的魔鬼会调查此处的任何声响。

宝藏

@Item[9cxjVhJLmz0nnpFr]{低纯度银质剑杖}

这些工具都不算特别值钱，但只需匆匆一瞥就足以注意到它们都很干净，且处于良好状态。手杖藏着一把银质刀刃；它是一根低纯度银质剑杖。任何试图在未成功通过一次@Check[type:thievery|dc:16]{Thievery}检定的情况下移动它，都会导致其他工具哐啷作响地散落一地，堆成一团。

Shelves line the walls of this room, each filled with tools used for cleaning or repair work. A silver-headed cane lies amid a tangle of mops, brooms, and buckets.

The devil in area @UUID[.sqvGeda8OYK1pIzj]{B27} investigates any noise here.

Treasure

@Item[9cxjVhJLmz0nnpFr]{Low-Grade Silver Sword Cane}

None of these tools are particularly valuable, but even a brief glance is enough to note that they're all clean and in good condition. The cane hides a silver blade; it's a low-grade silver sword cane. Any attempt to move it without a successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:16]{Thievery} check causes the other tools to clatter noisily to the floor in a heap.

B26. Clockwork Storage.name: B26. 发条 储藏室 B26. Clockwork Storage
B26. Clockwork Storage.text:
一对魁梧的人形物体静静地立在这间房室中，每个都覆盖着厚厚一层尘土。

这两台发条助手曾经帮助维护这一等级，但如今都已损坏到毫无修复希望。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

在一次成功的 @Check[type:crafting|dc:18]{工艺} 或 @Check[type:perception|dc:18]{察觉} 检定后，一名英雄辨认出八颗 @Item[NoXxBALNaFXPDaju]{小型宝石}（每颗价值5 gp），它们在发条机构中用作轴承。

A pair of hulking humanoid objects stands quietly in this chamber, each covered in a thick layer of dust.

These two clockwork assistants once helped maintain this level, but both are now broken beyond any hope of repair.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

With a successful @Check[type:crafting|dc:18]{Crafting} or @Check[type:perception|dc:18]{Perception} check, a hero identifies eight @Item[NoXxBALNaFXPDaju]{Small Gemstones} worth 5 gp each used as bearings in the clockworks.

B27. Zozzlarin’s Room.name: B27. 佐兹拉林的房间 B27. Zozzlarin’s Room
B27. Zozzlarin’s Room.text:
这个房间的墙壁被涂画过，笔触粗糙，几乎像孩童的涂鸦一般，用来描绘一幅恐怖的地狱景象：燃烧的群山、生锈的城市，以及受折磨的灵魂。

贝科拉曾将数名被束缚的魔鬼作为爪牙与守卫使用，大多安置在憎恨魔窟的较低等级。她派往上层的两名魔鬼中，较弱的那位是一名名叫佐兹兹拉林的不走运的斥控魔。佐兹兹拉林是个胖乎乎、苍蝇般躯体的魔鬼，被束缚在这一层作为永恒的清洁工。按契约规定，佐兹兹拉林每天必须在这个房间里待满18小时；他尽力把墙壁涂画成这样，好让自己想起故乡。每天其余6小时，他会被强迫嗡嗡飞到周围的建筑群中清扫除尘。由于贝科拉残酷的幽默感，佐兹兹拉林还被要求在这6小时里至少有3小时要用舌头清理地城布满灰尘的墙壁与地面；但对这绝望的斥控魔而言，这种羞辱与他被迫在材料位面生活的时间远远超过原先交易所要求的期限相比，根本不算什么。

遭遇

低 2

@Actor[Vmmc8ZcyIAZJhA5t]{Zozzlarin}

60 XP

因此，挫败的佐兹兹拉林会迅速对英雄们发动攻击；他的囚禁条款允许他保护地城，抵御来自地表的入侵者。但如果他的生命值降至10或更少，这名魔鬼就会乞求饶命，并提出分享一段“特别的记忆”作为回报。

如果英雄们同意，斥控魔会使用他的“炼狱之眼”能力，揭示他在许多年前目睹的一件重大事件：奥塔里曾穿越地城，逃到区域 @UUID[.BHmLYQVCwzBneNFu]{B28} 躲藏。佐兹兹拉林并不知道这段记忆的重要性，但这是他对其他地表居民所拥有的最新记忆，因此他认为英雄们会感兴趣。一次成功的 @Check[type:society|dc:16|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{社交} 或相关学识检定，就足以让一名英雄认出那位著名的冒险者——人们原以为他在很久以前与贝科拉的冲突中已经丧生。

The walls of this room have been painted, crudely and almost childishly, to depict a horrific Hellscape of burning mountains, rusting cities, and tormented souls.

Belcorra used several bound devils as minions and guardians, mostly in lower levels of the Abomination Vaults. The lesser of the two devils she assigned to the upper levels is a hapless zebub named Zozzlarin. A chubby, fly-bodied devil, Zozzlarin is bound to this level as an eternal janitor. Zozzlarin is contractually required to spend 18 hours each day in this room, and he has done his best to paint the walls to remind him of home. For the other 6 hours each day, he’s compelled to buzz out into the surrounding complex to clean and dust. Thanks to Belcorra’s cruel sense of humor, Zozzlarin is required to spend at least 3 of those hours cleaning the dusty walls and floors of the dungeon with his tongue, but to the hopeless zebub, this indignity is nothing compared to the fact that he has been forced to live here on the Material Plane for much longer than his bargain originally required.

Encounter

Low 2

@Actor[Vmmc8ZcyIAZJhA5t]{Zozzlarin}

60 XP

The frustrated Zozzlarin is quick to attack the heroes as a result; the conditions of his imprisonment allow him to defend the dungeon from above-ground intruders. If reduced to 10 or fewer Hit Points, though, the devil begs for his life, offering to share a “special memory” as a reward.

If the heroes agree, the zebub uses his Infernal Eye ability to reveal a significant event he witnessed many years ago: Otari's flight through the dungeon to hide out in area @UUID[.BHmLYQVCwzBneNFu]{B28}. Zozzlarin doesn't know this memory's significance, but it's the most recent memory he has of other surface dwellers, so he assumes the heroes are interested. A successful @Check[type:society|dc:16|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} or relevant Lore check is enough for a hero to recognize the famous adventurer, who was thought to have been killed long ago in the clash against Belcorra.

B28. Haunted Washroom.name: B28. 闹鬼的洗手间 B28. Haunted Washroom
B28. Haunted Washroom.text:
这间十英尺见方的洗手间北侧有一只铁制浴缸，西南侧有一只便桶。北侧墙壁发光并闪烁着诡异绿色光亮的波纹丝带。

当奥塔里·伊瓦什提被困在憎恨魔窟时，他竭尽全力寻找一条逃脱路线。不幸的是，在那个时代，贝科拉的许多危险爪牙仍在守卫该等级的大部分区域。他只来得及到达这房间，便因伤势倒下。所幸贝科拉的死亡令地城陷入混乱，他没有被发现。奥塔里在一段时间后醒来，经历磨难后不再徘徊在死亡边缘；他蹑手蹑脚地离开房间，向西穿过区域 @UUID[.7Cs3QciAV15HwrG8]{B31}，最终抵达区域 @UUID[.FS4EnskC5S91c9RU]{B20}，却遭到一只愤怒且体型过大的甲伏怪的拦截。他在区域 @UUID[.8qZk6POeK6TgPon4]{B32} 发现了暗门，于是转而向更深处逃去。

当奥塔里最终死在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18} 时，他的灵魂以幽灵（特征）留存，而他在最后几日里躲藏过的三个地点被他灵体绝望的回响所浸染。这些回响为寻找他的遗骸提供了线索。

这些幽灵般的能量会对英雄的存在产生反应。英雄们第一次看到发光能量时，它会蜿蜒成字母，写道：“我是奥塔里……把我从下方拯救出来！”片刻之后，文字从墙上滑落，形成一条绿色的光亮丝带，像蛇一样以20英尺的速度沿地面蜿蜒而行。英雄们可以跟随这条丝带；它只持续数分钟，通向区域 @UUID[.8qZk6POeK6TgPon4]{B32}，在那里它从暗门下方滑入并淡化。奥塔里行进路线的下一条线索位于区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.LSGUFeDZHwsJMxev]{C03}。

该幽魂显现每天可出现一次。

This ten-foot-square washroom features an iron bathing tub to the north and a commode to the southwest. The northern wall glows and shimmers with rippling ribbons of eerie green light.

When Otari Ilvashti became trapped in the Abomination Vaults, he did his best to find an escape route. Unfortunately, at that time, many of Belcorra’s dangerous minions still guarded much of this level. He made it to this room only to collapse from his wounds. Fortunately, Belcorra’s death had thrown the dungeon into chaos, and he wasn’t discovered. When Otari woke some time later, no longer on the edge of death from his ordeal, he crept out of the room and made his way west through area @UUID[.7Cs3QciAV15HwrG8]{B31} and eventually to area @UUID[.FS4EnskC5S91c9RU]{B20}, only to be confronted by an angry and oversized chuul. He discovered the secret door in area @UUID[.8qZk6POeK6TgPon4]{B32} and fled deeper instead.

When Otari finally died in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}, his soul remained as a ghost, and the three locations where he hid during his final days became infused with desperate echoes of his spirit. These echoes provide a trail to his remains.

The ghostly energies react to the presence of the heroes. The first time the heroes see the glowing energy, it slithers into letters to read, “I was Otari... save me from below!” A moment later, the words slide off the wall and form a green ribbon of light that slithers across the floor like a serpent with a speed of 20 feet. The heroes can follow this ribbon, which lasts for only minutes, to area @UUID[.8qZk6POeK6TgPon4]{B32}, where it slips under the secret door and fades away. The next clue of Otari’s path is in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.LSGUFeDZHwsJMxev]{C03}.

This spectral manifestation can appear once per day.

B29. Hall of Hatred.name: B29. 憎恨走廊 B29. Hall of Hatred
B29. Hall of Hatred.text:
这条L形走廊的墙上装饰着数个宽大的壁龛。每个壁龛都包含同一座城市的小型立体景观，但面临着不同的灾祸——滔天大火、毁灭性的海啸、震耳欲聋的地震、遭到一只巨大的触手怪物的攻击，以及一支亡灵大军的入侵。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

壁龛中的每一幕都描绘了艾巴萨罗姆在贝科拉想象中某种异想天开的末日里走向毁灭的景象。这些石制立体景观以次级幻术加以强化；火焰闪动，水波荡漾，诸如此类。每一幕场景的边缘都有一座小小的凄凉灯塔，仿佛远在数英里之外。一名英雄在研究最后一个立体景观时若成功通过一次@Check[type:religion|dc:16]{宗教}检定，会注意到当凄凉之光射线照耀其上时，亡灵正从艾巴萨罗姆的坟墓中爬起。

危害

低阶2

@Actor[qjuLgWr2VhPcuylI]{未来的末日 (5)}

60 XP

除了展示她关于艾巴萨罗姆毁灭的一些幻想外，贝科拉还让沃鲁克在大厅里布置了数个陷阱来惩罚闯入者。每个立体景观都与一个陷阱相连。

Several wide alcoves adorn the walls of this L-shaped hallway. Each alcove contains a small diorama of the same city facing different perils—a massive fire, a devastating tsunami, a thunderous earthquake, an attack by an enormous tentacled monster, and an invasion of an army of undead.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Each of the scenes in the alcoves depict the city of Absalom in a different fanciful doom from Belcorra’s imagination. The stone dioramas are enhanced with minor illusions; flames flicker, water ripples, and so on. A tiny Gauntlight, as though miles distant, sits at the edge of each scene. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:religion|dc:16]{Religion} check while studying the last diorama notes that the undead are rising from Absalom’s graves as Gauntlight’s beam shines upon them.

Hazards

Low 2

@Actor[qjuLgWr2VhPcuylI]{Dooms of Tomorrow (5)}

60 XP

In addition to displaying some of her fantasies about Absalom’s destruction, Belcorra had Volluk rig several traps in the hall to punish intruders. One trap is linked to each diorama.

B30. War Room.name: B30. 作战大厅 B30. War Room
B30. War Room.text:
这间宽阔而天花板低矮的房间中央摆着一张十字形桌子。十号椅子环绕桌子而立。房间的墙壁、地面与天花板都被厚厚的蛛网术层层覆盖。

贝科拉曾在此与她最器重的顾问、爪牙以及召唤而来的盟友举行会议，通常用来筹划她那从未实现却屡屡幻想的对艾巴萨罗姆的袭击。中央的桌子上展示着一幅幻象地图，呈现的是数百年前、贝科拉在世时的艾巴萨罗姆城，以便为她的计划提供援助，但此处的蛛网术遮蔽了这道幻象。

数年前，一只名为米尼维克斯的伏网怪从沼泽进入地城后来到此处。他发现这座幻象城市妙趣横生，并自封为“幽灵之城之王”，将这里当作巢穴。由于曾在外侧走廊被陷阱伤到，米尼维克斯如今习惯沿着走廊上方攀爬，以避免在往返狩猎时踏入陷阱前方，并会将时间安排在河栖龙兽离开她在@UUID[.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{区域 B19}的巢穴的时段。

遭遇

严重 2

@Actor[ZMr28tFTA5NUcBTi]{米尼维克斯} @Actor[Z2v611Np3J1MBkpv]{梦蜘蛛（2）} @Actor[Or0jjL8xS3GyiMq0]{伏网怪套索（2）}

116 XP

英雄们初到时，伏网怪正蹲在桌面上，沉醉于又一次端详他那被蛛网术糊住的城市。发现英雄后，他会站起至全高，用阿克罗语发号施令般问候：“向幽灵之城之王俯首，并献上你们的贡品！”米尼维克斯膨胀的自我令他期待任何访客都可能是携带赋礼的求恳者；若英雄们不献上赋礼（任何种类都行），他会恼怒地嘶鸣并发动攻击。若英雄们真的这么做了，米尼维克斯会被自己权威的实现吓到而短暂沉默。随后他会继续对英雄提出更多要求：献上更多贡品、为他打磨利爪等等，直到他厌倦他们的卑躬屈膝，然后干脆攻击。他会召唤出隐藏的梦蜘蛛爪牙来伏击英雄，并尽力将英雄诱入他两处网捕之一。米尼维克斯战至死方休。

危害

米尼维克斯在房间里布置了两处伏网怪套索，位置如地图所示。

宝藏

@Actor[WgqdPlzcS4OMewi7]{米尼维克斯的宝藏}

伏网怪收集了一大堆“宝藏”，用一团蛛网术包裹起来并固定在桌子下方保存。其中大部分贵重物其实都是毫无价值、却迎合他怪异审美的小玩意儿，例如生锈的箭头、发亮的石头、被浪涛磨得光滑的玻璃碎片，或是精致的贝壳。在这堆杂物中有一颗迷心蛋白石、五发闪光投石索弹丸，以及一条类型I 火球项链。任何人只要往桌子底下看就能看到这处藏匿点，因为这些魔法投石索弹丸会透过固定它们的蛛网术微微发光。

This large, low-ceiling room has a cross-shaped table at its center. Ten chairs stand around the table. The walls, floors, and ceilings of the chamber are completely covered with thick layers of webbing.

Belcorra once held meetings with her most valued advisors, minions, and conjured allies in this room, usually to plan out her never-realized but oft-imagined assaults on Absalom. The table in the center displays an illusory map of the city of Absalom as it appeared hundreds of years ago, during Belcorra's life, to aid in her plans, but the spiderwebs in this room obscure this illusion.

Several years ago, a web lurker named Mimnivix came to this room after entering the dungeon from the swamp. He found the illusory city a delight and fancied himself the "King of the Ghost City" making the room his lair. After being damaged by a trap in the outer hall, Mimnivix has taken to clambering along the upper reaches of the hall to avoid stepping in front of the traps as he comes and goes on hunting trips, timing them for the hours the river drake is out of her lair at @UUID[.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{Area B19}.

Encounter

Severe 2

@Actor[ZMr28tFTA5NUcBTi]{Mimnivix} @Actor[Z2v611Np3J1MBkpv]{Dream Spiders (2)} @Actor[Or0jjL8xS3GyiMq0]{Web Lurker Nooses (2)}

116 XP

When the heroes first arrive, the web lurker is squatting atop the table, delighting in yet another examination of his web-caked city. He rises up to full height upon spotting the heroes and, in Aklo, greets them by commanding, "Bow down before the King of the Ghost City and present your offerings!" Mimnivix's inflated ego leaves him expecting any visitors to be potential supplicants bearing gifts, and if the heroes don’t offer him gifts (of any sort), he hisses in frustration and attacks. If the heroes actually do so, Mimnivix is so startled by his own authority that he's momentarily silent. He makes further demands of the heroes to give more offerings, polish his claws, and so forth until he tires of their obsequiousness and simply attacks them. He calls his hidden dream spider minions out to ambush the heroes and does his best to lure the heroes into one of his two web traps. Mimnivix fights to the death.

Hazards

Mimnivix has placed two web lurker nooses in the room, in the locations indicated on the map.

Treasure

@Actor[WgqdPlzcS4OMewi7]{Mimnivix's Treasure}

The web lurker has gathered a fairly large stash of "treasure" that he keeps in a bundle of webbing affixed under the table. Most of these valuables are worthless trinkets that appealed to his strange sense of aesthetics, like rusty arrowheads, shiny rocks, bits of glass worn smooth by the surf, or neat seashells. Among the clutter is a mesmerizing opal, five shining sling bullets, and a type I necklace of fireballs. The cache is visible to anyone who looks under the table, as the magic sling bullets glow faintly through the webbing holding them in place.

B31. Reception Room.name: B31. 接待室 B31. Reception Room
B31. Reception Room.text:
一张破损的桌子和几把被毁的椅子堆成一堆，位于这个房间的中央，旁边还有几根巨大的骨头。

如果英雄们正沿着奥塔里从区域 @UUID[.BHmLYQVCwzBneNFu]{B28} 留下的幽灵踪迹前进，他们会看到这道踪迹在房间中央舞动并闪动——那里有一具牛头怪的骷髅（特征）与破败的家具纠缠在一起。奥塔里在这里遭遇了守卫并将其杀死后继续前进。不幸的是，凄凉灯塔的死灵影响使这些遗骸活动了起来。

遭遇

低等 2

@Actor[5MVBU86ZRw2ANMQn]{骸骨巨人}

60 XP

当英雄们进入房间时，骨头颤动着并拉拢聚合。这需要 1 轮，因此敏捷的角色可以在骨头组装完成前离开房间——一旦他们离开，骨头便会重新散落回原位。若牛头怪的骷髅（特征）完全重建自身，它会从残骸中拔出锈蚀的长柄刀并战斗至被摧毁——但它不会追击离开此房间的敌人。

当骷髅（特征）开始重新组装时，你可以使用这个宏同时切换骨头与骷髅（特征）的可见性！

@Macro[e7SbhVgzoGNhPHDS]{B31 - 骸骨巨人}

A ruined table and several destroyed chairs lie in a heap in the middle of this room, along with several large bones.

If the heroes are following the ghostly trail left by Otari from area @UUID[.BHmLYQVCwzBneNFu]{B28}, they’ll see this trail dance and flicker around the center of the room where a minotaur’s skeleton is entangled with the ruined furniture. Otari encountered the guardian here and killed it before moving on. Unfortunately, the necromantic influence of Gauntlight has animated these remains.

Encounter

Low 2

@Actor[5MVBU86ZRw2ANMQn]{Skeletal Giant}

60 XP

As the heroes enter the room, the bones shudder and pull together. This takes 1 round, so swift characters can exit the room before the bones assemble, at which time they fall back into place. If the minotaur skeleton completely rebuilds itself, it pulls its rusty glaive from the wreckage and fights until destroyed- but it doesn't pursue foes from this room.

When the skeleton begins to reassemble itself, you can use this macro to toggle the visibility of the bones and the skeleton at the same time!

@Macro[e7SbhVgzoGNhPHDS]{B31 - Skeletal Giant}

B32. Secret Stairs.name: B32. 秘密楼梯 B32. Secret Stairs
B32. Secret Stairs.text:
探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

英雄们可以通过一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定在这些楼梯的顶部发现秘密门。秘密门会在以某种方式推动最上一级台阶上的凸起时打开。秘密门后的楼梯通往下方的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.YhRSOC6JXrOhl9wU]{C10}。

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

The heroes can spot the secret door at the top of these stairs with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. The secret door opens when the rise on the top step is pushed a certain way. The stairs beyond the secret door lead down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.YhRSOC6JXrOhl9wU]{C10}.

B33. Punishment Room.name: B33. 惩戒室 B33. Punishment Room
B33. Punishment Room.text:
损坏的酷刑器具半塌成堆，散落在这里的地面上。北边歪倒着一架毁坏的拉伸刑架，而南边的颈手枷已经倒在地上。生锈的钳子与铁链、磨损腐烂的鞭子，以及其他器具摆在摇摇欲坠的架子上。

贝科拉用这间房间来惩罚无礼的仆人，或是在她感到无聊、需要找点事分散注意力时使用。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

这里几乎没有什么有用的东西，但一名正在搜索这间房间并在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功的英雄，会发现南边的暗门；当猛地向下拉动墙上一枚生锈的圆环时，这扇门就会打开。

Broken-down torture instruments lie in half-collapsed heaps on the floor here. To the north slumps a ruined stretching rack, while to the south a pillory lies fallen on the floor. Rusty tongs and chains, frayed and rotten whips, and other implements lie on tottering shelves.

Belcorra used this room to punish insolent servants or when she was bored and needed something to distract her.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Little of use remains here, but a hero Searching this room who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} finds the secret door to the south, which opens when a rusted ring on the wall is pulled down sharply.

B34. Elevator Down.name: B34. 向下的升降机 B34. Elevator Down
B34. Elevator Down.text:
探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

一名英雄在此死胡同中进行搜索，成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定后会斑点到秘密门。两块墙石同时被按下会使其摆动开启。

这间朴素的圆形房间空无一物。东墙上装饰着一幅覆满苔藓的骷髅图像。

这间房间的地板是一部魔法升降梯，连接到下方的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.Y5ErIQKfh97WDP2G]{C22}。如果一名生物在秘密门关闭时触碰覆苔骷髅的图像——宁布洛斯的象征——地板会伴随着刺耳的摩擦声缓慢下降30英尺。北侧与南侧的门会滑升进入视野。

如果升降梯位于区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.Y5ErIQKfh97WDP2G]{C22} 时秘密门被打开，这个房间就是一个30英尺深的坑。

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A hero Searching this dead end spots the secret door with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. Two wall stones, pushed in unison, cause it to swing open.

This plain, circular room is empty. A single image of a moss-caked skull adorns the eastern wall.

The floor of this room is a magical elevator that links to area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.Y5ErIQKfh97WDP2G]{C22} below. If a creature touches the image of the mossy skull- Nhimbaloth's symbol- while the secret door is closed, the floor slowly descends 30 feet with a grinding noise. Doors slide up into view to the north and south.

If the secret door is opened while the elevator is in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.Y5ErIQKfh97WDP2G]{C22}, this room is a 30-foot-deep pit.

B35. Gauntlight Basement.name: B35. 灯塔地下室 B35. Gauntlight Basement
B35. Gauntlight Basement.text:
如果英雄们设法在本章开头@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{凄凉灯塔}启动之前进入这间房间，那么该神器已经被赋能；当前并不存在任何幽魂能量带，你应相应修改以下朗读文本。凄凉灯塔启动后需要充能，因此能量带会再次出现。

这间圆形房间的墙壁光滑而灰暗。一条淡蓝色光带在空中盘绕滑行，将房间中央的地面与上方十五英尺高的天花板连接起来。光亮触及上下石面之处翻涌蠕动，仿佛石头本身正遭受感染折磨。一条巨虫干枯的残骸瘫伏在光带周围，形成一弯皱缩破碎的紫色肉质残片。

贝科拉最喜欢的宠物之一曾栖居于此——一条她从幽暗地域运入此室的紫虫。尽管这生物拥有野兽般的力量，但由于要塞的墙壁坚不可摧，它完全依赖贝科拉供给食物。贝科拉死后，这条紫虫也随之被活活饿死。

这条幽魂般的光带是凄凉灯塔力量不断累积的具现。这诡异的光亮在房间中央形成一个直径5英尺的爆发区域并翻涌不息。任何活体生物在其中结束其回合时，进行一次@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true]{基础反射}豁免，失败则受到[[/r 2d6[negative]]]伤害；而亡灵生物则恢复等量HP。

只要凄凉灯塔仍处于其低等级的启动状态，这光亮就会持续翻涌；但如果英雄们从区域@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D09}救出拉斯达·范克维尔，它就会熄灭。

宝藏

@Item[CTwOeEWuOqG7zaMZ]{+1 战锤}

一名英雄若挖开干枯的虫尸，会发现它最后一餐的残余：一具仍紧抓着一把+1 战锤的灰矮人骸骨（骷髅（特征）），那武器没能帮助他从紫虫的胃里杀出一条生路。

If the heroes manage to enter this room before @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight} activates at the beginning of this chapter, then the artifact is already empowered; no ribbon of ghostly energy is currently present, and you should amend the following read-aloud text accordingly. After Gauntlight activates, it needs to recharge, so the ribbon of energy returns.

The walls of this circular room are smooth and gray. A ribbon of pale blue light coils and slithers through the air, connecting the floor at the center of the room to the ceiling fifteen feet above. The points where this light touches the stone above and below seethe and writhe, as if the stone itself were suffering from an infection. The desiccated remains of an enormous worm lie slumped around the ribbon, forming a crescent of shriveled and tattered purple flesh.

One of Belcorra’s favorite pets dwelt in this room, a purple worm she transported into the chamber from the Darklands. For all the creature’s bestial power, it was entirely dependent on Belcorra for sustenance, as the keep’s walls are indestructible. After Belcorra’s death, the worm starved to death.

The ribbon of ghostly light is a manifestation of Gauntlight’s mounting power. This eerie light churns in a 5-foot-diameter burst at the room’s center. Any living creature ending its turn within it takes [[/r 2d6[negative]]] damage with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true]{Basic Reflex} save, and undead creatures regain HP of the same amount.

As long as Gauntlight remains at its low-level activation, the light keeps churning, but if the heroes rescue Lasda Venkervale from area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D09}, it winks out.

Treasure

@Item[CTwOeEWuOqG7zaMZ]{+1 Warhammer}

A hero who digs into the dried worm's carcass finds the remains of its last meal: a duergar skeleton still clutching a +1 warhammer that didn't help him cut his way out of the worm's gut.

Chapter 2: The Forgotten Dungeon.name: 第2章：被遗忘的魔窟 Chapter 2: The Forgotten Dungeon
Chapter 2: The Forgotten Dungeon.text:
章节概要

憎恨魔窟的第二等级——也是其最靠上的地下等级——潜藏着数个古老陷阱，以及一群极端独立、会上到地表狩猎的居民。这里也有一小群从更深处被迫向上迁移的摩洛克。然而，在英雄们来得及深入探索这一等级之前，贝科拉为精炼该神器的力量，以一次毁灭性的测试启动了@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{凄凉灯塔}。

仆役寝区
