憎恨魔窟的第一地下等级曾是贝科拉仆役的住处。在这里，工人们生活、劳作，不为上方凄凉灯塔要塞的人所见。当贝科拉被杀后，这里的仆役陷入恐慌。有些人逃走，有些人躲进自己的房间，还有些人沦为下一层那些食人图书管理员的食物。如今，仆役寝区大多已成废墟。

环境线索：

破损的低质家具与工具、蛛网、远处的敲击声、墙面凝结的水珠、霉味、令人不适的潮湿。

特征

除非另有注明，否则各区域都未照明；天花板高度通常为走廊8英尺、房间10英尺。门为结实的木门，但因受潮而膨胀卡死。受过运动训练的英雄可以如常用一次交互动作打开本等级的门；未受运动训练的角色必须花费2次交互动作才能打开一扇门。

Chapter Synopsis

The Abomination Vaults’ second level—its highest underground level—harbors several old traps and fiercely independent denizens who hunt on the surface. It also contains a small group of morlocks pushed up from below. Before the heroes get too far into exploring this level, though, Belcorra activates @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight} in a devastating test as she refines the artifact’s power.

Servants' Quarters

The first underground level of the Abomination Vaults once served as the quarters for Belcorra’s servants. Here, the workers lived and toiled out of sight from those in Gauntlight Keep above. When Belcorra was killed, the servants here panicked. Some fled, others hid in their rooms, and still others became food for the cannibal librarians the next floor down. Today, the servants’ quarters are largely in ruins.

Environmental Cues:

Broken low-quality furniture and tools, cobwebs, distant banging noises, moisture beading on the walls, smells of mold, unpleasant dampness.

Features

Areas are unlit unless otherwise noted, and the ceiling heights are typically 8 feet in hallways and 10 feet in rooms. The doors are sturdy wood, swollen shut with moisture. A hero trained in Athletics can open doors on this level with a single Interact action, as normal; characters who aren’t trained in Athletics must spend 2 Interact actions to open a door.

Children of the Ghost Queen.name: 幽灵女王之子 Children of the Ghost Queen
Children of the Ghost Queen.text:
目前在仆役寝区活动的最大派系，是一群自称为“幽灵女王之子”的摩洛克。这些摩洛克曾居住在该等级更深处、与憎恨魔窟相邻的洞窟中。当贝科拉苏醒时，他们攀爬到更高的楼层为她铺路，期间与溃烂教的食尸鬼爆发了一场毁灭性的冲突，随后又将泥舔者螨精驱逐出去。贝科拉一直把摩洛克当作害虫（即使成了幽灵也仍然如此），但摩洛克的首领格劳格斯特希望通过为她建造一座神殿来改变她的看法。然而，正如贝科拉的玄奥庇护者宁布洛斯几乎不在乎人们如何敬奉她一样，这些摩洛克所侍奉的幽灵女王也不在乎这些虔诚的摩洛克是生是死。

The largest faction presently active in the Servant’s Quarters is a group of morlocks who call themselves the Children of the Ghost Queen. These morlocks once dwelt deep below this level in caverns adjacent to the Abomination Vaults. When Belcorra wakened, they clambered into the higher levels to prepare the way for her, enduring a devastating clash with the Cult of the Canker ghouls and later driving out the Mudlicker mitflits. Belcorra always considered morlocks to be pests (and still does, even as a ghost), but the morlocks’ leader, Graulgust, hopes to change her mind by building her a temple. But, just as Belcorra’s eldritch patron Nhimbaloth cares little about how she’s honored, the morlocks’ Ghost Queen doesn’t care whether these devout morlocks live or die.

Deadtide Prelude.name: 亡潮序曲 Deadtide Prelude
Deadtide Prelude.text:
时机

英雄们一旦发现城堡下方地下城的任何入口，随时都可以自由进入；但在他们过于深入憎恨魔窟之前，应当先发生一件重要事件。最好让这件事发生在夜间、且英雄能对凄凉灯塔的圆顶保持视觉线时，例如他们撤退去休息之时，或者甚至在他们刚击败区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{A25} 中的吸血魔雾之后。不管怎样，这个事件发生时英雄应为2级。时机成熟时，开始奥塔里的尸潮。

@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{凄凉灯塔} 还未完全运作，但其魔法力量已恢复到足以让贝科拉将其作为一次测试射击来启动，随后她才会进行更繁复的流程，以将这件遗物恢复到可完全使用的状态。她以奥塔里墓园为目标，使其中的死者复苏。随后，这个幽灵（特征）通过凄凉灯塔的透镜守望，但她除了观察之外做不了太多——受限于她在憎恨魔窟深处的闹鬼地点。朗读或转述以下内容以开始该事件。

凄凉灯塔猛然一震，其光芒骤然炽盛，绽放出病态的淡蓝色照明。光束向南划出一道弧线，坠落之处并非直接落在奥塔里，而是投向位于奥塔里西缘、绵延开阔的墓园。

强烈幻象

@Macro[0C1vnwN5UaW0aWFQ]{奥塔里的尸潮}

如果你想用一些光照效果来配合你的描述，这个宏会让一阵幽异的发光降临到墓园上空，在 @Scene[MSHO9s465zhZIuH7]{Landing} 或 @Scene[lQkXSdxvO9CRxohD]{奥塔里} 场景中都能看到。

光亮(术)始终固定在墓园上空，从凄凉灯塔一直到城镇都清晰可见。英雄们没有任何办法阻碍这束光，因为它是从凄凉灯塔以魔法方式放射而出，除非凭借贝科拉的意志，否则无法从其源头将其停止。

尽管英雄们可能会因那诡异光亮所暗示的不祥而匆忙直奔墓园，你仍可以按原样运行这些事件，即使英雄先花些时间处理伤口或以其他方式耽搁。由于死者被埋葬，大多数需要花些时间才能挖出地面。如果英雄到达时已超过两小时，@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.St1SBR4xOInfNoPj]{奥塔里守卫}已经在墓地周围竖起了封锁线，但他们因恐惧那些偶尔有更早挣脱出来、拖着脚步的尸体而不敢进入墓地范围。应由英雄来处理不死生物；如果他们并未主动进入墓园、扮演英雄的角色，随时可以让长鞍队长、欧瑟夫·曼妮姆斯市长，或万蒂·班得黛西等官员请他们去处理局势。若英雄仍继续犹豫，不死生物可能会变成更大的麻烦。

当玩家准备好应对不死威胁时，推进至 @UUID[.bwT6PloCsffN9m73]{奥塔里的尸潮}。

Timing

While the heroes are free to enter the dungeon below the keep as soon as they discover any of its entrances, an important event should take place before they dive too deeply into the Abomination Vaults. It’s best if this event takes place at night while the heroes have line of sight to Gauntlight’s cupola, such as when they retreat to rest or perhaps even right after they’ve defeated the vampiric mist in area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{A25}. In any case, the heroes should be 2nd level for this event. When the timing is right, begin Deadtide for Otari.

@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight} isn't yet fully functional, but enough of its magical power has been restored that Belcorra activates it as a test firing before proceeding with the more-involved process of restoring the artifact to full use. She targets Otari's graveyard, animating the dead within it. The ghost then watches through Gauntlight’s lens, but she can’t do much beyond observe, limited as she is to the site of her haunting deep in the Abomination Vaults. Read or paraphrase the following to begin this event.

Gauntlight shudders and its light suddenly blazes with a sickly, pale-blue illumination. This beam arcs south, falling not directly on Otari, but onto the sprawling graveyard located at Otari’s western edge.

Powerful Visions

@Macro[0C1vnwN5UaW0aWFQ]{Deadtide for Otari}

If you'd like to have some lighting effects to accompany your descriptions, this macro will cause a spectral glow to descend onto the graveyard, visible on either the @Scene[MSHO9s465zhZIuH7]{Landing} or @Scene[lQkXSdxvO9CRxohD]{Otari} scenes.

The light remains fixed on the graveyard and is visible all the way from Gauntlight to the town. There isn’t any way for the heroes to impede the beam, as it emanates magically from Gauntlight and can’t be stopped from its origin point except by Belcorra’s will.

Although the heroes might hurry directly to the graveyard given the sinister implications of the eerie light, you can still run these events as written if the heroes first take some time to tend to their wounds or otherwise delay. As the dead are buried, it takes most of them some time to dig free. If the heroes take more than a couple of hours to arrive, @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.St1SBR4xOInfNoPj]{Otari's Guard} have already erected a barrier around the cemetery but are afraid to enter the grounds for fear of the occasional shuffling corpse that pulled itself free sooner than the others. Dealing with the undead should fall to the heroes; if they aren’t self-motivated to enter the graveyard and act the part of heroes, feel free to have an official like Captain Longsaddle, Mayor Oseph Menhemes, or Vandy Banderdash ask them to deal with the situation. If the heroes continue to hesitate, the undead might become a bigger problem.

When the players are ready to deal with the undead threat, progress to @UUID[.bwT6PloCsffN9m73]{Deadtide for Otari}.

Deadtide for Otari.name: 奥塔里的尸潮 Deadtide for Otari
Deadtide for Otari.text:
奥塔里墓园的土壤在诡异的蓝色光亮(术)中翻涌搅动。数十具骷髅（特征）与蹒跚的尸体从地里拖拽着爬出，朝南方冲去。它们毫不迟疑地越过悬崖边缘坠落，像雨点般砸向下方晨花图书馆的穹顶。

大多数被凄凉之光射线唤起的不死生物都坠下悬崖，在可怖的摔落中粉身碎骨，但仍有少数留在墓园里。然而，伤害已经造成——奥塔里的市民惊恐万分、陷入恐慌。若英雄们踏入墓园，对付那几名残余的不死生物，这场战斗将是一次重要的象征性挺身而出——这是英雄们首次真正迈向被认可为奥塔里救星的一步。

遭遇

严重 2

@Actor[ro9oVsu1cuCP8OQH]{Graveyard Skeletons (5)} @Actor[0plBflWwrCWQO2RO]{Zombie Shamblers (3)} @Actor[rsATu823vatRe7QJ]{Otari Guards (4)}

120 XP

墓园中共有五名骷髅卫士与三名蹒跚丧尸仍在活动。这些敌人从规则上来说构成一场针对2级角色的严重遭遇，但精明的英雄们拥有不少优势。骷髅手无寸铁，只能用爪子战斗。此外，不死生物分散在墓园各处，彼此之间30尺内没有任何其他不死生物，尽管它们会迅速向任何战斗或骚动移动。潜行与远程战术很可能在它们接近前就削减对手。由于不死生物分散，若英雄们行动迅速而高效，就不必一次面对大量敌人。

附近的四名镇卫被眼前的情形吓坏了，几乎不可能帮上什么忙——若遭到攻击，他们会逃跑。由你自行裁量，尤其是当某位英雄成功向守卫提出请求（Request）或胁迫（Coerce）其援助时，他们中的一些人或许会参战。守卫也能将倒下的英雄拖到安全处。将任何加入战斗的守卫在战斗开始时视为 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}。

贝科拉在远处饶有兴致地守夜，看着英雄们处理不死生物。然而，这场战斗一结束，她便决定是时候测试凄凉灯塔的主要功能：将怪物传送到敌人身边。贝科拉花了点时间命令她的学徒沃鲁克把一只油鳞蛛从区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.df69jJ0DznVnWMAb]{D10}带到区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D09}。这段延误让英雄们有几分钟从先前的战斗中恢复。随后，她将凄凉之光射线聚焦在英雄们的位置，把该生物传送过去。那道照明让被触及者起了一身鸡皮疙瘩，并让残余的守卫惊慌四散。

遭遇

中等 2

@Actor[Nkz8Z5TrEqRePGlk]{Scalathrax}

80 XP

憎恨之物的降临

在凄凉之光射线照到英雄们身上的瞬间，一只蛛形的油鳞蛛在他们中间显现——而几乎同一时间，凄凉灯塔变暗。该异怪使用潜行来决定其先攻并立刻发动攻击，战至死亡。任何目睹该生物突然到来并在一项 @Check[type:arcana|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{奥术学}或 @Check[type:occultism|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{神秘学}检定中成功的英雄（可在战斗中或战斗后进行）都会意识到：该生物是通过射线传送进该区域的。

垂死之光

一旦凄凉灯塔送达油鳞蛛并变暗，至少要过一个月，这件遗物才能恢复到足以让贝科拉再次启动它的程度。她可能会用它来复苏更多不死生物，或将另一只怪物传送进城里——要么直接攻击英雄们，要么只是散播恐慌。

当然，镇民并不知道这一时间表，而“凄凉灯塔随时可能再次照耀”的恐惧让市民惶惶不安。人们害怕在天黑后外出，关于贝科拉的归来的流言也甚嚣尘上。若英雄们在击败不死生物与油鳞蛛的过程中发挥了关键且显眼的作用，他们很快就会收到市长欧瑟夫·曼妮姆斯的联络；他请求他们尽力查明这次事件的原因，并在可能的情况下阻止其再次发生。你也可以让其他镇上的显要人物在此时到场——给英雄们一个挺身而出的机会。无论如何，欧瑟夫承诺：若他们返回凄凉灯塔要塞并确保凄凉灯塔再也不会照向奥塔里，镇库将向每位英雄支付50 gp作为奖励。

The soil of Otari's graveyard roils and churns in the eerie blue light. Dozens of skeletons and shambling corpses haul themselves free from the ground and rush to the south. Without any hesitation, the walking dead plummet over the cliff's edge to rain down upon the domes of the Dawnflower Library below.

Most of the undead raised by Gauntlight’s beam plummet to their grisly destruction over the cliffs, though a few remain in the graveyard. Yet the damage is done- Otari's citizens are horrified and panicked. If the heroes step into the graveyard to take on the few remaining undead, the fight is an important symbolic stand- this is the heroes' first real step toward being recognized as Otari's saviors.

Encounter

Severe 2

@Actor[ro9oVsu1cuCP8OQH]{Graveyard Skeletons (5)} @Actor[0plBflWwrCWQO2RO]{Zombie Shamblers (3)} @Actor[rsATu823vatRe7QJ]{Otari Guards (4)}

120 XP

A total of five skeleton guards and three zombie shamblers remain active in the graveyard. These foes technically constitute a severe encounter for 2nd-level characters, but canny heroes have a number of advantages. The skeletons are unarmed, and fight with their claws. In addition, the undead are scattered throughout the graveyard with no undead within 30 feet of any other, although they quickly move toward any fight or distraction. Stealth and ranged tactics could well thin the opposition before they close in. With the undead being scattered, the heroes won't need to deal with large numbers all at once if they're quick and efficient.

The four nearby town guards are horrified by the situation and are unlikely to be of much help- they flee if attacked. At your discretion, and particularly if a hero manages to make a Request of the guards or Coerce their aid, some of them might fight. Guards can also drag a fallen hero to safety. Treat the guards as @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} at the start of any fight they join.

Belcorra watches with amusement from afar as the heroes deal with the undead. As soon as that fight ends, though, she decides it's time to test Gauntlight's primary function: teleporting monsters in among her enemies. Belcorra takes a moment to order her apprentice Volluk to bring one of the scalathraxes from area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.df69jJ0DznVnWMAb]{D10} into area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D09}. This delay grants the heroes a few minutes to recover from their previous fight. She then focuses Gauntlight's beam upon the heroes' location to transport the creature there. The illumination raises gooseflesh on those it touches and scatters any remaining guards in a panic.

Encounter

Moderate 2

@Actor[Nkz8Z5TrEqRePGlk]{Scalathrax}

80 XP

Abomination's Arrival

An instant after Gauntlight's beam shines upon the heroes, a spiderlike scalathrax manifests in their midst- and, just as quickly, Gauntlight goes dark. The aberration uses Stealth to determine its initiative and immediately attacks, fighting to the death. Any hero who witnesses the creature's sudden arrival and succeeds at a @Check[type:arcana|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Arcana} or @Check[type:occultism|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism} check (either during or after the fight) realizes that the creature was teleported into the area via the beam.

Dying Light

Once Gauntlight has delivered the scalathrax and gone dark, it will be at least a month before the artifact can return to a point where Belcorra can activate it again. She might do so to animate more undead or teleport another monster into town, either to attack the heroes directly or to simply spread panic.

Of course, the townsfolk have no idea about this schedule, and the fear that Gauntlight could shine again at any moment has the citizens terrified. People fear to go outside after dark, and rumors about Belcorra’s return run rampant. Assuming the heroes played a key and visible role in defeating the undead and the scalathrax, they’re soon contacted by mayor Oseph Menhemes, who asks them to do what they can to find out what caused this event and, if possible, prevent it from occurring again. Feel free to have other town notables be present at this time—give the heroes the chance to rise to the occasion. In any event, Oseph promises a reward of 50 gp per hero from the town treasury if they return to Gauntlight Keep and see to it that Gauntlight never shines on Otari again.

10. To Draw the Baleful Glare.name: 10. 抽出凶邪凝视 10. To Draw the Baleful Glare

J01. First Challenge.name: J01. 第一项挑战 J01. First Challenge
J01. First Challenge.text:
一个装满芦苇与苔藓的水盆立在通往北方的门之间的一处壁龛里。两根金属管从东方伸入房间内，每根管道在其内部约一尺处都被某种类似虹膜的机关密封。看不出任何打开这些机关的方法。黑色石门通向南方，西侧则是一扇灰色石门，上面雕刻着旋转雾气的形状。所有门都没有把手或门闩。

试炼从西门后的灵魂挑战开始。金属管向下倾斜并排入区域 @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} 的沼泽中。它们刚好足以让一名中型生物滑下去。若英雄们带着女士的耳语从此处进入，骷髅会沉默地指向灰色石门。那扇门只需一推就会打开，或若有人站在门前持续 1 轮，它也会自行摆开。南侧的门（硬度 15，生命值 60）以及管道的机械虹膜开口（硬度 18，生命值 72）都紧闭着，除非女士的耳语愿意，否则不会打开。

如果恐怖鬼火正在跟随英雄，其中一只会停在水盆上方，以无声地将英雄在此的一举一动汇报给贝科拉。

通过灵魂挑战

当英雄们在区域 @UUID[.iESpyOXVCFTTGXxk]{J08} 喂食或击败恐怖鬼火后返回此处，女士的耳语会打开南侧的门并让其保持开启。一名英雄若成功进行一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:27|traits:action:sense-motive]{察觉} 检定以进行 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{察言观色}，便会意识到女士的耳语因英雄通过了试炼而感到被冒犯，但它将这股恼怒压了下去。

监考官

起初，英雄们也许会顺着女士的耳语行动，想弄明白这名神秘的不死生物究竟在要求他们做什么。在完成一两个试炼后，他们可能会决定自己终究不想被评判为值得引起宁布洛斯的注意。若他们意识到每次成功的试炼都会加深女士的耳语的不悦，而且这不死生物还打算杀了他们，那么这种想法尤其强烈。

女士的耳语对英雄们任何先发制人的攻击都会像早有预料般作出回应。这不死生物会尝试以浮空术飞离近战触及，并施放法术来消灭英雄们。那对可能从区域 I64 跟来的潜伏恐怖鬼火也会加入战斗。

A basin filled with reeds and moss stands in an alcove between doors that lead to the north. Two metal tubes jut into the room from the east, each sealed off by some iris-like mechanism a foot or so inside the pipe. No method of opening these mechanisms is visible. Black stone doors lead south, and a single gray stone door carved with shapes of swirling mist leads west. None of the doors have handles or latches.

The tests begin with the Challenge of Souls through the western door. The metal tubes slant downward and drain into the swamp in area @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15}. They’re just large enough for a Medium creature to slide down. If the heroes enter here with Lady’s Whisper, the skeleton silently points at the gray door. That door opens with a push or simply swings aside if someone stands in front of it for 1 round. The doors to the south (Hardness 15, Hit Points 60) and the tubes’ mechanical iris openings (Hardness 18, Hit Points 72) are all shut and don’t open unless Lady’s Whisper wills it.

If dread wisps are following the heroes, one of them takes a position above the basin to silently report everything the heroes do here to Belcorra.

Passing the Challenge of Souls

When the heroes return here having either fed or defeated the dread wisps in area @UUID[.iESpyOXVCFTTGXxk]{J08}, Lady’s Whisper opens the doors to the south and leaves them open. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:27|traits:action:sense-motive]{Perception} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} realizes that Lady’s Whisper is offended that the heroes passed the test but is keeping this irritation suppressed.

The Proctor

The heroes might go along with Lady’s Whisper at first, wondering just what the enigmatic undead is asking of them. After they complete one or two tests, they might decide they don’t want to be judged worthy of Nhimbaloth’s attention after all. This is especially true if they realize that each successful test increases Lady’s Whisper’s displeasure and that the undead plans to kill them.

Lady’s Whisper responds to any preemptive attack by the heroes as though expecting it. The undead attempts to levitate out of melee reach and cast spells to eliminate the heroes. The lurking pair of dread wisps that might have followed from area I64 join the fight as well.

J02. Poisoning Room.name: J02. 毒杀室 J02. Poisoning Room
J02. Poisoning Room.text:
在这间狭长房间的东端，矗立着一尊巨大的翡翠雕像：一具布满裂痕与缺口、裹着裹尸布的骷髅（特征）。骷髅头骨用牙齿紧咬着一束沼泽杂草。墙体上嵌着数道狭窄的狭缝与石门。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

一名英雄若调查这尊雕像，并在一次 @Check[type:religion|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{宗教} 检定中成功，便会意识到这是一种罕见的宁布洛斯实体化形象。

很久以前，入会者被命令跪在宁布洛斯面前。当他们照做时，藏在射击回廊中的邪教徒会朝他们射出带毒的吹箭飞镖。未被毒素击倒者会被判定为值得一试并被带往南方；屈服于毒素者则会被带往北方，让他们的灵魂遭到收割。

遭遇

中等 10

@Actor[BOaM3pAuWl06Q6IZ]{邪教徒幽魂（6）}

80 XP

六名邪教徒已作为幽魂复起。他们在射击回廊中显现，手持幽灵般的吹箭筒，除了以其卑劣的接触打击外，还用其射出由自身幽灵物质构成的短暂飞镖。狭窄的狭缝使射击回廊中的任何人获得更强的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{掩蔽}（对 AC、对抗区域效果的反射豁免，以及隐匿检定获得 +4 环境加值）。如果英雄进入某条射击回廊，幽魂会穿墙而过以保持距离。幽魂会战斗直到被摧毁。

At the eastern end of this long room stands a giant jade statue of a cracked and chipped skeleton in a burial shroud. The skull clenches a bundle of swamp weeds in its teeth. Built into the walls are several narrow slits and stone doors.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

A hero who Investigates the statue and succeeds at a @Check[type:religion|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Religion} check realizes that it’s a rare physical representation of Nhimbaloth.

Long ago, initiates were commanded to kneel before Nhimbaloth. When they did, cultists hiding in the galleries shot poisoned blowgun darts at them. Those who didn’t succumb to poison were deemed to be worthy and led south; those who succumbed were taken north to have their souls harvested.

Encounter

Moderate 10

@Actor[BOaM3pAuWl06Q6IZ]{Cultist Specters (6)}

80 XP

Six cultists have arisen as specters. They manifest in the shooting galleries with ghostly blowguns, which they use in addition to their vile touch Strikes to shoot ephemeral darts made of their own ghostly substance. The narrow slits provide anyone in the shooting galleries with greater @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Cover} (+4 circumstance bonus to AC, Reflex saves against area effects, and Stealth checks). If the heroes enter a shooting gallery, the specters pass through the walls to keep their distance. The specters fight until destroyed.

J03. Cleansing Chamber.name: J03. 净化室 J03. Cleansing Chamber
J03. Cleansing Chamber.text:
两只布满污垢的铜浴桶，里面没有水，靠着南墙摆放。

这间房间早已被遗弃；曾经，熬过毒气室的见习者会在这里被剥去衣物，用沼泽水洗浴，然后被护送进入适格者洞穴。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

英雄在搜索此房间时，成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定即可发现暗门。东墙上的一块假石头必须被旋转，才能把其中一只铜浴桶以及其后方的墙壁一起枢轴式打开。

你可以使用 @Macro[buxrVuDqbnEptMtB]{J03 - Secret Door} 宏来切换门与版块的可见性。

Two grime-crusted copper tubs, devoid of water, stand against the south wall.

Long abandoned, this chamber was once where initiates who survived the poisoning room were stripped, bathed with swamp water, and then escorted into the worthies’ cave.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A hero can discover the secret door while Searching this room with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. A false stone on the eastern wall must be rotated to pivot open one of the copper tubs and the wall behind it.

You can use the @Macro[buxrVuDqbnEptMtB]{J03 - Secret Door} macro to toggle the visibility of the door and tile.

J04. Worthies’ Cave.name: J04. 适格者洞穴 J04. Worthies’ Cave
J04. Worthies’ Cave.text:
这间天然洞室的天花板上有七个孔洞，每个孔洞的周长都不比一根人类手指大。

在幸存的受训者迎接下一个挑战——绝望灵光挑战——之前，他们会先被施以一种令人麻木大脑的气体，以使测试更加困难。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索} 

这里的两扇暗门都以相同方式开启：当它们被旋转时，光滑平整墙面的一部分会作为门轴转开。暗门各自位于短走廊的尽头，因此并不难发现。任何正在搜索任一短走廊的人都会发现暗门及其开启方式。然而，如果房间的陷阱处于启动状态，门就无法打开，因此必须将其砸开（硬度 18，生命值 60）才能逃脱陷阱。

危害

低 10

@Actor[PphyArSCoxkaI6IS]{麻醉大脑气体陷阱}

60 XP

陷阱会通过天花板上的七个孔洞喷出令人麻木大脑的气体。

The ceiling of this natural chamber bears seven holes no larger around than a human finger.

Before surviving initiates took the next challenge—the Challenge of Despair—they were subjected to a mind-numbing gas to make the test more difficult.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

The secret doors here both open the same way: when rotated, a portion of the smooth, flat wall makes the door pivot open. The secret doors are each at the end of short hallways, so they aren’t hard to find. Anyone Searching either short hall discovers the secret door and the method of opening it. The doors won’t open, however, if the room’s trap is active, so they must be battered down (Hardness 18, Hit Points 60) to escape the trap.

Hazard

Low 10

@Actor[PphyArSCoxkaI6IS]{Befuddling Gas Trap}

60 XP

The trap spews mind-numbing gas through the seven holes in the ceiling.

J05. Level Ten Portal Chamber.name: J05. 十号传送门密室 J05. Level Ten Portal Chamber
J05. Level Ten Portal Chamber.text:
遭遇

中等 10

@Actor[Upf2fOZ6QgGG3seI]{精英石魔像}

80 XP

作为最底层的传送门密室，贝科拉确保这里戒备森严。一具强大的石魔像被建在墙体之中，位于灌注银色的符文之间的一处开阔空间里。它会迈步而出，攻击任何未与贝科拉同行的人。

传送网络

憎恨魔窟内的一些@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{传送法阵}是更大网络的一部分。通过描摹墙上符文的特定图案，有人可以将这些密室中的任意一间里的所有人传送至憎恨魔窟内另外九个传送门密室之一——前提是出发密室与目的地内的传送法阵都已通过@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{唤醒传送门}仪式（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}）被唤醒。

这九个密室分别是区域@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}、@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}、@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}、@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}、@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}、@UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}以及@UUID[.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

贝科拉将这间房间增建到神殿中，用以连接她那由永久性传送法阵构成的网络。其门已上锁，钥匙也早已遗失。英雄可以通过成功的@Check[type:athletics|dc:25|traits:action:force-open]{运动}检定@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{破拆}打开，或通过四次成功的@Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃}检定@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{开锁}。

旋涡般的、灌注银色的符文装点着这间密室的圆弧形墙壁。成片的反光金属覆盖着地面与天花板。

英雄可以重新启动这座传送门密室，并将其与憎恨魔窟各处的其他密室连接起来，如区域@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}中所述。

XP 奖励

若英雄使用唤醒传送门仪式重新启动此处的传送法阵，奖励他们 30 XP。

Encounter

Moderate 10

@Actor[Upf2fOZ6QgGG3seI]{Elite Stone Golem}

80 XP

As the lowest portal chamber, Belcorra ensured this room was well-guarded. A powerful stone golem is built into the wall, in an open space between the silver-filled runes. It steps out and attacks anyone who isn’t accompanying Belcorra.

Teleportation Network

Some of the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} within the Abomination Vaults form a part of a larger network. By tracing specific patterns on the wall runes, someone could transport everyone in any one of these chambers to one of nine other portal chambers in the Abomination Vaults- so long as the teleportation circles in both the departure chamber and destination have been awakened by the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal} ritual (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}).

The nine chambers are areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}, @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}, @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}, @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}, @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}, @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}, and @UUID[.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

Belcorra added this room to the temple to connect her network of permanent teleportation circles. Its door is locked, and the key is long lost. A hero can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open} with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:25|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check or @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} with four successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks.

Swirling, silver-filled runes adorn the rounded walls of this chamber. Sheets of reflective metal cover the floor and ceiling.

The heroes can reactivate this portal chamber and connect it to others throughout the Abomination Vaults, as described in area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for using the awaken portal ritual to reactivate the teleportation circle here.

J06. Crematorium.name: J06. 火葬场 J06. Crematorium
J06. Crematorium.text:
两个冒泡的岩浆池并排位于这座巨大房间的中央。

遭遇

中等 10

@Actor[Z3J7uGaLmlFRfwPk]{岩浆蝎（4）}

80 XP

被束缚的火元素体在数个世纪里一直维持着此处的热量。它们会从岩浆坑中爬出以攻击入侵者，积极追击并战斗直至被摧毁。

强烈热量

这座火葬场十分炽热，每10分钟造成[[/r 2d6[fire]]]伤害（蝎子免疫）。浸入深25英尺的岩浆池中会在每轮造成[[/r 20d6[fire]]]伤害。

Two pools of bubbling magma sit side by side in the center of this large chamber.

Encounter

Moderate 10

@Actor[Z3J7uGaLmlFRfwPk]{Magma Scorpions (4)}

80 XP

Bound fire elementals have maintained the heat in this room for centuries. They climb out of the magma pits to attack intruders, pursuing aggressively and fighting until destroyed.

Intense Heat

This crematorium is extremely hot, dealing [[/r 2d6[fire]]] damage every 10 minutes (the scorpions are immune). Immersion in the 25-foot-deep magma pools deals [[/r 20d6[fire]]] damage each round.

J07. Soul Extractors.name: J07. 灵魂萃取者 J07. Soul Extractors
J07. Soul Extractors.text:
这座奇异而不规则的大厅里有数个宽阔的壁龛，每个壁龛都放着一座立式架子，上面装有水晶与拉杆，宛如怪诞的拷问器具。

失败的入会者会被带到这里，绑在这些奇怪的立式架子上。这些神秘学机器会将入会者的灵魂抽取到水晶球中，同时，特殊的玻璃魔像会将他们的身体切成碎片。邪教徒把注入灵魂的水晶球（这些水晶球过于脆弱，无法让持刃之手的魔像处理）带到区域 @UUID[.iESpyOXVCFTTGXxk]{J08} 的恐怖鬼火那里。

遭遇

中等 10

@Actor[eoQgRltsgJWa4aeC]{宁布洛斯的切割者（4）}

80 XP

四具魔像仍留在此处，会尽其所能把入侵者切成碎条。它们略带绿色的玻璃身躯散发出令人不安的发光，使它们拥有“冷酷闪光”能力，而非“炫目光辉”。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

水晶球

只有三台神秘学机器仍能运作，每台都装着一个水晶球，其中封存着一名在数百年前被杀害的入会者的灵魂。一名英雄进行调查行动来检查一台可运作的机器，并在一次 @Check[type:occultism|dc:30|traits:action:investigate]{神秘学}、@Check[type:religion|dc:30|traits:action:investigate]{宗教}或相关学识检定（例如精魂学识）中获得成功，就会意识到这些球是什么，以及它们是如何被制造出来的。

这三颗水晶球每颗直径约一尺，对某些不太光彩的灵魂商人（例如夜鬼婆）而言每颗价值 200 gp。若将其砸碎，碎片将一文不值，但其中囚禁的灵魂会前往骨园，并获得其最终的奖赏。

机械装置

三台仍在运作的机器里含有一些 @Item[tvMBhLS1R7bTiqwK]{贵重零件}。经过数小时工作并在一次 @Check[type:crafting|dc:30]{制作}检定中获得成功后，英雄可以从一台机器上拆下稀有金属与精密道具，总价值 80 gp。若该检定为大成功，这些零件价值 160 gp；若为大失败，则该机器中的零件被毁，变得一文不值。

 

This strange, irregular hall features several wide alcoves, each with a standing rack bearing crystals and levers, like bizarre torture devices.

Failed initiates were brought here and strapped to the strange standing racks. These occult machines extracted the initiates’ souls into crystal globes as special glass golems sliced their bodies to pieces. Cultists took the soul-infused globes (which were far too delicate for the blade-handed golems to handle) to the dread wisps in area @UUID[.iESpyOXVCFTTGXxk]{J08}.

Encounter

Moderate 10

@Actor[eoQgRltsgJWa4aeC]{Nhimbaloth's Cutters (4)}

80 XP

The four golems remain here and do their best to slice intruders to ribbons. Their greenish glass bodies emit an unsettling glow, giving them the Grim Glittering ability instead of Dazzling Brilliance.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

The Crystal Globes

Only three of the occult machines still function, and each holds a crystal globe containing the soul of an initiate killed centuries ago. A hero Investigating a functional machine and succeeding at a @Check[type:occultism|dc:30|traits:action:investigate]{Occultism}, @Check[type:religion|dc:30|traits:action:investigate]{Religion}, or relevant Lore check (such as Spirit Lore) realizes what the globes are and how they were created.

The three crystal globes are each about a foot in diameter and worth 200 gp to certain unsavory soul merchants, such as night hags. If smashed, their fragments are valueless but the soul trapped within travels to the Boneyard and its ultimate reward.

The Machinery

The three functioning machines contain some @Item[tvMBhLS1R7bTiqwK]{Valuable Parts}. With several hours’ work and a successful @Check[type:crafting|dc:30]{Crafting} check, a hero can strip a machine of rare metals and delicate gears worth 80 gp. If this check is a critical success, the parts are worth 160 gp; on a critical failure, the parts in that machine are ruined and valueless.

J08. Devouring Chamber.name: J08. 噬食厅 J08. Devouring Chamber
J08. Devouring Chamber.text:
这个巨大的厅室有着布满尖刺、覆满尘土的地面。在最西端远处有一个巨大的石盆，里面长满沼泽植物。

厚厚的一层尘土覆盖着散落满地的破碎水晶碎片，这是数百名入会者被抽取灵魂的证据。破碎水晶使地面成为困难地形，并对隐匿检定施加–5环境减值，但对任何非赤足者都不危险。赤足生物在该房间内每次结束一次Stride时承受5点穿刺伤害。

遭遇

严重 10

@Actor[QnbMaJPU7jG4uhaC]{噬魂者（3）}

120 XP

三只被称为噬魂者的强大恐怖鬼火漂浮在此。作为空无之窟（区域 @UUID[.a9b40LjI7QwLgirk]{J20}）邪恶能量的延伸，它们将此处释放的灵魂导入那个厅室。没有更多灵魂，它们无法回到空无之窟，甚至无法离开这个房间。

当英雄到来时，浮沉的鬼火要求英雄从隔壁房间取来水晶球体并在此处砸碎。它们不会承认这样做会让它们得以返回空无之窟，但可能会坚持（确实如此）这么做会使它们从这里消失。英雄每砸碎一个球体，就会有一只噬魂者熄灭消失；英雄将在空无之窟再次面对它们。

如果噬魂者看清英雄不会配合，它们就会攻击英雄，试图杀死他们，并将其灵魂作为空无之窟的燃料。噬魂者会一次围攻一名英雄，在其目标死亡后转而攻击另一名英雄。每有一名英雄在此房间被杀死，就会立刻有一只噬魂者返回空无之窟。

被窃之魂

在此房间死亡的英雄，其一部分灵魂会被窃取以驱动空无之窟。该英雄仍可如常被复活，但他们获得@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭（状态） 1}状态，且在一年内无法将其毁灭（状态）降低到1以下。

XP奖励

若英雄应对了这些噬魂者并通过灵魂挑战，则奖励英雄30 XP。

This large chamber has a spiny, dust-covered floor. On the far western end is a large stone basin filled with swamp plants.

A thick layer of dust covers the shattered crystal shards littering the floor, evidence of hundreds of initiates’ extracted souls. The broken crystal makes the ground difficult terrain and inflicts a –5 circumstance penalty to Stealth checks, but it isn’t dangerous to anyone who isn’t barefoot. Barefoot creatures take 5 piercing damage at the end of each Stride in the room.

Encounter

Severe 10

@Actor[QnbMaJPU7jG4uhaC]{Soul Feeders (3)}

120 XP

Three powerful dread wisps called soul feeders float here. As extensions of the evil energies of the Empty Vault (area @UUID[.a9b40LjI7QwLgirk]{J20}), they funnel souls released here into that chamber. They can’t return to the Empty Vault, or even leave this room, without more souls.

When the heroes arrive, the bobbing wisps demand that the heroes gather the crystal globes from the next room and smash them here. They don’t admit that doing so frees them to return to the Empty Vault but might insist (truthfully) that doing so will cause them to vanish from here. One soul feeder winks out for each sphere the heroes smash; the heroes will face them again in the Empty Vault.

If it becomes clear to the soul feeders that the heroes aren’t going to comply, they attack the heroes in an attempt to kill them and use their souls as the fuel for the Empty Vault instead. Soul feeders gang up on one hero at a time, moving on to another when their target is dead. Each hero killed in this room returns one soul feeder to the Empty Vault immediately.

Stolen Soul

A hero who dies in this room has a portion of their soul stolen to power the Empty Vault. The hero can be raised as normal, but they gain the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} condition and can’t reduce their doomed condition below 1 for a year.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for dealing with these soul feeders and passing the Challenge of Souls.

J09. Second Challenge.name: J09. 第二项挑战 J09. Second Challenge
J09. Second Challenge.text:
这间大厅看起来很像北边的房间，只是西侧的灰色门上雕刻的是惊恐的面孔而非迷雾，而且这里有三根金属管而非两根。芦苇与沼泽水构成的水盆在南侧。

此处是受训者开始“绝望挑战”的地方。南侧的门以及管道中的机械虹膜开口与区域 @UUID[.GZNjyAZgRDgPx68z]{J01} 中的类似。西墙上的门未上锁，并通往第二项测试。

如果女士的耳语正带领英雄们通过这些挑战，它会默默指向西侧的门。第二只恐怖鬼火在女士的耳语身旁潜随，移动到水盆上方悬停，并将英雄的移动默默汇报给贝科拉。英雄们一旦穿过那扇门，女士的耳语便会打开通往区域 @UUID[.mNKZFTEUn2ag0OSn]{J14} 的门，并在那里等待英雄们，在穿过门后将其关闭。

This chamber looks much like the room to the north, except the gray door to the west is carved with frightened faces rather than mist, and there are three metal tubes rather than two. The basin of reeds and swamp water is to the south.

This is where initiates began the Challenge of Despair. The south doors and mechanical iris openings in the tubes are similar to those in area @UUID[.GZNjyAZgRDgPx68z]{J01}. The door on the west wall is unlocked and leads to second test.

If Lady’s Whisper is leading the heroes through the challenges, it points silently at the western door. The second dread wisp shadowing Lady’s Whisper moves to hover above the basin and silently report the heroes’ movements to Belcorra. Once the heroes are through the door, Lady’s Whisper opens the doors to area @UUID[.mNKZFTEUn2ag0OSn]{J14} and awaits the heroes there, closing the doors after moving through them.

J10. Path of Pleasant Memories.name: J10. 愉悦回忆之路 J10. Path of Pleasant Memories
J10. Path of Pleasant Memories.text:
这条狭长走廊的墙壁片刻间呈现出刺目的纯白，但很快便有绚丽的影像在其上盘旋流动。走廊两端各有一扇门。

强力幻象

@Macro[RSuO0bzkA10DXFry]{J10 - Visions}

当英雄开始经历本房间所述的幻象时，你可以使用此宏来启用光照效果，以配合你的描述。

此处以及构成绝望灵光挑战的道路上的幻象（区域 @UUID[.kzauNC4XPJrmBf4e]{J11} 与 @UUID[.xiziHQMNSOhwPi4t]{J12}）由隐秘魔法提供动力。每位观者所见影像各不相同，因为这些影像都是从观者心智中抽取的记忆拼凑而成的一锅杂烩。你可以从本冒险路径中英雄的胜利、友谊以及有趣的遭遇中取材来描述这些影像。一名靠近西侧门的英雄必须尝试一次 @Check[type:will|dc:24]{意志} 豁免；若失败，该英雄会被幻象影像入迷 24 小时。处于入迷期间，该英雄在区域 J10 至 J12 内的所有速度都受到 –10 尺减值，且无法在同区域内对这些影像 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.UWdRX1VelipCzrCg]{转移目光}。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

两扇暗门让邪教徒得以在各项挑战之间快速穿行。英雄在此走廊进行搜索时，成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定即可发现北侧暗门，成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:30|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定即可发现南侧暗门。两扇门都可通过操纵墙上一处比周围石材略暗的区域来开启。南侧暗门仅为单向；英雄可以用它来取得进入区域 @UUID[.xiziHQMNSOhwPi4t]{J12} 的许可，但无法返回。

 

The walls of this long, narrow hall are momentarily stark white, but colorful images soon swirl upon them. A door stands at each end of the hall.

Powerful Visions

@Macro[RSuO0bzkA10DXFry]{J10 - Visions}

When the heroes begin to experience the visions described in this room, you can use this macro to enable lighting effects to accompany your descriptions.

Occult magic powers the illusions here and along the path that constitutes the Challenge of Despair (areas @UUID[.kzauNC4XPJrmBf4e]{J11} and @UUID[.xiziHQMNSOhwPi4t]{J12}). Each viewer sees different images, as they’re all a hodgepodge of memories drawn from the viewers’ mind. You might draw upon the heroes’ victories, friendships, and amusing encounters in this Adventure Path to describe the images. A hero who approaches the western door must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:24]{Will} saving throw; on a failure, the hero is entranced by the illusory images for 24 hours. While so entranced, the hero takes a –10-foot penalty to all Speeds in areas J10 to J12 and can’t @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.UWdRX1VelipCzrCg]{Avert their Gaze} from the images in the same areas.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Two secret doors allowed cultists to cut quickly between the challenges. Heroes Searching this hall discover the secret door to the north with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{Perception} check and the secret door to the south with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:30|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. Each is opened by manipulating a nearby section of the wall that’s slightly darker than the surrounding stone. The secret door to the south is one-way only; the heroes can use it to access area @UUID[.xiziHQMNSOhwPi4t]{J12} but can’t come back.

J11. Path of Failure.name: J11. 失败之路 J11. Path of Failure
J11. Path of Failure.text:
这条通道在那扇狭窄的单扇门对面变宽并向南转弯。其墙壁上满是翻涌旋转的图像，令人眼花缭乱。

强大的幻象

@Macro[F36cbZOxZIumCnTr]{J11 - Visions}

当英雄们开始体验本房间中描述的幻象时，你可以使用这个宏来启用照明效果，以配合你的描述。

这条走廊中的神秘魔法会从观看者身上拉出个性化的记忆，如同区域 @UUID[.YtiItJUQB7PEc61I]{J10}，但这些记忆全都是失败：导师训斥观看者、当权者惩罚他们，或逝去的朋友哭泣。你也可以取材于英雄在本冒险路径中经历过的任何重大失败，例如不得不逃离某个强敌或触发一个造成伤害的陷阱。

危害

@Actor[9BEHjBWRs0st7IVv]{失败之影像}

16 XP

本房间的图像会钻入受害者的心智。英雄们可以通过这些图像@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.UWdRX1VelipCzrCg]{转移目光}，并获得该动作对本危害所要求的豁免检定的加值，尽管这些幻觉并非仅仅是视觉上的。

This path widens and turns south opposite the single narrow door. Its walls are a riot of swirling images.

Powerful Visions

@Macro[F36cbZOxZIumCnTr]{J11 - Visions}

When the heroes begin to experience the visions described in this room, you can use this macro to enable lighting effects to accompany your descriptions.

The occult magic in this hall pulls personalized memories from the viewer, as in area @UUID[.YtiItJUQB7PEc61I]{J10}, but these memories are all failures: mentors scolding the viewer, authorities punishing them, or lost friends crying. You can also pull from any significant failures a hero had during this Adventure Path, such as needing to flee a significant foe or triggering a damaging trap.

Hazard

@Actor[9BEHjBWRs0st7IVv]{Images of Failure}

16 XP

This room’s images worm into the victim’s mind. The heroes can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.UWdRX1VelipCzrCg]{Avert their Gaze} from these images and gain that action’s bonus to saving throws required by this hazard, even though these illusions are more than merely visual.

J12. Path of Powerlessness.name: J12. 无力之路 J12. Path of Powerlessness
J12. Path of Powerlessness.text:
这条长厅的墙壁、地板与天花板上翻涌着层层重叠、不断变换的影像。

这条走廊的神秘魔法会显现从观者心智中汲取的影像，如同区域 @UUID[.YtiItJUQB7PEc61I]{J10} 与 @UUID[.kzauNC4XPJrmBf4e]{J11} 那样，但这些影像预示着未来的失败。观者会看到自己日渐衰弱、屈服于疾病，或在与贝科拉的战斗中坠落。

通往北方的密门无法从这一侧开启。东方的密门是唯一能离开并完成绝望灵光挑战的方法；那些没能找到这处隐藏出口的人最终都死于影像带来的折磨。任何距离密门超过20尺的人都因重叠影像而看不见它，但任何在20尺内、并在区域中进行 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{（Seeks）动作} 的人，只要成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:27|traits:action:seek]{察觉} 检定就能发现它。 

危害

@Actor[fvijt2whssxJzxCF]{无力影像}

16 XP

这个陷阱类似于区域 @UUID[.kzauNC4XPJrmBf4e]{J11} 中的那个，不过它的区域要大得多，因为它充满了整条长走廊。若英雄愿意，他们同样可以对该陷阱中的影像使用 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.UWdRX1VelipCzrCg]{转移目光}。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜查}

对走廊进行搜查的英雄（当陷阱处于启用状态时无法这么做，因为英雄处于遭遇模式而非探索模式）会自动找到密门。

The walls, floor, and ceiling of this long hall swirl with overlapping, shifting images.

This hall’s occult magic manifests images drawn from the viewer’s mind, as in areas @UUID[.YtiItJUQB7PEc61I]{J10} and @UUID[.kzauNC4XPJrmBf4e]{J11}, but these images predict failure in the future. Viewers see themselves growing infirm, succumbing to disease, or falling in battle against Belcorra.

The secret door leading north doesn’t open from this side. The secret door to the east is the only way to leave and complete the Challenge of Despair; those who couldn’t find this hidden exit eventually died from the torment in the images. Anyone more than 20 feet from the secret door can’t see it due to the overlapping images, but anyone within 20 feet who @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seeks} in the area discovers it with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:27|traits:action:seek]{Perception} check. 

Hazard

@Actor[fvijt2whssxJzxCF]{Images of Powerlessness}

16 XP

This trap is similar to the one in area @UUID[.kzauNC4XPJrmBf4e]{J11}, though its area is much larger, as it fills the entire long hallway. The heroes can also @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.UWdRX1VelipCzrCg]{Avert their Gaze} from the images in this trap as well, if they choose.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A hero who Searches the hall (which isn’t possible while the trap is active, as the heroes are in encounter mode rather than exploration mode) finds the secret door automatically.

J13. Chamber of Reflection.name: J13. 反思密室 J13. Chamber of Reflection
J13. Chamber of Reflection.text:
这间空荡房间的墙壁洁白而朴素。

通过了绝望灵光挑战的受训者被允许在这处灵能庇护所停留，在面对下一项考验之前进行恢复。

XP Award

在通过绝望灵光挑战后抵达此房间，给予英雄30 XP。

The walls of this bare room are white and plain.

Initiates who passed the Challenge of Despair were permitted to stop in this psychic refuge to recover before facing the next test.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for reaching this room after passing the Challenge of Despair.

J14. Third Challenge.name: J14. 第三项挑战 J14. Third Challenge
J14. Third Challenge.text:
这个巨大的房间北面有一对黑石双开门，南面则有一块巨大的粗凿岩石板阻挡通道。两根金属管从东墙伸入房间。它们的机械虹膜都处于打开状态。

阻挡南侧通道的岩石板，是两块作为巨大门扇运作的石板之一。两者之间只有几英寸的缝隙。这些门格外坚固，除女士的耳语之外，其他人唯一能打开它们的方法就是把它们砸倒（硬度 20，每块 80 生命值）。

通过绝望灵光的挑战

女士的耳语会在此与从区域 J13 进入的英雄们会面。一名英雄若在进行用于@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{察言观色}的 @Check[type:perception|dc:22|traits:action:sense-motive]{察觉} 检定时成功，便会意识到女士的耳语对英雄们通过感到愤怒。若大成功，该英雄会意识到：如果他们继续通过宁布洛斯的考验，女士的耳语计划背叛他们。

女士的耳语指向打开的管道。当英雄们通过管道离开时，它会在他们身后关闭虹膜传送门，然后将石板抬起到足以进入区域 @UUID[.yu0TAevCvs4s8Fql]{J18} 的高度，并在那里再次等待英雄们。

This large room has double doors of black stone to the north and an enormous slab of rough-hewn rock blocking passage to the south. Two metal tubes jut into this room from the east wall. Both of their mechanical irises are open.

The slab of rock blocking the passage south is one of two slabs that function as enormous doors. There’s a gap of only a few inches between them. The doors are particularly sturdy, and the only way for anyone other than Lady’s Whisper to open them is to smash them down (Hardness 20, 80 Hit Points each).

Passing the Challenge of Despair

Lady’s Whisper meets the heroes who enter from area J13 here. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:22|traits:action:sense-motive]{Perception} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} realizes that Lady’s Whisper is angry that the heroes passed. On a critical success, the hero realizes that Lady’s Whisper plans to betray them if they keep passing Nhimbaloth’s tests.

Lady’s Whisper points to the open pipes. When the heroes exit through the pipes, it closes the iris portals after them and then raises the stone slabs enough to enter area @UUID[.yu0TAevCvs4s8Fql]{J18}, where it again waits for the heroes.

J15. Deadly Swamp.name: J15. 致命沼泽 J15. Deadly Swamp
J15. Deadly Swamp.text:
通往这间大厅的管道以一段落差结束（从区域 @UUID[.GZNjyAZgRDgPx68z]{J01} 起落差25英尺，从区域 @UUID[.HIyVCXXLryTcvTX0]{J09} 起落差20英尺，从区域 @UUID[.mNKZFTEUn2ag0OSn]{J14} 起落差15英尺）。在所有情况下，落点都是恶臭的沼泽烂泥，因此坠落的生物不会受到伤害，但会引起此房间住民的注意。

这座巨大的洞窟是一片浓密的沼泽，潮湿而臭气熏天。沼泽茂密的芦苇间隐约可见七个锈蚀的金属箱。洞窟南端是一道圆弧形金属坝，已经向上滑起，因此只有一股持续的细流从靠近天花板的坝顶滴落。大坝两侧的古老道具似乎能够将其放下，不过锈迹斑斑的痕迹显示它们已经很久没有移动过了。在洞窟较低的北端，沼泽水流入一间阴暗、被水淹没的房间。

这间房间的环境呼应了宁布洛斯死寂世界“虚空之蕨”的剧毒地形。“沼泽挑战”很简单：活下来，找到打开大坝的方法，并进入区域 @UUID[.8bFODbBUtuHOV9HL]{J17}。

此区域为困难地形：水不深，但下方地面黏陷且险恶。此外，沼泽中的空气有毒。任何生物在沼泽中开始其回合时，必须在一次 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:27]{强韧} 豁免上成功，否则会变为 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}（大成功或大失败中的大失败时为 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 4}），且在沼泽中无法降低其恶心（状态）。无论该生物在豁免中是否成功，随后都会在10分钟内获得临时免疫。这是一个毒素效果。

遭遇

中等 10

@Actor[tXfiVIThQlBT6B1H]{虚空之蕨甲伏怪（3）}

80 XP

在英雄们能做太多事情之前，他们必须先应对三只被虚空之蕨的邪秽能量灌注的甲伏怪。甲伏怪会战斗到被杀死为止。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{调查}

在此处进行搜索的英雄会斑点到三根锈蚀的金属管道，它们就在沼泽水与杂草的下方延伸。这些管道连接到锈蚀的金属箱（地图上已标注），是用于放下大坝的控制系统的一部分。

在一次 @Check[type:crafting|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{制作}、@Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{盗窃} 或 工程学学识 检定以回忆知识时成功的英雄会意识到，这些管道对控制大坝很重要；在大成功或大失败中的大成功时，该英雄还会意识到它们连接到更北面的控制装置（位于区域 @UUID[.IRSNx7dn1ps2j7R3]{J16}）。

生锈箱体

每个箱体都有一个阀门，横向扳到一侧，指向东西方向。这是“关”位置；将其转到指向南北方向（与其下方管道的走向一致）则为“开”位置。七个箱体都必须被转到“开”位置后，区域 @UUID[.IRSNx7dn1ps2j7R3]{J16} 的控制轮才能转动。如果你的玩家喜欢谜题，你可以让每个被转动的阀门（无论朝哪个方向）都会自动转动同一根管道上以及同一排上的所有其他阀门；如此一来，玩家就需要推理出如何把它们全部转到“开”。

The pipes leading to this chamber end with a drop (25 feet from area @UUID[.GZNjyAZgRDgPx68z]{J01}, 20 feet from area @UUID[.HIyVCXXLryTcvTX0]{J09}, and 15 feet from area @UUID[.mNKZFTEUn2ag0OSn]{J14}). In all cases, the drop is into reeking swamp muck, so falling creatures take no damage but draw the attention of this room’s inhabitants.

This massive cavern is a thick swamp, moist and stinking. Seven rusted metal boxes are just visible within the dense reeds of the swamp. The south end of the cavern is a rounded metal dam that’s slid upward so only a constant trickle of water dribbles from its top, near the ceiling. Ancient gears on either side of the dam appear to lower it, though streaks of rust show they haven’t moved in quite some time. At the lower north end of the cavern, the swamp water drains into a murky, flooded room.

This room’s environment echoes the poisonous terrain of Nhimbaloth’s dead world, Voidbracken. The Challenge of the Swamp is simple: survive, find the way to open the dam, and enter area @UUID[.8bFODbBUtuHOV9HL]{J17}.

This area is difficult terrain, as the water isn’t deep, but the ground beneath it is sucking and treacherous. Further, the air in the swamp is toxic. Any creature starting its turn in the swamp must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:27]{Fortitude} saving throw or become @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4} on a critical failure) and can’t reduce its sickened condition while in the swamp. The creature is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes, whether or not it succeeded at the save. This is a poison effect.

Encounter

Moderate 10

@Actor[tXfiVIThQlBT6B1H]{Voidbracken Chuuls (3)}

80 XP

Before the heroes can do much, they must contend with a trio of chuuls imbued with Voidbracken’s vile energy. The chuuls fight until slain.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Heroes Searching this area spot three rusted metal pipes running just beneath the swamp water and weeds. These connect to the rusty metal boxes (marked on the map) and are part of the control system to lower the dam.

Heroes who succeed at a @Check[type:crafting|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Crafting}, @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Thievery}, or Engineering Lore check to Recall Knowledge realize that the pipes are important to controlling the dam; on a critical success, the hero also realizes that they connect to controls further north (in area @UUID[.IRSNx7dn1ps2j7R3]{J16}).

Rusting Boxes

Each box has a single valve turned sideways, pointing east to west. This is the “off” position; turning it to point north to south (the way the pipes run beneath them) puts it in the “on” position. All seven boxes must be turned to the “on” position before the control wheels in area @UUID[.IRSNx7dn1ps2j7R3]{J16} can turn. If your players like puzzles, you can have each valve that’s turned (in either direction) automatically turn all other valves along its pipe and in its row as well; the players then need to puzzle out how to turn them all “on.”

J16. Perilous Controls.name: J16. 危险操控装置 J16. Perilous Controls
J16. Perilous Controls.text:
沼泽水淹没了这座洞穴的大部分区域。三座小岛上各放着一个带锈蚀轮盘的金属箱。

这间房内浑浊的水看起来不比区域 @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} 的沼泽更深，但水深其实有25尺。英雄们很可能需要游泳才能抵达这些小岛。所幸，这座洞窟里的空气不像区域 @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} 那样有毒，在此处呼吸不需要进行任何豁免。

小岛上的三个轮盘控制着区域 @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} 的水坝。若在所有阀门都处于“开”位时，将它们全部完全顺时针转到底（每个都需要三次 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{交互} 动作），那里的水坝便会轰隆着向下磨落，释放出一股恶臭的沼泽水瀑流。这股涌入会使此处以及区域 @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} 的水位上升数寸。

遭遇

严重 10

@Actor[YHYdZemNHp0fnWca]{恐惧触鳍鱼怪（2）}

120 XP

水下潜伏着一对恐惧触鳍鱼怪，它们会试图伏击闯入者，并战斗至死。

Swamp water floods much of this cave. Three small islands each bear a metal box with a rusty wheel.

The murky water in this room looks no deeper than the swamp in area @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15}, but the water is 25 feet deep. The heroes will likely need to swim to reach the islands. Fortunately, the air in this cavern isn’t as toxic as that in area @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} and no saving throws are required for breathing the air here.

The three wheels on the islands control the dam in area @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15}. If all are turned fully clockwise (requiring three @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions each) while all the valves are positioned “on,” the dam there grinds downward, releasing a cascade of fetid swamp water. This influx raises the water level here and in area @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} by several inches.

Encounter

Severe 10

@Actor[YHYdZemNHp0fnWca]{Dread Dhuthorexes (2)}

120 XP

Lurking under the water are a pair of dread dhuthorexes that attempt to ambush intruders and fight to the death.

J17. Infested Reeds.name: J17. 虫群芦苇 J17. Infested Reeds
J17. Infested Reeds.text:
这个房间通常会被沼泽水淹到1英尺深：当与区域 @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} 相连的水坝关闭时，水会从空无之窟排入此处。英雄们最可能在降下水坝后从区域 @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} 进入这一区域；若他们如此进入，就已完成“沼泽的挑战”。

这间方形石室中央有一汪圆形的沼泽水池。水池由西墙上的一条水道供水，水道位于两组黑石双开门之间。水流向北，经由一座金属水坝流出。一团粗大纠结、不断扭动的芦苇结块自水池中隆起，宛如一棵怪诞的树。

水池与水道只有6英寸深，这也是水坝一旦关闭便如此容易导致房间被淹的原因。

遭遇

低 10

@Actor[kElZCC1zMQVftoi9]{Isqulug}

60 XP

这里的扭动源于伊斯库鲁格的虫群侵扰。英雄抵达时，这个怪诞的畸变会从芦苇中移出并发起攻击。尽管它是个恶意的生物，但它并不隶属于宁布洛斯，而且几乎记不得它的幼体在许多年代之前是如何来到这里的。若其生命值降至150以下，伊斯库鲁格会施放操控水位，将此房间内的水位抬升10英尺，并希望借此在战斗中获得优势。当它被摧毁时，它的幼体会在水中四散开来并滑入下方的沼泽——随着时间推移，长成新的寄主体。

This room is usually filled a foot deep with swamp water that drains from the Empty Vault when the dam connected to area @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} is closed. The heroes most likely enter this area from area @UUID[.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15} after lowering the dam; if they do, they’ve completed the Challenge of the Swamp.

A circular pool of swamp water sits at the center of this square chamber. The pool is fed by a channel in the west wall, between two sets of black stone double doors. The water flows out to the north, through a metal dam. A thick knot of writhing reeds, like a grotesque tree, rises from the pool.

The pool and channels are only six inches deep, which is why the room floods so easily when the dam is closed.

Encounter

Low 10

@Actor[kElZCC1zMQVftoi9]{Isqulug}

60 XP

The writhing here is caused by an isqulug infestation. When the heroes arrive, the grotesque aberration moves out of the reeds to attack. While a malevolent creature, it isn’t affiliated with Nhimbaloth and recalls very little about how its larvae came here ages ago. If reduced to fewer than 150 Hit Points, the isqulug casts control water to raise the water in this room by 10 feet and, it hopes, gain an advantage in the fight. When destroyed, its larvae scatter in the water and slip into the swamp below—in time, to grow a new host body.

J18. Maw of the Goddess.name: J18. 女神之喉 J18. Maw of the Goddess
J18. Maw of the Goddess.text:
这间巨大的厅室有着拱形穹顶，高达80尺，天花板上雕刻着繁复的骨骸、沼泽杂草与雾气旋涡图案。南侧矗立着一座巨大的高台，其石材被雕刻成歪斜、龟裂的牙齿。高台上安放着一颗巨大的头骨，眼窝空洞，面容狰狞。一条污浊的水渠横穿房间，从东侧与西侧墙基处涌出。每处水渠出口两侧各有一扇双开门。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}

巨型头骨后方的墙壁隐藏着一道暗门，门缝被潮气部分勾勒出来，因此比通常更容易找到。在该区域进行搜索时，成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定即可用定位术找到它。

遭遇

低 10

@Actor[dWOK0nzGWyc5NkNz]{女士的耳语}

60 XP

如果英雄们尚未击败女士的耳语，它正等待在高台之上。它并不指向任何方向，而是缓慢地向英雄们走去。它低语道：“我知道你们是冒名顶替者。亵渎者。你们不该在这里。宁布洛斯认为你们对她的计划有某种用处，但我不同意。”随后，女士的耳语会发动攻击以阻止英雄们的进展。它使用其强迫传送能力，将英雄们转移至区域 @UUID[.mNKZFTEUn2ag0OSn]{J14}，使他们不得不再次从沼泽绕行。女士的耳语会战斗直到被摧毁。

The vaulted ceiling of this massive chamber reaches eighty feet high and is carved with intricate patterns of bones, swamp weeds, and misty swirls. To the south stands a huge dais, its stone carved into crooked, cracked teeth. Upon the dais rests a massive skull, its eye sockets empty and its visage menacing. A channel of filthy water cuts across this room, emerging from the base of the walls on the east and west side. Double doors bracket each channel outlet.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

The wall behind the giant skull hides a secret door, partially outlined in moisture and easier to find than normal. A successful @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check while Searching this area locates it.

Encounter

Low 10

@Actor[dWOK0nzGWyc5NkNz]{Lady's Whisper}

60 XP

If the heroes have yet to defeat Lady’s Whisper, it’s waiting on the dais. It doesn’t point toward any direction, but instead walks slowly toward the heroes. It whispers, “I know that you are pretenders. Defilers. You should not be here. Nhimbaloth thinks you serve some purpose to her plans, but I disagree.” Lady’s Whisper then attacks to stop the heroes’ progress. It uses its unwilling teleportation ability to shunt the heroes into area @UUID[.mNKZFTEUn2ag0OSn]{J14} to come around through the swamp again. Lady’s Whisper fights until destroyed.

J19. Passage to the Depths.name: J19. 通往深处的通道 J19. Passage to the Depths
J19. Passage to the Depths.text:
一座光滑的天然洞窟在黑暗中蜿蜒前行，尽头通向一间更大的洞室，远端有一处宽阔的深坑。一具尸体瘫倒在深坑边缘。

深坑有数百尺深，并通向幽暗地域中更深处。其挑战超出了本《冒险路径》的范围。

尸体是一名外形怪异的人形生物，被胡乱杀死：双头，且有几丁质的身体。深坑中的触手蟹将其内里掏空并填入碎石，因此除非极其小心地搬动，否则一旦被惊扰就会发出哗啦作响的声音。

宝藏

这具古怪的尸体仍戴着一条奇异的@Item[mHwbLST2tqJm4F9e]{宝石颈环}，价值500 gp。

遭遇

严重 10

@Actor[10JbkieWjqKA5Hzc]{触手蟹}

120 XP

尽管这条通道已有数个世纪无人使用，但并非完全被遗弃。来自幽暗地域更深处的一只蟹状触手蟹潜伏在深坑中。当触手蟹听到上方房间里的行动声响——例如它所设置的可怖魔法警报里碎石的哗啦声——它便会沿坑壁疾速攀上，并在2 轮后抵达。若其生命值降至50以下，它会撤退，放弃到手的潜在餐食。

A smooth, natural cavern winds its way through the darkness, ending in a larger chamber with a wide pit at the far side. A corpse is slumped at the pit’s edge.

The pit is hundreds of feet deep and leads to even deeper places in the Darklands. Its challenges are beyond the scope of this Adventure Path.

The corpse is a messily killed humanoid of a strange appearance: two heads and a chitinous body. The irlgaunt in the pit hollowed it out and filled it with gravel, so it makes a clattering noise when disturbed unless it’s handled very carefully.

Treasure

The odd corpse still wears a strange @Item[mHwbLST2tqJm4F9e]{Jeweled Torc} worth 500 gp.

Encounter

Severe 10

@Actor[10JbkieWjqKA5Hzc]{Irlgaunt}

120 XP

Although this passage hasn’t been used in centuries, it isn’t wholly abandoned. A crab-like irlgaunt from deeper in the Darklands lurks in the pit. When the irlgaunt hears activity in the room above, such as the clattering of gravel from the gruesome alarm it made, it skitters up the pit and arrives in 2 rounds. It retreats, abandoning its potential meal, if reduced to fewer than 50 Hit Points.

J20. Empty Vault.name: J20。空无之窟 J20. Empty Vault
J20. Empty Vault.text:
这间形状怪异的大厅潮湿闷热，令人窒息般黏冷。房间的四个翼室里各有一座巨大的池子，池中沼泽水咕嘟翻涌。闪烁的光亮与黑暗在池面之下游走。大厅中央部分被一圈高耸的黑色立石阻隔，这些立石噼啪作响，散发出诡异能量，向上射入天花板中的竖井。七道狭窄的沟渠仿佛由一只七指之手在石头上挖掘而成，从每座池子以及其中三面墙壁延伸至房间中央的一圈壕沟。水从那里流向东侧墙下，穿过一对黑色石质双开门之间。壕沟中有一座小岛，上面立着一座光滑的祭坛，祭坛顶端放着一枚拳头大小的黑色透镜。

空无之窟一直都是为侍奉宁布洛斯的微灵所准备的孳生之坑。它是一道由沼泽、绝望与幽灵能量构成的漏斗，并在神秘层面与憎恨魔窟下层各处的沼泽植物水盆相连。任何宁布洛斯的追随者都能在此以心灵感应与这些水盆旁的微灵交流。

玫瑰团杀死贝科拉之后，空无之窟吸引了她的灵魂；在她人生最痛苦的事件过去500年后——并非她的死亡，而是她的家族被逐出艾巴萨罗姆——她的幽灵在此重新现身。贝科拉无法长时间离开这间大厅，因此她借由微灵替身与受缚的代理者在整个憎恨魔窟中贯彻她的意志。她将@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.CTiLugp5ptSItEqN]{乌木支点镜片}放在祭坛上以恢复其能量；当它位于此处时，能够重新汲取宁布洛斯本质的微光，但这需要时间。

七条沼泽水细流既危险又带毒，因为它们标记着宁布洛斯曾触及世界之处。跨过去并不困难，但它们会令人不适地拉扯穿越者的生命能量。在任意一个英雄跨越细流的回合结束时（无论是疾行、挪步、飞行或任何其他方式），该英雄必须成功通过一次@Check[type:fortitude|dc:22]{强韧}豁免，否则获得@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭（状态） 1}。该DC会在同一回合内每额外跨越一条不同的细流而提高2（例如，一名英雄在其回合跨越3条细流时，必须进行DC 26的强韧豁免）。毁灭（状态）会在后续轮次中累积。穿过水池本身不会产生此效果，因此英雄们可能会意识到，在房间里移动有比直线步行更安全的方法。这些细流对宁布洛斯的追随者没有影响，包括贝科拉与恐怖鬼火。

这些黑色石质立石帮助支撑凄凉灯塔的重量，并放射出一条扭曲的诡异能量飘带，沿竖井盘绕上升，穿过@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8pbhSFgv71lvCz9M]{B35}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.eOv6LI3wvIuKyyNJ]{C15}、@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.rVwX8eSwEBHWEjcg]{H37}与@UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.NaEg1IQHphXU25Nk]{I28}等区域。贝科拉能够操纵这条能量飘带为凄凉灯塔供能。

最终之战

若英雄们在抵达空无之窟前不久击败贝科拉，她会使用乌木支点镜片的力量加速她的复苏，以便在圣所迎战他们。

在空无之窟中，贝科拉从不投降或逃跑。英雄们有可能在尚不具备永久击败她的能力时就在此面对她。在这种情况下，他们需要撤退，收集支点镜片后再回来与她再战。只要英雄们能够将宁布洛斯的凝视聚焦在贝科拉身上，就能彻底击败这名术士。

摧毁贝科拉

贝科拉只有在完成她对艾巴萨罗姆施加嗜血复仇的目标后才会停止复苏——但仍有另一种方法能永绝她的恶行。宁布洛斯——吞噬者——可以将这名幽灵彻底湮灭，使她不再烦扰世间。要引起隐居而非人的宁布洛斯的注意并不容易，但贝科拉因过度依赖@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.CTiLugp5ptSItEqN]{乌木支点镜片}而为此铺好了道路。由于贝科拉频繁动用该物品中宁布洛斯本质的微光，宁布洛斯已倾向于将其吞灵的注意力转向贝科拉。英雄们必须通过将@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.yAqGhT0GuZrkvWZl]{猩红支点镜片}、@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.IS1P6er2hLyKXAss]{翡翠支点镜片}与@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.I2ul8Bzcth7sleow]{赭石支点镜片}中的宁布洛斯本质碎片灌注进贝科拉体内来强化这种联系（通过@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.JwHNSaiwwqF7VCC5]{支点晶格}更容易做到，但并非绝对必要）。每一片碎片都会赋予贝科拉更多力量，但三者齐备（并建立在她过往使用乌木支点镜片的基础上）将把宁布洛斯恐怖的目光引向其幽灵信徒。

遭遇

极限 10

@Actor[DDJGNAh3rfyIupAb]{哈鲁维克斯} @Actor[QnbMaJPU7jG4uhaC]{灵魂饲喂者（1至4）}

180 XP

若贝科拉尚未复苏，当英雄们抵达时，乌木支点镜片会自动令她复苏。她因又一群冒险者竟敢在她的圣所中反抗她而怒不可遏，于是以全部狂怒发动攻击。贝科拉会将攻击集中在任何携带支点镜片的人身上，尤其是将镜片装在支点晶格中的英雄。她意识到这些镜片是强力武器，可被用来对付她。

这里始终有一名灵魂饲喂者在场。若英雄们曾在区域J8向灵魂饲喂者献上灵魂，它们也会来到此处并与贝科拉并肩作战；这会使遭遇尤为艰难！

贝科拉与灵魂饲喂者利用立石作为掩护快速穿梭，试图引诱英雄跨越会引发毁灭（状态）的沼泽水细流。

当英雄们用猩红支点镜片、翡翠支点镜片与赭石支点镜片中的碎片灌注贝科拉时，宁布洛斯将为她而来，她会被永远摧毁。当英雄们如此行事时，继续阅读下方的“宁布洛斯降临”。

宁布洛斯降临

当英雄们将宁布洛斯的三枚碎片全数灌注进贝科拉体内后，大地震颤。一声巨大而骇人的哀嚎从这间大厅之外的某处传来——确切地说，似乎来自材料位面之外。憎恨魔窟中的所有生物必须成功通过一次@Check[type:will|dc:30]{意志}豁免，否则成为@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐惧 3}（大失败的生物还会@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}[[/r 1d4]]轮）。在下一轮开始时，宁布洛斯的本质弥漫整个房间。

可怖的黑灰色雾气渗入房间。它散发着腐臭沼泽的恶臭，并在所经之处留下令人作呕的黏滑水膜。雾气不断扭曲变形，七指触须在雾中时隐时现。

这种雾化的化身无法被攻击或伤害。它涌入贝科拉体内，贝科拉尖叫道：“不！我应得的是你的力量，不是你的注视！我的死亡充满愤怒与力量——它并不空无！”尽管她如此抗议，贝科拉的形体仍被雾气撕扯分解，随后雾气消散无踪。

高空传来巨大刺耳的碾磨声。凄凉灯塔——贝科拉最伟大的作品——正一层接一层地崩塌。随着每一轮过去，这件奇物会沿着灯塔的占地投影下坠一个地下城等级（但不会影响憎恨魔窟的其余部分！），并将其正下方的一切彻底抹消。在第9轮时，它会坍塌进这间大厅，摧毁此处所有东西——到那时，英雄们最好早已离开。

结局

贝科拉被摧毁后，奥塔里与艾巴萨罗姆将免于她恶毒阴谋的威胁。英雄们在奥塔里会受到热烈欢迎，人人都想围着友善的炉火，配上美食与好几杯酒，聆听他们的故事。英雄们的传说将被讲述、复述，并在世世代代中不断添油加醋。

凄凉灯塔不复存在，雾隐沼泽中的深坑是它曾屹立之处的唯一标记。潜伏其中的危险也许有朝一日会重拾力量，威胁地表——但那将是属于另一批英雄的故事。

This strangely shaped chamber is humid and oppressively clammy. The room’s four wings each contain a massive pool of bubbling swamp water. Flickering motes of light and darkness play underneath the surface of the pools. The chamber’s center is partially blocked by a circle of towering black standing stones, which crackle with eerie energy that shoots up into a shaft in the ceiling. Seven narrow channels, as though dug into the stone by a seven-fingered hand, run from each pool and three of the walls to a moat in the center of the room. From there, the water flows under the wall to the east, between a pair of black stone double doors. An island in the moat holds a smooth altar topped with a black lens the size of a fist.

The Empty Vault has always been a generation pit for the wisps who serve Nhimbaloth. A funnel of swamp, despair, and ghostly energies, it’s mystically connected to the various swamp plant basins throughout the lower Abomination Vaults. Any follower of Nhimbaloth can telepathically communicate with wisps adjacent to the basins from here.

The Empty Vault drew Belcorra’s soul after the Roseguard killed her, and her ghost reappeared here 500 years after the most traumatic event in her life—not her death, but her family’s exile from Absalom. Belcorra can’t leave this chamber for long, so she uses her wisp proxies and bound agents to enact her will throughout the Abomination Vaults. She keeps the @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.CTiLugp5ptSItEqN]{Ebon Fulcrum Lens} on the altar to restore its energies; while here, it can regain its glimmers of Nhimbaloth’s essence, but this takes time.

The seven swamp water rivulets are both dangerous and noxious, as they mark where Nhimbaloth once touched the world. It’s a simple matter to step over them, but they pull unpleasantly at the life energy of anyone who crosses them. At the end of any turn in which a hero crosses a rivulet (whether by Striding, Stepping, Flying, or any other means), the hero must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:22]{Fortitude} save or become @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. This DC increases by 2 for each additional unique rivulet crossed during that turn (for example, a hero who crosses over 3 rivulets in their turn must attempt a DC 26 Fortitude saving throw). The doomed condition is cumulative on subsequent rounds. Crossing the pools doesn’t have this effect, so the heroes might learn that there are safer ways to move about the room than simply walking in a direct line. The rivulets have no effect on followers of Nhimbaloth, including Belcorra and the dread wisps.

The black stone menhirs help support Gauntlight’s weight and emit the twisting ribbon of eerie energy that writhes up the shaft through areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8pbhSFgv71lvCz9M]{B35}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.eOv6LI3wvIuKyyNJ]{C15}, @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.rVwX8eSwEBHWEjcg]{H37}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.NaEg1IQHphXU25Nk]{I28}. Belcorra can manipulate this ribbon of energy to power Gauntlight.

The Final Battle

If the heroes defeat Belcorra shortly before they reach the Empty Vault, she uses the power of the Ebon Fulcrum Lens to hasten her rejuvenation so she can face them in her sanctum.

Belcorra doesn't ever surrender or flee in the Empty Vault. The heroes could possibly face her here without yet having the ability to permanently defeat her. In this case, they'll need to retreat to collect the fulcrum lenses and return to face her again. Once the heroes can focus Nhimbaloth's gaze upon Belcorra, they can defeat the sorcerer for good.

Destroying Belcorra

Belcorra only stops rejuvenating once she completes her goal of inflicting murderous revenge upon Absalom—but there’s another way to end her villainy for good. Nhimbaloth, the devourer of spirits, can utterly annihilate the ghost so she troubles the world no longer. Drawing the reclusive and inhuman Nhimbaloth’s attention isn’t easy, but Belcorra laid the groundwork for this by relying so heavily upon the @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.CTiLugp5ptSItEqN]{Ebon Fulcrum Lens}. Nhimbaloth is already inclined to turn her spirit-consuming attention to Belcorra because Belcorra has made frequent use of the glimmers of Nhimbaloth’s essence within the item. The heroes must strengthen this contact by imbuing Belcorra with the splinters of Nhimbaloth’s essence in the @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.yAqGhT0GuZrkvWZl]{Crimson Fulcrum Lens}, the @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.IS1P6er2hLyKXAss]{Emerald Fulcrum Lens}, and the @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.I2ul8Bzcth7sleow]{Ochre Fulcrum Lens} (it’s easier to do so via the @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.JwHNSaiwwqF7VCC5]{Fulcrum Lattice}, but that item isn’t strictly required). Each splinter gives Belcorra a bit more power, but all three together (building upon her past use of the Ebon Fulcrum Lens) draw Nhimbaloth’s dread gaze to her ghostly devotee.

Encounter

Extreme 10

@Actor[DDJGNAh3rfyIupAb]{Belcorra Haruvex} @Actor[QnbMaJPU7jG4uhaC]{Soul Feeders (1 to 4)}

180 XP

If Belcorra hasn’t yet rejuvenated, the Ebon Fulcrum Lens automatically rejuvenates her when the heroes arrive. She’s so incensed that another group of adventurers would dare to oppose her in her sanctum that she attacks with her full fury. Belcorra focuses her attacks on anyone who carries fulcrum lenses, especially a hero who carries them in the Fulcrum Lattice. She realizes that the lenses are potent weapons that can be used against her.

There’s one soul feeder here at all times. If the heroes presented souls to the soul feeders in area J8, they’ve come here and also fight at Belcorra’s side; this makes the encounter particularly challenging!

Belcorra and the soul feeders use the menhirs for cover as they dart about, hoping to draw the heroes over the doom-inducing rivulets of swamp water.

When the heroes infuse Belcorra with splinters in the Crimson Fulcrum Lens, the Emerald Fulcrum Lens, and the Ochre Fulcrum Lens, Nhimbaloth comes for her, and she’s forever destroyed. When the heroes do this, proceed to Nhimbaloth’s Entrance below.

Nhimbaloth’s Entrance

Once the heroes infuse Belcorra with all three of Nhimbaloth’s splinters, the earth shakes. A tremendous and hideous wail emanates from somewhere beyond this chamber—indeed, it seems, from beyond the Material Plane. All creatures in the Abomination Vaults must succeed a @Check[type:will|dc:30]{Will} save or become @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} (a creature that critically fails is also @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for [[/r 1d4]] rounds). At the start of the following round, Nhimbaloth’s essence pervades the room.

A terrible, blackish-gray mist seeps into the room. It stinks of a fetid bog and leaves a layer of cloying, slimy water upon everything it passes. The mist twists in shape and form, with seven-fingered tentacles appearing and disappearing in the fog.

This misty incarnation can’t be attacked or damaged. It flows into Belcorra, who shrieks, “No! I deserve your power, not your attention! My death is full of rage and strength—it is not empty!” Despite these protestations, Belcorra’s form is pulled apart into the mist, and the mist vanishes.

An immense grinding noise comes from high above. Gauntlight, Belcorra’s greatest work, is collapsing, one level at a time. With each passing round, the artifact drops one dungeon level along the lighthouse’s footprint (but not in the rest of the Abomination Vaults!), obliterating anything directly beneath it. In the 9th round, it collapses into this chamber, destroying everything here—by then, the heroes would best be gone.

Conclusion

With Belcorra destroyed, Otari and Absalom are safe from her spiteful schemes. The heroes receive a warm welcome in Otari, and everyone wants to hear their tales over a friendly fire, good food, and more than a few drinks. The heroes are told, retold, and embellished upon for generations.

Gauntlight is no more, and only the pit in the Fogfen marks the spot it once stood. The dangers lurking there might one day regain their strength and menace the surface—but those are tales for other heroes.

Chapter 10: To Draw the Baleful Glare.name: 第10章：引来凶恶的凝视 Chapter 10: To Draw the Baleful Glare
Chapter 10: To Draw the Baleful Glare.text:
章节概要

英雄们将在本章与贝科拉展开最终对决。前往空无之窟——贝科拉所在之处——的路上，他们会经历若干挑战，这些挑战源自此地仍是空无之死活跃神殿时，宁布洛斯的追随者所要面对的考验。讽刺的是，憎恨魔窟的这一最低等级反而是最安全的地方之一：其居民通常安分不动，而英雄们可以在空房间中按需休息任意长的时间。他们需要以最佳状态迎战贝科拉；若他们到现在仍未集齐三枚支点镜片，可能需要撤退、找回镜片，然后再次面对贝科拉。

神殿

也许地下室的少数居民知道宁布洛斯远古神殿的真实故事——尤其是女士的耳语，以及可能的一两只恐怖鬼火——但无人会讲述这段往事。它究竟是某个古老敌人将一个教团深深打入土中的枢纽，还是幽暗地域密社的总部？不论其最初用途为何，这一连串复杂的入会试炼，是英雄们在对抗贝科拉前必须面对的最后挑战。第一项是灵魂挑战，不配的入会者会被下毒、折磨，并被抽取灵魂。第二项是绝望灵光挑战，入会者将直面他们最深的恐惧。最后一项考验是沼泽挑战，入会者需展示他们对沼泽险境的掌控。若由女士的耳语引导，英雄们很可能会按顺序遭遇这些试炼；否则，他们可以按自己想要的任何顺序进行。再往前便是空无之窟——贝科拉的领地，也是凄凉灯塔力量的源头。

环境线索：

黑色石材、骨骸或雾气雕刻、湿冷空气、诡异灯光、浓雾、沼泽植物。

特征

神殿整体一片黑暗，除非另有说明。天花板通常高15英尺，但在主厅（区域 J1、J9、J14、J18 与 J20）高达60英尺。所有石门上都刻有繁复雕纹，例如长满苔藓的骷髅、盘旋雾气或细致的沼泽场景，以及七处杂草簇。女士的耳语控制着此处的门。

Chapter Synopsis

The heroes have their final confrontation with Belcorra in this chapter. On the way to the Empty Vault, where Belcorra can be found, they pass through several challenges that aspirants of Nhimbaloth faced back when this was an active temple to the Empty Death. Ironically, this lowest level of the Abomination Vaults is one of the safest, in that its denizens generally stay put and the heroes can rest for as long as they need in empty chambers. They’ll need to be in top form to tackle Belcorra; if they haven’t collected all three fulcrum lenses by now, they might need to retreat, recover them, and face Belcorra again.

The Temple

Perhaps a few of the vaults’ inhabitants know the true story of Nhimbaloth’s ancient temple—notably Lady’s Whisper and maybe a dread wisp or two—but none will tell the tale. Was it the hub of a cult cast deep into the earth by some ancient enemy, or the headquarters of a Darklands cabal? No matter its original purpose, the complex series of initiation trials are the last challenges that the heroes must face to confront Belcorra. The first is the Challenge of Souls, where unworthy initiates were poisoned, tormented, and had their souls extracted. The second is the Challenge of Despair, where initiates faced their greatest fears. The last test is the Challenge of the Swamp, where initiates demonstrated their mastery over swampland dangers. The heroes are likely to face these in order only if guided by Lady's Whisper; otherwise, they’re free to tackle them in whatever order they’d like. Beyond lies the Empty Vault, Belcorra’s domain and the source of Gauntlight’s powers.

Environmental Cues:

Black stone, carvings of bones or mist, clammy air, eerie lights, fog, swamp plants.

Features

The temple is wholly dark, except where otherwise noted. Ceilings are generally 15 feet high but reach 60 feet in the main chambers (areas J1, J9, J14, J18, and J20). The stone doors all bear intricate carvings, such as a moss-filled skull, swirling mists, or detailed swamp scenes, as well as clusters of seven divots. Lady's Whisper controls the doors here.

Belcorra Haruvex.name: 贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯 Belcorra Haruvex
Belcorra Haruvex.text:
这是镇上父母之间流行的一首童谣所发出的警告；他们常在夜里把这首旋律动听却令人不安的小诗唱给@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{奥塔里}的孩子听，以鼓励良好行为。结果，每个在奥塔里长大的人，对雾隐沼泽外的古老废墟与那座矗立在沼泽之心的奇异灯塔，都怀有一种由恐惧(术)、敬畏与好奇交织而成的复杂情绪。随着年岁增长，镇民会学到更被普遍认可的“真相”：奥塔里的英勇奠基者在许多年前杀死了邪恶的术士贝科拉。有一段时代里，寻求刺激的人探索过那座名为凄凉灯塔的灯塔周围的废墟，但到了今天，常识认为那里已成害虫的巢穴——在被彻底搜刮一空后，不再是活跃的危险源，也不再有重要宝藏。毕竟贝科拉被击败至今将近500年了，而在这段时代里，她对奥塔里的威胁只存在于阴森的童谣之中。

至少奥塔里的市民是这么相信的。

虽然关于贝科拉的许多古老传说确有其事（例如，她确实实行过食人——只是并不把饮食范围限制在愚蠢的孩子身上），但“她不再构成威胁”的想法却是错的。两年前，在她生命中最重要事件的500周年纪念日——她的家族因可憎仪式而被逐出艾巴萨罗姆——贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯恶毒的幽灵（特征）在凄凉灯塔要塞深处苏醒。灯塔与周边废墟不过是一座庞大设施的最高等级；贝科拉曾在其中塞满恶意而致命的生物：她的憎恨魔窟。几个世纪间，她的怨毒不断发酵，她渴求复仇——不仅要向摧毁她家族的艾巴萨罗姆复仇，也要向奥塔里及其奠基者复仇——那些杀死她的英雄。贝科拉潜伏等待，争取时代重建自身，重新为令人战栗的凄凉灯塔注入能量，并重新确立她对憎恨魔窟中那些野化且被遗忘的怪物的统治！

贝科拉的历史

幽灵术士贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯是《憎恨魔窟》冒险路径的主要反派。她怨毒怒火背后的故事，是一段流放与失落的故事。

哈鲁维克斯家族谱系既枝繁叶茂，又因术法之力而澎湃涌动。家族最强的血脉带有异怪的脉络，这既为家族带来声望，也赋予其术士力量。数代哈鲁维克斯家族成员在家族内部通婚以强化这条血脉，而最强大的哈鲁维克斯们在500年前居住于艾巴萨罗姆。这些艾巴萨罗姆的哈鲁维克斯暗中向外神俯首称臣，以换取巨额财富与更强大的力量。然而，家族中无人能接近其最年轻后裔——贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯——所拥有的力量。贝科拉从有记忆起，几乎每天都被告知：她是宁布洛斯——空无之死——的先兆，是家族获取力量与繁荣的最大希望。

哈鲁维克斯在其崇拜中施行可憎仪式，包括血腥献祭，而当局最终嗅到了他们罪行的风声。哈鲁维克斯家族终于在4219 ar被赶出寇托斯岛，被迫把产业与奢华尽数抛在身后。当时贝科拉只有6岁，但随着她长大，失去家园的愤怒逐渐凝结成对艾巴萨罗姆及其中所有人的滔天仇恨。

大多数被流放的哈鲁维克斯在贫困中死去，但贝科拉却变得强大而骄傲。17岁时，她解读了来自宁布洛斯的幻象，并因此返回寇托斯岛来筹划复仇。在一处远离人烟的林地海岸上——距离艾巴萨罗姆数十英里——有一座名为空无之窟的地下宁布洛斯圣所；贝科拉在其上方建起了一座魔法灯塔，并称其为@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{凄凉灯塔}。她向下深挖以抵达幻象中所见的圣所；在劳作的同时，她也开始规划复仇。她会将地下怪物与暴烈野兽引入她的秘密地城——也就是她称为憎恨魔窟之处——再利用凄凉灯塔的魔法将它们送入艾巴萨罗姆大肆破坏。她完成了计划的第一部分：扩建憎恨魔窟，并在灯塔周围建起一座易守难攻的要塞。她还借助家族旧识，招揽强大的扈从与勇士来统率她的怪物军势。

当贝科拉仍在用异怪充实她的憎恨魔窟时，有关她恶行的传闻传到了艾巴萨罗姆。@UUID[.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{玫瑰团}——一支总部设在艾巴萨罗姆的英雄团队——从城中出发，誓要与她对峙并将其消灭。玫瑰团在凄凉灯塔要塞内与贝科拉交锋，并在那里杀死了她。玫瑰团四名成员之一、一位名叫奥塔里·伊瓦什提的游荡者，在此战中丧命。玫瑰团为失去的友人悲恸不已，他们离开时封闭了要塞，建立了后来成为奥塔里镇的聚落，并在此隐退。他们从未得知要塞的更深层，也不知道仍有许多生物留在其中。

憎恨魔窟的怨毒主宰

贝科拉的灵体并未安宁休息。她被怒火吞噬，又得宁布洛斯之力加持；在其家族被逐出艾巴萨罗姆500年后——那场戏剧性改变她一生的事件——她以强大的幽灵（特征）之身再度崛起。如今贝科拉潜伏在憎恨魔窟最深的等級，筹谋对艾巴萨罗姆以及那些消灭她的英雄的复仇。玫瑰团早已亡故，但他们建立的小镇仍在，而代表他们冒险生涯的遗珍如今拥有穿透贝科拉防护的力量。

起初，奥塔里无人意识到贝科拉带来的危险。她的阴谋与她的怪物都隐藏得很深，远离视线。然而，在对艾巴萨罗姆出手之前，她打算先用凄凉灯塔对付奥塔里——这座由五个世纪前杀死她的冒险者所建立的小镇。唯有奥塔里的新一代英雄，才能阻止贝科拉的复仇，并让她的灵体得以安息。

So warns a popular nursery rhyme among the parents in the town of @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{Otari}, as they often sing the melodious but unsettling poem to their children at night to encourage good behavior. As a result, everyone who grows up in Otari has a healthy mix of fear, respect, and curiosity for the old ruins out in Fogfen and the strange lighthouse that stands at the swamp's heart. As they grow older, townsfolk learn what's more often accepted as truth: that the heroic founders of Otari had slain the wicked sorcerer Belcorra many years ago. For a time, thrill-seekers explored the ruins around the lighthouse called Gauntlight, but today, common knowledge holds that the place has become a haven for pests—no longer a source of active danger or significant treasure after being completely picked over. Nearly 500 years has passed since Belcorra's defeat after all, and in that time, she has only posed a menace to Otari through sinister rhymes.

Or so the citizens of Otari believe.

While many old legends about Belcorra are true (she did practice cannibalism, for example, but didn't limit her diet to foolish children), the belief that she's no longer a danger is false. Two years ago, on the 500th anniversary of the most significant event of her life- her family's exile from Absalom for abhorrent rites- Belcorra's spiteful ghost awoke deep beneath Gauntlight Keep. The lighthouse and surrounding ruins presented only the highest level of a vast complex Belcorra had stocked with malicious and malignant creatures: her Abomination Vaults. Belcorra's spite has festered in the intervening centuries, and she hungers for revenge, not only against Absalom for destroying her family, but also the town of Otari and its founders- the heroes who killed her. Belcorra bides her time while she rebuilds, reenergizing the dread Gauntlight and reasserting her dominance over the feral and forgotten monsters of the Abomination Vaults!

Belcorra's History

The ghost sorcerer Belcorra Haruvex is the primary villain of the Abomination Vaults Adventure Path. The story behind her spiteful rage is one of exile and loss.

The Haruvex family tree both sprawls and surges with sorcery. The family's strongest bloodlines have an aberrant strain, which provides family prestige as well as sorcerous power. Generations of Haruvexes married within the family to strengthen this lineage, and the most powerful Haruvexes lived in Absalom 500 years ago. These Absalom Haruvexes made secret obeisance to the Outer Gods for great wealth and greater power. But none in the family approached the power of their youngest scion, Belcorra Haruvex. Belcorra had been told, every day for as long as she could remember, that she was the harbinger of Nhimbaloth, the Empty Death, and that she was her family's greatest hope for power and prosperity.

The Haruvexes enacted abhorrent rites in their worship, including bloody sacrifices, and the authorities eventually caught wind of their crimes. The Haruvexes were finally driven from the Isle of Kortos in 4219 ar, forced to leave their estates and luxuries behind. Belcorra was only 6 years old at the time, but as she grew, her rage at losing her home solidified into an overwhelming hatred of Absalom and everyone in it.

Most of the exiled Haruvexes died in poverty, but Belcorra grew strong and proud. At 17, she interpreted visions from Nhimbaloth that led her back to the Isle of Kortos to plan her revenge. Far above a subterranean shrine to Nhimbaloth called the Empty Vault, in a lonely stretch of wooded coast a few dozen miles from Absalom, Belcorra erected a magical lighthouse and called it @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight}. She dug deep beneath it to reach the shrine she had seen in her visions, and while she worked, she began to plan her revenge. She would draw subterranean monsters and violent beasts into her secret dungeons- which she called the Abomination Vaults- and use Gauntlight's magic to send them into Absalom to wreak havoc. She enacted the first part of her plan, expanding the Abomination Vaults and raising a defensible keep around the lighthouse. She leveraged family acquaintances to acquire powerful retainers and champions to lead her monstrous forces.

Belcorra was still stocking her Abomination Vaults with aberrations when rumors of her villainy reached Absalom. The @UUID[.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{Roseguard}, a group of heroes headquartered in Absalom, set out from the city to confront and vanquish her. The Roseguard faced Belcorra within Gauntlight Keep and killed her there. One of the four members of the Roseguard, a rogue named Otari Ilvashti, died in this fight. Grieving their lost friend, the Roseguard left, sealed up the keep, founded what would become the town of Otari, and retired there. They never knew of the keep’s lower levels or the many creatures still remaining within them.

Spiteful Master of the Abomination Vaults

Belcorra’s spirit didn’t rest peacefully. Consumed by rage and empowered by Nhimbaloth, she arose as a powerful ghost 500 years after her family’s exile from Absalom, the event that so dramatically altered her life. Belcorra now lurks in the deepest levels of the Abomination Vaults, plotting her revenge against Absalom and the heroes who vanquished her. The Roseguard are long dead, but the town they founded remains, and the icons representing their adventuring careers now have the power to penetrate Belcorra’s protections.

At first, no one in Otari realizes the danger Belcorra poses. Her machinations and her monsters are well out of sight. But before she moves against Absalom, she intends to use her Gauntlight against Otari—the town built by the adventurers who killed her five centuries before. Only Otari’s newest heroes can prevent Belcorra’s vengeance and put her spirit to rest.

Carman Rajani.name: 卡曼·拉贾尼 Carman Rajani
Carman Rajani.text:
战役角色

走投无路、惹祸上身的绝望盗贼

卡曼在这场冒险中的初始定位是一个小障碍；为了绕过@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.5MfX6RVIF7rOroV3]{幽魂封印}，英雄们需要玫瑰团的四件遗珍，而卡曼偷走了其中一件——合作之刃。追踪并找到卡曼是英雄们最早的任务之一。由于他在形势对他不利时很快就会投降，队伍更可能将他绳之以法而不是杀了他。有些队伍甚至可能认同卡曼对这把剑的主张是合理的，并把合作之刃还给他。

但卡曼在这场冒险中还有更重要的作用。作为玫瑰团某位成员的最后一名后裔，他的灵魂对契约恶魔@UUID[.t9SSGAP5pW2NpkWh]{乌瑞维安}至关重要。乌瑞维安给英雄们一个选择：把这名堕落的卡曼带到他面前，从而引出这场冒险的关键道德困境。卡曼的最终命运掌握在英雄们手中

背景

作为@UUID[.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{玫瑰团}原始成员之一的后裔，卡曼从小听着沃尔的英勇、奉献与技能的故事长大。还是个男孩时，卡曼不明白为什么自家的剑会挂在@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.AztvvKcx7K7gOXhN]{晨花图书馆}里，而不是在他们家里。那是他们家的——至少他的父母一直这么坚持。随着卡曼长大，他先在奥塔里的铁匠铺工作，@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.5yYs7JNliPnSYLhp]{伐木之刃}，后来又在一次走运的赌局中从前任店主手里赢下了这家店。然而他始终忘不了那把家族之剑。按官方说法，曼妮姆斯家族宣称拥有沃尔的古老刀刃，但出于所谓的慷慨而“允许”它继续留在图书馆里——卡曼认为这是一种冒犯。

在他父母于从艾巴萨罗姆返回的路上遭到强盗伏击并被杀的那个夏天，卡曼成了一个心碎的人。他在铁匠铺的工作变得忽冷忽热，他不再与朋友放松，也不再帮助社区。失去方向的他挥霍了继承的财产，把钱花在娱乐、华服和稀有威士忌上。他开始在@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.sdNti6BHkPTeO5fC]{骗子之角}赌博与酗酒的时间，比待在自己的铁匠铺里还多。最终继承的钱花光了，卡曼背上了一大笔债。又欠下好几个“人情”之后，他开始坑骗旅人，或在骗子之角的飞刀靶盘前设局骗他们。但他的恶习依旧远超他从小骗局里赚到的收入，很快他就在伊娜斯梅拉的调教下转而公然行窃。“刀刃王牌”是骗子之角里对最佳飞刀手的称号，而卡曼·拉贾尼持有这个头衔太久了，以至于它成了他在鱼鹰俱乐部同伴间的绰号。

市长竞选

几年之内，卡曼便安顿在他的新生活里：白天当铁匠，晚上在骗子之角狂欢，有时当他的钱袋开始变轻时，就顺手干点小偷小摸。然而当他听到传言，说人们认为他在虚度人生时，这刺痛了他的自尊。他决定与欧瑟夫竞争市长，向全镇证明他家族与曼妮姆斯家族不相上下。

所有人都认为卡曼的参选是个笑话。第二次参选时，他的政纲沦为对曼妮姆斯家族尖刻的人身攻击；镇民觉得这笑话变酸了，认为这是在浪费他们的时间。他用暴力回应他们的嘲讽，为证明自己更优秀而打架斗殴。第三次参选时，他确实努力去帮助社区。尽管他以小得多的差距落败，但他把失败当作证据：善意带你走不了多远——你的拳头才行。第四次，他试图用公开行贿与敲诈来强行推动一场成功的战役。

欧瑟夫以压倒性优势获胜，在选举日穿着合作之刃，将其作为庆祝盛装的一部分现身。卡曼终于认定，这把魔法剑一定是他成功的关键。全镇人都知道它能给奥塔里带来好运，所以谁持有这把剑，谁就能把全镇攥在手心。作为沃尔的继承人，他理应拥有这把剑。他恳求欧瑟夫出售这件武器，但欧瑟夫怀疑这是某种新花样——更糟的是，可能与卡曼传闻中的某项罪行或债务有关——便以拖延、借口与抬高价格来应对。

最终，卡曼决定自己受够了。若他想取回家族之剑，就只能自己动手把它夺回来。

Campaign Role

Desperate Thief In Over His Head

Carman’s initial role in this adventure is as a minor obstacle; to bypass the @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.5MfX6RVIF7rOroV3]{Spectral Seal}, the heroes need the four icons of the Roseguard, and Carman has stolen one of them, the Cooperative Blade. Tracking Carman down is one of the heroes’ first tasks. They’re likely to bring Carman to justice rather than kill him, as he’s quick to surrender when things turn against him. Some parties might even agree that Carman’s claim to the sword is valid and give the Cooperative Blade back to him.

But Carman has a greater role to play in this adventure. As the last descendant of one of the Roseguard, his soul is important to the contract devil @UUID[.t9SSGAP5pW2NpkWh]{Urevian}.
