Urevian gives the heroes the option to bring the reprobate Carman to him, providing the key moral dilemma of this adventure. Carman’s ultimate fate is in the heroes’ hands

Background

A descendant of one of the original members of the @UUID[.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{Roseguard}, Carman grew up on stories of Vol's bravery, dedication, and skill. As a boy, Carman didn't understand why his family's sword was hanging in the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.AztvvKcx7K7gOXhN]{Dawnflower Library} and not in their house. It was theirs, or so his parents insisted. As Carman grew older, he first worked at Otari's blacksmith's shop, @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.5yYs7JNliPnSYLhp]{Blades for Glades}, and later won the shop in a lucky wager against the prior owner. Yet he couldn't forget his family's sword. Officially, the Menhemes family claimed ownership over Vol's ancient blade but "allowed" it to stay in the library in an act of purported generosity that Carman found offensive.

The summer his parents were waylaid and slain by bandits on the road from Absalom, Carman became a broken man. His work at the smithy became erratic, and he stopped relaxing with his friends and helping his community. With no other direction, Carman squandered his inheritance, spending the money on entertainment, fine clothes, and rare whiskey. He started spending more time gambling and drinking at the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.sdNti6BHkPTeO5fC]{Crook’s Nook} than he did at his smithy. Eventually the inheritance money ran out, and Carman was faced with a sizable debt. Several owed favors later, he started grifting travelers or hustling them at the knife-throwing board at the Crook's Nook. But his vices still outpaced his earnings from petty cons, and soon he took to outright thievery under Yinyasmera's tutelage. The "Ace of Blades" is the moniker given to the best knife thrower in the Crook's Nook, and Carman Rajani has held that title for so long that it's become his nickname among fellow members of the Osprey Club.

Mayoral Candidacy

Within a few years, Carman had settled into his new life, working as a smith during the day, carousing at the Crook's Nook at night, and occasionally engaging in some petty larceny when his coin purse started to get light. When he heard rumors that people thought he was wasting his life, though, it stung his pride. He resolved to run for mayor against Oseph, to show the whole town that his family was the equal of the Menhemes family.

Everyone thought Carman's candidacy was a joke. The second time he ran, his platform became nothing more than sharp personal attacks against the Menhemes family; the townspeople felt the joke had gone sour and considered it a waste of their time. He met their jibes with violence, getting into brawls to prove he was the better man. The third time he ran for office, he actually put in effort to help the community. Though he lost by much smaller margin, he took the loss as proof that kindness can't get you any further than your fists can. The fourth time, he tried to force a successful campaign with open bribes and blackmail.

Oseph won by a landslide, showing up on Election Day wearing the Cooperative Blade as part of his celebratory regalia. Carman finally decided that the magic sword must be the key to his success. Everyone in town knew it brought Otari good luck, so whoever held the sword had the town in their pocket. As Vol's heir, he deserved the sword. He begged Oseph to sell the weapon, but Oseph suspected it was some new scheme- or worse, connected to one of Carman's rumored crimes or debts- and countered with delays, excuses, and price increases.

Finally, Carman decided he'd had enough. If he wanted his family's sword back, he'd have to take it.

Jafaki.name: 贾法基 Jafaki
Jafaki.text:
战役角色

非人的炼金术师，创造完美怪物

贾法基起初认为这些英雄不过是些烦人的小麻烦，并相信其他人会处理他们。一旦贾法基意识到英雄强大到足以与其正面交锋，这名双尾虫怪便明白他们会是绝佳的实验候选者。对贾法基而言不幸的是，这份觉悟很可能来得太晚。

背景

贝科拉在建造憎恨魔窟时，首次在幽暗地域发现贾法基与数名其他双尾虫怪蜿蜒而行。他们表现出渴望为她效劳、并推进自身实验的热忱。贝科拉知道双尾虫怪既能强化她的兵力，也能帮助她扩张。她指派他们为她打造一名完美士兵，然后制造其军团以征服艾巴萨罗姆。贝科拉明白“完美”是个高昂的价格，便将她所能调动的一切资源都输送给双尾虫怪。双尾虫怪不只走一条研究路线，而是多线并进，包括塑肉仪式、怪物繁育，甚至还涉足魔法构装体。贝科拉并不介意这种广泛的实验，因为几乎所有成果都能为她日益壮大的军队提供有用的怪物。她还将双尾虫怪的创新转交给其他炼金术师与法师，好让他们复制这些成果。

贝科拉之后

当玫瑰团击败贝科拉后，双尾虫怪仍旧继续追逐他们的目标。他们最初的障碍是一名名为塔坎纳的骨魔。塔坎纳认为自己对贝科拉的持续职责——即便在她死后仍对其忠诚——意味着要更强硬地监督双尾虫怪。塔坎纳试图限制并引导双尾虫怪那四处蔓延的研究。双尾虫怪不愿服从这些不受欢迎的要求而起而反叛；贾法基伏击并杀死了塔坎纳，夺取了实验室等级的控制权。

这次袭击引发了魔鬼与双尾虫怪之间的一场短暂战争。数月间双方交战不休，但@UUID[.t9SSGAP5pW2NpkWh]{乌瑞维安}很快发现双尾虫怪并非真想扩张地盘，只是防守他们已有的领地。双方最终在魔窟各自的等级上达成了不安的停战。这些前线并非绝对；乌瑞维安乐于允许潜在的“原材料”穿过牢房，而双尾虫怪弃置的生物也常常流入这名魔鬼逐步扩张的势力之中。

贾法基几乎不关心在其下方等级中不断壮大的军队。双尾虫怪不会理会偶尔穿过实验室的小魔鬼与斥控魔间谍，但贾法基与其同僚却能让大军穿行的代价变得高昂，甚至变得不可能。贾法基打算只在换取额外让步、以强化其持续实验的前提下才允许自由通行，尽管乌瑞维安肯定会对这份代价感到退缩。

贾法基的执念

这些年来，贾法基的研究似乎在各种骇人的科学之间漂移：塑肉仪式、死者复苏、选择性繁育，甚至魔像创造。然而，他们对“创造完美士兵”这一目标的专注程度，仍与多年前对贝科拉谈起时别无二致。

那个词驱使贾法基已历经数百年。好士兵？他们已经造出来了，而这些作品在竞技场中成打、成百地死去。伟大的士兵？贾法基的一些最杰出作品几乎无可阻挡。但“几乎”并非“完美”。无论需要多久，贾法基都会追逐完美。

Campaign Role

Inhuman Alchemist Creating Perfect Monsters

Jafaki initially considers the heroes to be little more than annoyances and trusts in others to take care of them. Once Jafaki realizes the heroes are powerful enough to face them directly, the seugathi understands that they would make excellent candidates for experimentation. Unfortunately for Jafaki, this realization probably comes too late.

Background

Belcorra first spotted Jafaki and several other seugathis slithering through the Darklands while she was building the Abomination Vaults. They expressed an eagerness to serve her and advance their own experiments. Belcorra knew the seugathis could improve her forces, as well as expand. She tasked them with building her a perfect soldier, then making armies of them to conquer Absalom. Knowing that perfection was a high price to ask, Belcorra funneled all the resources she could to the seugathis. The seugathis pursued not one research path but many, including fleshwarping, monster breeding, and even dabbling in magical constructs. Belcorra didn’t mind this broad experimentation, as nearly all of it provided her with useful monsters for her growing army. She passed along the seugathis’ innovations to other alchemists and mages who could duplicate the work.

After Belcorra

When the Roseguard defeated Belcorra, the seugathis nevertheless continued pursuing their objective. Their initial obstacle was a bone devil named Tarkannah. Tarkannah deemed that ongoing duty to Belcorra—to whom the bone devil remained loyal even after her death—meant taking a firmer hand in overseeing the seugathis. Tarkannah tried to constrain and direct the seugathis’ sprawling research. Rather than comply with these unwelcome demands, the seugathis rebelled; Jafaki ambushed and killed Tarkannah and seized control of the laboratories level.

This assault started a brief war between the devils and the seugathis. For months the two sides fought, but @UUID[.t9SSGAP5pW2NpkWh]{Urevian} soon discovered the seugathis weren’t really interested in expanding their holdings, only defending the territory they had. The two sides settled in an uneasy truce on their respective levels of the vaults. These front lines aren’t absolute; Urevian is happy to permit potential “raw materials” to pass through the prison, and the seugathis’ cast-off creatures often find their way into the devil’s gradually increasing forces.

Jafaki has little concern for the army growing on the level below. The seugathis don’t bother with the imp and zebub spies that occasionally pass through the laboratories, but Jafaki and their colleagues can make marching through with a large army costly or even impossible. Jafaki plans to permit free passage only in exchange for additional concessions to bolster their ongoing experiments, even though Urevian is certain to balk at the cost.

Jafaki's Obsession

Jafaki's research has seemed to drift over the years through various abhorrent sciences: fleshwarping, reanimation of the dead, selective breeding, or even golem creation. Yet they remain as focused on their goal of creating the perfect soldier as they were when they spoke to Belcorra all those years ago.

That word has driven Jafaki for centuries. Good soldiers? They’ve created those, and all have died by the dozens or hundreds in the arena. Great soldiers? Some of Jafaki's finest works have been nearly unstoppable. But “nearly” is not “perfect.” Jafaki will pursue perfection for as long as it takes.

Urevian.name: 乌瑞维安 Urevian
Urevian.text:
战役角色

契约魔鬼，渴望达成交易

乌瑞维安将英雄们视为意外的机会与潜在的解决方案。若英雄们一路屠戮贾法基与双尾虫怪，那对魔鬼而言更是再好不过。乌瑞维安已命令他的魔鬼们留意英雄们的动向，杀光除一两人外的所有人，然后把幸存者带来与他谈判。他计划说服剩余的英雄把卡曼·拉贾尼交给他；否则，他就会率军沿地下城一路向上进军，摧毁奥塔里。

乌瑞维安信守承诺，一旦得手便会迅速离开。若英雄们拒绝，尽管乌瑞维安言辞甜蜜，且他们击败了他，他就会被投入喧主的法庭，在那里他必须解释自己的失败，否则将面临湮灭。

背景

五个世纪前，贝科拉召唤了契约魔鬼乌瑞维安来管理她的憎恨魔窟。乌瑞维安总想着让交易更“划算”，便进一步提出愿意训练贝科拉的军队并带领她入侵艾巴萨罗姆——当然，得付出价格。乌瑞维安知道，来自奈多的流亡王族、传奇的玫瑰团女剑士沃尔·拉贾尼就住在艾巴萨罗姆。出于某些连乌瑞维安也不清楚的原因，拉贾尼家族对地狱中的某些势力具有特殊价值。作为乌瑞维安援助的交换，贝科拉保证把拉贾尼的灵魂交给他。

当玫瑰团攻击凄凉灯塔、把那灵魂直接送到贝科拉家门口时，乌瑞维安却在地狱里，正将拉贾尼的灵魂“许诺”给某个更强大的存在——尽管他当时还没真正拿到。等他返回时，玫瑰团已获胜，贝科拉也被杀死。那名女术士无法履行交易中属于她的一方，使乌瑞维安被困在无休无止的筹备地表入侵的过程中，却得不到任何回报。更糟的是，他不敢在没有拉贾尼灵魂的情况下返回地狱；而他的协议又禁止他亲自或通过其地狱代理直接捕获该灵魂，因为按约定应由贝科拉将其交付。乌瑞维安被困住了。

如今贝科拉归来，乌瑞维安与她的协议终于能够履行。他计划训练她的军队并入侵地表，从奥塔里开始；他的侦察已告知他，卡曼·拉贾尼——其灵魂同样可用于履行他的契约——就住在那里。乌瑞维安已全面动员麾下魔鬼，训练那些来到他领地的畸肉体。贝科拉将数个可怕的怪物置于停滞状态，但乌瑞维安尚不知道如何可靠地释放它们，并将这一发现列为他下一项优先事项。

不安的盟友

尽管魔鬼们可以使用 次元门 快速抵达地表，乌瑞维安的其他部队却需要物理通道，这迫使他去找双尾虫怪 @UUID[.qrb0F1AQ3iIR7Xni]{贾法基}，商议允许他们穿过实验室。贾法基担心又是一场魔鬼诡计——考虑到双尾虫怪过去与乌瑞维安的关系，这是合理的推断——并在一个条件下同意：乌瑞维安必须允许双尾虫怪“亲自检查”所有地狱势力，并进行“升级与改良”。乌瑞维安知道，这套把戏是让贾法基用触手攫取无穷无尽的研究对象，而那名畸肉体绝不会放行任何部队。乌瑞维安已准备好对这整套安排洗手不干，但唉，他有一份契约。

Campaign Role

Contract Devil Eager to Make a Deal

Urevian sees the heroes as an unexpected opportunity and a potential solution. If the heroes slaughter their way through Jafaki and the seugathis, then all the better for the devil. Urevian has ordered his devils to keep an eye out for the heroes, to kill all but one or two, and then bring him the survivors for negotiations. He plans to convince the remaining heroes to deliver Carman Rajani to him. Otherwise, he’ll march his army up through the dungeon and destroy Otari.

Urevian is true to his word and departs quickly once he has his prize. If the heroes refuse, despite Urevian’s honeyed words, and they defeat him, he’s cast into the demagogue’s court, where he must explain his failure or face obliteration.

Background

Five centuries ago, Belcorra summoned the contract devil Urevian to administer her Abomination Vaults. Always looking to sweeten a deal, Urevian further offered to train Belcorra’s armies and lead her invasion of Absalom—for a price. Urevian knew that Vol Rajani, legendary Roseguard swordswoman and exiled royalty from Nidal, lived in Absalom. The Rajani family has, for reasons even Urevian doesn’t know, special value to certain parties in Hell. In exchange for Urevian’s aid, Belcorra guaranteed him Rajani’s soul.

When the Roseguard attacked Gauntlight, bringing the soul right to Belcorra’s doorstep, Urevian was in Hell, committing Rajani’s soul to a much more powerful entity—even though he didn’t yet have it. By the time he returned, the Roseguard had prevailed with Belcorra slain. The sorcerer couldn’t fulfill her end of the bargain, trapping Urevian in the interminable process of preparing a surface invasion that would gain him nothing. Worse, he didn’t dare return to Hell without the Rajani soul, and his agreement forbid him from capturing the soul directly or through his infernal proxies, as Belcorra was intended to deliver it. Urevian was trapped.

Now that Belcorra has returned, Urevian’s agreement with her can be fulfilled. He plans to train her armies and invade the surface, starting with Otari; his spying has informed him that Carman Rajani, whose soul can also fulfill his contract, lives there. Urevian has fully mobilized his devils to train the fleshwarps who’ve come into his realm. Belcorra placed several horrible monsters in stasis, though Urevian doesn’t yet know how to reliably free them and has made that discovery his next priority.

Uneasy Allies

Although the devils can use dimension door to reach the surface quickly, Urevian’s other troops need physical access, which required him to approach the seugathi @UUID[.qrb0F1AQ3iIR7Xni]{Jafaki} about allowing them through the laboratories. Jafaki feared another diabolic ruse—a reasonable assumption given the seugathis’ past relations with Urevian—and agreed on one condition: Urevian must allow the seugathis to “personally inspect” all infernal forces and make “upgrades and improvements.” Urevian knew this ploy was for Jafaki to get their tentacles on endless research subjects and that the fleshwarper would never sign off on any troops. Urevian is ready to wash his hands of this entire arrangement, but alas, he has a contract.

Wrin Sivinxi.name: 瓦琳·希温尼斯 Wrin Sivinxi
Wrin Sivinxi.text:
战役角色

乐于助人的赞助人 受幽魂幻象困扰

瓦琳·希温尼斯的主要目的，是激励英雄们最初的探索，并为他们提供一个可共同聚拢的核心焦点。《憎恨魔窟》冒险路径假定瓦琳是英雄们共同认识的一位联络人，因此当她注意到远方凄凉灯塔顶部有一股诡异光亮(术)正在聚集时，她自然而然会向英雄们倾诉自己的恐惧(术)。

随着战役推进，瓦琳还能以其他方式帮助英雄们，例如为英雄们进行占星解读，以在他们的探索中提供援助。她不会免费送出自家店铺的货物，但她的店是购买与出售英雄们常会发现并渴求的古怪魔法宝藏的最佳去处。瓦琳也能向英雄们介绍灵界的奇观——她的教导会解锁@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.mkp6lhBbTASEmKwY]{Ghost Hunter}幽灵猎手变体。尽管她饱受幽闭恐惧之苦，但若英雄们在《憎恨魔窟》中陷入难以应付的局面，你可以让瓦琳直面恐惧(术)，勇闯地下城并展开营救。当然，除非作为防止战役过早结束的最后手段，否则不应让瓦琳承担这种职责！

背景

瓦琳·希温尼斯在奇奥尼的辉树村这个小村庄长大，但旅行者若在今日造访该国，已找不到她的故乡——辉树村在10年前被为毁木者效力的恶魔摧毁。尽管失去了家乡，瓦琳对这件事并不感到悲伤或绝望灵光，因为在辉树村的沦陷中无人丧生。在恶魔大军进攻前的那些日子里，瓦琳曾预见这场灾害。她警告了父母与邻里，而他们对她预言的信任为城镇赢得了将全村人迁往安全地带所需的时间。恶魔到来时只见辉树村空无一人；当他们愤怒地将其焚毁时，又因精灵预先留下的魔法陷阱而遭受重创。

数年后成年之际，瓦琳离开父母与朋友，渴望在世上找到属于自己的位置。她在旅行中信赖自己的异象，也信奉一组与空间与时代相关、被她称作篷车星座群的神祇；她仰望夜空群星，为明日的决定寻求指引。她擅长寻回遗失之物并收集奇异宝藏，使得开设一家奇物店成为显而易见的选择；而她选择在奥塔里开店也并非偶然——那只是她所抵达的港口，恰好在她携带收藏的能力终于超过其便携性之时。

她在四年前开设了自己的店铺：@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.jlb4fsKQC57ZjNQ7]{瓦琳的奇珍}。在这段时间里，她已成为社区的一部分，尽管许多居民仍将她视作性情温和的怪人。奇异离奇之物在小镇里销路并不快，但瓦琳并不在意——她很有耐心，也一直享受在奥塔里的生活。总有一天，她希望攒够钱资助一次向西的旅程；她听说在瑞瓦诺西南海岸的小镇骗子湾，有一座被遗弃的天文台，她希望能将其买下并改造成一座献给篷车星座群的神殿。但就目前而言，她满足于留在奥塔里，枕着星光入眠。

瓦琳的魔裔族裔特征令人无法忽视，而这也是她很久以前便决定拥抱的一部分。没有瞳孔的双眼、环绕精灵耳朵卷曲的小公羊角、细长的尾巴，以及指尖闪烁的点点光亮(术)微尘，都无疑表明她受到了超自然力量的触及。然而，她爽朗的笑容与热情好客的态度，总能帮助她在旅行中结交朋友。

Campaign Role

Helpful Patron Haunted by Spectral Visions

Wrin’s primary purpose is to motivate the heroes’ initial explorations and to give them a focal point to gather around. The Abomination Vaults Adventure Path assumes that Wrin is a contact the heroes share in common, so when she notices a strange buildup of eerie light atop distant Gauntlight, it’s natural for her to confide her fears in the heroes.

As the campaign progresses, Wrin can help the heroes in other ways, such as by performing astrology readings for the heroes to aid them in their explorations. While she won’t give her store’s wares away for free, her establishment is the best place to buy and sell the odd magical treasures heroes tend to find and crave. Wrin can also introduce the heroes to the wonders of the spirit world—her tutelage unlocks the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.mkp6lhBbTASEmKwY]{Ghost Hunter} archetype. Despite the claustrophobia she suffers, if the heroes find themselves in over their head in the Abomination Vaults, you can have Wrin face her fears to brave the dungeon and mount a rescue. Of course, you shouldn’t use Wrin in this capacity except as a last resort to keep the campaign from reaching an untimely end!

Background

Wrin Sivinxi grew up in the small village of Glitterbough in Kyonin, but a traveler wouldn’t find her hometown if they were to visit that nation today, for Glitterbough was destroyed 10 years ago by demons in the service of Treerazer. Despite the loss of her hometown, Wrin feels no sadness or despair about the event, for none perished in Glitterbough’s fall. In the days before the demon army’s attack, Wrin had a vision of the disaster. She warned her parents and neighbors, and their trust in her visions gave the town the time it needed to relocate everyone in the village to safety. When the demons came, they found Glitterbough deserted, and when they burned it in frustration, they suffered greatly from the magical traps the elves had left behind to greet them.

When she came of age a few years later, Wrin left her parents and friends, eager to find her own place in the world. As she traveled, she trusted in her visions and her unusual faith in a pantheon of deities associated with space and time she refers to as the Cosmic Caravan, looking to the nightly stars to make decisions for tomorrow. Her knack for finding lost things and gathering strange treasures made establishing her own curio shop an obvious choice, and it wasn’t by chance that she decided to set up that shop in Otari—it was simply the port she’d arrived at when her capacity to carry her collection finally outweighed its portability.

She opened her shop, @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.jlb4fsKQC57ZjNQ7]{Wrin’s Wonders}, four years ago. In that time, she has become part of the community, even if many of its citizens regard her as a good-natured eccentric. Sales of the strange and bizarre aren’t brisk in the small town, but that’s no matter to Wrin—she’s patient and has enjoyed her time in Otari so far. One day, she hopes to make enough money to fund a trip west, for she has heard tell of an abandoned observatory in the small town of Crookcove on Ravounel’s southwestern coast that she hopes to purchase and transform into a temple devoted to the Cosmic Caravan. But for the time being, she’s content to stay in Otari and sleep under the stars.

Wrin’s tiefling ancestry is impossible to miss, and it’s something she long ago decided to embrace. Eyes devoid of pupils, small ram horns curling around her elven ears, a thin tail, and fingertips that sparkle with motes of glittering lights leave no doubt that she’s touched by supernatural forces. Yet, her quick smile and welcoming attitude have always helped her to secure friendships during her travels.

Otari Ilvashti.name: 奥塔里·伊瓦什提 Otari Ilvashti
Otari Ilvashti.text:
战役角色

带有重要线索的躁动灵体

奥塔里的作用，是提出抵达憎恨魔窟更低等级所必需的任务，这些任务记载于@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.5MfX6RVIF7rOroV3]{幽魂封印}。当英雄们遭遇奥塔里的幽灵（特征）并驱散折磨他的微灵后，他会讲述自己悲惨的故事。他很难记起自己生前的大部分经历，但如果他得知玫瑰团幸存下来，并以他的名字为他们的城镇命名，他会变得非常激动。

尽管奥塔里关于地下城的信息已是几个世纪前的旧闻，但他与憎恨魔窟之间的超自然联系，使他得以窥见地下城的内部运作以及其中的关键人物。当奥塔里与英雄们交谈时，务必让他传达以下关键信息要点，可以以回答问题或主动告知的形式呈现。

玫瑰团所知

贝科拉对艾巴萨罗姆怀恨在心，打算把她那座阴险的灯塔——凄凉灯塔——当作对付这座城市的武器。玫瑰团从未发现它的实际用途，只知道它似乎与将生物跨越巨大距离传送的能力有关，并且能以其光亮(术)驱使亡者行动。玫瑰团的其他成员都不知道凄凉灯塔下方还有憎恨魔窟。奥塔里直到生命最后几天才得知此事。

灵体的来源

憎恨魔窟的某种特性增强了其领域内幽灵（特征）、幽魂不死生物以及作祟的显现。奥塔里起初认为这是凄凉灯塔的副作用，但如今他开始怀疑，在本等级更深处有一个更古老、更不祥的源头与此相关。他对宁布洛斯一无所知，但如果英雄们告诉他这位外神，他会怀疑其影响正是源头。

贝科拉的归来

贝科拉本人如今也是一名幽灵（特征），不过她无法离开将她锚定的地点太远。奥塔里能感觉到她在地下深处的某处，也察觉到她的移动射程正在缓慢扩大。

贝科拉的计划

奥塔里怀疑贝科拉意图让凄凉灯塔完全重新启动，并以此开始她那被长期拖延的对艾巴萨罗姆的攻击。在她完成这项任务之前，必须让她安息。奥塔里不确定该如何阻止她，但他相信在憎恨魔窟更深的等级里有等待被发现的线索。

幽魂封印

最后，奥塔里感知到在区域@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.QCU2xefly79ZVBxj]{D12. 幽灵之路}存在一道屏障，阻挡着深入憎恨魔窟的进程。他明白这道屏障以贝科拉被击败的敌人的灵魂为动力。幸运的是，他也知道如何解除这道屏障。玫瑰团正是最终杀死她的冒险者，而他们的心灵共鸣能够降下这道屏障。英雄们必须找到并将四件玫瑰团曾珍视的遗珍放置在区域@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.CGaM81kBLtYIxmqu]{D13. 宁布洛斯的上层神殿}的祭坛上，才能做到这一点。奥塔里的盗贼工具与他的遗骨一同在此，并作为他的遗珍。其他遗珍在@UUID[.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{玫瑰团}讲义中有所描述，并可在地表找到。找回它们是下一章第一部分的重点。

背景

奥塔里·伊瓦什提对自己的生平所记无多。他在艾巴萨罗姆度过的童年时光，以及与玫瑰团其他成员一同经历的冒险，都已淡去为遥远却愉快的回忆。正是他对贝科拉计划对艾巴萨罗姆释放的毁灭之力的恐惧(术)，让他以幽灵（特征）的身份被束缚在这个世界上。

当玫瑰团在凄凉灯塔要塞与贝科拉交战时，她释放了一次强大的魔法爆炸，令战斗所在的房间坍塌。贝科拉与三位英雄避开了坍塌并继续战斗——直到贝科拉最终败北——但游荡者奥塔里却被压在坍塌之下。他的伙伴们以为他已被碾成齑粉，然而奥塔里却跌入了凄凉灯塔要塞下方一个连玫瑰团都不知道存在的等级。奥塔里迫切想要逃脱并回到地表分享这一发现，但贝科拉的爪牙迫使他不断向魔窟更深处逃亡，直到他最终在一处死胡同洞穴里被一只巨大的食腐怪逼入绝境，使他受困并感染腐热症。奥塔里死在那处深洞之中，但他的幽灵（特征）仍然徘徊不去。

Campaign Role

A Restless Spirit with Valuable Clues

Otari’s role is to present the tasks necessary to reach the lower levels of the Abomination Vaults described in @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.5MfX6RVIF7rOroV3]{Spectral Seal}. Once the heroes encounter Otari’s ghost and drive off the wisps that torment him, he relates his tale of woe. He has difficulty remembering much of his life, but becomes very emotional if he learns that the Roseguard survived and named their town after him.

While Otari’s information about the dungeon is centuries out of date, his supernatural link to the Abomination Vaults affords him glimpses into the inner workings of the dungeon and its key players. As Otari speaks to the heroes, make sure he conveys the following key points of information to them, either in the form of answers to questions or volunteered information.

What the Roseguard knew

Belcorra harbored a grudge against Absalom and intended to use her sinister lighthouse, Gauntlight, as a weapon against the city. The Roseguard never discovered its actual use, other than that it had something to do with the ability to transport creatures across significant distances and could animate the dead with its light. None of the other Roseguard members knew about the Abomination Vaults beneath Gauntlight. Otari learned about them only in his last few days alive.

Source of the spirits

Some property of the Abomination Vaults increases the manifestation of ghosts, spectral undead, and haunts within their domain. Otari initially believed this was a side effect from Gauntlight but has now come to suspect a link to a much more ancient and ominous source deep below this level. He knows nothing of Nhimbaloth, but if the heroes tell him of the Outer God, he suspects her influence is the source.

Belcorra's return

Belcorra herself is now a ghost, although she can’t move far from the site to which she’s anchored. Otari can sense her somewhere deep underground and is also aware that the range of her movements is slowly expanding.

Belcorra's plans

Otari suspects Belcorra intends to fully reactivate Gauntlight and use it to begin her long-delayed attack on Absalom. She must be put to rest before she can finish this task. Otari isn’t sure how to stop her, but believes that clues await discovery in the deeper levels of the Abomination Vaults.

The Spectral Seal

Finally, Otari feels the barrier in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.QCU2xefly79ZVBxj]{D12. The Ghostwalk} blocking progress deeper into the Abomination Vaults. He understands that it’s powered by the souls of Belcorra’s defeated enemies. Fortunately, he also understands how to take the barrier down. The Roseguard were the adventurers who finally killed her, and their psychic resonance can drop the barrier. The heroes must find and place four icons the Roseguard once held dear onto the altar in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.CGaM81kBLtYIxmqu]{D13. Upper Temple of Nhimbaloth} to do this. Otari’s thieves’ tools are here with his bones and serve as his icon. The other icons are described in the @UUID[.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{The Roseguard} handout and can be found on the surface. Recovering them is the focus of the first part of the next chapter.

Background

Otari Ilvashti recalls little of his life. His time as a child growing up in Absalom and his adventures with the other members of the Roseguard have dwindled to distant but pleasant memories. His fear of the devastation Belcorra plans to unleash upon Absalom is what keeps him shackled to this world as a ghost.

When the Roseguard fought Belcorra in Gauntlight Keep, she unleashed a powerful magical explosion that collapsed the room where the fight took place. Belcorra and three heroes avoided the collapse and fought on— to Belcorra’s ultimate defeat—but the rogue Otari was caught beneath the collapse. His companions assumed he was pulverized, but Otari had fallen into a level beneath Gauntlight Keep that none of the Roseguard knew existed. Otari desperately wanted to escape to the surface and share his discovery, but Belcorra’s minions forced him to flee ever deeper into the vaults, until finally he was cornered in a dead-end cave by an immense otyugh that left him trapped and suffering from filth fever. Otari died in that deep cave, but his ghost lingers on.

Khurfel.name: 库尔费 Khurfel
Khurfel.text:
战役角色

被幻象折磨的军阀

库尔费领导着英雄们在《憎恨魔窟》中所面对的规模最大、行动最活跃的一支敌对势力。他与英雄们命中注定的对决不可避免，因为他持有翡翠支点镜片，并且只要他还活着就绝不交出——那是他邪教领导权的象征。库尔费看见自己将死在英雄手中的幻象并未激起恐惧(术)——它激起的是暴怒；只要身体里还留有一口气，他就会与这些预言中的敌人战斗到底。

背景

库尔费小时候在第一次尝到敌人的血后，看见了自己的第一段血之幻象。并非每个透肌魔人都有血之幻象；有此经历者往往会保持缄默，因为经历这些幻象的人会被视作不理性或不值得信任。此类幻象总会传递巨大的末日景象，或许与恶魔以及透肌魔人对大规模死亡的渴求有关，但它们往往荒诞无稽，极少应验。然而，和所有受血之幻象折磨的透肌魔人一样，库尔费对其幻象的真实性深信不疑，而那结局令他胆寒。他看见了自己的邪教的终结：那些曾在《憎恨魔窟》中宣誓效忠贝科拉、却大多已遗忘誓言的透肌魔人将走向灭亡。他看见，这终结会在他统治之时到来，而他无力阻止。他将成为最后的战斗勇士。

当然，库尔费将幻象守口如瓶。若邪教其余成员得知，他必死无疑——但那并非他否认幻象的真正原因。那启示令他热血沸腾。他是末日荒原所选之人。他确实将崛起为战斗勇士，但他会与这些灼热的梦魇对抗。它们只是另一种需要被消灭的敌人。

库尔费的崛起迅猛。他高大、强壮、令人胆寒。当他率领第一支战团时，他收获了胜利与屠杀；当他啜饮敌人的血时，那些萦绕不去的幻象便会减弱。短短几年内，库尔费便成为邪教历史上最年轻的战斗勇士。他发誓要守护领导权的象征——由一代代战斗勇士传承携带的翡翠支点镜片。也正是在那时，库尔费的麻烦开始了。

带领同伴上阵是一回事；一切非透肌魔人之物皆为猎物。战斗简单而原始，它让库尔费心神专注，也令他兴奋不已。但他逐渐明白，成为领袖要微妙得多。他必须周旋于邪教中每个人的嫉妒、野心与问题之间——这是他职位的一种性相，而他觉得既疲惫又乏味。更糟的是，他的血之幻象又回来了。幽灵女王贝科拉归来，告知他的邪教做好准备：待她的计划完成，他们将迎来屠戮诸界的时刻。同伴透肌魔人为这番承诺欢呼雀跃，但库尔费的幻象却浇熄了他的喜悦。

他的幻象告诉他，追猎卓尔首领劳拉索斯将是邪教走向毁灭的第一步。然而劳拉索斯对透肌魔人所宣称归其所有的巨湖进行谨慎的探索，激怒了库尔费。劳拉索斯在那禁忌的地窖中寻找秘密——很久以前透肌魔人就被告知任何人都不应进入的那一处。库尔费渴望再次战斗，并相信自己能够战胜幻象，于是他游向湖中的一座小岛，在那里杀死了劳拉索斯与其女儿。他饮下卓尔的血，把尸体抛入湖中，让怪物将其撕碎。他已消灭仇敌。胜利辉煌无比，他的族人高声呼喊他的名字以示凯旋。劳拉索斯的血令人振奋。哪个透肌魔人会不想要这些？将死亡与毁灭带入世界，是每个透肌魔人的权利。

然而，库尔费的血之幻象如今出现得更频繁，显现出威胁他的陌生人，以及与他作对的卓尔。他已召集邪教中的折磨者与血法师，去召唤更多恶魔并强化防御，但幻象依旧持续。库尔费心神不宁，而他的怀疑感觉就像弱点。解决问题的唯一办法就是将其彻底毁灭——这是他的族人一直以来的做法。可幻象仍旧降临，库尔费对此无能为力。

Campaign Role

Visions-Wracked Warlord

Khurfel leads the largest and most active group of adversaries the heroes face in the Abomination Vaults. His fated confrontation with the heroes is necessary because he holds the Emerald Fulcrum Lens and refuses to give it up as long as he lives, as it symbolizes the leadership of his cult. Khurfel’s vision of falling at the heroes’ hands doesn’t inspire fear—it inspires fury, and he fights against his prophesized enemies as long as breath remains in his body.

Background

Khurfel saw his first blood vision as a child, after his first taste of an enemy’s blood. Not every urdefhan has blood visions; those who do tend to keep them quiet, for those who experience them are seen as irrational or untrustworthy. Such visions always relay great apocalypses, perhaps connected to daemons and urdefhans’ lust for great death, but they’re nonsensical and rarely come true. Yet, like all urdefhans subjected to blood visions, Khurfel was absolutely convinced of his vision’s veracity, its outcome terrifying him. He saw the end of his cult, the urdefhans in the Abomination Vaults once sworn to Belcorra but who had mostly forgotten their oaths. He saw that this end would come while he ruled and that he was powerless to stop it. He would be the last war champion.

Of course, Khurfel kept his visions secret. If the rest of his cult knew of them, his life would be forfeit— but that wasn’t the real reason he denied them. His blood boiled at the revelation. He was the chosen of Abaddon. He would indeed rise to war champion, but he would fight these fevered nightmares. They were another enemy to be vanquished.

Khurfel’s rise was swift. He was large, strong, and fearsome. When he led his first war band, he achieved victory and slaughter, and when he partook in his enemies’ blood, the haunting visions waned. Within a few years, Khurfel became the youngest war champion in his cult’s history. He swore to defend their symbol of leadership, the Emerald Fulcrum Lens carried by generations of war champions. That’s when Khurfel’s troubles began.

It’s one thing to lead comrades into battle. Everything not urdefhan is prey. Fighting was simple and visceral. It focused Khurfel’s mind, and it exhilarated him. But being a leader, he learned, was far more nuanced. He had to juggle the jealousies, ambitions, and problems of everyone in his cult, an aspect of his position that he found tiring and dull. Worse still, his blood visions resumed. The Ghost Queen Belcorra returned to tell his cult to be ready, for they would soon have worlds of slaughter when she finished with her plans. His fellow urdefhans cheered at this promise, but Khurfel’s visions dampened his joy.

His visions showed him that hunting the drow leader, Larathols, would be the first step toward his cult’s demise. However, Larathols provoked Khurfel with his cautious explorations of the great lake the urdefhans claimed as their own. Larathols sought secrets in the forbidden vault—the one the urdefhans had been told long ago that no one should enter. Hungry for another fight and believing he could overcome his visions, Khurfel swam to an island on the lake and there killed Larathols and his daughter. He drank of the drow’s blood and threw the body into the lake so monsters could rip it apart. He had vanquished his foes. The victory was glorious, and his people screamed his name in triumph. Larathols’s blood was invigorating. What urdefhan doesn’t want these things? It’s every urdefhan’s right to bring death and destruction into the world.

But Khurfel’s blood visions now manifest more frequently, showing strangers who threaten him and drow working against him. He has called upon his cult’s tormentors and blood mages to summon more daemons and strengthen their defenses, but the visions persist. Khurfel is uneasy, and his doubt feels like weakness. The only way to solve a problem is to destroy it utterly—what his people have always done. Still the visions come, and Khurfel is powerless to stop them.

Quara Orshendiel.name: 库娅拉·奥申迪尔 Quara Orshendiel
Quara Orshendiel.text:
战役角色

不情愿的统治者

库娅拉很可能会成为英雄们的盟友，因为她一眼就能看出谁是有用的伙伴。她有兴趣为父亲和姐姐复仇，但她也知道，父亲用赭石支点镜片所追求的目标，可能对将伊尔达里斯永远从贝科拉的控制中解放出来至关重要。她得知赭石镜片只是贝科拉在数个世纪前托付给该地区盟友的三枚镜片之一，于是她让英雄们踏上回收其余镜片并查明更多真相的线索。库娅拉提供给英雄们最重要的线索是：她的父亲正前往湖畔边缘的一座古老地窖，因此英雄们可以在那个地点发现更多信息。

英雄们可能会将卓尔视为敌人并袭击伊尔达里斯。在这种情况下，库娅拉会竭尽全力保护她的族人，依靠她敏捷手指中仍残留的枪手训练。经历此类侵略后，她很可能不会再信任英雄们并向他们提供任何信息，但他们或许能在她的住处找到一些线索。

背景

库娅拉·奥申迪尔从未想过自己会成为伊尔达里斯的统治者。她的父亲劳拉索斯是一位睿智而审慎的人，统治这处聚居地已长达许多世纪。她爱她的父亲，不仅因为他为人正直，更因为他给予库娅拉自由，让她能开辟自己的道路。她喜爱伊尔达里斯枪手们的派头与无畏，并在成长过程中对他们的夸夸其谈与沉醉于自身壮举的方式感到迷魂。

劳拉索斯看不出有什么理由不去满足小女儿的志向。他早已在为库娅拉的姐姐加露娜做准备，好在时机到来时领导伊尔达里斯——而库娅拉一直以为那会是在未来的许多个世纪之后。与此同时，她在枪手们的队伍里磨练自己的技能。没过多久，她便开始亲自讲述那些激励人心的故事，并收集与之相伴的伤疤——其中最严重的一道来自她与一头古格巨人的遭遇，而她最终取得了胜利。她穿着那生物的毛皮披风好多年，直到它破烂得不再实用。

在父亲与姐姐死后，库娅拉无忧无虑的生活发生了变化。当时，她正在洛扎丁纵酒作乐，并沉浸在当地居民关于她的那些夸张传闻之中。劳拉索斯决定袭击贝科拉的一处秘密仓库，以获取更多关于那枚魔法镜片的信息——那位术士多年前曾将其托付给劳拉索斯的父亲。加露娜与他同行，而附近透肌魔人的战争勇士库尔费设伏并杀死了二人。库娅拉随即被召回伊尔达里斯。作为枪手中资历最深者，同时也是劳拉索斯的女儿，她被期望接掌这座前哨的领导权。

库娅拉对贝科拉了解不多，也不了解那场夺走父亲与姐姐性命的秘密使命。贝科拉在库娅拉出生前多年曾造访伊尔达里斯，并与她的祖父达成了一项交易；库娅拉对其中含糊的细节，只是通过流言有所耳闻。她知道祖父在与贝科拉玩一场危险的游戏：承诺他无法兑现的力量，同时将这项安排对洛扎丁的统治者保密。

当那位术士突然消失——据流言说是死于地表居民之手——问题似乎就自行解决了。

来自被遗忘的朋友的造访

库娅拉回家后不久，贝科拉便抵达伊尔达里斯，盛气凌人地要求库娅拉像她的祖父当年那样宣誓效忠。库娅拉本就不太会受承诺束缚，她轻佻地发誓支援这幽灵（特征），因为那看起来是最安全的做法。

库娅拉立刻咨询了伊尔达里斯神秘的洞窟先知与父亲最亲密的盟友，以弄清他身上发生了什么。她得知了一些关于父亲最后时日的情况：他去了哪里、为何而去，以及他带走了一件名为赭石支点镜片的东西——那是贝科拉在五个世纪前托付给库娅拉祖父的。贝科拉出现在库娅拉面前时并未提及镜片——或许她以为镜片正被遗忘在伊尔达里斯某座宝藏库中——但库娅拉推断出镜片至关重要。

管理伊尔达里斯的责任改变了库娅拉。她狂野的日子结束了；她很少喝酒，也从不过量。然而，她作为枪手的放纵时代教会了她这座前哨的危险。她不再那么爱夸口，也变得更加谨慎周全，学会了真正领导力的教训。她的族人因此爱戴她。若听到这话库娅拉会大吃一惊，但她作为领袖同样备受敬重，丝毫不逊于劳拉索斯当年。

Campaign Role

Reluctant Ruler

Quara will likely become an ally of the heroes, as she knows useful partners when she sees them. She’s interested in avenging her father and sister, but she knows that whatever goal her father was pursuing with the Ochre Fulcrum Lens could prove critical in freeing Yldaris from Belcorra’s control forever. She has learned that the ochre lens was only one of three lenses that Belcorra entrusted to allies in the region centuries ago, and she sets the heroes on the trail of recovering them and finding out more. The most important lead Quara provides to the heroes is that her father was headed toward an ancient vault at the edge of the lake, so the heroes can find out more at that location.

The heroes might see drow as enemies and assault Yldaris. In this case, Quara does her best to protect her people, relying on the shootist training that still lingers in her quick fingers. She likely won’t trust the heroes with any information after such aggressions, but they might find some clues in her quarters.

Background

Quara Orshendiel never expected to become the ruler of Yldaris. Her father, a wise and prudent man named Larathols, had ruled the settlement for many centuries. She loved her father, not only because he was a decent man, but because he granted Quara the freedom to forge her own path. She loved the swagger and fearlessness of Yldaris’s shootists and grew up fascinated by their tall tales and the way they reveled in their exploits.

Larathols saw no reason not to indulge his youngest daughter’s aspirations. He was already preparing Quara’s older sister, Galuna, to lead Yldaris when the time came, which Quara always imagined as many centuries in the future. In the meantime, she honed her skills with the shootists. It didn’t take long for her to start inspiring stories herself and to collect the scars that go with them—the most severe of which came from a run-in with a gug, against which she ultimately prevailed. She wore the creature’s pelt for years until it grew too tattered to be practical.

Quara’s carefree life changed after her father’s and sister’s deaths. At the time, she was carousing in Lozardyn and delighting in its residents’ larger-than-life rumors about her. Larathols decided to raid one of Belcorra’s secret storehouses to gain more information about the magical lens the sorcerer had entrusted to Larathols’s father many years ago. Galuna had gone with him, and Khurfel, war champion of the nearby urdefhans, ambushed and killed the pair. Quara was immediately called back to Yldaris. As the most senior of the shootists and Larathols’s daughter, she was expected to assume leadership of the outpost.

Quara never knew much about Belcorra or about the secret mission that cost her father and sister their lives. Belcorra had visited Yldaris years before Quara’s birth and made a deal with her grandfather, the vague details of which Quara heard only through rumors. She knew her grandfather played a dangerous game with Belcorra, promising forces that he couldn’t deliver and keeping the arrangement secret from Lozardyn’s rulers.

When the sorcerer suddenly disappeared—killed at the hands of surface dwellers, rumor said—the problem seemed to have sorted itself out.

Visit from a Forgotten Friend

Belcorra arrived in Yldaris shortly after Quara came home, imperiously demanding that Quara swear fealty just as her grandfather had. Never one to be much bound by promises anyway, Quara glibly swore to support the ghost because it seemed like the safest course of action.

Quara immediately consulted with Yldaris’s enigmatic cavern seers and her father’s closest allies to find out what had happened to him. She learned a little bit about her father’s last days, where he had gone and why, and that he’d taken something called the Ochre Fulcrum Lens that Belcorra had entrusted to Quara’s grandfather five centuries earlier. Belcorra hadn’t mentioned the lens when she appeared before Quara—perhaps assuming it was languishing in some Yldaris treasure vault—but Quara deduced the lens’s critical importance.

The responsibility of administering Yldaris has changed Quara. Her wild days have ended; she rarely drinks and never to excess. However, her freewheeling time as a shootist taught her the dangers of their outpost. She boasts less and has become more circumspect, having learned the lessons of true leadership. Her people love her for it. Quara would be shocked to hear it, but she’s just as well-regarded a leader as Larathols ever was.

The Roseguard.name: 玫瑰团 The Roseguard
The Roseguard.text:
奥塔里的创始者

玫瑰团是一支在艾巴萨罗姆扬名的冒险队伍，他们击败了邪恶的@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.snj2fGhhuxfAInom]{贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯}，并建立了如今的伐木小镇@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{奥塔里}——其名源自他们的一位同伴，此人在对抗那位女术士的战斗中阵亡。

如今，奥塔里的人们在创始日（德斯努斯月3日）纪念他们。

玫瑰团成员

玫瑰团由以下英雄组成：

牧师艾斯法娜·曼妮姆斯：艾斯法娜是队伍的治疗者。她是一位信奉埃拉斯蒂尔的牧师，比起大城市，她总是更适应小城镇。

奥塔里·伊瓦什提：奥塔里是队伍的游荡者，是个乐观主义者；即便在最黑暗的时刻，他也用自己的魅力与幽默让同伴们保持希望。

沃尔·拉贾尼：沃尔是队伍的战士，一位干练、直来直去的女剑士，自称是来自奈多的流亡王族。

扎马夫迪安：队伍的法师受过良好教育，是一位占卜师，追逐离奇的阴谋论与神秘学传说。

玫瑰团的遗珍

奥塔里的创始者们每人都有一件单独的物品，灌注了他们作为冒险者能力的精髓。其中两件是寻常物品，仅被注入了一丝足以让它们在岁月中不致劣化的魔法：奥塔里·伊瓦什提的专家级盗贼工具（英雄们可在区域@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}找到）以及扎马夫迪安的法术书《真理的门槛》。沃尔·拉贾尼的长剑与牧师艾斯法娜·曼妮姆斯的胸针则是魔法物品。奥塔里的盗贼工具与标准的专家级盗贼工具别无二致；其余三件物品将在此处详细描述。

当然，玫瑰团当时并未意识到这些物品会成为灌注了他们精髓的遗珍；这一切发生在他们死后——那时他们已将自己的冒险道具收起，享受来之不易的退休生活。直到奥塔里·伊瓦什提以幽灵（特征）之身归来，并目睹那道屏障的形成后，他才得知这些特定物品对于绕过阻挡憎恨魔窟更低等级层的结界至关重要。

当然，玫瑰团每位成员还有其他有用但寻常的冒险道具，其中许多作为历史遗物陈列在曼妮姆斯庄园的城镇博物馆中。

合作之刃

这把长剑在拉贾尼家族中传承多年，沃尔·拉贾尼在其卓越的冒险生涯中一直携带着它。尽管外观光洁如新、寒光闪耀，合作之刃却极其古老，铸于星陨之灾前的奈多。合作之刃通常在晨花图书馆展出，但卡曼·拉贾尼会在第5章开头将其从图书馆盗走——见@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.6EE3LBjSntNQeK8i]{盗窃}。

猎人胸针

牧师艾斯法娜·曼妮姆斯——一位信奉埃拉斯蒂尔的牧师——在她冒险者时代佩戴着这枚银质胸针。她将其传给后代，如今陈列在曼妮姆斯庄园。现在，它仍保留着她力量的一丝痕迹，使持有者在与不死生物战斗时获得更强的力量。

真理的门槛

扎马夫迪安的法术书《真理的门槛》最初曾是一部朴素的奥术与神秘学传说论著，收录了数个实用法术。然而其上批注过于繁密，以至原文几乎难以辨认。显然，扎马夫迪安希望阻止怪异生物操弄无辜者的心智，但对那些寻求危险或晦涩传说的人而言，这本法术书却是一座宝藏宝库。书商莫里宾特目前将此书收藏在怪谈故事中。

Otari's Founders

An adventuring party who made their name in Absalom, the Roseguard defeated the villainous @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.snj2fGhhuxfAInom]{Belcorra Haruvex} and founded what’s now the logging town of @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{Otari}- named after a comrade of theirs who fell in battle against the sorceress.

Today, the people of Otari honor them on founders’ day, 3 Desnus.

Members of The Roseguard

The Roseguard consisted of the following heroes:

Aesephna Menhemes: Aesephna was the party’s healer. She was a cleric of Erastil who was always more comfortable in smaller towns than big cities.

Otari Ilvashti: Otari, the group’s rogue, was an optimist who kept the others hopeful with his charm and humor, even during their darkest hours.

Vol Rajani: Vol was the party’s fighter, a capable and no-nonsense swordswoman who claimed to be exiled royalty from Nidal.

Zarmavdian: The group’s wizard was a well-educated diviner who pursued outlandish conspiracy theories and occult lore.

Icons of the Roseguard

The founders of Otari each had a single item imbued with the essence of their abilities as adventurers. Two of these are mundane items, invested with a spark of magic sufficient to keep them from deteriorating over the years: Otari Ilvashti’s infiltrator’s thieves’ tools (which the heroes can find in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}) and Zarmavdian’s spellbook, Thresholds of Truth. Vol Rajani’s sword and Aesephna Menhemes’s brooch are magic items. Otari’s thieves’ tools are no different than standard infiltrator’s thieves tools; the other three items are described here in detail.

The Roseguard didn’t realize that these items would become icons imbued with their essence, of course; this occurred after their deaths, when they’d already put their adventuring gear away for their well-earned retirement. Otari Ilvashti only learned that these specific items are critical to bypassing the ward that blocks the Abomination Vaults’ lower levels once he returned as a ghost and witnessed the barrier’s creation.

Of course, each member of the Roseguard had other useful, if mundane, adventuring gear, much of which is on display in the town museum in Menhemes Manor as historical relics.

The Cooperative Blade

This longsword has been in the Rajani family for years, and Vol Rajani carried it throughout her distinguished adventuring career. Despite its pristine and gleaming appearance, the Cooperative Blade is incredibly ancient, created in pre-Earthfall Nidal. The Cooperative Blade is normally on display at the Dawnflower Library, but Carman Rajani steals it from the library at the beginning of Chapter 5- see @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.6EE3LBjSntNQeK8i]{The Theft}.

The Hunter's Brooch

Aesephna Menhemes, a cleric of Erastil, wore this silver brooch during her time as an adventurer. She passed it down to her descendants, and it’s now on display in Menhemes Manor. Today, it holds a small trace of her power, granting the wielder greater strength when combating undead creatures.

Thresholds of Truth

Zarmavdian's spellbook, Thresholds of Truth, was once a straightforward treatise on arcane and occult lore containing several useful spells. It's been so heavily annotated, however, that the original text is hard to read. It's clear that Zarmavdian wanted to prevent eldritch creatures from manipulating innocent minds, but his spellbook is a treasure trove for those seeking dangerous or inscrutable lore. The bookseller Morlibint currently keeps this book in his collection at Odd Stories.

Campaign Timeline.name: 战役时间线 Campaign Timeline
Campaign Timeline.text:
日期

事件

黑暗年代

蛇人族建造了空无之窟——一座献给外神宁布洛斯的圣所，深藏于格拉利昂地表之下。当奥罗登将星石群岛自内海升起时，空无之窟也随之上升，最终停在科托斯岛下方数百英尺处。

未知

某座地底城市中的中立卓尔在更靠近地表处建造了一座前哨站，名为伊尔达里斯。这些卓尔在无意识间被空无之窟吸引，却并不知道它的存在。

4213 AR

贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯出生于艾巴萨罗姆的富裕哈鲁维克斯家族。除家族成员外无人知晓，哈鲁维克斯家族拥有强大的异怪血脉，并世代虔奉外神宁布洛斯。

4219 AR

哈鲁维克斯家族的秘密献祭被发现后被逐出艾巴萨罗姆。他们逃往安多安，并在贫困中度日。这对年仅6岁的贝科拉——家族最年幼的后嗣——尤为艰难。哈鲁维克斯家族向贝科拉灌输对艾巴萨罗姆的仇恨，并让孩子牢记她作为宁布洛斯天选之人的使命。

4230 AR

作为最后一位被放逐的哈鲁维克斯家族成员，贝科拉已成为强大的术士。她秘密迁往科托斯岛，开始建造一座名为凄凉灯塔的魔法灯塔，其位置正位于空无之窟之上。她以魔法贯穿土，开辟通往圣所的通道，并开始收集一支异怪大军以攻击艾巴萨罗姆。

4234 AR

贝科拉完成凄凉灯塔，并开始修建其地下城——憎恨魔窟。她利用鬼火与被束缚的魔鬼来将迅速扩张的群落纳入其意志之下。她与栖居于此区域的卓尔与透肌魔人会面，并以性命为筹码要求他们效忠。

4244 AR

艾巴萨罗姆的一支被称作“猎友会”（受官方认可的冒险者团体）的队伍——玫瑰团——得知贝科拉的存在后前来调查她的灯塔。他们杀死了她，却始终未能发现凄凉灯塔之下规模庞大的憎恨魔窟；在这场战斗中，贝科拉杀死了游荡者奥塔里·伊瓦什提。获胜的玫瑰团在此建起一座小型港口聚落并就地隐退，以逝去的友人之名将其命名为奥塔里。

4290 AR

最后一位玫瑰团成员去世，奥塔里开始走向衰落。

4294 AR

奥塔里被遗弃。

4300 AR

石鳞狗头人殖民奥塔里。

4310 AR

雅拉普引诱船只走向覆灭，为其部族敲响丧钟；不久之后石鳞狗头人被冒险者击败。马克兰尼·曼妮姆斯领导了奥塔里的重新定居。

4323 AR

奥塔里锯木厂与运木水槽的建造完成。

4719 AR

贝科拉以幽灵之身苏醒，并开始着手重新启动凄凉灯塔。自她死后，其地下城已被世代相争的生物占据；她试图再次将它们纳入自己的掌控。

4721 AR

当前年份。凄凉灯塔被一群螨精侵占，但它们又在“幽灵女王”的驱使下，被向上推进的摩洛克所取代。凄凉灯塔已准备好进行一次测试，以展示其力量。

Date

Event

Age of Darkness

Serpentfolk construct the Empty Vault, a shrine to Nhimbaloth far beneath the surface of Golarion. When Aroden raises the Starstone Isles from the Inner Sea, the Empty Vault ascends with it, ending up several hundred feet below the Isle of Kortos.

Unknown

The neutral drow of a subterranean city construct an outpost closer to the surface called Yldaris. These drow are unconsciously drawn to the Empty Vault but don’t know of its presence.

4213 AR

Belcorra Haruvex is born to the wealthy Haruvex family in Absalom. Unknown to anyone outside the family, the Haruvexes have a strong aberrant bloodline and a familial devotion to the Outer God Nhimbaloth.

4219 AR

The Haruvex family is ejected from Absalom when their secret sacrifices are discovered. They flee to Andoran, where they live in poverty. This is particularly hard on 6-year-old Belcorra, the family’s youngest scion. The Haruvexes instill in Belcorra a hatred of Absalom and impress upon the child her role as Nhimbaloth’s chosen one.

4230 AR

Belcorra, the last exiled Haruvex, has become a powerful sorcerer. She secretly relocates to the Isle of Kortos, where she begins work on a magical lighthouse called Gauntlight, situated directly above the Empty Vault. She magically opens passages through the earth to reach the shrine and begins to collect an army of aberrations to attack Absalom.

4234 AR

Belcorra completes Gauntlight and begins work on its dungeons, the Abomination Vaults. She uses will-o’-wisps and bound devils to enforce her will on the rapidly expanding hordes within. She meets the drow and urdefhans who dwell in the area and demands their fealty in exchange for their lives.

4244 AR

One of Absalom’s “hunting lodges” (a sanctioned group of adventurers) called the Roseguard hear of Belcorra’s presence and come to investigate her lighthouse. They kill her but never learn of the existence of the expansive Abomination Vaults beneath Gauntlight; Belcorra kills the rogue Otari Ilvashti in this battle. The victorious Roseguard construct a small port community and retire there, naming it Otari after their fallen friend.

4290 AR

The last Roseguard passes away, and Otari begins to fall into decline.

4294 AR

Otari is abandoned.

4300 AR

Stonescale kobolds colonize Otari.

4310 AR

Yarlaip seals his tribe’s fate by luring ships to their doom; the Stonescale kobolds are soon thereafter defeated by adventurers. Maklanni Menhemes leads the resettlement of Otari.

4323 AR

Construction of the Otari Mill and log flume is completed.

4719 AR

Belcorra awakens as a ghost and begins work to reactivate Gauntlight. Its dungeons have been populated with generations of infighting creatures since her death, and she seeks to bring them under her control once more.

4721 AR

The current year. Gauntlight becomes infested with a band of mitflits, who are displaced by morlocks pushing upwards at the urging of their “ghost queen.” Gauntlight is ready for a test to demonstrate its power.

Gauntlight.name: 凄凉灯塔 Gauntlight
Gauntlight.text:
凄凉灯塔很难不引人注目，它高耸于凄凉灯塔要塞的废墟之上，其基座一路向下贯穿《憎恨魔窟》的每一层，直达更深处的空无之窟。从许多方面来说，这件神器与其说只是战役中的一处地点，不如说与充满怨毒的贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯本人一样，都是这场战役的关键危险之一。

凄凉灯塔

物品 20

  • 独特
  • 神器
  • 魔法
  • 死灵

凄凉灯塔远不止是一座从雾隐沼泽古老废墟核心升起的、115英尺高的灯塔——它苍白的石墙向废墟之下延伸很深，穿过八个不同的地城楼层，最终在地表以下的第九层终止；在那里，它深邃的地基以一间不祥的密室为中心，久远之前，宁布洛斯本人曾在此以实体与这个世界发生过接触。完成其实体建造后，术士贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯将这处斑点作为力量源泉，把墙壁、地面与天花板逐层灌注以异界之力。灯塔顶端的透镜本应在时间推移后能将这股残留的异界能量聚焦为一道强大的光束，但贝科拉的计划在她用危险的魔法透镜替换普通透镜之前就被迫中止了。

作为神器，凄凉灯塔无法用常规手段破坏。其墙壁无法穿透，除宁布洛斯的追随者外，任何人都不可能突破它们。它们会阻挡允许暂时穿行的效果，例如穿墙术，并且也会制造一道抵御次元旅行的屏障。墙壁会尝试反制传送效果与异界旅行，使其无法进入或离开凄凉灯塔内的区域，以及将生物召唤进该区域的尝试（使用+37反制调整值）；此效果不会阻止被召唤的生物在召唤结束时离开。注意：此效果仅适用于位于凄凉灯塔及其占地范围之内的区域（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{A11}、@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{A25}、@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8pbhSFgv71lvCz9M]{B35}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.eOv6LI3wvIuKyyNJ]{C15}，等等），而非覆盖整个《憎恨魔窟》！

如果贝科拉的幽灵（特征）被永久摧毁，凄凉灯塔将失去所有魔法性质，并一路向内坍塌直到其基座，在雾隐沼泽中留下一个深得惊人的巨坑。

启动要启动凄凉灯塔，一个生物必须位于该神器最深处，即神殿楼层的空无之窟（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.a9b40LjI7QwLgirk]{J20}）。在空无之窟内的任何位置，生物都能通过凄凉灯塔穹顶室内的透镜远程观察外部世界，包括凄凉灯塔的光束能够触及的任何区域。

支点镜片

在凄凉灯塔当前功能受损的状态下，它只能以下述两种方式启动。通过替换并装入一组名为支点镜片的四枚魔法灯塔透镜——它们能聚焦宁布洛斯的凶恶凝视，强大到连贝科拉也会格外小心对待——该神器将获得显著更强的力量，包括将光束触及艾巴萨罗姆的能力，以及每分钟都能启动其效果的能力。

启动 3 交互；

频率 每月一次；

效果一道淡蓝色光束自凄凉灯塔的透镜射出，照亮以1英里内任一点为中心的30英尺半径爆发区域。光亮(术)充满该区域，使区域内或在被照亮区域表面10英尺范围内的任何尸体苏醒为等级 –1的不死生物（通常为骷髅卫士或蹒跚丧尸）。一旦苏醒，这些不死生物将持续活动直至被杀死。在此之前，它们不受控制，只被屠戮生者的欲望所驱使。

若凄凉灯塔被完全修复，则不死生物改为按使用者意愿苏醒为任意15级或更低的常见不死生物。

启动 3 交互；

频率 每月一次；

效果一道淡蓝色光束自凄凉灯塔的透镜射出，照亮以1英里内任一点为中心的30英尺半径爆发区域。使用者选择一个实体位于凄凉灯塔内、等级为4级或更低的生物；该生物随后被传送至此照明半径内的任意一点。这是一个传送效果。

若凄凉灯塔被完全修复，则可运输凄凉灯塔内任意数量、等级为15级或更低的生物。

Gauntlight is hard to miss, as it towers over the ruins of Gauntlight Keep and its base extends down through every level of the Abomination Vaults to the Empty Vault far below. In many ways, this artifact is just as much a key danger of the campaign as the spiteful Belcorra Haruvex herself.

Gauntlight

Item 20

  • Unique
  • Artifact
  • Magical
  • Necromancy

Gauntlight is much more than a 115-foot-tall lighthouse rising from the heart of an old ruin in Fogfen—its pale stone walls extend far below the ruins, passing through eight different dungeon levels and finally terminating at the ninth level below the surface, where its deep foundation centers on an ominous chamber where, long ago, Nhimbaloth herself once physically brushed against this world. Once she finished its physical construction, the sorcerer Belcorra Haruvex used this spot as a source of power to infuse the walls, floors, and ceilings of each of Gauntlight’s levels with eldritch power. The lens at the apex of the lighthouse would have, in time, been able to focus this lingering eldritch energy into a powerful beam, but Belcorra’s plans were cut short before she could replace the mundane lenses with dangerous magical ones.

As an artifact, Gauntlight can’t be damaged by normal means. Its walls are impenetrable and impervious to any attempt to breach them by anybody except for followers of Nhimbaloth. They block effects that allow temporary passage, such as passwall, and also create a barrier against dimensional travel. The walls attempt to counteract teleportation effects and planar travel into or out of areas within Gauntlight and efforts to summon creatures into the area (using a +37 counteract modifier); this effect does not stop a summoned creature from departing when the summoning ends. Note that this effect only applies to the areas that are within Gauntlight and its footprint (areas @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{A11}, @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{A25}, @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8pbhSFgv71lvCz9M]{B35}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.eOv6LI3wvIuKyyNJ]{C15}, and so on), and not to the entirety of the Abomination Vaults!

If Belcorra’s ghost is permanently destroyed, Gauntlight loses all of its magical properties and collapses in on itself all the way down to its base, leaving an incredibly deep pit in the Fogfen.

Activation To activate Gauntlight, a creature must be in the deepest portion of the artifact, the Empty Vault on the Temple level (area @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.a9b40LjI7QwLgirk]{J20}). From anywhere within the Empty Vault, a creature can observe the world outside remotely through Gauntlight’s lens in its cuploa, including any area Gauntlight’s beam can reach.

Fulcrum Lenses

In Gauntlight’s current state of diminished functionality, it can be activated only in the two ways below. By swapping in a series of four magical lighthouse lenses called fulcrum lenses that focus Nhimbaloth’s baleful gaze—lenses so powerful that even Belcorra takes special care with them—the artifact gains significantly greater power, including the ability to reach all the way to Absalom and to activate its effects every minute.

Activate 3 Interact;

Frequency once per month;

Effect A pale blue beam shines from Gauntlight’s lens and illuminates a 30-foot-radius burst centered on any point within 1 mile. The light saturates the region, causing any corpses in the area or within 10 feet of the surface of the illuminated area to animate as level –1 undead (typically as skeleton guards or zombie shamblers). Once animated, the undead remain active until slain. Until then, they remain uncontrolled and are driven only by the desire to slaughter the living.

If Gauntlight is fully restored, the undead instead animate as any Common undead of 15th level or less, as the user wishes.

Activate 3 Interact;

Frequency once per month;

Effect A pale blue beam shines from Gauntlight’s lens and illuminates a 30-foot-radius burst centered on any point within 1 mile. The user chooses one creature of 4th level or less that is physically located within Gauntlight; this creature is then is teleported to any point within this illumination radius. This is a teleportation effect.

If Gauntlight is fully restored, any number of creatures within Gauntlight of 15th level or lower can be transported.

Nhimbaloth.name: 宁布洛斯 Nhimbaloth
Nhimbaloth.text:
灵魂之河的河岸掠过每一个世界，因为当凡人死去时，他们的灵魂会迈出躯壳，踏上通往来世的第一步，跨越这道河岸。然而，如同大多数河流一样，掠食者潜伏在这些险恶的河岸旁。夜鬼婆、星界达厄魔、吞噬者，以及更糟的存在在河边徘徊，渴望将灵魂从轮回中摘下并以其为食。可怖的宁布洛斯——空寂之死——并不屑于与这些掠食者一同在灵魂之河的岸边狩猎；相反，她以掠食者自身为食，沉溺于吞噬那些正被自诩为死者顶级猎手之存在在咽喉中消化的灵魂。

宁布洛斯借助灵魂之河的河岸在宇宙无数世界中显现，但她无法随心所欲地想来就来。在空寂之死能在某个世界中显现之前，该世界必须先经历一场浩劫，其规模之巨足以让涌入灵魂之河的亡者洪流削弱生与死之间的界限。当如此惨烈的伤亡将这道边界稀薄到一定程度，她便能自裂隙间漂入，并玷污所见之物。灵魂之河与其河岸因此产生的模糊，在形而上学层面上类似沼泽泥泞不清的边界。宁布洛斯降临某个世界时会选择栖居于偏远沼地，这绝非巧合。宁布洛斯并非饕餮——她拥有无尽的耐心，能在一个世界潜伏数个世纪而不被察觉。

更多时候，她在孤立沼地中的存在只是悄然溃烂，将一片自然美景化作危险的沼泽洼地，把各类怪物吸引到其腐臭的核心。这类土地会呼唤鬼火；对这些以恐惧为食者而言，空寂之死造成的毁灭就像一瓶无与伦比年份的佳酿。随着时代推移，许多鬼火会意识到它们所选巢穴中影响之源的真相，而在多数情况下，这些贪婪的异怪会成为空寂之死最狂热的信徒。

拟象与领域

尽管可怖的宁布洛斯并无属于自己的物理躯体，但在完美条件下，她也曾显现出可被感知的形态：在吞噬海量灵魂之后，她会变得可见，就像空杯一旦注满液体，其轮廓便更为分明一般。在此形态下，宁布洛斯呈现为一团扭曲、融化般的闪耀蓝色流体，其眼睛呈黄色四尖星形，半透明触手纠缠成束，向四面八方延伸。触手末端分裂为七条更细的须腕，而这些“手”触碰世界之处，便会留下她的印记——一圈由七处奇异杂草构成的凹痕：植被拒绝生长，岩石变得粉白如粉笔，血肉溃烂，仿佛忘记了如何施放治疗术。天空中星辰的位置、沼泽里被困的亡者数量、以及一年中的时节，似乎都会影响这道或许曾是宁布洛斯躯体之影的显现时机；她的邪教徒的在场同样如此，但这种显现很少持续太久。显现总会以一次由内而外的骤然吞噬作结，空寂之死退回她的领域，只留下有毒水域与无智不死的死亡沼地。

这种形态常见于描绘空寂之死的插画中，但宁布洛斯也常被刻画成一名幽魂般的人类女子（幽灵（特征））：她的脸本是一片空白，唯有一只黄色四尖星形的独眼；一束漫长、翻涌的幽魂触手（每条皆具七指）如烟幕般缠绕其近乎骨骸的躯体。这一形象无疑源自艺术家的噩梦，但邪教却将其奉为己有。

宁布洛斯的领域是一处双重疆域。她将灵魂之河的河岸当作狩猎场，也当作从世界到世界进行旅行的高速通道，但据说她居于一颗遥远的死亡行星之上。此领域之名已湮没于时代；宁布洛斯的信众仅以耳语称其为“虚空荆沼”（Voidbracken）。在此，宁布洛斯与另一股力量曾爆发过一场远古之战（多数神话暗示她的敌手是法莱斯玛），并导致空寂之死的躯体被摧毁。然而，这场冲突并未令她死亡，她的邪教反倒将其视作一次进化——失去躯体之后，她便能随心所欲地沿着灵魂之河的河岸来去。虚空荆沼依然在黑暗织锦中旋转，漫无目的地漂游于宇宙，却始终受宁布洛斯的意志驱动；当它靠近一个有人居住的星系时，生者的灵魂便会在一场被稀少幸存记载称为“死潮”（Deadtide）的浩劫中被从凡躯中牵引而出。根据诸如《死灵之书》这类古老文本中的某些段落所述，许多伟大的旧日支配者与外神必须等待群星排列得恰到好处才能显现。对宁布洛斯而言，这一点几乎是字面意义上的真实。终有一日，她的死潮将夺走足够多的生命，使宁布洛斯的“死亡”也走向死亡；她所消化并积累的灵能最终会抹消她远古的败北，让她再次以物理存在的形态降临。

她将自死亡中崛起，比以往任何时候都更加饥饿。

教义与信众

宁布洛斯的信条与崇拜完全是其邪教徒的产物，因为空寂之死几乎没有兴趣为信众提供直接的启示或指引。此根源呼应了所有以长者神话中同样漠视信众的实体为中心之邪教所建立的模式。由于缺乏神祇层面的指引，尽管信众努力完成特定目标，他们却不受禁忌约束。

就宁布洛斯而言，她的信徒试图制造不死生物——尤其是幽灵（特征）与其他无形体生物——以为其怪诞圣像提供养分。他们也会在仪式中大啖食肉动物，以模仿宁布洛斯对噬魂怪物的掠食。她的信仰在城市区域几乎无人知晓，但在偏僻的沼泽村落中，对空寂之死的崇拜可能渗透整个聚落。在这种情况下，邪教通常会搭建一座主流教堂的空壳作为掩护，以应付路过的好奇外人，而在夜色深处的隐秘地点崇拜他们的女神。

较低阶的宁布洛斯牧师会穿着其社会葬礼仪式中常见的尸衣，选择在仪式中披上“终末礼服”或“临终长裙”，希冀甜美的湮灭能回应他们的祈祷。然而，邪教首领常常摒弃这一传统，改穿深绿或灰色的兜帽长袍，其上装饰着纠结成团、黏附不落的苔藓布片，并戴着覆以额外苔藓面纱的骷髅状面具。邪教徒偏爱在战斗中使用连枷；这些武器的槌头常被制成四尖星形，连枷的链条连接于星形中心，握柄则缠绕苔藓与从死者身上剥下并鞣制的皮肉。

类人生物远非空寂之死唯一的崇拜者。如前所述，鬼火及其同类在宁布洛斯降临荒凉沼地时带来的阴森气息中发现许多可赞之处，他们很快便会转而信奉空寂之死，仿佛在她影响下以恐惧(术)为食会将虔诚感染给鬼火。沼泽巨人也被认为会以“泥沼之母”“灯芯草火女”“沼火女王”等名号崇敬宁布洛斯，不过他们对她的祈祷更像是在向沼地的守护者祈求而已。吸血迷雾也常在她的沼地中出没，许多学者紧张地揣测宁布洛斯的印记与吸血迷雾通过雾状须腕吸食后在受害者体内留下的七个等距穿刺孔簇之间所暗示的联系。

神殿与神龛

空寂之死的邪教成员往往是真正绝望之人：钱很少，希望更少。他们在家中进行崇拜，或者在勉强能称为“家”的地方——半塌的棚屋、废弃的谷仓，甚至坍陷的生存主义者避难所——这些都足以用来崇拜宁布洛斯。更为罕见的是，由有财力的离经叛道者领导的邪教会建造更大的建筑以尊崇宁布洛斯，并常把这些建筑建成对其他教堂的嘲弄：加入彩绘玻璃窗、马赛克镶嵌画等艺术品来颂扬外神女神。在这种情况下，该建筑往往还兼具第二用途，例如城堡、庄园宅邸或类似设施。耐人寻味的是，这些大型建筑常共享一个特征：一座作为烽火台或灯塔的高塔，用以向鬼火致敬——邪教徒对其极尽宠爱。对追随者而言，鬼火是宁布洛斯的眼睛，她的目光通过这些超自然掠食者的幽明发光注视世界。因此，神殿中的烽火台或灯塔象征着一只鬼火；同时他们也相信，这能为宁布洛斯提供一枚镜头，使她得以凝视世界。

宁布洛斯的圣徽是一枚骷髅，其啃咬中塞满苔藓；不过她的邪教徒常将其变体制作成粗陋的人偶或塑像，由覆满苔藓的骨头与骷髅碎片拼成。那些敢公开表明与女神关联的神殿，往往会用骷髅装点建筑：小心培育苔藓，使其长成湿漉漉、寄生害虫的胡须；或以垂落于拱门上的苔藓帷幕代替真正的门，形成潮湿的帘幕。

祭司的职责

如同多数长者神话的邪教一般，宁布洛斯的虔信者大多并非出于敬重或爱慕而崇拜，而是出于恐惧。对他们而言，引发噩梦的并非“死亡”的概念，而是对来世可能遭受何种审判的恐惧，这驱使大多数人投向她的信仰。那些曾犯下罪孽、曾对先前信仰犯下异端，或仅仅因持续惶恐自己抵达法莱斯玛的王座前时她会对自己说些什么的人，会转而寻求宁布洛斯所提供的湮灭。他们并非想逃离死亡或生命，而是想逃离他们所恐惧、并认为会更糟的来世。

然而，吸引信众加入她麾下的动机并非只有这一种。有些人并非被对来世的恐惧驱使，而是被沉浸于他人痛苦与绝望灵光的机会所诱惑。这些成员是该教派中最可憎的一群，因为他们把宁布洛斯向崇拜者许诺的湮灭当作诱饵，引诱绝望者上钩，以援助他们自身的邪恶阴谋。有些人试图将这些渴求湮灭的狂热者当作可消耗的军队，用于复仇或暴怒之举；另一些人则把信众当作祭品，以为可憎的仪式提供燃料，或打造骇人的魔法物品。

即便这些捕食绝望者的掠食者，与宁布洛斯最恶劣的信徒相比也显得苍白无力——那是彻底理解空寂之死、并将其视为毁灭自己所憎恨之世界的终极工具的虚无主义者。对这些邪教徒而言，唯有利用虚空荆沼为他们的世界带来一次死潮才算足够。他们或许有一个隐秘计划，要在万物终结之瞬逃离世界；他们甚至可能寻求自身的湮灭，或相信宁布洛斯会以统治一颗死亡世界作为奖赏回报他们。不论其意图为何，这些末日牧羊人都是空寂之死信徒中最危险的一群。

节庆

在小型社区中以其他宗教作伪装存在的宁布洛斯邪教，会煞费苦心地遵守那一信仰的节日，以防访客或（更罕见地）镇民并不知晓他们集会的真实信仰。但除此之外，空寂之死的信众并不庆祝固定节日或宗教庆典——只有一个不同寻常的例外。宁布洛斯的躯体被夺走、虚空荆沼被剥夺生命的确切日期已不可考，因此每个邪教都会自行选择某个重要日子来纪念这一周年。无人知晓虚空荆沼一年的长度，这使得该仪式更显随意；尽管如此，她的信众相信，在这些所谓的“虚空黎明”之一，太阳将不会升起，而所有生命都会在一场死潮中被掐灭。邪教徒会以饕餮盛宴来庆祝通往虚空黎明的那一夜，宴席由各式食肉动物与怪物组成——他们常在仪式进行时就开始制作这些餐食，而“食材”仍然活着。当太阳不可避免地升起时，邪教徒会从自己人中挑选一名作为最后的盛宴，以赎罪于未能为世界带来死潮。

箴言

宁布洛斯的信众喜爱引用并背诵《呓语芦苇》中他们最钟爱的故事，每则故事都包含若干令人难忘且萦绕不去的句子。然而，一句源自《死灵之书》的恶名昭著引言之变体，尤能引起她所有信徒的共鸣。

“死者永眠，而死亡亦可死去”

对许多人而言，死亡的概念类似永恒的沉睡：一种没有黎明的安歇，灵魂在其中经历来世，仿佛熟睡之人在一夜之间能梦见数段不同人生。不论梦者在黎明醒来，还是在睡梦中死去，一切梦境终将结束。正如空寂之死前来叩门之时，即便死亡也知晓湮灭——甚至死亡也可能死去。

圣典

即便在外神这一深奥主题之中，关于宁布洛斯的记述也相当罕见。可怖的《死灵之书》提及了她，而该书某些译本据称包含对其真形的描述；这也许是唯一将宁布洛斯的真形以印刷形式记录下来的地方。甚至在与其崇拜最常相关的文本——一部名为《呓语芦苇》的稀有典籍——中，也不包含这些信息。

《呓语芦苇》的起源并非来自崇拜空寂之死之人，而是来自试图反抗她之人。此书由故事、神话、寓言以及与宁布洛斯的遭遇记录构成，材料采集自数十个世界、数百个区域。编纂者的名字早已被遗忘，因为其在文本中未署名。对崇拜宁布洛斯的人而言，这无关紧要；作者最初撰写此书本是为了编目记录可以对抗宁布洛斯影响的方式，这一点同样无关紧要。收集这些关于空寂之死擦过世界的古老故事这一行为本身产生了相反的效果；如今，那些试图将女神的注意引向自己世界的人，会利用《呓语芦苇》传播她过往降临的故事。

与其他宗教的关系

宁布洛斯并不与其他神祇结交，尽管她对荒野的造访常会迫使其与其他信仰发生对抗。尤其是哥兹莱与黛丝娜反对她的影响：前者因不自然之物的扩散玷污沼地而反对，后者则出于愤怒与恐惧的混合，担心其信众在探索荒野时会意外跌入宁布洛斯的掌控。第一世界的长老们同样反对宁布洛斯，因为她寄生般的须腕偶尔会通过妖精之门与传送门漂入那一位面。即便成功驱逐空寂之死之后，仍不可避免会残留一些已落入其影响之下的小型妖精邪教。

法莱斯玛出于多重理由反对宁布洛斯。那些死于后者存在所萦绕之土地的人，往往会化为幽灵（特征）。更甚者，空寂之死吞噬这些幽灵的习性理所当然地激怒了法莱斯玛，因为被吞噬的灵魂不会被送往骨园，而是直接消失。人们或许会以为，对生死循环如此严重的冒犯将迫使法莱斯玛与宁布洛斯直接对决；确实，某些古老文本记述了两位女神在凡人文明伊始之黎明发生过一次冲突。那场泰坦般的战斗没有胜者。宁布洛斯学会隐藏自己对世界的掠食，以至于连法莱斯玛也难以轻易找到她；而《呓语芦苇》中有一则尤为亵渎的故事提到，法莱斯玛至今仍背负一道隐秘伤疤，作为她未能彻底击败空寂之死之尝试的提醒——据说那道伤疤呈七处杂草构成的血肉凹痕之形，正是宁布洛斯吞噬死之女神本质之处。

无论此神话是否有事实依据，法莱斯玛的信众都以仇恨与敬畏交织的态度看待宁布洛斯及其邪教。唯有法莱斯玛最虔诚且最强大的信徒才会获准狩猎宁布洛斯的信众；他们竭力阻止平信徒过多了解空寂之死。他们的理由是——宁布洛斯只以幽灵为食，而通过击败或阻止这些不死生物的形成，他们便能打击空寂之死——但在一些人看来，这更像借口。

宁布洛斯的灵感来源

H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特曾鼓励他人扩展他所创造、用以填充其怪奇小说的怪诞存在神话；我最初正是在这一根源之中，创作了宁布洛斯，用作我个人故事与角色扮演战役中的反派。她主要受到阿尔杰农·布莱克伍德经典短篇《柳林》（“The Willows”）中那种潜伏于自然帷幕后方的神秘恐怖所启发；同时，我也从Chaosium的朋友们那里获得了关于外神命名惯例的一些宝贵建议。就这样，宁布洛斯成为我最自豪的创作之一，也是不断扩张的洛夫克拉夫特神话体系中的新增成员。

——詹姆斯·雅各布斯

The banks of the River of Souls brushes against every world, for when a mortal dies, their spirit steps out of their body to cross over these banks on the first step toward the afterlife. Yet, as with most rivers, predators lurk along these perilous banks. Night hags, astradaemons, devourers, and worse stalk the River, eager to pluck souls free and feed on them. Dread Nhimbaloth, the Empty Death, doesn’t deign to hunt the shores of the River of Souls alongside these predators—she instead feeds upon the predators themselves, reveling in consuming souls already being digested in the gullets of those who would deem themselves the apex hunters of the dead.

Nhimbaloth uses the shores of the River of Souls to manifest upon the universe’s countless worlds, but she can’t just do so whenever she wills it. Before the Empty Death can manifest within a world, it must first endure a cataclysm so vast that the outflow of the dead into the River of Souls weakens the boundaries between life and death. When such massive casualties sufficiently thin these borders, she can drift in through the cracks and stain what she finds. The resulting blurring between the River of Souls and its shore is metaphysically akin to the muddied boundary of a swamp. It’s no coincidence that when Nhimbaloth emerges into a world, she chooses to dwell in its remote swamplands. Nhimbaloth isn’t a glutton—she’s endlessly patient and can linger on a world for centuries before being noticed.

More often, her presence in an isolated swampland simply festers, turning a region of natural beauty into a dangerous fen that draws all manner of monsters to its fetid heart. Such lands call to will-o’-wisps; for these feeders of fears, the ruin wrought by the Empty Death is like a fine wine of unparalleled vintage. In time, many of these wisps realize the truth of the influence in their chosen haunts, and in most cases, these ravenous aberrations become Empty Death’s most fervent worshippers.

Personification and Realm

While Dread Nhimbaloth has no physical body of her own, she has been known to manifest a perceivable shape under the perfect conditions, growing visible after consuming a huge quantity of souls the way an empty glass’s contours becomes more defined once filled with liquid. In this form, Nhimbaloth appears as a twisting, melted mass of glistening blue fluid with eyes the shape of yellow four-pointed stars and a tangle of translucent tentacles extending in every direction. The tentacles’ tips split into seven smaller tendrils, and where these “hands” touch the world, they leave her mark behind—a ring of seven strange divots where vegetation refuses to grow, stone becomes chalky, and flesh festers as if it had forgotten how to heal. The position of the stars in the sky, the number of dead trapped within the swamp, and the time of year all seem to play a part in determining when this shadow of what might have once been Nhimbaloth’s body can appear, as does the presence of her cultists, but the manifestation rarely persists for long. Always, the manifestation ends in a sudden consumption from within when the Empty Death retreats to her domain, leaving behind a dead swampland of toxic waters and mindless undeath.

This form often appears in illustrations that depict the Empty Death, though Nhimbaloth is also portrayed as a ghostly human woman with a single yellow eye in the shape of a four-pointed star filling her otherwise blank face, and a long, writhing mane of ghostly, seven-fingered tentacles wraps around her nearly skeletal body in a smoky shroud. This version of her is surely the product of an artist’s nightmare, yet cults have adopted it as their own.

Nhimbaloth’s realm is a twofold domain. She uses the banks of the River of Souls as a hunting ground and a highway to travel from world to world, but supposedly dwells on a distant, dead planet. The name of this domain has been lost to time; the faithful of Nhimbaloth refer to it in whispers only as Voidbracken. Here, an ancient battle between Nhimbaloth and another power took place (most myths suggest her foe was Pharasma) that resulted in the destruction of the Empty Death’s body. This conflict didn’t result in her death, however, and her cult fondly views the event as an evolution—for without a body, she could now come and go as she pleased along the shores of the River of Souls. Voidbracken spins still in the Dark Tapestry, wandering aimlessly through the universe but driven always by Nhimbaloth’s will, and when it draws near an inhabited system, the souls of the living are drawn from their mortal shells in a cataclysm referred to in rare surviving accounts as the Deadtide. According to certain passages scribed in ancient texts like the Necronomicon, many of the Great Old Ones and Outer Gods must wait for the stars to align just right to manifest. This is quite literally true in Nhimbaloth’s case. Eventually, her Deadtides will claim enough lives so that Nhimbaloth’s death will die; the accumulated spiritual energy she has digested will ultimately undo her ancient defeat, allowing her to once more exist as a physical being.

She will rise from death hungrier than ever.

Dogma and Worshippers

Nhimbaloth’s creed and worship are entirely the product of her cultists, as the Empty Death has little interest in providing her worshippers with direct inspiration or direction. This tradition echoes the pattern established with all other cults centered on entities of the Elder Mythos who similarly care not for their worshippers. Because of this lack of divine direction, while their worshippers strive to accomplish specific goals, they aren’t limited by anathemas.

In Nhimbaloth’s case, her worshippers seek to create undead—particularly ghosts and other incorporeal creatures—to provide sustenance for their eldritch icon. They also feast upon carnivores at their ceremonies, aping Nhimbaloth’s predation upon soul-eating monsters. Her faith is all but unknown in urban areas, but in isolated swamp villages, worship of the Empty Death can suffuse entire settlements. In such instances, the cult typically builds the shell of a mainstream church to serve as a front and satisfy any curious outsiders passing through, while worshipping their goddess at a hidden location in the heart of the night.

Lower-level clerics of Nhimbaloth dress in whatever corpse’s attire is commonly used in their society’s burial rites, choosing to wear a “final suit” or “last gown” during their rituals in hopes that sweet oblivion might answer their prayers. Cult leaders, however, often eschew this tradition, instead wearing dark green or gray hooded robes adorned with tangled sheets of clinging moss and skull-shaped masks adorned with veils of additional moss. The cultists favor flails in combat; these weapons often have heads shaped into four-pointed stars with the flail’s chain attached to the center of the star and handles wrapped in moss and tanned flesh stripped from the dead.

Humanoids are far from the Empty Death’s only worshippers. As mentioned, will-o’-wisps and their kin find much to admire in the sinister aura Nhimbaloth’s presence brings to desolate swamplands, and it doesn’t take long for them to take up faith in the Empty Death, almost as if feeding on fear spurred by her influence infects the wisps with devotion to her faith. Marsh giants have also been known to venerate Nhimbaloth under names like “Bogmother,” “The Rushlight Woman,” “Swampfire Queen,” or the like, although they pray to her more as a patron of swampland than anything else. Vampiric mists commonly appear in her swamplands as well, and many scholars have nervously wondered about the implied connection between Nhimbaloth’s mark and the clusters of seven perfectly spaced punctures vampiric mists leave in the bodies of those they’ve fed upon through their misty tendrils.

Temples and Shrines

Often, the members of a cult of the Empty Death consist of the truly desperate, those with little money and less hope. They conduct their worship in their homes, or what passes as a home—partially collapsed shacks, abandoned barns, or even slumped survivalists’ shelters all suffice for the worship of Nhimbaloth. The rarer cults led by deviants of means construct larger structures to honor Nhimbaloth and often build these structures as mockeries of other churches by including stained glass windows, mosaics, and other works of art that honor the Outer Goddess. In such cases, the structure often serves a secondary purpose, such as a castle, a manor house, or the like. Curiously, these larger structures often share a particular feature: a tower that serves as a beacon or lighthouse as a way to honor will-o’-wisps, which the cult adore. To her followers, will-o’-wisps are Nhimbaloth’s eyes, and her gaze looks out upon the world through the lambent glow of these supernatural predators. A beacon or lighthouse in a temple thus symbolizes a will-o’-wisp, but also, they believe it gives Nhimbaloth a lens through which to gaze upon the world.

Nhimbaloth’s symbol is a skull with moss stuffed into its jaws, although her cultists often create variants of it as crude dolls or effigies of moss-caked bones and fragments of skulls. Temples that can afford to be open about their affiliation with the goddess often adorn their structures with skulls that have moss carefully grown into soggy, vermin-infested beards or with moss draperies that hang down over archways to form moist curtains in place of proper doors.

A Priest's Role

As with most cults of the Elder Mythos, the majority of Nhimbaloth’s devout don’t worship out of respect or adoration so much as fear. For them, the concept of death isn’t what evokes nightmare, but the fear of what judgment might await in the afterlife is what drives most to her faith. Those who have sinned, who have committed heresy against a prior faith, or who simply live in constant terror of what Pharasma might say to them when they reach her throne instead seek the oblivion offered by Nhimbaloth. They seek not to escape death or life, but to escape what they fear will be an even worse afterlife.

Yet this is not the only motive that draws worshippers to her fold. Some, rather than being driven by a fear of the afterlife, are enticed by the opportunity to bask in the misery and despair of others. These members are some of the most awful in the sect, for they use the promise of oblivion that Nhimbaloth offers to those who worship her as a lure to draw in the desperate to aid their own nefarious plots. Some seek to use these eager-for-oblivion zealots as disposable armies for acts of vengeance or rage; others draw upon these worshippers as sacrifices to fuel abhorrent rituals or to craft horrific magic items.

Even these predators of the desperate pale in comparison to the worst of Nhimbaloth’s worshippers—nihilists who fully understand the Empty Death and see in her the ultimate tool to destroy a world they’ve grown to loathe. For these cultists, nothing less than using the Voidbracken to bring a Deadtide upon their world will suffice. They might have a hidden plan to escape the world the moment all life is ended; they might even seek their own oblivion or believe that Nhimbaloth herself might reward them with dominion over a dead world. Regardless of their intent, these doomsday shepherds are the most dangerous of the Empty Death’s worshippers.

Holidays

Cults of Nhimbaloth that exist in small communities under the guise of a different religion take pains to observe that faith’s holidays if visitors or (more rarely) townsfolk don’t know their gathering’s true faith, but apart from that, worshippers of the Empty Death don’t observe regular holidays or religious festivals—with one unusual exception. The exact date on which Nhimbaloth’s body was taken from her and Voidbracken was denuded of life is unknown, so each cult chooses one day of import to observe this anniversary. The fact that no one knows the length of Voidbracken’s year makes this ritual even more arbitrary; regardless, her faithful believe that on one of these so-called Void Dawns, the sun won’t rise upon the world and all life will be snuffed in a Deadtide. Cultists celebrate the night leading to a Void Dawn with a gluttonous feast consisting of all manner of carnivores and monsters—meals they often make during the proceedings while the “food” still lives. When the sun inevitably rises, the cultists choose one of their own as the final feast in atonement for failing to bring the Deadtide to their world.

Aphorisms

Worshippers of Nhimbaloth fondly quote and recite their favorite tales from The Whispering Reeds, each of which has a number of memorable and haunting lines. However, a variant of an infamous quote from the Necronomicon particularly resonates with all of her worshippers.

"Long Dream the Dead, Yet Even Death Can Die"

To many, the notion of death is akin to an eternal slumber, a dawnless rest in which the soul experiences an afterlife in the way a sleeping person could dream several different lives in the span of a single night. Whether a dreamer wakes with the dawn or dies in their sleep, all dreams eventually come to an end. Just as when the Empty Death comes to call, even death knows oblivion—and even death may die.

Holy Text

Mentions of Nhimbaloth are rare, even for the esoteric topic of the Outer Gods. The dread Necronomicon mentions her, and certain translations of that book purportedly contain descriptions of her true form, which might be the only place where Nhimbaloth’s true form is set down in print. This information isn’t even present in the text most often associated with her worship: a rare tome called The Whispering Reeds.

The genesis of The Whispering Reeds lies not in those who worship the Empty Death, but in those who sought to oppose her. The book consists of stories, myths, parables, and encounters with Nhimbaloth gathered from hundreds of regions in dozens of worlds. The compiler’s name has been long forgotten, as they neglected to name themself in the text. This matters not to those who worship Nhimbaloth, nor does the fact that the author originally penned the book for the purpose of cataloging the ways in which Nhimbaloth’s influence could be opposed. The very act of collecting these old stories of the Empty Death brushing against the world had the opposite effect, and now, those who seek to draw their goddess’s attention to their world uses The Whispering Reeds to spread stories of her previous visits.

Relations with Other Religions

Nhimbaloth doesn’t consort with other gods, although often her visitations upon the wilderness force confrontations with other faiths. In particular, Gozreh and Desna oppose her influence—the former because of the proliferation of unnatural elements that taint swamplands, and the latter out of a mixture of anger and fear that her flock might stumble into Nhimbaloth’s clutches accidentally while exploring the wilds. The Eldest of the First World also oppose Nhimbaloth, whose parasitic tendrils can occasionally drift into that plane through fey gates and portals. Even after driving out the Empty Death, small cults of fey who have fallen under her sway inevitably remain.

Pharasma opposes Nhimbaloth for multiple reasons. Those who perish in lands haunted by the latter’s presence tend to rise as ghosts. Moreover, the Empty Death’s habit of consuming those ghosts has rightly angered Pharasma, for rather than being released to the Boneyard, the consumed souls simply disappear. One might assume that such an affront to the cycle of life and death would compel Pharasma into a direct confrontation with Nhimbaloth, and indeed, certain ancient texts tell of such a clash between the two goddesses at the very dawn of mortal civilization. The titanic battle left neither goddess the victor. Nhimbaloth learned to hide her predations upon the world so that even Pharasma can’t readily find her, and one particularly blasphemous tale in The Whispering Reeds speaks of a hidden scar that Pharasma bears to this day as a reminder of her failed attempt to decisively defeat the Empty Death—a scar, supposedly, in the pattern of seven divots of flesh where Nhimbaloth fed upon the essence of the Goddess of Death.

Whether or not this myth has any basis in fact, the faithful of Pharasma view Nhimbaloth and her cult with a combination of hatred and fearful respect. Only the most devout and powerful of Pharasma’s worshippers receive leave to hunt Nhimbaloth’s faithful, and they work hard to prevent lay worshippers from learning much of the Empty Death. Their justification—that Nhimbaloth feeds only on ghosts, and that by defeating or preventing the formation of theses undead, they strike blows against the Empty Death—reads to some as an excuse.

Nhimbaloth's Inspiration

H. P. Lovecraft encouraged others to add to the mythos of eldritch beings he created to populate his weird fiction, and it was in this tradition that I first created Nhimbaloth as an antagonist for my own stories and roleplaying campaigns. Largely inspired by the mysterious horror lurking behind nature’s veil in Algernon Blackwood’s classic short story “The Willows,” and with some valuable advice on Outer God naming conventions from the fine folks at Chaosium, Nhimbaloth has become one of my proudest additions to the ever-expanding Lovecraft Mythos.

- James Jacobs

The Abomination Vaults.name: 憎恨魔窟 The Abomination Vaults
The Abomination Vaults.text:
憎恨魔窟由10个等级组成，包括地表上凄凉灯塔周围的废墟。

它们自上而下分别是：

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj]{凄凉灯塔要塞的废墟}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm]{仆役宿舍}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5]{图书馆}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6]{贝科拉曾经的起居室}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5]{竞技场}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ]{实验室}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ]{牢房}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf]{农场洞窟}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc]{狩猎洞窟}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol]{神殿}，其中包含@UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.a9b40LjI7QwLgirk]{空无之窟}。

每个等级都有其独特的风貌，而且英雄们越深入探索，等级就会变得越发危险。

充满怪物的地下城

在贝科拉死亡后的数个世纪里，被困在憎恨魔窟中的恐怖之物逐渐形成了某种生态系统。尽管要塞下方的许多怪物死去了，另一些却繁荣兴盛，如今有若干个由摩洛克、透肌魔人、食尸鬼以及更奇异的生物组成的群落把这座地下城当作家园。只有寿命最为长久者才记得除地下城之外的生活。贝科拉曾束缚数名魔鬼，让它们作为监管者与管理者为她效力，其中许多至今仍在维持秩序。除了这些魔鬼维持的地区，以及在某个最深等级中的一处卓尔前哨站之外，憎恨魔窟无法无天且危机四伏。

游荡的怪物

虽然本书并未为憎恨魔窟提供游荡怪物表，但地下城的居民仍会偶尔离开它们的巢穴！你可以先熟悉每个等级的居民，然后让它们对队伍的推进与现身作出反应，从而让地下城显得更加动态。比如，若英雄在某个区域喧闹探索，附近房间的生物可能会前来调查，或许还会设下伏击。若英雄决定在地下城里扎营而非返回城镇的安全之处，附近的生物可能会在他们休息时拜访，甚至攻击他们的营地。若英雄清剿了某个等级的居民，数周后再回来，可能会发现有新的怪物迁入。让憎恨魔窟的住民保持活跃，你就能让这个地点在玩家眼中显得更加危险且难以预测。

凄凉灯塔之外

凄凉灯塔要塞的废墟离城镇并不远——从奥塔里步行到废墟仅需20分钟。憎恨魔窟冒险路径几乎完全聚焦于地下城本身，你可以按需略过在地下城与城镇之间往返旅程的细节。若你的玩家表示想换换口味，你可以使用独立的《Pathfinder冒险：奥塔里的麻烦》中的一些遭遇或短篇冒险。该冒险提供了适用于2至4级角色的奥塔里腹地额外内容，并为那些在深入憎恨魔窟更深、更危险的等级之前需要一些额外XP的英雄提供了极佳的准备方式。

The Abomination Vaults consist of 10 levels, including the ruins around Gauntlight on the surface.

They are, from top to bottom:

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj]{The Ruins of Gauntlight Keep}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm]{The Servants' Quarters}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5]{The Library}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6]{Belcorra’s former living chambers}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5]{The Arena}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ]{The Laboratories}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ]{The Prison}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf]{The Farm Caverns}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc]{The Hunting Cavern}
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol]{The Temple}, which holds the @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.a9b40LjI7QwLgirk]{Empty Vault}.

Each level has its own character, and the levels are progressively more dangerous the deeper the heroes venture.

A Dungeon Full of Monsters

The horrors trapped in the Abomination Vaults developed some measure of ecosystem in the centuries following Belcorra's death. While many monsters beneath the citadel died, others have prospered, and now several communities of morlocks, urdefhans, ghouls, and stranger creatures call the dungeons home. Only the longest-lived remember any life other than the dungeons. Belcorra had bound several devils to serve her as overseers and administrators, and many of these still maintain order. Apart from the regions maintained by these devils and a drow outpost in one of the lowest levels, the Abomination Vaults are lawless and dangerous.

Wandering Monsters

While this book doesn’t present wandering monster tables for Abomination Vaults, the dungeon’s denizens still occasionally leave their homes! You can make the dungeon feel more dynamic by familiarizing yourself with each level’s denizens and then having them react to the party’s progression and presence. For example, if the heroes noisily explore an area, creatures in nearby rooms could come to investigate or perhaps set up an ambush. If the heroes decide to camp out in the dungeon rather than return to the safety of town, nearby creatures might visit or even attack their campsite while they rest. If the heroes clear out the denizens of a level and then return weeks later, they might find that new monsters have moved in. By keeping the inhabitants of the Abomination Vaults active, you can make the location feel all the more dangerous and unpredictable to your players.

Beyond Gauntlight

The ruins of Gauntlight Keep aren’t far out of town—just a 20-minute walk from Otari to the ruins. The Abomination Vaults Adventure Path focuses almost entirely on the dungeon itself, and you can gloss over the details of trips between the dungeon and town as you see fit. If your players express interest in mixing things up, you can use some of the encounters or short adventures in the standalone Pathfinder Adventure: Troubles in Otari. That adventure presents additional content in the Otari hinterlands suitable for 2nd- to 4th-level characters and provides great ways to prepare heroes who need a bit of extra XP before they delve into the deeper, more dangerous levels of the Abomination Vaults.

A History of Otari.name: 奥塔里的历史 A History of Otari
A History of Otari.text:
另请参阅

关于与本冒险路径相关的重要事件（包括奥塔里）的粗略历史，请参阅以下日志条目：@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.YFiR0qkYBybmdFao]{战役时间线}

贝科拉的复活与陨落（4230-4244 AR）

尽管庞大的大都会艾巴萨罗姆长期主宰着星石岛的城市版图，文明始终在整座岛上蓬勃发展。奥塔里的起源相对较晚，且途中经历了几次失败的开端。4230 AR，@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.snj2fGhhuxfAInom]{贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯}受一连串阴森异象的引诱来到该区域时，这片沿海区域几乎无人居住。她在此建造了@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{凄凉灯塔}——环绕该区域的要塞——以及其下方规模庞大的地城，却没有引起注意。最终，一支被称为@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{玫瑰团}的冒险者小队得知贝科拉的恶行并杀死了她，但代价是失去了一名同伴：一名名叫奥塔里·伊瓦什提的游荡者。

早期奥塔里（4244-4294 AR）

既失去了朋友，也失去了对冒险的兴致后，玫瑰团的三名幸存成员决定退隐。他们用大部分积蓄在最终决战地点以南的一处隐蔽海湾里修建了数座建筑和一座相当规模的码头。由于他们逝去的朋友生前最大的梦想便是在一座小小的海滨村落安定下来，他们便以他的名字为这座新村庄命名。

在接下来的几十年里，奥塔里作为渔村繁荣兴盛，尽管人口从未增长到一百人以上。玫瑰团的三名幸存冒险者都长寿善终，最终因自然原因离世——这是一项许多冒险者永远无法达成的成就。

衰落（4290-4294 AR）

4290 AR，玫瑰团最后一人——牧师艾斯法娜·曼妮姆斯——去世后，奥塔里的运势开始走下坡路。短短数年间，镇民纷纷迁往他处；到4294 AR时，这座城镇已彻底空无一人。

石鳞狗头人（4300-4310 AR）

奥塔里荒废了数十年，直到一群名为石鳞狗头人的狗头人迁入。当这些狗头人在恶劣天气里开始引诱过往船只、伏击船员并劫掠货物时，新的冒险者到来并将其击败也只是时间问题。

奥塔里重建（4310-4721 AR）

冒险者不久后便继续上路，而他们的资助者马克兰尼·曼妮姆斯则留了下来。作为艾斯法娜的孙女，马克兰尼构思出一项计划：将奥塔里复兴为伐木城镇。毕竟这里已有数十栋建筑，只需修复即可，而鱼鹰河也仍然非常适合建设磨坊与木材场。然而，一个挫折使马克兰尼的计划变得复杂——环绕奥塔里的陡坡与峭壁让将木材运往海边变得困难。
