马克兰尼的解决方案堪称巧妙——她建造了一条木制溜槽，使木材能够轻松从森林运至她的磨坊；并从那里沿着一条惊人的装载坡道继续下运，这条坡道从200英尺高的悬崖顶端一路延伸到下方的港湾。磨坊与溜槽让马克兰尼致富并使奥塔里重获生机，但也令她成为寇托斯财团的眼中钉——该财团对全岛木材行业有着牢牢的控制。另有两家小型木材公司也脱离寇托斯财团并在奥塔里落脚，它们各自付费使用马克兰尼的发明。

今日的奥塔里

如今，奥塔里是一处繁荣的聚居地——是艾巴萨罗姆与迪奥贝尔之间海岸线上规模最大的定居点。马克兰尼早已去世，但她的后裔欧瑟夫·曼妮姆斯延续着家族行当，并兼任镇长。寇托斯财团中不受欢迎的代表已秘密渗透奥塔里，意图破坏城镇的安全。然而，一项更为巨大的威胁正笼罩着这座城镇：贝科拉回来了，并正准备再次点燃凄凉灯塔那凶兆般的火焰！

See Also

For a rough history of significant events relevant to this Adventure Path, including Otari, please see the following journal entry: @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.YFiR0qkYBybmdFao]{Campaign Timeline}

Belcorra's Rise and Fall (4230-4244 AR)

Though the immense metropolis of Absalom has long dominated the urban scene on Starstone Isle, civilization has always thrived across the island. Otari’s beginning is relatively recent and involved a few false starts along the way. When @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.snj2fGhhuxfAInom]{Belcorra Haruvex} arrived in the region in 4230 AR, drawn by a series of sinister visions, the coastal region was practically uninhabited. Here, she built @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight}, the keep surrounding the area, and the sprawling dungeons below the structure—without attracting notice. A group of adventurers known as the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{Roseguard} eventually learned of Belcorra’s villainy and slew her, but at the cost of one of their own: a rogue named Otari Ilvashti.

Early Otari (4244-4294 AR)

Having lost both their friend and their taste for adventuring, the three surviving members of the Roseguard decided to retire. They spent much of their savings constructing several buildings and a sizable pier in a sheltered cove south of the site of their final battle. Since their lost friend’s fondest dream had been to settle down in a small seaside village, they named this new village after him.

For some decades, Otari prospered as a fishing village, though its population never grew beyond a hundred or so. The three surviving Roseguard adventurers lived to a ripe old age, ultimately passing away from natural causes—an accomplishment many adventurers never achieve.

Decline (4290-4294 AR)

With the passing of the last Roseguard, Aesephna Menhemes, in 4290 AR, Otari's fortunes began to dwindle. Within the span of a few years, its citizens had all drifted elsewhere, and by 4294 AR the town was entirely empty.

Stonescale Kobolds (4300-4310 AR)

Otari lay abandoned for decades, before a group of kobolds called the Stonescales moved in. When the kobolds started luring in passing ships during bad weather to ambush their crews and steal their cargo, it didn't take long for new adventurers to arrive and vanquish them.

Otari Rebuilt (4310-4721 AR)

While the adventurers moved on soon thereafter, their backer, Maklanni Menhemes, remained behind. Maklanni, Aesephna's granddaughter, conceived a plan to revitalize Otari as a lumber town. It already contained dozens of buildings that only needed to be restored, after all, and the Osprey River remained ideal for a mill and lumberyard. However, one setback complicated Maklanni's plan- the steep slopes and cliffs surrounding Otari made transporting timber to the ocean difficult.

Maklanni's solution was ingenious- she constructed a wooden flume that allowed for the easy transport of lumber from the woods to her mill and, from there, down an astounding loading ramp that extended from the top of the 200-foot-tall cliff to the harbor below. The mill and flume made Maklanni wealthy and revitalized Otari, although it made her an enemy of the Kortos Consortium, which had a stranglehold on the island's lumber industry. Two other small lumber companies broke from the Kortos Consortium and settled in Otari as well, each paying for use of Maklanni's invention.

Otari Today

Today, Otari is a thriving settlement- the largest on the coast between Absalom and Diobel. Maklanni is long dead, but her descendant Oseph Menhemes carries on the family trade and also serves as the town's mayor. Unsavory representatives of the Kortos Consortium have secretly infiltrated Otari and seek to undermine the town's security. However, a far greater threat looms over the city: Belcorra has returned and is preparing to light the baleful fires of Gauntlight once again!

Exploring Otari.name: 探索奥塔里 Exploring Otari
Exploring Otari.text:
奥塔里的关键地点

奥塔里的重要地点详载于你日志侧边栏标签中“奥塔里地点”文件夹内的各篇日志。这些地点描述也作为地图标注钉在场景上。未标注的建筑是木造民居，其住户在附近的商家或镇上三家木材公司之一工作。

地点数据

许多重要地点都包含数据，用于传达该地点或商铺的一般用途与等级，以便确定与之相关的任何必要数值，例如用于赚取收入的最高等级任务。所有这些信息都收录在该地点的日志条目中，同时还包括地址、商品与出售的服务（例如施法者服务），以及关于居住或在该场所工作的最重要NPC的信息。

奥塔里的角色

除描述与插图外，日志还会包含各地点NPC的一些重要细节。他们对英雄的初始态度状态，以及与该NPC互动时最可能有用的DC，若玩家希望如下面所述赢得该地点的支援，将尤其重要。

支线任务

憎恨魔窟中的一些地点会列出英雄可接取的支线任务，通常在与某位NPC互动或发现线索之后。若英雄完成支线任务，除支线任务本身给予的任何奖励（如宝藏或有用信息）外，还可因一次中等成就获得XP奖励（30 XP）。

获得支援

若某位英雄将一名NPC的态度状态调整为乐于助人（这可能需要完成列出的任务，但通常需要成功的交涉检定以 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}），则该NPC所在地点会在某些探索与休整模式活动中支援队伍。具体益处取决于地点的特征，并列于下文。此类支援通常会贯穿整个战役，但你也可以判定某些行为会失去某地点的支援。只要交到足够多朋友，英雄就能同时获得镇上多个地点的支援！

地点特征

这些地点中有些包含特征，可作为一种简写，用以表示英雄在赢得商铺所有者的信任与支援后可能获得的益处。以下包含这些特征的说明。

教会

信仰虔诚且其信念与教会NPC相符的角色（由你酌情决定）被允许使用该地点的资源，以更高效率进行重训。通常需要一周的重训在此地点仅需5天；通常需要一个月的重训在此地点仅需3周；且重训通常免费。在该地点进行的辨识魔法、治疗伤口或治疗疾病检定获得+1环境加值。

折扣

该地点的商品提供10%折扣。

雇主

该地点以指定技能提供最高至其等级的任务，用于赚取收入。

驻军

偏好武艺的角色可在此更高效率地重训（同“教会”）。在该地点进行的收集信息或治疗伤口检定获得+1环境加值。

住宿

该地点免费提供舒适的生活开销水准的住宿。

图书馆

学者型角色，以及奥术与秘法施法者，可在此更高效率地重训（同“教会”）。在该地点进行的伪造文书、文书解读或学习法术检定获得+1环境加值。

会所

原初施法者可在此更高效率地重训（同“教会”）。在该地点进行的辨识魔法或求生检定获得+1环境加值。

客厅

偏好社交的角色可在此更高效率地重训（同“教会”）。在该地点进行的收集信息检定，或以表演赚取收入的检定，获得+1环境加值。

工坊

英雄可以使用该地点的资源来制作与其用途相关的物品，并在相关的制作检定上获得+1物品加值。

Otari's Key Locations

Significant locations in Otari are detailed in the journals in the Otari Locations folder of your journals sidebar tab. These location descriptions are also pinned to the scene as map pins. Unlabeled buildings are wooden homes whose inhabitants work for nearby businesses or for one of the town's three lumber concerns.

Location Statistics

Many significant locations include statistics that help to communicate the general function and level of the location or business, for the purpose of determining any necessary values associated with it, such as the highest level task available to Earn Income. All of this information is included in the location's journal entry, as well as the address, wares, and services for sale (such as spellcasting services), as well as information about the most significant NPC who lives or works at the establishment.

Otari's Characters

As well as a description and artwork, the journals will include some important details about the NPCs in each location. Their initial attitude condition to the heroes, along with DCs most likely to be useful when interacting with the NPC, will be especially important if the players would like to earn the support of the location, as outlined below.

Side Quests

Some of the locations in the Abomination Vaults list side quests the heroes can pick up, usually after interacting with an NPC or discovering a clue. If the heroes complete a side quest, they earn an XP award for a moderate accomplishment (30 XP) in addition to any rewards the side quest grants, such as treasure or useful information.

Earning Support

If a hero adjusts an NPC’s attitude condition to helpful (which might require completion of a listed task but usually requires successful Diplomacy checks to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}), that NPC's location supports the party in certain exploration and downtime activities. The specific benefits are based on the location's traits and are listed below. This support generally lasts throughout the campaign, although you might decide certain actions lose a location's support. The heroes can be supported by multiple locations in town, so long as they make enough friends!

Location Traits

Some of these locations include traits which can be a useful shorthand for the kind of benefits that the heroes might get for earning the trust and support of the business owners. An explanation of these traits is contained below.

Church

Faithful characters whose beliefs align with those of the church’s NPC (at your discretion) are permitted to use the location’s resources to retrain more efficiently. Retraining that would normally require a week takes only 5 days at this location, retraining that would normally require a month takes only 3 weeks, and retraining is generally free. Checks to Identify Magic, Treat Wounds, or Treat Disease on site gain a +1 circumstance bonus.

Discount

The location provides a 10% discount on its wares.

Employer

The location offers tasks up to its level to Earn Income with a specified skill.

Garrison

Martially inclined characters can retrain more efficiently here (as Church). Checks to Gather Information or Treat Wounds on site gain a +1 circumstance bonus.

Housing

The location offers accommodations at a comfortable cost of living for no charge.

Library

Scholarly characters, as well as arcane and occult spellcasters, can retrain more efficiently here (as Church). Checks to Create Forgery, Decipher Writing, or Learn a Spell on site gain a +1 circumstance bonus.

Lodge

Primal spellcasters can retrain more efficiently here (as Church). Checks to Identify Magic or Subsist on site gain a +1 circumstance bonus.

Parlor

Socially inclined characters can retrain more efficiently here (as Church). Checks to Gather Information or Earn Income with Performance gain a +1 circumstance bonus.

Workshop

Heroes can use the location’s resources to Craft items associated with its purpose and gain a +1 item bonus to associated Crafting checks.

Otari Gazetteer.name: 奥塔里地名志 Otari Gazetteer
Otari Gazetteer.text:
奥塔里坐落在两座巍峨峭壁之间的海岸山谷中。向西，崖壁升起，与一片精心维护的墓园相接。向东，一项惊人的工程壮举引人注目——支撑木制装货滑槽的栈桥从崖顶向下延伸，通往嵌入港湾的装货平台。这座巧妙的构造能迅速将内陆锯木厂进一步加工的木材输送至下方等候的船只。

奥塔里的居民大多友善而好客，不过他们对那些被怀疑来自艾巴萨罗姆的人往往会更为矜持。与艾巴萨罗姆的贸易很重要，但镇民自尊心强，觉得没有必要去迎合来访的“城里人”。奥塔里人通常以鱼类为食，并搭配本地农场出产的蔬菜（主要是马铃薯、胡萝卜及其他根茎类蔬菜），但从艾巴萨罗姆也不难买到更不寻常的食材。咖啡是这里的生活必需品，也是勤劳且早起的居民最爱的饮品。

奥塔里名人录

欧瑟夫·曼妮姆斯
N 男性 人类 市长 4

现任市长，同时也是当地三家木材公司之一的家长。

拉杜斯·长鞍
CN 男性 人类 士兵 4

满口粗话、脾气火爆的镇卫队队长。

万蒂·班得黛西
NG 女性 半身人 莎伦莱牧师 5

健谈的莎伦莱女祭司，也是一位知识渊博得出奇的城镇史学家。

瓦琳·希温尼斯
CG 女性魔裔精灵古董商人 5

古怪的神秘物品商人、工匠，以及故事与流言的收藏家。

奥塔里

定居点 4

  • N
  • 城镇

多元的伐木城镇与贸易港口，拥有充满传奇的过往，以及不在少数的阴森秘密。

政府：市长（民选领袖）

人口：1,240（60% 人类，8% 半身人，7% 半精灵，6% 精灵，5% 矮人，5% 侏儒，3% 半兽人，2% 地精，4% 其他）

语言：通用语、矮人语、精灵语、半身人语

宗教：凯登·凯连、埃拉斯蒂尔、哥兹莱、莎伦莱

威胁：异怪恐魔、诡异作祟、狗头人、走私者

小玩意贸易：奥塔里有着长期为冒险者提供便利的根源，镇上的商店可供出售最高至等级10的消耗品物品。

Otari is nestled in a coastal valley between two looming cliffs. To the west, the cliffside rises to meet a well-cared-for graveyard. To the east, a fantastic feat of engineering draws the eye—the trestle supporting a wooden loading chute extends down from the clifftop to a loading platform built into the harbor. This ingenious construction swiftly delivers lumber processed further inland at the mill to waiting ships below.

The people of Otari are friendly and welcoming for the most part, although they tend to react with reticence toward those they suspect hail from Absalom. Trade with Absalom is important, but the townsfolk are proud and feel no need to accommodate visiting “city folk.” People in Otari typically subsist on fish along with vegetables from local farms (primarily potatoes, carrots, and other root vegetables), but more unusual fare isn’t hard to get from Absalom. Coffee is a mainstay and a favorite drink of the hardworking and early-rising residents.

Who's Who in Otari

Oseph Menhemes
N male human mayor 4

Current mayor and patriarch of one of three local lumber companies.

Lardus Longsaddle
CN male human soldier 4

Foul-mouthed and short-tempered captain of the town guard.

Vandy Banderdash
NG female halfling cleric of Sarenrae 5

Chatty priestess of Sarenrae and unusually knowledgeable town historian.

Wrin Sivinxi
CG female tiefling elf oddities merchant 5

Eccentric occult items dealer, artisan, and collector of stories and rumors.

Otari

Settlement 4

  • N
  • Town

Diverse lumber town and trade port with a storied past and its fair share of sinister secrets.

Government: Mayor (elected leader)

Population: 1,240 (60% humans, 8% halflings, 7% half-elves, 6% elves, 5% dwarves, 5% gnomes, 3% half-orcs, 2% goblins, 4% other)

Languages: Common, Dwarven, Elven, Halfling

Religions: Cayden Cailean, Erastil, Gozreh, Sarenrae

Threats: aberrant horrors, eerie hauntings, kobolds, smugglers

Trinket Trade: Otari has a long tradition of catering to adventurers, and consumable items of up to level 10 are available for sale in its shops.

Blades for Glades.name: 伐木之刃 Blades for Glades
Blades for Glades.text:
伐木之刃

商店 5

  • 折扣
  • 雇主
  • 工坊

地址：50 伊瓦什提街

  • 商品：金属冒险道具、金属武器、金属盾牌、金属护甲

镇上最主要的铁匠铺专门打造锯、斧以及其他伐木行业使用的工具，但这里技艺高超的铁匠也会生产优质的护甲、盾牌和武器。

卡曼·拉贾尼

LE 男性人类流氓 6，不友好。
察觉 DC 22，意志 DC 20。

伐木之刃现任店主是一位名叫卡曼·拉贾尼的怨愤男子，他自夸自己是奥塔里奠基者之一沃尔·拉贾尼的后裔。他希望有朝一日取代欧瑟夫·曼妮姆斯成为镇长，但尽管有这般血统，他仍连续四次在镇长选举中落败，因此卡曼正筹划以其他方式夺回自己与生俱来的权利。当英雄们在第5章开头打开更深的等级时，他便会采取行动。

地点支援

如果英雄们获得伐木之刃的支援，卡曼可能会让他们担任兼职学徒——前提是英雄们不会让卡曼觉得他们过于爱管闲事或太守法。对卡曼而言不被视作潜在告密者的英雄可以使用工艺进行赚取收入。

Blades for Glades

Shop 5

  • Discount
  • Employer
  • Workshop

Address: 50 Ilvashti Street

  • Wares: Metal adventuring gear, metal weapons, metal shields, metal armor

The primary smithy in town specializes in crafting saws, axes, and other tools used in the lumber trade, but the skilled smiths here also produce quality armor, shields, and weapons.

Carman Rajani

LE male human scoundrel 6, Unfriendly.
Perception DC 22, Will DC 20.

The current owner of Blades for Glades is a bitter man named Carman Rajani, who boasts of being descended from one of Otari's founders, Vol Rajani. He hopes to supplant Oseph Menhemes as the town's mayor someday, but after losing four mayoral elections in a row despite his pedigree, Carman is planning other ways to seize his birthright. He makes his move when the heroes open the deeper levels at the start of Chapter 5.

Location Support

If the heroes gain the support of Blades for Glades, Carman might take them on as part-time apprentices- provided the heroes don't strike Carman as being too nosy or law-abiding. A hero whom Carman doesn't regard as a potential snitch can Earn Income using Crafting.

Chertel Manor.name: 查泰尔庄园 Chertel Manor
Chertel Manor.text:
查泰尔庄园

庄园 4

  • 雇主

地址: 扎马夫迪安街5号

作为奥塔里三家木材企业之一，查泰尔木业在糟糕的管理、远方伐木营地的劳资纠纷以及融资困难的多重夹击下举步维艰。

瓦布·查泰尔

N 人类 木材大亨 4，不友好。
察觉 DC 19，意志 DC 17。

瓦布·查泰尔是查泰尔木业现任家长。瓦布怀疑其他公司在他的生意里捣鬼，既破坏伐木工人的士气，也破坏装备；而事实上，寇托斯财团才是瓦布困境的幕后黑手。通过把查泰尔逼入绝境并迫使其仓促雇人，寇托斯财团成功将越来越多属于自己的特工安插进奥塔里的木材行业。

地点支援

如果查泰尔庄园支援英雄们，瓦布会额外给钱，让他们盯紧他的竞争对手——门赫姆家族与印科霍兹家族——以及他自己的工人。英雄们可以使用察觉来赚取收入，但若出现大成功或大失败中的大失败，他们从事监视的消息会走漏风声，而查泰尔将不再提供这份工作。

Chertel Manor

Manor 4

  • Employer

Address: 5 Zarmavdian Street

One of Otari's three lumber concerns, Chertel Timber struggles with a combination of poor management, labor disputes in distant lumber camps, and difficulties with financing.

Wrab Chertel

N human lumber magnate 4, Unfriendly.
Perception DC 19, Will DC 17.

Wrab Chertel is the current patriarch of Chertel Timber. Wrab suspects the other companies of meddling in his business and sabotaging both lumberjack morale and equipment alike; in truth, the Kortos Consortium is behind Wrab's woes. By forcing Chertel into desperate straits and hasty hiring, the Kortos Consortium has managed to place an increasing number of its own agents in Otari's lumber industry.

Location Support

If Chertel Manor supports the heroes, Wrab offers extra money for keeping an eye on his competition- the Menhemes and the Inkleholtzes- as well as his own workers. The heroes can Earn Income using Perception, but on a critical failure, word of their spying gets out, and Chertel no longer offers the job.

Crook’s Nook.name: 骗子之角 Crook’s Nook
Crook’s Nook.text:
骗子之角

旅店/酒馆 5

  • 折扣
  • 雇主
  • 住房
  • 雅间

地址：鬼灵街10号

  • 商品：饮品、餐食、住宿、违禁品、盗贼道具。

任何经济繁荣的城镇，最终都会滋生出属于自己的本地盗贼与无赖团伙，奥塔里也不例外。

骗子之角在镇上有多重用途——这座巨大的木结构建筑横跨鱼鹰河，既是夜宿的廉价落脚处，也是以供应镇上最棒海鲜而闻名的酒馆。

酒馆地板上的活板门可直接通往下方河面以便垂钓，但鲁莽（或醉醺醺）的客人有时会在这些开口处扭打角力，以决出谁更强、以及谁会被弄湿。

建筑的阁楼则作为奥塔里盗贼公会——鱼鹰俱乐部的会馆；这一用途或许是镇上最不算秘密的秘密，从建筑的名字就可见一斑。

伊娜斯梅拉

CN 女性 人类 走私者 5，不关心。
察觉 DC 22，意志 DC 20。

身形瘦长而精明的伊娜斯梅拉拥有骗子之角，使她成为镇上最显赫的商界人士之一。尽管她从未参选镇长，但她在镇上的影响力仍与任何公开当选的官员一样强大。她同时还是鱼鹰俱乐部——奥塔里盗贼公会的首领，这一事实只会进一步增强她的影响力。

伊娜斯梅拉忠于自己的城镇，极少许可她的盗贼将本地居民作为目标，尽管外来者则是骗局或抢劫的合理目标。只要鱼鹰俱乐部的活动不至于过度妨碍奥塔里的市民，长鞍队长便会睁一只眼闭一只眼。

地点支援

如果英雄们带回伊娜斯梅拉失踪的“雇员”（见区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.zPMrDHV75TJzsGba]{A17} 中的支线任务），只要他们对鱼鹰俱乐部的事守口如瓶，骗子之角就会支援他们。如果骗子之角支援英雄们，而他们又表示对违法工作感兴趣，伊娜斯梅拉会建议对访客犯下些小罪行（扒窃、小额入室盗窃、骗局等）。这使英雄们可以使用巧手赚取收入，但在大成功或大失败中的大失败时，他们的行为会被发现，而伊娜斯梅拉会断绝他们未来的工作。由你酌情决定，英雄们还可能因此招致更多法律麻烦。

Crook's Nook

Inn/Tavern 5

  • Discount
  • Employer
  • Housing
  • Parlor

Address: 10 Wisp Street

  • Wares: Beverages, meals, lodging, illicit goods, thieves' gear.

Any town with a successful economy inevitably generates its own homegrown band of thieves and scoundrels, and Otari is no exception.

Crook’s Nook serves several purposes in town—the large wooden structure functions as a bridge over the Osprey River, as a cheap place to get a room for the night, and as a tavern well known for serving the best seafood in town. 

Trapdoors in the tavern’s floor allow direct access to the river below for fishing, but foolhardy (or inebriated) patrons sometimes wrestle over these openings to determine who’s stronger and who’s getting wet.

The building’s attic serves as the guildhall for Otari’s thieves’ guild, the Osprey Club—a function that’s perhaps the town’s worst-kept secret, as evidenced by the building’s very name.

Yinyasmera

CN female human smuggler 5, Indifferent.
Perception DC 22, Will DC 20.

The lanky and shrewd Yanyismera owns Crook’s Nook, making her one of the town’s most prominent business owners. While she has never run for mayor, her influence in town remains as strong as that of any publicly elected official. The fact that she’s also the head of the Osprey Club, Otari’s thieves’ guild, only increases her influence.

Yinyasmera is loyal to her town and rarely permits her thieves to target locals, although outsiders are fair targets for con games or robberies. So long as the activities of the Osprey Club don't overly inconvenience Otari's citizens, Captain Longsaddle turns a blind eye.

Location Support

If the heroes return Yinyasmera's missing "employees" (see Side Quest in area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.zPMrDHV75TJzsGba]{A17}, Crook's Nook supports them as long as they keep quiet about the Osprey Club. If Crook's Nook supports the heroes and they express interest in illicit work, Yinyasmera suggests minor crimes against visitors (pickpocketing, petty burglary, con games, and the like). This allows the heroes to Earn Income using Thievery, but on a critical failure, their actions are spotted, and Yinyasmera cuts them off from future jobs. Further legal woes might arise for the heroes as well, at your discretion.

Crow’s Casks.name: 乌鸦之桶 Crow’s Casks
Crow’s Casks.text:
乌鸦之桶

酒馆 4

  • 教会
  • 折扣
  • 雇主
  • 会客室

地址：伯劳街 10 号

  • 商品：饮料、餐食、炼金物品、药水、油剂、神圣卷轴。

这栋两层石制建筑的大门上方挂着一块招牌，上面描绘着一群醉醺醺的乌鸦栖在一只漏酒的酒桶上。乌鸦之桶不仅仅是一家很受欢迎的酒馆兼酿酒坊——它还是献给凯登·凯连的神龛。其经营者是一名名叫玛吉洛的天狗炼金术师，店名也由此而来。

玛吉洛

CG 女性 天狗 酿酒师 4，不关心。
察觉 DC 21，意志 DC 17。

如果说玛吉洛在镣铐群岛的六码头海盗船上挥霍的青春岁月给她留下些什么，那便是对奇特酒类的偏爱。如今已步入暮年，玛吉洛喜欢在吧台招呼客人，并发明新的饮品供本地人和访客享用。她总是在寻找热情的顾客来品尝她最新的调配品。

目前最受欢迎的两种饮品是香料南瓜朗姆酒和酸黑莓艾尔。至于上个月那次颇为灾难性的地精椒烈性黑啤酿造尝试，玛吉洛宁愿永远不提。

地点支援

如果乌鸦之桶为英雄们提供支援，玛吉洛可能会雇他们做试饮员——这份工作比人们想象的要惊险得多。试饮员可以用强韧豁免来赚取收入，但若出现大成功或大失败中的大失败，他们所品尝的东西会让胃里很不舒服，英雄将获得 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} 状态，持续 24 小时。

Crow's Casks

Tavern 4

  • Church
  • Discount
  • Employer
  • Parlor

Address: 10 Shrike Street

  • Wares: Beverages, meals, alchemical items, potions, oils, divine scrolls.

A sign over the door to this two-story stone building depicts a group of drunk crows perched on a leaky cask. Crow's Casks is more than just a popular tavern and brewery- it's a shrine to Cayden Cailean. Its proprietor, a tengu alchemist named Magiloy, gives the establishment its name.

Magiloy

CG female tengu brewer 4, Indifferent.
Perception DC 21, Will DC 17.

If Magiloy's misspent youth aboard a half dozen pirate ships in the Shackles gave her anything, it was a fondness for unusual alcohol. Now well into her twilight years, Magiloy likes tending bar and inventing new drinks for locals and visitors to enjoy. She’s always looking for enthusiastic customers to taste her newest concoctions.

The two most popular drinks currently are a spiced pumpkin rum and a sour blackberry ale. Of last month's somewhat disastrous attempt to brew a goblinpepper stout, Magiloy prefers never to speak.

Location Support

If Crow's Casks supports the heroes, Magiloy might hire them as taste testers- a job that's quite a bit more harrowing than one might expect. A taste tester can Earn Income using Fortitude saves, but on a critical failure, something they've tasted sits poorly, and the hero becomes @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 24 hours.

Dawnflower Library.name: 晨花图书馆 Dawnflower Library
Dawnflower Library.text:
晨花图书馆

神殿 5

  • 教会
  • 折扣
  • 图书馆

地址：晨花街 10号

  • 商品：治疗魔法，宗教物品（包括奥塔里最知名宗教所偏好武器的 +1 版本：细剑、长弓、三叉戟与弯刀），神圣卷轴。
  • 施法：可向万蒂或她的侍祭购买神圣法术。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{治疗术}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{移除疾病}与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SnaLVgxZ9ryUFmUr]{复原术}始终可用，其他法术则由你酌情提供。

奥塔里最大的神殿坐落在城镇最西端的边缘，矗立于一处隆起的岩台之上，岩台向外伸出，远远低于悬崖顶端。图书馆以莎伦莱信徒神殿的卡迪亚风格建造，两座较小的宣礼塔夹击着一座金色圆顶。建筑的位置使其能够承接初升太阳的光辉，将圆顶化作对太阳女神灿烂辉耀的见证——至少，在没有浓雾或阴云密布的日子里是如此。

十余名来自不同信仰的侍祭在晨花图书馆服务。建筑西侧可见凯登·凯连、埃拉斯蒂尔与哥兹莱的神龛，而供奉莎伦莱的主神龛占据了东侧。其余部分则是书库。晨花图书馆藏书广泛，从小说到历史，从讽刺到教科书，甚至还收录了一大批（大多）品味得体的情色读物。

万蒂·班得黛西

NG 女性 半身人 莎伦莱牧师 5，友善。
察觉 DC 20，意志 DC 22。

图书馆现任的首席女祭司是一位健谈的半身人女性，名叫万蒂·班得黛西，是莎伦莱的虔诚信徒。她总是热切地欢迎新来者，不论对方的信仰或职业为何。万蒂还有一种古怪的本事：能够为刚认识不久的人推荐正合其口味的读物。

她对几乎所有话题都很开明，但对盗窃毫无耐心，因为不久前她的姐姐从神殿偷走了几本珍贵书籍并逃之夭夭。

Dawnflower Library

Temple 5

  • Church
  • Discount
  • Library

Address: 10 Dawnflower Street

  • Wares: Healing magic, religious items (including +1 versions of the favored weapons of Otari's most prominent religions: rapiers, longbows, tridents, and scimitars), divine scrolls.
  • Spellcasting: Divine spells are available for purchase from Vandy or her acolytes. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Remove Disease}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SnaLVgxZ9ryUFmUr]{Restoration} are always available, with other spells available at your discretion.

Otari's largest temple stands at the town's westernmost edge, atop an upraised shelf that juts out far below the clifftop. The library is constructed in the Qadiran style of Sarenite temples, with two smaller minarets flanking a golden dome. The building's position allows it to catch the rays of the rising sun, which transforms the dome into a brilliantly glowing testament to the sun goddess- at least, on days that aren't fogged in or overcast.

A dozen acolytes of various faiths attend to Dawnflower Library. Shrines to Cayden Cailean, Erastil, and Gozreh can be found in the western portion of the building, while the primary shrine to Sarenrae takes up the eastern portion. The rest of the building contains the stacks. Dawnflower Library has a wide range of books ranging from fiction to history, satire to textbook, and even includes a sizable collection of (mostly) tasteful erotica.

Vandy Banderdash

NG female halfling cleric of Sarenrae 5, Friendly.
Perception DC 20, Will DC 22.

The current head priestess of the library is a chatty halfling woman named Vandy Banderdash, a devotee of Sarenrae. Always eager to greet newcomers, regardless of their faith or vocation, Vandy has a strange knack for recommending literature tailored to the tastes of people she only just met.

She’s open-minded on almost every subject, but has no patience for thievery, as her sister stole several valuable books from the temple and fled not long ago.

Farmer’s Guild.name: 农夫公会 Farmer’s Guild
Farmer’s Guild.text:
农民协会

协会会馆 2

  • 雇主
  • 住房

地址：70 玫瑰团路

  • 商品：住宿、动物。

这栋建筑及其附近的场地提供马厩、拍卖场、牲畜围栏、肉铺，以及供本地区农民使用的协会会馆。奥塔里的农民协会负责分配来自附近各个农场与牧场的货物，既确保会员因辛劳而获得丰厚报酬，也免去他们不得不花费过多时间在镇内送货的麻烦。协会会馆维持着十余间房间，供来访农民免费使用，但也可出租给其他人。

贾拉·海斯泰珀

N 女性 半身人 协会会长 2，不关心。
察觉 DC 16，意志 DC 16。

现任会长是一位精明的半身人女性，名叫贾拉·海斯泰珀；她在侧院维持着一座献给埃拉斯蒂尔的圣龛。她本人并非牧师，并希望有朝一日能说服一位来访的埃拉斯蒂尔祭司定居奥塔里，接过代表本地区农民的职责，尽管迄今为止她自己已将这份工作完成得相当出色。

地点支援

如果农民协会支援英雄们，他们可以担任入境货物的检验员。这使英雄们能够使用自然来赚取收入，成功剔除腐烂、受虫害或以其他方式不适合公众食用的食品。

Farmer's Guild

Guildhall 2

  • Employer
  • Housing

Address: 70 Roseguard Road

  • Wares: Lodging, animals.

This building and its nearby yards provide stables, auction houses, livestock pens, butcher shops, and a guildhall for the region's farmers. Otari's Farmer's Guild handles the distribution of goods from the various nearby farms and ranches, ensuring that the members are paid well for their toil while saving them the trouble of having to spend too much time on deliveries of goods in town. The guildhall maintains a dozen rooms that are free of charge to visiting farmers, but available for rent to others.

Jala Highstepper

N female halfling guildhead 2, Indifferent.
Perception DC 16, Will DC 16.

The current guildhead is a business-minded halfling woman named Jala Highstepper who maintains a shrine to Erastil in the side yard. She isn't a cleric herself, and hopes someday to convince a visiting priest of Erastil to settle in Otari and take up the mantle of representing the regional farmers, despite the fact that she has done an admirable job of it herself so far.

Location Support

If the Farmer's Guild supports the heroes, they can work as inspectors for incoming shipments. This allows the heroes to Earn Income using Nature to successfully weed out foodstuffs that are rotten, infested, or otherwise not fit for public consumption.

Gallentine Deliveries.name: 加伦丁速递 Gallentine Deliveries
Gallentine Deliveries.text:
加伦丁速递

信使 4

  • 雇主
  • 驻军

地址：120 玫瑰团路

  • 服务：寄养马匹、运输（商队或马车）
  • 递送：本地递送的费用为每负载 1 cp，通常在 24 小时内送达。递送至艾巴萨罗姆或迪奥贝尔（或更远地点）的费用为每负载 5 cp，每周送达一次；若支付每负载 1 gp，可加急递送并在 2 天内送达。

这座大型建筑前方立着一块醒目的大招牌：画中一名男子骑马以不要命的速度狂奔，同时单手平衡着一摞包裹。加伦丁速递负责处理奥塔里的邮件，无论是镇内还是镇外。

奥罗瑞亚·加仑丁

LN 女性 人类 游侠 4，不关心
察觉 DC 21，意志 DC 19

奥罗瑞亚·加仑丁是奥塔里的第七代居民，同时拥有并经营加伦丁速递——该区域最快且最可靠的递送服务。作为一名退休的伊门森林游侠，奥罗瑞亚大概能弄到英雄们所需、却无法在奥塔里找到的任何东西，不过此类订单的价格可能会相当昂贵。

地点支援

如果英雄们赢得了加伦丁速递的支援，他们便可以进行本地递送，从而使用社交技能来赚取收入。

Gallentine Deliveries

Courier 4

  • Employer
  • Garrison

Address: 120 Roseguard Road

  • Services: Stabling, transportation (caravan or carriage)
  • Deliveries: Local deliveries cost 1 cp per Bulk and are generally delivered within 24 hours. Deliveries to Absalom or Diobel (or for points beyond) cost 5 cp per Bulk and are delivered weekly; for 1 gp per Bulk, a delivery can be expedited to arrive in 2 days.

A large sign depicting a man riding at breakneck speed on horseback as he balances a stack of packages in one hand stands out in front of this large building. Gallentine Deliveries handles Otari's post, both within town limits and beyond.

Oloria Gallentine

LN female human ranger 4, Indifferent
Perception DC 21, Will DC 19

Oloria Gallentine is a seventh-generation citizen of Otari and owns and operates Gallentine Delivries, the fastest and most reliable delivery service in the area. A retired Immenwood ranger, Oloria can probably acquire anything the heroes need that they can’t find in Otari, although the price for such orders might be steep.

Location Support

If the heroes earn the support of Gallentine Deliveries, they can make local deliveries, allowing them to Earn Income using Society.

Inkleholtz Manor.name: 印科霍兹庄园 Inkleholtz Manor
Inkleholtz Manor.text:
印科霍兹庄园

庄园 4

  • 雇主

地址: 75 鬼灵街

艾利莫拉·印科霍兹

NG 半精灵伐木业巨头 4，友善。
察觉 DC 17，意志 DC 19。

惠斯登伐木公司之所以成功，多亏其所有者艾利莫拉·印科霍兹精明狡黠的商业头脑。她投入资金来强化奥塔里的教育服务，这一精明之举让她受到了奥塔里家长们的敬仰。许多人一直在推动艾利莫拉在下一次选举到来时竞选镇长，但就目前而言，这位半精灵很满足于抚养家庭并打造她事业的传承。

地点支援

如果印科霍兹庄园为英雄们提供支援，艾利莫拉会在她于镇上维持的一间教室里为他们提供工作。这使得英雄们可以使用与四门学科之一相关的传说来赚取收入；印科霍兹家族希望在当地孩子们中培养这四门学科：文学、数学、科学与历史。

Inkleholtz Manor

Manor 4

  • Employer

Address: 75 Wisp Street

Alymora Inkleholtz

NG half-elf lumber magnate 4, Friendly.
Perception DC 17, Will DC 19.

Whistledown Cutters is a successful lumber company thanks to the cunning business sense of its owner, Alymora Inkleholtz. She invested funds to bolster Otari's educational services, a shrewd move that has made her admired by Otari's parents. Many have been pushing Alymora to run for mayor the next time elections come along, but for now, the half-elf is happy raising her family and building her business's legacy.

Location Support

If Inkleholtz Manor supports the heroes, Alymora offers them work in a classroom she maintains in town. This allows the heroes to Earn Income using Lore associated with one of the four disciplines that the Inkleholtzes hope to foster in the local children: literature, mathematics, science, and history.

Menhemes Manor.name: 曼妮姆斯庄园 Menhemes Manor
Menhemes Manor.text:
曼妮姆斯庄园

庄园 4

  • 雇主

地址：10 高边路

曼妮姆斯家族的宅邸住着奥塔里的镇长欧瑟夫，以及他的妻子艾娜拉、他们的五个孩子和一小支仆从队伍。作为镇上最古老的建筑之一，这座十字形建筑占地广阔，比曼妮姆斯家族所需的规模更大。庄园的整个西翼已封闭了两代人，而东翼则被改造成一座向公众开放的奥塔里历史博物馆。

欧瑟夫·曼妮姆斯

N 男性 人类 镇长 4，不关心。
察觉 DC 19，意志 DC 19。

欧瑟夫尽力将自己作为商人与政客的身份区分开来：上午作为公众人物处理事务，下午则管理他的公司——奥塔里木业公司。英雄们很可能会与曼妮姆斯一家有更多互动，尤其是在第 5 章中与欧瑟夫的长女多里安娜的互动。

地点支援

如果英雄们赢得了曼妮姆斯家的支援，他们可以使用社交来赚取收入，以辅导这家人的孩子，并为他们进入艾巴萨罗姆的社交圈做准备。

Menhemes Manor

Manor 4

  • Employer

Address: 10 Highside Road

The Menhemes family estate houses Otari's mayor, Oseph, along with his wife Emnala, their five children, and a small army of servants. One of the town's oldest structures, the cross-shaped building is a sprawling affair that's larger than the Menhemes clan needs. The entire west wing of the manor has been closed for two generations, while the eastern wing has been converted into a publicly accessible museum of Otari's history.

Oseph Menhemes

N male human mayor 4, Indifferent.
Perception DC 19, Will DC 19.

Oseph does his best to keep his roles as businessman and politician separate, devoting the mornings to work as a public figure and the afternoons to managing his company, Otari Lumber. The heroes are likely to have much more interaction with the Menhemes family, particularly Oseph's oldest daughter, Dorianna, in Chapter 5.

Location Support

If the heroes earn the Menhemes' support, they can Earn Income using Society to tutor the family's children and prepare them to fit into Absalom's social scene.

Odd Stories.name: 怪谈故事 Odd Stories
Odd Stories.text:
怪谈故事

商店 4

  • 折扣
  • 图书馆

地址：100 玫瑰团路

  • 商品：书籍、配方、奥术与灵异卷轴。
  • 施法服务：莫里宾特通常为付费顾客提供以下奥术法术。若提前一天安排，你也可酌情提供其他法术。
  • 等级 2：@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{通晓语言}  @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}
  • 等级 1：@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.X9dkmh23lFwMjrYd]{负重术} @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{修复术}
  • 戏法：@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{侦测魔法}

这家单层木质书店的后半部拔地而起一座三层石塔。前门上方的招牌描绘着一叠摊开的书本，书页间升腾起缕缕魔法能量。尽管店主确实是一名法师，但莫里宾特委托制作这个招牌，是为了展现他所专精的奇幻想象类小说与选集作品中“想象力的力量”。莫里宾特也出售其他文本，不过他把非虚构类的选书整理交给了他的丈夫卡尔西；卡尔西的专长使得怪谈故事成为印科霍兹教育事业的主要教材与教学工具来源（见 @UUID[.I7TqLHaoC42RkjV6]{印科霍兹庄园}）。

莫里宾特

LN 男性 人类 法师 4，不关心。
察觉 DC 17，意志 DC 19。

莫里宾特有一头鲜红的头发，贴着头皮修剪得很短。尽管他总是皱着眉头，但在其他学者与法师面前他很快就会热络起来，因为他总是兴奋地想要“聊聊行当”。

莫里宾特专精于奇幻想象类小说，但他博览群书，能够帮助英雄们解读他们在冒险中可能遭遇的、使用古老或罕见语言写就的巨著。他也会热切收购英雄们在冒险中发现的珍稀书籍，希望能转手获利（当然，是在他自己先读过之后）。

地点支援

怪谈故事会自动支援代表莫里宾特寻找书籍的英雄（见 区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.l9NjtV6c0sjeD50H]{C11} 中的支线任务）。

Odd Stories

Shop 4

  • Discount
  • Library

Address: 100 Roseguard Road

  • Wares: Books, formulas, arcane and occult scrolls.
  • Spellcasting: Morlibint typically has the following arcane spells available for paying customers. Other spells can be available at your discretion, if arranged a day in advance.
  • Level 2: @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Comprehend Language}  @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}
  • Level 1: @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.X9dkmh23lFwMjrYd]{Ant Haul} @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{Mending}
  • Cantrip: @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic}

A three-story stone tower rises from the back half of this one-floor wooden bookstore. A sign above the front door depicts a stack of open books with lines of magical energy rising from the pages. While the shop's owner is indeed a wizard, Morlibint had the sign commissioned in an attempt to portray the power of imagination within the fanciful fiction works and anthologies that are his specialty. Morlibint sells other texts as well, although he leaves the nonfiction curation to his husband Carlthe, whose expertise makes Odd Stories the primary source of textbooks and teaching tools for Inkleholtz's educational pursuits (see @UUID[.I7TqLHaoC42RkjV6]{Inkleholtz Manor}).

Morlibint

LN male human wizard 4, Indifferent.
Perception DC 17, Will DC 19.

Morlibint has bright red hair that he keeps closely cut to his scalp. Despite his perpetual scowl, he warms quickly to the presence of other scholars and wizards, for he's always excited to "talk shop."

Morlibint specializes in fanciful fiction, but he is incredibly well-read and can help the heroes decipher tomes in ancient or unusual languages they might encounter in their adventures. He eagerly purchases rare books the heroes come across in their adventures, hoping to resell them at a profit (after reading them himself, of course).

Location Support

Odd Stories automatically supports heroes seeking books on Morlibint's behalf (see Side Quest in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.l9NjtV6c0sjeD50H]{C11}).

Otari Fishery.name: 奥塔里渔场 Otari Fishery
Otari Fishery.text:
奥塔里渔场

公会大厅 3

  • 雇主
  • 会客厅

地址：渔民街 10号

  • 商品：饮料、餐食、交通（帆船）。

每天晚上，从日落前1小时到午夜前1小时，塔米莉·坦德威尔都会向水手、劳工与旅人开放镇上主渔场的一楼，提供一个舒适而热情的聚会场所，让大家玩游戏与消遣娱乐。这里为想要边玩边喝点饮料或吃点零食的人提供一份小菜单，其收入塔米莉常常会以比赛与各类临时游戏锦标赛的奖金钱形式回馈给大家。

塔米莉·坦德威尔

NG 女性 人类 港务官 3，友善。
察觉 DC 18，意志 DC 16。

塔米莉·坦德威尔曾经背弃了一份本可获利丰厚的职位——在灰海盗中担任船长——转而在奥塔里选择了更安全的工作；她在一次突袭海盗船的行动中失去了一条腿，这让她确信担任港务官对她的长寿而言是更明智的决定。开朗而放肆不羁的塔米莉收集了越来越多可在不同场合使用的木腿，并经常更换。每天晚上，从日落前1小时到午夜前1小时，塔米莉都会向水手、劳工与旅人开放渔场的一楼，供他们玩游戏、吃零食与娱乐消遣。

地点支援

一旦英雄们获得奥塔里渔场的支援，他们就可以帮助维护镇上的码头，或在一艘渔船上工作。他们可以使用制作、自然或航海学识来赚取收入。

Otari Fishery

Guildhall 3

  • Employer
  • Parlor

Address: 10 Fisher Street

  • Wares: Beverages, meals, transportation (sailing ship).

Every night, from an hour before sundown to an hour before midnight, Tamily Tanderveil opens the ground floor of the town’s main fishery to sailors, laborers, and travelers alike, offering a comfortable and welcoming place to gather for games and entertainment. A small menu is offered for those who wish to have drinks or snacks while gaming here, the proceeds of which Tamily frequently gives back in the form of contests and prize money for various impromptu gaming tournaments.

Tamily Tanderveil

NG female human harbor warden 3, Friendly.
Perception DC 18, Will DC 16.

Tamily Tanderveil turned her back on what could’ve been a lucrative position as a captain among the Gray Corsairs to retire to a safer job here in Otari- the loss of a leg during a raid on a pirate ship having convinced her that serving as a harbor warden would be a wiser decision for her longevity. The jolly and irreverent Tamily maintains a growing collection of peg legs for various occasions that she regularly swaps out. Every night, from an hour before sundown to an hour before midnight, Tamily opens the fishery's ground floor to sailors, laborers, and travelers for games, snacks, and entertainment.

Location Support

Once the heroes earn the support of the Otari Fishery, they can help keep the town's pier in repair or work aboard a fishing vessel. They can Earn Income using Crafting, Nature, or Sailing Lore.

Otari Garrison.name: 奥塔里卫队 Otari Garrison
Otari Garrison.text:
奥塔里卫队

兵营 4

  • 雇主
  • 卫队

地址: 龙兽街20号

  • 商品 : 护甲、盾牌、武器、弹药、护符、符文。

奥塔里卫队的总部是一座坚固的石制建筑，悬挂着与卫兵制服相配的绿白相间旗帜。这些城镇卫兵维持镇内治安，并巡逻通往艾巴萨罗姆方向的玫瑰团路，确保道路没有匪患与麻烦。奥塔里卫队身着醒目的绿白制服，也担任消防员与律政官；当他们到达40岁的年代后，会主要转为后者。镇上的监狱位于建筑的地下室，但牢房很少用来关押除小偷小摸或醉汉之外的罪犯。

任何与奥塔里卫队起冲突的英雄都该祈祷别碰上队长——他那满口诅咒的痛骂声名远播，而且他倾向于因轻微违规而判处短期监禁。

拉杜斯·长鞍

CN 男性 人类 战士 4，不友好。
察觉 DC 19，意志 DC 21。

卫队的首领是粗鲁而敦实的长鞍队长。这位年迈却硬朗的男子曾是艾巴萨罗姆城卫的老兵，十年前“退休”来到奥塔里。在前任队长塔斯克·亨利于一次不幸的意外中溺亡后，他接过了领导者的职责——那场意外涉及喝了太多覆盆子蜂蜜酒，以及一次欠考虑的夸口：他能憋气多久。卫队中记得塔斯克的人都对他怀有好感，因为长鞍脾气暴躁、出口成脏，而且比他那矮人前任严苛得多。

地点支援

如果英雄赢得奥塔里卫队的支援，卫兵会表达他们对装备保养与维护的强烈需求；英雄可以使用【制作】来赚取收入。

Otari Garrison

Barracks 4

  • Employer
  • Garrison

Address: 20 Drake Street

  • Wares : Armor, shields, weapons, ammunition, talismans, runes.

The headquarters of the Otari Guard is a sturdy stone building hung with green-and-white banners that match the guards’ uniforms. These civic guards keep the peace in town and patrol the Roseguard Road, which leads off toward Absalom, to ensure it stays clear of banditry and trouble. Clad in distinctive green and white uniforms, the Otari Guard also serve as firefighters and barristers, switching predominantly to the latter role when they reach the age of 40. The town's jail is in the basement of the building, but its cells are rarely used to hold any criminals other than petty crooks or drunkards.

Any heroes who get in trouble with the Otari Guard should hope to deal with anyone other than the captain—his curse-laden tirades are legendary, and he’s inclined to issue short jail sentences for minor infractions.

Lardus Longsaddle

CN male human fighter 4, Unfriendly.
Perception DC 19, Will DC 21.

The head of the guard is the gruff and stout Captain Longsaddle. This elderly but hale man was a veteran of Absalom's city guard who "retired" to Otari a decade ago. He took up the mantle of leader after its previous captain, Trusk Hanely, drowned in an unfortunate misadventure involving a bit too much raspberry mead and an ill-advised boast regarding how long he could hold his breath. Those among the guard who remember Trusk do so fondly, for Longsaddle is short-tempered, foul-mouthed, and much stricter than his dwarven predecessor.

Location Support

If the heroes earn the support of the Otari Garrison, the guards express a strong need for equipment upkeep and maintenance; the heroes can Earn Income using Crafting.

Otari Graveyard.name: 奥塔里墓园 Otari Graveyard
Otari Graveyard.text:
在西侧悬崖边缘高高矗立着的奥塔里墓园，内有风化坍塌的陵寝与一片片无叶的树丛。除了负责照料墓园的@UUID[.AztvvKcx7K7gOXhN]{晨花图书馆}侍祭之外，几乎无人到访。墓园下方的图书馆处有一段木制阶梯沿着崖壁向上延伸，但多数祭司更愿意花上半小时穿过城镇，沿更平缓的道路上来照看坟墓。

在奥塔里，火葬与海葬愈发流行，因此在墓园下葬往往是重视根源的年长家族所坚持的做法。尽管墓园本身阴森令人不安，但其边界之内并没有任何不死生物的问题——至少，在@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{凄凉灯塔}于@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.Jyoads7l6vDaxZyb]{第2章}期间再次照耀到这里之前都是如此；那将触发@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.bwT6PloCsffN9m73]{奥塔里的尸潮}事件！

Looming over the western cliffside, the Otari Graveyard holds crumbling mausoleums and groves of leafless trees. The graveyard is rarely visited by any except the @UUID[.AztvvKcx7K7gOXhN]{Dawnflower Library} acolytes that tend to it. A wooden stairway ascends the cliff face from the library below, but most priests prefer to take the half-hour walk through town and up the easier roads to tend the graves.

Cremations and burials at sea have become more popular in Otari, so burials in the graveyard tend to be the province of older families who value tradition. While the graveyard itself is spooky and unsettling, it doesn’t have any undead problems within its boundaries—at least, not until @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight} shines upon it again during @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.Jyoads7l6vDaxZyb]{Chapter 2}, triggering the @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.bwT6PloCsffN9m73]{Deadtide for Otari} event!

Otari Market.name: 奥塔里市场 Otari Market
Otari Market.text:
奥塔里市场

商店 2

  • 折扣
  • 雇主

地址：曼妮姆斯街80号

  • 商品：食物、冒险道具、简易武器、轻型护甲。

奥塔里市场一半是露天农贸市场，一半是木屋式贸易站，是本地人的聚集地，也是购买各类日用杂货的一站式商店。奥塔里市场每天从黎明营业到黄昏，只有一个例外。

基莱诺·拉瑟纳

N 男性 人类 市场主人 2，不关心。
察觉 DC 14，意志 DC 14。

市场由阴沉寡言、毫无幽默感的基莱诺·拉瑟纳打理。为了纪念他已故的挚爱妻子艾拉，基莱诺在每年戈兹然月的5日都会关闭市场。艾拉在30年前被撕咬致死。凶手后来被查明是一名名叫杰尔·梅兹勄的狼化人德鲁伊；基莱诺相信此人至今仍在逃。基莱诺对德鲁伊始终心怀怨恨与恐惧，尤其是那些在石环池塘做礼拜的人；他会高价收购狼皮，希望有朝一日能得到杀死他妻子的凶手之皮。

地点支援

如果任何一位英雄被人知道是（或自称是）德鲁伊，奥塔里市场就不会支援英雄。除此之外，只要英雄将艾拉的项链归还给基莱诺，并同时带回杰尔已死的证据（见区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.qWygGTAEvPCJLopE]{D15} 中的支线任务），奥塔里市场便会自动支援英雄。若奥塔里市场支援英雄，英雄就能在市场站岗，并使用威吓来赚取收入。由你决定，在一次工作轮班期间，可能会发生一场与扒手或其他小贼的轻微遭遇。

Otari Market

Shop 2

  • Discount
  • Employer

Address: 80 Menhemes Street

  • Wares: Food, adventuring gear, simple weapons, light armor.

One part open-air farmer's market, one part log-cabin trading post, the Otari Market is a gathering place for locals and a one-stop shop for all manner of general goods. Otari Market is open every day from dawn to dusk, with one exception.

Keeleno Lathenar

N male human market owner 2, Indifferent.
Perception DC 14, Will DC 14.

The market is tended by the dour, humorless Keeleno Lathenar. Keeleno closes the market down on every Gozran 5th in honor of his dear departed wife, Ayla, who was mauled to death 30 years ago. The killer turned out to be a werewolf druid named Jaul Mezmin, whom Keeleno believes remains at large to this day. Keeleno remains bitter and fearful toward druids, particularly those who worship at Stone Ring Pond, and he pays handsomely for wolf pelts in the hopes of one day acquiring the skin of his wife's killer.

Location Support

The Otari Market won't support the heroes if any of them are known to be (or profess to be) druids. The Otari Market otherwise automatically supports heroes who return Ayla's necklace to Keeleno along with evidence of Jaul's death (see Side Quest in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.qWygGTAEvPCJLopE]{D15}). If the Otari Market supports the heroes, they can stand guard over the market and Earn Income using Intimidation. At your discretion, a minor encounter with a cutpurse or other petty crook might take place during a work shift.

Outside Otari.name: 奥塔里郊外 Outside Otari
Outside Otari.text:
奥塔里腹地

奥塔里周围古老的丘陵与森林，自城镇建立之前的漫长岁月里便已有人居住。昔日野心军阀的倾颓堡垒、阴湿且爬满亡灵的古冢、以及充斥着怪物与被遗忘宝藏的洞窟，都在距离奥塔里仅需步行数小时的范围内。许多当地人听闻关于奥塔里腹地危险与宝藏的传言，而这些故事是否属实，就有待冒险者去揭开真相！

雾隐沼泽

从奥塔里向北步行约半小时，便是一片名为雾隐沼泽的广袤湿地。凄凉灯塔要塞的废墟便坐落其中，苔藓丛生，害虫横行。凄凉灯塔要塞最神秘的景观，是那座耸立在废墟之上的 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{灯塔}——它离海岸之遥，令人费解。

Otari Hinterlands

The old hills and forests around Otari have been inhabited since long before the town existed. Fallen fortresses of would- be warlords, dank barrows crawling with undead, and caves filled with monsters and forgotten treasure lie within a few hours’ walk of Otari. Many locals have heard the rumors of danger and treasure in the Otari hinterlands, and it’s up to adventurers to discover whether these tales hold any truth!

The Fogfen

About a half hour’s walk north of Otari is a sprawling swamp called the Fogfen. The ruined Gauntlight Keep lies within, overgrown with moss and overrun with vermin. The most mysterious feature of Gauntlight Keep is the @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{Lighthouse} that towers above the ruins, curiously far from the shore.

Ruins of the Thirsty Alpaca.name: 口渴的羊驼废墟 Ruins of the Thirsty Alpaca
Ruins of the Thirsty Alpaca.text:
饥渴羊驼曾是奥塔里最大的酒馆，但在最近的一场灾害中，一小队过于急切的狗头人试图扩建建筑下方一些古老的石鳞巢穴，进行挖掘作业，导致建筑戏剧性坍塌。数名雇员以及几位外地来访者在事故中丧生，而酒馆的老板也下落不明。如今，当地人避开这片废墟，因为那里诡异的光亮(术)与阴森的声响使此地背上了闹鬼的名声。事实上，几名狗头人坑道工在坍塌中幸存，并用骇人的把戏把镇民从他们的巢穴旁赶走。

The Thirsty Alpaca was once the largest tavern in Otari, but in a recent disaster, excavations by a small band of overeager kobolds attempting to expand some of the old Stonescale warrens below the building caused the structure’s dramatic collapse. Several employees and a few visitors from out of town perished in the accident, and the tavern’s owner has gone missing. Today, the locals avoid the ruins, for strange lights and eerie sounds there have given the place a reputation of being haunted. In truth, a few kobold sappers survived the collapse and are keeping the townsfolk away from their lair with spooky tricks.

Stone Ring Pond.name: 石环池塘 Stone Ring Pond
Stone Ring Pond.text:
石环池塘

神殿4

  • 教会
  • 会所
  • 商品：德鲁伊装备、自然主题的魔法物品、原初卷轴。
  • 施法服务：可从沃里温或哥兹莱的信徒处购买神圣与原初法术。以下法术始终可用，其他法术由你酌情决定是否提供。
  • 等级2：@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Restore Senses}
  • 等级1：@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.qXTB7Ec9yYh5JPPV]{Purify Food and Drink}

两打直立巨石，每块都恰好12英尺高，如哨兵般环绕这座浅池的岸边。这些巨石是数代之前由哥兹莱教会竖立的，就在奥塔里从石鳞狗头人手中被夺回不久之后；自那时起，这里一直是德鲁伊、游侠与博物学者的礼拜之所。池水异常澄澈如镜，但尽管流传着低声的传闻，它并不具备魔法。

一小群信奉哥兹莱的游牧牧师与德鲁伊在旅途中会将石环池塘纳入行程，因此附近总会有几位临时扎营。总体而言，这些旅人已经有30年避免与奥塔里接触——自从他们中的一员杰尔·梅兹勄败坏了他们与小镇的关系之后便是如此。杰尔是一名狼化人，甚至连其他祭司都不知道他的本性；某天夜里他失控，屠杀了半打本地人，随后被赶下峭壁坠入下方海中。他的尸体从未被寻回。

沃里温

NG 女性 侏儒 德鲁伊4，友善。
察觉DC 19，意志DC 21。

在杰尔失踪约五年后，一名理想主义的侏儒德鲁伊——沃里温——听闻了杰尔的暴行，便专程来到奥塔里，意在修复这名狼化人对哥兹莱信徒名声造成的伤害，并引导那些希望与土地更和谐共处的本地人。又过了一代人，沃里温在很大程度上取得了成功，但仍有一个显著例外：依旧沉浸在悲痛中的@UUID[.jPieo4zoajYJyrbg]{基莱诺·拉瑟纳}。

沃里温与基莱诺共享的不止是悲伤。她也怀疑杰尔从悬崖坠落后仍然活着。她每晚巡逻奥塔里的荒野，警惕任何杰尔可能已回到他旧日狩猎场的迹象。

地点支援

若英雄们为杰尔·梅兹勄伸张正义（见区域@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14}中的支线任务），无论是杀死还是活捉他，石环池塘都会自动支援英雄们。

Stone Ring Pond

Temple 4

  • Church
  • Lodge
  • Wares: Druid equipment, nature-themed magic items, primal scrolls.
  • Spellcasting: Divine and primal spells are available for purchase from Worliwynn or the Gozrens. The following spells are always available, with others available at your discretion.
  • Level 2: @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Restore Senses}
  • Level 1: @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.qXTB7Ec9yYh5JPPV]{Purify Food and Drink}

Two dozen standing stones, each exactly 12 feet high, stand sentinel around the shores of this shallow pond. These stones were raised generations ago by the church of Gozreh soon after Otari was retaken from the Stonescale kobolds and have remained a place of worship for druids, rangers, and naturalists ever since. The waters of the pond are unusually reflective but, despite whispered rumors, aren't magical.

A small cabal of nomadic clerics and druids faithful to Gozreh include Stone Ring Pond in their peregrinations, and there's always a few temporarily camping nearby. For the most part, these travelers have avoided contact with Otari for 30 years, ever since one of their number, Jaul Mezmin, soured their relationship with the town. A werewolf who had kept his nature from even the other priests, Jaul lost control one night and slaughtered a half dozen locals before he was driven over the cliffside into the ocean below. His body was never recovered.

Worliwynn

NG female gnome druid 4, Friendly.
Perception DC 19, Will DC 21.

About five years after Jaul's disappearance, an idealistic gnome druid named Worliwynn heard of Jaul's rampage and came to Otari specifically to repair the damage the werewolf had done to the Gozrens' reputation and guide locals interested in living in greater harmony with the land. A generation later, Worliwynn has been largely successful, with the significant exception of still-grieving @UUID[.jPieo4zoajYJyrbg]{Keeleno Lathenar}.

Worliwynn shares more than grief with Keeleno. She also suspects that Jaul survived his fall from the cliff. She patrols the Otari hinterlands nightly, vigilant for any sign that Jaul might have returned to his old hunting grounds.

Location Support

Stone Ring Pond automatically supports the heroes if they deliver justice to Jaul Mezmin (see Side Quest in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14}), whether by killing or capturing him.

The Giant’s Wheel.name: 巨人之轮 The Giant’s Wheel
The Giant’s Wheel.text:
巨人之轮

木材磨坊 5

  • 雇主

地址：磨坊路 10 号

奥塔里锯木厂在当地被称作“巨人之轮”，因为它那高耸、直径 30 英尺的水轮确实令人叹为观止。水轮巨大的体型是必须的，它需要产生足够的扭矩来驱动机械化踏车，将原木装入运木水槽，并让磨坊内的锯子持续运转。一条装载滑槽通向港口，便于将木材装上船。运木水槽一直是当地年轻人的乐子，他们喜欢“滑槽冲浪”，但在几次不幸事故之后，克洛特便对这种愚行格外警惕。 

巨人之轮世世代代归曼妮姆斯家族所有，但它并非只供奥塔里锯木厂使用。木材场的许多收入来自镇上两个更大的木材家族——他们付费在这里加工木材。

水轮碾磨与翻搅的持续噪音，与锯子的尖啸声和装载坡道的哐当声相互争抢。夜里，磨坊忙碌的杂活声在下方的镇子里也能听见。

克洛特·亨格斯

守序中立 男性 半兽人 工头 5，不关心。
察觉 DC 20，意志 DC 20

巨人之轮及其磨坊的日常运作由其工头负责——那位满身疤痕的前角斗士克洛特·亨格斯。

年轻时，克洛特在艾巴萨罗姆的角斗场——义洛里宫——以一对短柄斧作战闯出了名声，并得到了“伐木工”这个绰号。克洛特已将那段暴力的过去抛诸脑后，也完全不觉得自己如今受雇于货真价实的伐木工这件事有什么讽刺可笑之处。

地点支援

如果英雄们赢得巨人之轮的支援，克洛特会允许他们用“生存”通过沿运木水槽全程巡逻来赚取收入。你也可以选择让与当地野生动物的遭遇为一次走槽巡班增添些活力。若克洛特对英雄们更为热络，他甚至可能将自己的一把旧 +1 短柄斧作为赋礼送给他们。

The Giant's Wheel

Lumber Mill 5

  • Employer

Address: 10 Miller's Road

The Otari Mill is known locally as the Giant's Wheel, as its towering, 30-foot-diameter waterwheel is truly a sight to behold. The wheel's immense size is needed to generate enough torque to power the mechanized treadmill loading logs into the flume and keep the saws running within the mill. A loading chute descends to the harbor so that timber can easily be loaded onto ships. The loading flume has long been a draw to local youths who enjoy “riding the chute,” but after a few unfortunate accidents, Klorte keeps a wary eye out for such foolishness. 

The Giant’s Wheel has belonged to the Menhemes family for generations, but it isn’t exclusively used by the Otari Mill. Much of the lumberyard's income comes from the town's two larger lumber families, who pay to have their lumber processed here.

The constant noise of the wheel’s grinding and churning competes with the whine of the saws and the clatter of the loading ramp. At night, the busywork of the mill can be heard in the town below.

Klorte Hengus

LN male half-orc foreman 5, Indifferent.
Perception DC 20, Will DC 20

Day-to-day operation of the Giant’s Wheel and its mill fall to its foreman, the heavily scarred ex-gladiator named Klorte Hengus.

In his youth, Klorte made a name for himself in Absalom's gladiatorial arena, the Irorium, by fighting with paired hatchets and picked up the moniker "the Lumberjacker." Klorte has put that violent past behind him and fails to see any ironic humor in the fact that he's now employed by honest-to-goodness lumberjacks.

Location Support

If the heroes earn the support of the Giant's Wheel, Klorte allows them to Earn Income using Survival by patrolling the flume's length. If you choose, encounters with local wildlife might liven up a shift of flume-walking. If Klorte warms to the heroes, he might even gift them one of his old +1 hatchets.

The Rowdy Rockfish.name: 喧闹石斑鱼 The Rowdy Rockfish
The Rowdy Rockfish.text:
喧闹的石斑鱼

旅店/酒馆 3

  • 住宿
  • 会客厅

地址：扎马夫迪安街50号

  • 商品：饮品、餐食、住宿。

尽管名字如此，“喧闹石斑鱼”却是奥塔里最安静、最别致的酒馆。一块招牌挂在这座两层木结构建筑的门上方，画着一条石斑鱼举起鱼鳍、摆出拳击姿势；但走进店内，客人们平和的举止让人不禁怀疑，这里或许是内海唯一一家从未发生过酒馆斗殴的酒馆。

布雷达·范克维尔

守序善良 女性 矮人 旅店老板 3，不关心。
察觉 DC 16，意志 DC 20。

石斑鱼酒馆现任店主是一位慈母般的矮人，名叫布雷达·范克维尔。她沉稳而精明，在她的儿子、上一任老板@Actor[u36SRb3lyB4beHCN]{拉斯达·范克维尔}无影无踪地失踪后接手了酒馆。几位当地人曾看见红胡子的拉斯达与一名提着灯笼的兜帽陌生人一起步行离开城镇。一年多过去了，布雷达怀疑她的儿子恐怕已一去不返。

地点支援

如果英雄们把拉斯达带回家（见区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D9}中的支线任务），喧闹石斑鱼会自动支援他们。

Rowdy Rockfish

Inn/Tavern 3

  • Housing
  • Parlor

Address: 50 Zarmavdian Street

  • Wares: Beverages, meals, lodging.

Despite its name, The Rowdy Rockfish is the quietest and quaintest of Otari's taverns. A sign depicting a rockfish with his fins up in a boxing pose hangs above the door of this two-story wooden structure, but within, the calm demeanor of its patrons leads some to wonder if this might be the one tavern in the Inner Sea to never host a barroom brawl.

Brelda Venkervale

LG female dwarf innkeeper 3, Indifferent.
Perception DC 16, Will DC 20.

The Rockfish's current proprietor is a matronly dwarf named Brelda Venkervale, a stoic but shrewd businesswoman who took over the bar after her son @Actor[u36SRb3lyB4beHCN]{Lasda Venkervale}, the previous owner, vanished without a trace. A few locals saw the red-bearded Lasda walking out of town with a hooded stranger carrying a lantern. Over a year has passed, and Brelda suspects that her son is gone for good.

Location Support

The Rowdy Rockfish automatically supports the heroes if they bring Lasda home (see Side Quest in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D9}).

Wrin’s Wonders.name: 瓦琳妙妙屋 Wrin’s Wonders
Wrin’s Wonders.text:
瓦琳妙妙屋

商店 5

  • 折扣
  • 图书馆
  • 旅舍

地址：鱼鹰街60号

  • 商品：冒险道具、五花八门的小摆设、魔法物品（非弹药的消耗品、手持物品、法杖、魔杖、穿戴物品）。
  • 算命：只要有人给瓦琳提供一件不寻常的物品或一个故事，瓦琳就会为其进行一次占星算命（使用她的占星能力）。
  • 施法：瓦琳提供施法服务，但她仅能施放其数据表中列出的法术。

这家古玩店没有招牌，但本地人都知道它名为瓦琳妙妙屋：在这里，你可以惊叹于它那同样古怪的主人可能搜罗到的各种奇异新奇小玩意与供品。建筑由一圈看似竖立的石头组成，这些“石头”围成一个直径60英尺的圆，环绕着一座15英尺高的木梁穹顶，外覆三角形帆布片。仔细观察这些竖立的“石头”会发现它们同样是木框与帆布制成，并被巧妙涂装成花岗岩的样子。中央穹顶与外圈之间的区域，摆着一组其他穹顶形帐篷，用来存放店内的商品。未下雨时，这些穹顶的布帘会被拉开，让逛店的人在阳光——或者说月光——下欣赏待售之物；毕竟，瓦琳妙妙屋永远开门营业。

瓦琳·希温尼斯

CG 女性魔裔精灵古董商人 5，友善。
察觉 DC 22，意志 DC 22

@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.raJDQ95RBqeXxV14]{瓦琳·希温尼斯} 认为这家古玩店的奇特布局有个很好的理由——她在曲线中看见安全，在棱角里看见威胁，并且有点幽闭恐惧。中央穹顶是她的居所，她把内部表面涂绘成夜空的模样，描绘着篷车星座群的所有星座，这样即便在阴云密布的夜晚，她也能在星空下入睡。

地点支援

只要瓦琳确信英雄们正真诚努力地探索凄凉灯塔之谜，瓦琳妙妙屋就会为英雄们提供支援。当瓦琳妙妙屋支援英雄们时，瓦琳会按他们希望的频率免费为他们占星。

Wrin's Wonders

Shop 5

  • Discount
  • Library
  • Lodge

Address: 60 Osprey Street

  • Wares: Adventuring gear, eclectic bric-a-brac, magic items (non-ammunition consumable items, held items, staves, wands, worn items).
  • Fortune telling: Wrin performs an astrological fortune telling (using her Read the Stars ability) for anyone who provides her with an unusual item or story.
  • Spellcasting: Wrin's spellcasting services are available, but she's limited to the spells listed in her stat block.

This curio shop bears no sign, but locals know it as Wrin's Wonders: a place to marvel at whatever strange new trinkets and offerings its equal strange owner might have come across. The structure consists of a ring of what appear to be standing stones arranged in a 60-foot-diameter circle surrounding a 15-foot-high dome of wooden beams covered with triangular pieces of canvas. Closer inspection of the standing "stones" reveals they're also made of wood frames and canvas, cleverly painted to resemble granite. The area between the central dome and the surrounding circle is a collection of other dome-shaped tents used to store the shop's wares. When it's not raining, the fabric of these domes is pulled aside so shoppes can admire what's for sale in the light of the sun- or the moon, for that matter, as Wrin's Wonders is always open.

Wrin Sivinxi

CG female tiefling elf oddities merchant 5, Friendly.
Perception DC 22, Will DC 22

@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.raJDQ95RBqeXxV14]{Wrin Sivinxi} has what she regards as a very good reason for the curio shop's strange arrangement- she sees safety in curves and menace in angles and suffers from a touch of claustrophobia. The central dome is her domicile, and she's painted the interior surfaces to resemble a night sky featuring all the constellations of the Cosmic Caravan, so that even on overcast nights she can fall asleep under the stars.

Location Support

Wrin's Wonders supports the heroes as long as Wrin's convinced they're making genuine efforts to explore Gauntlight's mysteries. When Wrin's Wonders supports the heroes, Wrin Reads the Stars for them for free as often as they'd like.

Chapter Synopses.name: 章节概要 Chapter Synopses
Chapter Synopses.text:
升级

英雄从1级开始（如果他们玩过《Pathfinder新手盒》冒险，则从2级开始）。

里程碑：英雄在清理凄凉灯塔废墟的大部分区域（包括灯塔的穹顶）后提升至2级（或保持2级）。

@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj]{第1章：雾中的灯塔}

作者：詹姆斯·雅各布斯

瓦琳·希温尼斯怀疑凄凉灯塔要塞的废墟中潜藏着危险，并请求英雄前去调查这片废墟及其诡异的灯塔。

升级

在“奥塔里的尸潮”事件之前，英雄应为2级。

里程碑：英雄在击败幽灵女王的摩洛克后提升至3级。

@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm]{第2章：被遗忘的魔窟}

作者：詹姆斯·雅各布斯

凄凉灯塔的恐怖光束令奥塔里墓园中的死者苏生，英雄必须协助平息不死者的暴动，并重返魔窟。

升级

英雄在进入图书馆时应为3级。

里程碑：英雄在击败溃烂教后提升至4级。

@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5]{第3章：溃烂教}

作者：詹姆斯·雅各布斯

英雄探索一座规模庞大的图书馆；如今这里栖居着一群自称溃烂教、既博学又阴险的食尸鬼。

升级

英雄在进入贝科拉的避难所时应为4级。

里程碑：英雄在与奥塔里的幽灵交谈后提升至5级。

@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6]{第4章：死者永眠}

作者：詹姆斯·雅各布斯

英雄遭遇奥塔里·伊瓦什提的幽灵后，会收到一则严峻的警告，告知他们在憎恨魔窟更深处等待着什么。

升级

英雄在处理镇上的盗窃与梦境占据术之前应为5级。

里程碑：英雄在清理竞技场楼层的大部分区域后提升至6级。

@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5]{第5章：进入训练场}

作者：瓦妮莎·霍斯金斯

英雄从奥塔里的奠基者处取回四件遗珍，以获得进入更深层魔窟楼层的许可，并结识与魔窟有着惊人关联的镇民。

升级

英雄在进入实验室楼层时应为6级。

里程碑：英雄在击败贾法基和seugathis后提升至7级。

@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ]{第6章：血肉实验}

作者：瓦妮莎·霍斯金斯

在古老的炼金实验室中，英雄可以挫败一名seugathi的阴谋。

升级

英雄在进入牢房楼层时应为7级。

里程碑：英雄在处理乌瑞维安一事后提升至8级。

@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ]{第7章：灵魂看守者}

作者：瓦妮莎·霍斯金斯

一名名为乌瑞维安的契约魔鬼必须履行一份延续数百年的协议，但英雄也许能与这名魔鬼达成交易以拯救小镇。

升级

英雄在进入农场楼层时应为8级。

里程碑：英雄在清理农场楼层的大部分区域后提升至9级。

@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf]{第8章：腐朽花园}

作者：斯蒂芬·拉德尼-麦克法兰

英雄遭遇一个怪异的caligni教团与一群不死侏儒密会团。

升级

英雄在进入狩猎场楼层时应为9级。

里程碑：英雄在进入宁布洛斯之门时提升至10级。

@UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc]{第9章：狩猎之中}

作者：斯蒂芬·拉德尼-麦克法兰

在巨大的狩猎场楼层中，英雄可以得知击败贝科拉的秘密，并找到所需的支点镜片。

升级

英雄在进入神殿楼层时应为10级。

里程碑：英雄在击败贝科拉之后（或也许就在击败之前）提升至11级。

@UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol]{第10章：引来不祥凝视}

作者：斯蒂芬·拉德尼-麦克法兰

英雄探索一座供奉外神宁布洛斯的古老神殿，并一劳永逸地与贝科拉决战！

Advancement

The heroes begin at 1st level (or at 2nd level if they've played the Pathfinder Beginner Box adventure).

Milestone: The heroes advance to 2nd level (or remain 2nd level) after clearing out most of the Gauntlight Ruins, including the lighthouse's cupola.

@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj]{Chapter 1: A Light in the Fog}

by James Jacobs

Wrin Sivinxi suspects something dangerous in the ruins of Gauntlight Keep and asks the heroes to investigate the ruins and its strange lighthouse.

Advancement

The heroes should be 2nd level before the "Deadtide for Otari" event.

Milestone: The heroes advance to 3rd level after defeating the Ghost Queen morlocks.

@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm]{Chapter 2: The Forgotten Dungeon}

by James Jacobs

Gauntlight's dread beam animates the dead in Otari's graveyard, and the heroes must help quell the undead uprising and return to the dungeon.

Advancement

The heroes should be 3rd level upon entering the library.

Milestone: The heroes advance to 4th level after defeating the Cult of the Canker.

@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5]{Chapter 3: Cult of the Canker}

by James Jacobs

The heroes explore a sprawling library now inhabited by a group of scholarly and sinister ghouls who call themselves the Cult of the Canker.

Advancement

The heroes should be 4th level upon entering Belcorra's Retreat.

Milestone: The heroes advance to 5th level after speaking with Otari's ghost.

@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6]{Chapter 4: Long Dream the Dead}

by James Jacobs

After the heroes encounter the ghost of Otari Ilvashti, they receive a dire warning about what lies even deeper in the Abomination Vaults.

Advancement

The heroes should be 5th level before addressing the theft and dream-possession in town.

Milestone: The heroes advance to 6th level after clearing out most of the Arena level.

@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5]{Chapter 5: Into the Training Grounds}

by Vanessa Hoskins

The heroes recover four icons from Otari's founders to access deeper dungeon levels and meet townspeople with surprising connections to the dungeon.

Advancement

The heroes should be 6th level upon entering the Laboratories level.

Milestone: The heroes advance to 7th level after defeating Jafaki and the seugathis.

@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ]{Chapter 6: Experiments in Flesh}

by Vanessa Hoskins

In old alchemical laboratories, the heroes can foil a seugathi's schemes.

Advancement

The heroes should be 7th level upon entering the Prison level.

Milestone: The heroes advance to 8th level after dealing with Urevian.

@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ]{Chapter 7: Soul Keepers}

by Vanessa Hoskins

A contract devil named Urevian must fulfill a centuries-old agreement, but the heroes might strike a deal with the devil to save the town.

Advancement

The heroes should be 8th level upon entering the Farm level.

Milestone: The heroes advance to 9th level after clearing out most of the Farm level.

@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf]{Chapter 8: Decaying Gardens}

by Stephen Radney-MacFarland

The heroes encounter a strange caligni cult and a cabal of undead gnomes.

Advancement

The heroes should be 9th level upon entering the Hunting Grounds level.

Milestone: The heroes advance to 10th level upon entering the Gate of Nhimbaloth.

@UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc]{Chapter 9: On the Hunt}

by Stephen Radney-MacFarland

In the enormous Hunting Grounds level, the heroes can learn the secret to defeating Belcorra and find the required fulcrum lenses.

Advancement

The heroes should be 10th level upon entering the Temple level.

Milestone: The heroes advance to 11th level after (or, perhaps, just before) defeating Belcorra.

@UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol]{Chapter 10: To Draw the Baleful Glare}

by Stephen Radney-MacFarland

The heroes explore an ancient temple of the Outer God Nhimbaloth and take the fight to Belcorra once and for all!

Getting Started.name: 入门 Getting Started
Getting Started.text:
本模组随附大量日志条目，提供详细的房间描述、NPC 传记，以及其他工具。只要条件允许，我们会尽量在日志本身链接到相关条目，确保你随时都能掌握有用信息。如果你决定运行《憎恨魔窟》冒险路径，这里有一些有用的日志，供你入门阅读！

规划你的游戏

本日志包含数页实用材料，帮助你决定如何开始规划，并最终运行你的战役。你可以使用左侧的目录来导航到这些页面。

根据你想从哪里开始，你可以阅读推荐的 @UUID[.uGgoAibjz5qhnqmL]{成长} 规则，或查阅 @UUID[.8aIgvvxLjsYxB1LS]{章节概述} 来快速了解冒险事件梗概。

使用本模组分类包含数页建议，说明如何阅读这些日志，以及如何使用其中的信息。

冒险工具箱

如果你想进一步了解奥塔里的过去与凄凉灯塔的历史，@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ]{冒险工具箱}包含一条关键日期与事件的时间线，以及数页对本地历史与事件的详尽介绍。

如今的奥塔里最适合通过 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{奥塔里地志} 来呈现；该日志也描述了城镇中每个主要地点，并提供可在当地找到的 NPC 信息。

你还可以在角色传记中阅读故事里最重要的角色，以帮助你充实他们的动机与过去。

使用本内容

@UUID[.mH6Z1rs7XY2Agp9q]{遭遇} @UUID[.qkriih9KjZ8YA9za]{探索} @UUID[.N725007XsfScJ6hd]{宝藏} @UUID[.yJnbkL33UerrQWr9]{使用音频}

如果你看到像这样的方框，意味着我们提供了关于如何最好地利用本模组及其内容的建议。标题将包含指向相关日志文章、物品等的链接。例如，这里列出的链接会继续本段说明！点击每一个链接，了解一种不同类型的方框——在后续日志中你也会看到与之类似的方框。

进入冒险

我们已经介绍了那些涵盖战役背景信息，以及如何使用本模组的一般建议的日志。那么最后一组日志，就是实际的冒险本身。这些日志按章节组织，你可以在右侧边栏的“日志”标签页中找到它们。@UUID[JournalEntry.huN2s6RInuTublnV.JournalEntryPage.8aIgvvxLjsYxB1LS]{章节概述}页面中的各个标题也分别链接到其对应的日志。

每一章的日志条目包含该章所有必要的故事与剧情事件，并按其在书中出现的顺序排列。通常，它们先从该章关键剧情要素的概述开始，然后继续提供逐房间的描述，详述玩家可能在其中发现的每个生物、事件或物品。

冒险开始

《憎恨魔窟》冒险路径主要聚焦于庞大的地城复合体；本战役从英雄们首次接近地表的 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{凄凉灯塔遗迹} 开始。他们共同的朋友 @UUID[Actor.ZDYMKYZVyR8Fqakp]{瓦琳·希温尼斯} 已经向他们简要说明：她曾目睹遗迹那座高耸灯塔顶端出现诡异的发光。从奥塔里出发，除了瓦琳之外无人能辨认出这道发光；但若英雄们在夜里于遗迹附近仰望，便能证实瓦琳那超自然般敏锐的眼睛 从镇上就捕捉到的景象——灯塔顶端确实会在入夜后泛起微弱、阴森的蓝光。

当然，你不必把战役起点放在地城的“字面前廊”上——若你愿意，你可以通过角色扮演来让英雄们更平缓地进入剧情：比如先演绎他们与瓦琳的初次遭遇（也许是她为他们进行一次占星解读），或让英雄们先在镇上逗留一段时间，进行临行采购或去酒馆一趟。在这种情况下，请参阅 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{奥塔里地志} 或 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.raJDQ95RBqeXxV14]{瓦琳的传记}；但真正的乐趣要等到英雄们沿着凄凉小径前往雾隐沼泽中那令人不安的遗迹时才会开始！

内容警告：

《憎恨魔窟》包含典型的《探路者》动作与冒险内容，但也呈现自杀、健全主义歧视（ableism）、躯体恐怖与人体实验等主题。在你开始之前，请理解：玩家同意（包括游戏主持人的同意）对确保所有人获得安全且愉快的游戏体验至关重要。你应该在开始前与玩家沟通，并视情况修改描述或情境。

This module comes packaged with a host of journal entries providing detailed room descriptions, NPC biographies, and other tools. Wherever possible, we will try to link to relevant entries within the journals themselves, so that you've always got useful information at hand. If you've decided to run the Abomination Vaults adventure path, here are some of the useful journals you could read to get started!

Planning your Game

This journal contains several pages containing useful material to help you to decide how to get started with planning and eventually running your campaign. You can use the table of contents on the left-hand side to navigate to them.

Depending on where you want to start, you could read about the suggested @UUID[.uGgoAibjz5qhnqmL]{Advancement} rules, or consult the @UUID[.8aIgvvxLjsYxB1LS]{Chapter Synopses} for a brief overview of the events of the adventure.

The Using This Module category contains several pages with advice on how to read the journals and how to use the information they contain.

Adventure Toolbox

If you'd like to learn more about Otari's past and the history of Gauntlight, the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ]{Adventure Toolbox} contains a timeline of critical dates and events, as well as several pages containing a detailed view of local history and events.

The town of Otari as it is today is best presented by the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{Otari Gazetteer}, and the journal also has a description of each major location in the town, with information about the NPCs that can be found there.

You can also read about the story's most important characters in the Character Biographies to help you to flesh out their motivations and past.

Using this Content

@UUID[.mH6Z1rs7XY2Agp9q]{Encounters} @UUID[.qkriih9KjZ8YA9za]{Exploration} @UUID[.N725007XsfScJ6hd]{Treasure} @UUID[.yJnbkL33UerrQWr9]{Using Audio}

If you ever see a box like this one, that means we have advice about how best to make use of the module and its content. The header will include links to relevant journal articles, items, and so on. For instance, the ones listed here continue this explanation! Click on each one to learn about a different type of box just like this one that you'll see in the journals to come.

Into the Adventure

We've already covered the journals which cover background information on the campaign and general advice on how to use this module. The last set of journals, then, are the actual adventure itself. These journals are organized by chapter, and you can find them in the Journals tab of the right-hand sidebar. The headers in the @UUID[JournalEntry.huN2s6RInuTublnV.JournalEntryPage.8aIgvvxLjsYxB1LS]{Chapter Synopses} page also each link to their corresponding journal.

Each chapter's journal entry contains all essential story and plot events for that chapter, arranged in the same order as they appear in the book. Typically, they start with an overview of that chapter's key plot elements, then go on to include room-by-room descriptions that detail every creature, event, or item that the players might find within.

Beginning the Adventure

The Abomination Vaults Adventure Path focuses primarily on the sprawling dungeon complex, and this campaign begins as the heroes approach the aboveground @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight Ruins} for the first time. Their mutual friend, @UUID[Actor.ZDYMKYZVyR8Fqakp]{Wrin Sivinxi}, has already briefed them about her sighting of a strange glow atop the ruin’s towering lighthouse. From Otari, no one other than Wrin can make out this glow, but if the heroes look up at night from the immediate environs, they can confirm what Wrin’s supernaturally acute eyes picked out from town—the top of the lighthouse does indeed glow a faint, eerie blue after dark.

Of course, you don’t have to start this campaign on the literal front porch of the dungeon—if you wish, you can ease the heroes by roleplaying their initial encounter with Wrin (perhaps as she gives them an astrology reading), or after the heroes spend time in town involving some last-minute shopping or a trip to a tavern. In this case, consult the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{Otari Gazetteer} or @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.raJDQ95RBqeXxV14]{Wrin's biography}, but the fun doesn't truly begin until the heroes head up the Gaunt Trail to the foreboding ruins in Fogfen!

Content Warning:

While Abomination Vaults contains typical Pathfinder action and adventure, it also presents themes of suicide, ableism, body horror, and human experimentation. Before you begin, understand that player consent (including that of the Game Master) is vital to a safe and fun play experience for everyone. You should talk with your players before beginning and modify descriptions or scenarios as appropriate.

Advancement.name: 进阶 Advancement
Advancement.text:
来自入门盒

如果你以《探路者入门盒》与冒险《奥塔里地下的威胁》作为英雄们职业生涯的起点，那么你的英雄已经了解奥塔里。他们也已经是2级了！你不需要对本冒险做任何调整，因为2级角色可以毫无困难地开始本冒险。不要让他们升到3级，直到他们在地城上方两个楼层中已大幅清除其中的危险。

使用经验值

虽然@UUID[JournalEntry.huN2s6RInuTublnV]{憎恨魔窟}的每个等级都是以一群处于特定角色等级的英雄为前提来构建的，但每个等级都提供了绰绰有余的遭遇，足以让队伍升级。大型地城探索的乐趣之一在于探索每一个角落与缝隙，而一支面对每一场遭遇的队伍，可能在这条冒险路径结束之前就获得足够的经验值达到更高等级——这也没问题！一些后续遭遇依然能很好地挑战高等级队伍，即便英雄们需要较少频率地撤退、休息与恢复。

地城提供了大量的自由探索，尤其是在中层。让玩家自行判断他们的角色是否已力有不逮，并在局势要求时撤退（或逃跑！）。当英雄面对对其当前等级而言比预期更困难的挑战时，他们会获得更多XP；而当他们面对比预期更容易的挑战时，他们会获得更少XP。这能让他们的成长大致保持在同一轨道上。尽管如此，如果你想要节奏更慢的游戏，《憎恨魔窟》也很适合采用慢速升级（《探路者核心规则书》509页）。

使用里程碑

基于故事的成长方式在巨型地城探索中可能很棘手，因为英雄可以通过多条路线在各等级之间移动。如果你更喜欢基于故事的成长方式，而不是仅因为英雄们快速抵达了更深的地城等级就自动允许他们升级，那么请考虑要求他们完成特定里程碑才能升级，详见@UUID[.8aIgvvxLjsYxB1LS]{章节概要}中的“成长”部分。

From the Beginner Box

If you started the heroes' careers with the Pathfinder Beginner Box and the adventure "Menace Under Otari," your heroes already know about Otari. They're also already 2nd level! You don't need to make any adjustments to this adventure, as 2nd level characters can begin it without any trouble. Don't allow them to level up to 3rd level until they've substantially cleared the dangers in both of the upper two dungeon levels.

Using Experience Points

While each level of the @UUID[JournalEntry.huN2s6RInuTublnV]{Abomination Vaults} is built with the assumption of a group of heroes at a particular character level, each has more than enough encounters for a party to level up. Part of the joy of a large dungeon crawl is the exploration of every nook and cranny, and a party who faces every encounter might gain enough experience points to reach higher levels well before the end of this Adventure Path- and that's fine! Some later encounters challenge a high-level party well enough, even if the heroes have to retreat, rest, and recover less often.

The dungeon provides lots of freedom to explore, particularly in the middle levels. Let the players gauge whether their characters are in over their heads and retreat (or flee!) if the situation demands it. When the heroes face harder-than-expected challenges for their current level, they earn more XP, and when they face easier-than-expected ones, they earn less. This keeps their progression on roughly the same track. That said, if you want a slower-paced game, Abomination Vaults works well with a slow Advancement Speed (Pathfinder Core Rulebook 509).

Using Milestones

Story-based progression can be tricky for a giant dungeon crawl since the heroes can move between levels through multiple routes. If you prefer story-based progression, rather than automatically allowing the heroes to level up simply because they quickly reached a lower dungeon level, consider requiring them to complete specific milestones to level up, as detailed in the "advancement" section in @UUID[.8aIgvvxLjsYxB1LS]{Chapter Synopses}.

Exploration.name: 探索 Exploration
Exploration.text:
你应该留意玩家让他们的角色在探索时通常会做什么。你可以在《Pathfinder 核心规则书》中找到探索行动的列表，或者在 @Compendium[pf2e.pf2e-macros.s2sa8lo9dcIA6UGe]{Compendium Browser} 的 Actions 选项卡中按 探索 特征进行筛选——或者，你也可以直接让每位玩家描述他们的角色在做什么，然后决定哪种探索行动最符合他们的描述。

探索框

某些效果会根据英雄是在进行调查行动、搜索，还是进行其他探索行动，而在房间条目中列出。这些效果会用特殊的提示框标示出来，例如下面的示例。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

搜索房间

英雄在搜索房间时，若在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功，则会发现北墙上挂毯后面藏着一扇暗门。

调查马赛克

进行一次 @Check[type:society|dc:20|traits:action:decipher-writing]{Society} 检定以 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{文书解读}，会揭示北墙上的神秘文字是一句古老的精灵谚语。

动作

在探索提示框中，你需要留意的相关动作会列在标题处。例如在这个例子里，我们知道如果任何玩家正在使用 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 或 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}，他们可能会获得额外信息。这两者是最常见的两种探索行动，但其他的，例如 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} 或 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}，也同样有用。当然，即便他们没有进行所列出的特定探索行动，你也完全可以随时用信息、暗门或宝藏来奖励你的玩家！

你大概已经注意到了：这些链接除了作为你应留意哪些行动的参考之外，你也可以点击它们来查看该探索行动的完整规则文本。

检定

有时这些探索行动会需要掷骰，就像你在上面的段落中看到的那样。在整个冒险中，大多数技能检定与豁免检定都会以这种格式呈现。按下按钮旁的对话气泡图标，你可以把它输出到聊天栏，让你的玩家只要点击它（并选中他们的指示物！）就能掷骰进行检定。这完全是可选功能，但能让你一眼看出成功度，是个很方便的方法。

不过有时候，只要角色花费时间去搜索房间，他们就会找到某样东西。

You should take note of what the players have their characters generally do as they explore. You can find a list of exploration activities in the Pathfinder Core Rulebook or by filtering for the exploration trait in the Actions tab of the @Compendium[pf2e.pf2e-macros.s2sa8lo9dcIA6UGe]{Compendium Browser}- or, you can just ask each player to describe what their character does and decide which exploration activity best fits their description.

Exploration Boxes

Certain effects are listed in the rooms based on whether a hero is Investigating, Searching, or performing another exploration activity. These effects are marked by special callout boxes, such as the example below.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Searching the Room

A hero that succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check while searching the room finds a secret door behind the tapestry hanging on the north wall.

Investigating the Mosaic

A @Check[type:society|dc:20|traits:action:decipher-writing]{Society} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} reveals that the mysterious script on the northern wall is an old Elvish proverb.

Actions

In the exploration callout boxes, the relevant actions you need to look out for will be listed in the header. For example, in this case, we know that if any of our players are using @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} or @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}, they may learn additional information. These are the most common two exploration activities, but others, such as @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} or @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}, will also be useful. Of course, you should feel free to reward your players with information, secret doors, or treasure even if they aren't doing the specific exploration activity that's listed!

As you've probably already noticed, as well as being a reference for which activities to look out for, you can also click on these links to see the full rules text of that exploration activity.

Checks

Sometimes these exploration activities will require a roll, as you can see in the above section. Throughout the adventure, most skill checks and saving throws will be presented in this format. By pressing the speech bubble icon next to the button, you can print it to chat, allowing your players to simply click it (with their token selected!) to roll a check. This is quite optional but can be a handy way to tell degrees of success at a glance.

Sometimes, however a character who searches a room will find something as long as they simply spend the time to do so.

Encounters.name: 遭遇 Encounters
Encounters.text:
当英雄们探索憎恨魔窟时，他们不可避免地会遇到必须击败的敌人，才能拯救奥塔里——甚至是艾巴萨罗姆本身！当这种情况发生时，他们就进入了一场遭遇。

遭遇框

在阅读区域描述时，你会经常看到一些房间里有生物，玩家最终可能会与之战斗。在这些地方，像这样的遭遇框会包含你运行该遭遇所需的全部信息。

当然，并非每场遭遇都必须以战斗收场。许多遭遇是可选的，或为英雄提供外交的机会。仅仅因为它在这些框里，并不意味着某个生物就无法被说服，甚至最终成为一名盟友！

遭遇

中等 2

@Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.ZMr28tFTA5NUcBTi]{伏网怪} @Compendium[pf2e.hazards.Or0jjL8xS3GyiMq0]{伏网怪套索（2）}

76 XP

一个可怖的敌人躲藏着，等待毫无戒心的过路者。

伏网怪很饥饿，但并不鲁莽。如果它意识到英雄们强大到它无法应付，它会逃跑。

危害

需要担心的不只是蜘蛛——伏网怪布置了两道套索来捕捉不够谨慎的冒险者！

每场遭遇中涉及的生物会列在页眉中以便快速许可，并且它们的指示物已为你放置在地图上。页眉还会告诉你该遭遇是否为危害、作祟或类似情况，以及该遭遇的威胁评级与经验预算。请注意，尽管后两者通常相关，但在某些情况下，经验预算会与预期略有不同——尤其是在包含简易危害或极其弱小的敌人时！

正文文本包含对生物战术或优先事项的描述，以及其他有用信息，例如潜在的环境危害或宝藏。

授予经验

尽管我们为你提供了数值，但一如既往，你可以自行决定：是将该遭遇的总经验值分配给玩家，依据威胁等级授予特定数量，或是如 @UUID[.uGgoAibjz5qhnqmL]{进度} 日志中所详述的那样，直接使用里程碑升级。

As they explore the Abomination Vaults, the heroes will inevitably come across foes that must be defeated in order to save Otari- or even Absalom itself! When they do, they enter an encounter.

Encounter Boxes

When reading the area descriptions, you will often come across rooms containing creatures which the players may end up fighting. In those places, encounter boxes such as these will contain all of the information you'll need to run the encounter.

Of course, not every encounter has to end in combat. Many are optional, or provide the heroes with an opportunity for diplomacy. Just because it's in one of these boxes, it doesn't mean that a creature couldn't be reasoned with, or even eventually become an ally!

Encounter

Moderate 2

@Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.ZMr28tFTA5NUcBTi]{Web Lurker} @Compendium[pf2e.hazards.Or0jjL8xS3GyiMq0]{Web Lurker Nooses (2)}

76 XP

A terrifying foe hides in wait for unsuspecting passers-by.

The web lurker is hungry, but not reckless. It will run if it realises the heroes are too much for it to take on.

Hazards

There's more than just spiders to worry about- the web lurker has strung up two nooses to catch unwary adventurers!

The creatures involved in each encounter are listed in the header for quick access, and their tokens are already placed for you on the map. The header will also tell you whether an encounter is a hazard, haunt, or similar, as well as the encounter's threat rating and experience budget. Note that while those last two are often related, there are cases where the experience budget will vary slightly from what you might expect- especially when there are simple hazards or extremely weak enemies involved!

The body text includes a description of the creatures' tactics or priorities, as well as other useful information like potential environmental hazards or treasure.

Awarding Experience

Although we provide the numbers for you, as always, it's up to you whether you'd like to allocate the players the total experience value of the encounter, award a specific amount based on threat level, or simply use milestone levelling as detailed in the @UUID[.uGgoAibjz5qhnqmL]{Advancement} journal.

Treasure.name: 宝藏 Treasure
Treasure.text:
当英雄们深入探索《憎恨魔窟》时，他们很可能会发掘出珍贵的财宝或强大的魔法物品。

一般来说，你的玩家能够获得的所有财宝都会列在该区域描述的日志条目中。通过 @UUID[.mH6Z1rs7XY2Agp9q]{遭遇} 或 @UUID[.qkriih9KjZ8YA9za]{探索} 获得的物品，通常可以在各自的标注框中找到；而其他类型的宝藏则会有单独的框，就像这个一样。

宝藏框

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.LJdbVTOZog39EEbi]{一把闪亮的长剑} @Actor[S8VDmNHzkFEmjWfL]{一只进水的箱子} 

在洞穴深处坐落着一堆闪闪发光的宝藏！

发放物品

如你所见，我们可以用两种不同方式链接到宝藏。直接链接到物品的链接（如上面的长剑）可以直接从日志拖到玩家的角色卡上。另一些情况下，尤其当同一处地点有大量不同物品时，我们会提供战利品演员（loot actors），例如上面的“进水的箱子”。它们的指示物会被放置在场景上，且默认隐藏。它们可以包含多个物品；将这些物品交给玩家就像揭示该指示物一样简单。玩家将能够打开战利品表，并通过把物品拖入自己物品栏的方式直接从中取走物品。

作为宝藏的硬币

硬币是唯一一种不会在日志中以链接形式提供的宝藏。这是因为玩家已经有一种简单方式可将硬币添加到角色卡上——通过物品栏中的“添加货币”功能。

修改宝藏

如果你打算修改玩家将会找到的物品，或你想了解他们可能会入手的物品类型，你可以查看下方列表。该列表列出了每一章的所有永久与消耗类魔法物品，但不包含只在交易中有用的宝物。当然，你的玩家很可能不会找到《憎恨魔窟》所提供的每一件宝藏！
